32404350.takeaway: In neonatal mice, deleting the m6A regulators Mettl3 and Mettl14 impaired beta-cell maturation through MafA mRNA stability, and reduced expression was also seen in islets of patients with type 2 diabetes.

32409491.takeaway: In mice, dexamethasone given in late pregnancy reduced fetal brown fat development through increased Ppargc1a promoter methylation, leaving offspring with insulin resistance, adiposity and cold sensitivity.

32410303.takeaway: Among 94 patients with bilateral pheochromocytoma at Mayo Clinic, 80% had a genetic disease, most often MEN 2A, and most synchronous tumors were treated with simultaneous bilateral adrenalectomy.

32410305.takeaway: In 128 families of children aged 5 to 9 with new type 1 diabetes, parental hypoglycemia worry rose over 18 months, and baseline parental depression modified that trajectory.

32410329.takeaway: Among 343 youth with diabetes seen at an eye center, retinopathy was found in 3.8%, and none with HbA1c below 8% had it.

32410357.takeaway: Diabetes incidence in Austrian children under 15 rose steadily until about 2012, driven by the youngest age group, then leveled off, with type 1 diabetes making up 94% of cases.

32411089.takeaway: Among 29 women with PCOS and 29 BMI-matched controls, 15 microRNAs differed after false discovery correction, and none were linked to BMI, androgens, insulin resistance or AMH.

32411094.takeaway: Two Danish MEN 2A patients with RET L790F, diagnosed with medullary thyroid cancer at ages 14 and 70, had no germline RET variant explaining the difference; a somatic FLT3 variant was found.

32413117.takeaway: Children with nephropathic cystinosis had an 11-fold higher risk of short stature, bone deformities or skeletal surgery than CKD controls, despite Fanconi syndrome treatment.

32413135.takeaway: In 206 adolescents aged 8 to 14, medium-chain acylcarnitines were inversely associated with insulin resistance, with sex-specific metabolite patterns linked to BMI z-score.

32413843.takeaway: Heterozygous aggrecan mutations can cause isolated short stature with advanced bone age, so genetic evaluation of children with idiopathic short stature may identify monogenic causes.

32413848.takeaway: Spot urine metanephrine ratios correlated closely with 24-hour urine outputs in 3,143 specimens from 2,416 patients, supporting spot urine as a practical alternative for pheochromocytoma screening.

32418261.takeaway: In 31 children with celiac disease and islet autoimmunity at diagnosis, a gluten-free diet was associated with decreased or disappearing islet autoantibodies in 71%.

32418262.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes enrolled in 2019 ate more protein and fat and less carbohydrate and fiber than those enrolled in 2009, and their HbA1c was lower.

32418263.takeaway: In a systematic review of 502 neonatal diabetes cases from KATP channel mutations, transfer from insulin to sulfonylurea succeeded in 91% with KCNJ11 and 86.5% with ABCC8 variants, with response varying by genotype.

32418266.takeaway: Among 192 Danish youths aged 11 to 19 with type 1 diabetes, 21% had disordered eating, including 34% of girls versus 9% of boys, and those affected had higher BMI z-scores.

32418302.takeaway: In a pilot randomized trial of 21 youths on multiple daily injections, an algorithm that adjusted insulin doses achieved time in target similar to physician adjustments (39.5% vs 38.4%), with 92% of its changes accepted.

32418308.takeaway: Among 125 children with type 1 diabetes, those with two foreign-born parents had more DKA at onset and higher HbA1c, and reported different quality-of-life scores than children of Italian parents.

32418334.takeaway: In 158 youth with overweight or obesity, visceral fat was the fat compartment most strongly linked to oxidative stress, and higher vitamin D was associated with lower oxidative stress in those with more visceral fat.

32418360.takeaway: Among 37 children with monogenic diabetes at a South Indian centre, 15 had neonatal diabetes, five had MODY, and 13 had Wolfram syndrome.

32419140.takeaway: Among 508 Chilean girls, 37 (7.3%) had transient thelarche, and they more often entered puberty through pubarche (51% vs 23%).

32419214.takeaway: In 26 women with MEN 1 across 96 pregnancies, hyperparathyroidism occurred in 16 pregnancies, and gestational diabetes was far more common than the Australian average (56% vs 8.9%).

32421355.takeaway: In 13 youths using hybrid closed-loop systems, time in range stayed good through the Italian COVID-19 lockdown and was higher during full lockdown (72%) than during partial restrictions (66%).

32421787.takeaway: In 63 girls with Turner syndrome treated with GH dosed by IGF-1 titration, only 6% had supranormal IGF-1 levels, at a median dose of 33 μg/kg/day.

32421827.takeaway: Three novel pathogenic HMGA2 variants were found in five patients from three Silver-Russell syndrome families, including homozygosity in a severely affected sibling pair, while heterozygous parents were mildly affected.

32422605.takeaway: In 36 boys with non-palpable testes, serum AMH, inhibin B, FSH and hCG-stimulated testosterone cut-offs were derived to tell functional testicular tissue from anorchia.

32424540.takeaway: Higher average weight z-scores in each childhood growth period predicted type 2 diabetes incidence in 2,100 American Indian participants followed for up to 25 years, with rate ratios of about 1.7 to 2.1 per SD.

32424871.takeaway: A compound heterozygous TPO mutation in a 23-year-old Chinese woman with congenital hypothyroidism was analysed functionally, and structural modelling predicted damage to the enzyme.

32425882.takeaway: In 50,019 adults followed for ten years, mean BMI rose under age 60 and fell in older adults, while estimated body fat rose at all ages.

32425884.takeaway: Among 377 congenital hypothyroidism cases, DUOX2 variants were most common (21%), with DUOXA2 more prominent in thyroid dysgenesis and DUOX2 in gland-in-situ cases.

32428920.takeaway: TRPC4AP variants were found in patients with thyroid dysgenesis, including a de novo stop codon, and knockdown in Xenopus tadpoles reduced thyroid anlage volume.

32430458.takeaway: In 463 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, insulin glargine 300 U/mL matched glargine 100 U/mL for HbA1c reduction at week 26, confirming noninferiority.

32430905.takeaway: Among 121 UK patients referred for hereditary hyperparathyroidism testing, a pathogenic germline variant was found in 16%.

32430977.takeaway: In 85 at-risk children followed in ENDIA, fecal elastase fell over time in those who developed islet autoimmunity, sometimes before autoantibodies appeared.

32431136.takeaway: In 14 children with iatrogenic Cushing syndrome from potent glucocorticoids, 12 had adrenal insufficiency at presentation, and HPA axis recovery took a median of 60 days.

32431137.takeaway: In 124 adolescents, serum DEHP and MEHP did not differ between 63 with PCOS and 61 controls, so these phthalates did not separate the groups.

32431667.takeaway: In five pinealectomized patients, three months of melatonin raised vagal heart-rate-variability measures, including RMSSD and high-frequency power.

32431668.takeaway: Among 251 girls with central precocious puberty who had detailed brain MRI, 75.7% had no brain abnormality, and 24.3% had hypothalamic or pituitary findings.

32431669.takeaway: A systematic review of 10 studies found that children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes tended to have more severe periodontal disease than healthy peers.

32432211.takeaway: Among 81 French children with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, 10-year event-free survival was 39%, while overall survival was 97%.

32433752.takeaway: In people without CAH who were exposed to dexamethasone in early pregnancy, HOMA-β was lower than in 75 controls, mainly in girls, with no overall effect on lipids.

32434441.takeaway: Among 41,911 pregnant women screened in early pregnancy in Shanghai, isolated maternal hypothyroxinemia was associated with a higher risk of preterm birth (OR 1.32).

32435230.takeaway: An overweight adolescent girl with very high DHEAS but no adrenal tumor had a heterozygous steroid sulfatase nonsense variant, with a transporter defect suggested as a mechanism.

32436858.takeaway: In 133 patients with GH deficiency, the pons ratio on pituitary MRI was higher than in 47 controls, and a cut-off of 0.27 gave 71% sensitivity and 56% specificity.

32436859.takeaway: A 3.5-month-old infant with extreme hypertriglyceridemia was diagnosed with glycogen storage disease type Ia from a homozygous G6PC variant.

32436860.takeaway: A 36-year-old with type 1 diabetes had drug-refractory focal epilepsy linked to elevated GAD-65 autoantibodies in serum and cerebrospinal fluid, with epilepsy diagnosed a decade before diabetes.

32436861.takeaway: Two siblings with neurofibromatosis type 1 presented at ages 6 and 7 with cyclical vaginal bleeding and prepubertal GnRH responses, consistent with isolated premature menarche.

32436948.takeaway: An 18-year-old woman developed subacute thyroiditis 15 days after a mild SARS-CoV-2 infection, the first such case reported.

32436949.takeaway: Serum chromogranin A was raised in 66% of people with neuroendocrine tumors, 39% with type 1 diabetes, 38% with autoimmune gastritis and 24% with autoimmune polyendocrinopathy.

32436958.takeaway: Whole-genome sequencing found two novel GNAS deletions in pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A, one of which reduced methylation of the exon A/B region, identifying a new region that affects imprinting.

32436961.takeaway: In 363 young adults born SGA, metabolic and bone outcomes after GH with or without two years of GnRH analogue were similar over five years after GH cessation, although fat mass rose in both groups.

32439825.takeaway: Among 50 people with type 1 diabetes who carried the protective HLA-DQB1*06:02 allele, average HbA1c at diagnosis was 10.8%, showing that they failed this genetic protection.

32441669.takeaway: A 12-year-old Jamaican girl first diagnosed with type 1 diabetes was found to have type A severe insulin resistance from a novel heterozygous INSR missense variant.

32441670.takeaway: Among 177 girls with precocious puberty, basal LH, estradiol and pelvic ultrasound measures identified rapidly progressive central precocious puberty, with diagnostic power rising as abnormal parameters accumulated.

32441671.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes had thicker epicardial fat and longer P-wave, QT and Tp-e dispersion than 41 matched healthy children, suggesting early cardiac conduction changes.

32442282.takeaway: A three-question telephone screen identified PCOS with 89% sensitivity and 78% specificity in community women aged 14 to 45.

32445735.takeaway: In 147 young adults with early type 2 diabetes, an intensive lifestyle programme with diet replacement cut body weight by about 6 kg more than usual care at 12 months.

32445737.takeaway: In an individual-participant meta-analysis of 48,145 mother-child pairs, maternal subclinical hypothyroidism was associated with higher risk of small-for-gestational-age infants (11.8% vs 10.0%).

32447329.takeaway: In 1,171 obese adolescents aged 10 to 16, the triglyceride/HDL ratio identified metabolic syndrome more accurately than HOMA-IR (AUC 0.849 vs 0.689).

32447330.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with Prader-Willi syndrome and diabetes improved glycemia with an SGLT-2 inhibitor combined with a GLP-1 agonist after growth hormone was stopped.

32447331.takeaway: Among 85 Turkish patients with urea cycle disorders, classical citrullinemia was most common and had the highest mortality, and higher peak ammonia was seen in patients who died.

32447332.takeaway: Among 3,524 Korean children born full term, 13.4% were born SGA, and those who had not caught up made up 36.4% of children with short stature; shorter parental heights predicted SGA birth.

32447333.takeaway: Among 34 Chinese patients with mucopolysaccharidosis III, speech delay and intellectual disability were universal, with 19 having type IIIB and 14 type IIIA.

32447334.takeaway: Expanded newborn screening of 220,443 infants in Tianjin identified 25 fatty acid oxidation disorders (1 in 8,817), most often primary carnitine deficiency at 1 in 20,040.

32447335.takeaway: In 532 obese children, a 1-hour OGTT glucose of 155 mg/dL or more was linked to a less favorable lipid profile, even among children with normal glucose tolerance.

32447336.takeaway: Among 24,321 German and Austrian children with new type 1 diabetes, about 19% presented in DKA, and these children were treated at centers closer to home regardless of center size.

32447804.takeaway: In 200 Colombian families with type 1 diabetes, a RNASEH1 variant (rs7607888) was associated with the disease and interacted with HLA tagSNPs.

32448901.takeaway: In 36 patients with MEN2B, diffusion abnormalities were found in 94%, and diffusion capacity declined by about 2.9% per year.

32449692.takeaway: Thyroid cancer after childhood cancer, in 31 survivors matched to 93 sporadic cases, tended to be smaller and more often bilateral, and 46% were found by surveillance neck palpation.

32451572.takeaway: Among 27,935 people with type 1 diabetes in Scotland, crude mortality before age 50 fell from 2004 to 2017, but standardized mortality stayed about three to four times that of the general population.

32453405.takeaway: In 271 low-risk thyroid cancer patients not given radioiodine, thyroglobulin correlated with TSH over follow-up, so Tg changes need to be read alongside TSH.

32454486.takeaway: In 10 patients with hypopituitarism and eyelid anomalies, three had FOXL2 mutations, all with typical BPES, and their pituitary deficits ranged from isolated GH deficiency to complete deficiency.

32457058.takeaway: In 80 TrialNet participants followed through diagnosis, C-peptide stayed stable until about six months before type 1 diabetes was diagnosed and then declined.

32457700.takeaway: A woman with genetically confirmed Carney complex and ACTH-independent hypercortisolism was treated with metyrapone, which prolonged her pregnancy by five weeks, and her newborn needed hydrocortisone for transient hyponatremia.

32459310.takeaway: In pediatric papillary thyroid cancer, extracellular-vesicle PD-L1 correlated with clinical features and contributed to suppression of T cells.

32459320.takeaway: Targeted sequencing of 167 congenital hypothyroidism cases found variants in 66.5%, but 68.5% of those variants were of unknown significance.

32460296.takeaway: Among 46 patients with craniopharyngioma followed for a median of 12.8 years, the share with at least one affected pituitary axis rose from 54% at presentation.

32460688.takeaway: A standardized map of iodine status across Europe was built by postharmonizing urinary iodine data from 40 studies in 23 countries against a gold-standard laboratory.

32468610.takeaway: A three-generation pedigree with the GCK p.Leu122Val variant supports its pathogenicity and provides the first phenotype description for this variant in MODY.

32469330.takeaway: In 136 Japanese infants with congenital hypothyroidism, sequencing gave a likely molecular diagnosis in 19%, most often from biallelic DUOX2 variants, while 23% carried single variants in recessive genes.

32469331.takeaway: In 23 children with obesity but no hypertension, circulating chemerin correlated with systolic blood pressure load on 24-hour monitoring (r = 0.5).

32469332.takeaway: In 17,066 Turkish newborns screened by tandem mass spectrometry, the authors established local acylcarnitine and amino acid cut-offs for 26 inborn errors of metabolism.

32469333.takeaway: Serum soluble α-Klotho was significantly lower in 46 children with type 1 diabetes than in 78 controls under age 12.

32469429.takeaway: Of 87,815 US pediatric DKA admissions from 2010 to 2014, 4.6% were followed by an all-cause readmission within 30 days.

32471808.takeaway: Among 29 patients with painful diabetic neuropathy, those with an irritable nociceptor phenotype were 8.7 times more likely to respond to intravenous lidocaine.

32471809.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes performed worse on a working memory task than 47 controls and showed greater brain activation modulation, which was linked to better performance and earlier diagnosis.

32471909.takeaway: During an induced hyperglycemic clamp, 20 adolescents with type 1 diabetes had lower spatial working memory capacity than during euglycemia.

32471910.takeaway: In 109 people with type 1 diabetes, switching from predictive low-glucose suspend to closed-loop control raised time in range by 5.9 percentage points over three months.

32476492.takeaway: A machine learning model using CGM data from 112 patients predicted hypoglycemia with over 91% sensitivity and over 90% specificity at 30- and 60-minute horizons.

32477268.takeaway: This review asks whether myelin deficits in MCT8 deficiency are delayed or permanent, noting that case reports suggest delayed myelination while post-mortem and MRI studies suggest persistent white matter abnormalities.

32477270.takeaway: Among 1,720 youths aged 5 to 25 with overweight or obesity in a US health system, anti-obesity medications were often used off label, since only two are FDA-approved for children.

32479603.takeaway: In 586 short children born preterm and treated with GH in the KIGS database, height SDS gained 1.82 over GH treatment in those born appropriate for gestational age.

32480405.takeaway: In 16 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, two (13%) carried whole-gene MKRN3 deletions, both paternally inherited, and one had no typical Prader-Willi features beyond obesity.

32482020.takeaway: In an infant with ABCC8-related congenital hyperinsulinism who still had severe hypoglycemia after subtotal pancreatectomy, sirolimus markedly improved glycemic control, and it was stopped at 15 months.

32483683.takeaway: Across 90 prominent type 2 diabetes trials with 268,978 participants, mean age was 63 years, so adults aged 18 to 39 with early-onset disease were severely underrepresented.

32486989.takeaway: A girl with congenital hypothyroidism was homozygous for a novel frameshift in SLC26A7, predicted to be nonfunctional, pointing to this thyroid anion transporter in dyshormonogenesis.

32487778.takeaway: In 86 adults tested for suspected nonclassic 21-hydroxylase deficiency, baseline serum steroids measured by mass spectrometry were used to find markers that discriminate the disorder without cosyntropin stimulation.

32492708.takeaway: PMN-MDSCs were increased in the blood of patients with papillary thyroid cancer, and in cell experiments they promoted invasion of thyroid cancer cells by repressing miR-486-3p.

32495721.takeaway: In 93 pediatric papillary thyroid carcinomas, 55.9% carried a gene fusion, most often involving RET, NTRK or ALK, and five of the fusions were novel.

32496604.takeaway: In 43 very-low-birth-weight infants, those with transient hypothyroxinaemia of prematurity had a delayed TSH decline after TRH stimulation, with a 180-minute to baseline TSH ratio of 3.0 vs 1.3.

32497228.takeaway: In 19 people given first-trimester dexamethasone for CAH risk but without CAH, brain imaging at ages 16 to 26 showed enlarged amygdalae and altered white matter diffusivity compared with 43 controls.

32498089.takeaway: In 590 adults aged 18 to 97, serum 11-ketotestosterone and 11-ketoandrostenedione stayed stable with age in women but declined in men.

32498666.takeaway: Eighteen hypothyroid patients aged 3 to 59 kept elevated TSH despite rising levothyroxine doses, and their hormone ratios were compared with those of thyroid hormone receptor-β resistance.

32499384.takeaway: In 77,925 Chinese adults in the 4C cohort, fetal-period famine exposure was linked to higher diabetes risk (RR 1.17), while childhood exposure was not significantly linked.

32501499.takeaway: The C allele of HCP5 variant rs3094228 was overrepresented in 469 UK Graves' disease patients (OR 1.76), with a stronger association in young-onset disease.

32501612.takeaway: In youth with type 2 diabetes in the TODAY trial, MCP-1 rose and VCAM fell over one to three years, while ICAM and E-selectin rose with HbA1c, with no treatment-group differences.

32502242.takeaway: At clinical diagnosis of type 1 diabetes, Hispanic children in TrialNet had more DKA (44.7% vs 25.3%) and higher ZnT8 autoantibody positivity than non-Hispanic whites.

32503005.takeaway: In 68 women with PCOS and BMI of 27 or more, a behavioural programme did not change global well-being at four months, though the intervention group had less anxiety and depressed mood.

32506065.takeaway: A female infant with 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 deficiency and Bartter syndrome type 3 had both conditions from maternal uniparental isodisomy, a combination not previously reported.

32506132.takeaway: In 317 Danish girls with median age 16.1 years, 6.3% had oligomenorrhea, and the study describes reproductive hormone and ovarian imaging values in a general population.

32506592.takeaway: Among 31,861 children with type 1 diabetes in the German DPV registry, 12,326 received psychological care, and those who did had higher HbA1c and more DKA, with HbA1c stable after care began.

32506728.takeaway: Among 235 poorly controlled Indian children with type 1 diabetes, dyslipidemia prevalence was 47.2%, with poor glycemic control and higher TSH as predictors.

32506739.takeaway: Among 3,456 emerging adults with type 1 diabetes, African American and Hispanic participants less often took snack boluses and checked glucose with a meter than non-Hispanic whites.

32508309.takeaway: Childhood cancer survivors who develop secondary thyroid cancer have no specific management guidance, so prior treatment toxicities should shape the choice of thyroid cancer therapy.

32508745.takeaway: This review asks whether genetic testing helps classify delayed puberty, noting that genes such as IGSF10 and FTO have been linked to self-limited delayed puberty in some families.

32517539.takeaway: Among 98 children treated for differentiated thyroid cancer, 19% had lung metastasis, mostly found within six months of thyroidectomy, and metastasis was more common in children under 13.

32519829.takeaway: A mother and two sons with a COL1A1 variant of uncertain significance had prenatal bone deformities and early nontraumatic fractures that stopped after infancy, a previously unrecognized osteogenesis imperfecta pattern.

32521075.takeaway: GH measured in dried newborn screening cards separated 25 newborns with severe GH deficiency (median 3.9 μg/L) from 281 healthy newborns, which may enable early diagnosis.

32522029.takeaway: In parents of five- to nine-year-olds with recent-onset type 1 diabetes, starting CGM reduced hypoglycemia-avoidance behaviors but did not reduce hypoglycemia worry.

32522039.takeaway: Among 233 adults with type 1 diabetes using CGM in the DPV registry, those aged 30 and older had higher time in range (54% vs 49%) and less time above range than younger adults.

32525525.takeaway: In a crossover trial of 20 healthy adults, a late dinner at 22:00 caused nocturnal glucose intolerance and reduced fatty acid oxidation compared with an 18:00 dinner.

32525982.takeaway: In 920 newborns, principal component analysis raised the positive predictive value of 21-hydroxylase deficiency screening from 20.0% to 66.7% in a retrospective comparison with the current algorithm.

32528405.takeaway: Petal-like calcifications on thyroid ultrasound occurred only in papillary thyroid carcinomas and were linked with a high rate of lymph node metastasis.

32528408.takeaway: Female Olympic athletes had a lower 2D:4D digit ratio than sedentary controls, and the ratio correlated with urinary androgen metabolites and physical performance.

32528415.takeaway: In children with obesity, CRP, classical monocytes and neutrophils correlated with waist circumference, insulin resistance and triglycerides.

32528417.takeaway: Higher cumulative risk on oxytocin-pathway genes was associated with greater disruption of default mode network connectivity in trauma-exposed youth.

32530459.takeaway: Basal 17-hydroxyprogesterone above 5.4 ng/mL distinguished nonclassical CAH from PCOS, and the 17OHP/cortisol ratio was no better.

32532756.takeaway: A patient-level model of type 1 diabetes predicted life expectancy about 13 years shorter than the general population, with complications for about 40% of remaining life.

32533869.takeaway: Kabuki syndrome patients with hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia had more KDM6A variants (50%) than those without it (11.5%), and KDM6A was more often linked with HH than KMT2D.

32534471.takeaway: Six of 37 female survivors of childhood allogeneic HSCT had spontaneous pregnancies, supporting contraception counselling despite documented ovarian failure.

32535587.takeaway: Sleep apnoea in children with Prader-Willi syndrome appeared independent of GH start age, so early GH may be safe with regular sleep analysis.

32539318.takeaway: Four patients from two families had CYP11B2 variants causing corticosterone methyloxidase deficiency type 2, presenting with salt loss, dehydration and poor growth.

32539319.takeaway: An 18-month-old boy had virilisation from an oncocytic adrenocortical carcinoma, then embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma; after surgery, chemotherapy and radiotherapy he had no recurrence.

32547492.takeaway: Trials show burosumab is effective with minimal safety concerns for X-linked hypophosphatemia in adults and children; long-term effects on nephrocalcinosis remain unknown.

32548699.takeaway: Women with type 2 diabetes had lower odds of live birth per embryo transfer after assisted reproduction than women without diabetes, whereas type 1 diabetes showed no reduction.

32548702.takeaway: In children with a first-degree relative with type 1 diabetes, diabetes-related autoantibodies were associated with lower later incidence of asthma and eczema.

32552001.takeaway: Brief camp training on CGM trend arrows raised time in range and lowered time above and below range and total daily insulin dose in adolescents with type 1 diabetes.

32556222.takeaway: Of 48 pediatric differentiated thyroid cancers, 69% had somatic alterations, most often BRAF V600E and RET-PTC1, with no link to clinicopathological features.

32558116.takeaway: Nearly 30% of newly diagnosed Indian children with type 1 diabetes were negative for all islet autoantibodies, with clinical features similar to antibody-positive children.

32558988.takeaway: An inpatient multidisciplinary program for youth with type 1 diabetes lowered HbA1c and improved psychosocial measures, though HbA1c returned to baseline by 6 months.

32559473.takeaway: In this Swedish birth cohort of about 2.2 million, offspring cardiovascular disease rates rose with higher maternal BMI in early pregnancy.

32559475.takeaway: Among 151 patients with MCT8 deficiency, 21% died; failure to gain head control by 1.5 years and underweight at ages 1-3 years predicted higher mortality.

32561908.takeaway: Obese youth with NAFLD had lower gut bacterial diversity and a different microbiota composition than those without it, and the difference persisted after adjusting for PNPLA3.

32561914.takeaway: Age-, sex- and ancestry-specific reference curves for ultradistal radius aBMD were built from 2014 children, and Z-scores tracked strongly over 6 years.

32562346.takeaway: Reviews long-acting reversible contraceptives such as implants and IUDs for adolescents and young women with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, including their side effects.

32562358.takeaway: Rising childhood obesity and migration make pediatric diabetes classification harder, with growing overlap between types; the review proposes alternative schemes.

32567554.takeaway: In 5α-reductase type 2 deficiency, the SRD5A2 p.Arg246Gln variant did not appear pathogenic alone; homozygous p.Val89Leu seemed essential for its effect.

32568734.takeaway: Pediatric metabolic syndrome has no international definition, but all definitions require obesity; the review recommends WHO BMI cutoffs for overweight and obesity.

32574349.takeaway: Sex-specific anogenital distance reference ranges for healthy infants aged 0-24 months were created; AGD rose over the first 6 months and then plateaued.

32575104.takeaway: Arm span-to-height reference charts were built for healthy children aged 2-17, and carriers of ACAN haploinsufficiency had elevated arm span ratios in childhood and adolescence.

32578226.takeaway: Australasian guidance for pediatric type 2 diabetes covers screening, HbA1c targets of 48 mmol/mol or lower, pharmacotherapy, transition, and care for Indigenous children.

32578498.takeaway: Five years after radiofrequency or laser ablation of benign thyroid nodules, 74% met the efficacy criterion, 28% regrew, and 18% needed retreatment.

32579294.takeaway: A three-year awareness campaign in Stuttgart reduced ketoacidosis at type 1 diabetes onset in children from 28% to 16%.

32579712.takeaway: Women with Turner syndrome, and those whose puberty was induced, were less likely to have had sexual intercourse and reported later first relationships than women with premature ovarian insufficiency.

32580144.takeaway: A standardised two-hour education programme for chronic adrenal insufficiency raised knowledge scores from 17 to 23 of 29, and 91% of patients felt able to self-inject after training.

32580145.takeaway: Mild subclinical hypothyroidism in children is often benign and remitting; the review advises regular monitoring and individual decisions about levothyroxine treatment.

32580146.takeaway: Familial nephrogenic diabetes insipidus is usually due to AVPR2 or AQP2 variants; early genetic testing of males and reduced solute intake help prevent dehydration and kidney damage.

32580148.takeaway: Over 2007-2017 the Dutch stepwise T4-TSH-TBG screen identified 612 congenital hypothyroidism cases, detecting 62.8% of central cases by T4/TBG ratio, with a positive predictive value of 21%.

32580193.takeaway: Three children with congenital hyperinsulinism developed pericardial effusion on diazoxide, and the authors advise echocardiography 1-2 months after starting and yearly thereafter.

32580197.takeaway: A one-year personalised multidisciplinary plan in 1,000 children and adolescents reduced the prevalence of obesity by 16.8% and significantly improved cardiometabolic indices.

32582020.takeaway: Normative clitoral length and width by gestational age were established for 580 Iranian female neonates, to define clitoromegaly in term and preterm infants.

32582023.takeaway: In 201 children with autoimmune thyroiditis, 26% of those euthyroid at presentation later needed levothyroxine versus over 50% with subclinical hypothyroidism; free T4 at presentation predicted outcome.

32582026.takeaway: Reviews the cardiovascular consequences of idiopathic and syndromic childhood obesity; syndromic obesity has few data because of small, heterogeneous samples.

32582030.takeaway: Bone ultrasound showed lower wave velocity in eight children and young adults with XLH than in controls, indicating reduced cortical bone quality that may help monitoring.

32582034.takeaway: Reviews prevalence, risk factors, screening and treatment of micro- and macrovascular complications in children and adolescents with diabetes, which can begin in childhood.

32585071.takeaway: A 19-item Hindi version of the Diabetes Self-Management Profile was reliable and valid for Indian patients with type 1 diabetes (mean age 13.5), and its scores correlated with HbA1c.

32586221.takeaway: Across 78,470 adults in China, thyroid antibody positivity was inversely associated with iodine intake and was highest in iodine-deficient groups.

32587391.takeaway: Reviews routes to generating functional beta cells for diabetes cell therapy, including stem-cell-derived beta cells, transdifferentiation, engineered non-beta cells and synthetic particles.

32587933.takeaway: In mice, the peripubertal decline in hypothalamic Mkrn3 expression was not altered by leptin, suggesting it occurs independently of leptin at puberty onset.

32589738.takeaway: Nevanimibe lowered 17-OHP within 2 weeks in adults with uncontrolled classic CAH, but only 2 of 10 reached the primary target, and one stopped early due to a serious adverse event.

32589812.takeaway: In 99 very-low-birthweight neonates, complete antenatal corticosteroid exposure was associated with less hyperthyrotropinaemia at 2 weeks (6% vs 22%).

32592269.takeaway: In adolescent girls, the 2-hour oral minimal model best estimated peripheral insulin sensitivity compared with the clamp, while hepatic surrogates performed poorly.

32593172.takeaway: In a nationwide cohort, patients with acromegaly were more often retired and less often cohabiting or parents than matched controls, with worse outcomes in women and in those without disease control.

32593173.takeaway: A nasal tetracosactide formulation gave a 60-minute plasma cortisol response not significantly different from 250 µg IV Synacthen, and salivary cortisol could make the test noninvasive.

32593174.takeaway: Among 19,213 women with miscarriage or subfertility, 4.8% had abnormal thyroid function and 9.5% were thyroid peroxidase antibody positive; subclinical hypothyroidism was linked to BMI of 35 or more and Asian ethnicity.

32594135.takeaway: In 19 healthy men, adding a 5α-reductase inhibitor to prednisolone raised prednisolone levels and reduced insulin-mediated glucose disposal compared with prednisolone alone.

32594169.takeaway: A noninvasive CRH and desmopressin test, pituitary MRI and whole-body CT algorithm reached a 98% positive predictive value for Cushing's disease and could have avoided petrosal sinus sampling in 47%.

32595599.takeaway: In 5,869 children, higher baseline and improved fitness were independently linked to favourable one-year changes in cardiometabolic risk score, with baseline BMI mediating much of the effect.

32598474.takeaway: Children with newborn TSH of 8-14 mIU/L had midchildhood IQ similar to their siblings, suggesting mild neonatal TSH elevation below the screening threshold has no lasting effect.

32599600.takeaway: Reviews the hypotheses for minipuberty, the transient HPG axis activation in infancy, and its proposed roles in genital development, body composition and cognition.

32607749.takeaway: In 24 children with recently diagnosed type 1 diabetes, low-dose IL-2 increased regulatory T cells in a dose-dependent way with mostly mild adverse events, and glycaemic control did not change versus placebo.

32609827.takeaway: Parathyroid adenomas showed reduced CaSR expression in 90% of samples, with promoter hypermethylation and histone changes, and methylation correlated with PTH levels.

32609902.takeaway: Three years of growth hormone in young adults with Prader-Willi syndrome did not significantly increase impaired glucose tolerance or type 2 diabetes, and metabolic syndrome rates stayed stable.

32610327.takeaway: In 16 boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy and delayed puberty, testosterone induction was associated with a significant rise in lumbar spine BMD over a median of 2.5 years.

32611608.takeaway: Higher fasting serum fructose predicted incident type 2 diabetes in 949 adults aged 40 and over, with a hazard ratio of 1.33 per SD after adjusting for uric acid and renal function.

32612573.takeaway: In 2,594 children and adolescents in a nationwide study, hypovitaminosis D was most common in the metabolically unhealthy obese phenotype (85.3%).

32612574.takeaway: In a pilot randomised study, oral combined contraception suppressed the IGF-I response to an IGF-I generation test in young women, whereas the vaginal ring did not.

32612575.takeaway: Genetic testing of 80 patients with combined pituitary hormone deficiency found PROP1 defects in most, plus candidate variants in SEMA3A and IGSF10 that may add to the phenotype.

32613719.takeaway: HLA-DR/DQ genotype strongly determined whether GAD or insulin autoantibody appeared first in islet autoimmunity in Finnish children, a pattern confirmed in 1591 children with T1D.

32613727.takeaway: In youth diagnosed with type 2 diabetes at 10-25 years, adjusted risk of microalbuminuria was 3.3 times that of matched type 1 diabetes, and retinopathy risk was 1.17 times higher.

32614332.takeaway: Mexican pediatric endocrine guidance on puberty blockade for central precocious puberty; the abstract states recommendation topics but no specific recommendations.

32614333.takeaway: Mexican pediatric endocrine guidance on diagnosing precocious puberty; the abstract states recommendation topics but no specific recommendations.

32614335.takeaway: Mexican pediatric endocrine guidance on diagnosing secondary, central causes of precocious puberty; the abstract states topics but no specific recommendations.

32614336.takeaway: Mexican pediatric endocrine guidance on adjuvant interventions beyond puberty blockade for precocious puberty; the abstract states topics but no specific recommendations.

32614338.takeaway: Mexican pediatric endocrine guidance on monitoring children treated for central precocious puberty; the abstract states topics but no specific recommendations.

32614782.takeaway: Screening six common CYP21A2 mutations in 47 Egyptian patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency detected variants in 87.2% of alleles, with good genotype-phenotype correlation in salt-wasting forms.

32614948.takeaway: In 203 women aged 18-48, PCOS was associated with lower muscle mass index and bone mineral density than normoandrogenic controls, and with lower Matsuda insulin sensitivity.

32615685.takeaway: Reviews the diagnostic approach to short stature, separating the healthy majority from children with growth hormone deficiency, Turner syndrome or other disease, with early genetic testing and timely treatment.

32615686.takeaway: Reviews real-world studies on eating speed as a possible novel risk factor for type 2 diabetes, noting that high-quality evidence is still sparse.

32615687.takeaway: Reviews neonatal HPG axis activation (minipuberty) and its role in maturing genitalia, with long-term significance uncertain and potential use in evaluating hypogonadism and DSD.

32615688.takeaway: Scoliosis was more prevalent in 338 girls with central precocious puberty (11.5%) than in 215 controls (6.0%), and it did not progress over 1 year of GnRH agonist treatment.

32615689.takeaway: Four Korean patients with P450 oxidoreductase deficiency all had adrenal insufficiency and genital ambiguity, and two with compound variants had skeletal anomalies suggesting Antley-Bixler syndrome.

32615690.takeaway: In 1,349 Korean youths aged 10-19, the highest serum uric acid quartile had about 2.9 times the odds of metabolic syndrome in males and 5.2 times in females.

32615691.takeaway: In 11 infants and children with intestinal malabsorption, weekly intramuscular cholecalciferol raised 25(OH)D from 6.0 to 50.4 ng/mL by 3 months and improved rickets radiographically in two patients.

32615692.takeaway: In 24 children with type 1 diabetes and 20 controls, miRNA-378 expression was higher in the T1D group, while body fat was similar between groups.

32615693.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl with Floating-Harbor syndrome and short stature without growth hormone deficiency improved her height SDS after 55 months of growth hormone therapy.

32615694.takeaway: An 8-year-old boy with Alport syndrome had Van Wyk-Grumbach syndrome from prolonged untreated congenital hypothyroidism, with pseudoprecocious puberty and growth retardation.

32616607.takeaway: A 12-year-old boy with Hodgkin lymphoma developed ketoacidosis from type 1 diabetes after five cycles of pembrolizumab and needs lifelong insulin; the authors know of no prior pediatric cases.

32616608.takeaway: Among 370,854 UK adults with new type 2 diabetes, the share diagnosed under 50 rose to 2010 and then stabilised, and young-onset patients had a high cardiovascular risk factor burden.

32616609.takeaway: Diabetes-related end-stage kidney disease incidence fell 53% for American Indians and Alaska Natives, 33% for Hispanics and 20% for Blacks from 2000 to 2016, but rose 10% for whites.

32616617.takeaway: Among 41,203 people in CDC-recognised diabetes prevention programmes, retention to 18 weeks was lower in younger, non-white and less active participants, with the largest attrition at week 2 and weeks 17-18.

32616618.takeaway: Among 643 homeless and 10,559 nonhomeless New York minors with diabetes, homeless minors had higher hospitalization and readmission rates (20.4% vs 14.1%) but lower odds of DKA.

32619193.takeaway: Reviews pharmacological options for monogenic obesity caused by leptin-melanocortin pathway defects, including MC4R signalling and POMC-derived treatments, since lifestyle measures often fail.

32620937.takeaway: Reviews how childhood environment and epigenetic mechanisms may shape adult reproductive function, including pubertal and menopausal timing, with implications for clinicians.

32621562.takeaway: In the ABIS birth cohort, first-trimester maternal respiratory infection was associated with later type 1 diabetes in offspring, alongside maternal autoimmune disease and paternal T1D.

32621582.takeaway: SDHx mutations were found in 1.1% of 263 patients with isolated pituitary adenoma who had no personal or family history of paraganglioma, and the benefit of screening remains unclear.

32621587.takeaway: A pharmacokinetic model in 24 children with adrenal insufficiency aged 2 weeks to 6 years showed cortisol levels outside healthy ranges at many time points, most often low and most in neonates.

32621730.takeaway: Among 10,037 North Indian school adolescents, 5.4% had abdominal obesity, and 39.3% of those were not obese by BMI; abdominal obesity rose with age.

32621731.takeaway: In 19 children with congenital nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, causative AVPR2 or AQP2 variants were found in all, and treatment noncompliance was associated with high morbidity.

32621732.takeaway: Over one year of weight-management counselling, 51 obese adolescents had higher PYY, lower BMI and triglycerides, and less uncontrolled eating, which was linked to better insulin levels.

32623373.takeaway: In 305 short children born SGA, rhGH raised height SDS from -2.72 to -1.16, with glucose, insulin and triglycerides rising within normal range while LDL cholesterol fell.

32623374.takeaway: In 11 children with glycogen storage disease IIIa, eight of 20 AGL variants were novel; six developed ventricular hypertrophy, which was linked to higher lactate, pyruvate and LDH.

32623375.takeaway: In 151 children, overweight or obese children had higher odds of a high sleep arousal index than normal-weight children, independent of age and sex.

32623376.takeaway: Age- and sex-specific waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio percentile curves were built for 10,668 healthy Pakistani children aged 2-18 to evaluate central obesity.

32623377.takeaway: Three unrelated patients with G6PC3 deficiency had short stature, cardiac abnormalities and lymphopenia, and CD4 lymphopenia was not rare in this disorder.

32623378.takeaway: Among 41 Saudi children with celiac disease, GAD antibodies were present in about two-thirds of both the isolated celiac and the combined T1D groups, with no significant difference.

32623379.takeaway: Sequencing DLK1 in 100 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty found no allele-frequency difference from controls, with only one potentially meaningful variant.

32623380.takeaway: In 67 women formerly treated for central precocious puberty, untreated women were more often obese (72.1% vs 36.6%) than those treated with GnRH analogues, and 83% had regular cycles.

32623730.takeaway: Three 46,XX Chinese children with aromatase deficiency had ambiguous genitalia and elevated FSH; a review of 30 reported 46,XX patients found some were not diagnosed until puberty or adulthood.

32625166.takeaway: In male adolescents with obesity, serum ferritin was mainly determined by liver fat and inflammation rather than body iron status.

32625167.takeaway: In pubertal mice, a high-fat diet altered circadian gene rhythms and estrogen and progesterone receptor expression in mammary glands, which may contribute to early mammary development.

32625170.takeaway: In porcine prepubertal Sertoli cells, three FSH preparations produced different effects on AMH, inhibin B and protein expression, relevant to personalised male fertility treatment.

32628634.takeaway: TPO antibodies were positive in 13.9% of 223 children aged 7-10 with HLA susceptibility to type 1 diabetes, but were only weakly linked to thyroid function.

32628635.takeaway: In 200 youths with type 1 diabetes, an eGDR cut-off of 8.44 mg/kg/min using waist-to-hip ratio detected metabolic syndrome with 85.7% sensitivity and 82.6% specificity.

32634108.takeaway: An infant with diazoxide-unresponsive congenital hyperinsulinism on long-term octreotide developed exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and secondary vitamin K deficiency, presenting with a haemorrhagic syndrome.

32634109.takeaway: In a retrospective comparison of 105 youths with type 1 diabetes, 12-month HbA1c was lower with CGM use than in controls (8.2% vs 8.7%).

32636808.takeaway: Reviews how severe iodine deficiency in pregnancy and the neonatal period causes pregnancy loss, neonatal hypothyroidism and neurodevelopmental harm, and how to prevent it.

32638409.takeaway: In 10 children with Prader-Willi syndrome and 7 healthy children, acyl and desacyl ghrelin fell after food, and GLP-1 was higher in PWS after both test meals than after a standard meal.

32639944.takeaway: In Tunisia, 61% of 65 parents of children with late-treated phenylketonuria had impaired quality of life, linked to maternal gender, low income, low education and child autism.

32640846.takeaway: In young adults with poorly controlled type 1 diabetes, sotagliflozin added to insulin did not significantly lower HbA1c overall (-0.4%, P=0.10), though it did in the prespecified subgroup with HbA1c of 10% or less.

32641373.takeaway: In the TEDDY cohort, the risk of a second autoantibody did not depend on whether GADA or IAA appeared first, and second-appearing autoantibodies increased the risk of type 1 diabetes.

32642808.takeaway: In French young adults with type 1 diabetes, hospitalisation for ketoacidosis was followed by more suicide-attempt admissions (7.2% vs 2.5% at 9 years), though the association weakened after 5 years.

32644264.takeaway: In an RCT of 87 children with type 1 diabetes, advanced carbohydrate counting lowered HbA1c at 3 months but not at 12 months, and gave higher KIDSCREEN psychological scores at 1 year.

32647049.takeaway: In 906 people with type 1 diabetes followed for a median of 8.2 years, higher arterial stiffness (augmentation index) predicted all-cause mortality independent of conventional risk factors.

32647052.takeaway: In 241,551 Danish adults with diabetes over nine influenza seasons, influenza vaccination was associated with reduced cardiovascular mortality.

32649295.takeaway: A prepubertal boy with progressive cherubism had lesions ossify after eight denosumab injections over 6 months, though growth slowed transiently and hypercalcemia rebounded.

32651985.takeaway: Reviews cystic fibrosis-related diabetes, its progression from postprandial to fasting hyperglycaemia, its effects on lung function and growth, and screening from age 10.

32651986.takeaway: Three children with CAH due to 17α-hydroxylase deficiency all had CYP17A1 mutations; two had hypertension at diagnosis and none had hypokalaemia.

32651987.takeaway: In 71 patients aged 21 or younger with differentiated thyroid cancer, blood-dosimetry predicted and actual I-131 activity differed significantly for remnant and lung disease but not nodal metastases.

32651988.takeaway: Two children with hyperandrogenism had porto-systemic shunts, suggesting shunts should be considered in unexplained hyperandrogenism of childhood.

32652002.takeaway: In a GWAS of 614 children on GH, no common variant reached genome-wide significance for first-year height response in the primary analysis, though some loci did in secondary analyses.

32652026.takeaway: Among 72 participants, islet antigen-specific CD4+ T-cell responses differed by T1D subtype, with GAD65 IL-6 and IP-10 responses raised in acute-onset and G-CSF responses in fulminant disease.

32653624.takeaway: An ASTCT expert panel answered 16 FAQs on bone health after hematopoietic cell transplantation, including bone loss and avascular necrosis, because controlled trials are lacking.

32653876.takeaway: In 25 Tunisian children with phenylketonuria, phenylalanine varied widely through the day, and a single morning sample missed unbalanced control in about a third of patients.

32653877.takeaway: Screening 200 children referred for overweight or obesity found celiac disease antibodies in 4%, all confirmed by biopsy and HLA typing, with no link to pregnancy or lifestyle factors.

32653878.takeaway: In 128 children with cerebral palsy, a rehabilitation programme with home whole-body vibration increased lean mass and bone mineral content, but age-adjusted lean mass Z-scores did not change.

32653879.takeaway: Of 91 children with Down syndrome followed long term, 73.6% had a thyroid disorder, most often autoimmune thyroid disease (31.8%), subclinical hypothyroidism (25.3%) or congenital hypothyroidism (16.4%).

32654473.takeaway: In 120 children and adolescents with T1D, exosomal miR-34a was higher than in 100 controls and was independently associated with total cholesterol, LDL, endoglin and ICAM.

32655496.takeaway: In 15 people with PLS3 mutations aged 9 to 77, vertebral height reduction was more common than in 13 mutation-negative controls, most in the upper thoracic spine.

32656923.takeaway: Three children with homozygous INS promoter mutations had variable neonatal diabetes, with remission and early relapse, and one relapsed at 2.6 years with severe DKA.

32657434.takeaway: In 571,785 Finnish singleton births, maternal hyperthyroidism was associated with higher odds of hypertensive disorders, caesarean section, placental abruption, preterm birth and small-for-gestational-age infants.

32657529.takeaway: In 183 youth with type 2 diabetes, renin-angiotensin markers including ACE activity were higher than in 100 controls and higher still in those with albuminuria.

32658863.takeaway: A 5-year-old boy with autism had persistent hypercalcaemia after taking over 700 times the recommended daily vitamin A, and pamidronate was the definitive treatment.

32658864.takeaway: In 88 Sudanese children with autoimmune hyperthyroidism, carbimazole remission among Graves' patients reached 41.2% by year 4 and then plateaued.

32658865.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl with cystic fibrosis and GCK-MODY had insulin deferred because glycaemic control was acceptable, with no respiratory decline reported so far.

32659761.takeaway: Of 164 CAH cases from a newborn screening programme, 25% were detected only on a second screen; these infants had lower 17-OHP and were more often simple virilizing.

32661106.takeaway: In a pilot study of 12 participants, 6 with type 1 diabetes, hyperinsulinaemia blunted exercise-induced endogenous glucose production in T1D, whereas hyperglycaemia did not.

32661108.takeaway: During closed-loop control in young adults with T1D, a premeal Afrezza bolus lowered early postprandial glucose versus aspart, with the benefit waning after 2 hours.

32661110.takeaway: In 1,959 mother-child pairs, higher maternal random glucose in early pregnancy was associated with lower left ventricular mass and volume on cardiac MRI at age 10.

32662200.takeaway: At a diabetes camp, honey and fruit juice were similarly effective for treating mild hypoglycaemia within 15 minutes (95% recovery) in 32 children and adolescents with T1D.

32664805.takeaway: Among 2,288 patients on active surveillance for low-risk papillary microcarcinoma, 7.1% underwent conversion surgery, and the rate fell over time.

32666011.takeaway: In 10 children treated for Cushing disease, telomeres were shorter than controls at follow-up, and shorter telomeres during active disease correlated with higher triglycerides.

32666595.takeaway: Reviews why South Asian youth have higher cardiometabolic and diabetes risk at lower BMI, including genetic, maternal-fetal, dietary, fitness and body-composition factors.

32666666.takeaway: Reviews medical nutrition therapy for Indian children with type 1 diabetes, noting high-GI, low-protein diets and tailoring insulin to school timetables and supervision.

32668452.takeaway: Hypoglycaemia occurred in 15 of 23 (65%) adolescents and young adults with pancreatic-insufficient cystic fibrosis during a 3-hour oral glucose tolerance test.

32669410.takeaway: In 16,289 Hispanic/Latino adults, a waist circumference above 97 cm in women, nine points above current criteria, gave optimal discrimination for cardiovascular risk.

32669411.takeaway: In 19 studies of 41,509 patients with acute myocardial infarction, 48.4% had newly discovered abnormal glucose tolerance, and prediabetes carried higher mortality than normal glucose tolerance.

32670194.takeaway: Reviews type 1 diabetes prediction using family history, HLA and non-HLA genes and metabolic biomarkers, and primary, secondary and tertiary prevention strategies.

32670198.takeaway: In 39 elite male athletes, carbohydrate intake predicted faster hormonal stress responses and better explosive exercise performance, and protein intake predicted body composition.

32670199.takeaway: Protocol for a double-blind placebo-controlled trial of Jinlida granules in 880 adults aged 18-70 with metabolic syndrome and abnormal glucose metabolism, with type 2 diabetes incidence as the primary outcome.

32670203.takeaway: Reviews how estradiol-induced neuroprogesterone from hypothalamic astrocytes acts on kisspeptin neurons to trigger the LH surge, mainly from rat studies.

32676665.takeaway: Sequencing 444 people from Spanish central precocious puberty families found a de novo DLK1 deletion that left serum DLK1 undetectable in one girl with sporadic CPP.

32678672.takeaway: Virtual training on the MiniMed 670G system during COVID-19 gave CGM metrics comparable to in-person training, 98% satisfaction, and shorter time from pump shipment to first training.

32680447.takeaway: In a survey of 101 patients using do-it-yourself artificial pancreas systems, 94% reported better time in range and 89% rated the system safe, compared with 27% of 152 providers.

32681534.takeaway: In NHANES 1999-2016, the difference in prediabetes detected by fasting glucose versus HbA1c varied by race, at about 20 percentage points in white and Hispanic adolescents but none in black adolescents.

32681582.takeaway: Among 264 youths with type 1 diabetes and public insurance, HbA1c fell by 0.39% at visits after CGM start, while losing CGM access was linked to higher HbA1c.

32681779.takeaway: A boy with rickets from age 5 had an FGF23-secreting thoracic tumour missed for years after a presumed hereditary diagnosis; excising it led to significant improvement.

32682344.takeaway: In 134 adolescents in transition with chronic endocrine conditions, quality-of-life scores were within reference ranges, though corrected height was low in Turner syndrome.

32685870.takeaway: In 267 healthy African American and Caucasian people aged 6-74, PCSK9 was positively associated with lipoprotein(a) carried by larger apo(a) isoforms, mainly in African Americans.

32685970.takeaway: In 20 SGA children with short stature treated with GH, exome sequencing found likely pathogenic variants in 4 children and copy-number variants were found in 2 others.

32686271.takeaway: In 132 children with islet autoimmunity from DAISY, a nutrient pattern lower in linoleic acid and higher in sugars that matched metabolite profiles at seroconversion was linked to progression to T1D (HR 3.17).

32686287.takeaway: A survey of 215 diabetes centres in 75 countries found most paediatric diabetes teams moved to telephone or video consultations during COVID-19, and 22% reported delayed diagnoses.

32687159.takeaway: Among 395 youths followed for 5 years, 13 metabolites in girls and 10 in boys were identified as determinants of later liver fat, with NAFLD prevalence of 7.9%.

32687189.takeaway: In Shandong schoolchildren aged 8-13, saliva iodine concentration correlated with urinary iodine measures, and children with saliva iodine above 273 µg/L had higher risk of thyroid nodules.

32687192.takeaway: In 14 matched pairs of amniocytes, gestational diabetes exposure enriched immune-related pathways in gene expression and DNA methylation.

32687482.takeaway: Two intronic variants, one in CYP11B1 and one in CYP17A1, disrupted mRNA splicing in patients with CAH, showing that cryptic intronic variants can cause the disease.

32688334.takeaway: In propensity-matched patients with metastatic thyroid cancer, outcomes were similar whether TSH stimulation was recombinant (n=43) or endogenous (n=34), with 91% gaining clinical benefit.

32688338.takeaway: In 75,549 healthy children aged 5-18, TSH levels varied with BMI and ethnicity, rising as weight moved away from normal, supporting personalised reference ranges.

32688436.takeaway: In 43 healthy children and young people, early-morning serum cortisol correlated strongly with salivary cortisol and cortisone, and salivary levels changed with age.

32689909.takeaway: In 61 thyroid nodules with RAS mutations, gene expression correlated with the degree of malignancy, identifying molecular determinants of high-risk nodules.

32691481.takeaway: In 23 children, thrombin generation showed a procoagulant shift at type 1 diabetes onset compared with follow-up after insulin treatment, alongside increased tissue factor activity.

32692360.takeaway: In 31 children at type 1 diabetes onset and 25 healthy children, several gut bacterial taxa differed by group, and machine learning used them to classify disease-linked microorganisms.

32692703.takeaway: A pubertal basal LH level had high specificity but poor sensitivity for needing leuprolide testing, and LH peaked at 180 minutes in most of 105 children.

32692704.takeaway: Among 832 high-school girls, 16.3% were overweight and 5.8% obese, and overweight or obesity was associated with breastfeeding history.

32697757.takeaway: In 2,364 Brazilian children aged 6-17, the FTO rs9939609 AA genotype was linked to higher BMI z-score, waist circumference and triglycerides, and overweight parents added to obesity risk.

32697758.takeaway: Ten Pakistani children with PHKG2 liver phosphorylase kinase deficiency carried seven variants, five of them novel, and their clinical phenotype varied.

32697759.takeaway: A preterm neonate with McCune-Albright syndrome and ACTH-independent Cushing syndrome had cortisol progressively normalised on metyrapone despite poor oral tolerance.

32697760.takeaway: In 64 children with type 1 diabetes, serum endocan and soluble endoglin were higher than in 64 healthy controls, and endocan correlated with HbA1c.

32698138.takeaway: Reviews genetic causes of central precocious puberty, noting MKRN3 loss-of-function as the most common identified cause and DLK1 as a second imprinted gene.

32698145.takeaway: A Dutch multidisciplinary group developed national recommendations for differentiated thyroid carcinoma under age 18, based on a systematic literature review and AGREE appraisal of existing guidelines.

32702692.takeaway: In 150 children born SGA assessed at about 6 years, the 81% who caught up in weight had a higher fat mass index than those who did not.

32702779.takeaway: Individual patient data from 364 ganglioneuroma cases showed 65.7% were diagnosed in adults, more often women, and 24.5% were found incidentally.

32702947.takeaway: A child with NF1 and medullary thyroid carcinoma carrying homozygous RET germline mutations was treated with vandetanib, a drug with limited paediatric data.

32703764.takeaway: In 108 parent-youth dyads starting CGM, youth involvement in the decision to start predicted later CGM use.

32705316.takeaway: In Amhara adults with insulin-dependent diabetes in Ethiopia, autoantibody positivity was 86.1% when onset was at 15 or younger and 50% at 26-35, and HLA-DRB1*03:01 and *04 were associated with disease.

32706856.takeaway: In 1,149 GH-deficient cancer survivors on GH for at least 5 years, total body irradiation for leukaemia blunted the growth response, while craniopharyngioma cranial radiotherapy did not.

32706870.takeaway: In 18 female survivors of medulloblastoma and other embryonal tumours, earlier puberty after irradiation was largely explained by BMI SDS at puberty and catch-up weight gain.

32707116.takeaway: Among 24,232 children treated with GH in Europe, mortality was not raised in isolated GH deficiency or idiopathic short stature, but was raised in SGA children and in moderate- and high-risk patients.

32707117.takeaway: In 588 premenopausal women aged 18-39 with regular cycles, higher DHEA, androstenedione and lower SHBG were associated with sexual desire, though the models explained under 4% of its variation.

32714280.takeaway: Rare germline DICER1 variants were found in 7 of 192 Cushing's disease cases, all paediatric, with no other known germline defects; parental transmission was confirmed in 5 of 7.

32717093.takeaway: In 68 monozygotic twin pairs at about 15 years, smaller twins from pairs with birthweight differences of 1 SDS or more had higher DHEA metabolite concentrations than their heavier co-twins.

32718224.takeaway: Two unrelated families with abnormal thyroid function had novel DIO1 missense variants, causing elevated reverse T3 and rT3/T3 ratios, also seen in heterozygous-null mice.

32718278.takeaway: In 1,010 benign thyroid nodules, the ATA ultrasound risk system safely identified nodules not needing repeat cytology, with missed cancer in 0.8% of very low to low-risk and 3.1% of high-risk nodules.

32720985.takeaway: In an extended family with novel NPR2 variants, short stature was progressive in heterozygous carriers, and compound heterozygous sisters had acromesomelic dysplasia.

32721016.takeaway: Pooled data from 228 children with X-linked hypophosphatemia provide height-for-age growth curves from age 1 to 14, compared with population norms.

32723843.takeaway: In a randomised crossover trial of 16-24-year-olds with type 1 diabetes, factory-calibrated Dexcom G6 CGM raised time in range compared with blinded self-monitoring.

32725624.takeaway: Of 130 children with Cushing disease after transsphenoidal surgery, 102 recovered adrenal function, with a median recovery time of 12.7 months; clinical and biochemical factors influenced it.

32726409.takeaway: The insulin-like growth factor system was examined in 124 human embryonic and fetal gonads at 5-17 postconception weeks, describing its expression in developing testes and ovaries.

32728890.takeaway: Children of mothers with metabolic syndrome in pregnancy had telomeres about 14% shorter at age 10, though the confidence interval reached zero.

32728891.takeaway: In youth with type 2 diabetes, short-term metformin raised incretin levels, and the glucose benefit appeared independent of changes in gluconeogenesis.

32728892.takeaway: In children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, plasma miR-23~27~24 clusters correlated with immunometabolic derangement and helped predict C-peptide loss.

32729374.takeaway: Of 200 adults, 81 with Hashimoto's thyroiditis reported more animal foods and less plant food than 119 controls, and meat consumption was linked to higher odds of thyroid autoimmunity.

32732304.takeaway: In patients with obesity, high E2F1 expression in visceral fat was linked to a TRAIL-TL1A network, and TL1A impaired insulin's inhibition of adipocyte lipolysis.

32732375.takeaway: Among 2,256 CARDIA participants, greater fasting glucose variability in young adulthood was associated with faster coronary artery calcification progression over 10 years.

32733375.takeaway: Describes the 4T approach for newly diagnosed youth with type 1 diabetes: teamwork, targets, technology and tight control, with CGM education from diagnosis.

32733376.takeaway: In 26 children with severe autoimmune hypothyroidism (TSH above 100 mIU/L), diagnosis came at a mean age of 10.3 years, with a female predominance of 1.8:1.

32733382.takeaway: Of 100 patients with discrepant thyroid tests, 88 were diagnosed with thyroid hormone resistance beta (65) or a TSH-secreting adenoma (23).

32737116.takeaway: In 50 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, whole-kidney renal oxygen availability relative to GFR was 25% lower than in 20 controls, suggesting relative renal hypoxia in early kidney disease.

32737139.takeaway: In 4,704 young adults followed for 30 years, higher folate intake, but not vitamin B6 or B12, was inversely associated with incident diabetes.

32737140.takeaway: An ICD-10 rule-based algorithm outperformed multinomial regression in identifying youth diabetes status and type from 8,682 electronic health records.

32737911.takeaway: Young people with type 1 diabetes had about 1.8 times the risk of alcohol-related hospital admission, peaking at ages 14-17, with weaker deprivation effects than in the general population.

32737919.takeaway: Among 1,814 youth with diabetes, often counting carbohydrates was linked to HbA1c 0.8% lower in type 1 diabetes, and starting calorie tracking to 0.4% lower.

32737942.takeaway: A model using prior admissions, HbA1c and non-commercial insurance identified about 8% of youth with type 1 diabetes with a 42% risk of hospitalization, validated in later data.

32738012.takeaway: Among 1,129 youth with type 1 diabetes, vigorous activity and team sports fell with age while moderate activity rose, and higher youth fear of hypoglycaemia was linked to more vigorous activity.

32738013.takeaway: Two children with biallelic DNAJC3 defects are described, with diabetes from beta-cell dysfunction and evolving neurological and endocrine features.

32738019.takeaway: In 14 people with pump-site lipoatrophy, switching to zinc-free insulin glulisine did not change subcutaneous fat thickness at 6 months compared with zinc-containing insulin.

32738021.takeaway: In 15-26-year-olds, lathosterol and lanosterol, markers of cholesterol synthesis, were 51% and 65% higher in type 2 diabetes than in lean controls.

32738022.takeaway: In five RCTs of 493 children with type 1 diabetes, predictive low glucose suspend reduced hypoglycaemia more than sensor-augmented pump therapy, without more hyperglycaemia or DKA.

32738041.takeaway: Over 5 years, mean eGFR rose 2.8 in 69 patients with hypoparathyroidism treated with rhPTH(1-84) but fell 8.0 in 53 untreated historical controls.

32738042.takeaway: In 62 children with central precocious puberty, a 6-month subcutaneous leuprolide 45 mg injection suppressed LH to under 4 IU/L in 87% by week 24.

32738133.takeaway: In 2,852 French childhood cancer survivors, GH therapy did not significantly increase the risk of several second neoplasm types, including brain tumours and non-brain cancers.

32741045.takeaway: Among 122 teens with T1D, goal-setting sessions that combined glucose monitoring or CGM with insulin dosing were linked to 0.4% lower HbA1c after 18 months.

32746774.takeaway: In 137 pregnant women in Norway, two weekly servings of cod for 16 weeks raised urinary iodine concentration compared with a standard diet.

32747405.takeaway: In 30 people with T1D, those with high residual C-peptide spent more time in glucose range 3.9-10 mmol/L in the 12 and 24 hours after exercise than those with low or undetectable C-peptide.

32749012.takeaway: In 138 children, obese children with metabolic syndrome had higher apelin-12 and lower adropin than obese children without it, suggesting both may help predict the syndrome.

32750115.takeaway: In a prospective cohort of 200 children, 17,20-lyase and DHEA sulfotransferase activities rose between ages 2 and 4 in boys, and 17,20-lyase activity kept rising to age 6.

32754115.takeaway: Reviews evidence that radioiodine for differentiated thyroid cancer may raise breast cancer risk as a second malignancy in young females, and surveys registries for a future case-control study.

32754732.takeaway: Among women with PCOS seeking pregnancy after bariatric surgery, pregnancy rates were 95.2% versus 76.9% in controls, a difference that was not significant.

32756064.takeaway: An updated consensus tool advises on diagnosing and treating pseudohypoparathyroidism and related disorders, stressing molecular diagnosis because presentations vary widely.

32756962.takeaway: Among 286 people with germline MEN1 in a prospective natural history study, the risk of venous thromboembolism was increased.

32757547.takeaway: A case report describes familial male-limited precocious puberty caused by a novel LHCGR mutation, which constitutively activates the receptor and drives excess testosterone.

32757778.takeaway: In a survey of 139 children with T1D, 51.1% had skin reactions caused by patch pumps or glucose sensors.

32759360.takeaway: Among 207,817 matched SGLT2 inhibitor and DPP-4 inhibitor users with type 2 diabetes, below-knee amputation risk did not differ (adjusted HR 0.88).

32759631.takeaway: Reviews dairy and type 2 diabetes studies from 2004 to 2019, finding a consistent protective link only for low-fat dairy and yogurt, not other dairy products.

32761180.takeaway: Reviews the knowledge gap on regulating primordial follicle dormancy and activation, which matters for ovarian tissue cryopreservation in girls and young women with cancer.

32761207.takeaway: In 18 Danish boys followed through puberty, LH rose about 4 months before INSL3 and testosterone, and INSL3 rose first in only 22% of boys.

32762331.takeaway: In the Chinese TIDE study of 78,470 adults, higher urinary iodine was significantly associated with higher TSH values in the reference population.

32765423.takeaway: Sequencing 40 screening-detected gland-in-situ or hypoplastic congenital hypothyroidism cases in Macedonia found potentially pathogenic variants in 14, four of them definitive.

32772515.takeaway: A boy with congenital central hypothyroidism had a novel hemizygous IGSF1 nonsense variant, with early testicular enlargement, delayed testosterone rise and hypoprolactinaemia as key clues.

32772522.takeaway: In 12,772 children aged 0-59 months in Bandung, Indonesia, national growth charts better reflected healthy height and weight than WHO standards.

32778554.takeaway: In an Italian survey of 53 paediatric diabetes centres, new-onset type 1 diabetes fell 23% in early 2020 versus 2019, and severe DKA at presentation rose from 36.1% to 44.3%.

32778555.takeaway: Among 427 young adults with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, 93% had health coverage in Medicaid-expansion states versus 68% elsewhere, and HbA1c varied by coverage type.

32778556.takeaway: In 644 youths aged 10-23, those with type 2 diabetes had age-dependent differences in areal BMD and lean mass z-scores compared with those with obesity or healthy weight.

32781914.takeaway: In 48 patients with advanced medullary thyroid cancer treated outside trials, partial response occurred in 26% on vandetanib and 22% on cabozantinib, with median vandetanib PFS of 17 months.

32781915.takeaway: In 743 biopsied thyroid nodules, an ML-assisted ultrasound and elastography approach beat ACR TI-RADS, cutting the unnecessary biopsy rate from 30.0% to 4.5% in validation.

32783254.takeaway: In 553 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, trefoil factor-3, cystatin C and beta-2 microglobulin were negatively associated with baseline eGFR.

32785651.takeaway: In 26 women with PCOS, follicular excess was present across anovulatory and sporadic ovulatory cycles, with follicles in anovulatory cycles regressing within about 5 days.

32785693.takeaway: Gonadotroph pituitary tumours had more CD68+ macrophages than other pituitary tumour types, and tumour cells drove monocyte recruitment, linked to gonadotroph tumour invasion.

32788279.takeaway: In 39 obese adolescents, the TCF7L2 rs7903146 risk genotype was associated with a reduced incretin effect, an early marker of β-cell dysfunction.

32788280.takeaway: In the pooled DCCT/EDIC cohort, a 1-percentage-point HbA1c rise carried the same cardiovascular risk as 4.3 additional years of age or diabetes duration.

32788281.takeaway: In 64 youths with type 1 diabetes and HbA1c of 9% or higher, six months of intermittently scanned CGM did not improve HbA1c more than self-monitoring.

32789437.takeaway: In 12,666 adults in China, the association between early-life famine exposure and adult hyperuricaemia was moderated by economic status.

32791885.takeaway: In triple-knockout mice lacking a thyroid and deiodinases, T4 alone supported neonatal survival and growth and regulated liver gene expression, indicating intrinsic T4 activity.

32793113.takeaway: Young people with type 1 diabetes and Hashimoto's had higher BMI and waist circumference than those without it (BMI 23.3 vs 21.3 kg/m2).

32794201.takeaway: Maternal thyroid disease was not associated with overweight or obesity in 7-year-old children, though pregnant women with hypothyroidism had higher risks of overweight (aRR 1.20) and obesity (aRR 1.45).

32797184.takeaway: Reviews how puberty suppression, gender-affirming hormones and antiandrogens affect fertility in transgender and gender-nonbinary people, and approaches to fertility preservation.

32797203.takeaway: Serum 11-oxygenated C19 steroids did not distinguish 21 premenarchal daughters of women with PCOS from 29 girls with obesity and no family history of PCOS.

32797230.takeaway: A pituitary stalk 'mismatch pattern' on MRI appeared in 58.6% of children with idiopathic central diabetes insipidus and was linked to smaller pituitary size and more growth hormone deficiency.

32798472.takeaway: In England, type 2 diabetes accounted for 31.4% of 23,698 in-hospital COVID-19 deaths, and type 1 diabetes for 1.5%.

32799208.takeaway: Bayesian analysis of 48 children with GH deficiency and 175 GH-sufficient children found IGF-1 useful for screening and IGFBP-3 useful for confirmation.

32803089.takeaway: In 184 17-year-old girls, apoB48 lipoprotein remnants were associated with cardiometabolic risk factors in both those with and without PCOS.

32803093.takeaway: Crushing and dispersing hydrocortisone 5 mg tablets to obtain small doses caused iatrogenic Cushing syndrome in a 6-year-old girl with salt-wasting CAH, with poor growth and rising BMI.

32805706.takeaway: A male fetus with antenatal goitre and two novel SLC5A5/NIS mutations was treated with intra-amniotic levothyroxine; this is the first reported fetal case due to NIS mutations.

32808724.takeaway: In a prospective cohort, weight gain from birth to age 3 was positively associated with offspring HOMA-IR, independent of maternal weight status.

32809953.takeaway: Among 142 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes in Iran, 81.7% had at least one positive autoantibody, most often ICA (66.2%) and GADA (56.3%).

32809954.takeaway: Among 77 children with liver disease, 22.1% had subclinical hypothyroidism, and those with raised TSH were younger (median 5 vs 9 years).

32809955.takeaway: A child with carbonic anhydrase VA deficiency presented with hyperammonaemic encephalopathy, diagnosed by exome sequencing; this is the 16th reported case.

32809956.takeaway: Using longitudinal heights of 1,572 healthy Swedish children aligned to pubertal growth onset, a new pubertal height reference was built that accounts for variation in pubertal timing.

32809957.takeaway: In a survey of 106 paediatric endocrinologists in 17 Arab countries, 49.4% induced puberty in non-Turner girls at age 12-13, and 32.5% at 14 or older.

32809958.takeaway: In 4,018 Korean adolescents, handgrip strength was linked to lower central obesity and triglycerides in boys only, and not in girls.

32809959.takeaway: In 9-18-year-olds with type 1 diabetes in Turkey, eating-problem screen-positive patients had higher HbA1c (9.4%), BMI and diabetes duration, and scores were higher in girls.

32809960.takeaway: Reference thyroid gland vascularity index values were measured in 138 healthy children aged 3-17 using superb microvascular imaging.

32809961.takeaway: Two infant siblings with compound heterozygous CYP11B2 variants had aldosterone deficiency mimicking pseudohypoaldosteronism, stabilised with sodium supplementation and fludrocortisone.

32809962.takeaway: Among 114 children, obese children had higher systolic ambulatory blood pressure and heart rate than normal-weight children, and parental hypertension was linked to higher nighttime pressure in obese children.

32809963.takeaway: A teenager with new-onset diabetes presented with severe diabetic ketoacidosis and concurrent COVID-19 and responded well to treatment for both.

32810255.takeaway: A Pediatric Endocrine Society working group reviewed diazoxide for hyperinsulinism, noting serious adverse effects such as pulmonary hypertension and neutropenia and little guidance on dosing and monitoring.

32810262.takeaway: In a meta-analysis of 29 studies, maternal hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism were linked to offspring ADHD and epilepsy, and hypothyroidism to autism spectrum disorder.

32810280.takeaway: Two men with non-obstructive azoospermia received endocrine stimulation before microsurgical sperm retrieval, highlighting the limited data on its safety and efficacy.

32810858.takeaway: In 192 children with nonclassical CAH, adult height relative to target height was related to chronological age, bone-age ratio and height at diagnosis.

32812688.takeaway: In 47 adolescents with type 2 diabetes, those with fatty liver had lower HDL2b and higher HDL3c, and liver fat correlated negatively with HDL2b and particle size.

32813014.takeaway: Among 23,087 new methimazole users, pancreatitis risk was raised during the first three trimesters, though the absolute risk stayed below 0.4% over 18 months.

32813019.takeaway: Of 171 patients under 19 with differentiated thyroid cancer, 29 developed distant metastases, all in the lungs, and lymph node metastasis and extrathyroidal extension predicted metastasis-free survival.

32813676.takeaway: Sequencing GLA in 47 Turkish individuals with suspected Fabry disease identified 22 mutations, including two novel variants.

32813677.takeaway: In 59 people with Turner syndrome, maternal-origin X chromosomes were linked to more skeletal anomalies, such as short neck and short fourth metatarsal.

32813678.takeaway: A homozygous GNRH1 p.R31H variant caused severe normosmic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism in an index boy, while his heterozygous parents had late puberty.

32814319.takeaway: In 6,009 children treated with Omnitrope, 45.8% had an adverse event and 6.6% a treatment-related one over long-term follow-up.

32815027.takeaway: Danish children with type 1 diabetes reported more peer support and headaches than the background population, and those with HbA1c above 70 mmol/mol had worse wellbeing.

32816013.takeaway: In 255 female adolescents hospitalised with anorexia nervosa, adult height SDS was -0.29, close to their premorbid height SDS of about zero.

32816094.takeaway: In a 2-year non-randomised trial of 504 children aged 6-9, a combined physical activity and diet intervention attenuated the rise in insulin resistance compared with controls.
