34093450.takeaway: In neonatal pig Sertoli cells, EPA restored AMH and inhibin B after chemotherapy-induced reductions, suggesting a possible approach to protecting fertility.

34095692.takeaway: Screening 117 patients with Kallmann syndrome found SOX10 haploinsufficiency explains only a small fraction of cases, with a phenotype beyond Waardenburg features.

34096789.takeaway: In youth starting Control-IQ hybrid closed loop in routine care, glycemic control improved over six months, with high continued use and under 4% discontinuing.

34097062.takeaway: In obese women with PCOS, combined exenatide and dapagliflozin improved metabolic and hormonal measures more than either drug alone, dapagliflozin/metformin, or phentermine/topiramate.

34097736.takeaway: Heterozygous variants in LEP, LEPR, POMC and PCSK1 were frequent among 1486 probands with severe obesity and sometimes gave a phenotype close to homozygous cases.

34097869.takeaway: Projecting current trends, about half of Chinese adults and a fifth of children have overweight or obesity, and the authors call for strong government commitment.

34098553.takeaway: In girls aged 6 to 8 with suspected central precocious puberty, IGF-1 SDS, unlike IGFBP-3, helped identify CPP when other criteria were inconclusive.

34098763.takeaway: In children aged 0-6 with T1D, a young-child GMI formula is preferred when CGM data cover under 18 days, and the default data window may need revisiting.

34099516.takeaway: DKA at type 1 diabetes diagnosis in SEARCH youth rose from 2010 to 2016 after a stable period, and this rise was not explained by sociodemographic shifts.

34099518.takeaway: A tubeless on-body automated insulin delivery system was safe in 112 children and 129 adults, improved HbA1c and time in range, and caused little hypoglycemia.

34105729.takeaway: Meta-analysis suggests growth hormone treatment is safe and improves body composition in adults with Prader-Willi syndrome, which may reduce cardiovascular complications.

34105732.takeaway: Children with congenital hypothyroidism had neurocognitive impairment and white matter abnormalities despite timely treatment, compared with 39 healthy children.

34108936.takeaway: In 273 adolescents with major depression, HPA and HPT axis function were only loosely related, suggesting age-related maturation differs from adults.

34109778.takeaway: Buccal vitamin D3 spray and oral drops were equally effective in raising 25(OH)D in 90 children and adolescents with deficiency over short-term treatment.

34111870.takeaway: Early GH by age 6 with uninterrupted childhood treatment prevented ongoing growth failure in girls with Turner syndrome, enabling height within the normal range.

34111908.takeaway: A male child with odontochondrodysplasia had a novel compound heterozygous TRIP11 mutation, with short stature, skeletal changes, and dentinogenesis imperfecta.

34113318.takeaway: In a European post-marketing registry of children with growth disorders, NutropinAq raised height SDS across aetiology subgroups with no new safety concerns.

34115956.takeaway: During 2020 lockdowns, children with type 1 diabetes who had telemedicine access had more visits and HbA1c tests than those without access across four Latin American countries.

34115959.takeaway: In the randomized iDCL trial, closed-loop control improved some patient-reported outcomes versus sensor-augmented pump therapy, with high perceived benefit and low burden.

34118796.takeaway: Adolescents with obesity and type 2 diabetes had raised lipocalin 2, which adiponectin independently predicted, suggesting LCN2 may signal early insulin resistance.

34121143.takeaway: In a large Hong Kong cohort, earlier age at type 2 diabetes diagnosis amplified the effect of diabetes duration on chronic kidney disease risk.

34122327.takeaway: In the four core genotypes mouse, splenic T cell sex differences appeared by postnatal day 7, long before puberty, with more than one mechanism contributing.

34122345.takeaway: This review of genetic screening in small-for-gestational-age children considered for growth hormone argues it could tailor therapy and improve follow-up.

34122353.takeaway: A 5.9-year-old girl with DPG-plus syndrome, with midline malformations and paired pituitary glands, had premature thelarche that responded to hormonal suppression.

34125233.takeaway: Mild idiopathic infantile hypercalcemia had a distinctive vitamin D metabolite profile and was mainly linked to heterozygous SLC34A1 and SLC34A3 variants.

34125705.takeaway: A case series of children with short stature, microcephaly and SGA supports IGF1 haploinsufficiency as a cause of short stature with a defined phenotype.

34126618.takeaway: A newborn with a novel SERPINA7 variant and low-affinity thyroxine-binding globulin was falsely flagged on Dutch T4-based screening for central hypothyroidism.

34126658.takeaway: In a single-center series of children with Hashimoto thyroiditis, malignancy in nodules linked to thyroiditis was no higher than in other nodules.

34127495.takeaway: Over 1999-2018, rural U.S. adults with diabetes improved less than urban adults in blood pressure and cholesterol control.

34128826.takeaway: In children aged 6 months to 10 years at risk of deficiency, 2800 IU weekly vitamin D3 raised 25-OHD across all GC haplotypes; 7000 IU added little, and free 25-OHD gave no advantage.

34128988.takeaway: In 890 ten-year-olds, a higher visceral fat index was associated with more effector memory CD8+ and Vδ2+Vγ9+ T cells, suggesting adiposity-related inflammation in childhood.

34130293.takeaway: Childhood obesity is linked to accelerated linear growth and growth plate maturation, with risks of reduced adult height and early puberty.

34131047.takeaway: Youth with dysglycemia had hyperresponsive beta cells and lower insulin sensitivity than adults, but glucagon was not higher, so alpha-cell dysfunction does not explain the gap.

34131048.takeaway: In youth and adults with impaired glucose tolerance or recent type 2 diabetes, lower baseline beta-cell responses predicted glycemic worsening in both groups.

34132785.takeaway: Adults with cystic fibrosis meeting both indeterminate and impaired glucose tolerance criteria had 42-56% CFRD risk across two cohorts, versus 17% with normal glucose tolerance.

34134112.takeaway: In 299 Turner syndrome patients, GH-treated women reached greater adult height than untreated peers; pooled published data show a mean gain of 5.7 cm.

34135015.takeaway: In dysglycemic adults, glucagon concentrations fell after liraglutide plus metformin and after gastric band surgery, an effect largely attributable to weight loss.

34136918.takeaway: Genetic work-up of 149 children referred for suspected growth hormone insensitivity found a wide range of diagnoses, supporting GHI as a spectrum.

34136937.takeaway: The authors argue that objectively measured sleep quality should be considered in personalised type 1 diabetes management, given its link to overnight glycemic variability.

34137288.takeaway: This commentary argues that carefully designed technology and supportive team roles may help overcome the HbA1c disparity seen in African American youth with type 1 diabetes.

34137866.takeaway: In 733,208 Veterans on thyroid hormone therapy, both exogenous hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism were associated with increased stroke risk over time.

34139759.takeaway: In 20 children with mild idiopathic infantile hypercalcemia, dietary calcium and vitamin D restriction did not consistently normalize 1,25(OH)2D or stop renal calcification from worsening.

34140930.takeaway: TSH reference intervals differed by ethnicity and iodine status, with iodine-sufficient populations showing the lowest median and 2.5th percentile values.

34140931.takeaway: In prepubertal children with GH deficiency, a poor two-year growth response did not predict poor adult height better than the first-year response.

34142516.takeaway: Comparing obese children with and without hepatosteatosis, clinical, endocrine and metabolic markers including uric acid may help predict NAFLD risk.

34142517.takeaway: In a three-year-old with familial dysalbuminemic hyperthyroxinemia, rapid ALB gene sequencing confirmed the diagnosis and prevented repeated unnecessary thyroid testing.

34143673.takeaway: In 345 children with new type 1 diabetes, Black children started and sustained CGM use less often than white children in the first year, so disparities emerge early.

34143868.takeaway: In 198 Singaporean preschoolers, a higher brown adipose tissue percentage was linked to a more favorable metabolic profile, suggesting a possible protective role.

34145957.takeaway: A pilot survey of final-year medical students in six countries found basic diabetes knowledge remains weak, with diabetes classes contributing most to what they knew.

34146144.takeaway: Among 203 pregnant women with pre-existing diabetes, 27% delivered preterm, most often for suspected fetal asphyxia or preeclampsia.

34147045.takeaway: Craniosynostosis was an underdiagnosed complication of hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets, and children with normal head size may be missed without cranial imaging.

34147046.takeaway: Serum neurotensin was high in obese adolescents but was not associated with metabolic parameters, hyperphagia, binge eating disorder or food preference.

34147047.takeaway: In a US claims database of 4,217 children with precocious puberty, histrelin implants had longer treatment, fewer discontinuations and lower annual costs than leuprolide.

34149613.takeaway: Metabolomic profiling of women with PCOS and metabolic syndrome, compared with PCOS without it and controls, identified metabolites that may help screen for MS risk.

34149616.takeaway: In monosodium glutamate-obese rats, metformin normalized autonomic nervous system activity and reduced obesity and metabolic dysfunction.

34149626.takeaway: This review of growth delay in Noonan syndrome covers its etiologies and notes that rhGH benefit is hard to establish because treatment selection, duration and dose vary.

34156463.takeaway: Offspring exposed to gestational diabetes had marginally lower school grade point averages at age 15-16 than background-population offspring, a difference unlikely to matter clinically.

34157100.takeaway: Molecular analysis of 84 subjects with pseudohypoparathyroidism 1b found diverse methylation defects and identified mutations in 9 of 12 families.

34157106.takeaway: Most patients with atypical parathyroid adenoma had a good prognosis after parathyroidectomy, though germline CDC73 carriers had more persistent or recurrent disease.

34159287.takeaway: Parafibromin loss was seen in some sporadic ossifying fibromas, with CDC73 mutations in two cases showing aberrant expression, suggesting a role in a subset.

34159289.takeaway: Trimester- and BMI-specific reference intervals for BNP and NT-proBNP were defined in healthy pregnant women to aid cardiac evaluation in pregnancy.

34160618.takeaway: A machine learning tool using clinical data was developed to predict non-benign pediatric thyroid nodules, but its estimates were not tested on an independent set.

34160619.takeaway: Morning urinary LH was a reliable screening biomarker for central precocious puberty in 355 Chinese girls and also tracked response to GnRH agonist therapy.

34160841.takeaway: Eight patients with MEN2B were short rather than tall with normal body proportions, so the marfanoid habitus should not lead clinicians to expect tall stature.

34161696.takeaway: Novel SLC35A2-CDG variants were reported in patients at both ends of the disease spectrum, including a male with seizures and mild developmental delay.

34162022.takeaway: Novel MAN1B1-CDG patients had persistently raised transaminases without evident infection or liver disease, suggesting regular transaminase monitoring.

34162024.takeaway: In 209 children, obesity measures largely mediated the link between cardiorespiratory fitness and metabolic syndrome; the authors favor fat mass or waist circumference.

34162026.takeaway: In 315 children with type 1 diabetes, overweight and obesity were compared with normal weight, with the authors stressing the need to address obesity risk from diagnosis.

34162028.takeaway: In 26 Turkish patients with hereditary fructose intolerance, no clear genotype-phenotype correlation was seen, and infants with unexplained acute liver failure should be screened.

34162029.takeaway: In a single-center series of X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy, presentations varied widely without genotype-phenotype correlation, and HSCT was the only option halting neurological decline.

34162030.takeaway: A recurrent cryptic intronic FGFR3 variant that disrupts splicing was found in patients with hypochondroplasia-like features, supporting its inclusion in genetic testing.

34162031.takeaway: A seven-year-old boy with autoimmune thyroid disease later had atrophic thyroiditis and GAD-antibody neurological disease, suggesting GAD-65 autoimmunity be considered when neurological signs appear.

34162032.takeaway: A Chinese neonate with 46,XY DSD from a homozygous SRD5A2 variant suggested a founder effect and the need for a new LC-MS/MS reference ratio for T/5αDHT.

34162033.takeaway: In 67 Japanese children with Prader-Willi syndrome on long-term GH, bone mineral density SDS declined gradually despite treatment, supporting clearer bone monitoring.

34162035.takeaway: Three adolescents with thyroid storm first presented with neurological and gastrointestinal symptoms of Graves' disease, and one died, so both features should prompt consideration of storm.

34162036.takeaway: Nine patients with acromesomelic dysplasia Maroteaux type carried two novel NPR2 variants, underscoring the value of detailed clinical evaluation before genetic testing.

34162665.takeaway: Pooled prospective cohorts show the number of islet autoantibodies at seroconversion predicts 15-year type 1 diabetes risk, and HLA genotype refines risk when one autoantibody is present.

34167121.takeaway: This review of pediatric Langerhans cell histiocytosis describes long-term hypothalamic-pituitary damage, with central diabetes insipidus and growth hormone deficiency most common, and little progress on prevention.

34167176.takeaway: In an unscreened Irish population, most of 69 children with CAH presented with life-threatening salt-wasting, so many could be detected earlier with newborn screening.

34167177.takeaway: Four DGUOK deficiency cases had hepatic and cholestatic features that can mimic neonatal hemochromatosis or tyrosinemia, so mitochondrial DNA-depletion syndromes should be considered.

34167179.takeaway: In 73 normotensive children with premature adrenarche, arterial stiffness tracked with overweight and insulin resistance with dyslipidemia rather than with androgen levels.

34167180.takeaway: Reference acylcarnitine concentrations from 12,000 full-term breastfed newborns varied by sex and birth weight, which may help interpret expanded newborn screening.

34169220.takeaway: A 38-year-old woman with unilateral pheochromocytoma carried a novel likely pathogenic MAX splice variant that should be considered in similar workups.

34171085.takeaway: Second-tier 21-deoxycortisol testing on inconclusive first heel-prick samples in Dutch newborn screening removed false positives and avoided a second heel prick, shortening referral time.

34171098.takeaway: In a Swedish cohort of 11,326 with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes, comorbid neurodevelopmental disorders were linked to poor glycemic control and more complications, especially nephropathy.

34171937.takeaway: Among 508 children with eutopic-gland congenital hypothyroidism, transient disease was common, and the levothyroxine dose at 24 months distinguished transient from permanent CH.

34171939.takeaway: A patient with glycogen storage disease type XII had a novel likely pathogenic ALDOA variant, with hemolytic anemia and rhabdomyolysis triggered by febrile illness.

34171940.takeaway: In 117 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, glycemic control improved during the first lockdown versus 2019, and depression and anxiety symptoms were linked to worse control.

34172488.takeaway: In Ontario youth and young adults with type 1 diabetes, eating disorders were associated with more than triple the DKA risk and nearly sixfold mortality risk.

34172490.takeaway: In 612 infants from a general-population birth cohort, HLA type 1 diabetes risk alleles were differently associated with growth and IGF-I levels, suggesting distinct endocrine mechanisms.

34173306.takeaway: An integrated stepped care model for adolescents with type 1 diabetes helped identify and discuss their concerns, with limited evidence of feasibility in an ambulatory clinic.

34173308.takeaway: Psychometric testing supports the Diabetes Skills Checklist for teens and parents as a tool to assess adolescents' perceived independence in diabetes self-care during clinic visits.

34173705.takeaway: Unhealthy adolescent obesity phenotypes, unlike metabolically healthy obesity, raised early-adulthood type 2 diabetes risk, but after adult BMI adjustment only boys with unhealthy normal weight remained significant.

34174128.takeaway: In children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, a multi-strain probiotic added to standard care improved glycemic control and reduced insulin needs in a small pilot RCT, with no adverse effects.

34175829.takeaway: In 127 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, late-pregnancy C-peptide tracked with fetal transfer and neonatal complications, arguing against pregnancy-related beta-cell regeneration.

34177801.takeaway: In a prospective ICU cohort, euthyroid sick syndrome occurred in 38.7% of patients, with BNP, platelets and albumin as independent risk factors.

34177802.takeaway: A 4-month-old with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia had a candidate ADCY7 variant; knockout in rat insulinoma cells increased insulin secretion, proposing ADCY7 as a CHI gene.

34177807.takeaway: Adding stanozolol to GnRH agonist therapy preserved growth plate development and bone growth in children with CPP, possibly via JNK/c-Jun/Sox9 signaling, per clinical and rat data.

34177810.takeaway: Screening seven Chinese families identified nine AQP2 mutations, three of them novel, in 13 patients with congenital nephrogenic diabetes insipidus; compound heterozygotes had higher serum sodium.

34177811.takeaway: Two patients with POMC deficiency, a rare recessive cause of severe obesity and adrenal insufficiency, showed evolving endocrine features, so long-term follow-up through adolescence is warranted.

34182561.takeaway: In a large retrospective cohort of SGA children who reached final height, rhGH increased final height in short children, and several factors predicted a better response.

34182615.takeaway: In a national Brazilian adolescent study, most anthropometric measures were associated with insulin resistance, and BMI combined with central adiposity should inform cardiometabolic risk evaluation.

34185606.takeaway: An online survey of the cystic fibrosis community found diabetes technology use in CFRD is low despite perceived benefits, with cost and patient education as barriers.

34187112.takeaway: In Pakistani infants and children tested for suspected monogenic diabetes, genetic testing was essential to confirm diagnoses that guide management in a highly consanguineous population.

34187135.takeaway: A newborn with maple syrup urine disease carried two novel BCKDHB mutations; the authors advise early branched-chain amino acid testing and brain MRI in suspected cases.

34187840.takeaway: In 714 children with moderate or severe DKA, faster fluid infusion normalized anion gap and Pco2 sooner than slower rates but increased hyperchloremic acidosis.

34192395.takeaway: Risky sexual behavior was a concern among adolescent and young adult women with type 1 diabetes, especially with suboptimal glycemic control, so contraception use should be reinforced.

34192833.takeaway: Children with classical CAH in Sri Lanka, without newborn screening, often presented late with impending adrenal crisis, and boys were diagnosed later than girls.

34194389.takeaway: A patient with APECED had severe hypocalcemic episodes from autoimmune enteropathy; chromogranin A staining on repeated biopsies supported a reversible gut involvement.

34194391.takeaway: Exome sequencing of a tall male and his parents suggested that non-syndromic familial tall stature may be oligogenic, with several ciliary-gene variants implicated in linear growth.

34194394.takeaway: An in-silico TCGA analysis of adrenocortical carcinoma points to immune pathways that may suggest immunotherapy targets, with prior steroidogenesis inhibition suggested.

34194397.takeaway: In 195 children with Graves' disease treated over 20 years, cumulative remission rose with antithyroid drug duration, and long-term methimazole was a useful option before definitive therapy.

34195525.takeaway: In African American youth, the PRKAR1B p.R115K variant was associated with a lipoprotein profile that may be favorable, and laboratory work suggests it alters cAMP signaling.

34210114.takeaway: A 9-year-old SGA girl diagnosed with idiopathic GH deficiency had a novel ACAN nonsense variant and recurrent patellar dislocation, suggesting ACAN testing for similar patients.

34211432.takeaway: A girl with early severe obesity and retinal dystrophy had a novel homozygous INPP5E variant confirming MORMS, with insulin resistance and progressive retinal disease.

34211433.takeaway: In a survey of 1,603 Chinese children under 14 with type 1 diabetes, DKA was more common in very young children, and insulin access remains a major challenge.

34211435.takeaway: Second-trimester metabolomics in PCOS pregnancies showed a distinct signature enriched in triglycerides and unsaturated fatty acids, and these pregnancies produced lower-birth-weight babies.

34211436.takeaway: This review of thyroid function in preterm and low-birth-weight infants covers their physiology, newborn screening effects and treatment studies, with unresolved questions noted.

34212195.takeaway: A single IL-2 injection transiently reduced pulsatile GH secretion by about 28-32% in young healthy men, with no change in older men.

34214153.takeaway: In 525 healthy infants aged 12 to 24 months, plasma phosphate fell with age, with sex, iron and creatinine as main modifiers, while vitamin D dose did not change it.

34214291.takeaway: In 47 Iranian patients with tetrahydrobiopterin deficiency, outcomes varied widely, and early diagnosis and treatment in the first months of life were critical.

34214479.takeaway: A phase 2 randomized trial tested imatinib in recent-onset type 1 diabetes to preserve beta-cell function; the authors stress that careful toxicity monitoring is required.

34218547.takeaway: Two siblings with a homozygous GHR missense variant had a milder Laron syndrome phenotype, with higher height SDS than previously reported cases with the same variant.

34218628.takeaway: This review of disorders of sex development outlines their genetic, chromosomal, steroidogenic and environmental causes, showing how heterogeneous these conditions are.

34218629.takeaway: This mini-review for pediatricians covers prevalence, causes and evaluation of subclinical hypothyroidism, noting that mild TSH elevation needs individualized decisions.

34218630.takeaway: This review of whole-pancreas and islet cell transplantation for type 1 diabetes notes islet transplant's lower surgical risk and fewer complications, with promise in pediatric patients.

34218631.takeaway: In 35 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, fibrinogen, PAI-1 and von Willebrand factor antigen were elevated compared with 20 healthy controls, suggesting a prothrombotic state.

34218632.takeaway: In 13 children with osteoporosis (BMD z-score below -2), intravenous pamidronate increased bone mineral density without significant adverse events.

34218633.takeaway: In children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, initial HbA1c and sex were associated with partial remission, and female sex was an independent risk factor for nonremission.

34218634.takeaway: A patient with X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita, who had adrenal crisis at 2 months, carried a novel DAX-1 variant and was later treated with hCG for spermatogenesis.

34218635.takeaway: A 25-year-old Korean woman, diagnosed with X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets at age 9, carried a rare pathogenic PHEX variant, underscoring the value of genetic confirmation.

34219257.takeaway: In 66 children undergoing thyroidectomy, a PTH-based risk algorithm guiding preventive therapy reduced hypocalcemia and hospital stay.

34220704.takeaway: In 14,994 ART pregnancy cycles, pre-pregnancy obesity was associated with higher early miscarriage and miscarriage risk, especially with twins, supporting normal BMI before ART.

34220711.takeaway: Two siblings with novel compound heterozygous TPO mutations had dyshormonogenetic fetal goiter and congenital hypothyroidism, with neuropsychological evaluation reported for the first time in this setting.

34220717.takeaway: A child with growth hormone deficiency and familial hypercholesterolemia had LDL cholesterol elevated beyond what low GH alone explains, suggesting a lipid defect may also impair growth.

34223895.takeaway: In generalized lipodystrophy, metreleptin attenuated left ventricular hypertrophy and improved septal e' velocity, possibly through reduced lipotoxicity and glucotoxicity.

34225480.takeaway: Among Latinx and non-Latinx youth with type 1 diabetes, technology experiences and CGM use differed by language group and socioeconomic status, pointing to culturally tailored interventions.

34226826.takeaway: The authors propose selective estrogen receptor modulators as a possible gender-affirming option for non-binary individuals, while noting their effects and risks in this setting are poorly known.

34228102.takeaway: In a phase 3 randomized trial, one year of IV zoledronic acid raised lumbar spine BMD z-scores in children with glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis versus placebo, with most adverse events after the first infusion.

34228124.takeaway: A simple index built from fasting blood parameters was validated against clamps in 150 young healthy participants and identifies insulin resistance without overt metabolic disease.

34228132.takeaway: In children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, the proinsulin-to-C-peptide ratio rose over the first year, consistent with beta-cell ER stress, and was higher with younger age and poorer glycemic control.

34232122.takeaway: In 786 patients, female sex and the PGRIS score were independent risk factors for postoperative hypoparathyroidism after thyroidectomy for differentiated thyroid cancer.

34232125.takeaway: Among 401 low- to intermediate-risk differentiated thyroid cancer patients, isthmus location was a risk factor for persistent disease at 12 months and shorter disease-free survival.

34232311.takeaway: In children with glucocorticoid-treated rheumatic disorders followed for six years, vertebral deformities were often reshaped, but lumbar spine BMD z-scores stayed low, indicating incomplete recovery.

34232537.takeaway: A qualitative study of Hispanic caregivers of children with type 1 diabetes found language and cultural concerns about care, supporting culturally tailored interventions.

34234744.takeaway: SEER-based nomograms for 764 patients with malignant pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma predict 3- and 5-year overall and cancer-specific survival with good calibration.

34235358.takeaway: In 367 healthy chimpanzees, IGF-1 changes across the lifespan largely mirrored humans, while prolactin patterns were less similar.

34235361.takeaway: A nursing society position statement recognizes that transgender and gender diverse people face health disparities and barriers to knowledgeable care, and sets out how to address them.

34237741.takeaway: Euthyroid children at Hashimoto's onset had lower serum soluble RAGE than controls, suggesting autoimmunity itself may reduce sRAGE and increase oxidative damage susceptibility.

34237809.takeaway: In 2,250 children from southern Brazil, cardiometabolic risk scores were better than international references in boys, not significantly, and worse in girls.

34239499.takeaway: An 18-year-old with Beckwith-Wiedemann syndromic obesity was the first reported liraglutide-treated case, with a possible benefit linked to GLP-1 and CDKN1C pathways.

34240162.takeaway: This updated review of rare causes of hypercalcemia, beyond primary hyperparathyroidism and malignancy, emphasizes mechanism-based evaluation against prior reported cases.

34240167.takeaway: In Swedish registers, women with chronic hypoparathyroidism mostly had normal pregnancy outcomes, though they had more labor inductions and slightly lower infant birth weight.

34244330.takeaway: In Scotland, DKA rates in people with type 1 diabetes rose from 2004 to 2018 except among 10- to 19-year-olds, with widening socioeconomic disparities.

34247158.takeaway: This review of human and animal data suggests hyper- and hypoglycemia in young children with type 1 diabetes can alter brain structure and cognition during critical development, with effects that may persist.

34248839.takeaway: Next-generation sequencing of 19 candidate genes in dyshormonogenetic congenital hypothyroidism showed high diagnostic value, with oligogenic inheritance possibly explaining phenotypic variation and goiter.

34248843.takeaway: In papillary thyroid cancer, tumor mutation burden predicted relapse better than other variables in public datasets, and TMB-related genes correlated with prognosis.

34248849.takeaway: Comparing 30 newly diagnosed children with Graves' disease and 30 matched controls, researchers found several serum environmental substances linked to pathogenesis, seven associated with TPOAb.

34248851.takeaway: Plasma N-glycome profiling distinguished thyroid cancer from benign nodules and identified N-glycan biomarkers that may stratify lymph node metastasis risk.

34250379.takeaway: In a mother-child cohort, birth weight and infancy catch-up growth related differently to gonadarche and pubarche, with patterns differing across early and late pubertal markers.

34250910.takeaway: In Turkish children with molecularly confirmed monogenic diabetes, GCK-MODY was the most common form, unlike the HNF1A-MODY predominance reported elsewhere.

34252292.takeaway: Among 157 young children newly diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, consistent CGM use over 18 months was linked to lower HbA1c, and families with public insurance may face barriers.

34256372.takeaway: This review of pediatric chronic kidney disease describes GH resistance and IGF dysregulation, the effect of metabolic acidosis on growth, and current and emerging treatments for short stature.

34257098.takeaway: In 356 healthy youth, a type 2 diabetes genetic risk score tracked with glucose-insulin homeostasis traits, and maintaining a healthy weight may matter most for high-risk youth.

34258488.takeaway: Patient-reported XLH burden in 209 adults and 86 children (proxy reports) spanned physical, emotional and social domains, with challenges differing by age and adults lacking appropriate treatment.

34258490.takeaway: In 155 UK children and young people with primary adrenal insufficiency of unknown cause, a genetic basis was common, and next-generation sequencing improved diagnostic yield.

34260806.takeaway: In the Nurses' Health Study II, maternal prepregnancy BMI and physical activity did not predict offspring type 1 diabetes, though maternal type 2 diabetes was linked to higher risk.

34261073.takeaway: A girl with juvenile Paget disease from osteoprotegerin loss had rhizomelia and impaired linear growth, adding to limited natural history data for this ultra-rare disease.

34261075.takeaway: This review of pandemic-related stress from social isolation and anxiety examines its poorly studied effects on mental and physical health in children and adolescents.

34261199.takeaway: A 1.5-month-old infant with hypomagnesemia and secondary hypocalcemia had a novel synonymous TRPM6 variant, showing that synonymous changes can affect splicing and cause disease.

34261348.takeaway: A qualitative study of adolescents using a smartphone app hosting the CamAPS FX closed-loop algorithm found that running a medical app on a phone brings challenges alongside potential benefits.

34263953.takeaway: Qualitative interviews with preteens and adolescents showed that diabetes technology self-management is dynamic, shaped by many facilitators and barriers.

34265053.takeaway: In 16 obese craniopharyngioma patients with hypothalamic obesity, bariatric surgery produced about 22% weight loss at 5 years, less than in obese controls after gastric bypass.

34265059.takeaway: In 80 youth started on CGM soon after diagnosis, clinically serious hypoglycemia was rare, did not track with time in range, and did not differ by partial remission status.

34265880.takeaway: In 26 boys with congenital unilateral cryptorchidism, AMH was not associated with appendix testis size or androgen and estrogen receptor measures, though AMH with estrogen receptor expression may contribute in some cases.

34267729.takeaway: In cord blood from neonates of mothers with gestational diabetes, DNA methylation changes at the ZNF696 transcription start site were associated with neonatal hypoglycemia.

34270328.takeaway: In a crossover trial of 113 adolescents and young adults, advanced hybrid closed-loop improved glucose monitoring satisfaction versus first-generation hybrid closed-loop, mainly in those with more glycemic benefit.

34270347.takeaway: In 25 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes using CGM and pumps, insulin doses changed with gestation, yet most did not reach 70% time in range, pointing to anticipatory pump adjustments.

34271599.takeaway: In Nigerian children with sickle cell anemia, growth failure was common and rose with age and older age at diagnosis, showing a high burden of linear growth impairment.

34271601.takeaway: Among 133 children with type 1 diabetes, older age at onset was the main factor linked to partial remission, while absence of DKA and higher C-peptide may also influence it.

34271602.takeaway: In NHANES youth, greater muscle mass did not protect against high LDL-C or triglycerides, which tracked with fat mass, so exercise may help mainly through fat reduction.

34271604.takeaway: In familial glucocorticoid deficiency, early diagnosis and adherence to hydrocortisone kept neurodevelopment normal, while delayed diagnosis caused hypoglycemic seizures and neurodevelopmental complications.

34271605.takeaway: A meta-analysis of birth prevalence estimates that 12,000 to 19,000 people worldwide have mucopolysaccharidosis III.

34272580.takeaway: In two cohorts including UK Biobank, HLA DR15-DQ6 remained protective against type 1 diabetes across the first five decades of life, including adult-onset disease.

34272849.takeaway: In treatment-naive children with GH deficiency, once-weekly lonapegsomatropin met its noninferiority endpoint for height velocity and was superior to daily somatropin, with similar safety.

34272858.takeaway: In 23 youth with classical CAH, diffusion imaging showed compromised white matter integrity in the fornix and stria terminalis, suggesting an additional brain phenotype.

34272865.takeaway: In a nationwide Danish register, adverse pregnancy outcome odds linked to GDM differed by mother's country of origin, so both immigrant background and GDM status matter.

34272965.takeaway: In 312 normal-weight youth, researchers tested whether in-utero overnutrition raises childhood adiposity through early insulin hypersecretion; the authors call for repeated measures to clarify the sequence.

34273916.takeaway: In children on hemodialysis, estimated volumetric BMD was a convenient size adjustment for lumbar spine DXA, while height-based adjustments under- or overestimated bone density.

34274990.takeaway: Analysis of human pancreas in type 1 diabetes showed altered localisation and expression of the prion protein PrPC with unconventional trafficking, suggesting a possible role in disease.

34276565.takeaway: Sequencing 28 congenital hypothyroidism genes in 15 Chinese Han patients identified mutations with a high detection rate, and the authors recommend genetic screening to guide management.

34276569.takeaway: Adolescent girls with PCOS and autoimmune thyroiditis showed no metabolic difference from PCOS alone but had higher estradiol, which may point to a role in autoimmunity.

34280962.takeaway: Anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibodies were present in 20% of Belgian children under 16 with new-onset type 1 diabetes, similar to rates in children without diabetes.

34281356.takeaway: In a large cohort with autoimmune thyroid disease, association with chronic atrophic gastritis was the most common type-3 polyglandular syndrome manifestation, mainly at the potential stage.

34283215.takeaway: In boys, obesity was strongly associated with lower testosterone and reduced penis growth during development compared with normal-weight peers, using a new penile length method.

34284528.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with a plurihormonal pituitary macroadenoma had a 30% volume reduction on dopamine agonist and somatostatin analogue therapy when surgery was not possible.

34285100.takeaway: A meta-analysis of youth with type 1 diabetes found abnormal bone development across DXA, pQCT and ultrasound, supporting routine bone density assessment in all youth with T1D.

34285119.takeaway: This perspective on half a century of studies in a Pima Indian population describes how serial prospective data reshaped understanding of kidney disease in type 2 diabetes.

34285121.takeaway: In early diabetes, glucose variations appear to trigger KIM-1 release from CD8+ T cells, and plasma from high-risk youth raised kidney injury markers that KIM-1 blockade reduced.

34286167.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl had a juvenile granulosa cell tumor with a GNAS mutation previously reported in McCune-Albright syndrome and in such tumors, raising surveillance questions.

34286837.takeaway: In youth with obesity, branched-chain amino acids correlated with inflammation and cardiovascular biomarkers, and a physical activity lifestyle intervention lowered some amino acid levels.

34288885.takeaway: A genome-wide study of 321 Taiwanese girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty and 148 controls replicated known pubertal-timing variants and examined a polygenic risk score for early puberty.

34289064.takeaway: In 286 children aged 4 to 8, hepatic fat was low but independently associated with estimated insulin resistance and sex-specific glucose and triglyceride levels, possibly an early metabolic marker.

34290667.takeaway: In a case-control study of 161 girls, soy intake was associated with central precocious puberty, while exclusive breastfeeding appeared protective, though prospective studies are needed.

34290673.takeaway: This historical review traces growth and growth hormone from antiquity through recombinant therapy, and anticipates future indications, longer-acting analogues and more physiologic delivery.

34291312.takeaway: In TEDDY, 328 of 8,502 high-risk children developed T1D; diagnosis before age 6 appeared more aggressive, and among older children age did not affect progression once multiple autoantibodies were present.

34291618.takeaway: In 115 Chinese girls, serum inhibin B and IGF-1 predicted a positive GnRH analogue response for central precocious puberty, with the combined model AUC of 0.849.

34291621.takeaway: In short children with GH deficiency or idiopathic short stature, correcting low IGF-I with GH therapy and/or better nutrition was associated with more linear growth and bone and muscle growth.

34291622.takeaway: In a 10-month-old with polyuria, polydipsia and hypernatremia, plasma copeptin diagnosed nephrogenic diabetes insipidus without a water restriction test, which is risky in young children.

34291625.takeaway: Children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes during the COVID-19 pandemic in southern Turkey had more new diagnoses, higher autoantibody positivity, and more frequent and severe DKA than before.

34291731.takeaway: Among 104 adrenal ganglioneuromas, no postoperative recurrence was reported, and long-term follow-up seems unnecessary after complete surgery absent genetic or histologic uncertainty.

34291806.takeaway: In a nationwide Israeli cohort of 1.72 million adolescents, active asthma was linked to higher type 2 diabetes risk before age 35, independent of adolescent obesity and glucocorticoid use.

34291809.takeaway: This review proposes classifying type 2 diabetes by etiology rather than as a single phenotype, given the heterogeneity uncovered over five decades of research.

34292170.takeaway: In 17 children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, knee MRI quantitatively tracked a year of burosumab therapy, offering a radiation-free alternative to radiographs for rickets.

34293838.takeaway: A meta-analysis finds aerobic exercise alone mainly improves lipoprotein, blood pressure and body dimensions in obese children with metabolic syndrome, but cannot fully cure it.

34295308.takeaway: In girls with Turner syndrome, uterine size rose significantly 6-12 months into estrogen-induced puberty, though mature uteri remained smaller than in healthy age-matched girls.

34296321.takeaway: In a UK prospective cohort of 4,746 pregnant women, early-pregnancy vitamin B12 and folate levels were examined against gestational diabetes at 26-28 weeks, and unmetabolised folic acid is suggested for further study.

34297116.takeaway: In 2.5 million Catalans, BMI rose monotonically with COVID-19 diagnosis and hospitalization risk but showed a J-shaped relationship with death.

34298591.takeaway: In 22 girls treated for idiopathic central precocious puberty with 3-month leuprorelin, follow-up to adult height showed favorable anthropometric, metabolic and reproductive outcomes, with PCOS in one.

34302303.takeaway: A systematic review found only a small number of dated, low-to-moderate quality studies on harm from false-positive congenital hypothyroidism screening, so conclusive evidence is lacking.

34302728.takeaway: Pooled data from six US cohorts linked elevated BMI and waist circumference in young adulthood to later-life diabetes independently, with insulin resistance a likely key mediator.

34313086.takeaway: Girls with central precocious puberty on GnRH agonist treatment had resilience scores similar to healthy peers, and early diagnosis may reduce the gap in somatic changes.

34313605.takeaway: In 235 patients aged 30 or younger with apparently sporadic pituitary adenomas, genetic screening found novel variants and suggested incomplete penetrance of MEN1 alterations, while AIP and MEN1 screening remains valuable.

34313765.takeaway: In a secondary analysis of a randomized trial, participation in a prepregnancy weight loss intervention was associated with lower rates of early gestational diabetes diagnosis.

34314489.takeaway: Among 1.39 million Chinese adults at health screenings, diabetes prevalence was high while awareness, treatment and glycemic control were low, with geographic and seasonal variation in glucose.

34315726.takeaway: TMAO levels were raised in women with gestational diabetes and related to newborn weight and placental thickness, and in mice TMAO appeared to promote placental development while inhibiting NET formation.

34318892.takeaway: A child with severe insulin-resistant diabetes can often be diagnosed through a thorough history and physical examination, an approach especially useful in low- and middle-income countries.

34320495.takeaway: In 41 Canadian children with hypercalcemia or hypercalciuria, CYP24A1 and SLC34A1 pathogenic variants were uncommon, and the 25-OH-D3:24,25-(OH)2D3 ratio screens well for CYP24A1 variants.

34323056.takeaway: A systematic review of stretched penile length at birth found normative data differ across studies, suggesting population-specific reference charts instead of classic cut-offs.

34324429.takeaway: In healthy men aged 18-30 and 60-80, 11-oxyandrogens and pregnenolone sulfate showed distinct circadian and age patterns, which matter when these markers are used clinically.

34324432.takeaway: In a nationwide cohort, infant and toddler brain tumor survivors were more vulnerable to hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction than older children, supporting endocrine surveillance.

34324772.takeaway: Interviews with 39 youth and 44 parents found that their top wish for an ideal artificial pancreas system was to reduce the physical and emotional burden of diabetes.

34326068.takeaway: In 1,061 autoantibody-positive at-risk individuals, TCF7L2 type 2 diabetes variants were not related to insulin sensitivity or secretion after adjusting for BMI, age, sex and ethnicity.

34326814.takeaway: During Italy's COVID-19 lockdown, young people with type 1 diabetes unexpectedly improved glycemic control on CGM, with age-proportional gains linked to less stress and maintained activity.

34327978.takeaway: A 9.5-year-old boy with pseudohypoparathyroidism 1A from a novel GNAS variant, first presenting with congenital hypothyroidism, also developed central precocious puberty, which is rare in this condition.

34328029.takeaway: In a randomized trial of 53 young adults with type 1 diabetes, virtual group appointments added to telehealth significantly reduced diabetes-related distress.

34330178.takeaway: In 32 teens with type 1 diabetes, momentary affect was associated with blood glucose checking and levels, supporting affect in automated insulin delivery design.

34330786.takeaway: In 1,457 pregnant women with preexisting diabetes, insulin detemir and other basal insulins carried similar risks of major congenital malformations, perinatal or neonatal death, hypoglycemia, preeclampsia and stillbirth.

34331423.takeaway: A child with idiopathic juvenile osteoporosis from a homozygous LRP5 variant, also present in an asymptomatic mother, was treated with intravenous zoledronate and followed for four years.

34331525.takeaway: In 764 children aged 6 to 12, overweight or obese children were more likely to have high uric acid, which was strongly associated with several cardiometabolic risk factors.

34332515.takeaway: In 185 healthy children aged 5-17, the apoptosis marker APO1/Fas was associated with metabolic syndrome predisposing factors and mean platelet volume, supporting early monitoring in overweight children.

34333639.takeaway: In girls with a Turner syndrome phenotype, microarray found higher chromosome 14 copy-number variant frequencies, suggesting a genomic network shared with Turner syndrome.

34333643.takeaway: In late pregnancy, placental miR-3940-3p expression was associated with maternal insulin resistance at delivery, possibly acting on placental genes that regulate it.

34333645.takeaway: In the DutchMEN cohort, starting pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor surveillance at age 13 to 14 years in MEN1 patients is justified, with the psychological and medical burden of early screening weighed.

34335471.takeaway: Prepubertal boys with cryptorchidism had detectable plasma bisphenol A, with BPS and BPF present to a lesser extent, suggesting widespread exposure to these chemicals.

34335473.takeaway: A child with a spinal aneurysmal bone cyst treated with high-dose denosumab had rapid changes in mineral and bone homeostasis that required expert advice from a European reference network.

34338806.takeaway: A simplified risk model using a single 120-minute OGTT blood sample predicted progression to stage 3 type 1 diabetes in pre-symptomatic individuals, reducing sampling burden.

34339631.takeaway: An international guideline group harmonized bone mineral density surveillance for childhood, adolescent and young adult cancer survivors, with repeat testing timed by Z-score results.

34340592.takeaway: In indeterminate thyroid nodules, ultrasound pattern, age and Bethesda category added limited value beyond molecular testing, though patient sex may contribute to cancer risk.

34342594.takeaway: Long-term ACROSTUDY data support a favorable benefit-to-risk profile and high efficacy of pegvisomant alone or combined in acromegaly, including aggressive or uncontrolled disease.

34343292.takeaway: In 18 vitamin D-deficient adults, correcting deficiency with cholecalciferol or calcifediol did not lastingly change fecal microbiota composition in this small pilot trial.

34343299.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests earlier pubertal maturation is associated with higher midlife blood pressure in men and women, independent of childhood BMI.

34343303.takeaway: A high-affinity electrochemiluminescence ZnT8 autoantibody assay separated higher-risk single-ZnT8A positives from many radiobinding results, improving prediction of type 1 diabetes progression.

34344062.takeaway: In 63 girls with breast development before age 8, GnRH stimulation rapidly increased AMH; basal AMH was lower in central precocious puberty than isolated premature thelarche.

34348285.takeaway: Preterm newborns differed from full-term newborns in CYP19A1 methylation, testosterone and the estradiol-to-testosterone ratio, which may contribute to sex hormone disturbances in preterm birth.

34348299.takeaway: In 30 children with obesity followed through puberty, vascular dysfunction and lower adiponectin persisted without further decline, and better vascular function tracked with lower BMI z-score and waist circumference.

34348302.takeaway: In a child with 6q24-related transient neonatal diabetes, annual glycemic profiles during remission showed fluctuating beta-cell function and insulin resistance.

34348303.takeaway: An international Prader-Willi organisation survey found no consensus on who should receive gonadal hormone substitution or at what age, and few behavioral problems were attributed to treatment.

34348306.takeaway: This review of brown adipose tissue in children describes its role in energy homeostasis and links BAT activity to glucose metabolism and insulin sensitivity, relevant to metabolic syndrome.

34348419.takeaway: The first Old Order Mennonite family with aromatase deficiency included a proband with ambiguous genitalia and a brother later confirmed with the same diagnosis, suggesting under-recognition.

34348423.takeaway: Obese prepubertal children with Down syndrome had more central adiposity, atherogenic lipids and insulin resistance than matched obese controls, and adiponectin performed better as a metabolic syndrome marker in them.

34350463.takeaway: MAIT cells were altered in adults with recent-onset and long-term type 1 diabetes, with changes possibly linked to impaired glucose homeostasis and to autoimmunity.

34350858.takeaway: In real-life surveillance of biosimilar growth hormone in children with Turner syndrome, treatment was well tolerated and effective, and dose optimization may raise adult height.

34351306.takeaway: This narrative review of pediatric NAFLD, which differs from the adult phenotype, outlines influencing factors such as age, sex, puberty and genetics, and calls for validated noninvasive biomarkers and trials.

34351307.takeaway: This review of pharmacotherapy for childhood obesity discusses the limits of lifestyle intervention and how molecular mechanisms may guide future antiobesity drug choice in children.

34351670.takeaway: A nationwide Polish cross-sectional study found over 40% of youth with type 1 diabetes met the international HbA1c target, with better control linked to newer technologies and optimal weight.

34352793.takeaway: This review argues that infancy, a short human life-history stage, has become decoupled from biological, cognitive and social maturation in affluent societies, with implications for infant care.

34355877.takeaway: Two unrelated 46,XY DSD patients had GATA-4 variants, and a review of 22 previously reported cases shows phenotypes ranging from mild undervirilization to female external genitalia.

34355878.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl with mosaic Turner syndrome and 21-hydroxylase deficiency had premature pubarche and SRY-negative virilization, suggesting CAH be considered in Turner patients with virilization.

34355879.takeaway: A real-life study switched poorly controlled, non-adherent youth with type 1 diabetes to degludec/aspart; the authors note this simplified regimen may not suit everyone because of its fixed aspart dose.

34362814.takeaway: Exome sequencing found monogenic diabetes in 2.8% of multiethnic youth with clinically diagnosed type 2 diabetes; in 89% the correct diagnosis would have changed management, but no clinical criterion reliably identified them.

34362815.takeaway: In 4,426 autoantibody-positive relatives, delayed time to peak glucose or C-peptide during an OGTT predicted diabetes within 5 years independent of peak levels, most strongly for C-peptide.

34363298.takeaway: In 212 youth with type 2 diabetes followed about 7 years, progression or persistence of abnormal LDL-C and triglycerides was associated with higher HbA1c.

34363430.takeaway: Children with type 2 diabetes diagnosed before puberty had greater insulin resistance and more frequent dyslipidemia than older youth, indicating higher morbidity risk.

34363474.takeaway: This case-based review shows that gene variants, acquired conditions or both cause childhood dyslipidemia, and that severe hypertriglyceridemia can cause pancreatitis, so early management matters.

34367069.takeaway: This systematic review found longer anogenital distance associated with PCOS and shorter distance with endometriosis, while calling for well-designed studies to corroborate these links.

34367073.takeaway: In a retrospective study, advanced paternal age increased SGA risk among preterm infants and LGA risk among term infants.

34368982.takeaway: This review explains how to interpret reproductive hormones before, during and after puberty, to distinguish healthy puberty from precocious, delayed or disordered puberty.

34369043.takeaway: Among parents of early school-age children with type 1 diabetes during early COVID-19, social support emerged as a key factor to assess alongside mood and diabetes experiences.

34369627.takeaway: In 2,159 children at increased risk, plasma glucose and HbA1c rose markedly before clinical type 1 diabetes, supporting the idea that increased insulin demand contributes to onset.

34370046.takeaway: In 761 mother-offspring pairs, higher maternal diet quality in pregnancy was associated with better metabolic biomarkers in offspring at age 4-7, especially in boys.

34370339.takeaway: In children with diazoxide-responsive hyperinsulinism and negative KATP genetics who needed over two years of therapy, the condition resolved long-term, though some had mild to moderate developmental delay.

34374183.takeaway: Algorithm-based prioritization of children with type 1 diabetes for weekly remote CGM review reduced provider time per patient and was associated with improved time in range.

34376501.takeaway: During the transition to adulthood, HbA1c testing frequency in youth with diabetes differed mainly by health care factors, and some of these were linked to outcomes in type 1 diabetes.

34376826.takeaway: This review of transgender and gender-diverse youth describes the mental health benefits of gender-affirming care, the challenges of providing it, and priorities for research.

34379603.takeaway: Ten full-term placentas contained relatively large amounts of 11-oxygenated androgens, suggesting the placenta participates in a feto-maternal network for androgen biosynthesis.

34379604.takeaway: A lipid-based oral native testosterone capsule was developed that is absorbed independent of food, a potential option for patients who do not tolerate injections.

34380293.takeaway: Feminizing adrenocortical tumors in children, mostly under 8 years old, cause pseudopuberty, and childhood cases may have a better prognosis than tumors presenting in adult males.

34382419.takeaway: A girl with congenital hypothyroidism had a poor levothyroxine response due to a concurrent THRB variant on top of dyshormonogenesis, the first report of combined SLC5A5 and THRB variants.

34382758.takeaway: A male child with compound heterozygous FAM111A variants had Kenny-Caffey syndrome type 2 features, including hypoparathyroidism and skeletal dysplasia, the first FAM111A case reported in Turkey.

34383079.takeaway: Four individuals from three consanguineous families with biallelic CPE variants had childhood-onset obesity, neurodevelopmental delay and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, defining BDV syndrome, which resembles Prader-Willi syndrome.

34387403.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 10 children with suspected MODY and non-diagnostic panels identified two patients previously labeled type 1 diabetes, one with a novel likely pathogenic variant.

34388329.takeaway: In Japanese infants with positive newborn screening for congenital hypothyroidism, abnormal urinary iodine with raised thyroglobulin was linked to lower levothyroxine requirements.

34388330.takeaway: This endocrine review compares menstrual suppression options for adolescents by efficacy and effects on bone, since adolescence is a key period of peak bone mass accrual.

34390338.takeaway: In 237 people with type 1 diabetes, the DR9/DR9 HLA genotype was linked to less frequent partial remission and lower beta-cell recovery in adult-onset disease.

34390365.takeaway: In 10,906 Nurses' Health Study II women, long or irregular menstrual cycles in mid-adulthood, but not earlier, were associated with higher later gestational diabetes risk.

34393996.takeaway: SEER-based nomograms predict distant metastasis risk and prognosis in newly diagnosed osteosarcoma, a cancer mainly of children and adolescents, to inform clinical decisions.

34393999.takeaway: Seminal plasma lipidomics distinguished 21 men with Kallmann syndrome from 22 healthy controls, with triglycerides, phosphatidylcholines and phosphatidylethanolamine proposed as candidate biomarkers.

34394004.takeaway: This review of CFRD causes highlights islet disorganization and impaired first-phase insulin secretion in very young children, suggesting CFTR mutations disrupt islet development.

34394011.takeaway: In 420 adolescents aged 11 to 14, plasma IGFBP-1 associated more strongly with waist-to-height ratio than with BMI-for-age z-score, suggesting it may be a sensitive obesity biomarker.

34397083.takeaway: In infants with classical CAH, lower plasma epinephrine was associated with more acute illness in the first year, suggesting epinephrine and genotype may help predict illness.

34401952.takeaway: In a nationwide cohort of 2.47 million people, maternal diabetes during pregnancy was associated with higher risk of high refractive error in offspring up to age 25, especially with diabetic complications.

34402903.takeaway: Genome sequencing of two sisters with early-onset primary ovarian insufficiency from a consanguineous family identified ZSWIM7 disruption, suggesting a role in human homologous recombination.

34403181.takeaway: This review traces six decades of pediatric type 1 diabetes care and research in China, summarizing treatment progress and identifying shortcomings to address.

34403357.takeaway: In 429 children evaluated for short stature, IGF-I, ALS and the IGF-I/IGFBP-3 ratio did not reliably separate GH deficiency from constitutional delay, leaving auxology as the main criterion.

34403358.takeaway: A targeted plasma miRNA profiling protocol discriminated PCOS in non-obese women and distinguished it from obesity, which often presents with overlapping features.

34403359.takeaway: In adolescents with delayed puberty, targeted gene panel or exome testing helped distinguish idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism from self-limited delayed puberty, enabling earlier diagnosis.

34403360.takeaway: In a Finnish APECED cohort, infections and immune-related causes were the most common primary causes of death, and adrenal crisis often contributed to fatal infections.

34405127.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with peripheral precocious puberty and very low SHBG carried a homozygous SHBG variant, which may have caused gonadotropin-independent puberty.

34405256.takeaway: A six-day subcutaneous GIP infusion did not convincingly change overall time in range in type 1 diabetes, though it added about two hours a day in the tight daytime range.

34405734.takeaway: In a German real-world series of 101 patients with radioiodine-refractory thyroid cancer, multikinase inhibitors showed efficacy and safety that compared favorably with sorafenib, though direct comparison is precluded.

34406395.takeaway: In glucose-intolerant pancreatic-insufficient cystic fibrosis, sitagliptin increased meal-related incretin responses and improved early insulin secretion and glucagon suppression, without changing postprandial glycemia.

34406976.takeaway: Adults with adrenal adenomas, including mild autonomous cortisol secretion, had lower muscle mass and more visceral fat than referents, suggesting subtle cortisol excess may affect health.

34407200.takeaway: In neonates with persistent hypoglycemia or congenital hyperinsulinism, real-time CGM revealed dysglycemia that intermittent blood glucose checks missed, agreeing with blood values within 11%.

34407327.takeaway: In children with incidental small pituitary cysts, surgery was not needed, and growth hormone replacement did not significantly enlarge the lesions.

34407329.takeaway: Among 73 children receiving 184 histrelin implants, most procedures succeeded in clinic without sedation, while longer implant duration raised difficulty and complications.

34408725.takeaway: This review of pediatric hypoglycemia presents age-related definitions and main metabolic and endocrine causes, and proposes a diagnostic flowchart to prevent hypoglycemic brain injury.

34410410.takeaway: In adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes, dietary fat and protein altered GLP-1, GIP and glucagon secretion during insulin clamps, suggesting a hormonal mechanism for postprandial glucose effects.

34413068.takeaway: A Beijing population-based registry of 21.7 million people found type 1 diabetes incidence higher than previously reported, rising sharply in adults but not in youth from 2007 to 2017.

34413832.takeaway: In NHANES 2013-2016, a pro-inflammatory diet was associated with lower testosterone and estradiol in male adolescents, with no significant link in younger boys.

34415074.takeaway: In 271 youth and young adults with type 1 diabetes, 3.4% had never had a retinopathy exam, and missed school and work were barriers, especially for older patients and longer duration.

34415989.takeaway: In children with differentiated thyroid cancer, age, ATA risk group and response to therapy were significant prognostic factors for event-free survival, supporting risk-adapted follow-up.

34415991.takeaway: In children with aldosterone synthase deficiency, growth improved and fludrocortisone needs fell over time through physiological adaptation, not better aldosterone synthase activity, so long-term surveillance is needed.

34416000.takeaway: In a nationwide Japanese cohort, midpregnancy maternal total cholesterol was associated with small or large for gestational age birth at term, possibly helping prediction.

34416104.takeaway: In very low birth weight infants, the standard vitamin D protocol raised most deficient or insufficient infants to sufficiency by day of life 30, and mother and infant levels correlated closely.

34416793.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl first diagnosed with type 2 diabetes had a novel heterozygous RFX6 nonsense variant causing monogenic diabetes, and her HbA1c improved from 8.8% to 6.8% on a GLP-1 receptor agonist.

34416796.takeaway: In 13 children with lipoprotein lipase deficiency, medical apheresis was a safe and effective acute treatment for severe hypertriglyceridemia, and it can be done at any center.

34417587.takeaway: This review of GH deficiency in children covers differential diagnosis through clinical presentation, neuroimaging and genetic testing, plus management advances and transitional care.

34421819.takeaway: This review of X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets, caused by FGF23 dysregulation from PHEX mutations, recommends multidisciplinary care because newer treatment improves outcomes over conventional therapy.

34423627.takeaway: A severely obese adolescent with classical CAH and migraine lost weight and central adiposity on topiramate without side effects, suggesting a pharmacologic option beyond lifestyle change.

34423677.takeaway: In a pilot of a diabetes-in-pregnancy app, user engagement varied with baseline behavioral and clinical traits, and digital health literacy distinguished engagement better than general health literacy.

34425572.takeaway: In a healthcare claims database, children diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder had a higher incidence of precocious puberty than undiagnosed peers.

34425574.takeaway: Pituitary MRI in children with short stature or isolated GHD can be done without gadolinium, though non-contrast images slightly overestimate stalk interruption, which newer sequences can address.

34425577.takeaway: Among 3,902 children at 17 short stature clinics, the boy-to-girl ratio of GHD-treated children reflected referral selection bias, since parents are more concerned about boys' height.

34427658.takeaway: Circulating kisspeptin varied across trimesters and was linked to preterm birth and gestational diabetes in unadjusted analysis, but not after multivariable adjustment.

34428361.takeaway: In pediatric records of persistently low alkaline phosphatase, a wide range of disorders was found, and hypophosphatasia should be considered when specific symptoms are present.

34429323.takeaway: Out-of-pocket costs for nonelderly U.S. adults with diabetes declined from 2001 to 2017, especially for those least able to afford them.

34431123.takeaway: About one-third of pediatric and adolescent Cushing disease patients had no visible pituitary tumor on MRI, and a negative MRI was linked to higher odds of nonremission after surgery.

34432968.takeaway: Adolescents' self-assessed pubertal stages were positively associated with hormone biomarkers of puberty, supporting self-staging as a research tool.

34434168.takeaway: Plasma lipidomics in 70 children born to women with PCOS differed from 71 controls, with phosphatidylcholines, lysophosphatidylcholine and sphingomyelin as possible cardiometabolic markers.

34435630.takeaway: The first reported case of TUBB3 E410K syndrome with childhood-onset NASH suggests the TUBB3 mutation may contribute to NASH pathogenesis in humans.

34435718.takeaway: Tubular injury occurred during DKA in 40 children, with copeptin and serum uric acid tracking its degree and possibly predicting acute kidney injury.

34438400.takeaway: In a pediatric dose-escalation trial, oral macimorelin at three doses showed excellent safety, tolerability and expected pharmacokinetics, supporting a phase 3 validation trial in children.

34438404.takeaway: A case showed that normal mid-gestation fetal ultrasound cannot reliably exclude severe perinatal hypophosphatasia, so antenatal genetic testing should be considered when there is family history.

34447350.takeaway: This narrative review links congenital hypothyroidism to hearing loss through thyroid hormone's role in auditory pathway development, with consequences for language and cognitive skills.

34447352.takeaway: In 110 US children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, glycemic control did not change significantly during the 2020 lockdown after adjusting for confounders.

34447353.takeaway: In 18 males with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism, low serum INSL3 with normal testosterone in some was possibly explained by discordant gonadal expression of INSL3 and CYP11A1.

34448000.takeaway: In children, adipocyte progenitor markers MSCA1 and CD36 were associated with obesity-related adipose tissue changes, and CD36 expression predicted the adipogenic potential of stromal cells.

34448034.takeaway: In autoantibody-positive relatives, ERBB3/IKZF4 variation affected progression to multiple autoantibodies in females, a sex-specific interaction that may contribute to the post-pubertal male excess in T1D.

34448208.takeaway: A systematic review finds GLP-1 receptor agonists appear safe in Prader-Willi syndrome, with possible benefits for weight, glycaemia and appetite, but well-designed studies are lacking.

34448386.takeaway: In 112 patients with biotinidase deficiency, clinical, biochemical and genetic features are described, and early detection before symptoms is urged because treatment is inexpensive and available.

34448875.takeaway: An oral phosphorus load raised circulating phosphate for hours in healthy subjects despite homeostatic responses, while FGF23 and the postprandial response to food were unaffected.

34448879.takeaway: In human iPSC-derived and MIN6 beta-like cells, a heterozygous mutant insulin gene caused progressive ER stress and beta cell dysfunction, with reducing sXBP1 or inflammation suggested as a way to restore function.

34453169.takeaway: PAX1 was epigenetically silenced in sporadic parathyroid adenomas, and a demethylating agent restored its expression in parathyroid cells, suggesting a possible therapeutic target.

34453540.takeaway: This meta-analysis finds first-degree relatives of women with PCOS have reproductive endocrine dysregulation, including more premature baldness and elevated DHEAS in male relatives.

34453541.takeaway: In 6,068 pregnant women, lower early-pregnancy free T4 or a higher fT3/fT4 ratio was associated with GDM, with the fT3/fT4 association largely mediated by specific lipid species.

34453777.takeaway: In Chinese children with beta thalassemia major, HbA1c, fructosamine and glycated albumin were assessed for glucose dysregulation, with heart iron deposition or high ferritin linked to abnormal glucose metabolism.

34455658.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes, social self-efficacy was linked to HbA1c through physical activity and diabetes-related quality of life, suggesting these are modifiable factors.

34455732.takeaway: In Qatari children with type 1 diabetes, celiac disease prevalence was comparable to global reports, and many cases were asymptomatic, supporting routine screening.

34456858.takeaway: In children with clinodactyly from phalangeal intra-articular osteochondroma, surgery is the first choice for symptomatic cases, and about 10 degrees of angulation is suggested as a diagnostic threshold.

34456866.takeaway: In a propensity-matched cohort, frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer on day 6 of progesterone gave a higher live birth rate than day 7, especially for women under 35 and with high-quality blastocysts.

34456870.takeaway: Among 1,492 girls with precocious puberty, basal LH and a single 60-minute GnRH agonist stimulation sample gave high diagnostic accuracy for idiopathic central precocious puberty, reducing blood draws.

34456876.takeaway: In 24 parents of children aged 1 to 7 with type 1 diabetes, hypoglycemia fear and parental well-being were not associated with HbA1c, and routine screening of parents is recommended.

34458657.takeaway: In a prospective Qatari cohort of children with idiopathic type 1 diabetes, the authors stress autoantibody testing and genetic screening for known monogenic causes.

34460908.takeaway: This review of Prader-Willi-like syndrome describes an overlapping phenotype without the typical 15q11-q13 defect, and proposes a diagnostic approach for endocrinologists within multidisciplinary care.

34462258.takeaway: Subthreshold predisposition to proinsulin misfolding can go undetected yet provides genetic susceptibility to diet-induced beta cell failure.

34467980.takeaway: In 152,139 Chinese adults, fatty liver disease was associated with increased all-cause mortality, and the risk varied with overweight, diabetes and other metabolic indicators.

34469888.takeaway: In 575 thyroid nodules from 324 children, the authors recommend fine-needle aspiration for nodules with TI-RADS above 3 regardless of size, and surgery for Bethesda IV and V nodules.

34469891.takeaway: This review of ovotesticular DSD covers its genetic causes, histology and management, which now prioritizes the child's future autonomy, with international monitoring still needed.

34469895.takeaway: This review links childhood stress, including pandemic-related stress, to obesity risk and finds mindfulness programs a promising adjunct for prevention, though evidence is partly equivocal.

34473288.takeaway: Four in ten US young adults aged 18-44 without diabetes had insulin resistance, often clustered with cardiometabolic risk factors, and nearly half of them were not obese.

34473920.takeaway: In 190 obese adolescents, their own psychiatric symptoms and BMI percentile affected quality of life more than maternal psychiatric symptoms did.

34474591.takeaway: This review of smart insulin pens for children on injections describes data-driven diabetes management, benefits, challenges and clinical use as an alternative to pump therapy.

34475030.takeaway: Newborns exposed to maternal metformin for pregnancy hyperglycemia had subtle, non-pathological metabolic screening changes, with all results within normal limits.

34475031.takeaway: In an insured US claims cohort, some adults newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes developed proliferative retinopathy or other neovascular complications within five years, supporting targeted screening.

34475033.takeaway: Among 1,217 youth with type 2 diabetes in a US registry, comorbidities were common regardless of race or ethnicity, except NAFLD was less common in Black youth, and disparities persisted.

34475850.takeaway: High PD-L1 expression in many anaplastic thyroid cancers and a subset of poorly differentiated cancers supports checkpoint inhibition, while FGFR expression in tumor cells is low.

34476481.takeaway: In healthy infants, IGF-I was associated with weight gain in girls but not with length growth in the first year, highlighting its anabolic role beyond linear growth.

34476487.takeaway: This review of pharmacologic management for trans and gender-diverse adolescents covers pubertal suppression and sex-hormone options, reported outcomes, and challenges given limited prospective data.

34477199.takeaway: In a Canadian birth cohort, large-for-gestational-age infants showed possible LGA-specific links between weight gain or BMI and adiponectin, suggesting dysfunction in the adiposity-adiponectin feedback loop.

34477200.takeaway: In maternally inherited STX16-deletion pseudohypoparathyroidism 1B, PTH levels rose years before overt hypocalcemia, indicating when calcium and calcitriol treatment should be considered.

34477355.takeaway: A meta-analysis finds letrozole safe and effective for improving predicted adult height and pubertal outcomes in constitutional delay of growth and puberty, with better testicular volume results than testosterone.

34477356.takeaway: An infant with congenital hyperinsulinism who still had persistent hypoglycemia after near-total pancreatectomy had episodes controlled by adding maltodextrin to the diet.

34478541.takeaway: Decreased monocyte count throughout pregnancy was closely linked to GDM, macrosomia and GDM-related inflammation across 214 women with GDM and 926 without, suggesting first-trimester count as an early marker.

34478616.takeaway: In 1,418 healthy Indian children aged 9 to 18, IAP 2015 BMI charts identified metabolic risk with higher sensitivity than WHO 2007 charts, suggesting they may suit Indian children better.

34480566.takeaway: In 5,124 Tehranian adults, the TFQI index of reduced thyroid hormone sensitivity was most associated with diabetes and hypertension among euthyroid people, though the diabetes link needs caution.

34480842.takeaway: A 7-year-old Korean boy with Gordon syndrome from a CUL3 mutation had hypertension, hyperkalemia and short stature; thiazide normalized electrolytes but not hypertension or height.

34481555.takeaway: Using primary care electronic records from England, researchers identified adult subgroups at highest risk of weight and BMI gain to target obesity prevention.

34481558.takeaway: This English national study compared emergency DKA admissions during the first COVID-19 wave with prior years, highlighting risk in type 2 diabetes and newly diagnosed diabetes.

34481559.takeaway: In the Amsterdam gender clinic cohort over five decades, cause-specific deaths gave no sign of a specific hormone treatment effect, but monitoring medical morbidity remains important.

34482307.takeaway: SNP-array copy number analysis in obese children found candidate genomic loci, with array testing most useful in children with dysmorphic features, intellectual disability or neuropsychomotor signs.

34484109.takeaway: Neonatal isolated hyperthyrotropinemia is rare (about 0.06%); none of 94 patients with developmental data had a poor outcome, but mild-disease neurodevelopmental risk remains uncertain.

34484127.takeaway: Humans ingest microplastics daily, with infants exposed through feeding bottles; animal and cell studies link them and their additives to endocrine disruption and altered metabolism, but systematic studies remain urgently needed.

34487407.takeaway: Prenatal folic acid use was not associated with neonatal diabetes/hyperglycemia or type 1 diabetes in a Norwegian register cohort of 781,567 children; longer follow-up is needed.

34489862.takeaway: Higher maternal fasting glucose in early pregnancy was linked to fetal growth and birth outcomes, with associations varying by maternal BMI and changing between mid and late pregnancy.

34490640.takeaway: In 224 pregnancies, term newborn bone mass was associated with birth weight, second-trimester fetal femoral volume and placental weight.

34491825.takeaway: In 25 people with type 1 diabetes aged 6 to 70, a CGM-trend-adjusted bolus calculator on Omnipod 5 was safe and gave fewer post-bolus readings below 70 mg/dL than the standard calculator.

34492746.takeaway: In 221 girls aged 6 to 10, ultrasound and Tanner breast staging agreed poorly, and Tanner staging overestimated development more as BMI z-score rose.

34492747.takeaway: Across 7 cases from one cohort and 165 published probands, delayed diagnosis of VDDR1A caused short stature and deformity, and truncating variants were linked to more severe disease.

34494709.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes, nocturnal hypoglycemia lengthened QTc slightly, and heart rate variability changed before CGM detected the low.

34496164.takeaway: In 30 children with type 1 diabetes versus 30 controls, renal diffusion-weighted MRI values correlated with eGFR and microalbuminuria and detected lower values even with normal albumin excretion.

34497581.takeaway: Urinary exosomal HSD11B2 mRNA was measurable and rose with the 662C>G genotype and hypertension, tracking steroid ratios in apparent mineralocorticoid excess.

34497584.takeaway: Quantitative cytology and immunohistochemistry distinguished congenital hyperinsulinism forms in 35 infants, supporting its use alongside frozen sections.

34498693.takeaway: In 200 children aged 1 day to 18 years, plasma inorganic pyrophosphate ranged from 2.36 to 4.44 µM by ATP sulfurylase assay, similar to adult values and without sex differences.
