36152639.takeaway: In adults with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk, tirzepatide slowed eGFR decline and reduced albuminuria versus insulin glargine, with a 42% lower kidney composite outcome risk (HR 0.58).

36156811.takeaway: In 152 children followed at least two years after stem cell transplant, 65% developed an endocrine complication, most often gonadal dysfunction, and total body irradiation raised the risk of several disorders.

36157438.takeaway: Reviews how gut microbiota and metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids and bile acids relate to childhood overweight and obesity, suggesting microbiota-targeted interventions as a possible strategy.

36157444.takeaway: In 578 Korean children with idiopathic short stature, GH started before age 6 gave higher height SDS, and automatic pen devices were linked to a higher chance of reaching target height SDS than needle-syringes.

36157451.takeaway: Among 18 term infants with perinatal stroke, placental inflammation was frequent, supporting placental examination as part of the diagnostic workup.

36157465.takeaway: Reviews ovarian tissue cryopreservation as a fertility-preservation option for children and adolescents with cancer, and as a physiologic hormone replacement option for premature ovarian failure.

36157474.takeaway: Across 40 RCTs (6,403 children), eHealth-delivered lifestyle programs modestly reduced BMI, waist, weight and body fat, with larger BMI effects when parents or schools were involved.

36161685.takeaway: ISPAD 2022 consensus guidance on youth-onset type 2 diabetes covers risk factors, diagnosis, treatment and comorbidities, incorporating updated TODAY, SEARCH and RISE data.

36162008.takeaway: A cost-effectiveness model found Australia's subsidised CGM for young people with type 1 diabetes cost AUD 39,518 per QALY gained, under the AUD 50,000 threshold.

36162139.takeaway: In 96 children with obesity, higher exercise doses were linked to greater reductions in body fat and blood pressure, with the highest activity quartile improving more than the lowest.

36166593.takeaway: In 17,280 new-onset type 1 diabetes cases across 92 centers, incidence rose in 2018-2021, and the usual winter peak was delayed to summer and autumn in Europe and North America after lockdown.

36168879.takeaway: In 251 children with DKA, head CT rarely changed cerebral edema management: most suspected cases were treated regardless of imaging, and some CT scans delayed treatment.

36169241.takeaway: In 59 pubertal boys, letrozole slowed bone maturation with variable growth responses, and predicted adult height rose more (3.2 cm) when growth hormone was added.

36170805.takeaway: In very-low-birth-weight infants, the ratio of glucocorticoid receptor alpha to beta rose within the first week of life, suggesting glucocorticoid sensitivity increases after birth.

36171898.takeaway: In 1,097 US youth aged 6-19 (NHANES 2013-2016), serum copper was inversely associated with testosterone and estradiol, while selenium was linked to higher sex steroids and lower SHBG.

36171902.takeaway: In 1,601 children with adrenal malignancies in SEER, 5-year overall survival was 70%, lowest for adrenocortical carcinoma (53%), and localized disease carried far lower mortality than metastatic disease.

36171903.takeaway: In 1,162 Finnish children with islet autoantibodies, HbA1c was lower 4.5-6 years before diagnosis in future progressors than in lower-risk children, with no OGTT differences.

36173235.takeaway: In 275 adults with type 1 diabetes, the bionic pancreas with fast-acting aspart lowered HbA1c by 0.5% versus standard care without more CGM-measured hypoglycemia, but was no better than aspart or lispro.

36173236.takeaway: In 161 adults with type 1 diabetes, the insulin-only bionic pancreas with aspart or lispro lowered HbA1c by about 0.5% versus standard care without increasing CGM-measured hypoglycemia.

36173237.takeaway: In 165 youth aged 6-17 with type 1 diabetes, the insulin-only bionic pancreas lowered HbA1c by 0.5% versus standard care without more CGM-measured hypoglycemia, with the largest gains in those with high baseline HbA1c.

36173238.takeaway: In 90 adults and children switched from standard care to the insulin-only bionic pancreas, HbA1c fell by about 0.55% over 13 weeks, similar in size to the randomized trial.

36175392.takeaway: After adjustment, relatives of people with type 1 diabetes who were autoantibody-screened and monitored had over 80% lower DKA risk at diagnosis than the general population (5% vs 31% raw).

36176470.takeaway: Atherogenic lipid indices such as non-HDL cholesterol were associated with higher odds of metabolic syndrome in adults and children, with pooled odds ratios of about 2.3 to 3.8.

36177768.takeaway: Two children with heterozygous CDC73 variants presented with symptomatic hypercalcaemia from parathyroid adenomas, illustrating that paediatric hyperparathyroidism is often symptomatic.

36178534.takeaway: In 12 men with type 2 diabetes, a single 2-hour hyperbaric oxygen session cut fasting glucose by 19% and improved insulin sensitivity and mitochondrial capacity compared with a control session.

36181235.takeaway: In 52 young men with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, pulsatile GnRH raised testosterone and improved insulin sensitivity, and higher insulin sensitivity predicted a stronger pituitary response.

36181314.takeaway: An 8.5-year-old boy with Peutz-Jeghers syndrome had prepubertal gynecomastia from a Sertoli cell tumour; anastrozole reversed it, though gynecomastia recurred after discontinuation.

36181459.takeaway: In 42 adult survivors of pediatric stem cell transplant, incretin levels matched controls overall, but GIP rose after total body irradiation and fasting glucagon was higher with hypertriglyceridaemia.

36181470.takeaway: In 76 children with CAH, telomeres were shorter in classic than nonclassic disease and in overtreated children or those on prednisolone, suggesting telomere length may track glucocorticoid exposure.

36181471.takeaway: In children and adolescents with Prader-Willi syndrome and obesity, liraglutide did not significantly change BMI SDS versus placebo at 16 or 52 weeks, though adolescents had lower hyperphagia scores.

36181486.takeaway: Among 14,708 pregnant women, 3.8% had NAFLD on ultrasound, and NAFLD raised odds of gestational diabetes, preeclampsia and preterm birth even in women with normal prepregnancy weight.

36183170.takeaway: Narrative review using a Janus-face framework to explain why adolescents sometimes accept diabetes technology poorly, proposing that the technology and human context be studied together.

36183171.takeaway: In 62 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes and DKA, severe DKA was linked to higher insulin requirements and different insulin sensitivity than mild DKA.

36184734.takeaway: Clinical approach to pediatric Graves' disease: methimazole is the usual first drug, most children do not remit, and radioiodine or surgery is often needed, with radioiodine avoided under age 5.

36187100.takeaway: In 57,516 women in Shanghai, higher early-pregnancy total cholesterol, triglycerides and LDL were associated with higher birth weight and greater risk of large-for-gestational-age infants and macrosomia.

36187103.takeaway: In 8,905 children aged 6-18, high muscle mass with high fat mass had the most dysglycemia and dyslipidemia, and higher muscle mass lowered hyperglycemia risk only in those with normal fat mass.

36187104.takeaway: Reviews functional studies of MKRN3, the most common known genetic cause of central precocious puberty, and its roles in puberty onset.

36187120.takeaway: A 29-year-old with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia had a successful pregnancy after diazoxide was stopped and short-acting octreotide added, delivering a well-developed infant.

36187131.takeaway: In 125 healthy people aged 6-50, raised PTH with normal calcium in spring mostly reflected vitamin D deficiency, while in autumn it was more likely true normocalcemic hyperparathyroidism.

36189645.takeaway: A 1.3-year-old with a 46,XX karyotype and male phenotype had a small Xq27.1 duplication containing SOX3, a rare cause of sex reversal.

36190305.takeaway: A 5-week-old infant with hepatic hemangioendothelioma and severe consumptive hypothyroidism improved with propranolol, low-dose sirolimus and combined levothyroxine and liothyronine.

36190481.takeaway: In 82 children with epilepsy and vitamin D deficiency, 60,000 IU every 10 days normalized 25-OHD in 81% versus 37% with 20,000 IU, with no adverse events.

36190810.takeaway: In 457 youth with type 2 diabetes followed 10 years, higher baseline HbA1c, lower beta-cell function and fasting glucose variability predicted loss of glycemic control and later comorbidities.

36190924.takeaway: In 146 transgender boys, puberty suppression and testosterone did not reduce adult height; adult height was similar to baseline SDS and above predicted height, especially in those who started at a younger bone age.

36192506.takeaway: Reviews hormonal control of mammary gland development, lactation and involution, including PTHrP-driven calcium mobilization, human milk hormones, and endocrine disorders that impair lactation.

36193568.takeaway: Reviews survivorship care for childhood thyroid cancer, recommending survivorship and transition care plans, quality-of-life assessment and lifelong thyroid hormone replacement for most survivors.

36193720.takeaway: Mini-review finds that long-term, consistent stimulant use for ADHD may reduce final adult height, so significant long-term stimulant doses should be used with caution.

36193775.takeaway: In 733 children with adrenocortical tumors, a modified pediatric S-GRAS score stratified overall survival, with median survival falling from 133 months in the lowest-risk group to 16 months in the highest.

36193929.takeaway: In 3,822 children and youth with type 1 diabetes in Tanzania, survival rose from 59% before 2005 to 69% in 2011-2019, after support programmes were introduced.

36194251.takeaway: In 45 children with new type 1 diabetes, a gluten-free diet changed gut bacteria, but those changes did not explain its moderate protective effect on beta-cell function.

36195673.takeaway: Among 1,403 autoantibody-positive children from four prospective cohorts, quantitative autoantibody levels improved type 1 diabetes prediction over positivity alone (C-index 0.76 vs 0.72).

36196598.takeaway: In 84 children with type 1 diabetes, serum cathelicidin was higher with microvascular complications and correlated with diabetes duration and carotid thickness, so it may serve as an early vascular marker.

36197956.takeaway: In 49 Turkish children suspected of MODY, an HbA1c cut-off of 6.95% at diagnosis identified GCK variants with 90% sensitivity and 86% specificity.

36198004.takeaway: In an adolescent PCOS program, 7.6% of youth with PCOS were gender diverse versus 1.8% of non-PCOS patients, and gender-diverse PCOS youth had more hirsutism and depression or anxiety.

36198016.takeaway: In 40 children with DKA, plasma free carnitine and acyl-carnitine levels at admission did not correlate with how long DKA treatment lasted.

36198069.takeaway: In 1,903 mother-child pairs in Shanghai, maternal overt hypothyroidism and other early-pregnancy thyroid abnormalities were linked to lower infant neurodevelopment scores at 6 and 24 months, sometimes sex-specifically.

36200311.takeaway: In 201 children with type 1 diabetes, most did not meet criteria for sustained hypertension, but 74% were nondippers, and higher diastolic pressure and variability tracked with albuminuria.

36201475.takeaway: Among 69 people with pituitary stalk interruption syndrome, those who were obese or overweight more often had neonatal hypoglycemia and extrapituitary malformations, suggesting hypothalamic involvement.

36201517.takeaway: In a Manitoba registry cohort aged 40 and older, comorbidity measures raised fracture hazard independently of FRAX and bone density, suggesting FRAX estimates could be adjusted for comorbidity.

36202118.takeaway: Across 13 national registries (104,290 children), DKA at type 1 diabetes diagnosis rose above predicted levels in 2020-2021, with the excess linked to stricter COVID containment measures.

36203204.takeaway: In 108 neonates with organic acidemias over 30 years, survival improved, but metabolic acidosis and hyperammonemia predicted poor outcome and mortality, and chronic complications persisted.

36203266.takeaway: Review of COVID-19 effects on pediatric diabetes: glycemic control in known diabetes held steady, new-onset DKA rose, and SARS-CoV-2 may contribute to beta-cell destruction.

36203267.takeaway: Reviews polygenic, syndromic and monogenic childhood obesity, advising genetic evaluation for early-onset severe obesity with hyperphagia, since melanocortin-4 receptor agonists are now available.

36203268.takeaway: Reviews treatment options for male congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, including inducing puberty and inducing fertility with gonadotropins or pulsatile GnRH.

36203269.takeaway: Obesity prevalence among Korean adolescents rose from 11.0% in 2019 to 12.1% in 2020 after lockdowns, mainly in boys aged 12-15, with less physical activity and more sedentary time.

36203313.takeaway: In 240 Saudi children on GH, SGA children gained 14 cm versus 21 cm for GHD, at lower cost per cm, but dysglycemia developed in 70 children, so shared decision-making is advised.

36204102.takeaway: In Chinese adults aged about 50-52, fetal-period famine exposure was linked to lower odds of overweight or obesity but higher odds of metabolically unhealthy status.

36204108.takeaway: Adrenal insufficiency admissions among Australians aged 10-24 rose from 2000 to 2020, with adrenal crisis rising most among women aged 20-24.

36204111.takeaway: Among 3,231 qualified sperm donors in China, thalassemia and G6PD screening flagged many carriers, and targeted gene testing found recessive carrier variants in 2.5% of 278 donors tested.

36205036.takeaway: In 93 healthy children aged 7-11, interrupting daily sitting with brief walking over six days lowered insulin response to an oral glucose test by 21% versus uninterrupted sitting.

36205650.takeaway: Among 722 adults clinically diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, 25% were autoantibody-negative, and 23% of those stopped insulin over two years with similar HbA1c.

36213263.takeaway: In 4,226 singleton IVF births, day-3 embryo fragmentation was linked to higher birth weight after blastocyst transfer, though it also raised the odds of large-for-gestational-age infants.

36213269.takeaway: In a pilot of 52 children, PDIA3 was higher in those with obesity, and both ER-stress markers tracked with insulin resistance, dyslipidaemia and metabolic syndrome criteria.

36213284.takeaway: In 31 patients with inactivating PTH/PTHrP signalling disorder, 75% of those with PHP2 had thyroid dysfunction, mostly subclinical hypothyroidism, and thyroid ultrasound was abnormal in all affected patients.

36213286.takeaway: In 11,909 US adults, osteopenia was associated with higher all-cause mortality (HR 1.37), and the association differed by age and BMI.

36213296.takeaway: In 450 children aged 6-8, higher cardiorespiratory fitness was linked to a more cardioprotective metabolite profile, mainly higher HDL and ApoA1, largely independent of body fat.

36220006.takeaway: In 260 children tested for short stature, those with ADHD were more likely to fail growth hormone stimulation testing than those without ADHD across peak GH cut-offs.

36220788.takeaway: In young adults with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, about 70% were low-adherent to oral medicines and 37% to insulin; interfering beliefs, distress and food or healthcare insecurity were linked to poor adherence.

36222545.takeaway: In a South Asian family with four generations of diabetes, a novel NEUROD1 nonsense variant co-segregated with diabetes, although family members had different phenotypes.

36223197.takeaway: In 26 underserved youth with type 1 diabetes, a point-of-care sample CGM led to 76% obtaining a personal CGM by 3-6 months, though HbA1c did not improve.

36225201.takeaway: In 149 people with osteogenesis imperfecta on bisphosphonate drug holidays, bone density stayed stable over three years and fractures did not rise, but 11% needed retreatment, mostly those with more severe types.

36225207.takeaway: Among 306 children with MIS-C in Poland, obese children were less likely to recover fully at discharge (76% vs 93% of normal-weight children), with an odds ratio of 4.2 for incomplete recovery.

36226635.takeaway: In 65 children and young adults with lung-metastatic papillary thyroid cancer, about 31% were radioiodine-refractory, a status that predicted progression, especially in patients under 15.

36227635.takeaway: Modelling TrialNet data on 6,193 autoantibody-positive people suggested that halving monitoring visits would still substantially reduce DKA at type 1 diabetes diagnosis.

36227734.takeaway: In 4,128 men of the Northern Finland 1966 birth cohort, underweight in early childhood was linked to more infertility work-ups and childlessness, while overweight in early childhood was linked to less infertility treatment.

36228141.takeaway: In 1,843 Belgian women, low gestational weight gain in gestational diabetes did not raise adverse outcomes and improved postpartum metabolic profile, while excessive gain raised neonatal hypoglycemia.

36228315.takeaway: The 2022 European Thyroid Association guideline for pediatric thyroid nodules and differentiated thyroid carcinoma advises care in experienced centers and shared decisions on diagnosis, treatment and follow-up.

36237121.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests that lower birth weight and higher childhood BMI each causally shift menarche earlier, supporting weight control in early childhood.

36237190.takeaway: Reference percentiles for liver stiffness and fat by transient elastography in 482 healthy children aged 10-18 show that age, sex, puberty and weight status should be considered when interpreting results.

36237195.takeaway: Reviews somatostatin biology and somatostatin receptor ligands in congenital hyperinsulinism, noting variable efficacy, loss of response and adverse effects such as bowel ischaemia.

36239000.takeaway: A monogenic cause was found in 24% of children diagnosed with hyperinsulinism after infancy versus about 75% of those diagnosed in infancy, so genetic testing should be considered at any age.

36239119.takeaway: A working group proposes renaming diabetes insipidus as arginine vasopressin deficiency for central causes and arginine vasopressin resistance for nephrogenic causes.

36240057.takeaway: A 9-year-old boy with central diabetes insipidus had desmopressin effect prolonged by about 50% during mild SARS-CoV-2 infection, suggesting closer monitoring for hyponatremia.

36246871.takeaway: In 27 children and adults with thyroid Langerhans cell histiocytosis, 81% first presented with diabetes insipidus, so thyroid involvement should be considered in DI, hypothyroidism or abnormal thyroid ultrasound.

36246889.takeaway: Within the same mothers across two pregnancies, changes in total cholesterol were linked to birthweight differences, with third-trimester cholesterol associated with higher birthweight, independent of shared genes.

36246890.takeaway: Reviews metabolomics for earlier diagnosis and prognosis of gestational diabetes, including detection weeks before standard testing and subtype-based prognosis.

36246895.takeaway: In 2,991 newborns, higher maternal thyroid resistance indices in early pregnancy were associated with higher neonatal TSH, suggesting they could refine congenital hypothyroidism screening.

36246897.takeaway: Among mother-child pairs in nuMoM2b, maternal hypertensive disorders or PCOS in pregnancy were linked to higher social communication scores in daughters, partly mediated by maternal testosterone.

36246904.takeaway: In 85 girls and young women, 37 with PCOS, vitamin D was not significantly lower than in controls and did not correlate with leptin, FGF23 or insulin resistance.

36246909.takeaway: Testicular cells from three boys with Klinefelter syndrome were propagated in culture for 110 days, maintaining spermatogonial stem cell populations as a step toward future fertility options.

36246913.takeaway: In 459 obese children, metabolically unhealthy obesity was a weak predictor of left ventricular hypertrophy, while BMI z-score and waist-to-height ratio were the main determinants.

36246931.takeaway: In 77 pregnant women, MRI findings of membrane prolapse over 5 mm and signal abnormalities were associated with prelabor rupture of membranes, with high specificity.

36249413.takeaway: In 62 children aged 7-11, longer objectively measured sleep was associated with lower adiposity and better insulin sensitivity, with body fat explaining much of the sleep-insulin link.

36250350.takeaway: In 6,459 healthy people aged 0-76, IGF-I levels tracked over life, and GH therapy in SGA children raised lifetime IGF-I exposure only modestly, staying below the population average.

36250647.takeaway: In 390 youth with type 1 diabetes, three parenting profiles emerged; the harmonious profile had the best adherence, glycemic control and well-being, and all profiles benefited similarly from a 2-year intervention.

36251796.takeaway: In 235 children with short stature, a low serum IGF-1/IGFBP-3 ratio was the most sensitive marker for growth hormone deficiency (88%), with 83% specificity.

36251886.takeaway: Reviews human postmortem and MRI evidence that hypothalamic inflammation and gliosis occur in obesity and relate to glucose intolerance, insulin resistance and low testosterone, independent of adiposity.

36254382.takeaway: In 20 adolescents with Graves' disease who had total thyroidectomy, disease-specific quality of life improved, goiter and hyperthyroid symptoms resolved, and no permanent surgical complications occurred.

36259452.takeaway: Four patients carrying the CAH-X CH-1 CYP21A2/TNXB chimeric allele had no clinical Ehlers-Danlos features, though the authors advise checking connective-tissue signs in all such carriers.

36263317.takeaway: In 16 mothers with GDM, breastfeeding decisions reflected limited information and underestimated long-term diabetes risk, so interventions should target providers, mothers and their networks.

36263326.takeaway: Reviews how oxidized fatty acids derived from linoleic and arachidonic acid affect the development and progression of NAFLD in youth.

36263328.takeaway: In 57 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, GnRH analogues gave near-target final height regardless of baseline BMI, while glucose metabolism worsened during treatment and recovered afterward.

36263447.takeaway: Pooled trials show that adding insulin for high-fat, high-protein meals lowers 240-minute postprandial glucose versus carbohydrate counting alone, with the strongest effect from split combined boluses on pumps.

36264033.takeaway: In 40 girls with premature adrenarche, collagen-induced platelet aggregation was higher than in 30 healthy girls, while ADP-induced aggregation did not differ.

36264034.takeaway: Among 86 newly diagnosed children with celiac disease, 27% had low lumbar BMD for chronological age, but none of the clinical, laboratory or histologic factors predicted it.

36264035.takeaway: In 341 children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in Jordan, 32% presented in DKA; a family history of T1D was protective, while celiac disease and higher HbA1c were linked to recurrent DKA.

36264042.takeaway: Two children with severe hypercalcaemia, from vitamin D intoxication and malignancy, responded to a single dose of zoledronic acid, though one developed hypocalcaemia needing calcium.

36264296.takeaway: Childhood-onset type 1 diabetes incidence in Sweden, after doubling in the 1980s and 1990s, has levelled off at a high level since 2005, and migration does not fully explain the plateau.

36268546.takeaway: In 403 children with DKA, plasma beta-hydroxybutyrate below 1.5 mmol/L defined DKA resolution with 83% sensitivity and 87% specificity.

36268624.takeaway: In 242 men with isolated hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, ANOS1 truncating variants were linked to absent puberty, and partial puberty or LH of at least 2.10 IU/L suggested pulsatile LH secretion.

36277702.takeaway: In 1,228 US adolescents, higher serum PFOA, PFOS and PFNA were linked to lower bone mineral density, with most associations seen in girls.

36277703.takeaway: TyG-derived indices and the lipid accumulation product were associated with hyperuricemia in 23,411 college students aged 17-20, with the best discrimination from TyG-waist circumference in men and TyG-BMI in women.

36277704.takeaway: In 3,173 hypertensive adults with suspected sleep apnea, higher plasma aldosterone was associated with about 1.8-fold higher risk of cardiovascular disease or death, even without primary aldosteronism.

36277722.takeaway: Curve matching predicted one-year height in children on growth hormone for GHD or SGA with an error of about 1.1-1.5 cm at ages 7-15, a simple and valid method.

36278759.takeaway: In 63 Malaysian children with type 1 diabetes, 35% had excessive body fat, and each 10 cm rise in waist circumference was predicted to raise HbA1c by 0.8%.

36279850.takeaway: Scoping review: SGLT2 inhibitors added to insulin improved glycaemic outcomes in adults with type 1 diabetes but raised DKA risk, and pilot youth studies were promising, especially with closed-loop insulin.

36279852.takeaway: A boy with McCune-Albright syndrome and FGF23-mediated phosphate wasting normalized his bone biochemistry after burosumab was added to phosphate and alfacalcidol, without adverse effects.

36282337.takeaway: In 110 pancreas donors with type 1 diabetes, those with TCF7L2 type 2 diabetes-risk variants were about three times more likely to retain insulin-containing islets, suggesting a milder beta-cell loss endotype.

36282972.takeaway: In 60 adolescent boys with obesity versus 30 lean controls, obesity was linked to lower testosterone and inhibin B and higher estradiol, suggesting raised estradiol may contribute to hypogonadism.

36284505.takeaway: In 133 children with obesity, a higher pan-immune-inflammation value was associated with the presence and severity of hepatic steatosis, though the systemic immune-inflammation index was not.

36284507.takeaway: In 394 Indian children and youth with type 1 diabetes, anaemia (16%) predicted macrovascular complications and poorer bone health, alongside 16% overweight or obese and 6% underweight.

36285573.takeaway: In 25 youth on insulin pumps, a 70/30 split bolus with a 20% increase, given over four hours, best controlled glucose after a traditional Egyptian Iftar meal without late hypoglycemia.

36287249.takeaway: Review argues that rising birthweight in offspring of women with type 1 diabetes reflects better periconceptional glycaemic control and improved placentation, with later fetal adiposity risk.

36288430.takeaway: Among 108 children with central precocious puberty, 37% had used complementary or alternative medicine, mostly herbal products, and many parents of users planned to use it again.

36300712.takeaway: In 142 youth with type 2 diabetes at a safety-net clinic, those with HbA1c below 7% at diagnosis were less likely to have poor control later, and glucometer prescription was linked to better outcomes.

36303872.takeaway: In First Nations adolescents, 36 differentially methylated regions were associated with type 2 diabetes, several near genes linked to altered serum metabolites such as glucose and leucine.

36303874.takeaway: In a pilot of 19 adolescents with obesity and their parents, parental anxiety was higher when the teen had gained weight the year before or had MAFLD, and adolescents said obesity limited leisure activities.

36303875.takeaway: In 50 children with type 1 diabetes on an advanced hybrid closed-loop system, BMI z-score and glycemic control stayed stable over one year, though total daily insulin per kg rose slightly.

36305565.takeaway: In 70 people with Turner syndrome and a 45,X/46,XY karyotype, gonadoblastoma was present in 12.8%; entire Y chromosome material was the main risk factor, favouring early gonadectomy.

36313739.takeaway: In 1,026 girls and women who had ovarian tissue cryopreservation over 20 years in Bologna, no surgical complications occurred, and transplantation led to six pregnancies.

36313741.takeaway: Review proposes an integrated, network-based approach across placenta, membranes, decidua, myometrium and cervix to understand spontaneous preterm birth, which remains highly prevalent.

36313745.takeaway: In 4,056 US adolescents, BMI and waist circumference were positively linked to bone mineral density, with a saturation point around BMI 22 beyond which extra adiposity gave no further gain.

36313768.takeaway: Review of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation, mostly studied in adults, and its potential as a treatment for pediatric neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders such as ADHD and autism.

36313771.takeaway: In mice, placental loss of allopregnanolone disrupted cortical development and caused adolescent female-predominant somatosensory deficits, linking placental endocrine function to sex-specific neurological outcome.

36313773.takeaway: In 2,648 neonates from frozen-thawed single blastocyst transfers, good-quality blastocysts were linked to less preterm delivery and higher trophectoderm quality to more male births, with birthweight unaffected.

36313778.takeaway: In 185 children with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c and time in range stayed stable through the pandemic, but BMI percentile and total daily insulin rose during lockdown, mostly reversing later.

36313780.takeaway: In 5,009 euthyroid adults with obesity, TSH rose with BMI in women while free T4 fell with BMI in men, and smoking was the strongest predictor of lower TSH and free T4.

36313785.takeaway: Among 15,114 Chinese children aged 7-18, metabolically healthy obesity affected 3.5% and unhealthy obesity 5.6%, with boys more affected and sex-specific risk factors such as premature birth and screen time.

36314086.takeaway: A data-mining framework found four atypical-diabetes clusters in adults and two in 758 children, one autoantibody-negative with poor beta-cell function and one with more DKA.

36314507.takeaway: In 66 adolescents and young adults with severe obesity, sleeve gastrectomy reduced total hip bone density by 8.5% over two years, versus no change in controls, suggesting increased skeletal fragility.

36315979.takeaway: Across five trials of 237 children with type 2 diabetes, GLP-1 agonists improved glycemia better than placebo, while the benefit of DPP-4 inhibitors remained unclear.

36317539.takeaway: In 44 children and teens switched to the MiniMed 780G system, time in range rose from 69% to 76% within two weeks and HbA1c fell from 7.2% to 6.6% over six months.

36318760.takeaway: Systematic review of 45 children with thyroid storm, most often from Graves' disease with infection as trigger, showing fever, tachycardia and altered mental status.

36322711.takeaway: In mice, lipopolysaccharide-induced non-thyroidal illness raised hypothalamic thyroid hormone action while fasting did not, so the two forms of low thyroid hormone arise from different hypothalamic mechanisms.

36323590.takeaway: Among parents of 1,371 infants at genetic risk for type 1 diabetes, panic symptoms were rare (4.9%), while 47% reported disease-specific worry, highest in mothers and parents with an affected relative.

36325445.takeaway: Among 244 UK children presenting with abnormal thyroid tests, overall presentation rates did not change during COVID-19, but transient thyroid dysfunction needing no treatment became more common afterwards.

36325455.takeaway: Review of fracture risk in Turner syndrome, where fractures are 1.4-2.2 times more common than in healthy people, largely due to estrogen deficiency, and of volumetric bone assessment methods.

36325459.takeaway: In 95 discarded human immature oocytes, 10 Hz microvibration culture raised parthenogenetic blastocyst formation compared with static culture.

36325536.takeaway: Review of the postnatal overlap between brown-to-white fat transition and skeletal muscle maturation in large mammals, suggesting hormone- and sex-influenced interplay relevant to metabolic syndrome.

36326757.takeaway: In autoantibody-positive children with similar high metabolic risk, progressors to type 1 diabetes lost C-peptide responsiveness within six months, while nonprogressors' responses stayed stable.

36327158.takeaway: In 50 euthyroid children with Hashimoto thyroiditis, serum cystatin C was higher than in 50 matched healthy children and correlated with thyroid antibody levels.

36329894.takeaway: A bibliometric analysis of 707 articles from 2002 to 2021 found gut microbiota and MAFLD publications growing sharply, with probiotics and bile acids as emerging research directions.

36329895.takeaway: Review of how perinatal and early-life metabolic environments and epigenetic changes may program later obesity risk, from conception onward.

36330655.takeaway: Children with thyroid cancer reported better quality of life than other pediatric cancer patients but worse functioning than healthy peers, and distress was linked to lower quality of life.

36330765.takeaway: A 13-month-old boy with peripheral precocious puberty had an adrenocortical tumour secreting beta-hCG, and androgen and beta-hCG levels normalized after surgical resection.

36334008.takeaway: In 25,520 German and Austrian youths, LADY cases resembled either T1D or T2D, and the T2D-like group had more cardiovascular risk, so the LADY label added little.

36334264.takeaway: A 4-year-old boy with hypophosphatemic rickets had compound heterozygous DMP1 mutations, including a large deletion and a novel start-codon variant, the first such report.

36339395.takeaway: Review of deep learning applications for diagnosing precocious puberty and classifying thyroid dysfunction, with their strengths, weaknesses and model-building considerations.

36339399.takeaway: Reviews clinical features, genetics, diagnosis and treatment of Noonan, Turner and Prader-Willi syndromes, emphasizing multidisciplinary care and pediatric-to-adult transition.

36339400.takeaway: In 69 children with osteogenesis imperfecta, echocardiography showed larger pulmonary artery and left heart dimensions and lower ejection fraction than matched controls, most marked in COL1A1 carriers.

36339403.takeaway: In 452 girls aged 6-8 with early breast development, 31% had central precocious puberty; BMI was an independent risk factor, and basal LH of 0.32 IU/L with BMI 16.4 kg/m2 gave a diagnostic cut-off.

36339415.takeaway: In 5,703 embryos from 611 patients, vacuolization on days 3-4 was linked to lower blastocyst and good-blastocyst rates, with no difference in euploidy or live birth.

36339428.takeaway: Narrative review of the sex hormone-gut microbiome axis in precocious puberty, noting altered gut microbiota in girls with central precocious puberty and the possibility of microbiota-targeted therapy.

36339431.takeaway: In late pre-diabetic NOD mice, an insulin peptide vaccine given with alum cut diabetes incidence to 39% versus 70-76% in controls, while the peptide without alum gave no protection.

36339444.takeaway: In 84 children with new type 1 diabetes, free 25OHD was higher than in controls, but children with DKA had lower bioavailable 25OHD, linked to more severe acidosis at diagnosis.

36339450.takeaway: Review compares mouse, human stem cell-derived beta-like cell and organoid models for studying beta-cell development and diabetes, using GATA6 as an example.

36343308.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 30 families with familial type 1 diabetes lacking typical HLA risk found seven uncertain-significance variants in five patients, with POLG a possible novel candidate.

36345221.takeaway: Macro-TSH was found in 0.43% of 939 newborns, and all their mothers had it too, so mothers should be checked when neonatal TSH is high but free T4 is normal.

36349753.takeaway: Describes ten years of the ESPE e-learning website, including its diabetes module and multilingual content for limited-resource settings, and how digital education could expand.

36350787.takeaway: In 74 very young children with type 1 diabetes, the CamAPS FX hybrid closed-loop system lowered caregivers' fear of hypoglycaemia and improved their well-being versus sensor-augmented pump therapy.

36351197.takeaway: A 13-year-old with McCune-Albright syndrome had hyperthyroidism that worsened his fibrous dysplasia pain, which eased after antithyroid drug treatment.

36351286.takeaway: A family with the rare PHEX intronic variant c.1586+6T>C had severe X-linked hypophosphatemia, and burosumab improved both children's biochemistry and adults' quality of life.

36353234.takeaway: In 75 children with non-classic CAH, muscle-to-fat ratio was lower than in 134 healthy controls, and lower ratios were linked to higher blood pressure and a worse triglyceride/HDL ratio.

36353241.takeaway: Pooled observational studies show obesity is associated with higher odds of periodontitis (OR 1.35), with the strongest association in adults aged 18-34 and in European studies.

36353243.takeaway: Review of fertility preservation for children with sickle cell disease and thalassaemia, including sperm banking, tissue cryopreservation and the need for multidisciplinary counselling.

36353245.takeaway: Across 44 studies (123,800 people), the TM6SF2 rs58542926 T allele was linked to NAFLD in adults (OR 1.62) and children (OR 2.87), with lower total cholesterol, LDL and triglycerides.

36355183.takeaway: Among 1,814 people with clinically diagnosed type 1 diabetes, autoantibody-negative adults had intermediate genetic risk largely from misclassified non-autoimmune diabetes; adjusted, autoantibody positivity matched children (93% vs 91%).

36355576.takeaway: Review of when and how to use genetic testing in the evaluation of short children, mainly targeted exome sequencing, and a call for an international repository of short-stature conditions.

36355601.takeaway: In 4,860 pediatric papillary thyroid cancers in the National Cancer Database, children under 11 presented with more advanced disease than adolescents, though survival was similar.

36357326.takeaway: In a systematic review of 52 probands with side-chain cleavage enzyme deficiency, 46,XY patients with typical male genitalia had spontaneous puberty and testicular adrenal rest tumours and four specific genotypes.

36372070.takeaway: A global microsimulation estimated 355,900 new type 1 diabetes cases in children and adolescents in 2021, with nearly half undiagnosed, and underdiagnosis highest in low-resource regions.

36372821.takeaway: In 98,658 Chinese adults, higher outdoor light-at-night exposure was linked to worse glucose measures and higher diabetes prevalence, with a prevalence ratio of 1.28 in the highest quintile.

36378855.takeaway: Among 1,258 adults with type 1 diabetes at a US academic center, Black patients were less likely to use CGM or pumps and were less often prescribed them, even after adjustment.

36380614.takeaway: In 176 youth with overweight or obesity, baseline HbA1c strongly predicted later HbA1c elevation (AUC 0.93), while random glucose, glucose challenge and HbA1c had moderate ability to predict later dysglycemia.

36381011.takeaway: In 11 children with X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets, intermuscular fat was over twice as high as in 22 typically developing children (8.7% vs 3.6%), independent of obesity.

36387846.takeaway: Review of anti-obesity medications for adolescents with type 2 diabetes, drawing lessons from adult trials, with three FDA-approved options for adolescents with obesity.

36387850.takeaway: In 48 men with obesity, with or without type 2 diabetes, or lean, eight weeks of rowing-and-cycling interval training raised insulin sensitivity 30-40% and VO2max 8-15%, with over 95% adherence.

36387865.takeaway: Review of pediatric adrenocortical carcinoma, linked to Li-Fraumeni and Beckwith-Wiedemann syndromes, with treatment borrowed from adult protocols and limited data on newer therapies.

36387871.takeaway: In eight randomized trials of overweight Chinese children, lifestyle interventions reduced BMI by about 1.5 kg/m2, with larger effects from multi-component programmes lasting over a year or in teenagers.

36387878.takeaway: In a Hungarian survey of 1,563 women, COVID-19 vaccination and infection were not linked to menstrual cycle changes, but menses lengthened and became less regular at the pandemic peak, tracking with depression.

36387887.takeaway: In 7,590 Beijing children aged 6-11, precocious puberty affected 5.9% of girls versus 0.9% of boys, with higher BMI linked to earlier puberty and boys needing a higher BMI threshold.

36387899.takeaway: Eight Chinese children with short stature and heterozygous ACAN variants, seven of them novel, had mild dysmorphism and normal bone age, and growth hormone raised growth velocity from 4.5 to 8.0 cm/year.

36387902.takeaway: A new estimation method for impulsive hormone secretion models, applied to luteinizing hormone data from healthy men, improved on earlier least-squares fits and removed the need for manual tuning.

36387905.takeaway: In 171 adults with papillary thyroid cancer invading the recurrent laryngeal nerve, age 55 or older independently predicted recurrence (OR 4.52), while preoperative voice analysis reflected nerve function.

36387906.takeaway: In 228 children with overweight or obesity, ultrasound showed fatty liver in 24%, a rate that rose with glucose intolerance, and most children with fatty liver had normal ALT.

36387921.takeaway: An umbrella review of 28 meta-analyses found bariatric surgery improves most outcomes, including gestational diabetes and PCOS, but may raise risks of fracture, suicide and some perinatal problems.

36394493.takeaway: In 49 GH-treated children with pituitary cysts, cyst size changed substantially over time, with 5 of 35 small cysts growing large and 6 of 14 large cysts shrinking, so large cysts need close monitoring.

36398930.takeaway: In 6,561 southern Chinese children, high birth weight was linked to about twice the odds of childhood obesity, while low birth weight reduced overweight risk; low birth weight became less common by 2008.

36398994.takeaway: In 166 term newborns receiving phototherapy, ionized and total calcium, magnesium, vitamin D and PTH all fell, most after 48 hours or more, suggesting PTH suppression contributes to hypocalcaemia.

36399011.takeaway: In 42 children with classic galactosemia, most were diagnosed before 4 months, typically with jaundice or liver dysfunction, supporting neonatal screening for earlier treatment.

36401627.takeaway: Serum from 82 people after 8-12 weeks of exercise training protected insulin-producing cells from stress-induced death by 28-35%, with protection unaffected by age, sex or diabetes status.

36407306.takeaway: In 366,212 births in Hebei province, China, gestational diabetes rose from 2014 to 2021 and was linked to higher risks of preterm delivery, caesarean section and macrosomia.

36407308.takeaway: In 240 men with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, the fertile eunuch variant had the mildest neuroendocrine defects, with pulsatile LH in 79% and spontaneous reversal in 44% of those followed.

36407313.takeaway: In 10 children with congenital hyperinsulinism, CGM showed a 19.3% mean error and only 45% sensitivity for hypoglycaemia, so it is not reliable alone for routine clinical use.

36407317.takeaway: In a UK database of 117 children on daily growth hormone, about 98% started persistently, but persistence fell to 72% at 12 months and 43% at 48 months.

36407325.takeaway: In 4,195 US adults, the lipid accumulation product best identified MAFLD on elastography among the anthropometric indices tested (AUC 0.81).

36408818.takeaway: In 1,053 European adolescents, a simple HELENA-IR score built from BMI, fat mass, fitness and screen time identified high insulin resistance with modest accuracy (AUC 0.63-0.71).

36409503.takeaway: In 813 children with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c was 1.17% higher in the most deprived quintile, and real-time CGM and pump use explained about 12% and 23% of that gap.

36409572.takeaway: In nine children with congenital hyperinsulinism in Istanbul, 66% had spontaneous remission, including some diazoxide-unresponsive children with focal lesions on PET.

36412007.takeaway: In 51 children with type 1 diabetes, uroflowmetry showed voiding dysfunction in 29%, unrelated to diabetes duration or metabolic control.

36412629.takeaway: In 330 youths with type 1 diabetes, a genetic score for insulin resistance was linked to lower insulin sensitivity and to higher blood pressure, triglycerides and waist-to-height ratio.

36412631.takeaway: In a TODAY2 retention survey of young adults with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, over 93% endorsed the study's benefits, with staff relationships the main reason to stay and other medical problems the main barrier.

36413496.takeaway: Among 1,889 children followed to age 17.5, extreme height-weight body types followed distinct growth paths with changes in infancy and puberty, and GWAS linked the trade-off score to loci including FTO.

36414887.takeaway: In 14,744 Danish pregnancies, a maternal TSH above 10 mIU/L was linked to a high frequency of miscarriage (12.5%) and preterm birth (11.4%), while thyroid autoantibodies were not.

36416098.takeaway: In nine adolescents and young adults with type 2 diabetes, 12 weeks of real-time CGM was feasible and acceptable and improved diabetes quality of life (PedsQL 70 to 75).

36416103.takeaway: In 35 children hospitalized with DKA, real-time CGM agreed with reference glucose in 95% of paired values within clinically acceptable zones, and was feasible during treatment.

36416456.takeaway: In 71 children with idiopathic GH deficiency on rhGH, carotid intima-media thickness was higher than in 44 controls, and it correlated with higher ghrelin and lower HDL.

36416457.takeaway: In 21 children with type 1 diabetes versus 21 controls, extended high-frequency hearing thresholds were raised despite normal standard audiometry, suggesting extended-frequency testing can detect early hearing loss.

36416458.takeaway: Evidence-based answers to common nutrition questions in children with type 1 diabetes, covering carbohydrate intake, Ramadan fasting, preschool feeding and gluten-free diets.

36416459.takeaway: A Turkish patient with microcephaly, epilepsy and diabetes syndrome 1 carried a new homozygous IER3IP1 variant, with late-onset diabetes and no typical simplified gyral pattern.

36418577.takeaway: In Finnish children registered with type 1 diabetes but lacking autoantibodies, 12.5% of those tested had monogenic diabetes, leading the authors to recommend genetic testing for all such children.

36419769.takeaway: In 800 children aged 7 and 12, white blood cell and neutrophil counts correlated more strongly with insulin resistance in girls with overweight or obesity than in boys, suggesting they could mark insulin resistance.

36419940.takeaway: Among 607 children and young people referred for DSD over 25 years, 61% had 46,XY DSD and 28% 46,XX DSD, often 21-hydroxylase deficiency, and 80% presented as neonates.

36420541.takeaway: In an infant with SIADH, neurofibromatosis-1 and poor growth, oral urea corrected hyponatremia when fluid restriction failed, allowing larger formula volumes and better weight gain.

36424806.takeaway: Consensus statement recommends a multidisciplinary, stepwise diagnostic approach to 46,XY DSD, including formal karyotyping, age-appropriate hormone testing, abdominopelvic ultrasound and staged genetic studies.

36425471.takeaway: Reticulocyte haemoglobin content was lower in 126 infants of mothers with diabetes than in 74 infants of uncomplicated pregnancies, and it may serve as an early screening marker for neonatal iron deficiency.

36427197.takeaway: In 61 boys followed longitudinally, penile diameter rose with pubic hair stage and testicular volume, and pubic hair stage predicted penile diameter better than genital stage.

36427218.takeaway: An 11-year-old with Duchenne muscular dystrophy developed a left ventricular thrombus 48 hours after his first zoledronate infusion, possibly from acute phase reaction and adrenal crisis, a previously unreported complication.

36433712.takeaway: Three Chinese children with BSCL2-related congenital generalized lipodystrophy had early hypertriglyceridaemia, hepatomegaly and diabetes, with diet lowering triglycerides, and one developed cardiomyopathy.

36438545.takeaway: Epidemiologic review links maternal overweight or obesity to hypospadias, cryptorchidism, earlier menarche, precocious puberty and PCOS in offspring, though offspring fertility has been little studied.

36438546.takeaway: Screening 28 unrelated children with idiopathic central precocious puberty found six novel MKRN3 variants, mostly with paternal inheritance, and a variant in two prepubertal brothers.

36440187.takeaway: A 12-year-old with SDHB-related metastatic paraganglioma progressed 13 months after surgery, then had a partial radiological and biochemical response to ten cycles of temozolomide.

36440191.takeaway: Perspective on counselling children before gonadotoxic treatment about fertility preservation, including referral logistics and experimental options for prepubertal children, drawing on a German ovarian tissue cryobank.

36440200.takeaway: In 159 pregnant women, those with GDM and normal weight had higher DHEA, testosterone and estrogens than normoglycaemic women, while overweight GDM women had reduced aromatase activity and estrogen production.

36440201.takeaway: A financial model based on 302 children in a weekly remote-monitoring programme found that about $10 per telehealth contact would keep algorithm-enabled monitoring revenue-neutral for a paediatric diabetes clinic.

36440204.takeaway: In 255 adults in southern Italy, better general executive function predicted lower BMI, partly through reduced avoidance behaviours.

36440223.takeaway: In 16 newborns with hypocalcaemic seizures, syndromic causes such as DiGeorge syndrome led to worse neurodevelopment and more anti-seizure drugs than vitamin D deficiency.

36440224.takeaway: A bibliometric analysis of 3,206 publications on non-coding RNAs in osteosarcoma (2000-2021) shows steady growth led by China, with long non-coding and circular RNAs as emerging topics.

36440225.takeaway: In 10,098 frozen single blastocyst transfer cycles, a thin endometrium under 8 mm was linked to higher rates of preterm birth (15.7% vs 9.8%), low birth weight and miscarriage.

36440231.takeaway: The upper reference limit for intact FGF23 in 115 healthy children was about 61 pg/mL, with no significant differences by age or sex, giving a pediatric reference for rickets and phosphate work-up.

36440232.takeaway: Among 812 pregnant women in the CANDLE cohort, urinary metabolites of prenatal PAH exposure were modestly associated with placental CRH, most notably 2-hydroxyphenanthrene.

36440592.takeaway: In 90 children with DKA, blood thiamine fell 24 hours into treatment (108.8 to 90.1 nmol/L), with lower post-treatment levels in older children and higher levels in those with better initial consciousness.

36446318.takeaway: Historical review of the Pediatric Endocrine Society, founded in 1972 as the Lawson Wilkins society with 37 members and now about 1,500.

36446319.takeaway: Historical review of growth hormone, from early descriptions of acromegaly and pituitary extraction through the shift to biosynthetic hGH to today's long-acting formulations.

36446320.takeaway: Historical review of diabetes, from antiquity through Banting and Best's insulin in 1921 to modern glucose monitoring, insulin pumps and emerging biological treatments.

36446321.takeaway: Historical review of congenital hyperinsulinism, from diazoxide and insulin assays to genetic subtypes and 18F-DOPA PET localization of focal lesions that allow cure.

36446322.takeaway: Historical review of normal and precocious puberty, from GnRH identification and kisspeptin discovery to long-acting GnRH analogues and monogenic causes.

36446323.takeaway: Historical review of congenital adrenal hyperplasia, from 19th-century case reports and 1950 cortisone treatment to the molecular genetics that identified its causative genes.

36446324.takeaway: Historical review of obesity research, contrasting energy storage and energy balance paradigms, with leptin's 1994 discovery merging them, though leptin resistance remains unexplained.

36446327.takeaway: Historical review of the thyroid, from ancient goiter treatment and the 1811 discovery of iodine to newborn screening for congenital hypothyroidism in 1973.

36446328.takeaway: Historical review of adolescent gender-affirming care, from Dutch protocols published in 1998 to guideline-based interdisciplinary care, while noting current political barriers in the US.

36446329.takeaway: Historical review of PCOS, premature adrenarche and hyperandrogenism, from the 1937 recognition of adrenarche to the 2018 identification of 11-ketotestosterone as the main adrenal androgen.

36446330.takeaway: Historical review of rickets and vitamin D, from sunlight and cod liver oil treatments to calcitriol's identification and the 2000 discovery of FGF23.

36446331.takeaway: Historical review of differences of sex development, from ancient myths and the discovery of testosterone and SRY to modern team-based approaches to sex assignment that acknowledge uncertainty.

36446332.takeaway: Historical review of the IGF system, from the somatomedin hypothesis to IGF binding proteins, expanded definitions of GH insensitivity, and clinical IGF-I therapy in children.

36446347.takeaway: In 249 healthy youth, 11-oxygenated androgens rose modestly through puberty, with trajectories differing by weight status, while changes in estradiol and testosterone were far larger.

36446741.takeaway: In 699 youth with type 2 diabetes followed for up to 12 years, maternal (but not paternal) diabetes was linked to loss of glycaemic control, glomerular hyperfiltration and reduced heart rate variability.

36446887.takeaway: In 1,415 TEDDY children, clustering autoantibody timing, type and titre separated risk groups; high IA-2A titres drove faster progression at ages 4-8, and high GADA titres mattered less after age 9.

36452324.takeaway: Narrative review of genetic and epigenetic contributions to childhood obesity, emphasizing maternal obesity and overnutrition in pregnancy as programming influences independent of inherited DNA variants.

36453602.takeaway: An 11-year-old with congenital hypothyroidism and a novel thyroglobulin gene mutation had a 16 mm follicular nodule with unusually high mitotic activity, a pitfall that can mimic carcinoma.

36455114.takeaway: In record-linked data for 1,212 Welsh children with type 1 diabetes, educational attainment did not differ overall from peers, but it varied with HbA1c, being better in the best-controlled quintile.

36457553.takeaway: In 51 pubertal children with Down syndrome, menarche came earlier than in healthy girls (mean 11.8 years), obesity affected 46% of pubertal girls, and male puberty appeared to last longer.

36458449.takeaway: In 62 children with Prader-Willi syndrome, an early rise in DHEAS was associated with accelerated mid-childhood growth and advanced bone age, independent of obesity.

36465610.takeaway: In five women with pseudohypoparathyroidism over six pregnancies, calcium control changed inconsistently, and PTH rising in late pregnancy accompanied worsening calcium; most pregnancies had good outcomes.

36465622.takeaway: In women with unexplained recurrent miscarriage, blood HMGB1 was higher than in controls, and low-dose aspirin lowered HMGB1 and IFN-gamma over four weeks, with no birth abnormalities.

36465629.takeaway: A four-factor model (prepregnancy obesity, hypertriglyceridaemia, GDM and fetal abdominal circumference) predicted macrosomia in late pregnancy with moderate accuracy, AUC 0.77-0.82 across training and external sets.

36465635.takeaway: In 15,065 Chinese mothers, overweight or obesity before pregnancy raised risks of GDM, hypertensive disorders, preterm delivery and macrosomia, and the authors suggest a pre-pregnancy BMI of 19.2-22.7 kg/m2.

36465638.takeaway: Review of central adrenal insufficiency in Prader-Willi syndrome, which lacks clear diagnostic and monitoring guidelines, with growth hormone therapy possibly affecting adrenal function in children.

36465645.takeaway: Update of the 2010 consensus on insulin resistance in children, reviewing its definition, measurement, risk factors and prevention, with gaps remaining in insulin sensitivity measurement and biomarkers.

36465655.takeaway: Review of how childhood obesity affects the reproductive axis and pubertal onset through leptin, ghrelin, insulin and ceramide, and strategies to prevent obesity and central precocious puberty.

36465664.takeaway: Overweight children chose very sweet and very fatty puddings about twice as often as normal-weight children, and mothers' fat preferences tracked with children's obesity.

36469726.takeaway: In 3,318 children born SGA, starting GH at ages 2-3 gave a larger height SDS gain after eight years (+2.5) than starting at 4-5 (+2.2) or at 6 or older (+1.7), with no safety signal.

36469736.takeaway: In 213 youths with obesity followed about two years, adipose tissue insulin resistance did not predict changes in BMI z-score, challenging the carbohydrate-insulin model of obesity.

36472543.takeaway: In 302 people with type 1 diabetes, the MiniMed 670G hybrid closed loop lowered HbA1c and time below 70 mg/dL versus pump therapy, with no severe hypoglycemia on the closed-loop arm.

36472931.takeaway: Pooling 32 observational studies of 1.3 million adults, preoperative hyponatremia was associated with higher major complications (aOR 1.37) and early mortality (aHR 1.27).

36473079.takeaway: Among 191 encounters of children with severe DKA, none died and most were managed on a general medical unit; ICU transfer was linked to lower initial pH, longer stays and higher costs.

36473093.takeaway: A 17-year-old with hypertension, hypokalaemia, low renin and high aldosterone was first labelled primary aldosteronism, but genetic testing revealed Liddle syndrome, which amiloride controlled.

36473097.takeaway: In 77 girls with central precocious puberty on leuprolide, predicted adult height changed most in the first 6-18 months, and longer treatment (33 months or more) was linked to a better final predicted height.

36473171.takeaway: Review of subclinical hyperthyroidism in children, covering its mild and severe definitions, causes, presentation, investigation and individualised management.

36473446.takeaway: Review of challenges in moving people with DSD from paediatric to adult care, including loss to follow-up, adult morbidity, and fertility planning that should begin in adolescence.

36473453.takeaway: At age 6-7, children given 30 versus 10 µg/day of vitamin D3 in infancy showed no significant difference in tooth enamel defects (53% vs 39%, p=0.10), with most children vitamin D sufficient.

36475821.takeaway: In SEARCH youth with type 1 diabetes, pump use rose from 32% to 59% over 2001-2019, but race, education and income gaps persisted; Black youth had about a quarter of the odds of use.

36475908.takeaway: In 76 people with type 1 diabetes across all ages, the Cambridge hybrid closed-loop 'Boost' mode, which raised insulin delivery about 35%, did not increase time in hypoglycaemia.

36476334.takeaway: Two Peruvian children with epilepsy had hyperinsulinism-hyperammonemia syndrome from GLUD1 missense variants, showing that unrecognised hypoglycaemic seizures delay correct treatment.

36476603.takeaway: In 172 Finnish children with congenital hypothyroidism, higher starting levothyroxine doses in later decades normalized TSH quickly with few overtreatment symptoms, though all groups were shorter than target at age 2.

36477488.takeaway: Endocrine Society guideline on managing diabetes at high risk of hypoglycaemia, with strong recommendations for structured education, non-reconstituted glucagon, and real-time CGM for multiple-injection type 1 diabetes.

36477853.takeaway: In 23 pregnant women after gastric bypass versus 23 matched controls, glucose time in range fell and time above and below range rose through pregnancy and postpartum, with hypoglycaemia linked to greater prior weight loss.

36478070.takeaway: A homozygous NNT variant in a boy with familial glucocorticoid deficiency impaired redox balance and adrenal steroidogenesis in patient cells and in CRISPR knockdown adrenocortical cells.

36479213.takeaway: A 3-year-old with mosaic Turner syndrome had ovarian tissue cryopreserved, the first such case in China, with follicle counts within the normal range for children without Turner syndrome.

36479217.takeaway: Review suggests in-utero exposure to diethylstilbestrol and other synthetic estrogens and progestogens contributes to psychiatric disorders, especially autism, with epigenetic and multigenerational effects.

36479220.takeaway: Protocol for a Polish multicentre study planning to genotype about 500 children with severe early-onset obesity to estimate the prevalence of monogenic obesity, focusing on the leptin-melanocortin pathway.

36482071.takeaway: In 24 people with Cornelia de Lange syndrome, hyperprolactinaemia was most common, with subclinical hypothyroidism, mild puberty delay and insulin resistance in some prepubertal children.

36482987.takeaway: In adults with metabolic syndrome, lymphatic filariasis infection was linked to higher incretin and glucagon levels, but this short-lived effect was absent at 10-year follow-up.

36482989.takeaway: In 296 term SGA infants, extremely rapid weight gain in the first two years raised the risk of overweight or obesity at 2-5 years (aOR 2.1), with gain in the first four months most predictive.

36482990.takeaway: In 200 children with thyroid nodules, EU-TIRADS and ACR-TIRADS correlated with malignancy but missed about a quarter of cancers, so they were not fully satisfactory replacements for biopsy.

36482992.takeaway: In 5,725 pregnancies in Beijing, lockdown in late pregnancy worsened maternal metabolic profiles, including higher HbA1c in women with GDM and higher fasting glucose in normoglycaemic women, without changing neonatal outcomes.

36483002.takeaway: In 72 people with RASopathies, compared with matched controls, thyroid autoimmunity, reduced bone density and lower vitamin D were common, with short stature in 40% of Noonan and 64% of CFC patients.

36493795.takeaway: International consensus recommends standardised CGM-derived metrics, such as time in range and hypoglycaemia time, as trial endpoints or supportive measures alongside HbA1c.

36494191.takeaway: In 50 Kazakh children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, genotype predicted phenotype closely for severe and moderate variants but less so for milder ones, with salt-wasting the more common form.

36504388.takeaway: Integrated methylome and transcriptome profiling of 77 pituitary tumours in a Brazilian cohort separated functioning from non-functioning adenomas and matched somatotroph, corticotroph and gonadotroph lineages.

36506059.takeaway: A systematic review of 16 studies (177,886 girls) found Chinese girls reaching breast stage 2 earlier over two decades, with earlier onset in southern and urban areas, suggesting precocious puberty definitions need revisiting.

36507640.takeaway: ADA Standards of Care 2023 chapter for children and adolescents with diabetes, providing annually updated care recommendations.

36508610.takeaway: In 880 schoolchildren aged 7-17 from northern and southern Kazakhstan, the Quetelet index was normal but higher in the north, and physical performance was higher in southern children.

36509067.takeaway: Review of screening tests for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes in youth with overweight or obesity: OGTT detects impaired glucose tolerance but is inconvenient, fasting glucose is practical, and HbA1c is affected by non-glycaemic factors.

36511459.takeaway: A 15-year-old presented with right footdrop and sensory loss, a first sign of new-onset type 1 diabetes, and the footdrop recovered within a month of insulin.

36511482.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with hypomagnesaemia and diabetes had a 17q12 deletion including HNF1B that a gene panel missed, showing that microarray or other methods may be needed.

36511758.takeaway: In four adolescents using hybrid closed-loop systems, fabricated sensor calibrations and incorrect pre-meal boluses occurred, and the algorithm failed only when calibrations were too frequent.

36511831.takeaway: In 35 children aged 2-6 with type 1 diabetes, 12 weeks of MiniMed 780G hybrid closed loop raised time in range by 8% without severe hypoglycaemia and reduced parental diabetes distress.

36511871.takeaway: In 29 children and young adults undergoing stem cell transplant, most had composite CGM Q-scores in the fair or poor range, showing that peri-transplant glycaemic control is often suboptimal.

36513037.takeaway: In 1,196 Chilean boys and girls, higher IGF-1 at about age 6.7 was linked to earlier breast, menarche or genital onset, with a hazard ratio of about 1.2 per standard deviation.

36513041.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl with Sensenbrenner syndrome had severe primary hypothyroidism that resolved after combined liver and kidney transplantation, expanding the syndrome's clinical features.

36513057.takeaway: In 38 children undergoing an arginine-insulin test, copeptin rose consistently from about 10 to 28 pmol/L, suggesting the test can assess posterior pituitary function.

36513116.takeaway: Among 2,003 Dutch adult childhood cancer survivors, 36% had low bone density and 10% very low, and first fractures ran 3.5 to 5.4 times the expected rate, with hypogonadism and hyperthyroidism among associated factors.

36515075.takeaway: Systematic review of 15 studies found sex-steroid priming raised growth hormone responses during stimulation testing in peripubertal children, reducing unnecessary GH diagnoses, though optimal regimens are undefined.

36516296.takeaway: Among Hispanic/Latino adults with diabetes in HCHS/SOL, living in a doubled-up household was linked to less frequent doctor urine checks for kidney disease, but not to self-management behaviours.

36518247.takeaway: In occludin knockout mice, epididymal epithelial degeneration and impaired acidification caused male infertility, with disrupted lipid metabolism in the epididymis.

36518253.takeaway: In 22 boys with constitutional delay of growth and puberty, dissatisfaction with physical appearance was the main quality-of-life burden, and letrozole or testosterone raised appearance scores by 12 months.

36518257.takeaway: A 30-year-old woman with pregnancy-onset virilisation had P450 oxidoreductase deficiency, and her son carried compound POR variants with birth defects, so PORD should be considered in pregnancy.

36523592.takeaway: INSL3 best distinguished congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism from normal men in adults, while inhibin B was the stronger discriminator in boys with delayed puberty.

36523598.takeaway: Review of sex-steroid priming before growth hormone stimulation testing in peripubertal short children, covering who, when and how, and the need for consensus to avoid GH overtreatment.

36524234.takeaway: In 45 children with maple syrup urine disease, leucine levels at diagnosis did not predict later leucine tolerance, while the highest lifetime leucine levels typically occurred in the first three years.

36524854.takeaway: In a survey of 221 North American paediatric endocrinologists, ACTH stimulation test dose, cortisol cut-offs and interpretation varied widely, and nearly half did not know their cortisol assay.

36524979.takeaway: In six children with vitamin D-dependent rickets type 1A from Pakistan, the disease often mimicked nutritional or hypophosphatemic rickets, and calcitriol healed rickets faster than alfacalcidol.

36525647.takeaway: In 42,173 US women, traumatic childhood experiences were linked to a 13% higher type 2 diabetes risk, strongest among Latina women (HR 1.64), and partly explained by metabolic syndrome.

36528349.takeaway: A genome-wide analysis of 4,571 adults with type 2 diabetes linked GLP1R and ARRB1 variants to HbA1c response to GLP-1 receptor agonists, suggesting ARRB1 carriers might start these drugs earlier.

36530035.takeaway: In 78 children with Turner syndrome, vitamin B12 and folate deficiency were common (65-73%) and roughly doubled the odds of hyperhomocysteinaemia, compared with 67 healthy controls.

36531456.takeaway: Maternal TSH and free T4, especially in the first trimester, were associated with linear or nonlinear changes in several neonatal metabolites.

36531458.takeaway: In children with idiopathic short stature on growth hormone, serum uric acid correlated with height SDS and rose over 30 months of treatment.

36531459.takeaway: Obesity was present in 18% of adults with type 1 diabetes in Catalonia, and those with obesity had more poorly controlled cardiovascular risk factors.

36531464.takeaway: Non-idiopathic central precocious puberty gave lower final height; GnRH analogue treatment delayed menarche and helped girls with idiopathic CPP reach target height.

36531473.takeaway: Across 22 observational studies, glucose metrics in paediatric type 1 diabetes improved during and after lockdown, while HbA1c did not change.

36531474.takeaway: Narrative review of hypertension and cardiovascular risk in offspring of women with PCOS, highlighting gaps in the evidence.

36531478.takeaway: Diagnoses of central precocious puberty rose during COVID-19 lockdown at one tertiary centre, and affected girls used electronic devices more than controls.

36531482.takeaway: Systematic review of lived experience found dissatisfaction with PCOS diagnosis and care and called for culturally specific resources co-created with patients.

36531483.takeaway: One year of family-based dietary education improved weight, waist size and several carbohydrate and lipid markers in children with excess weight.

36531484.takeaway: Narrative review of bile acid signalling through FXR and TGR5, suggesting bile acid modulation may be a treatment target for obesity and metabolic disease.

36531491.takeaway: In a Chinese birth cohort, hair metabolites differed between women with and without gestational diabetes and were linked to air pollution exposure.

36531492.takeaway: Narrative review of genetic and epigenetic factors in central precocious puberty, including variants acting at hypothalamic and pituitary levels.

36531497.takeaway: Palpable breast tissue was present in 98% of healthy infants in year one, persisted more often in girls, and a hormone profile predicted persistence in boys.

36531499.takeaway: In 338 patients with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, males outnumbered females 2.6 to 1, with sex differences in non-reproductive features and BMI.

36531507.takeaway: Neuroblastoma cells store few neurosecretory vesicles, so catecholamines are converted to metanephrines rather than released in bulk, which may explain the lack of hypertension.

36532360.takeaway: Of 157 children after haematopoietic stem cell transplant, 59% developed endocrine abnormalities, most often primary hypogonadism, with risk linked to age, puberty, GVHD and gonadal therapy.

36534444.takeaway: In youth with diabetes, Black youth and those in more deprived neighbourhoods were more likely to follow trajectories of worsening glycaemic control or stable obesity.

36536468.takeaway: Children and youth with Turner syndrome had lower myocardial microvascular perfusion than controls, with age and overweight or obesity as independent risk factors.

36536479.takeaway: In 10 children with Prader-Willi syndrome and obesity, ketogenic diet therapy reduced BMI SD score from a median of 3.05 to 0.41 without changing height.

36542554.takeaway: In a French adult cohort, higher total and industrially produced trans fat intake was associated with greater type 2 diabetes risk, while ruminant trans fats were not.

36545340.takeaway: In NOD mice, sustained high-glucose drinking accelerated type 1 diabetes onset and increased islet inflammation and beta-cell autoantigen expression.

36546344.takeaway: Review of managing primary hyperparathyroidism and hypoparathyroidism in pregnancy, favouring parathyroidectomy before conception and close calcium surveillance postpartum.

36546354.takeaway: In 15 youth with stage 1 type 1 diabetes, a 2-hour 7-point OGTT gave reliable estimates of beta-cell function and insulin sensitivity compared with the 3-hour test.

36546602.takeaway: Young adults with T1D who mostly attended telehealth visits had more diabetes care visits and stable physician-related distress, while in-person attendees' distress rose.

36561566.takeaway: Among 152 perinatally HIV-infected adolescents in Tanzania, 29% had impaired fasting glucose, more often in males.

36562146.takeaway: Only 21% of 265 children with Graves disease achieved remission on antithyroid drugs, and 40% of those stopping relapsed, about half within a year.

36565029.takeaway: In a mouse model of MCT8 deficiency, high-dose intracerebroventricular TRIAC reduced peripheral hyperthyroidism without worsening brain hypothyroidism.

36567461.takeaway: Review of genes affecting growth plate extracellular matrix, whose defects cause several well-known short-stature conditions.

36567462.takeaway: Review of how iodine deficiency and excess contribute to thyroid dysfunction and autoimmunity in children and adults.

36567463.takeaway: Rapid review of five pediatric dapagliflozin studies found it generally safe and effective in adolescents, but larger and longer studies are needed.

36567464.takeaway: In 101 children with Graves disease treated with antithyroid drugs, 18% achieved remission and 57% relapsed; longer treatment courses were linked to lower relapse risk.

36568069.takeaway: Circulating DLK1 was lower in obese adolescents than in controls and correlated negatively with HOMA-IR.

36568081.takeaway: In hospitalised pregnant women, biodynamic lighting raised daytime circadian light dose and increased nocturnal melatonin on days 3 and 5 versus standard lighting.

36568086.takeaway: In obese female rats with early puberty, short-chain fatty acids reversed precocious puberty by reducing hypothalamic GnRH release through the Kiss1-GPR54 pathway.

36568099.takeaway: Of 799 children newly diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in Kuwait (2011-2017), 36% presented with DKA; severe DKA fell in those over 6 but not under 6.

36568119.takeaway: In 300 Spanish schoolchildren, body fat, sedentary energy use and sports activity were linked to overweight; BPA exposure from dental sealants was not significant.

36573281.takeaway: Review of insulin pump and CGM systems concludes that closed-loop systems improve glycaemic control and reduce hypoglycaemia, with benefits across age groups.

36576974.takeaway: Two years after stopping golimumab, children and young adults with new-onset type 1 diabetes kept higher C-peptide than placebo, with greater benefit in responders.

36577747.takeaway: In 176 children with differentiated thyroid cancer, 10-year disease-free survival was 88.7%; dynamic risk stratification was tested against long-term outcomes.

36578956.takeaway: A model combining sex, age, nodule size, multifocality and contrast ultrasound features predicted cervical lymph node metastasis in papillary thyroid cancer, with AUC 0.887.

36578957.takeaway: In 2,546 Emirati women, GDM incidence ranged from 8.4% to 21.5% across six diagnostic criteria, and 27.1% under any criterion.

36578959.takeaway: In young Italian people with type 1 diabetes, Control-IQ Sleep Activity Mode did not improve nighttime glucose control compared with not using it.

36578961.takeaway: In young people aged 10 to 24, blood pressure, lipids and vascular markers were similar in obesity with and without type 1 diabetes, though HbA1c and insulin resistance were worse with T1D.

36578963.takeaway: Adding rescue in vitro maturation to ICSI increased oocyte, embryo and blastocyst numbers compared with ICSI alone in 2602 women.

36580405.takeaway: Projections suggest US youth diabetes could rise to 239,000 by 2060 at constant incidence, or to 526,000 if incidence keeps rising, with widening type 2 disparities.

36585801.takeaway: In 46 adolescents, serum sonic hedgehog N-terminal levels correlated with insulin resistance and adiponectin and were the strongest predictor of HOMA-IR.

36588297.takeaway: In obese adolescents, alexithymia and low health literacy were linked to poorer diet quality, and 69% of alexithymic adolescents had metabolic syndrome.

36589801.takeaway: Among 161 children with simple obesity, 17% had impaired glucose tolerance and 17% tested positive for at least one islet autoantibody.

36589818.takeaway: In 80 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, adding growth hormone to a GnRH analogue gave greater height gain and better predicted adult height than GnRHa alone.

36589836.takeaway: In adults born very preterm or very low birth weight, smaller hypothalamic subunit volumes were associated with altered long-term body weight trajectories.

36589844.takeaway: In 56 children with overweight or obesity and NAFLD, a high triglyceride to HDL-cholesterol ratio independently predicted significant liver fibrosis.

36589847.takeaway: An 11-year-old girl with 46,XX 17-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency had a gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma, underlining the need for genetic assessment in variable presentations.

36589849.takeaway: In eight 46,XX patients with partial 17-hydroxylase deficiency, most had abnormal menses and multilocular ovaries, and CYP17A1 variants were identified.

36589850.takeaway: After Project ECHO Diabetes tele-education, 116 primary care providers reported greater confidence in managing type 1 diabetes and insulin therapy.

36591961.takeaway: Amylase or lipase was raised in 28% of children with DKA treated in intensive care, and lipase was higher in severe DKA.

36592381.takeaway: In 23,843 pregnant women, elevated serum uric acid before 24 weeks was associated with a higher risk of gestational diabetes at 24 to 28 weeks.

36593179.takeaway: Children under 4 with classical CAH had far more emergency visits than controls, and electrolyte abnormalities and stress dosing predicted illness-related hospitalisation.

36595216.takeaway: Parents of children under 5 using FreeStyle Libre 1 off-label reported longer sleep and earlier bedtimes, with glucose metrics also reported.

36597712.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with a GH and prolactin-secreting pituitary tumour carried an AIP mutation inherited from her father, plus a MEN1 variant of uncertain significance.

36597761.takeaway: In rats, carob extract was linked to earlier preputial separation in males and higher antioxidant enzyme activity, with sex hormone levels unchanged.

36597877.takeaway: In adolescents with type 1 diabetes, the Pankowska algorithm for a high-fat meal caused hypoglycaemia in half of participants, so the algorithm was modified.
