37218134.takeaway: Type 1 diabetes incidence among Libyan children aged 0 to 14 rose about 2.1% per year from 2009 to 2018, with the highest rates in children aged 0 to 9.

37218135.takeaway: For children with cosyntropin testing, peak cortisol cutoffs of 12.5 μg/dL with monoclonal immunoassay and 14 μg/dL with LC/MS were proposed to avoid overdiagnosing adrenal insufficiency.

37218136.takeaway: In 10 children and adolescents with CAH, continuous glucose monitoring showed abnormal 24-hour glucose in two-thirds, with higher night glucose in pubertal patients on reverse circadian regimens.

37218509.takeaway: In a pediatric thyroid nodule cohort, adopting the 2015 ATA guidelines may improve cancer detection and reduce biopsies and surgery, with nodules of 1 cm or less reasonably monitored.

37219952.takeaway: Adolescents with type 1 diabetes switching to the MiniMed 780G system improved time in range, but advanced puberty, longer disease duration and lower adherence were linked to smaller gains.

37220095.takeaway: In children with adrenoleukodystrophy, newborn screening led to much earlier diagnosis of adrenal insufficiency in boys, at a median of 6.7 months versus 6 years when found later.

37220261.takeaway: This narrative review proposes that early-pregnancy fetal growth reduction followed by in-utero catch-up growth, seen with maternal obesity or diabetes, may raise later childhood obesity risk.

37221247.takeaway: In a phase I/II randomised placebo-controlled trial in adults with recent-onset type 1 diabetes, umbilical cord stem cell infusion was safe and preserved C-peptide over 12 months.

37222702.takeaway: An 11-year-old boy developed severe hypoglycemia after starting thyroxine for autoimmune thyroiditis and was diagnosed with idiopathic isolated ACTH deficiency, an uncommon cause of secondary adrenal failure.

37223024.takeaway: A bibliometric analysis of PCOS and coronary heart disease research identified oxidative stress and genome-wide association as emerging topics and suggested prevention research may grow in importance.

37223040.takeaway: Adolescents with bone fragility fractures had lower bone mineral density at several skeletal sites, whereas young children with fractures did not differ from matched controls.

37226986.takeaway: In 539 Chilean girls followed longitudinally, higher waist circumference, fat mass and fat mass index during childhood predicted earlier pubertal milestones, while BMI had a less consistent effect.

37229452.takeaway: In 105 adolescents, a four-metabolite plasma score was associated with hypertension risk, which may help early recognition of hypertension in adolescents with obesity.

37229591.takeaway: In 88 people with type 1 diabetes using hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery, time in hypoglycemia was highest in children and adolescents and lowest overnight in all age groups.

37231854.takeaway: In a feasibility study of childhood-onset craniopharyngioma, eating behaviour measures were well tolerated, and hyperphagia correlated with BMI in patients, suggesting targets for obesity management.

37231892.takeaway: In 171 children, a morning salivary cortisol of 5.0 nmol/L or higher had a 97% positive predictive value for HPA axis recovery after glucocorticoid therapy, but false negatives were common.

37231960.takeaway: A survey of international newborn screening programmes found wide variation in CAH screening timing, single or two-tier testing, gestational and birth weight cutoffs, and case definitions.

37231969.takeaway: Recurrent fetal thyrotoxicosis from maternal TSH receptor antibodies was followed by central hypothyroidism in the infant, suggesting long-term pituitary-thyroid follow-up is needed.

37232247.takeaway: In hypogonadal girls, final uterine length tracked with the oestradiol dose, and progestins should be introduced only with an adequate oestradiol dose and clinical response.

37232272.takeaway: In 72 children, thyroid hypo- or hyperthyroidism was absent 3 months after stem cell transplantation, suggesting thyroid surveillance could start later, though reverse T3 rose in many.

37234798.takeaway: In overweight and obese Ukrainian adolescent boys, a combination of triglyceride-glucose index, pediatric NAFLD fibrosis index and triglyceride-to-HDL ratio best predicted metabolic syndrome.

37234802.takeaway: In 105,683 pregnancies, gestational diabetes raised risks of preeclampsia, macrosomia and other adverse outcomes, with additive effects alongside advanced maternal age for polyhydramnios and preeclampsia.

37234806.takeaway: In 62 Indonesian children with Down syndrome, lower selenoprotein levels tracked with higher thyroid autoantibodies, suggesting selenium deficiency may contribute to autoimmune thyroid disease.

37234811.takeaway: A boy with a novel homozygous PCNT variant had severe growth failure, kidney anomalies and cerebral aneurysm, and the authors suggest early brain MRI with angiography in this dwarfism syndrome.

37235772.takeaway: This review summarizes how maternal low-calorie or high-fat diets, fetal hypoxia and inadequate vitamin B12 or folic acid program later risk of obesity, insulin resistance, hypertension and kidney disease.

37235798.takeaway: In 24 nonambulant children with cerebral palsy, 12 months of zoledronate significantly increased lumbar spine bone density versus placebo, though first-dose acute reactions were common.

37243570.takeaway: Cluster analysis of an unselected adolescent population gave PCOS feature cut-offs for free testosterone, androgen index, Ferriman-Gallwey score and cycle length that sit at lower percentiles than conventional thresholds.

37246615.takeaway: Four case vignettes illustrate managing pediatric growth hormone deficiency across congenital, failure-to-thrive, adolescent growth deceleration and metabolic presentations, with timely treatment aiming to improve growth and metabolic outcomes.

37246711.takeaway: In 385 transgender and gender-diverse people on gender-affirming hormones, only 1.6% discontinued during follow-up, and discontinuation was uncommon when Endocrine Society guidelines were followed.

37248699.takeaway: In a child with congenital hyperinsulinism, octreotide given by insulin pump and adjusted with CGM reduced hypoglycemia and carbohydrate intake and supported growth before surgery.

37251668.takeaway: Two infants with neonatal diabetes from KCNJ11 variants switched from insulin to glibenclamide guided by CGM, keeping good control without hypoglycemia; the authors favor switching sooner.

37251670.takeaway: A meta-analysis found that adult ultrasound risk-stratification systems such as ACR-TIRADS, ATA and EU-TIRADS perform only moderately in children with thyroid nodules, supporting pediatric-specific systems.

37251677.takeaway: This narrative review of central precocious puberty in Prader-Willi syndrome, which is rare in that condition, aims to improve recognition and prompt treatment.

37251679.takeaway: In endometriosis patients undergoing assisted reproduction, live birth rates stayed acceptable even with diminished ovarian reserve, and perinatal risks were largely unchanged except for less gestational diabetes.

37251684.takeaway: FGF21 appeared to blunt growth hormone signaling in human growth plate cells and was higher during growth failure in very preterm infants, supporting a role in linear growth failure.

37252734.takeaway: In early use of the MiniMed 780G system with Guardian 4 sensor, adults and pediatric users met most glycemic targets, with a pediatric A1C of 7.2% and no serious adverse events.

37255970.takeaway: In a UK birth cohort, metabolites causally linked to mid-pregnancy glucose differed by ethnicity, with cholesterols dominant in White European women and saturated fatty acids in South Asian women.

37255971.takeaway: This review summarizes how MODY-causing proteins regulate beta-cell glucose sensing and exocytosis, how mutations disrupt them, and how this knowledge informs new treatments.

37256841.takeaway: In classic CAH, newborn screening was associated with better adult height in males and in simple-virilizing CAH, though the overall difference was not statistically significant.

37257483.takeaway: In 12 patients with Fabry disease, endocrine and autoimmune abnormalities persisted on enzyme replacement therapy, though they were less likely to cause symptoms; HLA types did not track with autoimmune markers.

37260445.takeaway: Boys with hematopoietic malignancies had testicular and pituitary-gonadal dysfunction at diagnosis that improved over three months of chemotherapy, though pubertal boys still had raised gonadotropins.

37261399.takeaway: In a European longitudinal cohort of children, lower serum 25(OH)D was associated with higher blood pressure, glucose, insulin resistance and triglycerides, suggesting early vitamin D repletion may reduce cardiometabolic risk.

37264642.takeaway: In electronic records of people with type 1 diabetes, switching from self-monitoring to CGM lowered median HbA1c from 8.1% to 7.7%, while switching from CGM to self-monitoring raised it from 7.9% to 8.0%.

37265226.takeaway: In 95 children with ATA low-risk thyroid cancer, remission rates were similar with and without radioiodine therapy, supporting withholding it to avoid radiation exposure.

37265695.takeaway: In 599 euthyroid school-age children, higher baseline free T3 predicted greater BMI gain and systolic blood pressure rise at follow-up, most strongly in children with higher TSH.

37265707.takeaway: In 6,923 US adolescents aged 8 to 19, a higher weight-adjusted waist index was associated with lower total bone mineral density, with a saturation effect above a threshold.

37267430.takeaway: In a large international Prader-Willi cohort, malignancies were rare and all affected patients had a paternal 15q11-13 deletion, so screening is advised only for suggestive symptoms.

37269395.takeaway: About one-third of hospitalized children with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis developed steroid-associated diabetes needing insulin, usually short-term intravenous insulin, and they had longer ICU stays.

37272067.takeaway: In girls aged 6 to 9, bone marrow diffusion values on skull MRI were lower in central precocious puberty than in controls, suggesting a possible quantitative marker for early detection.

37274319.takeaway: In 200 Chinese preschool children, higher urinary bisphenol A concentrations were linked to greater body fat and other body composition measures in this cross-sectional study.

37274327.takeaway: This review summarizes neurological and eye features of McCune-Albright syndrome, a mosaic GNAS disorder, and discusses mechanisms including chronic Gsα signaling and early hypercortisolism.

37274328.takeaway: In 90 pediatric papillary thyroid carcinoma patients, coexisting autoimmune thyroiditis was not linked to tumor features, and the disease may be less aggressive in adolescents than in children under 10.

37274341.takeaway: This narrative review describes how machine learning is applied to pregnancy diseases and complications, mainly for diagnosis and management, and notes that its use is recent and growing.

37274342.takeaway: Adolescent and young adult female athletes with amenorrhea reported more anhedonia and anxiety than eumenorrheic peers, with blunted caudate activation during reward anticipation.

37278153.takeaway: In Northern Ireland over 40 years, congenital hypothyroidism incidence nearly tripled, mostly from thyroid dysgenesis, and the authors call for research into changing in-utero exposures.

37279034.takeaway: In 161 children starting a new insulin pump or sensor, skin ultrasound showed hyperechogenicity and vascularization rising over a year at pump sites but not sensor sites, and this did not predict HbA1c.

37279406.takeaway: In adolescents, younger age, obesity and heavy bleeding were linked to lower success with norethindrone 0.35 mg, and higher norethindrone acetate doses may help patients with obesity or heavy bleeding.

37279507.takeaway: Longitudinal thyroid tests in children with Down syndrome gave syndrome-specific reference ranges, showing TSH persistently higher than in non-syndromic children, which may reduce overdiagnosis of hypothyroidism.

37279943.takeaway: In a Finnish nationwide register study, children with congenital hypothyroidism had more neonatal morbidity, malformations and neurological disorders than matched controls, but not more severe psychiatric comorbidity.

37283093.takeaway: A Chinese child with 12q14 microdeletion syndrome and normal GH levels grew better after 12 months of growth hormone therapy, suggesting possible benefit without GH deficiency.

37283250.takeaway: Four patients from one family with DNAJC12 deficiency had hyperphenylalaninemia and neurotransmitter abnormalities, suggesting this cause should be considered in unexplained cases.

37283961.takeaway: In 14 pubertal children, disrupting slow-wave sleep with auditory tones did not change growth hormone secretion, suggesting slow-wave sleep is not a direct trigger for GH release.

37284213.takeaway: In 564 Chinese men, certain polyunsaturated fatty acid metabolites in seminal plasma were linked to infertility among men with normal semen, and may serve as potential biomarkers.

37285233.takeaway: In children with overweight or obesity, uric acid and soluble CD163 correlated with BMI and metabolic markers, and sCD163 correlated with a pediatric NAFLD fibrosis score, suggesting it may help identify pediatric MAFLD.

37285485.takeaway: Among 1803 patients with differentiated thyroid cancer, young adults had fewer recurrences than children over a median of 10.7 years, with better 10-year disease-free survival.

37285827.takeaway: This review traces the thalidomide-related gene SALL4 to a range of malformations and proposes it as a candidate gene for syndromic pituitary insufficiency and growth hormone deficiency.

37288292.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with primary hyperparathyroidism had persistent disease until a redo operation found an ectopic parathyroid adenoma in the piriform sinus, with biochemical cure at 6 months.

37288293.takeaway: In euthyroid pregnant women with positive TPOAb, a first-trimester sCD40L above 5.625 ng/mL was associated with higher odds of adverse neonatal outcomes, especially preterm birth.

37288298.takeaway: In children with Prader-Willi syndrome, adrenal responses to metyrapone were delayed and age-dependent, and early morning ACTH or 11-deoxycortisol levels were unreliable for diagnosing stress-related adrenal insufficiency.

37288299.takeaway: In a Taiwanese birth cohort followed for 15 years, several phthalate metabolites were associated with smaller uterine volume at age 14, suggesting exposure at certain times may affect pubertal development.

37290044.takeaway: This mini review summarizes progress toward screening for presymptomatic type 1 diabetes and emerging disease-modifying therapies that may alter its early stages, along with remaining challenges.

37290420.takeaway: In 24 children with growth hormone deficiency, endothelial function was impaired versus matched controls along with lipid and visceral fat abnormalities, which improved after one year of GH treatment.

37290465.takeaway: In Finnish people with type 1 diabetes, residual C-peptide persisted for decades in many adolescents and adults, shaped by polygenic risk, and low levels seemed linked to fewer complications.

37290466.takeaway: This review updates pregnancy care for type 1 diabetes, covering glucose targets, gestational weight gain, blood pressure and aspirin prophylaxis, and hybrid closed-loop systems that may help reach time-in-range goals.

37293488.takeaway: In term-born infants, higher urinary phthalate metabolites were associated with lower developmental scores at six months, with differences by sex.

37293499.takeaway: This narrative review examines physical activity interventions from birth to age 5 aimed at preventing obesity and supporting motor, cardiorespiratory, muscle and bone development, and calls for new home- and childcare research.

37293501.takeaway: In 443 girls with central precocious puberty, those born small for gestational age had more cardiometabolic risk, and higher DHEAS was linked to a better lipid profile, even in SGA-born girls.

37293503.takeaway: Using SEER registry data, two web-based models were built to predict bone metastasis in gastric cancer and survival after diagnosis, with diagnostic AUCs of about 0.8.

37293507.takeaway: In UAE women, childhood asthma was an independent risk factor for PCOS diagnosed at age 20 or older, and thinner childhood body size also carried higher risk.

37293998.takeaway: In Japanese children aged 9 to 10, leptin levels and the leptin-to-adiponectin ratio correlated most strongly with waist circumference, waist-to-height ratio and BMI.

37300580.takeaway: In juvenile diabetic rats, memory deficits were linked to excess hippocampal 11β-HSD1 activity driven by high glucose rather than insulin deficiency, suggesting a possible therapeutic target.

37305030.takeaway: This review summarizes gut microbiota features in childhood obesity and how prebiotics may affect metabolism, notes limited pediatric trial evidence, and highlights mechanisms to resolve in future trials.

37305049.takeaway: This experience report on setting up a university ovarian tissue cryobank advises at least a year of planning, outreach to referrers, and an internal audit of procedures in the first year.

37306289.takeaway: In Sweden, lowering the screening TSH threshold in 2009 raised screen-positive congenital hypothyroidism incidence, while about half of CH cases were screen-negative, mostly in preterm or low-birth-weight infants.

37306442.takeaway: This narrative review summarizes DKA prevalence, cost and burden, notes that younger children and minority groups are at highest risk at diagnosis, and discusses continuous ketone monitoring as a prevention option.

37307222.takeaway: In a single-centre pregnancy cohort, hypercalcemia and hypocalcemia were each linked to preterm delivery, emergency cesarean section, blood loss and NICU admission, raising the question of routine calcium testing.

37307239.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with a novel DICER1 germline variant had multinodular goiter, an ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor and a pineal tumor, establishing DICER1 syndrome.

37307302.takeaway: In a registry of 84,390 children with type 1 diabetes, 1,121 developed diabetic neuropathy, with risk linked to higher HbA1c, postprandial glucose, female sex, older age, smoking and retinopathy.

37307574.takeaway: In US female hospitalizations, PCOS was linked to higher odds of several cardiovascular events, especially in women aged 40 or younger, with obesity and metabolic syndrome mediating the associations.

37308751.takeaway: In people with type 2 diabetes, double or triple doses of once-weekly insulin icodec carried a similar hypoglycaemia risk to daily glargine, with comparable symptoms and somewhat greater counterregulatory hormone responses.

37310686.takeaway: Over 13 years in 792 youth, more light physical activity lowered inflammation (hsCRP) about twice as strongly as moderate-to-vigorous activity, a benefit that was largely mediated through fat mass.

37313442.takeaway: In youth with type 2 diabetes, a 10-day CGM trial did not change HbA1c, but most participants reported more glucose checks and insulin adjustments and wanted to keep using CGM.

37315542.takeaway: Patients with GH1 variants showed varied phenotypes across isolated and multiple pituitary hormone deficiency, including a novel homozygous variant, and need follow-up for additional pituitary deficiencies.

37319430.takeaway: This mini-review summarizes how childhood obesity, type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular risk are linked, and the evidence for lifestyle, medication and metabolic surgery treatments.

37324258.takeaway: In children with chronic kidney disease, metabolic syndrome, high ambulatory blood pressure and low height SDS were the main factors associated with left ventricular hypertrophy.

37324260.takeaway: In a mixed-methods feasibility study, nurse-led virtual reviews linked to growth hormone device adherence data were feasible, with adherence staying high and families valuing the reviews.

37324276.takeaway: A patient with type 1 diabetes carried a novel TNFAIP3 mutation causing A20 haploinsufficiency, suggesting this diagnosis be considered when diabetes occurs with autoimmune or ulcer symptoms.

37324278.takeaway: A child with an ovarian juvenile granulosa cell tumor and Ollier's disease carried a somatic IDH1 mutation, and hormone levels normalized after surgery.

37327191.takeaway: A 6-week-old infant with a hypothalamic hamartoma had SIADH and life-threatening hyponatremia, which tolvaptan corrected, allowing fluids for feeding and weight gain.

37329217.takeaway: In a Qatari cohort of children with early-onset obesity, likely pathogenic variants explained about 15% of cases, with MC4R the most common cause and 23 novel variants identified.

37329220.takeaway: In 421 prepubertal, mostly normal-weight children, two years of physical activity and diet intervention attenuated rises in adrenal androgens and delayed pubarche in boys, independent of body size changes.

37329450.takeaway: In 128 children found by islet autoantibody screening, clinical type 1 diabetes at onset was milder, with less ketonuria and DKA, especially in those who received education and monitoring.

37334213.takeaway: In 45 children with central precocious puberty, a 6-month leuprolide depot kept LH, estradiol and testosterone suppressed through 48 weeks, with no new safety signals.

37334282.takeaway: In Belgian children born SGA and treated with growth hormone, syndromic patients started earlier at higher doses and reached shorter adult heights, though height gain was similar in both groups.

37334294.takeaway: In 12,980 adults in the Kailuan cohort, higher Life's Essential 8 cardiovascular health scores and stable high scores over time were linked to thinner carotid walls and lower risk of high carotid thickness.

37334296.takeaway: In 136 Taiwanese children and adolescents, urinary flame retardant metabolites were detected, and per-kilogram intake was 5 to 17 times higher in newborns than in older children.

37334297.takeaway: In normal glucose tolerant pregnant women, low glycaemia during the glucose tolerance test was linked to higher odds of birth weight below 2.5 kg, independent of BMI and gestational weight gain.

37334302.takeaway: In 3,297 women with first-trimester fasting glucose of 5.1 to 5.6 mmol/L, treatment did not improve pregnancy outcomes such as macrosomia, preterm birth or preeclampsia.

37334303.takeaway: In 324 children with type 1 diabetes, dyslipidemia was common at both younger and older ages, and HbA1c was the main factor linked to lipids and kidney function, supporting screening at all ages.

37334309.takeaway: In 27 children undergoing transoral endoscopic thyroidectomy by a single surgeon, the approach was feasible and safe with no permanent complications, but the authors advise limiting it to experienced high-volume surgeons.

37334310.takeaway: Metabolomics and network pharmacology suggest EGCG may prevent obesity-related precocious puberty via estrogen and PI3K-Akt pathways, with AKT1, ESR1 and IGF1 as candidate targets.

37335751.takeaway: In a 15-month randomized trial of adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes from diverse backgrounds, those who attended virtual peer groups had lower HbA1c and more CGM use.

37335752.takeaway: In a crossover study of young people with type 1 diabetes, an occlusive hydrocolloid patch showed faster healing of skin irritation from diabetes devices, with no extra adverse events beyond one infection.

37335967.takeaway: In 408 children with congenital hypothyroidism followed for six years, suspected neurodevelopmental disorders were about 4.5 times more likely than in controls, and outcomes were worse when treatment started later.

37337008.takeaway: This review summarizes recent adolescent trials of anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists and phentermine-topiramate, and argues for pairing lifestyle therapy with ongoing pharmacotherapy.

37338295.takeaway: Screening 59 unrelated patients with short stature or pituitary deficiency found PROKR2 variants in four, causing GH deficiency or multiple pituitary hormone deficiency, a rare cause with variable carrier penetrance.

37339320.takeaway: MC3R loss-of-function variants were rare but overrepresented among 362 people with constitutional delay of growth and puberty, and not clearly among those with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.

37342257.takeaway: This review links intrauterine and early postnatal growth patterns, including prematurity, to later cardiometabolic risk, and argues for early growth monitoring and early lifestyle intervention.

37342899.takeaway: In three newborn girls from two families with PHEX-associated X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets, high FGF23 in cord blood and at day 4 to 5 may help predict affected offspring.

37343528.takeaway: In seven children with Schaaf-Yang syndrome, four years of growth hormone treatment significantly raised height SDS and lowered BMI SDS.

37347111.takeaway: In 248 patients with congenital adrenal hyperplasia in the Middle East, quality of life was lower than in matched controls, most for pain and anxiety or depression, supporting early psychological support.

37347736.takeaway: In fetal sheep and macaques, metformin reached the liver and altered fetal hepatocyte metabolism and stress pathways, a possible mechanism for reduced fetal growth.

37350510.takeaway: In childhood and adolescent papillary thyroid carcinoma, multifocal disease was less common than in adults and did not predict recurrence, with excellent long-term survival.

37351105.takeaway: In women with GDM, a pre- and postpartum lifestyle and psychosocial program did not significantly change offspring birth, growth or behaviour to one year, apart from borderline shorter birth length.

37356432.takeaway: In 151 adolescents having sleeve gastrectomy, an abnormal baseline HbA1c was linked to more weight loss at six months, while most other metabolic markers did not predict outcome.

37356445.takeaway: This review summarizes racial and ethnic disparities in US diabetes prevalence, complications and management, including among youth, and recommends community-engaged, multidisciplinary approaches to promote equity.

37357735.takeaway: Adolescent girls with classical CAH reported aggression scores similar to healthy peers, although aggression scores rose with age in the CAH group.

37358380.takeaway: A one-year-old girl with a novel homozygous CYP24A1 variant and hypercalcemia without vitamin D intake responded to zoledronic acid when standard calcium-lowering treatment was limited.

37361517.takeaway: This review explains why neonatal hypoglycaemia has no uniform definition or safe management threshold, and notes that long-term neurodevelopmental effects of different strategies remain unresolved.

37361523.takeaway: Children starting pumps through subsidised programs in Western Australia kept stable glycaemic control for two years, but many families could not afford the private insurance needed to continue pump therapy.

37361526.takeaway: A girl with Bannayan-Riley-Ruvalcaba syndrome and congenital hypothyroidism from a homozygous TPO variant developed multinodular goiter, suggesting combined TPO and PTEN variants may contribute and that surveillance is needed.

37361536.takeaway: This protocol describes a trial of the DiaCompanion app's personalized dietary recommendations for women with gestational diabetes, with postprandial glucose above target as the primary outcome.

37361538.takeaway: In a pilot randomised trial of 129 women undergoing frozen embryo transfer, an extra luteal GnRH agonist dose raised live birth rates from 28.6% to 40.7%, a difference that was not statistically significant.

37361539.takeaway: This review examines HIF2α and MYC signaling in pediatric adrenal neuroblastoma and pheochromocytoma, linking them to aggressive behavior and suggesting HIF-MYC interactions as possible therapeutic targets.

37361542.takeaway: A systematic review of epidemiological studies found no clear link between prenatal exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals and autistic traits in offspring, though current studies have important limitations.

37368990.takeaway: In recent-onset type 1 diabetes, beta-cell glucose sensitivity declined faster in children, and higher baseline sensitivity predicted slower decline and more robust clinical remission.

37378024.takeaway: In juvenile female mice, calvarial and cortical bone showed distinct gene expression profiles reflecting their different functions, with WNT and IHH signaling highlighted.

37378967.takeaway: In youth-onset type 2 diabetes, tighter early glycemic control was linked to better long-term beta-cell reserve, but HbA1c rose in all groups and beta-cell function still declined.

37379575.takeaway: In 15,509 Danish children exposed to gestational diabetes, three BMI trajectories emerged, with about 40% following accelerating patterns linked to overweight or obesity at age 10.

37381587.takeaway: A 9-year-old with TANGO2 deficiency improved from a metabolic crisis with encephalopathy, rhabdomyolysis and arrhythmia after treatment with vitamin B-complex, which the authors suggest is effective.

37382585.takeaway: These pediatric guidelines give seven recommendations and six principles for preventing and treating glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis, based on a GRADE review of the evidence and expert voting.

37383390.takeaway: In a pediatric Wolfram syndrome type 1 case series, gonadal dysfunction was common, sometimes causing pubertal delay, and the authors propose adding it to diagnostic criteria.

37383395.takeaway: GLP-1 receptor agonist prescriptions for Chinese children and adolescents rose from 2016 to 2021, mostly for overweight, obesity, or prediabetes and diabetes, while other indications had insufficient evidence.

37385287.takeaway: Rare MECP2 variants were found in girls with central precocious puberty, with or without mild neurodevelopmental features, suggesting a possible role in hypothalamic control of pubertal timing.

37386805.takeaway: In 12 girls with peripheral precocious puberty from ovarian cysts, most cysts regressed spontaneously, but some later progressed to central precocious puberty, and cysts can signal McCune-Albright syndrome.

37388211.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl had an epidermoid cyst of the oculomotor nerve, initially misread as a common cyst on MRI near the saddle, and was cured by complete surgical resection.

37388215.takeaway: Rare loss-of-function variants in the PAM gene were enriched in people with pituitary hypersecretion, and lab tests confirmed reduced protein function, pointing to PAM as a possible therapeutic target.

37388573.takeaway: In 14 children with papillary thyroid cancer, ethanol ablation shrank neck node metastases by about 87% with no complications over 5 to 20 years, offering an outpatient option for patients who decline surgery.

37390454.takeaway: In thyroid eye disease, batoclimab rapidly lowered pathogenic TSH receptor antibodies but did not significantly improve proptosis versus placebo at 12 weeks, and it was generally well tolerated.

37392130.takeaway: In girls with central precocious puberty, blood pressure stayed stable during GnRH analogue treatment, while high baseline blood pressure was linked to higher BMI and lower birthweight.

37393897.takeaway: Youth-onset type 2 diabetes incidence peaked during virtual learning in the pandemic at 18.7 cases a month, compared with 4.3 after in-person return, and was higher among Black and Latinx youth.

37394962.takeaway: Among youth with type 1 diabetes, Hispanic and Black youth started CGM later and discontinued it more often than white peers, and the gaps persisted among privately insured youth.

37396162.takeaway: In 91 pregnant women in western Poland, iodine deficiency persisted despite national salt iodization, and only 68% reported iodine supplementation, suggesting current prophylaxis is ineffective.

37396177.takeaway: In children with narcolepsy type 1, obesity was present in about a third at diagnosis and central precocious puberty in about one in five, and sodium oxybate treatment was linked to better BMI over follow-up.

37396180.takeaway: In mice, maternal hyperglycemia induced by streptozotocin altered hypothalamic POMC neuron numbers in offspring in a sex-specific way, with adult metabolic changes worse in females on a high-fat diet.

37396186.takeaway: In Brazilian adolescents, sitting more than 8 hours a day was linked to higher odds of metabolic syndrome, while higher physical activity was associated with better insulin sensitivity.

37401054.takeaway: This review explains how CYP21A2 and its pseudogene complicate genetic testing for 21-hydroxylase deficiency, recommending copy-number analysis alongside sequencing to guide diagnosis and CAH-X risk management.

37401055.takeaway: This narrative review summarizes pediatric Cushing disease, from diagnosis after excluding exogenous steroids to surgical, drug and radiotherapy options, with early treatment needed to protect growth and puberty.

37401056.takeaway: This update reviews denosumab in children with osteogenesis imperfecta, which improves bone density but not fracture rates, with hypercalciuria and rebound effects needing further study.

37401057.takeaway: During Japan's COVID-19 school lockdown, obesity rose among elementary school children, especially boys, while junior high students' obesity and underweight rates fell in 2020 before rebounding in 2021.

37401058.takeaway: In 86 Thai girls, basal LH of 0.2 IU/L or more with an LH/FSH ratio of 0.1 or more identified central precocious puberty with 71% sensitivity and 100% specificity.

37403207.takeaway: In 52 adolescents and young adults with obesity, sleeve gastrectomy reduced hepatic fat within one year, with NAFLD resolving in all operated participants, and the change tracked with lower visceral fat.

37403211.takeaway: Adolescents treated for congenital hypothyroidism showed a trend toward cortical thinning versus controls, with thickness linked to IQ and hypothyroidism severity, while socioeconomic status limited cognitive outcome.

37403553.takeaway: In three children with leukemia treatment who had very severe hypertriglyceridemia, the authors suggest a very-low-fat diet before fasting and drug therapy after, and call for guidelines.

37404205.takeaway: In 30 physically active youth with type 1 diabetes on hybrid automated insulin delivery, faster-acting insulin aspart was no better than standard aspart for time in range, and both achieved high time in range.

37404302.takeaway: In Finnish cohorts followed from pre-puberty to early adulthood, earlier fatness predicted later fatness more strongly than physical activity did, and the links between adiposity and activity differed by sex.

37404307.takeaway: In 1,060 women aged 35 to 40 having frozen blastocyst transfer, a single high-quality blastocyst gave lower live birth rates than two but far fewer twin and preterm pregnancies.

37404308.takeaway: A systematic review found ovarian stimulation and oocyte freezing feasible in girls up to 18, but evidence in premenarchal girls is minimal, so it is experimental for younger girls.

37406222.takeaway: In 2.48 million Israeli adolescents, underweight, overweight and obesity were each associated with higher odds of low cognitive scores, with severe obesity among the strongest associations.

37406251.takeaway: In 200 treatment-naive children with GH deficiency, once-weekly somapacitan sustained growth over two years, and most children switching from daily GH preferred the weekly injection.

37409224.takeaway: In 703 overweight Finnish children and adolescents, 15% had MAFLD, which was associated with male sex, pubertal stage, and glucose and lipid disturbances.

37409230.takeaway: In male rats, longer blue light exposure suppressed spermatogenesis and increased testicular vascular changes, and the authors interpret this as precocious puberty.

37409232.takeaway: A boy with a new NR5A1 frameshift variant yielded no sperm from repeated semen collections or testicular sperm extraction at 17 years, so the proposed fertility preservation protocol failed for him.

37414069.takeaway: In Chinese people with impaired glucose regulation, adding metformin to lifestyle intervention further reduced progression to diabetes versus lifestyle alone, with more gastrointestinal side effects but no new serious safety concerns.

37415666.takeaway: In rats fed a high-fat diet, maternal supplementation with Elateriospermum tapos yoghurt during pregnancy and lactation reduced maternal weight gain and calorie intake and reversed liver and fat tissue damage.

37415668.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggested that genetically lower BMI causally raises the risk of adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, while the reverse direction was not supported.

37420130.takeaway: In a European children's cohort, genetic variants linked to fasting insulin differed across the insulin distribution, with some variants showing associations only in the tails, suggesting shared genetics with dementia.

37421250.takeaway: In 1,805 real-world users of the mylife CamAPS FX hybrid closed-loop system across 15 countries, time in range averaged 73%, rising with age, with hypoglycaemia at 2.3%.

37422722.takeaway: In 116 children with overweight or obesity, prepubertal children had more severe obesity, NAFLD was common at both stages, and the authors question routine childhood metabolic syndrome diagnosis and advise NAFLD screening.

37424701.takeaway: In 799 children with obesity, higher fasting and post-load glucose and insulin tracked with worse blood pressure stages, and renin was higher in those with impaired glucose tolerance.

37424864.takeaway: This review explains how the immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment of pediatric sarcomas limits immunotherapy and proposes studying individual immune cell components to design better treatments.

37424867.takeaway: In 1,112 Chinese adolescents, the lipid accumulation product index was most closely associated with metabolic syndrome and identified affected adolescents well, making it a simple screening tool.

37424874.takeaway: In 43 pediatric and adolescent pituitary adenomas, the immune microenvironment differed from adult tumours, and CD8 lymphocyte and PD-L1 levels tracked with invasiveness and recurrence.

37424875.takeaway: In 1,287 older Beijing residents, the MBOAT7 rs641738 T allele was linked to more fibrosis in men with fatty liver, while the TT genotype was associated with lower odds of ASCVD and obesity.

37427576.takeaway: A neonate with CPS1 deficiency and a novel variant in the allosteric domain responded to N-carbamoyl glutamate, suggesting such domain variants may predict response to this therapy.

37427847.takeaway: The 2023 Bethesda System for thyroid cytopathology gives each of six diagnostic categories a single name with an average risk of malignancy, adds pediatric risk data, and expands molecular testing guidance.

37431949.takeaway: In a one-year single-centre study of children with type 1 diabetes, both first- and second-generation automated insulin delivery systems met recommended targets, with the second-generation system giving tighter glucose control.

37432944.takeaway: In Danish adults with type 1 diabetes, DKA admission rates rose from 1996 to 2008 and then declined through 2020 at all ages, likely reflecting better diabetes management.

37433116.takeaway: In a longitudinal Indigenous American cohort, higher childhood HbA1c and 2-hour glucose predicted later albuminuria and retinopathy, suggesting childhood glycemic screening may help predict long-term complications.

37434360.takeaway: Six children with rickets and short stature had proximal renal tubular acidosis from varied causes, and the authors note this cause is often overlooked in rickets.

37434499.takeaway: In 32,982 women, high early-pregnancy triglycerides were linked to large-for-gestational-age infants and low levels to fewer, suggesting a triglyceride range for ideal birth weight.

37435482.takeaway: In 51 small-for-gestational-age infants with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, watchful waiting and diazoxide gave a comparable clinical course and hospital stay, supporting supportive care as an alternative.

37435483.takeaway: In 149 adolescents having orthopaedic surgery, prediabetes was associated with higher serum neurofilament light chain, a marker of neuroaxonal damage, after adjustment for age, sex and triglycerides.

37435487.takeaway: Across 19 Latin American and Caribbean countries, about 35% of screened people were at risk of type 2 diabetes by FINDRISC, and eHealth screening proved feasible.

37436141.takeaway: In 38 children admitted with severe vitamin D deficiency hypocalcemia, most were Black and under two years, and lack of supplementation was a key risk factor the authors call preventable.

37439248.takeaway: In UK children and young people with congenital adrenal hyperplasia, parents rated quality of life below normative data, and lower height, higher weight and hormone levels suggesting overtreatment were linked to poorer scores.

37439792.takeaway: This review explains how type 1 diabetes genetic risk scores combine many variants to aid classification and newborn screening, with barriers including limited non-European data and unclear clinical integration.

37440674.takeaway: In 11 Pakistani patients with MTHFR deficiency, neonatal and adult-onset forms both occurred, adult-onset patients waited a median of 7 years for diagnosis, and two novel variants were identified.

37440711.takeaway: In young adults with Prader-Willi syndrome who had growth hormone in childhood, three further years of treatment kept IQ and behaviour scores stable rather than improving them.

37440712.takeaway: In children with maternal GNAS-related PHP1A, growth hormone raised height by 1.5 SD after three years and improved adult height by about 1.9 SD versus untreated controls, without changing BMI.

37442105.takeaway: Among 86 parents of children with type 1 diabetes, most reported exhaustion, over half had anxiety or depression symptoms, and many woke nightly for diabetes care, supporting routine screening of parent distress.

37442110.takeaway: In children with hypophosphatasia from a global registry, skeletal and extraskeletal problems were common before enzyme replacement therapy, with patterns differing by age at first symptoms and by region.

37442824.takeaway: This review proposes that childhood obesity after maternal diabetes arises from self-perpetuating cycles of offspring beta-cell hyperfunction and altered lipid metabolism set by intrauterine hyperglycaemia, and suggests points for intervention.

37449922.takeaway: In 45 children with type 1 diabetes starting advanced hybrid closed loop, glycemia risk index fell and time in range rose from 71% to 81% over six months, with more readings in the lowest-risk zone.

37450564.takeaway: This review examines growth hormone use for short stature without GH deficiency, noting less consistent adult height benefits than in GH deficiency and the biological limits on GH action.

37453086.takeaway: In Swedish children in an obesity treatment register, greater obesity severity was linked to greater height and a blunted pubertal growth spurt, and successful treatment normalized growth velocity.

37454648.takeaway: International consensus guidelines on diagnosing and managing hyperinsulinism in infants and children update earlier statements, with accommodations for regions with limited resources to reduce hypoglycaemic brain injury.

37454652.takeaway: A 17-year-old with refractory hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, with no lesion found on imaging or surgery, was treated with the glucagon analogue dasiglucagon under a single-patient protocol and achieved glycemic control.

37455919.takeaway: This review explains how markers such as AMH can inform counselling on ovarian function in Turner syndrome, and reports 20 years of transition from paediatric to gynaecological and adult endocrine care.

37455927.takeaway: A novel homozygous ASCC1 deletion in an infant with bone fragility lowered osteoblast genes and shifted human stromal cells from bone toward fat, clarifying how ASCC1 dysfunction weakens bone.

37457848.takeaway: In the second pandemic year, new-onset pediatric type 1 diabetes rose 48% and type 2 diabetes 188% over prepandemic years, and type 2 made up half of new pediatric diabetes cases.

37458618.takeaway: In adults with type 1 diabetes at one centre, technology use rose from 27% in 2014 to 83% in 2021, and users had lower HbA1c than non-users, with the gap widening to 0.93%.

37459161.takeaway: An adolescent girl in a Chinese family had mitochondrial diabetes from the m.3243A>G variant without clear deafness, and the authors note hereditary diabetes should be considered in atypical cases.

37460828.takeaway: In people with HIV and prediabetes in Tanzania, metformin did not lower blood glucose more than placebo at 12 months, though it was found safe.

37463572.takeaway: Two siblings with a novel homozygous RNPC3 variant had congenital hypopituitarism, pituitary hypoplasia and peripheral neuropathy, expanding the known phenotype and supporting genetic counselling.

37467734.takeaway: This review summarizes evidence for kisspeptin and neurokinin B, neuropeptides that control GnRH and puberty, and their emerging use as therapies in reproductive, metabolic and menopausal disorders.

37469167.takeaway: In Bogotá from 2015 to 2021, congenital hypothyroidism prevalence was below that of high-income countries, two-thirds of cases did not receive treatment after diagnosis, and treatment started late.

37469961.takeaway: Four untreated adults from one family with thyroid hormone alpha resistance had high free T3 with normal TSH and free T4, and more hypothyroid symptoms than treated childhood-onset patients, suggesting earlier THRA testing.

37469985.takeaway: In early adolescent girls, greater social jetlag was associated with a worse combined cardiometabolic score including BMI, waist-to-height ratio, cholesterol ratio and blood pressure, beyond adiposity.

37470245.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes without clinical retinopathy, enlarged foveal avascular zones on angiography were linked to higher HbA1c, and peripheral vessel density was lower than in controls.

37470253.takeaway: In obese children, pulse wave analysis showed higher central blood pressure and arterial stiffness than healthy peers, with the highest 24-hour central blood pressure in those with metabolic syndrome.

37470306.takeaway: Children with CAH did not report more anxiety or depression symptoms than controls, and child and caregiver reports disagreed, so routine mental health checks remain worthwhile.

37474111.takeaway: Adolescents and young adults with avoidant/restrictive food intake disorder had higher oxytocin levels before and after a standard meal than healthy controls, which the authors suggest may contribute to food avoidance.

37475119.takeaway: In a Welsh linked-record cohort with thyroid hormone beta resistance, survival was reduced and cardiovascular events were more frequent, with higher free T4 at diagnosis linked to greater risk.

37478166.takeaway: In the German Diabetes Study, intramyocellular lipid was higher early in type 2 but not type 1 diabetes and stayed stable over five years, with links to microalbuminuria and cardiovascular risk.

37478335.takeaway: In children using diabetes devices, a basic skin care program was linked to 71% lower odds of device-related wounds, though overall eczema or wound rates were not significantly reduced.

37480575.takeaway: An 18-day-old boy with bilateral cryptorchidism and a hernia contained testes and Müllerian structures, and genetic testing found a novel AMHR2 deletion, confirming persistent Müllerian duct syndrome.

37484939.takeaway: In ten infant girls, transient clitoral preputial edema was mistaken for clitoromegaly, and the swelling typically improved over weeks to months, so its appearance and course help distinguish the two.

37484942.takeaway: In human fetal adrenal tissue cultured ex vivo, dexamethasone altered steroid output and the response to ACTH, supporting monitoring adrenal function in neonates treated prenatally.

37487514.takeaway: In children with familial hypercholesterolaemia followed for 20 years, higher lipoprotein(a) predicted greater progression of carotid intima-media thickness, suggesting an additional risk factor for early atherosclerosis.

37490040.takeaway: In preadolescent children with overweight or obesity, hepatic steatosis was linked to more bone marrow fat, which accounted for about half of its association with lower lumbar spine bone density.

37493759.takeaway: In people with normal-weight type 2 diabetes, strength training lowered HbA1c more than aerobic training, while combined training did not differ from strength training.

37497349.takeaway: This review covers metabolism and senescence in the immune microenvironment of osteosarcoma and discusses how combining anti-senescence therapy with immunotherapy may improve treatment.

37497350.takeaway: In 2,267 mother-infant pairs, cord blood triglycerides, C-peptide and HbA1c were linked to infant weight and BMI patterns through 18 months, with higher cord triglycerides and HbA1c linked to lower overweight risk.

37497353.takeaway: In 1,203 frozen blastocyst transfer cycles at one centre, maternal age did not change singleton birthweight or adverse neonatal outcomes after adjustment.

37497768.takeaway: In term SGA infants followed for two years, low maternal height, a large mid-parental height gap, prior SGA history and low ponderal index predicted failure to catch up, identifying children who may need growth hormone.

37501784.takeaway: In Hungarian register data (1996-2018), pregnancies with type 1 diabetes still had more congenital malformations, but caesarean, NICU and low-APGAR gaps narrowed.

37501786.takeaway: Two siblings with congenital generalized lipodystrophy type 4 carried a novel homozygous CAVIN1 variant, with absent leptin and adiponectin, hyperphagia and mildly raised insulin resistance, highlighting the need for multidisciplinary assessment.

37503893.takeaway: In 100 real-world users of the Cambridge hybrid closed-loop app over 28 days, time in range averaged 73% and auto-mode was active 96% of the time, comparable to other commercial systems.

37515400.takeaway: This clinical update on paediatric pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma notes that presentations are often overt, so early recognition and timely treatment give a favourable prognosis, illustrated with four cases.

37515449.takeaway: During a COVID-19 lockdown in western China, preschool children showed excessive weight gain, especially those already heavy before the pandemic, while more living space and good mental wellbeing were protective.

37515585.takeaway: In 7,069 mother-child pairs, gestational diabetes combined with short maternal sleep was linked to higher risk of child neurodevelopmental delay, partly through cord blood C-peptide.

37522114.takeaway: In a nationwide Korean cohort of 253,967 children, rapid weight gain in infancy or toddlerhood raised the odds of central precocious puberty in girls, but not in boys.

37522123.takeaway: In 231 young women, longer hormonal contraceptive use was linked to lower resting-state connectivity of the amygdala and anterior cingulate cortex, regardless of progestin androgenicity.

37522130.takeaway: In school-age girls who gained weight, higher baseline serum alpha-Klotho was linked to lower follow-up waist circumference and visceral fat, suggesting a protective effect against central adiposity.

37522427.takeaway: In its first 18 months, the Partners4Growth twinning programme across Bulgarian paediatric endocrinology centres increased new growth-disorder patients and rhGH starts, with GH deficiency the most common indication.

37523175.takeaway: In a 13-week randomised trial of the insulin-only iLet bionic pancreas, adults reported less fear of hypoglycaemia and less diabetes distress, while youth and caregivers found it acceptable with less clear psychosocial gains.

37526290.takeaway: In a Chinese birth cohort, low maternal free T4 across pregnancy predicted higher child BMI trajectories and body fat at age 6, while higher free T4 was linked to lower obesity risk.

37529595.takeaway: A retrospective model linked maternal age, gestational diabetes, fetal distress, ritodrine use, prolonged pre-delivery fasting and higher neonatal BMI to neonatal hypoglycaemia risk, with an AUC of 0.79.

37529606.takeaway: In male rats, maternal and prepubertal codeine exposure impaired spermatogenesis and sperm quality, and prepubertal arginine supplementation reduced these effects through oxidative stress pathways.

37529614.takeaway: In Swedish girls with Turner syndrome treated with growth hormone, a higher dose and earlier start gave greater prepubertal gain, allowing puberty and adult height within the normal range.

37530217.takeaway: Thyroid-function gene variants found in adults were also associated with TSH and FT4 in newborns and preschool children, with some effects larger than in adults, though polygenic scores explained only a small share of variation.

37531076.takeaway: In 256 short children starting growth hormone, bone health index was reduced at baseline regardless of GH status, rose after one year of treatment and then plateaued.

37531149.takeaway: In 105 children and adolescents, pentraxin-3 levels were higher in obese children with metabolic syndrome, and high levels tracked with more metabolic syndrome and hepatic steatosis.

37536271.takeaway: In 8 patients with type B insulin resistance syndrome, low complement C3 and IGF-1 were characteristic, and high-dose glucocorticoid pulses followed by long-term immunosuppressants gave partial or complete remission.

37536280.takeaway: In 142 young adults with papillary thyroid cancer, those under 25 with fusion oncogenes had a trend toward advanced stage and more lateral lymph node metastasis, supporting age-aware risk assessment.

37537394.takeaway: In newly diagnosed youth with type 1 diabetes, serum proteins including GPX3 tracked with fasting C-peptide to glucose ratio during the first year, and the direction of GPX3 change indicated later beta-cell function.

37539847.takeaway: This review covers growth impairment in childhood cancer survivors from nonhormonal causes, including targeted therapies, and from hormonal causes such as growth hormone deficiency, along with overgrowth.

37542367.takeaway: In 5,518 pregnancies with pregestational diabetes, insulin pump therapy was linked to higher odds of cesarean delivery and large-for-gestational-age infants, with no difference in neonatal hypoglycaemia.

37547305.takeaway: In human myometrial cells, prostaglandin F2α triggered inflammatory signalling through FP receptor coupling to Gαq and Gαi, suggesting this pathway could be a target for managing preterm labour.

37547311.takeaway: This narrative review covers managing type 2 diabetes in pregnancy, including preconception care, tight glucose control, gestational weight gain, antihypertensive and aspirin use, and postpartum follow-up.

37547313.takeaway: Mendelian randomization linked genetically predicted neonatal and adult sepsis to lower BMI or obesity risk, with no association found for other inflammation-related diseases.

37547321.takeaway: Experts expect burosumab to reduce fractures and halt some XLH complications, and starting in childhood may help achieve an aligned skeleton, pending real-world confirmation.

37548178.takeaway: In identical twins with discordant prenatal growth, the smaller twins caught up quickly but stayed about 0.5 SDS shorter at age 17, suggesting a lasting effect of an adverse intrauterine environment.

37549682.takeaway: New UK national guidelines for paediatric craniopharyngioma, built with AGREE II methods, aim to standardize care for a benign tumour that can cause lasting neuroendocrine problems.

37551988.takeaway: In Belgian term newborns, thyrotropin screening from 48 hours with sampling before discharge was valid, treated positives earlier, and produced fewer unusable samples than home sampling.

37552959.takeaway: A scoping review found CAH is most reported in Thailand, Ghana and India, while most psychosocial research comes from the USA, Germany and the UK, calling for global collaboration.

37552972.takeaway: In 94 girls with a history of idiopathic central precocious puberty, PCOS was diagnosed in 12%, about 2.5 times the risk in healthy adolescents, with no difference between GnRH analogue-treated and untreated girls.

37553860.takeaway: Obesity prevalence in preschool children in Hangzhou declined between 2020 and 2022, and the authors credit community childcare management and an electronic health-care system.

37555570.takeaway: In 73 premenarchal girls with Turner syndrome, growth hormone therapy, especially an earlier start and longer use, was associated with normal uterine volume for age before oestrogen replacement.

37559363.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl's lateral neck mass proved to be papillary thyroid carcinoma with no thyroid primary after total thyroidectomy, raising whether it was ectopic thyroid or nodal metastasis.

37559365.takeaway: The Turkish Parent Diabetes Distress Scale proved valid and reliable in parents of 210 teenagers with type 1 diabetes, and most parents reported moderate or high distress.

37559366.takeaway: In a South Indian familial study, vitamin D deficiency was the main contributor to type 1 diabetes risk, and specific vitamin D receptor gene variants were linked to disease risk.

37559367.takeaway: In adolescents with type 1 diabetes, girls were 1.9 times more likely than boys to have two or more cardiovascular risk factors, with the highest burden in girls with obesity, alongside insulin dose and HbA1c.

37559368.takeaway: A one-month-old infant with nephrocalcinosis had a 5q35 deletion covering NSD1, SLC34A1 and FGFR4, consistent with Sotos syndrome, and the authors propose a contiguous-gene link to the kidney findings.

37559371.takeaway: A Diabetes Technology Society meeting report reviews hospital CGM use, covering nursing protocols, ward implementation, quality and cost, critical care and accuracy, and offers expert recommendations.

37560296.takeaway: In mice, paternal developmental thyroid hormone excess altered neonatal leptin and melanocortin signalling in offspring in a sex-dependent way, increasing adiposity and suggesting non-genetic inheritance of metabolic risk.

37560299.takeaway: In Turner syndrome, growth, cardiac and renal follow-up were well implemented, but ENT, dental, eye, skin and liver assessments were often missed, with better adherence after transition to adult care.

37560302.takeaway: A neonate with McCune-Albright syndrome and Cushing syndrome needed adrenalectomy and prolonged hydrocortisone, and over 34 months of follow-up developed fibrous dysplasia, rickets and peripheral precocious puberty.

37564886.takeaway: Patients with ROHHAD(NET) syndrome had altered blood T-cell subsets and higher IL-8 and MCP-1 than controls, with the highest IL-8 in those with a neural tumour, supporting immune dysregulation.

37564981.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with severe hypertension from a norepinephrine-secreting tumour carried a germline VHL variant and a novel KIF1B variant, supporting multi-gene panel testing in neural crest tumours.

37564990.takeaway: In US adolescents aged 12 to 19, higher serum uric acid was associated with lower eGFR, with the effect strongest in underweight adolescents.

37566523.takeaway: In very preterm infants, weekly thyroid screening in the first month found congenital hypothyroidism early, with incidence rising at lower gestational age and only 42% of cases caught at the first screen.

37568277.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes, an objective mealtime insulin bolus score correlated more strongly with HbA1c than the self-care inventory, supporting its use in pump data reports.

37576960.takeaway: This review finds puberty in Noonan syndrome is often delayed, and males are at risk of gonadal dysfunction from cryptorchidism and RAS/MAPK pathway effects, calling for long-term cohort data and genetic counselling.

37576969.takeaway: In pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, double diabetes with insulin resistance or obesity was common, and its early-pregnancy presence flagged higher risk of pre-eclampsia, preterm delivery and NICU admission.

37578804.takeaway: In 62 Chinese adolescents and adults with type 1 diabetes, one month of the MiniMed 770G hybrid closed-loop system improved glycaemia versus open-loop insulin, with no severe hypoglycaemia, DKA or serious adverse events.

37579024.takeaway: In a large Israeli cohort of children aged 2 to 18, boys had slightly higher fasting glucose than girls, and adolescents higher than younger children, suggesting age- and sex-specific reference ranges.

37579049.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with short stature had hypocalcemia and high phosphate without raised PTH from a GNA11 variant, diagnosing autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 2, the first pediatric case with this variant.

37579198.takeaway: In 58 patients with active Graves orbitopathy, monthly and weekly intravenous methylprednisolone gave comparable response and adverse event rates, so monthly dosing may be an alternative.

37579214.takeaway: In children with severe primary IGF-1 deficiency treated with mecasermin, hypoglycaemia was more likely in those with prior hypoglycaemia or Laron syndrome, who need closer monitoring.

37579297.takeaway: This award lecture reviews how pregestational diabetes in pregnancy has changed, with type 1 cases up about 40% and type 2 more than doubled, and how trials shaped CGM and metformin use.

37579501.takeaway: In TEDDY children with HLA DR3/4, introducing solid food before 6 months raised islet autoimmunity risk when no probiotics were given in year one, and early rice introduction was also linked to higher risk.

37580314.takeaway: The 2023 international PCOS guideline gives 254 recommendations and practice points on assessment and management, with evidence improved but generally low to moderate quality, and calls for more research.

37580861.takeaway: The 2023 international PCOS guideline gives 254 recommendations and practice points on assessment and management, with evidence improved but generally low to moderate quality, and calls for more research.

37584397.takeaway: This clinical approach review describes youth-onset type 2 diabetes as more aggressive than adult disease, calling for multidisciplinary care, intensive behaviour therapy from diagnosis, and newer medicines such as GLP-1 agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors.

37586336.takeaway: Three siblings with STAT5B deficiency had severe growth failure, and rhIGF-1 gave two of them substantial height gain, though the response was weaker than in primary IGF-1 deficiency.

37588986.takeaway: In 93 people with molecularly confirmed RASopathies, lipid profiles were unfavourable, especially in PTPN11-related Noonan syndrome, where total cholesterol was reduced in about half of patients.

37589444.takeaway: This review surveys current studies of artificial intelligence in pediatric endocrinology, including diabetes management, bone growth, metabolism, obesity and puberty, and urges clinicians to become familiar with it.

37589624.takeaway: The 2023 international PCOS guideline gives 254 recommendations and practice points on assessment and management, with evidence improved but generally low to moderate quality, and calls for more research.

37590955.takeaway: In transgender girls, higher estrogen dosing, including ethinyl estradiol and 6 mg estradiol, gave larger lumbar spine bone density gains than regular dosing, and about 4 mg estradiol may be needed for adequate levels.

37594959.takeaway: This award lecture reflects on 30 years of research on hyperglycaemia in pregnancy, covering diabetes risk after gestational diabetes, its pathophysiology in Hispanic women, beta-cell preservation and developmental effects on offspring.

37595261.takeaway: In adolescent boys with Klinefelter syndrome, executive dysfunction was linked to altered brain activation, and differences were larger in those with more pubertal delay, lower testosterone and smaller testes.

37595266.takeaway: Patients with impaired insulin receptor signalling grew poorly and had lower bone density, while elevated insulin receptor signalling in lipodystrophy was linked to faster growth and higher bone density.

37597173.takeaway: Among 82 caregivers of craniopharyngioma survivors, caregiver burden rose with the number of survivor health problems, especially hypothalamic symptoms such as hyperphagia rather than obesity alone.

37600690.takeaway: POU6F2 variants found in 15 patients with idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism altered GnRH gene regulation in cell assays, with one variant blocking normal repression, consistent with a role in pubertal failure.

37600703.takeaway: In a representative German adult type 1 diabetes population, older age, male sex and migration background were linked to lower diabetes technology use, while area deprivation effects were non-linear.

37600705.takeaway: In children with differentiated thyroid cancer, the response to initial radioiodine stratified outcomes, with 5-year disease-free survival of 95.5% in those with no evidence of disease, and lower progression-free survival in those with persistent disease.

37600706.takeaway: In 39 children on anticoagulation, lumbar spine and total body bone mineral density were reduced, with low BMI and pubertal stage as risk factors rather than anticoagulant-related factors.

37600718.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggested shorter telomeres increase the risk of spontaneous abortion, with limited evidence for links to preterm birth, pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes or growth restriction.

37600721.takeaway: An 11-year-old girl with HDR syndrome had a GATA3 splice-site variant that activated a cryptic splice site and removed seven nucleotides from exon 5, clarifying how such mutations cause the disorder.

37607392.takeaway: An integrated analysis of 609 patients showed teplizumab preserved C-peptide in stage 2 type 1 diabetes over two years, with mostly self-limited adverse events such as lymphopenia, rash and headache.

37607456.takeaway: In TEDDY children, gastrointestinal infections before age one, or 12 to 23 months before an insulin autoantibody, raised risk, while infections in year two lowered it.

37607514.takeaway: In children, an arginine-stimulated copeptin cut-off of 3.8 pmol/L identified central diabetes insipidus with 100% sensitivity and 86.5% specificity, potentially replacing water deprivation and hypertonic saline tests.

37608608.takeaway: This review of CAH monitoring says hormone replacement should be individualised using daily hormone profiles, notes limits of 17-OHP and androstenedione, and favours salivary or urinary steroid testing in children.

37608729.takeaway: A 16-year-old girl developed Graves' disease six to seven weeks after her second COVID-19 mRNA vaccine dose and responded to methimazole and propranolol, though the authors say causation cannot be determined.

37609994.takeaway: In a six-year Australasian registry audit of youth with type 2 diabetes, Indigenous Australian and Māori and Pacific youth were diagnosed younger with worse HbA1c, supporting earlier screening in these groups.

37611560.takeaway: This review finds that hypertension in childhood 21-hydroxylase deficiency is most linked to mineralocorticoid replacement, while evidence for links to androgens, insulin resistance or glucocorticoid dose is inconclusive.

37611564.takeaway: A family with a SALL4 nonsense variant across four generations had radial limb defects, and a boy with isolated growth hormone deficiency responded well to growth hormone therapy.

37614407.takeaway: In adolescents with type 1 diabetes, more moderate-to-vigorous physical activity was linked to less diabetes distress, while more sedentary time was linked to higher distress after adjustment.

37614408.takeaway: Interviews with 12 adolescents with type 1 diabetes and obesity, their caregivers and nine paediatric endocrinologists identified adaptations needed for a weight management programme, including content, structure and eating disorder risk.

37614409.takeaway: In genetically at-risk children followed to age 8, higher total energy intake raised islet autoimmunity risk through higher BMI, and a larger protein share of energy directly raised GAD autoantibody risk.

37614410.takeaway: In adolescents and young adults using hybrid closed loop, underestimating glucose and frequent alerts or pump engagement predicted lower time in range, while responding to alerts and entering carbohydrates predicted higher time in range.

37614411.takeaway: In US pediatric type 2 diabetes admissions, hyperosmolar hyperglycaemic state carried higher severity and mortality than DKA, and male sex and Black race were linked to HHS admission.

37615591.takeaway: A systematic review found GSD type 1a incidence of about 0.085 to 4.9 per 100,000 newborns, and simulations suggest counting diagnoses estimates incidence better than dividing by births.

37615689.takeaway: In pregnancies affected by type 1 diabetes, metabolite patterns differed by complication, with large-for-gestational-age linked to third-trimester changes and neonatal hypoglycaemia to changes from the first trimester.

37619990.takeaway: A meta-analysis found women with PCOS report more body image concerns than women without it, including greater dissatisfaction with weight and body area, supporting attention to body image in clinical care.

37619992.takeaway: A patient with White-Sutton and Kallmann syndromes carried a de novo POGZ variant, and patient-derived neural progenitors showed reduced proliferation and neurite growth, suggesting POGZ affects GnRH neuron development.

37621150.takeaway: A child diagnosed with diabetes at age 8 carried a PAX4 variant that segregated with diabetes across three generations and was reclassified as likely pathogenic, supporting PAX4 testing in MODY.

37621212.takeaway: A school-aged child with persistent hypoglycaemia from insulinoma had an unreported likely pathogenic MEN1 variant, showing insulinoma can be the first sign of MEN1 syndrome.

37622214.takeaway: In 278 advanced differentiated thyroid cancers, fusion oncogenes were more common in children and linked to radioiodine refractoriness there, while in adults TERT mutation drove refractoriness.

37622285.takeaway: A survey of national paediatric societies found good awareness of childhood obesity prevention, but implementation of WHO/UNICEF guidance and food advertising regulation was uneven and hindered by poor compliance.

37622424.takeaway: In 2,243 mother-child pairs, maternal isolated subclinical hypothyroidism before 20 weeks was linked to higher odds of inhibition, working memory and behaviour problems in children aged 3 to 6.

37623928.takeaway: In 46 children with type 1 diabetes at a camp, impulsive and avoidant problem-solving styles and low problem-solving confidence predicted poorer self-management, and depression altered how strongly problem-solving mattered.

37624230.takeaway: This perspective argues that metformin and lifestyle first-line treatment is suboptimal for over half of youth with type 2 diabetes within two years, and calls for more use of GLP-1 agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors.

37625035.takeaway: In 108,061 people diagnosed with type 2 diabetes aged 16 to 50 in England, the relative risk of death was higher at younger diagnosis ages, but absolute differences in 10-year mortality were small.

37632349.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 11 studies found newborns with vitamin D deficiency had higher odds of hypocalcemia, and maternal vitamin D deficiency was an even stronger risk factor.

37633255.takeaway: Over 24 months after sleeve gastrectomy in 23 youth, falls in BMI, lean mass and sex steroids were linked to bone density and strength loss compared with 30 non-surgical controls.

37635963.takeaway: A meta-analysis found exercise training lowered fasting insulin, HOMA-IR and body weight in children and adolescents with overweight or obesity, supporting exercise as a strategy against insulin resistance.

37635972.takeaway: In young Australian children followed to age 5, breakfast supplied much of their iron, calcium and zinc but also much of their sodium, saturated fat exceeded recommendations, and dietary patterns tracked only low to moderately.

37635973.takeaway: Sex non-specific growth charts built from 39,119 US youth aged 2 to 20 were largely similar until about age 10, and the authors suggest they may help assess growth in transgender youth.

37635978.takeaway: In 140 women with gestational diabetes after cesarean delivery, adding low-dose esketamine to sufentanil patient-controlled analgesia cut sufentanil use while giving equally effective pain control.

37635983.takeaway: In a Korean nationwide claims cohort, people with chronic idiopathic hypophosphatemia had about twice the risk of any complication, and higher mortality and hospitalization, than matched controls.

37635986.takeaway: In five children with 22q11.2 deletion or DiGeorge-like syndromes, thyroid neoplasms were found during follow-up, three malignant with good outcomes from early recognition, supporting prolonged thyroid surveillance.

37639628.takeaway: Biallelic ONECUT1 variants caused neonatal diabetes in one individual, and heterozygous null variants were associated with type 2 diabetes in UK Biobank, while missense variants were not.

37643291.takeaway: In a trial-embedded infant cohort of 432, gestational diabetes detected by lower but not higher thresholds, treated or not, did not raise infant fat mass at 5 to 6 months.

37643311.takeaway: In gestational diabetes, a provided higher complex-carbohydrate diet did not lower newborn adiposity compared with a conventional lower-carbohydrate diet, and glucose control and insulin resistance were similar.

37643900.takeaway: In 61 people with classic CAH followed from childhood into adulthood, GnRH agonist therapy did not compromise bone density, though density fell in early adulthood, possibly from chronic glucocorticoid exposure.

37646634.takeaway: In a real-world cohort of youth with type 1 diabetes starting Omnipod 5, time in range rose from 49% to 61% within nine days and held over 90 days.

37647889.takeaway: In a Chinese prospective cohort, higher maternal TSH in early pregnancy and subclinical hypothyroidism were linked to higher odds of gestational diabetes, with a nonlinear TSH relationship.

37650550.takeaway: In 53 prepubertal children with classic CAH, androstenedione could be suppressed at guideline-compliant hydrocortisone doses without hindering growth, though BMI already rose in prepuberty.

37650607.takeaway: Young Black women had higher systolic blood pressure and aldosterone-to-renin ratios than White women even on controlled sodium diets, suggesting aldosterone dysregulation contributes to their higher hypertension risk.

37653058.takeaway: Non-invasive prenatal testing of fetal GCK genotype in pregnancies with maternal GCK-MODY was highly accurate and gave results before the last trimester for most women, which can guide insulin use.

37654560.takeaway: In women with gestational diabetes, an extra-virgin olive oil-enriched diet appeared to prevent placental thickening and glycogen and collagen increases, alongside better maternal insulin resistance.

37654561.takeaway: In peri- and post-pubertal mice, diabetes reduced sperm motility and damaged testicular tissue, and combined diabetes and hyperthyroidism produced conspicuous epididymal damage.

37654562.takeaway: In nine children with Pompe disease on enzyme replacement therapy, precocious puberty was common and linked to shorter predicted adult height, so regular growth and puberty follow-up is advised.

37654565.takeaway: Six unrelated families with autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 1 and two children carried calcium-sensing receptor gain-of-function variants, two of them novel, with similar severity within each variant.

37656596.takeaway: In 681 children with type 1 diabetes in Jordan, 2.6% had subclinical and 4.4% overt hypothyroidism, with female sex and GAD antibodies predicting it, supporting thyroid screening.

37658752.takeaway: In 72 young people with type 1 diabetes in Egypt, a structured five-day onboarding protocol for MiniMed 780G lowered HbA1c from 8.7% to 6.7% and raised time in range to 82%.

37658767.takeaway: In 25 children with central diabetes insipidus, oral desmopressin lyophilisate normalised sodium within about 15 hours and was practical and safe, though some families were readmitted for non-adherence.

37660694.takeaway: A 17-year-old with type 1 diabetes and insulin antibody syndrome had insulin needs fall from 3.3 to 1.4 units/kg/day after seven months of mycophenolate mofetil, without adverse effects.

37664835.takeaway: In pubertal female rats, long-term hormonal and non-hormonal oral contraceptives both impaired bone mineralization and properties, with the hormonal pill causing greater loss of bone strength.

37664841.takeaway: This review proposes that reward and stress pathways link diabetes, obesity and depression in a feedback loop, arguing that lowering HbA1c alone without targeting these pathways is unlikely to be enough.

37664854.takeaway: In US insured children and young adults, those with CAH had about 1.7 to 2.5 times the prevalence of depressive or anxiety disorders and antidepressant prescriptions than peers, suggesting routine screening.

37668604.takeaway: In 25,718 young people with type 1 diabetes in the DPV registry, expected basal insulin patterns differed by age, sex, BMI, HbA1c and sensor use, which the authors say should guide pump basal settings.

37669316.takeaway: In children with GNAS-confirmed pseudohypoparathyroidism type IA followed up to 20 years, early obesity and raised PTH came first, hypocalcaemia about three years later, and adult female height was very short.

37670877.takeaway: In 94 children, biologically active leptin differed between newly diagnosed, poorly controlled and well-controlled type 1 diabetes and healthy controls, suggesting it may mark metabolic status.

37670884.takeaway: In Australian youth with type 1 diabetes, subsidised CGM use was similar across socioeconomic groups except the most disadvantaged, while pump use rose steeply with advantage under the user-pays model.

37672562.takeaway: In 86 pediatric recipients of total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation, a modified endocrine protocol kept median HbA1c at or below 6.5% through three years after surgery.

37672620.takeaway: In Danish transgender people, odds of mental and behavioural disorders stayed elevated for up to eight years compared with matched controls, especially among those assigned male at birth.
