37672642.takeaway: In arteries from infant boys undergoing hypospadias repair, androgens promoted vasorelaxation, unlike healthy controls where sex hormones promoted vasoconstriction, suggesting early androgen exposure shapes vascular function.

37673098.takeaway: Most parents of 280 children with islet autoantibodies had high anxiety about type 1 diabetes, and their perceived risk for their child varied widely, showing how hard risk is to communicate.

37680029.takeaway: This review covers long-term outcomes of 21-hydroxylase deficiency, including mortality, fertility, cardiometabolic disease and bone health, linked to replacement doses, excess androgens and high precursor levels.

37680384.takeaway: A Brazilian girl with hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets with hypercalciuria had compound heterozygous SLC34A3 variants including a novel one, and chlorthalidone improved her hypercalciuria alongside phosphate therapy.

37680884.takeaway: This review summarizes continuous glucose monitoring in pregnancy, noting it reduces hypo- and hyperglycaemia and that higher time in range during pregnancy is linked to better outcomes.

37680890.takeaway: A bibliometric analysis of 20 years of pheochromocytoma publications shows an overall upward trend, with precision medicine, metastatic disease and germline mutations emerging as likely research hotspots.

37690116.takeaway: In 12,350 children from four cohorts, a higher PCOS polygenic risk score was linked to higher childhood BMI, earlier pubarche and earlier peak height velocity, suggesting PCOS genetics act from early life.

37690117.takeaway: In 1,744 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes followed for about five years, uric acid was not consistently linked to rising blood pressure or arterial stiffness, mirroring trials in adults.

37693343.takeaway: In 15 people with type 1 diabetes aged 7 to 65, calibration-free sensors with remote monitoring on automated insulin delivery improved trust and reduced care burden, despite early sensor loss.

37694589.takeaway: In a US inpatient database, pregnant women with chronic hypoparathyroidism had more preterm births, transfusions and neonatal congenital anomalies than those without it.

37694684.takeaway: In a large US cohort, greater waist circumference and adult weight gain were associated with higher-risk thyroid cancer but not with low-risk disease.

37696273.takeaway: An individual-participant meta-analysis found a J-shaped link between free T4 and cardiovascular and all-cause mortality, and low TSH linked to higher mortality, supporting optimal healthy thyroid ranges.

37698163.takeaway: In a large cohort of girls with isolated breast development, principal component analysis of clinical and hormone profiles separated progressive central precocious puberty from premature thelarche with 84% sensitivity and 90% specificity.

37699205.takeaway: In 3,645 Swedish children at type 1 diabetes diagnosis, girls were younger and more often autoantibody-positive, especially GAD antibody-positive, suggesting sex-specific immune mechanisms.

37699386.takeaway: In 53 children and young adults with type 1 diabetes, poorer glucose profile quality, especially glucose fluctuations, predicted slower peripheral nerve conduction velocity.

37700590.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes using CGM, Black participants had higher HbA1c than White participants at similar mean glucose, suggesting a glucose-independent disparity.

37701896.takeaway: Phenotypic features of pubertal onset and progression help distinguish self-limited delayed puberty from congenital hypogonadotrophic hypogonadism in a longitudinal UK cohort.

37701899.takeaway: Cryopreserved immature testicular tissue from prepubertal patients was cultured ex vivo with hormones to test feasibility of in vitro spermatogenesis for fertility preservation.

37703313.takeaway: Sequencing 121 French index cases with idiopathic central precocious puberty found DLK1 variants, and serum DLK1 levels were examined as a possible marker.

37703317.takeaway: In 32 transgender adolescents, early puberty suppression and gender-affirming hormones did not alter final adult height.

37703843.takeaway: The GloBE-Reg growth hormone study group proposed a minimum dataset of measurements for monitoring children on recombinant growth hormone in routine care.

37703865.takeaway: Whole-exome sequencing of 328 Chinese patients with congenital hypothyroidism identified TPO variants, and functional assays assessed five novel variants.

37705267.takeaway: Summarizes the 2023 AAP guideline on evaluating and treating children and adolescents with obesity and discusses its implications for India.

37708074.takeaway: In a US Turner syndrome clinic cohort, serum AMH was described and correlated with spontaneous puberty and karyotype.

37708901.takeaway: Early-onset type 2 diabetes, diagnosed in childhood or early adulthood, is rising and carries excess risk of complications, cardiovascular events and earlier death.

37710956.takeaway: In a 7-year-old boy with cystic fibrosis, CGM detected dysglycemia missed by OGTT, and high-dose acarbose was used as treatment.

37713609.takeaway: Among 119 members of 15 Belgian families with a RET founder variant linked to medullary thyroid carcinoma, clinical phenotype and age-dependent penetrance were studied.

37715964.takeaway: This systematic review synthesizes studies of fetal, neonatal and childhood side effects of antenatal prednisolone and dexamethasone to inform benefit-risk decisions.

37720532.takeaway: Among 1,029 Chinese children with obesity before late puberty, 214 with fatty liver disease were compared with 815 without to assess known risk factors.

37720538.takeaway: Describes a Turner syndrome transition clinic in the West of Scotland and its aim of sustaining follow-up after transfer to adult endocrine services.

37720539.takeaway: Over 16 years, ovarian tissue cryopreservation in two pediatric units was reviewed for indications, results and outcomes in children facing gonadotoxic treatment.

37722360.takeaway: In 306 childhood cancer survivors exposed to radiotherapy, thyroid ultrasound surveillance was used to detect nodules and differentiated thyroid cancer, with risk related to age at radiotherapy.

37723940.takeaway: Letter argues sex steroid priming should be used in peripubertal GH stimulation testing to assess pubertal GH production, while noting little data on treatment response.

37725148.takeaway: Repeated biotinidase activity measurements in 110 patients were compared with BTD genotype to refine the genotype-phenotype relationship.

37725202.takeaway: Adolescents with type 1 diabetes were compared with healthy controls for depression, anxiety, eating problems and risk of diabetes-specific eating disorder.

37725835.takeaway: Ten individuals with congenital hyperinsulinism from eight activating GCK mutations, six novel, had variable phenotypes, and mutant enzymes were characterised in vitro.

37725936.takeaway: A 13-year-old boy with short stature and low IGF-1 carried a novel de novo heterozygous GHR splicing variant, supporting a genotype-phenotype continuum of mild GH insensitivity.

37725952.takeaway: In adolescent Japanese macaques, a maternal Western-style diet reduced skeletal muscle respiration and shifted lipid profiles toward insulin-resistance-associated species.

37728028.takeaway: CYP21A2 sequencing of newborn bloodspots in Australian children with 21-hydroxylase CAH matched genotype to phenotype in 36 of 44 cases.

37732157.takeaway: A survey of pediatric endocrine providers found that state bans on youth gender-affirming care may reduce access to qualified providers in affected states.

37735929.takeaway: In 58 girls re-evaluated in late adolescence after GnRH agonist treatment, BMI was not adversely affected, PCOS was not more frequent, and AMH matched controls.

37743516.takeaway: In 399 Indian children and youth with type 1 diabetes, pubertal disorders were uncommon despite suboptimal glycemic control, with puberty onset and sex steroids assessed.

37743662.takeaway: In an 8-year-old boy with central diabetes insipidus, a positive anti-rabphilin-3A antibody and MRI course supported a diagnosis of lymphocytic infundibuloneurohypophysitis without biopsy.

37745698.takeaway: In a premature girl with genetically confirmed MIRAGE syndrome, early diagnosis of adrenal crisis and hormone replacement were lifesaving, though diarrhea and developmental delay persisted.

37745704.takeaway: Among 2,628 adults in Qinghai Province, thyroid disease prevalence was compared across iodine nutrition status to inform salt iodization policy.

37745723.takeaway: Circulating metabolites differed between autoantibody-positive children who progressed rapidly and slowly to type 1 diabetes, suggesting a distinct metabolic profile linked to progression.

37747085.takeaway: In transmasculine adolescents on testosterone, most expected physical changes appeared in the first year, though not for all, underscoring the need for counseling.

37748128.takeaway: In 462,692 US solid organ transplant recipients aged 18 or older, pretransplant type 2 diabetes was independently linked to higher posttransplant mortality, most strongly in kidney transplant.

37748459.takeaway: A 6-hour training improved knowledge and reduced genderism and heteronormative attitudes among 96 Italian family pediatricians, and these gains held at follow-up.

37749899.takeaway: Among 363 children aged 2 to 9 at well-child visits, dyslipidemia occurred in about one-third and triglycerides rose with BMI z-score, supporting universal lipid screening.

37750208.takeaway: In preterm infants with transient hypothyroxinemia, levothyroxine was linked to more BPD and ROP but did not improve long-term neurodevelopment in this small study.

37750394.takeaway: Urinary gonadotropins and testosterone were measured longitudinally in term and preterm boys, characterizing postnatal HPG axis activation (minipuberty) across birth-weight and gestational subgroups.

37750395.takeaway: SHOX variants were analysed in 54 North Indian children with idiopathic short stature and pooled with Asian case reports to estimate their prevalence.

37751153.takeaway: In simulated scenarios with 30 parents and 30 school workers, nasal glucagon was administered more successfully and was more acceptable than injectable glucagon.

37752373.takeaway: Expert opinion on diagnosing childhood hypophosphatasia: persistently low, age- and sex-interpreted TNSALP activity, repeated measurements, and molecular testing to confirm.

37756535.takeaway: Meta-analysis of six cohorts found 537 associations between dietary glycemic index or load and blood DNA methylation in children and adolescents, mainly those with overweight or obesity.

37766689.takeaway: This review summarizes Mendelian randomization studies of age at natural menopause, noting inconsistent results across studies due to differing genetic instruments.

37768677.takeaway: Across over 48,000 people with type 1 diabetes in the T1D Exchange QI Collaborative (2016-2022), HbA1c improved overall, but gains were uneven by race, ethnicity and insurance.

37768904.takeaway: A systematic review of CYP24A1-related infantile hypercalcemia summarizes its clinical heterogeneity and treatment options, calling for targeted diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

37772077.takeaway: A young woman whose secondary amenorrhea went undiagnosed for 10 years illustrates a proposed global digital women's health initiative to study the condition.

37772083.takeaway: In 5,316 singleton frozen-thawed embryo transfer deliveries, hormone replacement cycles were linked to more hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and cesarean delivery, especially in young women.

37772429.takeaway: In 30 healthy children followed longitudinally, nocturnal urinary LH indicated central puberty onset at similar ages in boys and girls, while clinical signs lagged longer in boys.

37780631.takeaway: In 119 children with type 1 diabetes followed for six years, BMI Z-score rose after the honeymoon period ended, and daily insulin requirement was similar across groups at year six.

37782139.takeaway: A 12-week randomized trial compared intermittently scanned CGM with capillary glucose monitoring for HbA1c change in 100 children with type 1 diabetes and elevated HbA1c.

37782145.takeaway: In 160 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, MiniMed advanced hybrid closed-loop use was safe, lowered A1C and increased time in range.

37782353.takeaway: Oral AG019, a genetically modified bacterial immunotherapy, was tested alone and with teplizumab in recent-onset type 1 diabetes, and preliminary data support further study.

37782847.takeaway: In pregnancies with preexisting type 1 or 2 diabetes using CGM, most metrics were linked to neonatal morbidity, and an optimal time in range of 66-71% supports the 70% target.

37782904.takeaway: In the prospective CLIO real-world study, severe hypoglycemia and DKA rates with Control-IQ were lower than historical data in both adults and children.

37788389.takeaway: A novel IGAm index predicted long-term survival in 94 patients with early-diagnosed inherited metabolic disorders, with high index scores linked to higher mortality.

37788646.takeaway: Over six months, subcutaneous and intramuscular testosterone gave similar biochemical and clinical effects in transgender adolescents, who valued both options as safe and effective.

37788658.takeaway: In individuals with Turner syndrome, HbA1c and fasting glucose were compared with 2-hour OGTT results to identify optimal diabetes screening cut points.

37790607.takeaway: This review proposes that exercise during periods of hormone-driven bone stiffening, such as adolescence or teriparatide therapy, can optimize bone strength and reduce fragility.

37791580.takeaway: In Turkish children with glycogen storage disease type 1b and a novel mutation, neutropenia drove complications, and empagliflozin helped neutropenia resistant to G-CSF.

37791799.takeaway: A toddler on a ketogenic diet had hypercalcemia that persisted for two months after stopping it, mimicking hypophosphatasia; alkaline phosphatase normalization tracked recovery.

37793366.takeaway: In children with obesity, lower vitamin D was linked to more severe hepatosteatosis, but six months of vitamin D treatment did not improve steatosis on ultrasound.

37795192.takeaway: In a birth cohort, moderate to severe maternal anemia through pregnancy was linked to higher cord blood FGF-21, while malaria in the last trimester was linked to lower levels.

37795368.takeaway: A systematic review and meta-analysis of differentiated thyroid cancer in patients aged 0-19 years aims to estimate global incidence and calls for standardized registry data.

37795793.takeaway: Among 112 patients with inborn errors of amino acid metabolism on long-term nutrition therapy, the authors conclude malnutrition can be prevented with anthropometric and biochemical monitoring under a dietary protocol.

37795843.takeaway: Diurnal cortisol rhythms were preserved in extremely and very preterm children born appropriate for gestational age, with no concentration differences from full-term children.

37795854.takeaway: In children with inflammatory bowel disease treated with growth hormone for at least a year, height z-scores improved after one year and at completion of therapy.

37798422.takeaway: HNF1A-MODY prevalence was about 0.3% in Norwegian paediatric diabetes, and combining clinical phenotyping with functional studies improved diagnostic precision.

37798892.takeaway: This narrative review discusses the etiologies of hypoparathyroidism in children and adolescents.

37798893.takeaway: The 2022 Korean guideline for central precocious puberty gives 27 graded recommendations across screening, diagnosis, treatment and long-term outcome.

37798894.takeaway: Pituitary MRI abnormalities were common in newly diagnosed central precocious puberty, but true pathological findings were rare, so routine MRI should be weighed against cost.

37798895.takeaway: Pooled analysis of nine studies favored carbohydrate counting for HbA1c reduction in children with type 1 diabetes, though heterogeneity was high (I² 88%).

37798896.takeaway: In Spanish children, new-onset type 1 diabetes during the COVID-19 lockdown was associated with delayed diagnosis and greater severity at presentation.

37798897.takeaway: A Korean boy with a novel THRβ variant, first diagnosed with congenital hypothyroidism, had thyroid hormone resistance with poor weight gain and short stature over four years.

37800136.takeaway: In adults with Prader-Willi syndrome compared with matched adults with obesity or normal weight, spinal posture and mobility differed, supporting musculoskeletal assessment.

37801647.takeaway: Paediatric ectopic ACTH syndrome differs in aetiology from adults, with bronchial neuroendocrine tumours having the best survival, while distant metastasis and tumour size predicted poor survival.

37810886.takeaway: In 199 mother-infant pairs, cord blood vitamin A and E levels were associated with birth weight, suggesting relevance to fetal growth and later metabolic disease.

37810892.takeaway: A bibliometric analysis of 2012-2022 CGM literature in diabetes identifies research trends and expects future focus on young adults and time in range.

37811866.takeaway: Meeting report summarizing the 2023 NIH Fifth Artificial Pancreas Workshop discussions on full automation, access and adoption of closed-loop systems.

37812927.takeaway: In 788 euthyroid children with overweight or obesity, mildly reduced eGFR was associated with reduced thyroid hormone sensitivity indices, a preliminary finding needing prospective confirmation.

37814597.takeaway: Assessing the hypothalamic-pituitary-testicular axis in boys requires knowledge of its developmental physiology from fetal life through puberty to reach accurate diagnoses.

37814958.takeaway: In a national multicenter retrospective series of children with Cushing's disease, presenting complaints were subtle, MRI missed about one-third of adenomas, and recurrence after surgery occurred.

37815796.takeaway: A Banting lecture account of the author's KATP channel work explains how metabolic signals regulate glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, with reduced exocytosis and electrical activity contributing to reduced secretion in disease.

37818403.takeaway: Model-based analysis of 210 children with GH deficiency treated with once-weekly somapacitan gives expected weekly IGF-I concentrations and shows flexibility in dosing days.

37820012.takeaway: A real-world service evaluation found home waking salivary cortisone to be an effective, practical screening test for adrenal insufficiency and identified implementation barriers.

37820735.takeaway: Italy's voluntary iodine prophylaxis program reached iodine sufficiency in a nationwide sample of 164,593 adults over 2015-2019, though iodine status in pregnancy remains a concern.

37820740.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 488 Asian children with severe early-onset obesity identified MC3R and MC4R variants, two of which may predispose to obesity on functional testing.

37820744.takeaway: In 77 healthy adolescents, the COVID-19 lockdown had a negative effect on metabolic and inflammatory profiles, which the authors suggest may harm long-term health.

37822600.takeaway: In children aged 0-16 with hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia, real-time CGM was feasible with clinically acceptable accuracy, especially when hypoglycaemic, and improved quality of life.

37823890.takeaway: Among 20 youth with type 1 diabetes and HbA1c of 8.5% or higher, switching from injections to advanced hybrid closed loop was associated with sustained glycemic and psychosocial improvement at 12 months.

37837607.takeaway: Loss-of-function GNAS variants correlated with round faces and subcutaneous ossifications in pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1a, according to a systematic review.

37837608.takeaway: In a nationwide Dutch cohort of 2,338 childhood cancer survivors, overweight occurred in almost half, with no overall increase compared with controls.

37837609.takeaway: In male patients with CAH, diagnosis more than one year after birth was associated with a higher risk of testicular adrenal rest tumors than diagnosis within one month.

37839403.takeaway: In children with Prader-Willi syndrome, the acylated-to-unacylated ghrelin ratio rose during the shift from failure to thrive to weight gain, before hyperphagia began.

37841954.takeaway: Over seven years in a pediatric prediabetes clinic, 6.5% of patients progressed to type 2 diabetes, and initial laboratory values and weight trajectory helped stratify risk.

37843393.takeaway: In 79 glucocorticoid-treated children with vertebral fractures, higher steroid exposure, greater deformity burden, severe or lumbar fractures predicted persistent vertebral deformity.

37844212.takeaway: Among U.S. adults with diagnosed diabetes from 2008 to 2020, receipt of ADA-recommended preventive services did not improve, except for influenza vaccination.

37844258.takeaway: Greulich-Pyle bone age assessment showed excellent inter- and intra-observer reliability in 180 Turkish children, though discrepancies may occur during the peripubertal period.

37844556.takeaway: Angelman syndrome patients showed growth deceleration and reduced final height, lowest in the deletion subgroup, and the authors propose adding short stature to diagnostic criteria.

37846485.takeaway: Among 198 adolescents with type 1 diabetes and at least moderate distress, CGM use was associated with lower HbA1c and diabetes distress but not with family conflict or quality of life.

37846755.takeaway: An international survey found diabetes providers aware of skin reactions from technological devices, but unmet needs remain in management and knowledge.

37847107.takeaway: Among nine members of a kindred with a PTPN11 variant, the two individuals with homozygous inheritance had more severe clinical features of Noonan syndrome.

37847108.takeaway: In prepubertal children born SGA with catch-up growth, lower GLP-1 concentrations were associated with abnormal glucose metabolism, possibly reflecting impaired intestinal L-cell function.

37850094.takeaway: In 70 children aged 4 to 18, serum TMAO was linked to obesity, arterial stiffness and subclinical atherosclerosis, according to the authors.

37850096.takeaway: This review describes how liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry has improved newborn screening for congenital adrenal hyperplasia and outlines future developments.

37850343.takeaway: In 455 children aged 0.1-18 years, the HARP study provides LMS-based reference percentiles for seven phosphate homeostasis laboratory parameters to support z-score interpretation.

37850941.takeaway: Two years of Omnipod 5 automated insulin delivery in a single-arm multicenter trial maintained glycemic improvements safely in children, adolescents and adults with type 1 diabetes.

37852007.takeaway: In 140 racial-ethnic minority children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, technology users had better glycemic control than non-users.

37854179.takeaway: In female rats, 28-day exposure to two endocrine disruptors starting at weaning versus adulthood showed different sensitivity, with weaning start better for estrogenic effects.

37854192.takeaway: In whiteflies, bursicon, its partner and the rickets receptor regulate vitellogenesis and female reproduction, coordinating with juvenile hormone signaling.

37855273.takeaway: A 10-month-old girl with a novel homozygous ADCY3 variant had severe early-onset obesity, and the case illustrates challenges in follow-up and treatment.

37855389.takeaway: Adults born SGA who received childhood GH showed no increased cerebrovascular abnormalities on MRI 12 years after stopping therapy, compared with matched controls.

37859522.takeaway: Children born to mothers with subclinical hypothyroidism had slightly lower neuropsychological scores at 6 months to 2 years than those born to mothers with overt hypothyroidism.

37859607.takeaway: Patients with osteogenesis imperfecta and cardiovascular signs had worse carotid intima-media thickness and flow-mediated dilation than healthy controls, supporting early screening.

37859980.takeaway: The WFS1 miR-668 binding-site variant rs1046322 was associated with obesity and higher triglycerides in Southeast Asians, suggesting a role for WFS1 in obesity.

37859982.takeaway: Among 95 children and adolescents with obesity, the prevalence of sarcopenic obesity varied by diagnostic criteria, highlighting the need for a consensus definition.

37859988.takeaway: This review presents copeptin as a stable surrogate for vasopressin and its use in separating vasopressin deficiency and resistance from primary polydipsia, with pediatric and SIADH data still needed.

37859990.takeaway: A 16-year-old girl with genetically confirmed Goltz-Gorlin syndrome had papillary thyroid carcinoma, and the authors hypothesize PORCN variants may increase tumor susceptibility.

37859991.takeaway: This review summarizes how female sex hormones influence B-cell activation in systemic lupus erythematosus and its impact on pregnancy loss.

37860221.takeaway: In 32 patients with X-linked hypophosphatemia aged 2 to 60, lipocalin-2 was not linked to obesity risk, while children had lower circulating leptin.

37861431.takeaway: In Finland, reduced rotavirus exposure after the 2009 vaccine rollout was associated with lower type 1 diabetes incidence in children under five.

37862468.takeaway: Among 714 patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency CAH, injuries and accidents were more common than in 71,400 matched controls, especially in females and those born before neonatal screening.

37864354.takeaway: In preterm and ill neonates, handheld glucose monitor readings from arterial blood were reliable, but capillary results often fell outside tolerance, so capillary hypoglycemia readings need caution.

37867270.takeaway: An Arabic association consensus sorts people with diabetes who plan to fast in Ramadan into four risk categories, based on comorbidities, complications, fasting hours and socioeconomic factors.

37867506.takeaway: In 170 Saudi patients with differentiated thyroid cancer aged 18 or younger, young age, lymph node disease, extrathyroidal extension and elevated postoperative sTg predicted distant metastasis.

37870650.takeaway: A novel Gcg-Timer reporter mouse reveals spatial and transcriptional heterogeneity in alpha cell neogenesis, improving understanding of islet cell identity and plasticity.

37870651.takeaway: In a nationwide New Zealand birth cohort, type 1 diabetes was associated with lower educational outcomes spanning secondary school and university enrolment.

37870826.takeaway: In adolescents with obesity but without diabetes, primary insulin hypersecretors had altered adipose distribution, cellularity and lipid dynamics, independent of adiposity and insulin resistance.

37873499.takeaway: Among 133 girls with rapidly progressive central precocious puberty, incidence was 1.3-fold higher during COVID-19 than in prior years, with a trend toward higher BMI score.

37876543.takeaway: Gene ontology and pathway enrichment of mutated genes in Chinese children with hyperthyroidism points to hormone activity and thyroid hormone signaling pathways.

37876544.takeaway: A pharmacist-led medication management intervention in 81 preterm infants improved iron supplementation adherence and clinical outcomes, with higher developmental index scores.

37876547.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests rheumatoid, ankylosing and psoriatic arthritis raise risk of scleral, corneal and iris disorders, and those disorders raise juvenile idiopathic arthritis risk.

37877373.takeaway: The PCSK1 N221D variant was highly prevalent among 1,066 children with obesity and varied by ethnicity, and insulin-based resistance estimates may underestimate type 2 diabetes risk.

37878891.takeaway: Individual participant data from prospective cohorts suggest routine gestational free or total T3 measurement adds little value for assessing risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes.

37878899.takeaway: A five-day high-dose dexamethasone course in children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia significantly raised leptin, hunger and fat mass, suggesting possible acute leptin resistance.

37878959.takeaway: Deletions of ZNRF3 exon 2 were found in patients with childhood-onset primary adrenal insufficiency and linked to adrenal hypoplasia, with attenuated Wnt/β-catenin signaling in vitro.

37878964.takeaway: In a national survey dataset, cardiovascular and bone health care use did not differ significantly between levothyroxine and desiccated thyroid or LT4+LT3 users after covariate balancing.

37881494.takeaway: In 101 patients with childhood-onset GH deficiency re-tested after adult height, height below -3 SDS at diagnosis and pituitary MRI abnormalities indicated high risk of persistent GHD.

37881498.takeaway: A systematic review finds scarce offspring safety data for GLP-1 agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors in pregnancy and lactation, mostly from animal studies, supporting ongoing registries.

37881846.takeaway: In pancreatic tissue from organ donors, fibrosis differed by diabetes type: periductal and perivascular in type 1 diabetes, lobular and parenchymal in type 2 diabetes.

37883713.takeaway: In 77 pregnant women with subclinical hypothyroidism, offspring developmental differences appeared at a lower TSH cutoff, with a possible sex effect, underlining the need to define pregnancy thyroid normality.

37886638.takeaway: Describes the development, implementation and content of a workshop preparing young adults with diabetes, and their parents, for college, the workforce and adult diabetes care.

37886643.takeaway: In a 15-year-old girl with a fifth cystic progression of craniopharyngioma, biweekly intravenous tocilizumab stabilized the cyst for a prolonged period.

37886644.takeaway: This review of SGMS2-related bone disease describes sphingomyelin metabolism and proposes how a disrupted sphingomyelin gradient might impair bone formation.

37886647.takeaway: Pooled data from six studies of 1,428 patients estimated vitamin D insufficiency at 36% and deficiency at 41% in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.

37886648.takeaway: Proteomic profiling of plasma exosomes in children with type 1 diabetes altered proteins including RAB40A, SEMA6D, COL6A5 and TTR, proposed as possible therapeutic targets.

37888829.takeaway: Among 1,182 women with hyperglycemia in pregnancy, 7.4% had positive GADA, which was not linked to adverse outcomes except a lower cesarean delivery risk.

37889845.takeaway: TSH testing rates among commercially insured U.S. adults without known thyroid disease were stable from 2006 to 2020, and higher in women and with increasing age.

37897565.takeaway: In a consanguineous Kurdistani paediatric diabetes cohort, subtype and genetic spectrum were characterized, and syndromic diagnostic criteria may need short stature and hepatosplenomegaly.

37899273.takeaway: Caregivers of children with thyroid disorders had poor knowledge related to education level, highlighting the need for clear communication and adherence support.

37899276.takeaway: This review explains that intracranial germ cell tumors and their treatment often cause neuroendocrine dysfunction that is overlooked, requiring endocrine evaluation throughout the disease course.

37900135.takeaway: In mice, KU80 was not required to maintain the ovarian reserve, follicle development, ovulation with maternal ageing, or repair of induced DNA breaks in primordial-follicle oocytes.

37900142.takeaway: Among 152 Brazilian patients with type 1 diabetes, consistent dietary adherence was associated with good glycemic control after adjusting for sociodemographic and ancestry factors.

37900144.takeaway: In adolescent male rats, anandamide and kisspeptin-10 modulated hypothalamic and testicular reproductive signaling, with CB1 receptor involvement and possible effects on spermatogenesis.

37900147.takeaway: In a Wolfram syndrome rat model, long-term dual GLP-1 and GIP agonist treatment begun after symptom onset had therapeutic effects, which the authors interpret as reversal of progression.

37902743.takeaway: Among 854 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, most had time in tight range below 50%, except hybrid closed loop users, with HbA1c a significant predictor.

37902969.takeaway: In 57 high-risk pregnant women with type 2 diabetes, CGM metrics were linked to large-for-gestational-age births early in pregnancy and to neonatal hypoglycemia throughout.

37902975.takeaway: The ADA statement gives best-practice guidance and responsibilities for parents, childcare staff and clinicians caring for children under five with diabetes in childcare.

37906202.takeaway: In an EHR-based study, rural residence was a meaningful barrier to CGM use among children with type 1 diabetes.

37906994.takeaway: A patient with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A and a novel GNAS frameshift had venous thrombosis, and vascular calcifications resolved with acetazolamide treatment.

37908748.takeaway: In a national Czech pediatric registry, three hybrid closed-loop systems all maintained recommended long-term control, with the lowest Glycemia Risk Index among MiniMed 780G users.

37915243.takeaway: An IT-supported quality improvement project standardized hydrocortisone stress dosing documentation for children with adrenal insufficiency, with meaningful improvement in compliance.

37916152.takeaway: Cardiac mitochondrial respiration differed by sex in patients with aortic stenosis, and estradiol affected mitochondrial function in mouse hearts, suggesting sex hormones may contribute.

37920250.takeaway: Two male siblings with osteosclerotic metaphyseal dysplasia from a novel LRRK1 variant had jaw osteonecrosis and optic nerve involvement, raising whether LRRK1 belongs in osteopetrosis panels.

37922013.takeaway: Six weeks of oral magnesium did not improve insulin sensitivity compared with placebo in insulin-treated adults with type 2 diabetes and low serum magnesium.

37922335.takeaway: In real-world data from adolescents with type 1 diabetes, event-level factors helped predict the size of glucose drop during physical activity, informing self-management tools.

37925743.takeaway: In 13 patients with myopathic carnitine palmitoyltransferase II deficiency, rhabdomyolysis occurred without typical acylcarnitine elevation, so CPT2 gene analysis should be performed.

37929017.takeaway: Four youths with type 1 diabetes had insulin hypersensitivity reactions, ranging from urticaria to anaphylaxis, and treatment approaches showed limited success.

37929021.takeaway: In Kuwaiti adolescents, CYP2R1 and GC gene variants were associated with plasma 25(OH)D levels and lower odds of vitamin D deficiency, partly explaining its high prevalence.

37929024.takeaway: This narrative review summarizes endocrine and metabolic complications of perinatal asphyxia and hypothermia treatment, suggesting screening protocols and timely treatment.

37929230.takeaway: A national survey found pediatric type 1 diabetes providers value school-based diabetes care, but practice and policy barriers hinder collaboration between schools and health teams.

37929231.takeaway: In 217 children aged 7 to 12 with type 1 diabetes, glycemic metrics improved during school hours, possibly due to school routines, though time in range was higher on weekends and virtual school days.

37929232.takeaway: Among Pennsylvania school nurses, the Diabetes Device Confidence Scale correlated with prior training and experience, supporting its convergent validity.

37930757.takeaway: In a randomized phase 3 trial, add-on dasiglucagon infusion reduced CGM-recorded hypoglycemia in children with congenital hyperinsulinism and was well tolerated, though skin and GI events were more frequent.

37931151.takeaway: Nearly a quarter of 169 Indian children with islet antibody-negative type 1 diabetes carried recessive WFS1 mutations without other Wolfram features at diagnosis.

37931637.takeaway: Across 21 disease-modifying trials in new-onset type 1 diabetes involving 2,711 people, HbA1c improvement tracked C-peptide preservation, supporting C-peptide as a surrogate endpoint.

37933636.takeaway: In adults with Turner syndrome who reached adult estrogen dosing, uterine size and volume were larger than in women without Turner, suggesting current dosing allows normal uterine growth.

37934957.takeaway: In Finnish children with type 1 diabetes, the DRB1*04:04 allele was more frequent among 57 DQB1*06:02-positive cases, which may reflect preferential presentation of islet epitopes.

37937054.takeaway: In 111 patients with autoimmune polyglandular syndrome type 4, half developed the syndrome within ten years, and 5% of women had premature ovarian failure.

37937589.takeaway: A survey of adults with type 1 diabetes and caregivers in five European countries found mostly positive views of new technologies, though more device and digital tool education is needed.

37937903.takeaway: In 99 subjects with normal ACTH test results, ACTH stimulation was associated with changes in ischemia-modified albumin, suggesting a possible direct, dose-dependent effect.

37939726.takeaway: In 138 Chinese infants with neonatal cholestasis from citrin deficiency, high citrulline, tyrosine, bilirubin, ammonia and low albumin predicted severe liver damage.

37942631.takeaway: Overweight children aged 7 to 18 with reflux symptoms had lower health-related quality-of-life scores than normal-weight children without them.

37942886.takeaway: Three family members with the same germline RET S891A mutation had different medullary thyroid cancer features, and sorafenib was successful for advanced disease over seven years.

37942887.takeaway: An adolescent boy with ectopic ACTH syndrome from an atypical bronchial carcinoid was treated with surgery, chemotherapy and radiotherapy; the authors note such carcinoids are more aggressive.

37946401.takeaway: In 42 healthy relatives of people with type 1 diabetes, a linear SVM model using one-week home CGM data classified high- versus low-risk individuals with an AUC of 0.88.

37946439.takeaway: Pituitary volume did not differ significantly by GH deficiency severity but may predict growth response to one year of GH treatment in short children.

37948469.takeaway: In a multicenter prospective real-world study, two advanced hybrid closed-loop systems improved glucose control and patient-reported outcomes, with no difference between them.

37952170.takeaway: CGM in 11 children with classical CAH showed a disrupted daily glucose pattern, with more time in hypoglycemia linked to lower cortisol levels.

37952514.takeaway: In 40 adolescents with PCOS and obesity, both diets improved anthropometry, but the RESMENA diet additionally improved insulin resistance and androgen levels.

37955005.takeaway: Physicians from a somatrogon phase 3 study preferred once-weekly somatrogon over once-daily rhGH, citing fewer injections, less caregiver burden and better adherence.

37955644.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes, DKA at diagnosis was associated with persistently higher HbA1c over the first year, even with intensive management and CGM.

37955862.takeaway: In 589 Norwegian adolescents followed from age 16 to 18, vitamin D deficiency was prevalent, and more UV exposure or hormonal contraceptive use raised 25(OH)D levels.

37956265.takeaway: In 13 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes using the MiniMed 780G, glucose targets were reached only overnight, and maternal and neonatal complications remained high.

37956658.takeaway: A child with ERC1::RET-positive papillary thyroid carcinoma developed radiation-induced lung injury with fibrosis after radioactive iodine therapy.

37964596.takeaway: This review covers adolescent hormonal changes in congenital adrenal hyperplasia, the need to balance glucocorticoid dosing against androgen excess and cardiometabolic risk, and transition care.

37964632.takeaway: Patients with late hypothyroidism after radioiodine for Graves' disease who had insufficient information before deciding had more decision regret, supporting fuller shared decision-making.

37964948.takeaway: A man with Kallmann syndrome developed multiple prolactinomas after testosterone treatment, which the authors suggest reflects increased susceptibility, though the CASR variant's role is unclear.

37964960.takeaway: Among insulin-treated diabetes patients in Madinah, Saudi Arabia, hypoglycemia unawareness affected 48.9%, with poor diabetes knowledge a major risk factor.

37964965.takeaway: In vitamin D-deficient children on GnRH agonist therapy, monthly 25,000 IU vitamin D3 corrected deficiency more often than daily 1,000 IU, with no hypercalcemia in either group.

37964971.takeaway: In overweight and obese prepubertal children, an abnormal amino acid profile with raised ALT and uric acid may signal early metabolic disturbance.

37966142.takeaway: Among 300 children (100 obese with diabetes, 100 obese without, 100 healthy), microRNA-29a and microRNA-122 expression and inflammatory markers were measured, suggesting possible roles in obesity-related disease.

37967247.takeaway: In 22 African American youth with type 2 diabetes, metformin with or without liraglutide improved glycemia but did not suppress high rates of gluconeogenesis.

37971952.takeaway: In prospective cohorts of Hispanic youth and young adults, postprandial metabolite profiles improved prediction of prediabetes beyond traditional risk factors, with medium-chain fatty acids as early indicators.

37972573.takeaway: In a case-control study of 122 children, higher urinary bisphenol A was associated with obesity risk in girls, though causality remains unclear.

37975727.takeaway: In 28 Chinese girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, 3-month leuprorelin slowed or reversed pubertal development and was effective and safe, with one local intolerance.

37978828.takeaway: Untargeted metabolomics in pubertal girls with higher body fat found no insulin resistance signature explaining higher androgens, instead pointing to raffinose and bile acid pathways.

37979187.takeaway: An 8-year-old boy with alpha-mannosidosis, first thought to have celiac disease, showed novel ultrastructural bone marrow findings, the first reported in humans.

37988593.takeaway: CGM in children with congenital hyperinsulinism detected hypoglycemia during periods without routine point-of-care testing and led to medication dose adjustments in 30% of children.

37991411.takeaway: In 93 healthy short children undergoing GH stimulation tests, very high copeptin occurred in 9%, possibly from phlebotomy pain or stress, which should be recognized when interpreting values.

37992692.takeaway: Children with classic CAH missed on Indiana newborn screening showed no features that would have prompted earlier detection, so clinicians should keep a high index of suspicion.

37997458.takeaway: A systematic review comparing national and regional guidelines on neonatal hypoglycemia found management and pharmacotherapy recommendations simple and sketchy.

37997801.takeaway: This review draws on adults with congenital hypogonadism to highlight diagnostic delays and the limits of historic pubertal induction protocols.

38006605.takeaway: A 20-year-old man with Sturge-Weber syndrome had hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, GH deficiency and central hypothyroidism despite normal pituitary imaging, emphasizing endocrine evaluation.

38008082.takeaway: In an infant with McCune-Albright syndrome and hypercortisolism, metyrapone given as suppositories was tolerated and produced clinical and biochemical improvement.

38008794.takeaway: In 179 Indian girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty treated with GnRH analogues, most reached adult height within target range, above predicted height at treatment start.

38008926.takeaway: In 84 children on growth hormone, 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure showed lower daytime diastolic pressure than controls, and the authors conclude GH is safe regarding hypertension.

38009210.takeaway: In a population-based Israeli cohort, neonatal thyroid function was affected by maternal Graves' disease only when active in pregnancy, and maternal Graves' was linked to adverse dyad outcomes.

38010533.takeaway: In a pilot of adults with type 1 diabetes and impaired hypoglycaemia awareness, four weeks of high-intensity interval training was studied for sustained counterregulatory responses, with possible improvement in glucagon response.

38011519.takeaway: A meta-analysis of outpatient randomized trials found automated insulin delivery more effective than conventional insulin therapy in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, in both short and long term.

38011520.takeaway: Using disaggregated race and ethnicity data from over 3.4 million U.S. adults, type 2 diabetes risk factors and uninsurance varied widely, with 11.4% to 33.0% uninsured across Hispanic subgroups.

38011841.takeaway: A boy with a TXNRD2 variant had selective glucocorticoid deficiency from age 10, along with micropenis and undescended testis, extending the phenotype of this gene.

38015567.takeaway: In a multicentre cohort of pediatric thyroid carcinoma in Abu Dhabi, incidence and histology mirrored international patterns, with lower extrathyroidal extension, metastasis and recurrence rates.

38016434.takeaway: In children with CAH, corrected final height was lower with severe CYP21A2 genotypes, and adding low-dose prednisolone to hydrocortisone was linked to shorter height and higher BMI at equal total glucocorticoid dose.

38018388.takeaway: In 171 Chinese short pubertal boys, letrozole plus rhGH slowed bone age advancement more than rhGH alone and achieved a higher final adult height.

38024650.takeaway: This mini-review describes Van Wyk-Grumbach syndrome, where severe hypothyroidism causes incomplete precocious puberty that responds to levothyroxine, warning against unnecessary tests.

38027095.takeaway: Two neonates with DGUOK-related mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome presented with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, and rapid genetic testing changed management.

38027106.takeaway: In adolescents with obesity, weekly exenatide maintained endogenous total GLP-1 levels and lowered circulating DPP-4 during an oral glucose test, supporting its use in pediatric obesity.

38027114.takeaway: This review argues that current diabetes diagnostic thresholds and HbA1c have limitations for detecting type 2 diabetes risk early, especially in youth, and calls for better criteria.

38027123.takeaway: In a retrospective 6-year series from one endocrine surgery unit, surgery was the first-line option for parathyroid carcinoma, and early identification of high-risk patients was recommended.

38027126.takeaway: In 500 women with gestational diabetes and 502 controls in China, GLO1 rs1130534 was associated with higher GDM susceptibility, while rs4746 was associated with lower risk.

38027128.takeaway: A patient survey found thyroid eye disease affects quality of life across all disease phases and persists long after active inflammation subsides.

38027138.takeaway: In 7,606 frozen blastocyst transfer cycles, high-quality D5 and D6 expanded blastocysts gave similar outcomes, with D5 preferred for low-quality blastocysts.

38027144.takeaway: This review explains that AMH, produced by granulosa cells, reflects follicle cohort dynamics across life and is elevated in PCOS, beyond its use as an ovarian reserve marker.

38027153.takeaway: In Xiphophorus fish, dimerization of mutant and wild-type MC4R receptors reduces signaling and underlies the polymorphism in puberty onset and body size.

38027174.takeaway: In a long-term follow-up of children with excess weight, the benefit of a 12-month weight-loss program on BMI SDS was largest for younger children, especially girls who entered at age 6.

38027180.takeaway: In 75 children followed from birth to age 7, circulating exosomes decreased slightly in size and increased in number, and exosome size was associated with liver fat.

38027181.takeaway: In rats, a short-term high-fat diet altered testicular activity and blood-testis barrier integrity through SIRT1, NRF2 and MAPK signaling pathways.

38027190.takeaway: In 5,365 Shanghai children aged 6 to 9, tri-ponderal mass index agreed well with BMI z-score for identifying obesity, supporting its use as a screening tool.

38027197.takeaway: A UK national collaborative consensus sets standardized networked practice for diagnosing, assessing and treating congenital hyperinsulinism to reduce hypoglycemia risk.

38027198.takeaway: Among 109 treated and 95 untreated girls with early and fast puberty, GnRHa restored target height in some, especially those with poor predicted height, and younger age at start predicted better gain.

38027203.takeaway: Among about 200 patients with childhood-onset craniopharyngioma after surgery, hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction was common, so most need long-term multiple hormone replacement with individualized dosing.

38027204.takeaway: A PKA pathway-focused variant search in a large, ethnically diverse pediatric cohort with obesity or metabolic abnormalities identified several genetic associations, including a novel PDE11A variant.

38027205.takeaway: In a 10-year retrospective cohort of fresh ICSI cycles, clinical and singleton neonatal outcomes were similar across male infertility types and sperm sources.

38027206.takeaway: In New South Wales adrenal insufficiency admissions, psychosocial comorbidities may contribute to ongoing adrenal crises, especially among young adult women.

38029732.takeaway: In a discrete choice experiment of French children with GH deficiency and their caregivers, less frequent injections and lower injection pain were the most valued treatment features.

38030736.takeaway: Maternal and neonatal microbiomes in pregnancies with type 1 diabetes were studied while accounting for cesarean delivery, antibiotic prophylaxis and glycaemic control.

38032368.takeaway: This review argues that stricter early control of dyslipidaemia in children with type 1 diabetes may be justified by lessons from early statin treatment in familial hypercholesterolaemia.

38032850.takeaway: During two-hour outdoor physical activity after lunch, children using Control-IQ had no serious or severe hypoglycemia, and time in range increased in the second session.

38032855.takeaway: A scoping review finds limited evidence on automated insulin delivery and nutrition, with suggestion it may reduce food management burden and carb counting inaccuracy concerns.

38033998.takeaway: In Taiwanese children with diazoxide-unresponsive congenital hyperinsulinism, a likely founder ABCC8 variant and several KATP channel variants were linked to the severe phenotype.

38034001.takeaway: In 140 Spanish patients with lipodystrophy followed a median of 4.7 years, generalised disease brought earlier metabolic abnormalities and shorter time to death.

38034003.takeaway: This review explores the relationship between primary adrenal insufficiency and X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy, including shared pathophysiology and clinical manifestations.

38041865.takeaway: A global expert guidance document on denosumab in children with RANKL-mediated disorders advises multidisciplinary planning and oversight to manage the risk of mineral abnormalities.

38045876.takeaway: This review highlights animal-model findings that intrapituitary mechanisms, including TGF-β1 and activins, inhibit prolactin secretion and contribute to its sexual dimorphism.

38047117.takeaway: Euthyroid women positive for thyroid peroxidase antibodies were more likely to deliver low-birth-weight infants, suggesting regular monitoring of these pregnancies.

38048057.takeaway: In 163 girls with precocious puberty in northern China, a nomogram of basal LH, inhibin B, bone age and uterine length predicted central precocious puberty (AUC 0.906), offering an alternative to GnRH stimulation testing.

38048799.takeaway: Weekly 14,000 IU vitamin D3 for three years was safe but did not reduce fracture risk among Mongolian schoolchildren with high baseline vitamin D deficiency.

38050487.takeaway: Hyperosmolar therapy for suspected brain injury in children with DKA became more common at the COVID-19 pandemic peak, possibly because of delayed presentation.

38051360.takeaway: Rare pathogenic monoallelic GLIS3 variants increased type 2 diabetes risk, and carriers may benefit from sulfonylureas that improve beta cell insulin secretion.

38051782.takeaway: In adolescents and young adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, greater diabetes stigma was associated with food insecurity, disordered eating, depressive symptoms and lower quality of life.

38051959.takeaway: In 519 children, HIF1α was higher in adipose tissue, especially omental, of children with obesity, and elevated serum HIF1α was associated with adiposity and metabolic disorder.

38052189.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with a right renal reninoma presented with hypertension, hypokalemia and paraneoplastic SIADH, and was treated by surgical resection.

38053731.takeaway: This review summarizes hypoglycaemic events across the causes of adrenal insufficiency and strategies such as CGM and modified glucocorticoid replacement to prevent them.

38054412.takeaway: An infant with congenital hypothyroidism had worsening thyroid function after starting carob-bean gum thickened formula, suggesting the formula may impair levothyroxine absorption.

38054413.takeaway: In a boy with MCT8 deficiency, early triiodothyroacetic acid treatment resolved peripheral thyrotoxicosis and may have slowed neurodevelopmental regression.

38054414.takeaway: Screening 14 MODY genes and RFX6 in autoantibody-negative Turkish children with type 1 diabetes found GCK-MODY most common, then HNF1B-MODY, and three novel mutations.

38054937.takeaway: In 313 prepubertal children with obesity, girls appeared more susceptible to oxidative stress-related metabolic dysfunction, while boys' redox and nitric oxide markers seemed protective.

38059612.takeaway: This review examines European legal initiatives on medical treatment of intersex children, arguing clinical management should converge with human rights frameworks, centered on the child's best interests.

38059644.takeaway: Diazoxide below 5 mg/kg/day was effective in infants with transient hyperinsulinism with mild adverse events, and the authors suggest starting as low as 2-3 mg/kg/day.

38061004.takeaway: In a multicenter retrospective cohort with acquired partial lipodystrophy, skinfold thickness and DXA helped identify the disease, while C3 hypocomplementemia was less common than previously reported.

38066593.takeaway: In youth-onset type 2 diabetes, higher urinary BCAAs and diversion of tryptophan to the kynurenine pathway were seen in adolescent girls, linking them to higher diabetes risk than boys.

38066644.takeaway: In 128 prepubertal children treated with somapacitan, a pretreatment blood transcriptome predicted first-year growth response, and the same gene set also predicted response to daily GH.

38066647.takeaway: Female adolescents with anorexia nervosa had lower serum PAPP-A2 and IGF-I bioavailability, and those with amenorrhea had lower total IGF-I and IGFBP-3.

38069566.takeaway: Across the United States, increasing social vulnerability was associated with worse thyroid cancer care and prognosis, according to SEER and CDC data.

38071957.takeaway: In children with diabetes, echocardiographic epicardial fat thickness correlated with electrocardiographic conduction markers such as P-wave dispersion, suggesting an early cardiovascular marker.

38075047.takeaway: In 8,007 Chinese children, short sleep duration and late weekday bedtime were associated with early pubertal development.

38075063.takeaway: A 4-year-old girl with rapidly progressing precocious puberty and Cushing signs had adrenocortical carcinoma, and the authors emphasize complete surgical resection.

38075066.takeaway: A mixed-methods systematic review of interventions for gestational diabetes-related weight gain examined pregnancy outcomes and women's experiences, and calls for better criteria and interventions.

38075561.takeaway: In the HAPO Hong Kong cohort, placental vitamin D transfer was higher with lower maternal vitamin D, older age and higher solar radiation at delivery, with effects on cesarean delivery still uncertain.

38078582.takeaway: The ADA 2024 Standards of Care section for children and adolescents sets current clinical practice recommendations for diabetes care in young people.

38078681.takeaway: This perspective argues pediatric endocrinologists can expand their role in managing some skeletal dysplasias, such as achondroplasia, given advances in skeletal pathophysiology and targeted treatments.

38079466.takeaway: Meta-analysis suggests early-term delivery carries a modest long-term risk of type 1 diabetes in offspring, supporting avoidance of elective delivery before 39 weeks where possible.

38084036.takeaway: A girl's chronic keratitis was the first presenting feature of autoimmune polyendocrine syndrome type 1, followed by adrenal crisis, so unexplained keratitis in children may signal this syndrome.

38084047.takeaway: Three patients with Carney complex and primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease had atypical presentations, and one developed Hodgkin lymphoma five years after adrenalectomy.

38084048.takeaway: A review of 79 reported PAPSS2 deficiency patients finds bone abnormalities in all, while androgen excess is less common.

38084506.takeaway: A 10-month-old boy with a novel TRPM6 mutation had severe hypomagnesemia with seizures and secondary hypocalcemia, showing clinical suspicion is key for early diagnosis.

38085289.takeaway: In 364,695 UK Biobank adults, low childhood body size increased the type 2 diabetes risk linked to adult obesity, but not cardiovascular risk.

38085699.takeaway: In Danish registry data from 2016 to 2018, hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state was more common in type 1 than type 2 diabetes, and was the diabetes debut in one-third of patients.

38087928.takeaway: In 80 children, those with obesity and insulin resistance had elevated fasting glucagon and GLP-1 and altered responses during an oral glucose test, unlike insulin-sensitive peers.

38087932.takeaway: In 91 people with and without type 1 diabetes, transdermal capillary C-peptide sampling was sensitive and specific compared with venous sampling and was preferred by most with type 1 diabetes.

38088752.takeaway: A male infant with neonatal 11β-hydroxylase deficiency had a chimeric CYP11B2/CYP11B1 gene inherited from his father, so gene fusion variants should be considered in diagnosis.

38089633.takeaway: Among 205 women with GDM and 201 controls, GDM was associated with postpartum anxiety, and the authors call for early identification and intervention.

38089634.takeaway: In 14,251 medical examinees, the METS-VF score was positively associated with NAFLD odds and outperformed other visceral fat surrogates, with age modifying the association.

38090768.takeaway: Among 167 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes on insulin pumps, those with disordered eating had lower HbA1c on hybrid closed-loop systems than on pump therapy alone.

38093965.takeaway: Four men with severe obesity and prolactinomas lost weight and improved metabolic profiles after six months of dopamine agonist therapy, and the authors advise prolactin screening in severe obesity.

38095637.takeaway: Two siblings with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1B from a maternal STX16 deletion had different phenotypes, including severe infantile obesity that commercial gene panels may miss.

38096802.takeaway: In young-onset Cushing disease, inferior petrosal sinus sampling occasionally gave false-negative results, and management involved ectopic ACTH screening and repeat sampling.

38097375.takeaway: Across a 13-year cohort from childhood, sedentary time worsened lipid indices, while light physical activity lowered total cholesterol more than moderate to vigorous activity.

38097507.takeaway: This narrative review finds central precocious puberty incidence rose after COVID-19 lockdowns, though responses varied by location, with lifestyle changes possibly contributing.

38097671.takeaway: An international expert consensus on SDHB-related pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma recommends early surgery and total resection regardless of tumor size, with metastases treated by local or systemic therapy.

38098860.takeaway: In Hubei, China, GDM and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy were linked to worse maternal-perinatal outcomes in singleton and twin pregnancies, with twins having higher odds of adverse neonatal outcomes.

38098865.takeaway: This mini review proposes that genistein, a soy isoflavone, promotes obesity through PPARγ interaction, based mainly on in vitro and animal evidence.

38098869.takeaway: In pooled Norwegian pregnancy studies, a fasting plasma glucose threshold of 4.7 mmol/L as a first screen could avoid OGTT in 70-77% of pregnancies, with low GDM risk below it.

38099569.takeaway: During GnRH analogue treatment, transgender and gender diverse adolescents had hormonal and body changes linked to psychological well-being, suggesting treatment may begin a gender-affirming path.

38099591.takeaway: In a small study of 49 children, fasting ghrelin and GLP-1 did not differ between children with Prader-Willi or Bardet-Biedl syndrome and obese or lean peers.

38104243.takeaway: In Chinese children with congenital hypothyroidism, newborn-screen TSH and levothyroxine dose helped separate permanent from transient disease, and growth was similar by age three.

38104553.takeaway: In children and youth with type 1 diabetes, CGM variability and time in range below 70% were linked to overweight in girls and high LDL cholesterol in both sexes.

38107513.takeaway: In 91 girls with early thelarche, a thelarche variant with FSH-predominant response was identified, which the authors suggest may represent a precocious prepuberty state.

38107514.takeaway: In 246 healthy children, total bilirubin and the bilirubin-to-triglycerides ratio were independently associated with HbA1c and predicted its change over four years.

38113453.takeaway: In 13,461 real-world MiniMed 780G users, mean time in tight range was about 49%, rising above 56% with consistent optimal settings, supporting a TITR goal above 50%.

38114464.takeaway: In 278 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, vitamin D correlated with uterine volume, a link absent in 239 normally developing peers, and ICPP girls had lower vitamin D.

38116311.takeaway: This review covers reproductive health in Turner syndrome from puberty to pregnancy, including premature ovarian insufficiency and fertility preservation options.

38116317.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 15 case-control studies (2,145 cases, 2,063 controls) found an association between vitamin D levels and precocious puberty, calling for prospective and trial data.

38116318.takeaway: In 549 US adolescents in NHANES 2017-2018, serum total folate and 5-methyltetrahydrofolate were negatively correlated with hepatic steatosis, with BMI mediating much of the link.

38117469.takeaway: Off-label low-dose antithymocyte globulin in six children with stage 2 type 1 diabetes kept three diabetes-free for 1.5 to 4 years.

38117862.takeaway: This narrative review finds the benefit of myoinositol for adolescent PCOS unclear, with inconsistent improvements in some markers and limited high-quality evidence.

38128002.takeaway: In a Japanese prospective cohort of pediatric-onset adrenal insufficiency, younger age and more infections were independent risk factors for adrenal crisis.

38128064.takeaway: In 548 transgender adolescents, lean mass rose mainly in the first year of testosterone in trans boys, while body composition changed little during estradiol treatment in trans girls.

38128074.takeaway: In 30,717 German children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, diagnosis and DKA were less likely on weekends, public holidays and school vacations than on weekdays.

38128075.takeaway: In 2,003 pregnancies with type 1 diabetes, pump use with CGM or automated insulin delivery was linked to more large-for-gestational-age infants and preterm delivery than injections, not explained by HbA1c or weight gain.

38128110.takeaway: A systematic review and meta-analysis provides convincing evidence that gonadotropins induce puberty in males with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, though treatment choices and outcomes vary widely.

38130396.takeaway: In mice, moderate aerobic exercise restored intestinal IgA production through the T-dependent pathway in adults but not in aged mice.

38133644.takeaway: In 168 children with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c correlated strongly with time in range over 2 to 12 weeks, and two-week time in range is a viable complement to HbA1c.

38141219.takeaway: In 40 children and adolescents with Prader-Willi syndrome, higher PAPP-A may promote IGFBP proteolysis and IGF-I bioavailability.

38142669.takeaway: In 154 children referred for hypoglycemia over 1992-2018, ketotic hypoglycemia and congenital hyperinsulinism were the most common causes, with etiology varying by age.

38142677.takeaway: This review compiles 21 reported DHX37 variants in disorders of sex development, mostly linked to gonadal dysgenesis and testicular regression.

38144557.takeaway: In 109 children, carriers of the GC rs4588-A allele had lower serum 25(OH)D, and urinary vitamin D binding protein inversely correlated with serum levels.

38144571.takeaway: Using 2015-2019 national survey data, major depressive episodes and suicidal ideation among emerging adults with diabetes differed by race and ethnicity, gender and sexual orientation.

38144572.takeaway: Among 105 Czech patients with head and neck paragangliomas, a shared SDHD variant appeared in unrelated patients, but no founder effect was established.

38147013.takeaway: A 5-year-old girl with congenital clinical anophthalmia had Graves' disease with thymic hyperplasia, illustrating diagnostic challenges and radioiodine use for repeated relapses.

38147465.takeaway: In three children with MEN2B, desmoplasia in primary thyroid tumors tracked nodal metastasis, suggesting it is a useful biomarker in hereditary medullary thyroid cancer.

38148509.takeaway: An anaemia-based screening strategy for thyroid hormone alpha resistance in children did not reveal new cases, but could reduce unnecessary THRA genetic testing.

38149625.takeaway: This narrative review examines evidence linking maternal thyroid dysfunction in pregnancy to autism spectrum disorder in offspring and identifies research challenges.

38149768.takeaway: A literature review of 46,XX CAH newborns with severe genital masculinization suggests many raised male report good quality of life, supporting male assignment as an informed option.

38152125.takeaway: A 37-year-old woman with pituitary stalk interruption syndrome, tall stature, cirrhosis and diabetes had a possible KCNJ11 mutation, with untreated GH deficiency suggested to drive fatty liver and cirrhosis.

38152128.takeaway: In boys transplanted before age 18, testosterone fell after full pubertal attainment despite a compensatory LH rise, and treosulfan was linked to less hypogonadism than busulfan.

38153805.takeaway: In 50 youth with type 2 diabetes, severe β-cell dysfunction was linked to intraglomerular hypertension and kidney hyperoxia, with milder similar findings in controls with obesity.

38153877.takeaway: In 209 TODAY participants with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, miR-483-3p and miR-4306 may be associated with treatment failure, although a combined miRNA panel did not predict it.

38154030.takeaway: In 20 children with autoimmune thyroid disease, 12 weeks of zinc supplementation did not change thyroid autoantibodies or oxidative stress, and levothyroxine did not need escalation.

38154033.takeaway: In 814 patients with type 1 diabetes in Bauru, Brazil, month of birth was not associated with T1D risk over 40 years of data.

38156962.takeaway: Among 873 adults with type 1 diabetes using FreeStyle Libre 2, CGM alarms were linked to better glycemic control, and threshold choice involved trade-offs between hypo- and hyperglycemia alerts.

38158618.takeaway: In 119,898 neonates, second-tier genetic testing with a MALDI-TOF assay for 21 SLC22A5 variants, applied to those with low free carnitine, showed high detection and was recommended for screening.

38161981.takeaway: In children with thyroid disease, levothyroxine impaired urinary LH measurement, so urinary gonadotropins for puberty assessment are valid only in euthyroid children not taking levothyroxine.

38163427.takeaway: In a case series of pigmented hypertrichosis with insulin-dependent diabetes, some patients had autoantibodies, so the authors argue genetic testing should not be withheld for antibody positivity.

38163851.takeaway: A meta-analysis of randomized trials in children and young adults found SGLT2 inhibitors safe and tolerable, with higher time in range than placebo.

38163968.takeaway: In 249 boys aged 8 to 18 with overweight or obesity, bone mineral content did not adapt to excess body mass, and IGF-1, testosterone and insulin were determinants.

38164002.takeaway: In a large retrospective Chinese cohort of prolactinomas diagnosed by age 20, dopamine agonists remained first-line, with surgery viable for noninvasive tumors.

38164825.takeaway: This review of paediatric polyuria-polydipsia diagnosis covers water deprivation testing, copeptin assays and promising hypertonic saline, arginine and glucagon protocols that need pediatric study.

38167416.takeaway: In a 15-year-old girl with type 1 diabetes, persistent abdominal pain after mild DKA led to colonic necrosis and perforation, so gut ischemia should be considered when recovery is suboptimal.

38169712.takeaway: In 2,462 Korean adolescents aged 10 to 18, higher serum uric acid was associated with metabolic syndrome and its components, even in non-obese adolescents, more strongly in girls.

38169759.takeaway: In 377 children and adolescents followed longitudinally, those whose BMI-SDS rose had higher baseline TSH and free T4 than those whose BMI-SDS fell.

38173380.takeaway: In 83 children reevaluated for levothyroxine discontinuation, an average TSH above 9.05 mIU/L over three years predicted permanent congenital hypothyroidism with 100% sensitivity and specificity in this retrospective study.

38173381.takeaway: Across countries, type 1 diabetes incidence in children under 15 was negatively correlated with tuberculosis incidence, but not with BCG vaccination rate.

38173382.takeaway: In the Indonesian Family Life Survey, birth weight was associated with HbA1c in adolescence and early adulthood, partly explained by parental HbA1c, socioeconomic factors and underweight.

38173383.takeaway: In 54 children with diabetes, glycated albumin reflected glycemic control comparably to HbA1c, though obesity affected glycated albumin in children with or without diabetes.

38173384.takeaway: A Korean boy with Kleefstra syndrome and micropenis had penile growth after testosterone enanthate started at four months, following an hCG stimulation workup.

38173385.takeaway: A 3.5-year-old boy with short stature, transient hypercalcemia and low alkaline phosphatase carried a pathogenic ALPL variant, so hypophosphatasia should be considered even without skeletal deformity.

38173399.takeaway: In a 9-year cohort from ages 15 to 24, DXA-measured fat mass at 17 was bidirectionally linked to insulin resistance at 24, suggesting mid-adolescence is a window to interrupt this cycle.

38174333.takeaway: In 226 college students, cardiorespiratory fitness partly mediated the association between body fat percentage and executive function.

38174586.takeaway: A Danish nationwide registry study found fibrous dysplasia/McCune-Albright syndrome rare, peaking in adolescence, while no registered hypophosphatemia treatment was found among cases.

38181424.takeaway: This review of recent literature notes that the molecular regulation and significance of adrenarche remain unknown, and calls for prospective long-term studies.

38181427.takeaway: In 35 patients with adamantinomatous craniopharyngioma, methylation clustering identified a hypomethylated subgroup enriched for CTNNB1 mutations and linked to larger tumor size.

38181434.takeaway: This review explains that short stature in puberty must account for sex steroid effects on bone acceleration, with individualized treatment and attention to safety.

38182910.takeaway: Across 695,912 French deliveries in 2018, overt diabetes, GDM diagnosed before 22 weeks and GDM after 30 weeks were linked to poorer maternal-fetal outcomes than GDM diagnosed at 22-30 weeks.

38183624.takeaway: Sequencing 599 patients with congenital hypothyroidism identified CNTN6 as a novel causative gene acting through Notch signaling to regulate thyroid hormone biosynthesis.

38183676.takeaway: This review surveys AI applications in paediatric endocrinology, from insulin dosing and bone age to precocious puberty diagnosis, and stresses that AI should augment rather than replace clinical skills.

38185120.takeaway: A systematic review and meta-analysis found GnRHa may raise BMI in central precocious puberty in the short term, but BMI returns to normal by adult height.

38189043.takeaway: In 452 Arab adolescents from Kuwait, higher ANGPTL8 levels corresponded to higher BMI-for-age z-scores alongside hsCRP, leptin and chemerin, suggesting an early marker of adolescent obesity.

38189482.takeaway: In a population-based nested case-control study, maternal circulating sugar alcohol (polyol) levels were significantly associated with gestational diabetes.

38192416.takeaway: This review covers adrenal Cushing's syndrome in children, from adrenal tumors and rarer causes such as PPNAD and McCune-Albright syndrome to diagnosis, treatment and lifelong follow-up.

38192425.takeaway: Trio exome sequencing identified a novel PHKA2 insertion in a Chinese boy with glycogen storage disease type IXa, expanding the known variant spectrum.

38193204.takeaway: This article summarizes the Korean Society for the Study of Obesity's 2022 clinical guidelines for childhood obesity, covering assessment, comorbidities and treatment goals.

38193351.takeaway: Among 23 people with high-grade X aneuploidies compared with 46 with Klinefelter syndrome, each extra X was linked to progressively worse gonadal, thyroid and cardiac function.

38193465.takeaway: This comparative review summarizes virtual and augmented reality applications for diabetes training, management and treatment, noting that many are at an early stage.

38194229.takeaway: In a retrospective review of hospitalized youth with type 1 diabetes, Dexcom G6 readings matched point-of-care glucose, suggesting a potential role for CGM during pediatric admissions.

38196663.takeaway: In a Maltese newborn cohort, the GNRHR p.Q106R variant was about ten times more frequent than globally, and the authors conclude heterozygotes with hypogonadal features likely carry a second variant.

38197363.takeaway: A review of automated insulin delivery in pregnancy for women with type 1 diabetes outlines current evidence, ongoing RCTs and the remaining challenges.

38197679.takeaway: In 164 children with type 1 diabetes and 100 controls, FTO and MC4R polymorphisms were associated with T1D and were independent predictors of obesity within T1D.

38197810.takeaway: Maternal reports on Persian versions of the Pubertal Development Scale and Sexual Maturation Scale reliably estimated pubertal development in adolescent girls in Isfahan, Iran.

38198649.takeaway: In 84 children with osteogenesis imperfecta randomized to denosumab or zoledronic acid, denosumab increased bone mineral density and improved spinal morphometry, but rebound hypercalcemia was a caution.

38205164.takeaway: Of 100 boys with bilateral undescended testes who were tested, 38% had endocrine dysfunction, and genetic findings were also common, supporting routine endocrine and genetic evaluation.

38205198.takeaway: In mice, VAX1 in suprachiasmatic VIP neurons affected circadian rhythm generation, depressive-like behavior and the reproductive axis in a sex-specific manner.

38206362.takeaway: In neonatal mice, NRF2 maintained redox balance and mitochondrial biogenesis needed for beta cell growth, supporting its role in preserving beta cell mass.

38211570.takeaway: This mini review of metabolic bone disease of prematurity recommends distinguishing calcium and phosphate deficiency as primary causes to guide mineral supplementation.

38212959.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl with Schwartz-Jampel syndrome type 1 and short stature carried two novel compound heterozygous variants, and growth and neuromuscular monitoring is advised.

38213125.takeaway: In an 8-week randomized trial of 92 children aged 5 to 12, a gamified CGM app raised time in range by about 5% and lowered time above range compared with CGM alone.

38214123.takeaway: In 151 adults with Turner syndrome, aortic growth was faster than in non-Turner women and was not linked to known dissection risk factors, suggesting growth rate could stratify risk.

38214665.takeaway: Biallelic CRTAP variants in two families reduced CRTAP mRNA and protein in osteoblasts, impairing collagen modification and bone formation in severe osteogenesis imperfecta type VII.

38214711.takeaway: In 1,050 genetically at-risk children, early-childhood BMI rose during the COVID-19 pandemic in line with containment restrictions, and higher BMI was linked to islet autoimmunity.

38214712.takeaway: In islet autoantibody-positive children, high soluble PD-1 was associated with progression to type 1 diabetes, identifying it as a potential early intervention target.

38215171.takeaway: In 127 adolescents across the glycemic spectrum, low glycine, a low glutamine-to-glutamate ratio, and raised branched-chain and aromatic amino acids marked those at risk for β-cell failure.

38215208.takeaway: In a pilot of 10 children aged 2 to 7 using MiniMed 780G, time in range averaged 72.6% during the hybrid closed-loop phase, with 3.0% of time below 70 mg/dL.

38224692.takeaway: A girl with familial chylomicronemia syndrome treated with gemfibrozil and diet kept triglycerides in the normal range over six years, with no further pancreatitis episodes.

38227777.takeaway: In three patients with juvenile gigantomastia, the authors implicate ERα-driven estrogen sensitivity and local aromatase-driven estrogen production in breast overgrowth.

38229276.takeaway: In functional hypothalamic amenorrhoea, bone mineral density correlated positively with muscle mass, pointing to early screening and muscle gain to prevent osteoporosis.

38229738.takeaway: In 74 girls, intracranial MRI findings were no different between central precocious puberty at 6-8 years and rapidly progressive early puberty at 8-9 years.

38230957.takeaway: An 11-year-old Korean girl with Floating-Harbor syndrome, short stature and early puberty responded to growth hormone and a GnRH agonist, with height SDS improving from -4.6 to -2.4.

38232712.takeaway: In 36 Dutch children with ACAN deficiency treated with growth hormone for at least a year, the response was modest but significant and sustained over three years.
