38234314.takeaway: In 44 girls aged 6 to 13, the sum of urinary androgen metabolites was a good marker of circulating androstenedione and testosterone, with individual metabolites adding metabolic information.

38234422.takeaway: In German children under 20, district-level COVID-19 incidence was not associated with type 1 diabetes incidence, so a causal link from infection is unlikely.

38234428.takeaway: This review explains that germ cell numbers are impaired in cryptorchid testes already in childhood, linking this to later infertility and testicular germ cell tumors.

38234429.takeaway: Among 5,834 Chinese kindergarten children followed from 2019 to 2022, lockdowns were linked to higher obesity rates but not to impaired height growth.

38234430.takeaway: This review examines how metabolic reprogramming, involving mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation and glycolysis, contributes to gestational diabetes and may suggest therapeutic strategies.

38235510.takeaway: In a case-control study of neonates with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, fetal growth restriction and neonatal sepsis were notable risk factors, with a median diazoxide course of four months.

38235550.takeaway: A meta-analysis found GnRH analogue treatment for central precocious puberty did not significantly change insulin resistance, lipids, thyroid function, testosterone or bone mineral density.

38237119.takeaway: In 428,568 newly diagnosed Chinese adults with type 2 diabetes, age-standardized cancer risk was greater with earlier diagnosis, supporting age-stratified management.

38238968.takeaway: In 44 children with Bethesda 3 or 4 thyroid nodules, higher EU-TIRADS scores tracked malignancy, especially in Bethesda 4, while predictive value was poorer in Bethesda 3.

38238969.takeaway: Obese children had higher serum versican, hsCRP and IL-6 and more fatty liver than healthy peers, and a BMI SDS above 1.75 predicted hepatosteatosis.

38239985.takeaway: This review examines evidence on microplastic exposure and its potential effects on fertility, pregnancy and child health, including developmental origins of disease.

38239988.takeaway: This commentary discusses setmelanotide for acquired hypothalamic obesity after craniopharyngioma and an ongoing trial, asking whether it is an obesity drug or hypothalamic substitution therapy.

38240484.takeaway: The 2024 SCCM guideline update on glycemic control in critically ill children and adults gives actionable guidance on targets and monitoring, and calls for research on individualized targets and CGM.

38243909.takeaway: The authors developed and validated a serum assay for 11-oxygenated androgens in children and established paediatric reference intervals to support evaluation of hyperandrogenism.

38249431.takeaway: In a pilot of adolescents and young adults in Hawai'i, MASLD prevalence exceeded US figures reported elsewhere, highest among obese Asian participants.

38252314.takeaway: In 15,188 Swedish children and young people with type 1 diabetes, autoimmune comorbidity, mainly coeliac and thyroid disease, did not significantly affect HbA1c or mortality.

38252849.takeaway: In 2,966 youth in the SEARCH study, prediction models using routine clinical measures at diagnosis accurately identified those retaining endogenous insulin secretion consistent with type 2 diabetes.

38253221.takeaway: A French expert consensus reviews germline genetic predisposition to Cushing's syndrome and gives a statement on genetic screening for Cushing disease and adrenal Cushing's syndrome.

38253347.takeaway: A 4-year-old boy with neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis type 11 from compound GRN variants had developmental delay, epilepsy and hypothyroidism, supporting NCL11 in the differential for epilepsy with neurodegeneration.

38260129.takeaway: This review describes adrenalectomy improving insulin resistance in a girl with congenital generalized lipoatrophy and in a murine model, proposing adrenal overactivity and leptin resistance as mechanisms.

38260168.takeaway: In a randomized trial of 245 women undergoing artificial-cycle frozen embryo transfer, intramuscular hCG luteal support did not improve clinical outcomes.

38261995.takeaway: In Taiwanese HSCT recipients, a prior fracture and mean daily steroid dose above 0.5 mg were associated with higher fracture risk, supporting early bone-loss screening.

38262374.takeaway: In a prospective childhood traumatic brain injury cohort, most survivors with fatigue had no frank HPA axis dysfunction, and morning salivary cortisone was higher than in controls.

38262691.takeaway: Adding 1H-NMR lipoprotein profiling to familial hypercholesterolemia diagnostics identified differences beyond standard lipids and raised the yield of genetic testing, including in children.

38264283.takeaway: A nationwide survey of 662 Bangladeshi physicians found most followed relevant guidelines for hypo- and hyperthyroidism, though some gaps remained.

38266760.takeaway: In a prospective Chinese birth cohort of 729 women undergoing assisted reproduction, subclinical hypothyroidism was linked to lower communication scores at one year, especially in girls.

38271993.takeaway: A deep-learning bone age software showed low concordance with chronological age in 371 healthy Korean children, tending to underestimate bone age, especially under 8.3 years.

38271994.takeaway: In 200 children who had HSCT, followed for a median of 14 years, endocrine complications were common, and age at transplant should shape surveillance.

38272022.takeaway: A 13-year-old boy with hyperthyroid-phenotype thyroid hormone resistance had a large goiter that mimicked infiltrative carcinoma, and the case adds to liothyronine use in this phenotype.

38272607.takeaway: A systematic review of 138 studies covering over one million people found pandemic-era care disruptions affected clinical outcomes in diabetes, most in females, younger people and minority groups where reported.

38274224.takeaway: In young ischemic stroke patients on the Tibetan plateau, elevated serum uric acid was a distinct risk factor for major stroke, with risk rising above about 320 µmol/L.

38274235.takeaway: In a retrospective comparison of pediatric and adult papillary thyroid cancer, tumor size and multifocality were strong recurrence risk factors in children, supporting the proposed model.

38275147.takeaway: Executive function was assessed in 35 children with isolated GH deficiency and 35 healthy controls, and the authors suggest psychological evaluation before and during treatment.

38275148.takeaway: Among 7,580 child health records from Turkey, the authors suggest defining microcephaly as head circumference of -2 SDS or less to avoid missing cases during follow-up.

38277156.takeaway: Two years of Omnipod 5 use in children aged 2 to 5.9 maintained glycemic improvements safely in an extension of a single-arm pivotal trial.

38277162.takeaway: Over one year in 136 youth with type 1 diabetes, fat and protein intake both influenced glycemic outcomes, supporting consideration of all macronutrients in insulin delivery.

38281148.takeaway: A teenage boy on induction chemotherapy for B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia developed drug-induced diabetes presenting as DKA, with insulin needs that fluctuated and at times fell to nil.

38281180.takeaway: In very preterm infants under 32 weeks, hypothyroxinemia of prematurity was associated with growth velocity, while TSH and levothyroxine treatment were not, suggesting a mediating role.

38282366.takeaway: Urine glucose screening in obese Hong Kong students aged 10 to 18 had a high negative predictive value and is an inexpensive way to rule out type 2 diabetes early.

38283745.takeaway: A 10-year single-centre review of paediatric thyroid surgery suggests repeating fine-needle aspiration at an experienced centre before deciding on thyroidectomy when the initial biopsy is uncertain.

38288471.takeaway: This review describes how gestational diabetes and maternal obesity can perpetuate metabolic disease across generations and identifies early metabolic development as a target for intervention.

38288473.takeaway: In single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfers, combined development speed and quality had no significant effect on singleton birthweight, though transfer of slower, lower-quality blastocysts raised the chance of a female birth.

38288475.takeaway: A 3-year-old girl with systemic pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1 was confirmed molecularly early and managed with sodium polystyrene sulfonate, without severe hyperkalemia after gastrostomy placement.

38288476.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests childhood BMI at birth and in late childhood affects adult cardiometabolic traits differently, while infant and toddler BMI showed no causal association.

38291759.takeaway: This mini review summarizes idiopathic ketotic hypoglycemia in children, distinguishing physiological from pathological forms and outlining diagnosis and treatment by frequent feeding and avoiding prolonged fasting.

38291760.takeaway: In 69 Korean girls with central precocious puberty, a 3-month triptorelin depot effectively suppressed gonadal hormones and bone maturation and increased predicted adult height.

38291761.takeaway: In 3,861 Korean children aged 10 to 18 surveyed from 2016 to 2021, the number of metabolically unhealthy children with obesity rose during the COVID-19 pandemic.

38291762.takeaway: In juvenile-onset SLE, duration of glucocorticoid exposure was the main factor linked to low bone mineral density, alongside cumulative steroid and hydroxychloroquine doses.

38292775.takeaway: This review summarizes how maternal obesity and gestational diabetes shape offspring metabolic disease risk, with epigenetic myeloid reprogramming proposed as a mechanism.

38295770.takeaway: Three patients with X-linked central hypothyroidism from novel IGSF1 variants showed that delayed treatment may bring adverse effects such as speech delay.

38295777.takeaway: A 17-year-old girl with Graves' disease and methimazole-induced agranulocytosis was bridged with 29 days of saturated potassium iodide, and the authors review alternatives.

38295778.takeaway: In a prospective Chilean cohort followed four years after menarche, girls grew an average of 6.6 cm, 3.8 cm of it in the first year, and age at menarche shaped growth patterns.

38300440.takeaway: In 971 girls with premature breast development, a peak LH cut-off of 4 IU/L was proposed for diagnosing central precocious puberty in girls with overweight or obesity (sensitivity 86%, specificity 93%).

38304464.takeaway: In 72 healthy schoolchildren aged 7 to 9, higher salivary CEFIP was associated with a higher diastolic-to-systolic blood pressure ratio, more sedentary time and poorer balance.

38305782.takeaway: Across three international registries of 8,004 children under six with type 1 diabetes, CGM was used by most, pump use varied, and hybrid closed-loop use was rare.

38307035.takeaway: Among 34 children with familial tall stature, monogenic or cytogenetic causes were found, so genetic testing should be considered whether or not dysmorphic features are present.

38308814.takeaway: In a nationwide Italian cohort of 193 boys with central precocious puberty, the share with CNS abnormalities on MRI was among the lowest reported in the literature.

38310522.takeaway: A Japanese child with premature loss of deciduous teeth had odonto-hypophosphatasia from a novel heterozygous ALPL variant, showing dental presentation can reveal HPP.

38310850.takeaway: A multi-stakeholder opinion statement on DSD care identifies common ground among clinicians, patients and families, and offers preliminary recommendations for clinical management and resource allocation.

38310868.takeaway: This review explains skeletal development and skeletal dysplasia classification and gives a practical workup for children with suspected dysplasia, with the pediatric endocrinologist guiding initial diagnosis.

38313368.takeaway: School screening in Shenzhen found worrisome prediabetes rates among children and adolescents, with BMI showing a U-shaped association with prediabetes.

38315507.takeaway: In 181 adults with type 1 diabetes followed for 12 months, flash glucose monitoring reduced fear of hypoglycemia overall and improved quality of life, though a significant minority worsened.

38316111.takeaway: A 9-day-old boy with severe aldosterone synthase deficiency had a CYP11B2 variant that seemed benign in silico but was pathogenic on functional testing, allowing hydrocortisone to be stopped.

38317710.takeaway: In 121 girls with early secondary sexual characteristics, a basal LH of at least 0.58 IU/L and SHBG of at most 58.79 nmol/L helped identify rapidly progressive central precocious puberty early.

38317711.takeaway: In a diabetes registry, people with gender incongruence had more depression, anxiety and self-injury, while HbA1c and lipids matched controls.

38318290.takeaway: Higher maternal urinary kisspeptin in late pregnancy was inversely associated with neonatal growth measures in 724 mother-neonate pairs.

38318293.takeaway: Reviews recent advances in how hormones regulate development from fetal life through puberty, and calls for longer-term study of hormone modulation.

38318299.takeaway: Paediatric Cushing's disease is rare; the review advises rapid diagnosis and referral to tertiary centres with paediatric, adult and pituitary surgical expertise.

38318871.takeaway: In 155 children with adrenocortical tumours, hormone-excess features differed by age and sex; in pubertal patients androgen signs were often mistaken for normal puberty.

38320208.takeaway: Proposes a streamlined emergency-department approach for children with first-presentation hypoglycaemia, using point-of-care glucose and beta-hydroxybutyrate to select further testing.

38322155.takeaway: Serum humanin was lower in children with inflammatory bowel disease than in controls, and IBD serum suppressed humanin in cultured growth plates, linking inflammation to poor bone growth.

38324408.takeaway: In 18 children with ENPP1 deficiency (ARHR2), prior calcification from GACI helped identify the disease, and patients on calcitriol and phosphate need calcification monitoring.

38324670.takeaway: In 2,822 Australian youth with type 1 diabetes, pump and CGM use were linked to lower HbA1c across all socioeconomic quintiles.

38327564.takeaway: In 24 women treated with GnRH analogues for precocious puberty, the authors suggest childhood therapy may raise adult PCOS risk and advise long-term PCOS screening.

38327902.takeaway: Evidence on growth hormone and sleep in children is limited, dated and inconsistent, so effects of GH deficiency and GH therapy on sleep remain unclear.

38330932.takeaway: Reviews C-type natriuretic peptide analogues, which target the CNP/FGFR3 pathway, as an emerging treatment for genetic causes of short stature.

38330987.takeaway: In adults with obesity, all tested survodutide doses were tolerated and reduced bodyweight dose-dependently over 46 weeks, with mostly gastrointestinal adverse events.

38332657.takeaway: Children and adolescents with CAH have lower health-related quality of life, especially at school, with poor disease control and complications linked to worse scores.

38332670.takeaway: In 107 girls with Turner syndrome, the authors advise individualised timing of pubertal induction and refining estrogen regimens so height gain is not compromised.

38332686.takeaway: A nomogram built on 1,590 SEER patients identified clinicopathological predictors of lung metastasis in children and adolescents with differentiated thyroid cancer.

38332889.takeaway: Among 51,172 singleton births, ART was linked to more placental complications than natural conception or ovulation induction; preterm birth before 34 weeks did not differ significantly from ovulation induction.

38333723.takeaway: In 103 children and adolescents, serum irisin correlated with glucose, insulin, lipid and bone markers, suggesting a role in metabolic and bone health in obesity.

38335127.takeaway: In UK primary-care records, children with X-linked hypophosphatemia more often had rickets, genu varum, low phosphate and growth delay recorded before diagnosis than matched controls.

38336003.takeaway: Proposes harmonised reporting of paediatric lipid results in Canadian clinical laboratories to support implementation of the 2022 dyslipidaemia guidance.

38336897.takeaway: A Delphi-based consensus for children under 19 with suspected pituitary adenoma recommends multidisciplinary care, with surgery performed in specialist centres.

38336898.takeaway: Part 2 of the childhood pituitary adenoma guideline gives 74 management recommendations for specific tumour types, with planned transition to adult pituitary care.

38344969.takeaway: Describes a child with Sotos syndrome, a de novo NSD1 deletion and congenital hyperinsulinism, and proposes including CHI in the neonatal phenotype with genome-wide testing.

38345890.takeaway: A 17-year-old girl with primary ovarian insufficiency was diagnosed with MCT8 deficiency after skewed X-inactivation, showing the disorder can present clinically in females with SLC16A2 disruption.

38347684.takeaway: Among 80 young children with congenital heart disease and heart failure, non-thyroidal illness was common, and low free T4 and low fT3/rT3 index predicted mortality.

38347685.takeaway: Salivary sex steroid levels in 139 term infants were similar with and without colic, though colicky infants showed sex- and time-of-day differences, hinting at altered minipuberty.

38349399.takeaway: SIGLEC-1-positive monocytes with a strong interferon signature were found in adults with latent autoimmune diabetes, suggesting a possible marker of early type 1 diabetes activity.

38352715.takeaway: Meta-analysis of randomised trials of probiotics in overweight or obese adolescents; the authors judge the evidence not yet established and call for larger studies.

38353247.takeaway: Reports a girl with FA2H-related spastic paraplegia type 35 and progressive gait decline, and suggests FA2H-related neurodegeneration be considered even without a basal ganglia iron signal.

38353264.takeaway: Two children with PHP1A were followed for 20 years; the authors advise GNAS testing for infants with obesity, ectopic ossification and TSH resistance.

38353291.takeaway: Two infants with COQ4-related CoQ10 deficiency-7 presented with hypotonia and dysmorphism, and the authors urge including this disorder in the differential for such infants.

38353727.takeaway: Describes how AI applied to public data could support type 1 diabetes screening by identifying at-risk individuals and designing follow-up plans.

38359811.takeaway: In 11 Japanese 46,XY individuals with testicular regression or partial gonadal dysgenesis, DHX37 variants were a common genetic cause, supporting genetic testing.

38362587.takeaway: Mendelian randomisation links several inflammatory cytokines to placental syndromes, and molecular docking suggests traditional Chinese medicine compounds bind them.

38363873.takeaway: In U.S. claims data of adults with type 2 diabetes starting GLP-1 receptor agonists, anaphylaxis was rare, and lixisenatide did not carry a clearly higher risk.

38363973.takeaway: In 5,295 Swedish children with type 1 diabetes, 9.8% had biopsy-proven celiac disease, mostly within 5 years; younger age at diagnosis and DQ2 homozygosity raised risk.

38366195.takeaway: A 31-year-old woman with a novel KCNJ11 loss-of-function variant had sulfonylurea-sensitive diabetes, suggesting mild KATP mutations may cause insulin deficiency in adulthood.

38366626.takeaway: In 144 people with type 1 diabetes aged 2.6 to 71.8 years, open-source automated insulin delivery gave lower HbA1c than the commercial MiniMed 670G, without safety concerns.

38366903.takeaway: Normative thyroid volume and urinary iodine data from 1,553 Turkish school-age children in an iodine-sufficient region show a low prevalence of goitre.

38368602.takeaway: Three new Indian cases and a review of 292 probands propose a phenotype-based genotype classification of STAR variants in 46,XY lipoid CAH.

38368603.takeaway: In 30 Japanese children with GH deficiency, once-weekly somapacitan kept height velocity over 104 weeks, and most who switched from daily GH preferred it.

38368858.takeaway: In children with Prader-Willi syndrome on long-term GH, measured energy expenditure rose with age and lean mass, while energy intake stayed low relative to requirements.

38369573.takeaway: A multivalent coxsackievirus B vaccine targeting viruses linked to type 1 diabetes was well tolerated and immunogenic in 32 adults in a placebo-controlled phase I trial.

38370350.takeaway: Exome sequencing of a child with single kidney and vesicoureteral reflux found two inherited TNXB missense variants, relevant to preimplantation genetic diagnosis in future pregnancies.

38372780.takeaway: A genome-wide association study of 30,699 Chinese pregnant women identified genetic variants linked to gestational diabetes and glycaemic traits, implicating inflammatory pathways.

38373250.takeaway: In 30 Japanese infants with thyroglobulin gene defects, missense variants caused milder hypothyroidism with goitre, while truncating-only variants needed full replacement.

38373413.takeaway: In 27 children with CAH and 35 controls, brain-structure links to obesity and inflammation were largely explained by CAH status itself.

38374118.takeaway: A pilot in children with cerebral palsy and delayed puberty found the testosterone or oestrogen induction algorithm beneficial and well tolerated over two years, supporting treatment for severe delay.

38374795.takeaway: A 12-year-old with papillary thyroid cancer developed acute kidney injury and raised CK after thyroid hormone withdrawal, improving with hydration and levothyroxine.

38374961.takeaway: A practical step-by-step guide to diagnosing and managing osteoporosis and fragility fractures in children, including monogenic causes and bone health benchmarks.

38375192.takeaway: Two-sample Mendelian randomisation of PCOS and gestational diabetes; the authors suggest prevention should target women with high-risk PCOS features rather than all women with PCOS.

38375861.takeaway: Real-world data from nearly 70,000 Omnipod 5 users with type 1 diabetes aged 2 years and older show favourable glycaemic outcomes, including in Medicaid and Medicare users.

38375881.takeaway: In 193 children including 59 with central precocious puberty, PedsQL quality of life did not differ significantly between treated, untreated and healthy groups.

38375892.takeaway: In 2,890 ART-conceived children aged 4 to 10, paternal obesity was linked to unfavourable cardiometabolic profiles, partly mediated by offspring BMI.

38376731.takeaway: An Italian Delphi-style consensus of 41 statements guides transition from paediatric to adult care for people with Turner syndrome, covering bone, sexual, metabolic and psychosocial needs.

38377321.takeaway: Compared with the MiniMed 670G, the MiniMed 780G with Guardian 4 sensor reduced diabetes management burden, with fewer closed-loop exits and fingersticks and better glycaemic control.

38377327.takeaway: Over 12 months, adolescents using the MiniMed 780G met consensus glucose targets with either simplified meal announcement or carbohydrate counting, but carbohydrate counting gave better time in range.

38379863.takeaway: In adults with cystic fibrosis, CGM measures of dysglycaemia were associated with clinical outcomes, supporting future study of CGM as a CFRD screening tool.

38379864.takeaway: A literature review reports an association between raised alpha-fetoprotein and ovarian masses in fetuses, infants and children, supporting its use as a complementary biomarker.

38379866.takeaway: Protocol for a randomised trial of an app-guided resistance exercise programme in at least 52 children aged 8 to 18 with type 1 diabetes, measuring insulin requirements.

38385947.takeaway: Reference limits for serum osteocalcin from birth to age 5 in 551 Swedish children show a postnatal peak in year one, varying by sex, breastfeeding and gestational age.

38386069.takeaway: In 34,231 Swedish men, low birthweight and childhood or young-adult overweight each added to later type 2 diabetes risk in an additive way.

38386433.takeaway: In 160 pregnancies complicated by type 1 diabetes, CGM use was linked to better maternal glucose control and less macrosomia, with other neonatal outcomes not significantly different.

38386435.takeaway: In Danish children with type 1 diabetes, open-source automated insulin delivery was uncommon (1.89%), improved time in range and showed no increased safety risk.

38386924.takeaway: In 50 children with premature adrenarche and 50 controls, diastolic function and repolarisation measures were more abnormal, and testosterone correlated with diastolic function.

38387066.takeaway: Among 2.9 million U.S. adults with diabetes, small-town residents were disproportionately affected by complications compared with city residents.

38390197.takeaway: Multivariable Mendelian randomisation suggests childhood adiposity independently affects diabetic nephropathy risk, and may account for part of the effect of adult obesity.

38390211.takeaway: In 50 Polish children with type 1 diabetes, glycaemic control on the MiniMed 780G hybrid closed-loop system stayed stable over two years and weight was maintained.

38394634.takeaway: This award lecture reviews how CGM and hybrid closed-loop systems have improved glycaemia in pregnancy with type 1 diabetes beyond CONCEPTT, with less worry and work for women.

38402861.takeaway: Reviews immune-related endocrinopathies, including thyroid, diabetes, adrenal and pituitary dysfunction, in children treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, and suggests early diagnosis and management.

38402868.takeaway: A 13-year-old boy with heterozygous MC4R early-onset obesity was treated with semaglutide; the authors report efficacy and safety and suggest it may suit monogenic obesity.

38402874.takeaway: In 72 extremely tall adolescents, bilateral knee epiphysiodesis reduced final height efficiently and safely, with greater reduction in boys and when done at earlier bone age.

38404032.takeaway: In 45 obese adolescents, insulin resistance predicted higher FGF-21, and hepatokines were associated with endothelial and vascular markers.

38405141.takeaway: Pineal cysts were common in girls with central precocious puberty, and larger cysts were linked to faster puberty, leading the authors to hypothesise they may trigger CPP.

38405151.takeaway: In patients with CAH followed at NIH, the authors advise age-appropriate stress-dose guidelines during COVID-19 and state that COVID-specific guidance is not needed.

38405153.takeaway: In 104 children with obesity, fasting and postprandial zonulin rose with BMI and insulin resistance, linking intestinal permeability to obesity.

38407006.takeaway: A 2-year-old Chinese girl with short stature and low birthweight had 3M syndrome from a novel OBSL1 variant; the authors suggest c.458dupG may be a hotspot in Chinese patients.

38407229.takeaway: Meta-analysis finds BMI-SDS rises during GnRH analogue treatment for precocious puberty, with body-composition effects varying by baseline BMI; the authors advise lifestyle and diet support.

38408297.takeaway: In 104 Italian cases of neonatal diabetes or congenital severe insulin resistance, next-generation sequencing from 2013 to 2022 improved diagnosis and enabled precision therapy.

38410000.takeaway: At one paediatric tertiary centre, youth-onset type 2 diabetes case rates peaked in the first pandemic year and returned to pre-pandemic levels by year three.

38412033.takeaway: In 251 adolescents with type 1 diabetes recording 3,319 activities, postexercise glucose and nocturnal hypoglycaemia depended on activity duration and other participant and event factors.

38412310.takeaway: Polygenic scores for adult testosterone and SHBG were associated with reproductive hormone levels and their trajectories during infancy in male infants.

38414167.takeaway: A 14-month-old liver-transplant recipient developed hypercalcaemia and hypophosphataemia from exclusive almond milk; the authors advise against relying on it solely in infants and toddlers.

38415346.takeaway: Germline genome sequencing of 97 children with nonmedullary thyroid cancer found clinically relevant tumour-predisposition variants, supporting genetic counselling for all such patients.

38415841.takeaway: In 122 patients with adrenocortical carcinoma, PD-1 expression was a strong prognostic marker, and heterogeneous checkpoint expression may explain variable immunotherapy responses.

38415861.takeaway: In 551 patients with small intestinal neuroendocrine tumours, a modified grading system using Ki67 cutoffs of 5% and 10% may predict survival better than standard grading.

38417013.takeaway: In 111 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes using CGM, higher mean glucose and greater gestational weight gain independently predicted delivering a large-for-gestational-age infant.

38417014.takeaway: In 112 pregnancies with type 1 diabetes in Spain, off-label hybrid closed-loop users had similar glycaemic control to injection users but gained more weight and had larger newborns.

38417017.takeaway: In a feasibility study of 17 adults with type 1 diabetes, a hands-free closed-loop system that bolused for meals from gestures was safe and kept glycaemic control similar to carbohydrate counting.

38420910.takeaway: Reports the adult outcome of a woman with partial androgen insensitivity assigned female in infancy, highlighting the lifelong nature of the diagnosis and health-care reminders.

38421314.takeaway: In 110 parents of children starting growth hormone, improved child quality of life was linked to less parental caregiving burden, supporting patient-reported outcomes in treatment decisions.

38421672.takeaway: In a TOBOGM secondary analysis, women with early gestational diabetes had more adverse perinatal outcomes despite treatment from 24 to 28 weeks, suggesting earlier, more intensive treatment.

38425434.takeaway: In 351 children, accelerated early growth and weight gain predicted higher androgen levels and earlier puberty in girls, while small-birth-size children without catch-up growth were not shifted earlier.

38425490.takeaway: In five individuals with 17β-HSD3 deficiency, four novel variants were found, and the authors emphasise early intervention for genital appearance concerns.

38425754.takeaway: Meta-analysis finds PFAS exposure associated with glucolipid metabolism disturbances in children and adolescents, with PFOS possibly important and stronger associations in females.

38432193.takeaway: In a Belgian registry cohort of 54 genotyped patients with Noonan syndrome, long-term GH improved adult height and BMI regardless of genotype or cardiac and thoracic anomalies.

38434515.takeaway: In 93 women with PCOS and 33 controls, higher serum chemerin was linked to dysglycaemia and may help identify PCOS women with dysglycaemia.

38436354.takeaway: Five patients with transcobalamin II deficiency, including one new TCN2 variant, suggest newborn screening can detect the disorder early, when treatment can be life-saving.

38436980.takeaway: Reviews mini-puberty as a physiological wave of HPG activity after birth and its absence in congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, noting small series suggesting possible benefit from gonadotropin replacement.

38437850.takeaway: In a six-centre cross-sectional study of adult men with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, spontaneous reversal patterns were examined to identify reversal classes and predictors.

38441224.takeaway: In 792 UK children followed to age 24, higher light physical activity at 15 years was linked to lower insulin and HOMA-IR, supporting activity and lower body fat as targets.

38441533.takeaway: In 144 patients aged 21 or younger with medullary thyroid cancer, sporadic cases were older, with larger tumours and more advanced disease at follow-up than hereditary cases.

38441904.takeaway: In paediatric hospital admissions, Dexcom G6 CGM accuracy was similar during DKA and non-DKA, and held up during IV insulin, suggesting possible inpatient use.

38442699.takeaway: In a 13-year-old boy, multifocal pancreatic insulinomas were the sole presenting feature of MEN1, supporting MEN1 genetic testing in young patients with insulinomas.

38442738.takeaway: In 49 patients with hypophosphataemic rickets, 16 novel PHEX variants were characterised, and several disrupted PHEX function through synthesis, trafficking or catalytic activity.

38444307.takeaway: A 2.9-year-old boy with pituitary stalk interruption syndrome had a novel ROBO1 frameshift variant and posterior pituitary dysfunction, suggesting ROBO1 should be tested in PSIS.

38444312.takeaway: In 51 adolescents starting hybrid closed loop at diagnosis, glycaemic outcomes at 24 months were similar whether or not they had DKA at onset, suggesting HCL may mitigate its effect.

38444316.takeaway: Among 13 non-Hispanic Black youth with type 1 diabetes and HbA1c of at least 10%, six months of hybrid closed loop improved time in range and quality of life without increased safety risks.

38445628.takeaway: A machine learning model using one week of CGM data predicted a clinically significant hypoglycaemic event in the following week, with average ROC-AUC 0.74 across three cohorts.

38449846.takeaway: An XGBoost model using interview-obtainable factors such as race, age and BMI predicted vitamin D deficiency in NHANES data and was made available as an online calculator.

38449854.takeaway: Using SEER data, an XGBoost model incorporating socioeconomic and regional factors estimates cervical lymph node metastasis risk in children with differentiated thyroid cancer and was built into a web calculator.

38459773.takeaway: Post-menarche women with CAH had AMH levels and antral follicle counts comparable to controls, with smaller uterine and ovarian volumes; the authors link good adherence to good ovarian reserve.

38461800.takeaway: Overview of the Kabi International Growth Study, which found rhGH safe and increasing short-term and adult height in GH deficiency and other short-stature conditions.

38461801.takeaway: Narrative review contrasting paediatric and adult osteoporosis: paediatric diagnosis rests on fragility fractures rather than low bone density, and medication-free bone recovery can occur.

38461802.takeaway: In a Nigerian prospective cohort of non-diabetic pregnancies, maternal HOMA-IR was not associated with neonatal insulin resistance, birth size or body composition.

38461803.takeaway: In 1,748 Korean children aged 10 to 18, birth weight alone did not determine body composition or bone mass across small, appropriate and large for gestational age groups.

38461804.takeaway: In 37 children with suspected genetic short stature, next-generation sequencing confirmed diagnoses in 15, with the highest yield among children born small for gestational age.

38461805.takeaway: In 21 nonambulatory children with low bone density, pamidronate improved bone density without significant adverse events, and larger doses per kilogram were linked to bigger gains.

38461806.takeaway: Prenatal CYP21A2 testing in 27 families at risk of 21-hydroxylase deficiency allowed early hydrocortisone and fludrocortisone treatment of affected newborns, preventing adrenal crisis.

38461807.takeaway: A 16-month-old boy with familial male-limited precocious puberty from an activating LHCGR variant was treated with bicalutamide and anastrozole, suppressing puberty without side effects.

38462926.takeaway: In 80 euthyroid children with type 1 diabetes, metabolic syndrome was more common than in 30 controls, and thyroid hormone sensitivity indices were linked to metabolic parameters.

38462927.takeaway: In eight children tested with clonidine or L-Dopa, serum copeptin did not change, so neither agent supports copeptin testing for AVP-related disorders in practice.

38463009.takeaway: In a retrospective review of paediatric GHD, once biases were minimised, boys and girls had similar imaging abnormalities and pituitary hormone deficiencies, with no male predominance.

38464968.takeaway: In 30 sibling pairs, children with idiopathic short stature had gut microbiota different from their normal-height siblings, and the authors suggest microbiota may partly explain growth variation.

38465442.takeaway: In lingual thyroid with subclinical hypothyroidism, hormone suppression may reduce gland size and improve symptoms; surgery may be considered if growth or symptoms persist.

38465704.takeaway: Long-term follow-up of four children with Wolfram syndrome found a novel WFS1 deletion and poorly contractile bladders in three, highlighting the need to assess lower urinary tract function.

38465999.takeaway: In five consanguineous RET families, homozygous carriers developed MEN2A tumours in their mid-teens, decades earlier than heterozygotes, consistent with a dose-response effect.

38468563.takeaway: Among 3,628 childhood cancer survivors, hypogonadism was linked mainly to slower processing speed, while other cognitive domains were shaped by cancer-related factors.

38469646.takeaway: In two 14.5-year-old twins with MCT8 deficiency, glycerol phenylbutyrate improved thyroid hormone profile and BMI with minor neurodevelopmental change, though liver transaminases rose.

38470864.takeaway: Children followed in preclinical monitoring studies had about a tenth of the DKA rate at type 1 diabetes diagnosis compared with community patients, including minority children.

38471476.takeaway: In young adult women followed from childhood, a history of premature adrenarche did not impair health-related quality of life compared with age-matched controls.

38471485.takeaway: In a Paris prospective cohort of term newborns, expected serum calcium at 3 days ranged from 2.06 to 2.73 mmol/L, wider than the adult range.

38471495.takeaway: A UK national survey found only 12% of clinicians completely satisfied with CAH services for children, versus 68% of carers and 76% of patients.

38477491.takeaway: In about 300,000 Fukushima children and adolescents followed prospectively, overweight was associated with new thyroid nodules, mostly in adolescent females.

38477512.takeaway: Common pubertal-timing variants contributed strongly to constitutional delay of puberty, weakly to normosmic IHH, and possibly not to Kallmann syndrome, so these genetic architectures differ.

38477546.takeaway: In 1,002 Paris newborns, the lower limit of serum calcium was higher with higher cord 25-hydroxyvitamin D, leading the authors to propose a neonatal reference range of 2.25 to 2.75 mmol/L.

38481036.takeaway: A ten-year registry study of all adult Faroese found a high incidence of autoimmune thyroid disease despite declining iodine intake.

38481440.takeaway: Describes a young child with X-linked acrogigantism whose hormone excess was controlled with neurosurgery and high-dose first-generation somatostatin analogues.

38481442.takeaway: Among 389 children with X-chromosome abnormalities found by FISH screening, a higher proportion of X deletion was linked to more Turner phenotypic features, but not to renal disease.

38487340.takeaway: Faecal metabolomics in 37 girls with precocious puberty and 25 controls, plus a rat model, implicated altered pathways, and thymine supplementation delayed puberty in model rats.

38487852.takeaway: In 20 children with early type 1 diabetes and no retinopathy, retinal nerve fibre layer was thinner than in 20 controls, and thinning tracked with higher HbA1c.

38488037.takeaway: In 573 children with obesity, impaired fasting glucose and glucose tolerance were common and often reversed, while progression to type 2 diabetes was rare.

38488049.takeaway: A multicentre survey during COVID-19 found 15% poor adherence to growth hormone treatment, with longer treatment duration and older age as important factors.

38488050.takeaway: Reviews long-acting growth hormone formulations, which may improve adherence and, in randomised trials, restore growth velocity as effectively as daily treatment.

38488051.takeaway: Reviews ISPAD 2018 to 2022 guidance and presents ten key recommendations for paediatric type 1 diabetes care, emphasising teamwork and technology.

38493773.takeaway: In 72 children with arginine vasopressin deficiency from craniopharyngioma or germ cell tumours, MRI features and timing differed by tumour type, supporting early differential diagnosis.

38493780.takeaway: A 13-year-old boy with autosomal dominant hypophosphatemic rickets had a novel FGF23 variant outside the furin motif that resists proteolysis, the first such variant reported.

38494876.takeaway: In a six-month trial of 133 children and adolescents, Cambridge closed-loop insulin delivery appeared cost-effective below £20,000 per QALY in the UK and cost-saving in the US.

38495788.takeaway: In 153 children treated with rhGH, those with definite GH deficiency had lower baseline IGF-1 and larger treatment-related rises than those with short stature unresponsive to stimulation tests.

38495791.takeaway: Reviews surgical treatment of cryptorchidism, its effects on testicular development and fertility, and current Nordic, EAU and AUA guidance, with long-term follow-up advised.

38499689.takeaway: Reviews how the metabolic profiles of osteoblasts, osteoclasts and chondrocytes match their nutritional environment and stage, and how this may drive skeletal disease.

38501100.takeaway: Reviews anti-Müllerian hormone as a biomarker of testicular function from birth to early puberty, and its unclear role in testicular descent and cryptorchidism.

38502240.takeaway: In two Scandinavian birth cohorts of 153,843 mother-child pairs, prenatal EPA and DHA intake was not associated with offspring type 1 diabetes, so a prevention trial was not prioritised.

38505749.takeaway: A 46-year-old woman with primary aldosteronism had an adenoma with CTNNB1 and GNA11 mutations showing zona glomerulosa features, and was cured by surgery.

38505753.takeaway: In a mouse model, maternal diabetes combined with Hif1a deficiency altered cardiac sympathetic development and vasculature, which the authors link to higher neonatal death risk.

38505758.takeaway: In 39,200 singleton births, higher maternal serum albumin in early pregnancy was associated with poorer fetal growth, with effects apparent by mid-gestation.

38506158.takeaway: In Lombardy, liver-related mortality fell in people with diabetes from 2010 to 2019, but non-viral, non-alcoholic causes made up most deaths and the excess over controls stayed constant.

38513624.takeaway: Reviews ketotic hypoglycaemia in young children, distinguishing physiological from pathological forms, with an approach to investigation and management.

38514815.takeaway: Reviews the IGF acid-labile subunit, which stabilises circulating IGF complexes and shapes postnatal growth and metabolism, with emerging roles in disease.

38516410.takeaway: Mendelian randomisation finds a causal association between plasma eIF4G levels and central precocious puberty in two cohorts, and the authors call for studies of prevention or treatment.

38516411.takeaway: In 25 women who had ovarian tissue transplantation, ten pregnancies, four live births and two ongoing pregnancies were recorded, supporting fertility-preservation counselling.

38517484.takeaway: In a European cohort of newly diagnosed people aged 1 to 45 with type 1 diabetes, C-peptide was lower in younger children, but its rate of decline did not differ by age.

38523344.takeaway: In 52 North Indian children with idiopathic short stature and 68 controls, specific ESR1 genotypes were associated with ISS risk.

38523345.takeaway: Handheld point-of-care thyroid ultrasound by a paediatric endocrinologist was feasible, but the authors advise radiology referral with full-size equipment for nodule classification.

38523346.takeaway: Among 182 Sardinian children, 32% had insufficient or deficient vitamin D, and passive smoke exposure was a significant risk factor for low levels.

38523472.takeaway: In 43 boys with central precocious puberty treated in Helsinki, incidence rose over 1990 to 2014, and organic causes were linked to shorter stature, younger age and higher basal testosterone.

38524636.takeaway: A case report suggests semaglutide may be a possible alternative to insulin for an 18-year-old woman with HNF1B-MODY, though longer-term safety data are needed.

38526559.takeaway: Among 28,827 Ontario adults with type 1 diabetes, about one-third met the HbA1c target of 7.0% or lower in 2023, with improvement since 2021.

38529102.takeaway: In 6,305 Kuwaiti children followed from age 10 to 12, high soda intake was linked to higher obesity prevalence, milk showed a weaker association, and juice none.

38529393.takeaway: In 47 healthy children aged 4 to 14, fasting serum SIRT1 did not differ by sex, age, puberty or body size, but higher fruit, vegetable and dairy intake was linked to higher levels.

38529548.takeaway: A 6.5-year-old girl with MIRAGE syndrome from a SAMD9 variant developed hypothyroidism, hypoparathyroidism and dysautonomia, illustrating diverse presentations.

38529810.takeaway: A child with osteoma cutis and medulloblastoma had lost GNAS expression, prompting the authors to urge neurological vigilance in children with inactivating GNAS variants.

38529838.takeaway: New population-based German thyroid volume reference values suggest WHO 2004 values are overly conservative for European children from iodine-sufficient populations.

38531330.takeaway: Study of placental tissue from large-for-gestational-age births proposes that ERRγ1 dysregulation may alter placental estrogen-androgen balance, a possible route in fetal programming.

38532895.takeaway: Reviews pubertal development in boys with non-syndromic congenital or acquired cryptorchidism, finding Leydig cell function generally preserved, with limited data on acquired cases.

38532899.takeaway: In late-stage db/db diabetic mice at 32 weeks, sensory and motor deficits and morphological changes were severe, indicating neurological dysfunction in advanced diabetes.

38534046.takeaway: Among 228 children and adolescents followed after haematopoietic stem cell transplant, endocrine sequelae and gonadotoxicity were common, underlining the need for fertility counselling and bone health care.

38538470.takeaway: A French guideline on congenital hypopituitarism in children covers diagnosis and treatment of combined deficiencies, advising lifelong endocrine follow-up and multidisciplinary care for syndromic forms.

38544685.takeaway: In six men with Triple A syndrome, hormone and testicular studies helped explain infertility, and one woman conceived spontaneously, suggesting pregnancy may be possible.

38544688.takeaway: Surgical placental insufficiency in sheep slowed fetal growth trajectories, producing a characterised FGR model that can be used to test interventions.

38544690.takeaway: A Chinese patient with mandibuloacral dysplasia progeroid syndrome had a novel homozygous MTX2 splice-site variant, the first MTX2-associated case reported in China.

38546821.takeaway: In a 12-month primary-care trial, periodic five-day fasting-mimicking diets reduced glucose-lowering medication needs and improved HbA1c in adults with type 2 diabetes, and appeared safe.

38547465.takeaway: A Saudi expert consensus identifies payer and access barriers to diagnosing and treating growth hormone deficiency in children, and proposes strategies to overcome them.

38549284.takeaway: A systematic review of 76 published pseudoacromegaly cases highlights mimics of acromegaly and stresses GH and IGF-1 assessment before any pituitary surgery.

38552173.takeaway: A Delphi-based international consensus of 21 statements guides mitotane use in paediatric adrenocortical tumours, covering indications, therapy and management of adverse effects.

38554392.takeaway: In an infant cohort, higher early-life PFAS levels at 3 months were associated with faster fat mass gain over six months and lower fat-free mass at two years.

38557593.takeaway: In 17 children with classical CAH, salivary 11-ketotestosterone showed a circadian rhythm that correlated with 17-hydroxyprogesterone, but depended on BMI.

38557870.takeaway: Puberty-specific bone turnover reference curves in 800 Chinese children suggest obesity impairs bone formation in boys and raises bone resorption markers in girls.

38561011.takeaway: In Swedish register data, type 1 diabetes clustered in families and was heritable in childhood onset, while the authors suggest environment plays a larger role in adult onset.

38561783.takeaway: A UK consensus for children and young people with type 2 diabetes, graded by GRADE, offers a practical approach to assessment and management, including adiposity, activity and cardiovascular risk.

38561929.takeaway: Functional testing of a novel nonsense CASR variant found a constitutively active receptor with poor calcium sensitivity, consistent with chronic hypocalcaemia in an adolescent.

38562129.takeaway: In 56 transgender youth, total body BMD Z-scores were slightly below average and lowest in assigned-male youth on GnRH agonist monotherapy, with longer duration linked to lower BMD.

38562410.takeaway: In 1,500 overweight or obese non-diabetic Qatari adults, salivary α-amylase activity was associated with cardiovascular and inflammatory markers, mainly in women.

38563465.takeaway: In 1.15 million Korean infants, full-term low-birthweight children were consistently shorter and lighter than preterm children through the preschool years.

38563802.takeaway: Pooled individual-participant data show neonatal free T4 reference intervals vary by assay and population, and the authors recommend establishing local, laboratory-specific intervals.

38567304.takeaway: Among 12,400 women, singletons born after vitrified blastocyst transfer weighed more and had higher odds of high birth weight than after cleavage-stage transfer.

38567654.takeaway: Functional testing of 17 MC4R variants from adults and children with obesity showed they alter signalling in different ways yet produce similar clinical phenotypes.

38568210.takeaway: In 85 children with DKA, thyroid hormone changes during acute illness did not reliably reflect thyroid disease, so the authors judge routine thyroid testing unnecessary.

38571460.takeaway: A European Reference Network guideline on familial hyperaldosteronism, largely based on expert opinion, covers genetic subtypes, screening and treatment for genetically proven cases.

38572472.takeaway: In 173 paediatric thyroid nodules, lowering fine-needle aspiration thresholds for highly suspicious categories reduced missed malignancy, suggesting FNA criteria could be adjusted.

38574486.takeaway: A preterm neonate with neonatal diabetes, tracheoesophageal fistula and pulmonary vein stenosis had a novel de novo GATA6 variant, supporting cardiac imaging in similar cases.

38577566.takeaway: Meta-analysis finds the link between postnatal rapid growth and dyslipidaemia depends on confounders such as growth duration, national development and birth weight.

38578777.takeaway: A de novo activating GUCY1A2 variant in one patient with precocious peripheral puberty raised cGMP in functional assays, suggesting a syndromic form of autonomous ovarian puberty.

38578952.takeaway: Review argues that male puberty confers lasting physical advantages that justify protected female sport categories, and proposes a multistrand definition of biological sex.

38578980.takeaway: In 59 Finnish children with APECED, height declined progressively from birth through prepuberty, with disease severity and growth hormone deficiency as risk factors.

38584334.takeaway: In a prospective CAH study, adrenal crisis and stress dosing were frequent in children and adults, and most adult stress dosing did not follow German guidance, highlighting transition education needs.

38586466.takeaway: Sequencing 55 calcium-metabolism genes in 79 patients with hypercalcaemia found pathogenic variants in 30%, including 11 novel variants, supporting genetic testing.

38590442.takeaway: In 506 youth with type 2 diabetes from the TODAY study, no variant reached genome-wide significance, and an ATRNL1 variant was linked to worse metformin response on replication.

38590824.takeaway: Meta-analysis finds machine-learning models using clinical, hormonal and imaging data show high sensitivity, specificity and AUC for diagnosing central precocious puberty, though geographic applicability is limited.

38592062.takeaway: In adolescents with type 1 diabetes, arterial stiffness was linked to proinflammatory cytokines, and IL-10 correlated negatively with HbA1c and blood lipids.

38596219.takeaway: A child with a Silver-Russell-like phenotype and a novel paternally inherited IGF2 variant had improved height SDS with long-term growth hormone treatment.

38596222.takeaway: Reviews how gut microbiota dysbiosis and altered intestinal permeability relate to obesity and type 2 diabetes, and microbiota-based strategies to prevent or treat them.

38598969.takeaway: Expert consensus gives practical recommendations on lipoprotein apheresis for children with homozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia, covering indications, LDL goals and follow-up.

38601206.takeaway: In 2,382 diabetic patients from the MIMIC-IV database, machine learning highlighted hematocrit, haemoglobin, anion gap, age and comorbidity index as features associated with ketoacidosis.

38605470.takeaway: In 25 patients with APECED, systematic screening found more potentially life-threatening nonendocrine manifestations, which may add to disease severity.

38606830.takeaway: Critical appraisal of CGM metrics in pregnancy complicated by diabetes finds time-in-range targets are rarely maintained, leaving open questions about benefit and outcomes.

38609170.takeaway: In 53 transgender women randomised to cyproterone acetate or spironolactone, six months of feminising hormone therapy shifted the plasma metabolome toward an anti-atherogenic profile.

38613666.takeaway: Nordic register data show late preterm and early term birth raise type 1 diabetes risk in childhood and young adulthood, while extremely and very preterm birth lowers it.

38613811.takeaway: In 161 children with Graves' disease, neutropenia was more frequent with carbimazole than methimazole, and low pre-treatment neutrophil counts did not necessarily contraindicate treatment.

38615333.takeaway: Childhood diabetes incidence in Northern Thailand rose over two decades; during COVID-19, T1D incidence stayed stable while T2D incidence increased significantly.

38616550.takeaway: In 10 patients with congenital hyperinsulinism, the Dexcom G7 CGM had lower error and detected more hypoglycaemia than the G6, but still missed about 40% of episodes.

38616820.takeaway: Retrospective brain MRI review in children found white-matter changes suggesting hypoglycaemic injury without a known hypoglycaemia history, implying unrecognised early-life hypoglycaemia.

38618862.takeaway: In a post hoc analysis of girls with central precocious puberty, bone age to chronological age ratio before and after leuprolide may help anticipate time to first menses.

38618883.takeaway: A 14-year-old neuroblastoma survivor with premature ovarian insufficiency had a false-positive pregnancy test from pituitary hCG, confirmed by an LH/hCG suppression test.

38621411.takeaway: A post hoc analysis of six TrialNet immunotherapy trials found early stimulated metabolic measures distinguished successful treatments and predicted 12-month outcomes, supporting shorter early-phase trials.

38623954.takeaway: In silico and functional analyses of 35 novel NR5A1/SF-1 variants did not fully explain broad DSD phenotypes, and nine individuals had likely additional variants, suggesting oligogenic effects.

38624096.takeaway: Patients with Gaucher disease on enzyme replacement had thyroid, insulin resistance, lipid and bone abnormalities that the authors suggest assessing in routine follow-up.

38625056.takeaway: In 1,987 mother-child pairs, higher maternal fasting glucose trajectories in pregnancy were associated with refractive errors at age 6, with the first two trimesters possibly critical.

38626164.takeaway: In 11 sellar neurocytomas, hyponatraemia was the dominant clinical feature, and SSTR2 expression suggests somatostatin receptor ligands may be a potential therapy.

38626260.takeaway: In 368 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, MiniMed 780G improved glucose metrics within 15 days and the gains held over a year, including in those with low engagement.

38626285.takeaway: In 140 patients with Carney complex, 36% had GH excess and 20% symptomatic acromegaly, with most carrying PRKAR1A variants and genotype linked to GH dysregulation.

38626741.takeaway: A 2-year-old girl with peripheral precocious puberty had an ovarian Sertoli cell tumour and Peutz-Jeghers syndrome from a STK11 variant, the youngest such case reported.

38627922.takeaway: In 219 Danish transgender adolescents on GnRH agonists with sex steroids, adult height stayed within two SD of sex assigned at birth, with a minor height loss in trans girls.

38628580.takeaway: In 20 adolescents with suboptimal control, Control-IQ hybrid closed loop lowered HbA1c from 10.0% to 7.0% over six months, with two mild DKA episodes.

38628584.takeaway: A child with sporadic Kallmann syndrome carried an inherited IL17RD variant and a new CPEB4 nonsense variant, broadening the genes linked to Kallmann syndrome.

38628587.takeaway: In girls with early puberty and compromised growth prediction, continuing anastrozole after combined treatment further improved predicted near-adult height, most when continued until bone age 14.

38628589.takeaway: In 691 Chinese women with type 2 diabetes in pregnancy, inappropriate gestational weight gain was linked to adverse outcomes, and the optimal range may differ from IOM recommendations.

38629854.takeaway: Reviews neonatal hypoglycaemia, distinguishing transitional hypoglycaemia from persistent hyperinsulinaemic disorders that must be identified before discharge to prevent neurological injury.

38630246.takeaway: Routine MY-Q screening of adolescents with type 1 diabetes flagged mood concerns in about 30%, with 2.9% referred to mental health, and needed no additional resources.

38630895.takeaway: A patient with a homozygous TUFM missense variant had lactic acidosis, hypotonia, liver dysfunction, optic atrophy and mild encephalopathy, expanding the clinical spectrum of TUFM disease.

38633761.takeaway: In women with familial partial lipodystrophy type 2, fetal complications were frequent, though none reported infertility, underlining contraception planning around metabolic control.

38633762.takeaway: Reviews congenital cryptorchidism epidemiology, with prevalence from 1% to 9% and risk factors including preterm birth and endocrine-disrupting chemicals, though human evidence is complex.

38634410.takeaway: A systematic review links higher ambient temperature and humidity with altered serum sodium, and the authors infer hyponatraemia presentations may rise with climate change.

38634616.takeaway: In 129 children and adolescents at a psychiatric centre, new long-term antipsychotic users gained z-BMI, while those with depression and obesity on sertraline tended to lose it.

38636486.takeaway: A 15-year-old with transient congenital hypothyroidism had a partial loss-of-function NKX2-1 variant plus a DUOX2 nonsense variant and polymorphism, causing high serum thyroglobulin.

38636488.takeaway: In children on GH, first-year height response predicted long-term outcome in GH deficiency but hardly at all in small-for-gestational-age children.

38637868.takeaway: An Italian multisociety position paper on adolescent gender dysphoria calls for standardised, evidence-based care delivered in accredited multidisciplinary centres.

38640020.takeaway: In nationwide Danish registers, people with diabetes and severe mental illness had higher hospitalisation rates for hypoglycaemia and DKA, with the largest gaps under age 50.

38644699.takeaway: A fetus with hyperthyroidism from a toxic thyroid adenoma, with maternal Graves' disease excluded, was treated medically after birth and later by thyroidectomy.

38644701.takeaway: Compared with 29 healthy children, 16 children with Graves' disease showed irritability, oppositional and conduct symptoms, supporting follow-up for psychiatric comorbidity.

38647408.takeaway: Two Malaysian brothers with central hypothyroidism and macro-orchidism carried a novel likely pathogenic variant, and the authors advise family segregation testing.

38648259.takeaway: Across 6,775 Norwegian children with type 1 diabetes from 2013 to 2022, HbA1c improved with greater technology use, carbohydrate counting and quality-improvement participation.

38650427.takeaway: A 15-month-old 46,XY infant with ambiguous genitalia had a novel homozygous NR5A1 variant and hyposplenism with normal adrenal function, so such patients need adrenal and splenic monitoring.

38650713.takeaway: In 82 girls with central precocious puberty and 57 prepubertal controls, α-Klotho showed moderate diagnostic accuracy (AUC 0.723, sensitivity 69.5%, specificity 70.2%).

38650715.takeaway: Reviews the relationship between vitamin D and type 1 and type 2 diabetes in children and adults, including effects on insulin secretion, insulin resistance and complications.

38652605.takeaway: New LC-MS/MS oestradiol reference intervals from 1,724 healthy children aged 0 to 18 show mini-puberty in both sexes and typical pubertal patterns, underlining laboratory-specific ranges.

38653206.takeaway: Review of GnRH analogue monitoring studies and unpublished phase 3 data suggests subcutaneous leuprolide acetate suppresses LH and sex steroids similarly to intramuscular forms, supporting its use for monitoring.

38654931.takeaway: Reviews endocrine, auxological and metabolic disorders in children and young adults with Down syndrome, including thyroid dysfunction, diabetes, osteopenia, obesity and transition to adult care.

38655793.takeaway: Reviews eating-disorder risk in youth undergoing obesity treatment, noting structured weight programmes may reduce binge eating and bulimia symptoms, and offers provider guidance.

38660519.takeaway: Placental RNA-seq in hyperglycaemic mothers with macrosomic births identified 74 genes shared with macrosomia and ten hub genes as possible drivers.

38661069.takeaway: In a 13-year-old girl with primary hyperparathyroidism, [18F]fluorocholine PET/CT was used, and surgery normalised PTH with a confirmed parathyroid adenoma.

38661205.takeaway: In a registry of 34 people with autosomal dominant osteopetrosis, adults reported a high impact on quality of life, while children and their parents reported none.

38662611.takeaway: On postnatal day 7 in preterm infants, the TSH/fT4 ratio strongly distinguished congenital hypothyroidism from transient hyperthyrotropinaemia or hypothyroxinaemia, with an AUC of 0.999.

38662730.takeaway: In children treated for craniopharyngioma, BMI SDS rose in nearly all, including those with hypothalamus spared, though hypothalamic integrity was linked to less weight gain.

38662803.takeaway: In 150 prepubertal children with severe obesity, high free IGF-I, IGF-II and insulin may contribute to accelerated growth, and weight loss shifted several of these markers.

38663372.takeaway: A Pediatric Endocrine Society statement gives practical considerations for teplizumab to delay progression from stage 2 to stage 3 type 1 diabetes in children, covering infusions, prescreening and monitoring.

38663373.takeaway: German PATRO data suggest GH treatment in GHD, SGA and Turner syndrome could improve with earlier start and earlier dose adjustment, with responsiveness unchanged over 2007 to 2018.

38664930.takeaway: In 31 infants aged 0 to 6 months, only LH assays detecting intact and beta-subunit forms should be used in the neonatal period, to avoid hCG cross-reactivity.

38664989.takeaway: In 121 children with ultrasound-diagnosed fatty liver, the triglyceride-glucose index correlated with steatosis after BMI adjustment, with a cut-off of 8.91 predicting high fat indicator (AUC 0.785).

38664994.takeaway: In a nationwide Turkish paediatric craniopharyngioma cohort, recurrence mainly followed incomplete resection and low postoperative radiotherapy, and early obesity prevention was suggested.

38665000.takeaway: In 224 genetically diagnosed Turkish children with MODY, GCK and HNF1A variants were most common, hyperglycaemia was the usual presentation, and most received diet management alone.

38669475.takeaway: In 225 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, random forest models predicted post-exercise dysglycaemia, and starting activity at 130 to 160 mg/dL with a flat or falling trend was suggested to lower risk.

38677287.takeaway: A 65-expert international consensus sets recommendations for paediatric MAFLD, recognising its links with obesity, insulin resistance and atherogenic dyslipidaemia.

38681768.takeaway: In 19 children operated for craniopharyngioma, deep venous thrombosis and vascular changes occurred, with the shift from diabetes insipidus to SIADH possibly high-risk, calling for vascular follow-up.

38681770.takeaway: Describes the design and baseline data of a population-based prospective cohort of 5,799 adults in northern Iran studying obesity-related metabolic disorders and cardiovascular disease.

38683018.takeaway: In a single-centre paediatric thyroid cancer cohort, persistence or recurrence was more frequent with lymphovascular invasion (55.6% vs 0%), which may inform risk-based decisions.

38683019.takeaway: In newly diagnosed Malaysian children with T1D over 11 years, DKA rates showed no downward trend, and misdiagnosis and age 5 years or older predicted DKA.

38683020.takeaway: In 416 adolescents aged 12 to 18, those with obesity had poorer sleep quality and more social jet lag, and greater social jet lag was linked to higher BMI.

38683021.takeaway: Reviews delayed puberty and its causes, comparing traditional with physiological induction protocols, and notes constitutional delay is the most common cause.

38683034.takeaway: Reviews conventional and next-generation genetic techniques for diagnosing DSD, noting that a genetic cause remains unidentified in many cases despite current testing.

38684152.takeaway: In 62 children with CPP on 6-monthly subcutaneous leuprolide, unstimulated LH below 1 IU/L was a reasonable surrogate of response, and all completers showed suppression.

38685764.takeaway: In 188 mother-newborn pairs, maternal and cord thyroid hormones and maternal iodine status were not conclusively linked to birth weight, though cord TSH correlated negatively with birth length in girls.

38688258.takeaway: Reviews the shift from insulin replacement to disease-modifying immunotherapy in type 1 diabetes, including teplizumab and other agents under study, and multicentre trial networks.

38691652.takeaway: In 91 children aged 6 to 17, plasma pentraxin-3 was higher in obese children but inversely related to subcutaneous fat, suggesting it reflects lower inflammation.

38691659.takeaway: In 48 patients with corticotroph tumours, somatic USP8 variants were found in half and were more common in women, with a non-significant trend to shorter recurrence-free survival.

38694145.takeaway: Cluster analysis of 722 autoantibody-negative youth with type 2 diabetes identified subgroups with distinct clinical features that may inform precision management.

38695494.takeaway: At a Tripoli children's hospital, nearly half of newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes presentations had DKA, and very young children had about fivefold higher odds of presenting with it.

38696519.takeaway: In Welsh laboratory data, low FT4 with inappropriate TSH had a much lower predictive value for central hypothyroidism than previously reported, so screening must weigh yield against cost.

38696672.takeaway: In 179 people aged 6 to 75 with type 1 diabetes, ultra-rapid lispro in a Control-IQ pump over 13 weeks was judged safe, with quality-of-life benefits reported by participants.

38697182.takeaway: In a randomised trial of pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, the MiniMed 780G was safe and gave some benefits over standard insulin therapy, though the algorithm needs refining for pregnancy.

38697184.takeaway: In an open-label phase 2 trial, setmelanotide was judged effective for hypothalamic obesity in patients aged 6 to 40, and 12 extension participants averaged a 26% BMI reduction at 12 months.

38698871.takeaway: In twin pregnancies, GDM risk profiles resembled singleton pregnancies, and outcomes under GDM management matched twin pregnancies without GDM, though postpartum glucose testing was poor.

38699383.takeaway: A 4-year-old girl with late-diagnosed simple virilising CAH and Williams syndrome developed central precocious puberty after starting corticosteroid treatment.

38699388.takeaway: Reviews the genetics of Mayer-Rokitansky-Küster-Hauser syndrome, from familial recurrence and candidate genes to genomic studies, with implications for recurrence counselling.

38700489.takeaway: Across 12 studies of 514 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, automated insulin delivery did not significantly reduce hypoglycaemia during or after exercise.

38701341.takeaway: In a retrospective Minnesota newborn screening analysis, adding CYP21A2 molecular testing to multitier protocols could cut false positives without missing cases, though implementation challenges remain.

38701358.takeaway: A national reference centre found a 113-gene hereditary cancer panel faster and cost-efficient for detecting genetic alterations in endocrine tumour patients, with incidental variants possibly guiding therapy.

38701365.takeaway: Serum cathepsin S was elevated in children with new-onset type 1 diabetes and in autoantibody-positive siblings, and β-cells expressed it, suggesting a possible diagnostic biomarker.

38703083.takeaway: In Japanese pregnancies, PCOS raised GDM risk in a manner that depended on prepregnancy BMI, which may inform personalised preconception counselling.

38703096.takeaway: In 424 Chinese children aged 6 to 9, several plasma and fecal metabolites, including bile acids and stearoylcarnitine, were positively associated with BMI and body fat distribution.

38705144.takeaway: In 67 children, combined arginine and levodopa produced a robust copeptin peak in healthy short children and primary polydipsia, and may be a suitable first screen for AVP deficiency.

38706116.takeaway: Five children with primary hyperparathyroidism presented atypically, with rickets persisting despite vitamin D, pancreatitis, nephrolithiasis or psychiatric symptoms, so calcium testing should be considered.

38706300.takeaway: Genotyping of phenylketonuria patients in eastern Türkiye showed genetic heterogeneity, with novel PAH variants and more frequent variants in classic cases.

38706369.takeaway: The authors developed CAHQL, a patient-reported instrument for health-related quality of life in adults with classic CAH, which they describe as the first validated disease-specific tool for CAH.

38706378.takeaway: In French VHL carriers with pancreatic NETs, metastasis risk was 24% overall and rose with tumour size over 28 mm, higher grade and exon 1 variants, supporting expert-centre referral.

38706529.takeaway: In 54 East African youth with type 1 diabetes, standard HbA1c-to-glucose equations overestimated mean glucose, which could raise hypoglycaemia risk if HbA1c alone guides insulin.

38706530.takeaway: In young adults with youth-onset diabetes, neuropathy and higher blood pressure clustered with lower cognitive scores, with hypoglycaemia also linked in type 1, suggesting targets to mitigate cognitive problems.

38706696.takeaway: An Italian position statement reviews diagnosis, treatment and management of rickets, covering nutritional and genetic forms, with diagnostic algorithms and recommendations for rare hereditary types.

38706697.takeaway: In a non-randomised single-centre trial, short-term ondansetron was an effective prophylactic against nausea and vomiting after radioiodine therapy for thyroid cancer, and multiple or higher-dose treatment raised GI-disorder risk.

38708581.takeaway: In youth using CGM, those who performed more diabetes self-management habits achieved better glycaemia risk index scores.

38709662.takeaway: Among 461,849 Danish adults with type 2 diabetes from 2000 to 2020, polypharmacy increased, with uncertain appropriateness and risks from interactions and adverse effects.

38710189.takeaway: In three US prospective cohorts of adults, self-reported melatonin supplement use was not associated with risk of type 2 diabetes or cardiovascular disease.

38710228.takeaway: A German position paper on islet autoantibody screening for early type 1 diabetes weighs its benefits and drawbacks, and calls for paediatrician training and regional laboratories to implement it.

38712328.takeaway: In 47 children at type 1 diabetes diagnosis, starting insulin changed circulating IGF-system components including PAPP-A2 and STC2, though the effect on linear growth is unknown.

38712386.takeaway: Using TrialNet data, the authors built three personalised risk models for time to type 1 diabetes in people with multiple autoantibodies, since progression rates are not explained by any single variable.

38712491.takeaway: Reviews adolescent gynaecomastia, which is mostly physiological and transient from estrogen-androgen imbalance, and outlines when pathological causes should be sought and how to manage it.

38712492.takeaway: In 100 girls with premature thelarche, a triptorelin stimulation test appeared a valid alternative to the gonadorelin test for diagnosing central precocious puberty, and 120 minutes of sampling sufficed.

38712493.takeaway: In 129 girls aged 15 to 18, predictors of bone mass differed by body fat group, and body fat and waist circumference were negative predictors of bone mass.

38714321.takeaway: A joint European and Endocrine Society guideline gives recommendations on diagnosing and treating glucocorticoid-induced adrenal insufficiency, including tapering and patient education.

38715286.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes, the Glycemia Risk Index correlated with longitudinal HbA1c, mainly through time in hyperglycaemia, and may help assess glycaemia between clinic visits.

38715798.takeaway: In 93 young men, several surrogate insulin resistance indices were compared with the Matsuda index, and optimal cut-offs were proposed for preventive screening.

38717038.takeaway: In a post hoc analysis of Asian children with GH deficiency, once-weekly somatrogon was non-inferior to daily somatropin, consistent with the overall trial population.

38717898.takeaway: In 1,767 adults aged 18 to 49, levonorgestrel IUD use was associated with several moderate metabolomic changes, mostly suggesting lower arterial cardiometabolic risk.

38717911.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 137 Argentine cases of congenital hypopituitarism found pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in 19% of known genes and 16% of new genes, and proposed 13 candidate genes.

38718766.takeaway: A survey of 223 US paediatric endocrinologists found large cost differences between paediatric and adult GnRH analogue formulations and little evidence for safe use of adult ones in children.

38718769.takeaway: A global survey of 175 paediatric diabetes physicians from 62 countries found adherence to ISPAD guidance on vascular complications varied with country income, with knowledge gaps.

38718776.takeaway: In 10 children born to mothers with Graves' disease and neonatal hyperthyroidism, most had no severe neurodevelopmental impairment, but early detection and support were recommended.

38718777.takeaway: A global questionnaire found low-dose oestradiol tablets much less available than low-dose patches, with the lowest tablet dose in most countries at 2 mg.

38720938.takeaway: In mice, maternal caloric restriction during gestation and lactation produced smaller offspring, and adult male offspring resisted high-fat-diet weight gain, with sex-specific changes.

38721144.takeaway: In differentiated thyroid cancer with positive postoperative anti-thyroglobulin antibodies, a fall of over 47% identified patients without disease, which may help avoid overtreatment.

38722819.takeaway: Genetic testing of six families with X-linked hypophosphataemia identified rare and novel PHEX variants, and the authors propose a multi-method workflow for suspected XLH.

38723170.takeaway: In 108 children with NAFLD, controlled attenuation parameter had potential as a steatosis measure against MRI-PDFF, but ALT was simpler and more accurate.

38724043.takeaway: A joint European and Endocrine Society guideline gives recommendations on diagnosing and treating glucocorticoid-induced adrenal insufficiency, including tapering and patient education.

38736368.takeaway: Eight Turkish patients with familial dysalbuminaemic hyperthyroxinaemia carried a known ALB variant, and the authors recommend ALB sequencing before costly tests to avoid unnecessary treatment.

38737552.takeaway: Narrative review of endocrine features of Prader-Willi syndrome, linking genetic subtypes to thyroid, adrenal, gonadal, bone, metabolic and GH-axis problems and treatment responses.

38737553.takeaway: In 143 girls with central precocious puberty, 3-monthly leuprolide gave greater hormonal and growth suppression than monthly dosing, though predicted adult height did not differ.

38744258.takeaway: Three children with THRA mutations had variable phenotypes, and the authors report they can benefit from levothyroxine and respond well to growth hormone therapy.

38745950.takeaway: In frozen-thawed blastocyst transfers, cryopreservation beyond two years had no significant effect on singleton birth weight, though low birth weight risk should be watched.

38745955.takeaway: In 38 men with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella, embryo developmental potential and cumulative pregnancy rates were lower, supporting genetic counselling.

38747483.takeaway: In adolescents born to mothers with suboptimal gestational thyroid function, brain morphology did not differ, and levothyroxine supplementation in pregnancy had no detectable effect.

38748681.takeaway: The authors provide age, bone age and Tanner-stage-specific IGF-1 reference data from healthy Indian children and adolescents, with a broader interval during peripuberty.

38748847.takeaway: A new multi-society guideline for Turner syndrome across the lifespan covers diagnosis and genetics, growth, estrogen treatment, fertility, comorbidities and neurocognition.

38752175.takeaway: In 53 children with persistent growth failure, a repeat GH stimulation test revealed GH deficiency that the first test missed, supporting longitudinal follow-up.

38752206.takeaway: In 94 transmasculine youth, GnRH agonist treatment in early puberty before testosterone was associated with mildly greater final height than testosterone alone started later.

38752501.takeaway: In a Sri Lankan paediatric centre, most neonatal diabetes cases tested had pathogenic variants, mainly KCNJ11 in permanent disease, and nearly half of those were switched to sulfonylureas.
