38753423.takeaway: Hierarchical clustering of women with PCOS identified subtypes differing in reproductive and metabolic traits not used for subtyping, suggesting distinct causal pathways.

38753668.takeaway: In 199 US infants, higher early-infancy urinary phenol exposure was associated with higher mean BMI z-score and a greater risk of a rapid BMI increase trajectory.

38754024.takeaway: In 2,018 Korean children aged 10 to 18, higher urinary sodium excretion was negatively associated with bone mineral density.

38757001.takeaway: In 3,496 US women aged 18 to 45, higher dietary inflammatory index scores were associated with infertility, and the authors suggest anti-inflammatory diets might help.

38757580.takeaway: Among 255 patients with congenital hypothyroidism, those with multiple pathogenic DUOX2 variants usually had transient disease, but some developed recurrent hypothyroidism after a drug-free interval.

38757581.takeaway: In 13,243 Ukrainian residents exposed to iodine-131 as children, higher doses were linked to thyroid nodules found 12 to 14 years later, with a stronger risk for neoplastic nodules.

38757584.takeaway: In 402 patients with low-risk papillary thyroid carcinoma under active surveillance, an initial tumour volume doubling time under five years predicted progression, including growth and new lymph node metastasis.

38757585.takeaway: In 1,849 mother-child pairs, higher maternal thyroid peroxidase antibodies in pregnancy were linked to poorer preschool cognition in a sex-specific way, needing independent confirmation.

38757586.takeaway: Reviews how thyroid hormone acts in the human brain, using MRI and spectroscopy and brain organoids derived from stem cells, to study neurodevelopment and cognition.

38757613.takeaway: In a multicentre Latin American series, neoadjuvant systemic therapy for locally advanced thyroid cancer made surgery feasible in 55% of differentiated, 33% of anaplastic and 16% of medullary cases.

38757950.takeaway: In 63 people with generalised lipodystrophy treated with metreleptin, starting before severe metabolic disease was linked to better long-term control of diabetes, proteinuria and triglycerides.

38758194.takeaway: In real-world use of the MiniMed 780G over 12 months, youth with type 1 diabetes improved HbA1c and CGM metrics, but most did not reach optimal composite glycaemic control.

38758212.takeaway: In 217 adults using an automated insulin delivery system, the AID Benefits and Burdens Scale proved valid and reliable, and can help set expectations and address burdens.

38761403.takeaway: In 589 infants followed from fetal life, anogenital distance was sexually dimorphic by the third trimester and correlated between fetal and infant periods, but not with minipuberty androgen levels.

38765731.takeaway: In 87 T1D cases and 87 DAISY controls, the protective maternal effect of family history may operate through DNA methylation near DLGAP2.

38765732.takeaway: In youth and young adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, household food insecurity was not associated with cognition after adjusting for confounders.

38765897.takeaway: Among 716 children with type 2 diabetes at one hospital, about half of those presenting with DKA met criteria for A-β+ ketosis-prone diabetes, with obesity, preserved β-cell function and male predominance.

38765953.takeaway: In neonatal mouse inguinal fat, epigenetic activation of GABPα was linked to beige adipocyte development, suggesting a possible regulator of beige adipogenesis.

38767115.takeaway: In 713 autoantibody-positive TrialNet participants who developed type 1 diabetes, a higher genetic risk score and a T2D-associated JAZF1 allele were linked to lower C-peptide before diagnosis.

38771642.takeaway: In a Danish register cohort of 3,812 transgender persons, masculinising hormone treatment was linked to higher employment, while feminising hormones did not change employment at five years.

38771955.takeaway: Among 1,129 Danish pregnancies in women with type 2 diabetes, poor early glycaemic control was linked to lower odds of LGA but higher odds of SGA and congenital malformations.

38772918.takeaway: In a Swedish nationwide cohort, coeliac disease was not associated with type 2 diabetes risk, and genetic liability showed no association in Mendelian randomisation.

38774227.takeaway: Of 310 Austrian youth with gender incongruence, referrals rose over 2008 to 2022, most received hormone treatment and changed legal gender markers, while surgery and fertility preservation were uncommon.

38776636.takeaway: In 34 children with Chiari malformation who received GH, new intracranial hypertension symptoms were uncommon and no patient stopped GH permanently, suggesting GH is likely safe.

38777869.takeaway: In 8,417 Danish people newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, birthweight below 3000 g was associated with higher cardiovascular event risk, driven by stroke, peripheral arterial disease and CVD death.

38781537.takeaway: In a boy with MCT8 deficiency from a novel missense variant, 13 months of phenylbutyrate significantly lowered elevated thyrotropin and gave slight neurodevelopmental gains, but possible hepatotoxicity was noted.

38781538.takeaway: In Copenhagen registry data for children born 2000 to 2014, first-trimester maternal thyroid hormone levels were not associated with school performance, ADHD or autism.

38783717.takeaway: In a multisite US database, youth with CAH had higher odds of cardiometabolic diagnoses than matched controls, and classic CAH was linked to overweight, hypertension and liver dysfunction.

38785276.takeaway: Three Portuguese children with Cushing's disease had variable responses to transsphenoidal surgery, with recurrence linked to a shorter recovery time of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis.

38785359.takeaway: Narrative review compares automated insulin delivery systems for children with type 1 diabetes, with expert guidance on managing illness, exercise and changing insulin needs.

38787410.takeaway: In 8,262 mother-infant pairs, gestational glucose intolerance was associated with an increased risk of neonatal hypoglycaemia.

38796770.takeaway: Six neonates with non-CAH primary adrenal insufficiency were severely unwell despite normal CAH newborn screening, so clinicians should not delay diagnosis because of a normal screen.

38798200.takeaway: In 764 surgically treated pituitary adenomas, invasive growth carried a high risk of incomplete resection and was more common in older patients, and the Knosp classification was a useful preoperative tool.

38800483.takeaway: In 8,771 euthyroid Chinese adults, pituitary-thyroid sensitivity indices were negatively associated with thyroid nodule prevalence and number in women, suggesting sex-specific mechanisms.

38800487.takeaway: In 193 pregnancies with gestational diabetes, higher maternal inflammatory markers during pregnancy were associated with lower offspring weight and BMI in the first year.

38800488.takeaway: In a retrospective US paediatric weight clinic cohort, topiramate with lifestyle modification was assessed for real-world effectiveness, and no baseline characteristics predicted response.

38800840.takeaway: Among 249 children with raised alkaline phosphatase, 95 had benign transient hyperphosphatasaemia, typically at a mean age of 2.4 years, and a falling ALP on repeat testing helps identify it.

38801437.takeaway: In 181 patients with papillary thyroid cancer, a CT radiomics-clinical model predicted response to initial iodine-131 better than clinical factors alone in both training and test sets.

38801521.takeaway: Cluster analysis of routine variables in 2,682 women with gestational diabetes identified subgroups with different insulin needs, with differences confirmed in an external cohort.

38804535.takeaway: Youths with type 1 diabetes and device-related skin reactions, and their parents, reported more emotional distress than matched controls, and some had to stop pumps or sensors.

38805309.takeaway: In 297 youth starting Omnipod 5, self-starting with industry online modules gave glycaemic and pump-interaction outcomes minimally different from educator-led training over 90 days.

38805311.takeaway: In 189 children and adolescents using automated insulin delivery, more missed or late meal boluses were linked to lower time in range, underlining the importance of bolus behaviour.

38806007.takeaway: Reanalysing earlier variants of unknown significance in 10 people with clinical MODY was high-yield, with reclassification a median of 8 years after testing.

38806014.takeaway: In 154 Italian children with congenital hyperinsulinism, diagnosis was usually within two weeks, about two-thirds were diazoxide-responsive, and neurological outcomes were relatively good.

38807486.takeaway: Three adolescents with VHL-related hereditary pheochromocytoma were treated with CT-guided percutaneous cryoablation, which the authors suggest may reduce complications and adrenal insufficiency, with varying success.

38812814.takeaway: Pentoxifylline-assisted ICSI with frozen-thawed testicular sperm gave pregnancy and neonatal outcomes comparable to ICSI without it, with no difference in birth defects or birth weight.

38812818.takeaway: In 1,557 children aged 8 to 10 in Ningbo, cardiorespiratory fitness partly offset the adverse effect of fatness on cardiometabolic risk, more strongly in girls.

38814569.takeaway: Among 210 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, two girls developed early bilateral cataracts, which the authors suggest should be operated on once glycaemia is stable.

38815053.takeaway: In 365 TODAY participants with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, baseline abundance of certain circulating microRNAs was associated with later beta-cell function decline, suggesting possible markers.

38818501.takeaway: Two-sample Mendelian randomisation suggests genetically predicted juvenile idiopathic arthritis raises the risk of primary ovarian failure, and the authors recommend screening women with JIA.

38818505.takeaway: In 13 children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, two years of burosumab caused no cardiac morbidity and was associated with less overweight, obesity and elevated blood pressure.

38818508.takeaway: In adolescent girls with PCOS, the on-treatment rise in ALT and GGT seen only with oral contraceptives was associated with circulating METRNL, suggesting a hepatic response to treatment.

38819466.takeaway: In 8,135 TEDDY children, Caesarean delivery was not associated with progression to early-stage type 1 diabetes but was modestly linked to faster progression to stage 3 in children with multiple autoantibodies.

38820084.takeaway: Entropy rate and Poincaré plot area from CGM data were proposed as alternatives to fasting glucose or OGTT for identifying people at higher immunological risk of type 1 diabetes.

38820461.takeaway: In Ontario, offspring of mothers with pre-existing or gestational diabetes had higher risks of ADHD, autism and cardiometabolic disorders, and pregnancy glycaemia was linked to cardiometabolic but not neurobehavioural outcomes.

38826052.takeaway: In 159 children with type 1 diabetes, the authors suggest the systemic immune-inflammation response index could be a biomarker for early proatherosclerotic change, pending further study.

38828521.takeaway: Two families with rapid-tempo puberty had short adult height from early growth completion, and early standard therapy in the youngest preserved or regained adult height.

38828884.takeaway: Meta-analysis of 14 RCTs in 1,262 adolescents found GLP-1 receptor agonists lowered HbA1c, fasting glucose and weight, with liraglutide better for glucose and exenatide for weight.

38828891.takeaway: In 74 children aged 5 to 11 on monthly leuprolide for central precocious puberty, QTc intervals were normal and did not correlate with age, treatment duration or cumulative dose.

38828892.takeaway: Meta-analysis of studies from 1987 to 2017 found no significant sex difference or time trend in childhood obesity under age 12, and the authors call for comprehensive control measures.

38828893.takeaway: Targeted sequencing in 56 Turkish patients with osteogenesis imperfecta from 46 families found a genetic cause in 82.6% of families and nine new pathogenic variants in known genes.

38828931.takeaway: The Endocrine Society guideline on vitamin D for disease prevention advises against routine 25(OH)D testing without established indications and does not replace dietary reference intakes.

38828942.takeaway: Systematic review supporting the Endocrine Society vitamin D guideline, covering 14 clinical questions on benefits, harms and 25(OH)D screening across the lifespan, pregnancy and prediabetes.

38829694.takeaway: In 250 Vietnamese children, 124 with precocious puberty, urinary bisphenol A and dibutyl phthalate metabolite were detected more often in cases than controls, though the phthalate estimate was imprecise.

38832971.takeaway: In people with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes followed for two years in INNODIA, gut microbiome composition was associated with glycaemic control and disease progression.

38836230.takeaway: In 19 children under six with type 1 diabetes, switching to advanced hybrid closed loop over six months was effective and safe, with no ketoacidosis or severe hypoglycaemia.

38838652.takeaway: Narrative review of dietary strategies to prevent or slow type 1 diabetes in children, covering gluten, vitamin D, omega-3 and carbohydrate reduction, with no universal benefit found so far.

38838658.takeaway: In 42 short children from consanguineous Turkish families, genetic testing had a high diagnostic yield, especially with severe GH deficiency or insensitivity, microcephaly or syndromic short stature.

38838660.takeaway: In six children with pycnodysostosis treated with growth hormone for at least a year, the authors suggest GH may prevent height decline, though confirmation is needed.

38841305.takeaway: Reviews rare causes of 46,XX differences of sex development outside CAH, covering genetics, clinical features, puberty, hormone replacement and fertility outcomes.

38841307.takeaway: In 1,318 US children aged 6 to 14 in NHANES 2015 to 2016, lower 25(OH)D was associated with earlier puberty in both girls and boys.

38842902.takeaway: In Swedish children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, partial remission was less frequent with multiple daily injections, longer diabetes duration and female sex, while continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion was linked to longer remission.

38843077.takeaway: In a seven-year Chongqing cohort of 1,420 children, chronic psychosocial stress was linked to delayed pubertal signs in both sexes, while peer-related stress accelerated testicular development in boys.

38852580.takeaway: Reviews sex hormone treatment for girls and young women with hypothalamic, pituitary or ovarian disorders, covering puberty induction, replacement, menstrual management and contraception, and states it is safe when tailored.

38853577.takeaway: Among 58 children with new-onset diabetes admitted during the pandemic in Mississippi, COVID-19 infection was not significantly correlated with diabetes, while higher BMI was linked to type 2 diabetes.

38853748.takeaway: Systematic review of skin reactions to insulin pump infusion sets finds allergic contact dermatitis under-recognised in toxicological evaluation and clinical follow-up.

38857124.takeaway: Using NHANES 2015 to 2018, an estimated 21.5% of US adults with type 1 diabetes had chronic kidney disease, a conservative estimate from 47 identified individuals.

38857188.takeaway: In 270 children with central precocious puberty, distinct genetic causes were found in 12.6% of apparently idiopathic cases, with family history and neurodevelopmental disorders as predictors.

38857190.takeaway: In 56 adult women with pituitary stalk interruption syndrome, fewer were in relationships than controls, and gonadotropic function may decline over time, so fertility prognosis needs optimising.

38859884.takeaway: In 33 children with Kabuki syndrome and congenital hyperinsulinism, hypoglycaemia was often present from the first day of life, and KMT2D and KDM6A should be included in HI genetic testing.

38861482.takeaway: In 11,457 Beijing pregnancies without pre-existing diabetes, maternal glucose trajectories across pregnancy were linked to neonatal arginine, urea cycle and fatty acid oxidation metabolites.

38861550.takeaway: Clustering longitudinal autoantibody profiles in 1,845 genetically susceptible children identified five groups with distinct progression rates to diabetes, useful for prediction and trial selection.

38861956.takeaway: In 15 Latino adolescents with obesity, the same test meal produced greater insulin resistance when eaten in the afternoon and evening than in the morning.

38864451.takeaway: In teens with type 1 diabetes and executive function challenges, readiness for independent self-care stayed lower over 18 months, with older age and less parental involvement predicting higher readiness.

38864457.takeaway: In adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia, those treated with burosumab had fewer endodontic infections than untreated or conventionally treated patients.

38867506.takeaway: In a Southern California matched cohort, pregnancy rates were similar for women with and without primary hyperparathyroidism, and parathyroidectomy before pregnancy or in the second trimester appeared safe.

38867880.takeaway: In TEDDY children, rapid weight gain during puberty was associated with islet autoimmunity, while puberty itself did not significantly influence autoantibody appearance or type 1 diabetes.

38868742.takeaway: In 309 pregnancies with PCOS, a larger fall in maternal free T4 was linked to lower birthweight and shorter length, and higher mid-gestation TSH to less large-for-gestational-age risk.

38869512.takeaway: The EASL-EASD-EASO executive summary updates definitions, prevention, screening, diagnosis and treatment of MASLD, recommending non-invasive fibrosis case-finding in people with cardiometabolic risk factors.

38870258.takeaway: Reviews the thyroid risks of iodine excess, its sources and assessment methods, and guidance on contrast-induced thyroid dysfunction, calling for data on safe upper intake limits.

38870325.takeaway: In 1,478 mother-child pairs in Shanghai, better maternal cardiometabolic health in pregnancy was associated with lower risks of overweight, obesity and hypertension in children aged 3 to 6.

38872968.takeaway: Of 42 patients with hereditary vitamin D-dependent rickets type II in Saudi Arabia, the authors describe clinical, biochemical and genetic features and the most common VDR variants.

38877800.takeaway: In 16 patients with resistance to thyroid hormone β, compared with 28 matched controls, IL-6 was raised without raised TNF-α or CRP, suggesting a metabolic cause of the increase.

38878281.takeaway: A FAERS pharmacovigilance analysis of teprotumumab for thyroid eye disease identified ear and labyrinth, and reproductive and breast, disorders as possible safety signals, though data remain insufficient.

38881279.takeaway: In 67 girls with central precocious puberty treated with GnRH analogues, 94% reached target height and 35.8% exceeded it, with good height-SDS and predicted adult height at admission linked to greater final height.

38883396.takeaway: In 79 adolescent and young women with and without type 1 diabetes, an etonogestrel implant was associated with longer telomeres after 18 months, whereas combined oral contraceptives shortened them.

38883600.takeaway: In 559 pregnant women, serum iodine concentration may be a better marker of iodine nutrition than urinary measures, and neonatal TSH was affected by maternal TSH.

38883602.takeaway: In 206 overweight or obese youth, adding bioelectrical impedance parameters to waist-to-hip ratio improved identification of MASLD risk, including among those with normal ALT.

38885633.takeaway: Narrative review finds no reliable global birth prevalence for congenital hyperinsulinism, with consanguinity affecting national figures, and calls for more robust epidemiological studies.

38888175.takeaway: Twelve years after stopping childhood GH, adults born small for gestational age had stable quality of life and less problem behaviour, though all SGA adults reported lower quality of life than controls.

38894740.takeaway: Evidence-based recommendations from the Italian paediatric endocrine society on recognising, risk-stratifying and treating hypoglycaemia in children and adolescents, with decision flow charts.

38894747.takeaway: In 50,730 Korean females born between 1927 and 2004, age at menarche fell by about 0.71 years per decade, faster in those with obesity and in later-maturing girls.

38895640.takeaway: In adolescents with obesity, transient elastography's controlled attenuation parameter showed only modest diagnostic performance against MRI-defined hepatosteatosis, with a best cut-off of 281 dB/m.

38900947.takeaway: Meta-analysis of youth aged 10 to 24 with type 1 diabetes found suicidal ideation and attempts are common, but current evidence does not show higher rates than in peers without diabetes.

38904041.takeaway: In 142,184 Chinese adults in the REACTION study, a higher triglyceride-glucose index was significantly associated with prevalent breast cancer among middle-aged and older women.

38904047.takeaway: In people with type 1 diabetes and no complications, sustained hyperglycaemia was associated with several differentially methylated CpG sites in genes linked to chronic complications.

38904052.takeaway: In paediatric papillary thyroid carcinoma, BRAF V600E and RET fusions were involved in adolescent disease, and multigene testing may help with nodules indeterminate on fine-needle aspiration.

38905521.takeaway: In 42,975 children with type 1 diabetes in the DPV registry, new mental disorders rose during the pandemic in adolescent girls, who had more depression, eating disorders and self-harm, while substance misuse fell.

38905540.takeaway: From 2000 to 2020, several diabetes-related complications kept rising among US adults with diabetes, and age, sex and racial inequalities worsened for some of them.

38910151.takeaway: JDRF-led international consensus guidance on monitoring islet autoantibody-positive people before stage 3 type 1 diabetes, much of which will occur in non-specialised settings, stresses education and research needs.

38910317.takeaway: Among 585,886 newborns screened in Hainan from 2017 to 2021, congenital hypothyroidism incidence rose each year, and living in coastal areas, especially near salt fields, was a risk factor.

38911039.takeaway: Four patients with lipoprotein lipase deficiency from Slovenia and Pakistan had high triglycerides at diagnosis, with homozygous patients faring worse, and adherence to diet and medication reduced severity.

38912694.takeaway: JDRF-led international consensus guidance on monitoring islet autoantibody-positive people before stage 3 type 1 diabetes, much of which will occur in non-specialised settings, stresses education and research needs.

38912718.takeaway: A patient with 17α-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency presented with hyperpigmentation and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism while receiving chemotherapy for non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

38912751.takeaway: In very-low-birth-weight preterm infants, a 1 SD rise in weight Z-score at term and at 2 years predicted later metabolic and cardiovascular disorders in adolescence.

38913686.takeaway: In young adults with childhood-onset GH deficiency, a glucagon-test GH peak cutoff of 5.8 µg/L accurately confirmed permanent GHD in those with high pretest probability.

38915194.takeaway: In extremely preterm infants with severe hyperglycemia, subcutaneous insulin was feasible with rare hypoglycemia, but normoglycemia was less frequent than with IV insulin and required higher doses.

38915195.takeaway: Exome sequencing in a family with an obese breastfed infant found obesity-related variants inherited from the father, confirmed by segregation, and recommended periodic follow-up.

38915199.takeaway: Of 37 boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, 65% had delayed puberty, most of them on daily glucocorticoids, supporting routine puberty monitoring in this group.

38916200.takeaway: Australians with diabetes had higher adjusted risk of injury hospitalization than the general population, highest among those using insulin (RR 1.65 type 2, 1.62 type 1).

38916475.takeaway: Among 6,794 Danish mother-child pairs, offspring of gestational diabetes pregnancies had higher risk of overweight at ages 5–9; fetal growth explained up to 15% of this link.

38917236.takeaway: Targeted sequencing of 113 adrenocortical carcinomas found NF1+TP53 and Wnt/β-catenin+Rb/p53 combined alterations to be the most deleterious for survival, most evident in low-stage tumours.

38917410.takeaway: UCP1 expression in human brown fat declined with age and cardiometabolic risk, yet remained preserved in young obese adults, supporting brown fat as a potential therapeutic target in obesity.

38919482.takeaway: Three children with glycogen storage disease type 1b treated with empagliflozin for three years had fewer infections and improved neutrophil counts and function, allowing G-CSF to be stopped.

38919493.takeaway: In German-speaking registry data, youth with type 1 diabetes from Syria or Afghanistan had higher BMI-SDS, less CGM or AID use and more severe hypoglycemia than those from Ukraine in their first host-country year.

38920264.takeaway: In mucopolysaccharidosis, aortic elasticity was impaired and left ventricular mass increased; the authors report positive effects of enzyme replacement therapy on cardiac function and aortic stiffness.

38920271.takeaway: Sex- and age-specific inhibin B reference ranges from 2707 healthy people show high levels in minipuberty, a fall in childhood, and a rise through puberty; oral contraceptive users had lower levels.

38922417.takeaway: Parents of children with type 1 diabetes in Sweden had no higher risk of major cardiovascular events than matched controls, but exposed fathers had possibly higher all-cause mortality.

38924056.takeaway: In 268 children with adrenocortical carcinoma, the modified pS-GRAS score was strongly associated with overall survival, with age, resection status, stage and Ki67 index as key predictors.

38924772.takeaway: Hybrid closed-loop insulin for 48 months improved glycemic control versus standard therapy in newly diagnosed youth with type 1 diabetes but did not preserve residual C-peptide secretion.

38934083.takeaway: In 3,771 Iranian children and adolescents, non-HDL cholesterol and related lipid ratios best predicted elevated ALT, suggesting their use for identifying children at risk of fatty liver.

38934795.takeaway: Long-read sequencing in 26 Chinese patients with 17α-hydroxylase deficiency identified 20 pathogenic CYP17A1 variants, five of them novel, and one variant was shown to disrupt splicing.

38935559.takeaway: In TODAY youth with type 2 diabetes, certain circulating metabolites and their 36-month changes were associated with loss of glycemic control, and some predicted treatment failure better than HbA1c changes.

38935853.takeaway: Premature pubarche occurred in just over half of 43 children with Prader-Willi syndrome without compromising final height, and obesity and insulin resistance were not associated with it.

38936371.takeaway: Early pregnancy HbA1c, alone or in a composite risk score, identified gestational diabetes at 24–28 weeks in India, Kenya and the UK, and could reduce the need for OGTT by 50–64%.

38938059.takeaway: Most complete AIS patients kept female identity and most partial AIS patients were raised male; 31 of 88 AR variants were unreported, and gonadectomy should be carefully evaluated when fertility preservation is considered.

38938517.takeaway: In 3,767 US children and adolescents aged 6–19, the systemic immune-inflammation index was associated with sex hormone levels, with a nonlinear pattern for estradiol; the authors suggest it may be a risk factor.

38938519.takeaway: Human milk from women with gestational diabetes had different endocannabinoidome profiles, and some mediators were negatively correlated with weight-for-age z-scores of their 2-month-old infants.

38940443.takeaway: Hypercalcitoninemia was common in children (66%) and adults (54%) with PHP/iPPSD, did not correlate with PTH, and responded to calcium stimulation between healthy people and those with MTC.

38948512.takeaway: Among 1,923 first-trimester Chinese pregnant women, positive antinuclear antibodies were strongly associated with thyroid autoantibody positivity, with higher ANA titers conferring greater risk.

38948515.takeaway: In 12 children with obstructive sleep apnea, full-length 16S sequencing distinguished obese from non-obese children by Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratio, while partial-length V3-V4 sequencing was less conclusive.

38948521.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests genetically predicted higher childhood and adult adiposity causally increases sepsis risk, though the authors call for validation in well-designed studies.

38949847.takeaway: In a post hoc TrialNet analysis, oral insulin delayed stage 3 type 1 diabetes in participants with HLA DR4-DQ8 or high IA-2A autoantibodies, with no effect in those with low IA-2A levels.

38950282.takeaway: A radiofrequency noninvasive glucose sensor with a machine-learning model classified glycemic status as high, normal or low correctly 93% of the time in held-out data from 31 adults with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes.

38952103.takeaway: Two patients with the same homozygous TBX19 mutation had isolated ACTH deficiency with reduced mineralocorticoid as well as glucocorticoid biosynthesis, and one had hyponatremia.

38952115.takeaway: A survey of 180 physicians from 25 countries found varied practice in managing celiac disease in children with type 1 diabetes, and 81% agreed that more specific guidelines are needed.

38952118.takeaway: In nine patients with heterozygous IGF1 variants, growth hormone raised height by 1.3 SDS over two years, and in two adults final height exceeded the pre-treatment prediction.

38952179.takeaway: Two girls with hereditary severe insulin-resistance syndrome had novel insulin receptor mutations, with hyperinsulinemia, fasting hypoglycemia, acanthosis nigricans and fatty liver.

38952388.takeaway: Twin infants with diffuse congenital hyperinsulinism inherited recessive ABCC8 variants from their mother, who had focal CHI, underscoring genetic counselling and prenatal diagnosis.

38952395.takeaway: Most Rathke's cleft cysts without initial compressive symptoms stayed stable or shrank over about five years, supporting conservative management; surgery improved symptoms quickly, with 9% recurrence.

38953412.takeaway: Whole exome sequencing identified disease-causing variants in 6 of 12 children with osteogenesis imperfecta, in FKBP10, P3H1 and WNT1, and two of the variants were previously unreported.

38953734.takeaway: In 882 Turkish families of children with type 1 diabetes, access to CGM and pumps depended on region, parental education and household income, with CGM access the most unequal.

38953735.takeaway: In 61 children with secondary osteoporosis, all had vertebral fractures before treatment; bisphosphonates raised bone mineral density and significantly reduced fracture number and bone pain.

38953766.takeaway: In Chinese adults aged 65 and older, slightly raised TSH was not linked to metabolic disease, so the authors suggest raising the upper TSH reference limit for this age group.

38954432.takeaway: In a post hoc analysis of youth with type 2 diabetes, dulaglutide reduced the prevalence of glomerular hyperfiltration and proteinuria, while eGFR fell more than with placebo (−5.8 vs −0.1 mL/min/1.73 m²).

38954647.takeaway: In 82 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, vigorous activity lowered same-day glucose but was linked to more nocturnal hypoglycemia, particularly when the daily insulin dose was high.

38956751.takeaway: Oral GABA appeared safe in the reviewed studies and shows promise for delaying type 1 diabetes in genetically predisposed children, through β-cell proliferation and immunoregulation.

38956752.takeaway: Long-read sequencing detects structural variants, repeat expansions and hard-to-sequence regions, making it useful for molecular diagnosis of pediatric endocrine disorders.

38956753.takeaway: Among 123 children with diabetes in Daegu, all 35 with COVID-19 had mild illness, and unvaccinated children had higher and longer fevers than vaccinated children.

38956754.takeaway: In 1,661 Korean children aged 10–18, waist-height ratio correlated with cardiometabolic risk factors and DXA body fat, making it a useful, simple clinical indicator.

38957439.takeaway: Among 459 patients with suprasellar germ cell tumors, diagnosis delayed over six months was linked to more severe neuroendocrine dysfunction at diagnosis and after treatment, with less recovery.

38957442.takeaway: In 30 pediatric pump users with type 1 diabetes followed for 90 days, time in range and the glycemia risk index were both strongly associated with HbA1c, and the two measures correlated closely.

38958114.takeaway: The authors argue that GH treatment for children of normal height lacks efficacy and safety evidence, that small height gains may not matter functionally, and that counselling is preferable.

38958169.takeaway: A four-year-old boy with dihydropyrimidinase deficiency had atrioventricular septal defect, which the authors suggest may be a rare phenotypic feature of this disorder.

38958228.takeaway: In 23 adolescents, the GHRP2 test gave robust GH peaks in idiopathic GHD and short-stature groups, and two patients passed its cutoff but failed other tests, so the cutoff may miss GHD.

38960811.takeaway: This position statement advises adults with PCOS to do 150–300 minutes of moderate aerobic activity weekly plus strength work twice weekly, and adolescents at least 60 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous activity daily.

38961757.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests that lower fetal-determined birth weight raises adult type 2 diabetes risk and its subtypes, whereas maternal-determined birth weight shows no such effect.

38961758.takeaway: In 106 adult women with Turner syndrome, OGTT found newly diagnosed diabetes in 7.6% and impaired glucose tolerance in 19.5%, with weight and insulin resistance as key factors.

38962677.takeaway: Youth-onset type 2 diabetes is rising and progresses faster, so management should target insulin resistance with lifestyle, medication or, rarely, surgery to aim for remission.

38962684.takeaway: In 19 children with craniopharyngioma, 83% had recurrence or progression after first surgery, and obesity rose from 13% to 40%, so lifelong multidisciplinary follow-up is needed.

38963175.takeaway: A neonate with systemic pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1B from a novel homozygous SCNN1A variant presented with salt wasting, hyponatremia and hyperkalemia.

38963811.takeaway: In a Norwegian nationwide cohort of 77 congenital hyperinsulinism probands, 60% had a genetic cause, mostly ABCC8 variants, and known genetic causes were linked to earlier, more severe onset.

38963882.takeaway: Youth-onset type 2 diabetes involves more profound insulin resistance and faster loss of insulin secretion than adult-onset disease, so therapies must address both insulin resistance and β-cell function.

38964298.takeaway: A 10-year-old with type 1 diabetes on an automated insulin delivery system had recurrent severe hypoglycemia, which camera monitoring showed was caused by her manipulating the pump.

38964306.takeaway: Growth charts for 190 children with Noonan syndrome show height and weight near the 3rd percentile of the general Italian population, with PTPN11 variants linked to lower early growth.

38966211.takeaway: Among 6,156 Chinese college students, BMI rose 4.2% during the COVID-19 lockdown and a further 0.94% after it, with males and females showing different patterns.

38966212.takeaway: Pediatric patients with diffuse sclerosing papillary thyroid carcinoma had a higher recurrence risk than adults, and recurrence by age followed a different pattern than conventional papillary cancer.

38966214.takeaway: In 69 girls with Prader-Willi syndrome, puberty was often delayed despite early adrenarche, and the authors suggest starting estrogen at chronological or bone age 12–13 years.

38966218.takeaway: In 10 patients with cystic fibrosis-related diabetes, advanced hybrid closed-loop use lowered HbA1c from 7.31% to 6.35% and reduced insulin requirements over one year.

38967667.takeaway: CGM and pumps alone fall short of pregnancy glucose targets; CamAPS FX hybrid closed-loop has the strongest pregnancy evidence, while data for pregnant women with type 2 diabetes are limited.

38967999.takeaway: Blood CD8+ memory T-cell signatures differed across T1D progression, with a proinflammatory signature in new-onset children and a coinhibitory signature in autoantibody-positive children who later progressed.

38972845.takeaway: Among 1,690 asymptomatic at-risk neonates screened in the first hour, 3.1% had glucose at or below 25 mg/dL, and late-preterm and large-for-gestational-age status predicted early hypoglycemia.

38973169.takeaway: A Turner-like adolescent with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism had dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma; Y-chromosome microdeletions appeared in gonadal but not blood DNA, and bilateral gonadectomy was performed.

38974576.takeaway: In 34 young patients with Cushing's disease in biochemical remission, bisphosphonates did not significantly improve lumbar spine BMD over the first year, and bone formation markers were lower with treatment.

38974580.takeaway: Two siblings with an MC4R variant treated with semaglutide for six months showed no weight change, but corneal nerve fibre density and branch measures increased.

38976971.takeaway: A boy with long-term hypophosphatemia had a de novo PRPF8 stop-gain variant and GH deficiency; his phosphate normalised on GH treatment, suggesting the hypophosphatemia was partly secondary to GHD.

38978629.takeaway: In 210 adults with thalassemia, 62.4% had low bone mineral density; transfusion dependence and lower BMI were independently associated with it.

38979902.takeaway: Of 147 young people with chronic endocrine disease, 97% completed a structured transfer to adult care, at a mean cumulative cost of 519 euros per patient for the key elements.

38984944.takeaway: Compared with population registries, the 1,416-patient MTC collaborative registry had more advanced-stage tumours and more systemic therapy, so it may not represent typical MTC patients.

38985499.takeaway: In 117 children with type 1 diabetes, 30 months of hybrid closed-loop use kept HbA1c at 7.0% through puberty, with stable BMI and no severe hypoglycemia.

38986013.takeaway: Of 55 children with congenital hypothyroidism and a gland in situ reassessed at age three, 33% were euthyroid off therapy, and 49% of the cohort eventually stopped levothyroxine.

38986456.takeaway: Exome sequencing in 12 Indian patients with thyroid dyshormonogenesis found eight novel TPO variants, and functional assays showed the missense variants markedly reduced enzyme activity.

38988996.takeaway: This review finds puberty suppression with GnRH analogues may help selected adolescents with gender dysphoria, but its benefits and effects on bone, growth and fertility need larger long-term trials.

38989002.takeaway: In 184 girls with precocious puberty, uterine volume on pelvic ultrasound was the best predictor of time to menarche, with thresholds of 3.76, 6.02 and 8.80 mL for onset within 18, 12 and 6 months.

38994010.takeaway: Central adrenal insufficiency was diagnosed in 2 of 46 children with Prader-Willi syndrome (4.3%), and the ACTH and glucagon stimulation tests often disagreed.

38994570.takeaway: In 127 people with cystic fibrosis aged 10–25, changes in beta-cell functional mass tracked with worsening or improving glucose tolerance over at least one year.

38995398.takeaway: This review finds CGM is standard care for children with type 1 diabetes, and automated insulin delivery is safe, effective from age two, and improves quality of life.

38996042.takeaway: In 5,066 genetically at-risk children followed from birth, thyroid autoantibodies appeared as early as 10 months, more often in girls and with family history, and concurrent antibodies carried higher risk of thyroid dysfunction.

39006361.takeaway: In 119 Norwegian mother-child pairs, maternal vitamin A insufficiency and vitamin D deficiency were common in pregnancy, and higher mid-pregnancy retinol was linked to lower spine bone mineral content in boys only.

39006363.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests PCOS causally raises the risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, particularly gestational hypertension, but not other adverse pregnancy outcomes.

39008530.takeaway: In a large claims cohort of 553,552 people with and without diabetes, chronic diabetes complications and mental health disorders each raised the hazard of the other across the lifespan.

39008607.takeaway: In 94 Israeli children with central congenital hypothyroidism, 84% had multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies, newborn screening detected only 3, and neurodevelopmental sequelae were common regardless of diagnosis timing.

39008686.takeaway: Most of 34 adult endocrinologists surveyed treated CAH patients, but only half answered at least half of standard-of-care questions correctly, and the main transition barrier was lack of standardized policies.

39009863.takeaway: This perspective notes that BMI relates poorly to clinical outcomes compared with waist-based measures, and that adiposity measures vary by sex, age and ethnicity, complicating research and guidelines.

39010896.takeaway: In 6,499 pregnant women, higher triglycerides raised the odds of large-for-gestational-age births, and higher lipids were inversely linked to SGA, with vitamin D status modifying these associations.

39010900.takeaway: An improved LC-MS/MS assay measured serum INSL3 rising through normal pubertal transition in girls, and it fell during GnRH agonist treatment for central precocious puberty.

39010901.takeaway: In 403 Chinese girls, a model combining overweight, screen time and biochemical markers predicted early pubertal development well, and adding genetic risk scores gave only modest improvement.

39010903.takeaway: Genetic testing of 67 patients with normosmic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism found pathogenic variants in 34%, most often in GNRHR, and many uncertain variants were also found.

39010904.takeaway: Pooled data from 11 cohorts (5,363 children) linked prenatal bisphenol exposure to altered thyroid hormones in girls only, including lower TSH and higher total T3.

39011974.takeaway: An AI model combining 24-hour CGM profiles with 15 clinical variables predicted large-for-gestational-age infants in 371 women with gestational diabetes better than conventional models (AUC 0.852).

39012089.takeaway: A Taiwanese girl with autosomal recessive hypophosphatemic rickets type 2 had a novel ENPP1 variant; treatment with phosphate, active vitamin D and guided growth was followed by satisfactory growth.

39015175.takeaway: This review covers how long non-coding RNAs in osteosarcoma may serve as prognostic or diagnostic markers and may drive chemotherapy resistance.

39015178.takeaway: In 830 children on growth hormone in Argentina, optimal adherence rose from 68% to 82% after a smartphone adherence app was introduced, and patients who engaged with the app adhered best.

39015179.takeaway: In 100 pediatric differentiated thyroid cancer patients, a central lymph node ratio above 77.78% predicted recurrence, with about a 5.5-fold higher risk.

39026454.takeaway: Among 198 children with differentiated thyroid cancer, low-risk patients had no recurrence or metastasis, while intermediate- and high-risk patients had recurrence or metastasis in 33% and 40% despite radioiodine.

39026465.takeaway: A 39-year-old man with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1B had a half-reduced STX16 exon 5–7 copy number and GNAS methylation loss, and his mother carried the same deletion.

39027470.takeaway: In 101 youths with obesity, fasting and OGTT glucagon rose as glucose tolerance worsened, except in impaired fasting glucose, where levels were similar to normoglycemic youth with overweight.

39027477.takeaway: In 17,899 US children aged 6–17, a higher weight-adjusted waist index was associated with greater prevalence of developmental disabilities, with a J-shaped pattern in children aged 6–11.

39028360.takeaway: In 18 women with type 1 diabetes who breastfed, glucose fell modestly at night after feeds, and closed-loop therapy blunted this decline compared with open-loop pump therapy.

39028731.takeaway: In 162 patients and controls, the TSI bioassay detected more Graves' disease than binding TSH-receptor antibody assays, which were less sensitive and not specific for stimulating antibodies.

39031569.takeaway: In 4,565 children with DKA, maximum glucose, initial pH and type 2 diabetes predicted death or ICU stay over 48 hours, and type 2 diabetes largely explained higher adverse-outcome rates during COVID-19.

39036055.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with anosmic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, intellectual disability and papillary thyroid carcinoma had a heterozygous TCF12 deletion, suggesting haploinsufficiency causes anosmic hypogonadism.

39036056.takeaway: In 67 Greek mother-newborn pairs, bioavailable maternal 25(OH)D was inversely associated with neonatal irisin, with no other associations with adipokines.

39038449.takeaway: In 1,054 healthy children aged 6–19, 11-oxygenated androgens rose through puberty, and higher BMI and skinfold thickness were associated with higher levels.

39040010.takeaway: Among 618,396 people with diabetes in Lombardy, influenza, zoster and meningococcal vaccination were each associated with about a 2-fold lower mortality risk, though coverage remained far below targets.

39040671.takeaway: Sequencing identified thyroglobulin variants that explained the phenotype in 19 patients with congenital hypothyroidism, 10 of the 21 variants being novel, and some proved permanent on reassessment.

39042587.takeaway: In 2,983 pregnant women with type 2 diabetes on metformin plus insulin, continuing metformin was not linked to a higher composite neonatal risk, though SGA was higher in commercially insured continuers.

39042913.takeaway: In 409 children with type 1 diabetes in Brazil, cesarean delivery and being firstborn were linked to earlier diagnosis, with diagnosis ages about 29% and 18% lower.

39042921.takeaway: A 46,XY infant with nonclassical lipoid congenital adrenal hyperplasia had a novel homozygous STAR variant, with late salt-wasting and a mild virilization defect.

39044531.takeaway: Real-world user data and human-factors work improved a marketed bolus calculator, with fewer hypoglycemic events, higher treatment satisfaction and greater acceptance of bolus suggestions.

39045266.takeaway: This review examines how parental obesity may transmit metabolic risk to offspring through epigenetic and transgenerational mechanisms, with implications for managing childhood obesity.

39045271.takeaway: In 3,919 US adolescents, each 1 µg/dL rise in blood lead was associated with a 0.67 pg/mL rise in parathyroid hormone, an association seen only in males.

39045274.takeaway: In 3,440 US adolescents, higher saturated fat intake was associated with higher bone mineral density, while polyunsaturated fat intake was inversely associated with BMD and BMC.

39046992.takeaway: In a Swedish cohort of 1.8 million adults, parental type 1 diabetes and non-full-term birth were associated with adult-onset type 1 diabetes, and perinatal factors played a minor role overall.

39047686.takeaway: This review summarises new insulins, including ultra-rapid-acting bolus analogues and once-weekly basal insulins, and notes that affordability and access remain major barriers.

39049755.takeaway: Long-read sequencing resolved complex CYP21A2 chimeric alleles missed by standard tests in 832 patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, and the authors suggest it could serve as a first-tier test.

39049776.takeaway: In UK primary care, PCOS incidence rose from 1.22 to 2.20 per 1,000 person-years between 2004 and 2019, and affected women used more healthcare, at about £1,546 versus £940 per person-year for controls.

39049782.takeaway: In 103 patients with cystinosis across CKD stages, skeletal complications occurred in two-thirds, with adults at five times the risk of children, and osteoclast activity and sclerostin were raised.

39049789.takeaway: In children with Prader-Willi syndrome, growth hormone lowered free T4 in the first six months through increased T4-to-T3 conversion, and thyroid hormone levels then stayed stable over 10 years.

39050564.takeaway: In expert workshops with 22 clinicians in Italy and Korea, a connected GH injection device and digital platform were seen as easy to use and likely to support adherence and data-driven decisions.

39054034.takeaway: In 16.7 million people in England, type 2 diabetes incidence after COVID-19 was 4.3 times the baseline rate in weeks 1–4, with higher risk in unvaccinated than vaccinated people.

39055060.takeaway: The global incidence and disability burden of type 2 diabetes in people aged 15–24 rose from 1990 to 2019, with the steepest increases in high-SDI regions.

39056255.takeaway: In adolescent girls with type 1 diabetes, trabecular bone microarchitecture was altered and bone turnover markers were suppressed before clinical neuropathy appeared, and neuropathy did not explain these changes.

39058316.takeaway: In 53 people with type 1 diabetes, the SNAQ app estimated meal carbohydrates with a smaller mean error (13 g) than participants' own estimates (21 g) or Calorie Mama (24 g).

39058664.takeaway: The miR-203/ZBTB20/MAFA axis regulated β-cell maturation during weaning and under high-fat diet conditions, suggesting a possible route to boost functional β-cell numbers.

39066630.takeaway: Two adolescents with severe hyperandrogenism from ovarian hyperthecosis improved on GnRH agonist treatment with spironolactone or oral contraception, after adrenal and ovarian tumours were excluded.

39066640.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl had a thyroid abscess with transient hyperthyroidism that resolved with antibiotics alone, without drainage, and the authors advise monitoring for later hypothyroidism.

39072866.takeaway: This review notes paediatric thyroid disease differs from adult disease, with referrals driven by neonatal screening and inherited defects, and autoimmune disease challenging to manage in children.

39073616.takeaway: Cord blood fetuin-B was higher in newborns of mothers with gestational diabetes than in euglycemic controls and correlated with LDL, total cholesterol, IGF-I and IGF-II.

39074461.takeaway: A German consensus process produced 37 quality indicators for care in differences of sex development, covering structure, process and outcome, now used for yearly benchmarking.

39075889.takeaway: In 275 adults with type 1 diabetes, glucose management indicator overestimated HbA1c by about 0.6% on Dexcom G6 but matched it on FreeStyle Libre, and a revised GMI equation reduced discordance.

39075942.takeaway: In a first-in-human pilot of 11 adults, an experimental glucose/lactate sensor achieved a mean absolute relative difference of 14.5% against venous reference values, close to a commercial CGM's 13.9%.

39076151.takeaway: A simulator extending the Padova T2D model with lactate reproduced glucose, insulin, C-peptide and lactate responses to an OGTT in 44 adolescents with or without obesity.

39078977.takeaway: In a pilot of youth with type 1 diabetes, those with obesity had a different gut microbiome, with a higher Prevotella-to-Bacteroides ratio and higher stool short-chain fatty acids than lean peers.

39078990.takeaway: Whole-genome sequencing confirmed one of three novel KDM6A duplications in neonatal hyperinsulinism as pathogenic, while the other two remained uncertain.

39080045.takeaway: Deleting RFX6 in human stem-cell islet organoids reduced PDX1 expression at the foregut stage and impaired islet organoid development and survival, while PDX1+/NKX6.1+ progenitors were unaffected.

39080863.takeaway: In 118 adults with non-insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, a CGM-based AI digital therapeutic lowered HbA1c by 0.67% over three months, with larger reductions in those with poorer control.

39081790.takeaway: Among 4,578 Emirati adults, high OSA risk was associated with type 2 diabetes (OR 6.44 unadjusted), and the association remained significant after adjusting for education, marital status, waist and smoking.

39081792.takeaway: In 228 adults in Northeast Ethiopia, metabolic syndrome prevalence was 23.2% and was linked to fasting glucose, and H. pylori-positive participants had higher LDL, triglycerides and blood pressure.

39083673.takeaway: In 3,645 women tested before 20 weeks, higher early-pregnancy OGTT glucose was continuously associated with late GDM, and 1-hour glucose of 10.6 mmol/L or more predicted perinatal complications.

39084206.takeaway: In children with CNS tumors treated with erdafitinib, linear growth accelerated independently of sex steroids and IGF-1, with growth-plate widening and enhanced metaphyseal mineralization, suggesting an FGFR-mediated mechanism.

39086895.takeaway: In 423 patients with papillary thyroid cancer and nodal metastasis, low pre-ablation thyroglobulin and a lower lymph node metastasis rate predicted an excellent response to 131I ablation.

39089289.takeaway: In 75 children with Prader-Willi syndrome followed over 30 years, scoliosis affected 41%, and GH-treated children had higher height and lower BMI than untreated peers at age 16.

39090525.takeaway: In children admitted with DKA, 2020 admissions had higher HbA1c and were more often autoantibody-negative than 2019 admissions, and higher HbA1c appeared to mediate more severe DKA.

39091237.takeaway: In 6,572 Danish adults with type 1 diabetes, models predicted cardiovascular disease and death within five years well (AUROC 0.79 and 0.87), but prediction of kidney disease was weak (0.61).

39092285.takeaway: Eight children aged 2 to 13 with Bardet-Biedl syndrome mostly presented with kidney disease, polydactyly and obesity, and phenotypes varied even among patients with the same gene mutation.

39093413.takeaway: In 61 people with pancreatic-insufficient cystic fibrosis, the disposition index fell as glucose tolerance worsened, and lower insulin secretion was linked to higher insulin clearance.

39096188.takeaway: In 100 patients with type 2 diabetes after bypass surgery, an electronic insulin protocol lowered glucose and hypoglycemia and reduced a composite of infection, renal and arrhythmia complications from 58% to 16%.

39096521.takeaway: Among 145 girls aged 9–11, quality-of-life scores were lower in girls with early breast development than in prepubertal peers, and girls treated with GnRH agonists did not differ significantly.

39097643.takeaway: Adrenal suppression was frequent with prednisone and vamorolone in boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, occurring in a dose-dependent way with vamorolone, and the authors recommend hydrocortisone stress dosing.

39099207.takeaway: In 197 patients with optic nerve hypoplasia, children with bilateral disease had 4.9 times the odds of pituitary deficiency compared with unilateral disease, and worse vision was linked to more deficiencies.

39099554.takeaway: In 1,040 Indian neonates, the External Genitalia Score was 0 in typical females and 9.5–11.5 in typical males; DSD evaluation is advised for scores above 0 at or below the 10th percentile.

39101220.takeaway: A 16-year-old girl with glycogen storage disease type V improved on DL-3-hydroxybutyrate with a modified Atkins diet, with better walking capacity and less quadriceps stiffness on elastography.

39102795.takeaway: This review of hypophosphatasia covers its variable presentations, including mild forms and asymptomatic carriers, and calls for consensus guidelines on diagnosis, enzyme replacement and follow-up.

39102796.takeaway: A 10-year-old boy with severe obesity, growth failure and ACTH-independent hypercortisolism had bilateral micronodular adrenal hyperplasia, prompting a genetic investigation for Carney complex.

39103721.takeaway: Outcome-guided clustering of islet autoantibody-positive relatives in TrialNet (n=1,123), validated in a separate cohort, identified six clusters with differing type 1 diabetes risk, including a high-glucose, high-risk group.

39104254.takeaway: RNA sequencing of a 17-year-old with follicular variant papillary thyroid cancer identified a novel TG-IGF1R kinase fusion, suggesting a possible targetable oncogene for thyroid sequencing panels.

39104809.takeaway: In 143 children and adolescents with differentiated thyroid cancer, preablation thyroglobulin, T stage and response to initial radioiodine were linked to an incomplete response at follow-up.

39105174.takeaway: This review finds diabetes stigma is common (up to 98% of youth with type 1 diabetes) and is linked to higher HbA1c, complications and, in youth with type 1, DKA and severe hypoglycemia.

39106437.takeaway: Eight patients from four families with biallelic IYD variants developed goiter and hypothyroidism, which recurred off levothyroxine in three, with rising thyroglobulin preceding relapse at low iodine intake.

39109081.takeaway: Blood chemokine profiles differed in children with type 1 diabetes or obesity compared with controls, and several chemokine and monocyte patterns were associated with blood pressure, albuminuria and lipids.

39109291.takeaway: In 25 men with prolactin-secreting adenomas and normal baseline testosterone, testosterone and LH rose after prolactin normalisation, and symptoms of testosterone deficiency improved.

39109292.takeaway: In 104 children with obesity, MC4R-pathway variants were not linked to obesity severity or most cardiometabolic markers, except that the PCSK1 risk allele was associated with higher LDL cholesterol.

39109799.takeaway: In 116 children with overweight or obesity, adding supervised exercise to a family lifestyle program reduced lumbar spine bone marrow fat, an effect partly mediated by reduced liver fat.

39110546.takeaway: In a crossover pilot trial of adolescents with type 1 diabetes, financial incentives improved self-management goal attainment and time in range, but HbA1c did not differ across arms.

39110568.takeaway: In 29 studies of 18,965 pregnancies with type 1 diabetes, preconception BMI of 25 or more raised perinatal complications by 22%, and excessive gestational weight gain by 50%.

39113198.takeaway: In 393 girls with Turner syndrome, lymphedema affected 37%, usually starting in the first year of life, and was linked with 45,X karyotype, webbed neck and nail changes.

39113384.takeaway: In 26 children with primary mitochondrial disease, 23% had hormonal deficits, including central adrenal insufficiency and central hypothyroidism, suggesting endocrine abnormalities can be an early warning sign.

39113392.takeaway: A 5.5-year-old girl with Schimke immuno-osseous dysplasia had a novel homozygous SMARCAL1 variant, with hypercalcemia, hypophosphatemia and raised FSH reported for the first time in this syndrome.

39113393.takeaway: In 43 children with PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome, thyroid ultrasound from age 12 detected differentiated thyroid carcinoma in 2 (5%), supporting surveillance from age 12.

39113394.takeaway: A report on Türkiye's Diabetes at School Program describes teacher training, designated school caregivers and policy steps that support children with diabetes at school.

39113399.takeaway: Across Thailand, DKA admission incidence in children with T1D rose from 4.8 to 7.3 per 100,000 child-years in 2015–2019, highest in those aged 13–17 and rising fastest in the Northeast.

39114287.takeaway: In juvenile macaques, maternal Western-style diet did not change the share of beta cells expressing maturity markers, but raised NKX6.1 at 3 years and may increase mitochondrial fragmentation.

39116897.takeaway: In the NHS Type 2 Diabetes Path to Remission programme, 27% of 710 participants with repeat HbA1c results were in remission at one year, with mean weight loss of 13.4%.

39119007.takeaway: In 18 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, the ocular surface scatter index was higher than in matched controls, and this was associated with estradiol levels.

39120742.takeaway: In 113 adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia, 56% were overweight or obese, but glucose abnormalities were no more common than in matched healthy controls.

39126560.takeaway: Italian multisociety GRADE guidelines give recommendations on andrological disorders from childhood to transition, including gynecomastia, macroorchidism, fertility preservation and pubertal disorders.

39126675.takeaway: This review sets out principles for pediatric glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis, emphasising early vertebral fracture identification, DXA interpretation and intravenous bisphosphonates as first-line therapy.

39128457.takeaway: A nocturnal salivary cortisol of 8 nmol/L or more identified endogenous Cushing's syndrome in children with obesity with 100% sensitivity and specificity in this small study, outperforming the percent-decrease measure.

39129921.takeaway: In 140 exclusively breastfed infants, higher cord-blood vitamin A was linked to better head-circumference growth at 3–6 months, while higher cord vitamin D was linked to greater BMI-for-age growth but lower length growth.

39133812.takeaway: In 3,015 Chinese three-year-olds, accelerated BMI growth between 6 and 24 months was linked to higher triglycerides and LDL cholesterol, with effects differing by sex, birthweight and size for gestational age.

39133813.takeaway: Among 1,056 US women with PCOS, most waited a year or more for diagnosis, fewer than 27% were satisfied with care, and those diagnosed within five years reported more satisfaction.

39135509.takeaway: In 146 girls on GnRH agonist treatment (99 with central precocious puberty, 47 with EFP), growth deceleration was more common in the second year in the EFP group, and bone age predicted deceleration.

39135519.takeaway: In five newborns with breast enlargement beyond the first week, regression correlated with serum prolactin levels, which normalised as the breasts regressed.

39136243.takeaway: In US adolescents aged 12–19 in NHANES 2017–2020, 24% had MASLD, and overweight or obesity was the most common cardiometabolic factor linked to liver steatosis.

39137138.takeaway: Serum 21-deoxycortisone was markedly raised in newborns with 21-hydroxylase deficiency (mean 17.6 ng/mL) and was near the detection limit in newborns without it, suggesting a sensitive additional biomarker.

39138689.takeaway: This review finds older adults with diabetes can benefit from CGM, pumps and automated insulin delivery through fewer hypoglycaemic events, emergency visits, admissions and better quality of life.

39138889.takeaway: In 80 children with symptomatic vitamin D deficiency, daily and fortnightly oral vitamin D3 at equal cumulative doses both reached sufficiency, with transient hypercalcemia in 34–51% in both arms.

39143688.takeaway: This commentary proposes that CGM use is an ongoing self-management behaviour, with predictors of sustained use depending on each person's goal for CGM.

39143692.takeaway: This commentary argues that insulin-on-board displays in automated insulin delivery systems can mislead, because they do not reflect true insulin action or dynamic adjustments, and proposes a refined netIOB measure.

39143767.takeaway: A Chinese expert consensus with Delphi review gives 14 recommendations on aromatase inhibitors to improve adolescent height, covering efficacy, adverse effects, dosage and duration.

39145882.takeaway: This review proposes six steps for exercise in type 1 diabetes, including about 0.5 g/kg/h extra carbohydrate for adults and 1.0 g/kg/h for youth, and pre-emptive basal reduction or hybrid closed-loop exercise modes.

39146468.takeaway: In 7,464 CamAPS FX users, Boost and Ease-off were used safely: time below 70 mg/dL was low during Boost, time above 180 mg/dL fell during Ease-off, and no severe hypoglycemia or DKA occurred.

39147856.takeaway: An international consensus on pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma in children notes that most childhood cases are hereditary and calls for multidisciplinary teams that include paediatric endocrinologists.

39148300.takeaway: Using a 7-year-old boy with Cushing syndrome as an example, this review notes that adult diagnostic tests need adjustment for children and that care should be in centres with experienced paediatric endocrinologists.

39148418.takeaway: In SLC4A1 distal renal tubular acidosis, skeletal lesions were common, and HR-pQCT showed worse trabecular bone than in healthy controls and in X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets, with alkali therapy easing bone pain.

39150977.takeaway: In 60 trans women after about 4.5 years of hormone therapy, early puberty suppression did not increase breast volume, and 68% were satisfied with their breast size.

39150981.takeaway: In the Kailuan cohort of adults with statin indications, statin use was associated with a 22% lower risk of new NAFLD, an association seen only with at least two years of statin use.

39150993.takeaway: In 243 transgender adults, skeletal dimensions changed with hormone therapy mainly when puberty suppression began before puberty was complete, and early suppression narrowed shoulders in people assigned male.

39154638.takeaway: Among 36 children with iPPSD2 or iPPSD3, parents reported constipation in 61%, and the Bristol stool scale confirmed it in 87% of those reporting it.

39155058.takeaway: This review of paediatric adrenal insufficiency covers circadian glucocorticoid replacement, androgen-lowering adjuncts for CAH, and an AAV-based gene therapy now in development for CAH.

39155529.takeaway: This review says connected smart pens transmit dosing data, and combined with CGM they approach automated insulin delivery more cheaply, though people still dose insulin themselves.

39159241.takeaway: In 31 very young children with persistent multiple islet autoantibodies, CGM showed more glucose variability and more time above 7.8 mmol/L than in 24 autoantibody-negative controls.

39163037.takeaway: In 73,900 adults across China, higher long-term PM2.5 exposure was associated with subclinical hypothyroidism, autoimmune thyroiditis and thyroglobulin antibody positivity, but not with hyperthyroidism.

39163248.takeaway: In 93 children and adolescents with stage 1 papillary thyroid cancer managed without radioiodine, 91% stayed disease-free without further therapy over a median of 5.5 years.

39163851.takeaway: In 76 girls, the average of two peak LH values during a GnRH stimulation test, with a 4.25 IU/L cut-off, distinguished central precocious puberty from premature thelarche with 95% sensitivity and 97% specificity.

39165147.takeaway: Two siblings and their mother with diabetes and a heterozygous CFAP126 variant responded to glibenclamide, suggesting a possible new genetic diabetes subtype that needs confirmation.

39165509.takeaway: In 161 women with well-controlled gestational diabetes undergoing elective cesarean, ERAS raised preoperative glucose by a mean of 0.47 mmol/L, below the 1 mmol/L threshold, and composite glucose-related complications were lower.

39166792.takeaway: In 40 children with type 1 diabetes, urinary NGAL was higher than in matched controls, suggesting early tubular damage.

39169876.takeaway: In a mixed-meal tracer study, early adolescents with type 1 diabetes had insulin sensitivity similar to non-diabetic adults but higher than adults with type 1 diabetes, suggesting sensitivity falls with diabetes duration.

39171910.takeaway: Higher maternal thyroid peroxidase antibodies in early pregnancy were linked to higher cardiometabolic risk at age 5–6, mainly in boys, and high antibody trajectories raised the odds of hyperglycemia.

39171965.takeaway: In 256 patients with hereditary pheochromocytoma, partial adrenalectomy had higher ipsilateral recurrence (15% vs 4%) than radical surgery, with similar metastasis and mortality.

39172553.takeaway: In 130 youth with obesity, an OGTT-derived disposition index without insulin detected impaired glucose tolerance better than the oral index or the clamp-based index, at much lower cost.

39173606.takeaway: In 63 children treated for adrenocortical tumours, most reached adult height within target range despite advanced bone age at diagnosis, but nine developed central precocious puberty.

39175568.takeaway: Nine untreated 46,XX classic CAH patients reared as males in Indonesia had low unstimulated cortisol that did not rise with ACTH, and 11-oxygenated androgens made up 41–60% of androgens in 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

39175574.takeaway: In children and young adults with 21-hydroxylase-deficient CAH, leptin and HOMA-IR were higher in overweight participants, and adiponectin was inversely correlated with androstenedione.

39175575.takeaway: In 1,452 Chinese pregnant women, lower first-trimester PAPP-A and PLGF were linked to gestational diabetes, and a combined maternal-biomarker model reached an AUC of 0.73 for predicting it.

39180292.takeaway: In 796 adults with type 2 diabetes, time in range rose from 63% to 73% after switching from predictive low-glucose suspend to automated insulin delivery, with time above range falling.

39183148.takeaway: In 29 untreated classic CAH patients, free cortisol was similar to controls despite lower total cortisol, while free 21-deoxycortisol was high in 21-hydroxylase deficiency and undetectable in controls.

39186468.takeaway: In 14,292 children in the DPV registry, those diagnosed early by HbA1c had lower combined glucose indicators three years later and more partial remission (12.6% vs 9.1% with late diagnosis).

39186535.takeaway: In 113 patients with primary hypophysitis, glucocorticoid treatment produced more hormonal and radiologic improvement than observation, while spontaneous improvement may justify observation in mild cases.

39186924.takeaway: Among 75 nodules in 73 children who had surgery, 63% were malignant on histology, and the study assessed how well Bethesda-classified fine-needle cytology predicted malignancy.

39186929.takeaway: In interviews with 110 DSD stakeholders, successful fertility-related care was defined by early, repeated discussion of fertility options, attention to age and culture, and balancing trade-offs such as typical anatomy versus function.

39188918.takeaway: Among first-degree relatives of people with T1D who had positive autoantibodies, 54% progressed to diabetes over a median of five years, fastest in those under 20 with multiple autoantibodies.

39189533.takeaway: This case-based review illustrates the difficulty of establishing the cause of thyrotoxicosis in children, including thyroid hormone resistance and subacute thyroiditis, and treatment challenges such as flare-ups on antithyroid drugs.

39189676.takeaway: In 135 children with subclinical hypothyroidism, the most common cause was idiopathic (29%), followed by obesity (16%) and Hashimoto's thyroiditis (13%), and the authors suggest TSHR testing in idiopathic cases.

39190198.takeaway: In Chinese children with GH deficiency given PEGylated rhGH for five years, height SDS rose by 2.15 at five years, with no rapid bone maturation and no severe adverse events.

39190464.takeaway: Sequencing 679 Chinese patients with early-onset diabetes found KCNJ11 variants in 0.88%, judged uncertain, and loss-of-function variants showed a different phenotype from gain-of-function variants.

39190903.takeaway: In four infants with persistent hyperinsulinemic hypoglycaemia refractory to standard care, sirolimus enabled hospital discharge and worked at lower trough levels, though one infant had recurrent viral infections.

39192600.takeaway: A preterm infant developed severe hypothyroidism after enteral iodinated contrast, and a systematic review found only eight reported cases, so the authors recommend monitoring thyroid function after such exposure.

39205688.takeaway: In 108 children who had total thyroidectomy and were on levothyroxine, 94% had normal T3 levels, but most had T3 in the lower half of normal, often despite raised free T4.

39207206.takeaway: Pooling individual data from 1,904 healthy infants, the morning-to-evening salivary cortisol ratio rose from 1.7 at birth to 3.7 at 6–9 months, showing the morning peak gradually emerges.

39211452.takeaway: A meta-analysis of ten studies found burosumab improved phosphate, 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D, ALP and rickets severity in children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, but long-term height data are lacking.

39213311.takeaway: Among boys with partial androgen insensitivity, gynecomastia occurred in 91% of genetically confirmed cases, and clinicians rated surgery as more effective than medical therapy.

39215571.takeaway: Two cases illustrate how to distinguish pediatric pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma from neuroblastoma when adrenal, pelvic or retroperitoneal masses present, since management and surveillance differ.

39215812.takeaway: In a prespecified secondary analysis of the EMERGE trial, pre-eclampsia was strongly linked to SGA infants, and metformin did not produce a more severe SGA phenotype.

39220359.takeaway: In 31,449 Mexican adults screened online, 73% were at intermediate or high risk of hypothyroidism on the Zulewski scale, and questions on slow movement, dry skin and facial edema identified 90% of high-risk people.

39222618.takeaway: This review says GLP-1 receptor agonists help adults with type 1 diabetes, but they are not approved for children with T1D, and pediatric trial data are lacking.

39224124.takeaway: In 21 patients with Fanconi anemia, most had CNS anomalies and small pituitary volume was common, but pituitary volume did not correlate with short stature or endocrine deficiency.

39229379.takeaway: This review of hypertensive crises in children with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma notes that most cases are hereditary and recommends alpha-blockers first-line, with beta-blockers only after adequate alpha-blockade.

39229380.takeaway: Bioinformatic analysis of placental datasets identified three metabolism-related hub genes (ANPEP, CKMT1B, PLA2G4A) that distinguished spontaneous preterm birth, with AUC above 0.75 in validation.

39231019.takeaway: In 889 six-year-olds, maternal gestational diabetes reduced children's lung function z-scores, and higher maternal 1- and 2-hour glucose was linked to poorer lung function, especially in girls.

39231249.takeaway: In 1,297 children with new type 1 diabetes, Hispanic White children were younger at onset, more often in ketoacidosis, and had a higher DR4-DQ8 haplotype frequency (79% vs 60%).

39231482.takeaway: This review summarises evidence that microRNAs fine-tune the initiation of puberty alongside genetic, hormonal, nutritional and environmental factors, though their precise mechanisms remain unclear.

39231483.takeaway: In 506 propensity-matched Korean children, mean serum 25(OH)D did not change during the pandemic, but winter and spring levels were lower than before it.

39231484.takeaway: In 111 Korean adolescents with overweight or obesity, carotid intima-media thickness tracked age and BMI but not metabolic phenotype or cardiometabolic risk factors.

39231485.takeaway: In 275 people with type 1 diabetes tracked from infancy to early adulthood, HbA1c peaked at age 1, then again at 15–16 years, a pattern potentially due to adolescent insulin resistance.

39231486.takeaway: In 91 Saudi children with type 1 diabetes and 91 controls, serum TGF-β1 was lower in the diabetes group, and low-production TGF-β1 and IL-6 genotypes were more frequent in patients.

39231487.takeaway: In 1,630 Korean children, the tri-ponderal mass index correlated with IGF-I and IGFBP-3 SDS, and in overweight boys it may correlate more strongly with IGFBP-3 than BMI does.

39231488.takeaway: In children with acute leukemia, glycated albumin correlated with HbA1c, so it may complement HbA1c for glucose monitoring in pediatric leukemia.

39234504.takeaway: In 303 patients with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma followed for a mean of 11 years, survival stayed high unless patients had major cardiovascular events before diagnosis or metastatic disease.

39234508.takeaway: This review concludes that mindfulness shows preliminary effectiveness for improving physiological and psychological indicators in adolescent obesity, supporting it as a possible new approach.

39237104.takeaway: In 90 newly diagnosed people with type 1 diabetes followed for 12 months, 60% reached partial remission, which was linked to younger age, no DKA, higher C-peptide and the VDR Fok1 CC genotype.

39239989.takeaway: A 10-year-old girl with metastatic RET-fusion papillary thyroid cancer received selpercatinib before radioiodine, with lung metastases resolving and thyroglobulin falling to 1.0 ng/mL after RAI.

39242187.takeaway: In 40 children with type 1 diabetes, global longitudinal strain and diastolic indices were worse than in matched controls, while serum cardiotrophin-1 did not differ and was not specific for early cardiomyopathy.

39242350.takeaway: This review explains that refractory hypothyroidism in children is most often due to poor adherence, and that malabsorption, interacting drugs and other illnesses should be checked before increasing levothyroxine.

39243118.takeaway: Among 71 children receiving enzyme replacement therapy for lysosomal storage diseases, 25% had hypersensitivity reactions, with anaphylaxis in 6 of the 18, and several were managed by desensitisation.

39247917.takeaway: A nomogram combining age, prealbumin, HDL-C, C-peptide and autoantibodies distinguished type 1 from other diabetes in 522 patients, with AUC 0.966 in training and 0.961 in validation.

39247924.takeaway: In Hungarian health survey data, diabetes was not associated with migraine after adjustment, but stroke, low back pain and depression were linked to migraine among people with diabetes.

39250166.takeaway: This review presents youth-onset type 2 diabetes as a rapidly progressive disease preceded by prediabetes, and discusses social determinants and current and emerging management strategies.

39250908.takeaway: Among 50 adolescent girls with transfusion-dependent thalassaemia, 40% had ovarian insufficiency, which was linked to higher pituitary iron on MRI (R2*) and serum ferritin, with pituitary R2* the strongest predictor.

39252611.takeaway: In 3,152 atomic bomb survivors exposed before age 15, higher radiation dose was linked to higher CRP, triglycerides and HOMA-IR, suggesting insulin resistance may underlie radiation-related diabetes.

39252615.takeaway: In whole-blood RNA from people with new-onset type 1 diabetes, retained-intron splicing events distinguished cases from controls with high accuracy in a validation cohort, pointing to a systemic viral response.

39253355.takeaway: In Prop1-mutant mice, Pou3f4 upregulation was not required for normal pituitary development or function, so its loss is unlikely to cause combined pituitary hormone deficiency.
