39253584.takeaway: In 4,753 NHANES 2017–2018 participants, the ALT/AST ratio was positively associated with NAFLD, liver steatosis and fibrosis, with a non-linear pattern in women.

39254103.takeaway: This commentary argues that batteries in CGMs and insulin pumps add to environmental waste, with over 150 million CGM units discarded yearly, and highlights recycling and design options.

39255435.takeaway: In 135,405 Chinese adults followed for six years, diabetes raised all-cause mortality risk by 61% and shortened life expectancy at age 40 by about 4.2 years, while prediabetes had smaller effects.

39257303.takeaway: This review says new anti-obesity medications may fill the gap between lifestyle therapy and surgery for adolescents aged 12 and over, though long-term safety data and data for under-12s are lacking.

39258010.takeaway: In a 513-child CAH registry, median sick-day episodes per patient-year fell from 0.3 in 2019 to 0 in 2022, and hospitalisation after episodes fell from 27% to 22%.

39258502.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with SHORT syndrome had a novel PIK3R1 mutation and early hyperglycaemia that improved with metformin, and her short stature was not due to growth hormone deficiency.

39259767.takeaway: In 3,133 CARDIA adults aged 33–45, higher betaine was linked to lower 15-year diabetes risk and higher TMAO to higher risk, while choline showed no significant association.

39259909.takeaway: In 1,722 Chinese school girls, self-reported puberty scores correlated only weakly with Tanner staging, and in overweight or obese girls they reached a 90% positive predictive value for pubertal onset.

39262158.takeaway: An 11.5-year-old Chinese patient with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism had a novel homozygous KISS1R variant, with micropenis and cryptorchidism at birth.

39262574.takeaway: In 79 pubertal boys with idiopathic short stature, anastrozole and letrozole gave similar predicted adult height gains over three years, but letrozole caused greater hormonal and growth-velocity changes.

39268230.takeaway: In a rat model of PCOS, early postnatal overfeeding with hyperandrogenism impaired hepatic insulin sensitivity and triggered NLRP3-IL1β inflammation with reduced AMPK activation.

39269686.takeaway: In 42 youth with type 1 diabetes and HbA1c above 8.5%, advanced hybrid closed-loop lowered HbA1c by 0.77 percentage points versus usual care, but psychosocial outcomes did not differ.

39270074.takeaway: An Argentine paediatric endocrinology update says cryptorchidism should prompt evaluation for differences of sex development or syndromes, with early orchiopexy before 12–18 months as first-line treatment.

39271158.takeaway: In 62 prepubertal children born small for gestational age, once-weekly somapacitan gave height velocity and IGF-I responses similar to daily GH over 52 weeks, with comparable safety.

39271520.takeaway: Adding sitagliptin to advanced hybrid closed-loop in 46 adolescents with type 1 diabetes and microalbuminuria lowered urinary albumin-creatinine ratio from 7.3 to 1.3 mg/mmol, with no severe hypoglycaemia.

39277901.takeaway: In 493 children tested for GH deficiency, children with ADHD were GH-sufficient with normal IGFBP-3, suggesting IGFBP-3 may help avoid unnecessary provocation testing in ADHD.

39279438.takeaway: A premature newborn with 6q24 transient neonatal diabetes, caused by uniparental disomy of chromosome 6, needed IV insulin, and diabetes resolved after glibenclamide was stopped for adverse effects.

39279461.takeaway: In 105 girls, omentin-1 was lower and chemerin higher in lean girls with central precocious puberty, but both markers had only modest sensitivity and specificity.

39279998.takeaway: In 109 patients with MAX germline mutations, 93% developed pheochromocytoma, often bilateral, and 19% had metastases, with two variants described for the first time.

39280012.takeaway: In 2,915 US adults aged 18–45, depression was associated with infertility (OR 1.66), and obesity mediated about 7–16% of this association.

39282925.takeaway: This review highlights promising diagnostics for diabetic neuropathy, such as skin biopsy and corneal confocal microscopy, and new pain drugs, but finds that better diagnostics and treatments are still needed.

39283820.takeaway: Age-specific TSH and FT4 reference intervals from 7.6 million Dutch laboratory requests show limits vary with age, and adult age-specific TSH limits would reduce subclinical hypothyroidism diagnoses over age 50–60.

39283821.takeaway: In Olmsted County, Minnesota, thyroid eye disease incidence was 5 per 100,000 person-years, with women at 8.9 versus 1 in men, and severe soft-tissue involvement and diplopia predicted progression.

39283825.takeaway: In 12 male patients with monocarboxylate transporter 8 deficiency, combined propylthiouracil and levothyroxine lowered T3 by 25% and normalised free T4 and thyrotropin, with no liver or granulocyte toxicity.

39283830.takeaway: DICER1 variants were found in 6.9% of 350 pediatric and young adult thyroid nodules, and DICER1-positive papillary carcinomas were associated with the follicular subtype.

39284171.takeaway: Among 147 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes, 42% had disordered eating, and the factors linked to it differed by glycaemic variability, with disinhibited eating and HbA1c important in those with high variability.

39288009.takeaway: In 52,140 children in the Japan Environment and Children's Study, longer night-time sleep at 1.5 years was linked to higher odds of tall stature at 3 years, but total sleep duration was not.

39288020.takeaway: In 63 transgender women on estradiol, spironolactone and cyproterone acetate gave similar breast growth at six months, while cyproterone was more likely to suppress testosterone below 2 nmol/L.

39288098.takeaway: Among 273 children with Cushing syndrome, those without obesity were more often female, older at onset and further along puberty, while those with obesity had more hypertension and insulin resistance.

39288191.takeaway: Among 497 underserved young adults with type 1 diabetes, the SEAD programme reduced hospitalisations by 64% in those with HbA1c above 9% and by 74% in publicly insured patients.

39289684.takeaway: A modified Delphi of 17 international experts agreed that combining vosoritide with limb surgery should be planned by age and puberty within a multidisciplinary specialist team, with individualised goals.

39290158.takeaway: In 1,810 probands with idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, truncating and missense SOX11 variants were enriched, and carriers also had GH deficiency, hypothyroidism and pituitary or hypothalamic defects.

39290326.takeaway: This review summarises how lipid and energy sensors such as mTOR, AMPK and SIRT1 in the hypothalamus link metabolism to reproduction, with a focus on the nutritional control of puberty.

39290328.takeaway: Of 584 brain MRI scans in 414 children with growth hormone deficiency, short stature or central precocious puberty, 46% were judged unnecessary, mostly repeated scans with no change.

39292994.takeaway: In 81 girls followed through puberty, early maturers had higher peak height velocity than late maturers, and this was associated with higher fasting insulin rather than IGF-I or fat mass.

39293420.takeaway: In 25 children with arginine vasopressin deficiency and 43 controls, a maximum insulin-stimulated copeptin of 3.0 pmol/L identified deficiency with 92% sensitivity and 94% specificity.

39295121.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with high estrogen and gonadotropins, no breast development and delayed bone age had a homozygous ESR1 variant, consistent with estrogen resistance.

39295130.takeaway: An adolescent with non-classical 11β-hydroxylase deficiency, who did not tolerate glucocorticoids, controlled his hypertension on eplerenone monotherapy, with 24-hour blood pressure of 124/81 mmHg.

39295163.takeaway: In 80 children with partial biotinidase deficiency, optical coherence tomography angiography showed lower macular and optic disc vessel density and enlarged foveal avascular zones than in healthy controls.

39295284.takeaway: Among 36 pediatric cancer survivors with ovarian failure, 28% recovered ovarian function, with younger age at diagnosis and alkylating-agent chemotherapy without transplant linked to recovery.

39295451.takeaway: Two siblings with a biallelic ACAN variant had severe short stature and skeletal changes, including platyspondylia and scoliosis, and the authors stress genetic testing for such features.

39296715.takeaway: In 2,290 Korean children aged 6–18, an unhealthy dietary-habit cluster was associated with about 1.4-fold higher odds of general and abdominal obesity than a healthier cluster.

39296718.takeaway: Of 482 new transgender adult patients at a Midwest clinic, 81% had a mental health diagnosis and 12% reported a suicide attempt, and no single factor predicted a mental health diagnosis.

39296719.takeaway: In 406 women, 205 with gestational diabetes had more postpartum depression than 201 controls, with GDM a risk factor after adjustment and higher neonatal birth weight and more education protective.

39301311.takeaway: Among 524 children referred with prediabetes, 25% were lost to follow-up, and a scheduled telemedicine visit was the factor most strongly associated with returning to clinic.

39302657.takeaway: In 50 youth with type 1 diabetes, higher fractional urinary calcium excretion was linked to slower whole-body bone mineral accrual over 12 months.

39302847.takeaway: Among 3,603 Swedish children with type 1 diabetes, parents with type 2 diabetes were nearly twice as common as in the general population, and those with that family history were more often overweight.

39303070.takeaway: In 214 patients with head and neck paraganglioma, recurrence occurred in 74% with SDHx variants and 40% without, and carotid-body location predicted metastasis in those without SDHx variants.

39305340.takeaway: In 169 adults with type 2 diabetes in the Marshall Islands, a whole-food plant-based diet with exercise lowered HbA1c by an extra 1.3% at 12 weeks versus standard care and reduced glucose-lowering medication use.

39311388.takeaway: In a nationally representative NHANES sample of 1,299 US girls aged 6–18, girls with obesity had higher free testosterone than healthy-weight girls in every age group.

39311445.takeaway: In 18 people with type 1 diabetes and impaired hypoglycaemia awareness, four weeks of high-intensity interval training did not increase hypoglycaemia and reduced nocturnal hypoglycaemia exposure.

39311452.takeaway: A random-forest model estimated breakfast timing and glucose responses from CGM data without meal logs, with no significant difference from annotated responses in adults with or at risk of type 2 diabetes.

39311553.takeaway: In 24 adolescents with severe obesity, three months of liraglutide reduced BMI, HbA1c and triglycerides and reduced uncontrolled eating, with CGM showing more time in the normal glucose range.

39311554.takeaway: In 205 adolescents with obesity, those in the highest dietary acid load tertile had higher BMI, insulin, HOMA-IR, triglycerides and blood pressure, with poorer resilience and sleep quality.

39311599.takeaway: Five members of one family with genetically confirmed von Hippel-Lindau disease each developed pheochromocytoma during childhood, and the authors recommend screening and long-term care.

39311760.takeaway: A 9.3-year-old boy with Floating-Harbor syndrome, presenting with proportional short stature and delayed bone age, had an SRCAP pathogenic variant confirmed by molecular testing.

39312231.takeaway: In 61 patients with hypophysitis, almost half had a systemic cause such as sarcoidosis or histiocytosis, and pituitary deficiency preceded systemic disease in a quarter of cases.

39312415.takeaway: In 172 children with perinatally acquired HIV, height-adjusted whole-body bone mineral density and content stayed lower than in healthy peers, with slower bone-area accrual before age 14.

39313572.takeaway: This review argues that early-life obesity reflects interacting biological, social and environmental influences, and that solutions need coordinated, multi-focus action across the first 2,000 days.

39314523.takeaway: In 60 non-obese women with PCOS and 60 matched controls, PCOS was associated with higher testosterone, free androgen index and waist-to-hip ratio.

39319403.takeaway: In 15,959 US adults, a higher systemic immune-inflammation index was associated with metabolic syndrome (OR 1.56), but not among adults over 65.

39321413.takeaway: Among 475 juveniles with differentiated thyroid carcinoma in Poland treated from 1970 to 2015, tumours became smaller and less multifocal over time, while central-neck lymph node metastases became more common.

39324646.takeaway: In 102 children and young adults with skeletal fragility treated with zoledronic acid, median annual fracture rate fell from 0.6 to 0, with reductions in both primary and secondary fragility.

39324648.takeaway: In 90 children with central precocious puberty, (epi)genetic causes were found in 12%, mostly Temple syndrome 14 and MKRN3 defects, often in those with paternal early puberty or SGA birth.

39324654.takeaway: In 1.33 million people with hyperthyroidism in a national database, propylthiouracil use was linked to higher acute pancreatitis risk and propranolol to lower risk, with no significant association for methimazole.

39324669.takeaway: In 4,072 Chinese children aged 6–18, low weight-specific grip strength was linked to higher cardiometabolic risk, with a dose-dependent pattern particularly in boys.

39324789.takeaway: In 7,059 mother-child pairs in Hefei, short sleep during pregnancy was linked to neurodevelopmental delay in boys, and cord-blood C-peptide mediated about 11% of this association.

39329336.takeaway: In 302 infant girls during minipuberty, total antral follicle count tracked ovarian volume, AMH and inhibin B, and was inversely related to FSH.

39329345.takeaway: In two European cohorts, higher maternal thyroglobulin was linked to higher free T4 in pregnancy and lower early-childhood IQ, but not to IQ or brain structure later in childhood.

39348816.takeaway: In a survey of Pediatric Endocrine Society members, 85% routinely ordered brain MRI for isolated growth hormone deficiency, 60% used gadolinium contrast, and 54% were unaware of retention risks.

39351530.takeaway: This review summarises autoimmune primary adrenal insufficiency in children, now thought to be the second most common cause in the paediatric age group, and aims to raise awareness of early signs.

39351778.takeaway: This review proposes a workflow and RiGHT risk scores for Turner syndrome variants with Xp deletion, illustrated by a girl whose height improved after two years of growth hormone.

39351910.takeaway: In 129 patients with Cushing's syndrome and 48 with mild autonomous cortisol secretion, hypertension was the most common comorbidity, and patients with overt CS had more clinical signs than those with MACS.

39353071.takeaway: In 889 transgender youth before any treatment, bone mineral density Z-scores fell with age in those assigned male at birth between 12 and 22, a change partly explained by lean mass.

39353075.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 14,010 adolescents estimated PCOS prevalence at 6.3% using 2023 guideline criteria, compared with 9.8% using Rotterdam criteria that include ovarian morphology.

39359410.takeaway: Early-onset chronic kidney disease in people aged 15–39 rose in incidence from 1990 to 2019, with high systolic blood pressure, fasting glucose and BMI as the main attributable risk factors.

39360599.takeaway: Australian and New Zealand expert consensus recommends standardised preparation, sampling and interpretation for adrenal vein sampling to identify surgically curable unilateral primary aldosteronism.

39360602.takeaway: In children with hypoglycaemia, a plasma C-peptide above 291.5 pmol/L diagnosed congenital hyperinsulinism with 82% sensitivity and 99% specificity, the most useful of the markers studied.

39360615.takeaway: This review proposes that maternal under- or overnutrition, diabetes and endocrine disruptors program earlier puberty through leptin and insulin signalling, a pattern that may be amplified across generations.

39361726.takeaway: Two siblings with the same homozygous SRD5A2 Gly183Ser variant had distinct phenotypes, one raised as a girl and both later assuming male gender identity, illustrating weak genotype-phenotype correlation.

39362209.takeaway: Across three T1D registries of about 100,000 people, BMI and BMI SDS rose in DPV children and adults from 2018 to 2021, and nearly half in every registry were overweight or obese.

39363896.takeaway: This systematic review of eleven studies found that sleep duration affects food intake, eating habits and hormone levels linked to childhood obesity, supporting sleep hygiene as a modifiable factor.

39369310.takeaway: In 142 adults with painful diabetic neuropathy, 10-kHz spinal cord stimulation cut pain severity by 67% over 24 months and improved diabetes-related quality of life and functioning.

39369697.takeaway: A bilingual Latino research assistant and clinic-based approaches helped recruit underrepresented families with pediatric type 1 diabetes, with 87% of clinic approaches leading to consent and recruitment goals exceeded.

39371924.takeaway: A 14-year-old boy with insulinoma and hyperparathyroidism had a novel MEN1 frameshift variant, which his father also carried along with hyperparathyroidism, showing varied phenotypes within one family.

39371928.takeaway: This review explores how hormones such as glucocorticoids, thyroid hormones, insulin, leptin and sex steroids influence lung development, ventilation and inflammation in children, with implications for personalised care.

39371933.takeaway: In 15 children and adolescents with X-linked hypophosphatemia, rotational MRI and CT showed femoral and tibial torsion abnormalities in many limbs, including severe femoral retrotorsion in a 2-year-old.

39373523.takeaway: In 327 patients with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, lower CD4+ T-cell percentage was seen with lymph node or bone metastases, and a nomogram of immune markers identified metastatic disease with an AUC of 0.80.

39373987.takeaway: In 10,346 Swedish children with obesity, MASLD was linked to a 2.7-fold higher risk of youth-onset type 2 diabetes, and the joint effect with intermediate hyperglycaemia was about 9-fold.

39374844.takeaway: This review notes that paediatric pituitary adenomas are often larger and more aggressive than adult tumours, prolactinomas are most common, and any child with a pituitary tumour should have genetic testing.

39377073.takeaway: This review links maternal under- and overnutrition in pregnancy to changes in maternal and fetal pancreas and placenta that reduce beta-cell mass and insulin sensitivity, raising offspring risk of obesity and type 2 diabetes.

39377175.takeaway: Explainable machine-learning models built from CGM and baseline data were developed to predict week-to-week risk of hyperglycaemia, hypoglycaemia and glycaemic variability in type 1 diabetes.

39377546.takeaway: In 67 patients with Noonan syndrome who reached final height, those treated with growth hormone gained about 1.4 SDS in height compared with untreated patients, with no significant side effects.

39377547.takeaway: This review proposes a tiered approach to newborns with elevated TSH in iodine-deficient settings, following mild cases, and treating moderate cases by age, TSH trend and free T4 to limit overtreatment.

39378147.takeaway: Among 380 patients with autoimmune polyglandular syndrome, Hashimoto's thyroiditis was the most common component (67%), followed by Graves' disease and type 1 diabetes, and the syndrome started earlier in men.

39378179.takeaway: In a quasi-experimental study of 5,582 insured patients with diabetes, switching to preventive drug lists cut out-of-pocket medication spending by about 30% in year two, with similar savings for higher- and lower-income members.

39378853.takeaway: In 61 children with congenital hypothyroidism from 45 families, genetic testing found variants in 38% of families, most often in TPO, followed by TSHR and DUOX2, with six novel variants.

39380079.takeaway: An Italian position paper recommends early screening of children with overweight or obesity for hypertension, dyslipidaemia, prediabetes, MASLD, PCOS, sleep apnoea and kidney decline, with weight loss as the core treatment.

39381439.takeaway: In 1,768 US children from NHANES 2015–2016, links between sex steroids and hs-CRP differed by sex and pubertal stage, with an inverse SHBG–CRP link seen in all groups.

39382384.takeaway: Low-level mosaic GCK mutations, at 4–10% in pancreatic tissue, were found in 5 of 10 children with diazoxide-unresponsive hyperinsulinism, suggesting postzygotic mutations cause some non-focal cases.

39382514.takeaway: In 143 Mexican children, a late glucose peak on the OGTT was more common in those with obesity and monophasic curves, suggesting OGTT parameters could help flag children at higher risk of type 2 diabetes.

39383105.takeaway: Among 35 parents of children with DSD, 43% hesitated to disclose the diagnosis because they thought their child too young, and children with more psychiatric symptoms more often had gender-assignment discrepancies.

39387047.takeaway: An infant with triple A syndrome showed the full triad of alacrima, achalasia and adrenal insufficiency by six months, with severe autonomic involvement, and died at 25 months after pancreatitis.

39387055.takeaway: This review describes stem-cell and organoid models of MODY and neonatal diabetes, which are needed because important differences exist between mouse and human beta cells.

39387222.takeaway: In 1,441 DCCT/EDIC participants, insulin pump use carried a high DKA risk in the 1980s (HR 5.8) that fell to a non-significant 1.24 in the 2010s.

39387270.takeaway: Among 110 children with type 1 diabetes in New Delhi, mean diabetes knowledge scores were 58%, and higher scores were associated with HbA1c below 8.5% and urban residence.

39387353.takeaway: A 14.5-year-old girl with a 46,XX karyotype and virilization had bilateral gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma, and the authors advise considering gonadal biopsy even when investigations look normal.

39388314.takeaway: In 24,435 participants in a US digital cohort, 6.9% reported possible hirsutism and 31.8% moderate-to-severe acne, with hirsutism more common in Hispanic and South Asian and higher-BMI participants.

39389067.takeaway: Thyroid cancer incidence rose in most of 63 countries over 1980–2017, and the authors estimate the share of diagnoses that reflect overdiagnosis.

39391872.takeaway: In germ-free NOD mice, introducing microbiota at birth, rather than at weaning, markedly reduced type 1 diabetes risk, showing a time-limited early-life window for protection.

39391975.takeaway: In a Kaiser Permanente cohort of women with complete androgen insensitivity or müllerian agenesis, anxiety and depression were about twice as common as in men without DSD, but less clearly different from women without DSD.

39394785.takeaway: In 23,786 at-risk patients at Boston Medical Center, Black patients and those on Medicaid or charity insurance had higher odds of a missed PCOS diagnosis (OR 1.69 and 1.90).

39396497.takeaway: In 1,167 NHANES children aged 6–19, co-exposure to PAHs and heavy metals was linked to lower SHBG in prepubertal boys and lower estradiol in pubertal boys, with cadmium and mercury contributing most.

39397568.takeaway: Among 220 pediatric and young adult patients with thyroid cancer detected through Fukushima screening, 98% had papillary carcinoma and 98% had stage I disease.

39397750.takeaway: In 97 young people randomised at diagnosis of type 1 diabetes, hybrid closed-loop therapy did not significantly change sleep versus standard care over two years, though early trends favoured closed loop.

39397768.takeaway: After California Medicaid eased CGM coverage in 2022, CGM use among Medicaid-insured children and young adults with type 1 diabetes rose from 41% to 58%, though a disparity remained.

39397773.takeaway: In 165 people with type 1 diabetes, a higher glycemia risk index was strongly associated with cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy, and predicted it better than time in range.

39398332.takeaway: Among 398 people with type 1 diabetes discharged from hospital, BMI, dyslipidaemia and diastolic blood pressure were linked to whether non-insulin glucose-lowering drugs were prescribed, with factors varying by sex and age.

39398340.takeaway: In 28 obese adolescents, four weeks of aquatic or land high-intensity interval training reduced body mass, BMI, body fat and blood pressure, with only aquatic training lowering resting heart rate.

39401123.takeaway: Four patients with HNF1B deletion (MODY 5) had neurodevelopmental disorder, renal malformations and pancreatic abnormalities, so MODY 5 should be suspected in diabetes with renal anomalies.

39401151.takeaway: In GH3 pituitary cells, hsa_circ_0002473 acted as a competing RNA that suppressed proliferation and growth hormone secretion by sponging miR-4645-3p, which otherwise targets SSTR2.

39401333.takeaway: This review argues that lifestyle interventions during pregnancy have limited effect on child metabolic outcomes, and that intervention before conception may be needed to prevent childhood obesity.

39401495.takeaway: This review finds T cell-directed therapies may best preserve β-cell function, but a single short immunotherapy course is unlikely to give lasting insulin independence, and teplizumab is FDA-approved for delaying progression.

39403582.takeaway: In 671 young women undergoing first PGT-A, blastocysts from oocytes with smooth endoplasmic reticulum aggregates had lower euploidy (39% vs 51–55%), although pregnancy outcomes after euploid transfer were similar.

39403584.takeaway: In wild meerkats, maternal androgen exposure altered offspring sex-hormone and IGF-1 patterns and growth, with an early male bias in testosterone that disappeared by puberty.

39403587.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 10 studies found adolescent girls with PCOS had higher odds of depression and higher depression scores than controls, with no significant differences in anxiety, self-esteem or quality of life.

39404069.takeaway: This review summarises how progestins are used in PCOS, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, Turner syndrome and hypothalamic amenorrhoea, and highlights limited data on their glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid and androgen receptor effects.

39405488.takeaway: In 25,486 infants, maternal pre-existing diabetes was linked to thicker left ventricular walls, smaller chamber dimensions and lower stroke volume, with gestational diabetes showing smaller, non-significant changes.

39406189.takeaway: A survey of 123 US paediatric diabetes clinicians found 79% had ketone management protocols, but only 29% had protocols for automated insulin delivery, and 70% wanted standardised guidance.

39411309.takeaway: Specialists surveyed in several regions reported about 60% of patients on multiple daily injections, 74% saw real-time CGM as effective, and expressed concern that HbA1c can mislead.

39411314.takeaway: A woman diagnosed with GCK-MODY during pregnancy with twins saw both children diagnosed with GCK-MODY after birth, and the diagnosis brought relief and guided diet and lifestyle.

39412150.takeaway: In 51 patients with metastatic medullary thyroid cancer, a tumour volume doubling time under one year, based on serial scans, was independently linked to shorter disease-specific survival.

39412159.takeaway: In 132 patients with clinically suspected Silver-Russell syndrome, pathogenic variants were found in 9.1%, including IGF1R variants in 3% that cause IGF-1 resistance, a key differential diagnosis.

39413240.takeaway: In 97 Bavarian children, CGM glucose measures flagged 67% of stage 2 and 82% of those progressing to diabetes within a year, but repeat-test precision was poor.

39415662.takeaway: A 10.4-year-old girl with short stature and features of Noonan syndrome carried an uncertain MAP3K7 variant, the first case linking this gene to Noonan syndrome.

39415786.takeaway: This Belgian policy review sets out how childhood-onset GH deficiency should move from paediatric to adult care, stressing continued GH therapy for persistent deficiency and assessing transition readiness.

39415788.takeaway: This systematic review summarises recent treatment options for PCOS in adolescents and their complications, including links to metabolic syndrome, obesity, fatty liver disease and mental health.

39417219.takeaway: In interviews with 24 Chinese young adults with low-risk papillary thyroid cancer, decision making ranged from paternalistic to autonomous, with limited options and poor clinician-patient communication.

39417492.takeaway: In 45 pregnant women with insulin-treated diabetes, a higher third-trimester pregnancy glycemia risk index was associated with adverse neonatal outcomes, which occurred in 56% of pregnancies.

39417672.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 11 randomised trials (463 boys) found aromatase inhibitors increased final height by about 3.6 cm and predicted height by 2.5 cm, with more minor side effects but no severe ones.

39417734.takeaway: Among 996 children with GH deficiency in the LG Growth Study, weekly GH gave height SDS similar to daily GH at 2 and 4 years, with comparable safety, though first-year height gain was smaller.

39418532.takeaway: In 49 very young children with type 1 diabetes, 18 months of hybrid closed-loop use kept HbA1c at 6.7% with time in range of 70%, with no increase in hypoglycaemia.

39419009.takeaway: An 8-year-old girl with central precocious puberty had a novel de novo DLK1 variant, truncal obesity and abnormal fasting insulin, and the authors advise metabolic monitoring after puberty.

39421533.takeaway: Among 2,479 Chinese patients with thyroid-associated ophthalmopathy, the female predominance fell with age, while eye movement disorders, diplopia and sight-threatening disease rose with age.

39421535.takeaway: In 109 Korean children and adolescents, plasma asprosin was higher in obesity and insulin resistance and was independently associated with HOMA-IR and the triglyceride-to-HDL ratio.

39421536.takeaway: A neonate with congenital hyperinsulinism had hyperglycaemia after standard-dose diazoxide, and a novel HNF1A variant inherited from his mother suggests the drug response is mutation-specific, needing very low doses.

39422158.takeaway: In 51 people with type 1 diabetes, ultra-rapid insulins gave Boost and Ease-off safety and efficacy comparable to standard insulins, with Fiasp lowering glucose more at 120 minutes.

39422185.takeaway: Among 1,709 surgically treated patients with differentiated thyroid cancer in the Middle East, tumours over 4 cm independently predicted worse event-free survival, regardless of BRAF mutation status.

39423118.takeaway: In 194 adults with suboptimal type 1 diabetes control, tubeless automated insulin delivery raised time in range by 17.5 points versus pump therapy with CGM and cut HbA1c by 1.24% versus 0.68%.

39426393.takeaway: In 43 children with homozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia, lomitapide lowered LDL cholesterol by a mean of 53.5% at 24 weeks, with similar reductions in non-HDL cholesterol and apolipoprotein B.

39427650.takeaway: In 24 prepubertal children with hypochondroplasia on vosoritide, drug exposure did not correlate with growth outcomes, while the bone marker CXM rose and tracked prior height velocity.

39428970.takeaway: In 15 children treated for craniopharyngioma, all developed endocrine sequelae, 53% developed panhypopituitarism, and 60% had hypothalamic obesity, with 67% meeting hypothalamic syndrome criteria.

39429736.takeaway: In 174 children on growth hormone, those using a connected injection device gained significantly more height SDS in years 2 to 4 than those on non-connected devices, after adjustment.

39429740.takeaway: This perspective describes emerging oral, non-immunosuppressive beta-cell drugs that inhibit TXNIP, such as repurposed verapamil and TIX100, and argues they should complement immunotherapy in T1D.

39432818.takeaway: This perspective reports that children exposed to gestational diabetes in utero show altered hypothalamic brain development and higher energy intake, which predicts greater BMI gain, linking prenatal exposure to later obesity.

39435354.takeaway: Six children from Chinese families with isolated GH deficiency type II carried heterozygous GH1 variants, four novel; the four treated with rhGH gained 1.79 SDS in height in the first year.

39437266.takeaway: In a South Australian cohort of 242,077 births, clomiphene citrate use before conception was associated with higher perinatal death risk (OR 1.54), which persisted after adjusting for maternal risk factors.

39437749.takeaway: A novel PHIP missense variant segregated in a family in which a 5-year-old boy, his brother and their mother had severe early-onset obesity and developmental difficulties, supporting PHIP screening.

39438674.takeaway: An international Delphi consensus presents 36 recommendations for diagnosing, treating and following up congenital nephrogenic diabetes insipidus in children and adults, including emergency management and genetic counselling.

39439557.takeaway: In 31 pregnancies, the lipokine 12,13-diHOME was raised in maternal and cord plasma in preeclampsia, a pattern linked to fetal growth restriction.

39439563.takeaway: In 84 MEN1-related pituitary adenomas, microadenomas progressed to invasive macroadenomas in 7%, mainly prolactinomas, so long-term but less intensive surveillance may be appropriate.

39439567.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease data show high-BMI-related child deaths fell 34% from 1990 to 2019 while disability-adjusted life years rose 48%, with the greatest burden in children under five.

39444450.takeaway: An asymptomatic 15-year-old girl with primary hyperparathyroidism had an intrathymic ectopic parathyroid adenoma, cured only after thymectomy at a parathyroid-experienced centre following an initial unsuccessful operation.

39446459.takeaway: In 210 children with type 2 diabetes, earlier treatment with dapagliflozin or saxagliptin for 52 weeks raised no height, weight, puberty or bone safety concerns over a further year of follow-up.

39446494.takeaway: Among 2,050 women, gestational impaired fasting glucose was linked to insulin resistance and large-for-gestational-age infants, whereas impaired postload glucose was linked to neonatal brain injury and preterm birth.

39447557.takeaway: Six children with congenital central hypoventilation syndrome due to PHOX2B mutations developed hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia, which improved over time in three, and the authors urge screening such children.

39448829.takeaway: This review notes that type 1 diabetes is increasingly diagnosed in adults aged 60 and over, with incidence peaks comparable to children, and that misclassification with type 2 diabetes complicates the picture.

39451186.takeaway: Polish paediatric guidelines recommend hybrid closed-loop systems as the first-choice insulin therapy for children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, with principles for initiation, optimisation and education.

39455749.takeaway: This review concludes that metformin in gestational diabetes reduces gestational weight gain, neonatal hypoglycaemia and macrosomia, but heterogeneous trials leave its effect on glycaemia uncertain.

39462490.takeaway: In 11 adolescent football players with type 1 diabetes using a hybrid closed loop, a temporary 150 mg/dL target with pump disconnection kept time in range near 79% during a sports camp without more hypoglycaemia.

39462987.takeaway: An 11.2-year-old girl with mosaic Turner syndrome developed folliculotropic mycosis fungoides during growth hormone treatment, which was stopped, and topical steroids controlled the skin lesions.

39462996.takeaway: In 457 men with mostly obesity, DHEAS was positively associated with basal metabolic rate after adjusting for body composition, while testosterone, thyroid tests and IGF-1 were not.

39465557.takeaway: In 481 people with type 1 diabetes at a Dutch centre, HbA1c fell from 7.6% to 7.1% over 12 months on the MiniMed 780G system, with improvements across all age groups.

39465559.takeaway: In 60 adults with type 1 diabetes, machine learning on CGM components of hyperglycaemia and hypoglycaemia risk reached an AUC of 0.92 for identifying those with incident retinopathy.

39467069.takeaway: In 3,759 US men aged 20–85, higher testosterone and SHBG were associated with more lean mass and bone mineral content and less fat, while higher oestradiol showed the opposite pattern.

39467526.takeaway: Among 106,871 children, obesity rose from 12.8% before the pandemic to 15.4% during it and 15.0% afterwards, and BMI-SDS stayed above pre-pandemic levels, especially in younger children.

39467872.takeaway: Antibiotic exposure was not linked to latent autoimmune diabetes in adults or to type 2 diabetes, except for a modest link with narrow-spectrum antibiotics 6–10 years earlier.

39468683.takeaway: A male infant with adrenal hypoplasia congenita from a novel NR0B1 nonsense variant developed central precocious puberty at nine months that did not resolve with more hydrocortisone and required leuprolide.

39468766.takeaway: Serum DLK1 fell steeply through infancy in healthy girls and declined around puberty, but varied too widely between girls to serve as a diagnostic marker of pubertal onset.

39469573.takeaway: In high-fat-diet female rats, acupoint catgut embedding delayed vaginal opening and normalised reproductive hormone changes, suggesting it may delay obesity-related precocious puberty.

39469574.takeaway: In 39,749 Ethiopian adults, 8.5% were overweight and 2.9% obese, with female sex, marriage and higher wealth linked to higher odds, and rural residence and smoking to lower odds.

39469582.takeaway: In cultured prepubertal mouse ovaries, a cyclophosphamide metabolite rapidly depleted primordial follicles through apoptosis, with no sign of follicle activation.

39473227.takeaway: In 87 children treated with GH before age 8, those born SGA grew faster for three years than those with GH deficiency, but final height may not reach −1.0 SD.

39473505.takeaway: This review describes digital tools for paediatric growth hormone therapy, including connected devices and apps that show adherence and growth in real time to support clinicians and families.

39474673.takeaway: Pediatric thyroid carcinoma incidence in Germany rose from 0.84 to 1.48 per million between 1997–2001 and 2017–2021, most sharply in 15–17-year-olds, and incidentalomas rose from 5% to 26%.

39476804.takeaway: This review covers pancreas and islet transplantation and stem-cell-derived beta cells for type 1 diabetes, noting that surgical, immunological and donor-supply challenges still limit wider use.

39476806.takeaway: Four cases of thyroid hormone resistance, including a novel THRA 5′ UTR variant, showed that THRB-related resistance is often misdiagnosed and treated with medications that can worsen symptoms.

39477880.takeaway: In 56 adults and adolescents with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes, 52 weeks of fenofibrate did not change 2-hour C-peptide, insulin use or glycaemic control versus placebo, though it raised the proinsulin-to-C-peptide ratio.

39479268.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with SIADH that recurred despite fluid liberalisation was later found to have olfactory neuroblastoma, which was resected and irradiated, though SIADH persisted.

39479521.takeaway: A 28-year-old woman with acquired partial lipodystrophy had a successful but preterm pregnancy with cardiac complications, and a review of 12 studies found most women with lipodystrophy had successful pregnancies despite complications.

39480773.takeaway: This 2024 Argentine paediatric update makes healthy lifestyle the main obesity treatment, screens for complications such as sleep apnoea and raised ALT, and reserves drugs and surgery for precise indications.

39484850.takeaway: CASRdb compiles 498 disease-associated calcium-sensing receptor variants from the literature and genomic databases, including many absent from ClinVar or LOVD, to support diagnosis of FHH1 and ADH1.

39488733.takeaway: In 50 children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, testicular adrenal rest tumours were found in half of the boys, linked to higher BMI and advanced bone age, while ovarian imaging was rarely abnormal.

39492684.takeaway: In 60 children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency and advanced bone age, anastrozole slowed bone maturation and raised predicted adult height Z-score from −2.1 to 0.18 over six years.

39492690.takeaway: The MODY risk calculator overestimated MODY probability in 2,033 Hispanic youth, with a mean estimate of 18.8% against previous estimates of 1–5%, mainly in those not treated early with insulin.

39494781.takeaway: In 47 youth with poorly controlled type 1 diabetes, hybrid closed loop lowered HbA1c and diabetes-related hospitalisations, though higher baseline HbA1c predicted less success.

39496238.takeaway: Seven patients with primary adrenal insufficiency from MC2R defects developed early puberty, with no genetic cause of puberty found, and the authors suggest raised ACTH may trigger it.

39496810.takeaway: This review summarises findings from the TEDDY cohort of 8,667 children, showing insulin autoantibodies appear early and GAD65 autoantibodies later, suggesting two distinct routes to type 1 diabetes.

39500298.takeaway: In 297 children, first-morning urinary LH of about 0.6 IU/L predicted central puberty onset with 97% sensitivity and 91% specificity, offering a non-invasive alternative to serum LH.

39500362.takeaway: Pooling 465 patients with 17α-hydroxylase deficiency, hypertension and hypokalaemia were common, and the more severe p.Y329Kfs variant was linked to hypocortisolism and disordered sexual development.

39501471.takeaway: Pooling 3,359 children with Graves' disease, the remission rate on antithyroid drugs was 25%, rising from 16% with under two years of treatment to 33% with over five years.

39502477.takeaway: Open-label 3-year study of recombinant GH in 10 young children with aggrecan (ACAN) deficiency, tracking height SDS and height velocity.

39502571.takeaway: A child with hepatopulmonary syndrome from MASLD after hypopituitarism improved with growth hormone replacement without transplant; a review of pediatric cases accompanies the report.

39503771.takeaway: Multinational SWEET registry data describe how often children and young people present with type 2 diabetes at diagnosis, and their clinical features, across five world regions.

39504571.takeaway: Genetic testing of 138 Chinese children with suspected monogenic diabetes identified neonatal diabetes, MODY and syndromic forms, and described their clinical features.

39505766.takeaway: Survey of 1050 Jordanian adults examined demographic and clinical factors associated with diabetes knowledge and management behaviour.

39506342.takeaway: Genetic screening of 102 Japanese patients with permanent congenital hypothyroidism found causal variants in 19, and a pedigree compatible with CHNG3 was described.

39506343.takeaway: A 29-member Endocrine Society of Bengal consensus proposes a simplified diagnostic approach to rickets, aimed at resource-limited settings.

39506344.takeaway: In 194 patients with Turner syndrome from the LG Growth Study, three-year GH response was compared across karyotype groups.

39506345.takeaway: Among children tested for GH deficiency, those with greater height gain on GH replacement had lower IGF-BP3 and higher BMI SDS at baseline.

39506346.takeaway: Survey of 417 people in Kazakhstan compared persistent post-COVID symptoms in those with and without type 2 diabetes and examined vaccination effects.

39506347.takeaway: Among 47 children with Hashimoto thyroiditis who attempted levothyroxine withdrawal, outcomes and predictors of successful discontinuation were analyzed over about 30 months.

39508277.takeaway: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials assessed digital health lifestyle interventions for weight loss in adults with prediabetes.

39512182.takeaway: RNA analysis of urine-derived cells found PHEX mis-splicing in 3 of 4 children with XLH who had no causative variant on routine testing.

39513569.takeaway: In 96 short children born SGA, PEG-rhGH at 0.2 mg/kg/week for 52 weeks raised height SDS more than 0.1 mg/kg/week (0.92 vs 0.51).

39514762.takeaway: Spanish registry data on 71 people with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, 13 of them children, describe diagnosis, cardiovascular disease and lipid-lowering treatment.

39523580.takeaway: In 106 adults with insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, basal insulin adherence from connected pens was related to CGM time in range, with adherence metrics compared.

39523837.takeaway: Interviews with parents of 43 children aged 6 or younger with atypical genitalia in India assessed anxiety, depression, and experiences of care.

39525852.takeaway: In 2628 adults in Qinghai, China, hypothyroidism prevalence was 30.25%, and thyroid function was analyzed in relation to metabolic syndrome.

39526425.takeaway: Among 31 young adults with DSD in Lucknow, India, most believed genital surgery should be done in childhood, and six had attempted suicide at least once.

39527041.takeaway: In 80 adolescents with type 1 diabetes followed about 9 years, adolescent kidney hyperfiltration was examined as a predictor of later eGFR and albuminuria change.

39527371.takeaway: An Italian expert consensus recommends genetic testing and multidisciplinary evaluation for earlier diagnosis and personalized management of Wolfram syndrome.

39529259.takeaway: Among adolescents with type 1 diabetes and their parents, automated insulin delivery was linked to higher device satisfaction, though parent and adolescent ratings agreed only weakly.

39529271.takeaway: Glucose rate-of-change thresholds from CGM data of healthy people were used to test whether glycemic variability metrics predict abnormal rapid glucose changes in 736 people with T1D.

39530119.takeaway: Self-rated pubertal staging by patients aged 7 to 22 was assessed for validity and reliability against clinical examination, to inform telemedicine visits.

39531385.takeaway: In 4551 adults from two cohorts in Taiwan and Hong Kong, life-course PM2.5 exposure was examined in relation to prediabetes and diabetes prevalence.

39531505.takeaway: People with monogenic autoimmune diabetes had higher type 1 diabetes genetic risk scores than controls, driven mainly by the DR3-DQ2 haplotype, which may shape their presentation.

39533791.takeaway: Among 328 newborns referred after screening, 4.9% had transient hyperthyrotropinemia, and 50.6% of those diagnosed with congenital hypothyroidism started treatment, mostly in the first month.

39535106.takeaway: Ultrasound normative values for thyroid volume and tracheal index were measured in 144 healthy term newborns, with thyroid volume rising from 0.66 mL to 1.12 mL by 15 to 30 days.

39535107.takeaway: Of 52 adolescent males with β-thalassemia who had transplant, 46 (88%) showed Sertoli cell dysfunction on gonadal testing.

39535135.takeaway: A review argues that digital technologies can make continuing education for diabetes clinicians more scalable, while their effect on knowledge and patient outcomes remains under-researched.

39536728.takeaway: In 33 short children born at very low birth weight, rhGH response was analyzed at one year and in adult height, comparing subgroups by size, gestational age and cause.

39536731.takeaway: In a nationwide Danish cohort of 379 children with CAH diagnosed 1943 to 2018, CYP21A2 genotype was related to phenotype and to the frequency of feminizing surgery.

39538411.takeaway: HR-pQCT in 106 Chinese children and adolescents with XLH, compared with matched controls, showed significant differences in trabecular bone geometry and microarchitecture.

39539413.takeaway: Claims data for 570 people with familial hypophosphatemia and 1710 matched controls describe the clinical and cost burden in burosumab-naive pediatric and adult patients.

39539935.takeaway: A child developed hepatopulmonary syndrome after craniopharyngioma surgery despite strict weight control, and the report discusses possible benefit of GH therapy in fatty liver progression.

39540398.takeaway: An IFCC working group opinion calls for standardized CGM performance assessment, including comparator device, sample origin and study procedures, so CGM metrics align across systems.

39541997.takeaway: Across eight high-income datasets, incidence of type 1 and type 2 diabetes diagnosed at ages 15 to 39 was modelled for 2000 to 2020 by sex, age and calendar time.

39542658.takeaway: In 51,640 Beijing preschoolers aged 1 to 6, serum vitamin D status and overweight or obesity were assessed together to explore their association.

39544232.takeaway: A systematic review of endocrine comorbidities in Rett syndrome covers growth, bone, thyroid, puberty and weight abnormalities, to support earlier recognition.

39544233.takeaway: In 2980 NHANES children and adolescents, inflammatory indices SII and SIRI were examined for linear and non-linear associations with BMI.

39545512.takeaway: In a Danish registry of 448 people with CAH, psychiatric diagnoses and psychiatric medication use were compared with 44,527 matched population controls.

39546551.takeaway: A review of time in tight range (70 to 140 mg/dL) as a glycemic target for preschoolers with type 1 diabetes, set against ISPAD targets for time in range.

39546623.takeaway: In 13 patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, a randomized crossover study compared intravenous corticosterone, hydrocortisone and placebo for androgen control and metabolic effects.

39548894.takeaway: In 1901 youth and young adults with type 1 diabetes in the DPV registry, time in range and time in tight range were analyzed against HbA1c using CGM data.

39549719.takeaway: Open-label phase 3 VENTURE trial tested one year of setmelanotide in children aged 2 to 5 with POMC or LEPR deficiency or Bardet-Biedl syndrome, with hyperphagia and obesity.

39551654.takeaway: The French SFEDP expert consensus gives national recommendations for endocrine management of transgender adolescents, including multidisciplinary support, puberty-suppressing treatment and gender-affirming hormones.

39552056.takeaway: In 209 papillary thyroid carcinoma patients, RET-fusion tumors occurred in younger patients with larger size and more advanced nodal stage than BRAFV600E tumors, with distinct ultrasound features.

39555727.takeaway: In 45 children aged 3 to 12, salivary myo-inositol and D-chiro-inositol were compared between children with type 1 diabetes (25) and controls (20).

39556447.takeaway: A report summarizing research on how maternal hyperglycemia transmits diabetes risk across generations, and on interventions to interrupt this cycle.

39556468.takeaway: The European Calcified Tissue Society gives 25 evidence-based recommendations for preventing and treating glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis in adults, stratified by fracture risk.

39556501.takeaway: In a nationwide Swedish cohort of children with type 1 diabetes, adult height was compared across levels of glycemic control, considering sex, age at onset and timing relative to puberty.

39556808.takeaway: Genetic variants in CTSH can affect age at type 1 diabetes diagnosis, while most non-HLA type 1 diabetes loci showed no association with C-peptide or diagnosis age.

39557026.takeaway: In 81 people with 45,X Turner syndrome, the parent of origin of the intact X chromosome was examined for association with glycemia on oral glucose tolerance testing.

39557052.takeaway: In a nationwide Israeli cohort of conscripts aged 17 to 21, adolescent BMI was examined for association with serious morbidity before age 25.

39558481.takeaway: A commentary reviews barriers to CGM access in the United States, including racial disparities, provider bias and cost, and argues hospital-based CGM could improve ambulatory access.

39560745.takeaway: In 46 youth and young adults with type 1 diabetes, a randomized crossover non-inferiority trial compared simplified meal announcement with carbohydrate counting on hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery.

39564579.takeaway: In 79 Chinese patients with steroid-resistant Graves orbitopathy, including 15 children, tocilizumab was given every 28 days for 4 months and changes in vision and eye pressure were tracked.

39564675.takeaway: Among 2338 adult childhood cancer survivors, dyslipidemia prevalence was compared with 132,226 adults without cancer history, and its determinants were analyzed.

39778405.takeaway: In 95 children with growth hormone deficiency at one tertiary center, the frequency of pituitary or intracranial MRI abnormalities and their predictors were examined.

39778406.takeaway: Among 207 females with permanent congenital hypothyroidism and 598 healthy age-matched adolescents, age at menarche and final height SDS were compared.

39778407.takeaway: Clinical and genetic features of 43 Korean children with childhood-onset congenital combined pituitary hormone deficiency were analyzed in a retrospective single-center cohort.

39778536.takeaway: A child with congenital hyperinsulinism and long QT syndrome was found to carry a loss-of-function KCNE1 variant, linking the two conditions.

39781649.takeaway: A national consortium, PREDICT, was formed to build a data commons for monogenic diabetes research, to address case scarcity, missing data standards and limited collaboration.

39782875.takeaway: In a retrospective multicentre cohort of patients aged 16 and older with 17β-HSD3 or 5α-reductase type 2 deficiency, gonadal function and pathology were examined.

39785833.takeaway: The association between loss-of-function GHSR variants and short stature and low IGF-I was examined in patients.

39786952.takeaway: In adolescents with idiopathic premature ovarian insufficiency, the prevalence of low androgen levels and its relation to adrenal insufficiency was assessed.

39787047.takeaway: A review evaluates basal and stimulated inhibin B as a test to distinguish permanent from self-limiting delayed or precocious puberty.

39787321.takeaway: In a French nationwide prospective cohort of 514 newborns with congenital hypothyroidism found by screening, the inheritance mode of thyroid dysgenesis, including digenic inheritance, was investigated.

39787322.takeaway: A 5-year-old girl with coexisting phenylketonuria and tyrosinemia type 3 illustrates the difficulty of dietary management of two rare phenylalanine-tyrosine disorders.

39787354.takeaway: A systematic review of studies in children with X-linked hypophosphatemia examined the efficacy of medical therapies, mainly burosumab compared with conventional treatment, on patient-important outcomes.

39787502.takeaway: In 7,970 mother-newborn dyads and 4,160 children aged 11 to 14, GDM subtypes based on insulin sensitivity and secretion were associated differently with anthropometric and glycemic outcomes.

39788148.takeaway: YAP1 expression and methylation were analyzed in pediatric and adult adrenocortical carcinoma cohorts, and YAP1 inhibition reduced tumor progression in in vitro models.

39788892.takeaway: In 28 adolescents with type 1 diabetes using hybrid closed-loop, glucose and other physiological signals were compared across moderate-intensity, high-intensity interval and resistance exercise.

39789920.takeaway: Seven patients with Niemann-Pick type C are described, with diverse clinical presentations and a novel variant.

39791572.takeaway: GPT-4o with one-shot prompts estimated nutrients from photographs of 22 Japanese meals, with estimates compared against weighed food records.

39799940.takeaway: Three infants with pseudohypoparathyroidism 1A are described, expanding the phenotype with early and neonatal manifestations that may signal a more severe course.

39803807.takeaway: Three children from two families with HSD3B7 deficiency show novel mutations and varied clinical courses, mainly cholestatic liver disease.

39804800.takeaway: Three-year follow-up of a randomized placebo-controlled trial of 96 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes assessed C-peptide after antiviral treatment with pleconaril and ribavirin.

39806875.takeaway: A cross-sectional online questionnaire of clinicians in Australia and New Zealand identified gaps and barriers in current care models for children and adolescents with differences of sex development.

39806877.takeaway: In a UK Turner syndrome cohort, updated guideline aortic size thresholds were applied to estimate how many individuals would be referred to the heart team for elective aortic surgery.

39809244.takeaway: A review summarizes epigenome-wide association findings and challenges in the epigenetics of childhood obesity and related traits.

39810336.takeaway: In a pilot randomized trial in urban and rural Tamil Nadu, India, smartphone health apps were assessed for reducing cardiometabolic risk factors in adults aged 25 to 60.

39810511.takeaway: A review describes long-acting growth hormone options for pediatric GH deficiency, their advantages over daily injections, and guidance on selecting patients.

39812071.takeaway: This study examines whether viral infection, particularly enteroviruses, is linked to subacute thyroiditis, a painful thyroid inflammation with uncertain causes.

39812180.takeaway: In a large cohort of 46,XX individuals with duplications upstream of SOX9, clinical presentation and diagnostic features were characterized.

39812184.takeaway: From 5551 left-hand X-rays of Chinese children aged 3 to 18, a simplified bone age assessment model was constructed to aid quick clinical assessment.

39813114.takeaway: In a single-center retrospective study of youth under 21, changes in 90-day time in range were compared between Omnipod 5 and Tandem Control-IQ automated insulin delivery systems.

39813116.takeaway: A review covers diagnosis, complications and management of achondroplasia, including the newly available treatment vosoritide.

39815158.takeaway: In children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, the accuracy of early tissue transglutaminase IgA and endomysial antibody screening for celiac disease was assessed retrospectively.

39815165.takeaway: Among 1,001 girls aged 6 to 9 seen for breast development in Beijing, a clinical model was developed to predict central precocious puberty.

39815657.takeaway: A Glasgow transition clinic service evaluation reviewed case notes to determine whether young people stayed engaged with adult endocrine services after transfer from paediatric care.

39817629.takeaway: Pediatric patients diagnosed with Tangier disease were evaluated for clinical presentation and genetic cause, aiming to support earlier diagnosis of this HDL-deficiency condition.

39817663.takeaway: In 62 children and adolescents with cystic fibrosis compared with 62 controls, thyroid dysfunction frequency, iodine deficiency and selenium status were evaluated.

39818293.takeaway: A review chapter covers primary hyperparathyroidism across life stages, noting that germline mutations are found in about half of affected children and that presentation depends on the genetic cause.

39819748.takeaway: A review argues that hypothalamic obesity is not one disease, describing how hypothalamic energy-balance dysfunction produces obesity in different ways.

39820647.takeaway: T-cell responses to hybrid insulin peptides were examined in islet autoantibody-positive at-risk individuals to identify specificities that may contribute to beta-cell destruction.

39821270.takeaway: Autoantibodies targeting deamidated extracellular IA-2 epitopes were strongly associated with clinical onset of type 1 diabetes.

39827856.takeaway: A child with atrophic autoimmune thyroiditis recovered thyroid function, with disappearance of thyroid stimulation-blocking antibody proposed as a prognostic marker.

39827859.takeaway: In 57 infants and children with 46,XY differences of sex development, clinical and hormonal mini-puberty data and genetic analysis were compared as diagnostic contributions.

39829003.takeaway: The first comprehensive study of differences of sex development in Iran describes clinical and genetic data for the country's initial patient cohort.

39829212.takeaway: The 2024 Polish guideline update gives evidence-based recommendations for diagnosing and treating differentiated and medullary thyroid carcinoma in children, including radioiodine and thyroxine management.

39832134.takeaway: In 1,541 mother-child pairs, maternal fasting plasma glucose in early pregnancy was analyzed for association with developmental delay at age 2.

39832181.takeaway: Liver fat and stiffness were assessed by ultrasound and shear-wave elastography in north Indian children with type 1 diabetes, to determine fatty liver prevalence and predictors.

39835265.takeaway: Vitamin D levels and endocrine and metabolic factors were compared between children with slipped capital femoral epiphysis and controls, and with SCFE severity, in a retrospective case-control study.

39836616.takeaway: A review describes the daily burdens of living with classic CAH for patients and families, including medication demands and fear of unpredictable adrenal crises.

39836618.takeaway: A review addresses clinical manifestations and challenges in adolescent and adult females with classic CAH, including lifelong glucocorticoid replacement.

39836619.takeaway: A review describes structural, social and cultural barriers to comprehensive CAH care, including limited newborn screening, specialist centers and medications.

39836620.takeaway: A review examines balancing under- and overtreatment with glucocorticoids in adolescent and adult males with classic CAH.

39836621.takeaway: A review summarizes the genetics and pathophysiology of 21-hydroxylase deficiency, including CYP21A2 mutations and the disease forms they produce.

39836622.takeaway: A review summarizes clinical manifestations, treatment, monitoring and challenges in infants and children with classic 21-hydroxylase deficiency, including newborn screening.

39839367.takeaway: A review considers how genetic and epigenetic factors contribute to human pubertal timing, focusing on genes associated with central precocious puberty.

39839483.takeaway: Parents of children with CAH were studied about their fertility choices, including whether to use preimplantation genetic testing or conceive naturally.

39840426.takeaway: A six-day-old boy with neonatal severe hyperparathyroidism from a homozygous inactivating calcium-sensing receptor variant, p.I81K, is described.

39840579.takeaway: Fasting insulin and IGF-1 were evaluated as simpler biomarkers than the GnRH provocation test for diagnosing central precocious puberty in girls.

39842874.takeaway: In euthyroid Koreans, the Parametric Thyroid Feedback Quantile-based Index, a measure of central thyroid hormone sensitivity, was examined in relation to cardiovascular risk.

39843388.takeaway: IGF-1 levels, dose titrations, height velocity and BMI were tracked in children with growth hormone deficiency after switching from somatropin to lonapegsomatropin.

39845332.takeaway: In the SEARCH for Diabetes in Youth study, the frequency of undiagnosed celiac disease among youth with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes was assessed, and its association with diabetic retinopathy was examined.

39845880.takeaway: In Chinese children with obesity, the serum uric acid-to-HDL cholesterol ratio was examined for association with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.

39845887.takeaway: A teenager with type 1 diabetes and chronic recurrent osteomyelitis is described, with a short literature review on whether these conditions are linked.

39846147.takeaway: A patient with Moebius syndrome and deficiencies of three or more pituitary axes is described, with a literature review.

39846328.takeaway: Anti-HBs antibody levels were compared in children with type 1 diabetes at diagnosis who had been vaccinated against hepatitis B on schedule, to assess whether they remain protected.

39847034.takeaway: In a randomized pilot study of 13 girls with suspected central precocious puberty, the effect of a GnRH injection on kisspeptin levels was tested to examine negative feedback.

39849667.takeaway: An online survey of Turkish pediatric and adult endocrinologists compared practices and attitudes toward Hashimoto thyroiditis, with differences between the two groups.

39849668.takeaway: Serum neudesin levels were compared in children with congenital hypothyroidism, given its proposed roles in brain development and energy regulation.

39849669.takeaway: A machine-learning method was developed and validated to detect the honeymoon phase in children aged 6 to 17 with type 1 diabetes from continuous glucose data, to guide insulin dosing.

39849673.takeaway: Four novel COL2A1 variants are described in patients with a wide range of type 2 collagenopathy phenotypes, illustrating the difficulty of classifying these disorders.

39849892.takeaway: A Türkiye subanalysis of the ACTION Teens survey found that adolescents with obesity reported more worry and less motivation, with caregiver and clinician responses compared.

39849895.takeaway: Glycemic control and stress levels were assessed before and after the 2023 earthquakes in children with type 1 diabetes at one center in southeastern Türkiye.

39850475.takeaway: Mitochondrial DNA oxidation and content were compared across metabolic phenotypes of women with polycystic ovary syndrome.

39850788.takeaway: Exome sequencing of two sisters with primary amenorrhea and ovarian dysgenesis identified a novel homozygous BMP15 variant as the cause.

39851060.takeaway: A 15-year-old boy with prolactinoma developed pathological gambling while taking cabergoline, an impulse control side effect of dopamine agonist treatment.

39854362.takeaway: In a population-based UK cohort, diabetes risk after childhood and young adult cancer treatment was quantified and contributing treatment factors were explored.

39862065.takeaway: A commentary on a Lilly-sponsored study of the Tempo connected insulin pen reports that it met ISO 11608-1:2014 dose accuracy requirements across several doses.

39864410.takeaway: Real-world safety and effectiveness of vosoritide were described in children with achondroplasia enrolled in a French early access program, including its structure and follow-up.

39864412.takeaway: An index case of carboxypeptidase E deficiency expands the clinical features of this monogenic obesity, with laboratory findings also suggesting PC1/3 deficiency.

39864413.takeaway: A review describes strategies for optimizing automated insulin delivery systems, which combine pumps, continuous glucose monitors and software for children and adults with type 1 diabetes.

39864424.takeaway: In a 10-year Indiana newborn cohort with congenital hypothyroidism, the prevalence of delayed TSH rise was determined and compared with early-detected infants by clinical and demographic factors.

39870096.takeaway: In an open-label crossover non-inferiority phase 3 trial in homozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia, lerodalcibep was compared with evolocumab on safety and LDL cholesterol lowering.

39870583.takeaway: Genetic testing was used to search for monogenic autoimmune causes in patients whose type 1 diabetes began before 30 months of age, to avoid misdiagnosis.

39872023.takeaway: Using the national Kids' Inpatient Database, preterm labor and hypertensive disorders were compared between adolescent pregnancies with and without diabetes across 1.8 million admissions from 2006 to 2019.

39872400.takeaway: IGF-1 concentrations measured 96 hours after weekly somatrogon dosing were examined as a guide for monitoring safety and efficacy in pediatric growth hormone deficiency.

39873396.takeaway: The diagnostic utility of 11C-methionine PET/CT for localizing persistent or recurrent Cushing disease after surgery was evaluated in patients with equivocal pituitary MRI.

39876606.takeaway: Young adults with type 1 diabetes described their experiences after transferring from pediatric to adult care through a transition clinic and transfer letter, in semi-structured interviews.

39876876.takeaway: Perceived maternal stress in late pregnancy was assessed for association with infant fat mass and lean mass at one month of age.

39878145.takeaway: Genetic and endocrine characteristics of patients with pachydermoperiostosis referred to endocrinologists were assessed, given its overlap with acromegaly.

39878765.takeaway: Bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization tested whether childhood obesity causally affects delayed puberty and height.

39879258.takeaway: Two-year outcomes of Type1Screen, an in-home blood spot islet autoantibody screening program across Australia, were reported for 2,064 participants with a family history of type 1 diabetes.

39881439.takeaway: The Tempo Pen with Smart Button was tested under standard conditions and met ISO 11608-1:2014 dose accuracy requirements at three doses, with reliable data storage and transmission.

39881449.takeaway: In an assessor-blinded three-arm trial of 84 adults with type 2 diabetes, personalized diabetes text messaging with peer support education was compared with text messaging alone and with professional education.

39881452.takeaway: A prospective pilot study tested a calibration-free noninvasive glucose measurement approach, aiming to remove the need for invasive sensing.

39882649.takeaway: Among 275 consecutive girls aged 0 to 10 referred for suspected precocious puberty, features that distinguish true precocious puberty from puberty variants were identified.

39882769.takeaway: Within a multicenter randomized trial, the AI-driven Spotlight-AQ platform was assessed for cost-effectiveness, visit length and clinician burnout during routine diabetes visits.

39882784.takeaway: Longitudinal bone mineral content and density were analyzed in 109 children with cerebral palsy enrolled in a rehabilitation programme, to describe long-term bone development.

39883563.takeaway: The effects of human PTH 1-34 therapy on growth, areal bone density and trabecular bone score were assessed in children with hypoparathyroidism due to APS-1 or an activating CaR variant.

39884260.takeaway: The ISPAD 2024 chapter summarizes advances in glucose monitoring technology and recommendations for children, adolescents and young adults with diabetes.

39884261.takeaway: The ISPAD 2024 chapter updates principles of intensive insulin regimens and adjunctive treatments for children and adolescents with diabetes.

39884300.takeaway: In a prespecified extension of a randomized trial, hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery during the first six months postpartum was compared with standard care for safety and glycemic outcomes.

39885768.takeaway: The frequency of PCOS and of being at risk for PCOS was assessed in obese adolescent girls using current definitions, since adult-derived criteria may misclassify physiological oligomenorrhoea.

39885770.takeaway: An online survey of Turkish pediatric endocrinologists examined attitudes toward congenital hypothyroidism management and how work environment and experience affected them.

39885771.takeaway: Quadriceps muscle strength and thickness were compared between adolescents with PCOS and healthy controls, and their change after six months of combined oral contraceptive treatment was evaluated.

39888311.takeaway: The clinical utility of ultrasound surveillance for detecting residual or recurrent differentiated thyroid cancer in children, starting one year after initial therapy, was evaluated.

39891402.takeaway: Real-life setmelanotide use in four prepubertal children aged 3 to 9 with LEPR or POMC deficiency is reported, with findings on efficacy and safety.

39891704.takeaway: In the DD2 cohort of people recently diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, low birthweight was examined for association with incident chronic kidney disease.

39895319.takeaway: A Japanese sibling pair with iodide transport defect carries two novel compound heterozygous SLC5A5 variants that cause congenital hypothyroidism.

39897954.takeaway: In people with RASopathies such as Noonan syndrome, the effect of pubertal timing on growth progression and final height was examined.

39897959.takeaway: Deleterious copy number variations, including 16p11.2 deletions, were identified in patients with severe early-onset obesity in Brazil, and their clinical phenotypes were described.

39898459.takeaway: In a retrospective single-centre Indian cohort, the etiologies, phenotypes and genotypes of pediatric primary adrenal insufficiency beyond CAH were described.

39899446.takeaway: In mice, Atf4 expression in β-cells was protective under acute glucose stress but promoted β-cell failure when free fatty acids were also present.

39902162.takeaway: A review covers the etiology, epidemiology, diagnosis and emerging gene therapy approaches for maturity-onset diabetes of the young, a rare monogenic and often misdiagnosed form of diabetes.

39902649.takeaway: In 24 adults with type 1 diabetes, FreeStyle Libre 3, Dexcom G7 and Medtronic Simplera were compared against comparator methods and during clinically relevant glycemic scenarios.

39902656.takeaway: A cost-effective modular infusion pump platform was designed to help diabetes specialists learn pump mechanics and control principles, aimed at low-resource settings.

39902901.takeaway: Using national NHS hospital episode statistics, admissions, resource use and costs for adrenal insufficiency in England were analysed over time.

39902910.takeaway: In DCCT/EDIC participants with type 1 diabetes, intraindividual body-weight cycling was analyzed for association with diabetic kidney disease risk.

39903210.takeaway: Long-read sequencing detected chimeric CYP21A1P/CYP21A2 genes in patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, and genotype-phenotype correlations were analyzed.

39903487.takeaway: Using longitudinal data, repeated CGM, HbA1c and OGTT metrics were compared for predicting progression to stage 3 type 1 diabetes in presymptomatic individuals.

39903823.takeaway: In a retrospective analysis of residual serum from children, the effect of clonidine on copeptin release was examined as a marker of arginine vasopressin activity.

39903824.takeaway: A child with sepiapterin reductase deficiency was initially thought to have vitamin B12 deficiency, and early diagnosis led to a favorable outcome.

39903825.takeaway: Height and weight of children with CAH detected by newborn screening in Bavaria from 1999 to 2018 were assessed in a population-based prospective follow-up survey.

39903826.takeaway: In two Israeli tertiary centers, the impact of preoperative imaging on decisions in children who had laparoscopic adrenalectomy for adrenal masses was reviewed retrospectively.

39905798.takeaway: Presentation and evolution of congenital isolated versus multiple pituitary hormone deficiency were compared in patients at a large academic centre.

39906034.takeaway: IGF-1 monitoring during recombinant GH treatment becomes harder to interpret in early puberty, since levels depend on sex, age and pubertal stage.

39907056.takeaway: In a single-centre open-label pilot of hospitalized adults with diabetic ketoacidosis, glycemic control measured by real-time CGM was compared with point-of-care capillary and basic metabolic panel measures.

39909866.takeaway: DKA severity before and during the COVID-19 pandemic was compared between Black and White pediatric patients at one institution serving an underserved population.

39910927.takeaway: The Performance-Based Adaptation Index was introduced as a tool to adjust automated insulin delivery aggressiveness automatically from CGM metrics.

39911520.takeaway: In youth with type 2 diabetes, glycemia, insulin sensitivity and insulin secretion were measured three months after vertical sleeve gastrectomy.

39912790.takeaway: Insulin-to-carbohydrate ratios and insulin sensitivity factors were analyzed by age in pediatric pump users in the DPV registry, showing that total-daily-dose formulas may fall short for children.

39912799.takeaway: In teens with type 1 diabetes and executive function challenges, insulin pump use was associated with lower A1C without increased DKA or severe hypoglycemia.

39916355.takeaway: Among 2,338 adult survivors of childhood cancer in the Dutch DCCS-LATER2 cohort, diabetes prevalence and its determinants were assessed.

39918837.takeaway: In 548 patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma, thyroglobulin antibodies were analyzed for association with clinicopathological features and with unfavorable efficacy of 131I ablation.

39919031.takeaway: National data were used to evaluate whether children with adrenal insufficiency are more susceptible to COVID-19 or at higher risk of severe disease.

39919037.takeaway: In a phase 3 trial of setmelanotide in Bardet-Biedl syndrome, metabolic syndrome risk was assessed with a continuous metabolic syndrome Z-BMI score.

39921216.takeaway: A review describes the molecular landscape of pediatric differentiated thyroid carcinoma, with three tiers of mutation types linked to increasing risk of invasion and metastasis.

39925093.takeaway: Short-term diabetic retinopathy outcomes were examined in people aged 13 or older with type 1 diabetes after starting automated insulin delivery, to test for early worsening.

39926395.takeaway: Thyroid autoimmunity prevalence in children with type 1 diabetes rose before the COVID era but not during it, according to a 10-year population-based analysis.

39927665.takeaway: An Italian expert consensus describes the utility of smart multiple daily injection systems, which combine CGM, connected pens, apps and cloud data to support intensive insulin therapy.

39929154.takeaway: A 46,XX infant with atypical genitalia and primary ovarian insufficiency caused by HFM1 variants is described, with a literature review.

39929222.takeaway: Long-term outcomes of islet transplantation alone were evaluated over 20 years at one Italian centre, balancing glycemic benefit against immunosuppression risks.

39930628.takeaway: FSH and Sertoli cell biomarkers were evaluated for distinguishing hypogonadotropic hypogonadism from self-limited delayed puberty in males, as an alternative to LH or testosterone stimulation tests.

39930633.takeaway: Maternal free testosterone in the third trimester was examined for association with sex-specific body composition in 7-year-old children.

39930640.takeaway: Bone microarchitecture and quality were compared in osteopetrosis patients using HR-pQCT, to describe alterations in these rare high-bone-mass disorders.

39930933.takeaway: Urinary estrogen levels across puberty were examined as a marker of metabolic risk in girls, in relation to premature adrenarche.

39930944.takeaway: The international medullary thyroid carcinoma grading system was tested in a series of sporadic MTC patients for predicting disease-specific, metastasis-free and recurrence-free survival.

39931045.takeaway: Morning salivary cortisol and DHEA were lower in children with obesity, and their associations with food addiction, stress and diet were examined.
