39931437.takeaway: Three Chinese children with apparent mineralocorticoid excess had their clinical course and HSD11B2 genetic variants described.

39931438.takeaway: In female Atlantic cod, transcriptome analysis examined how ethynylestradiol and bisphenol A alter endocrine and metabolic pathways in the pituitary and liver.

39934096.takeaway: Day-to-day variation in first-morning urinary total LH was moderate, supporting use of a single noninvasive measurement to identify imminent central puberty.

39934369.takeaway: CGM metrics from baseline recordings in participants with islet autoantibodies across five studies were tested for predicting progression to stage 3 type 1 diabetes.

39936548.takeaway: A survey of CGM experts measured agreement on whether individuals without diabetes need clinical follow-up based on their independent review of CGM reports.

39937145.takeaway: In a large pediatric cohort with type 1 diabetes, the association between HbA1c and CGM time in range (70 to 180 mg/dL) was evaluated.

39938560.takeaway: Phenotype and genotype of 23 patients with congenital hypopituitarism carrying pathogenic GLI2 variants were analyzed, including genotype-phenotype correlations.

39938888.takeaway: In 1,338 Brazilian children and adolescents aged 6 to 17, screen time was tested as a moderator of the association between BMI and sleep duration.

39943817.takeaway: A review explains the approach to pediatric thyroid nodules, which carry higher cancer risk than adult nodules, and the management of indeterminate nodules.

39947153.takeaway: Thyroid function was studied prospectively in infants after enteral iodinated contrast medium, to determine whether this exposure causes hypothyroidism.

39949287.takeaway: Real-world data from the first pediatric users of Omnipod 5 under UK NHS universal coverage evaluated HbA1c, time in range, hypoglycemia and sensor glucose outcomes.

39950025.takeaway: Higher Life's Crucial 9 cardiovascular health scores were associated with lower infertility in U.S. women aged 18 to 45.

39950026.takeaway: In a retrospective cohort of infected mothers with gestational diabetes, the risk of neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infection was analyzed.

39950165.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with congenital tufting enteropathy was treated with growth hormone for short stature, and the effects are described alongside a literature review.

39950167.takeaway: An illustrative review compares ultrasound and histopathological features of benign, borderline and malignant pediatric thyroid tumors, to inform the choice of management.

39950168.takeaway: A review describes intraoperative neuromonitoring paradigms in pediatric thyroid surgery, given the small, sensitive larynx of children and the difficulty of some childhood thyroid cancer surgeries.

39950977.takeaway: Bone abnormalities beyond chondrodysplasia were characterized in Jansen metaphyseal chondrodysplasia, a rare PTH1R-activating disorder causing hypercalcemia.

39950996.takeaway: In 1,226 adolescents and young adults with youth-onset diabetes in the SEARCH study, arterial stiffness was analyzed for association with microvascular complications.

39950997.takeaway: Among youth with type 1 diabetes on Medicaid in California, self-monitored blood glucose testing frequency was examined in relation to CGM use after policy changes removed the testing requirement.

39950999.takeaway: An expert consensus describes the form and priorities of multidisciplinary pediatric thyroid programs, aiming to reduce variation in pediatric thyroid cancer care.

39951725.takeaway: A clinical nomogram was developed to predict individual survival outcomes in well-differentiated thyroid cancer, beyond population-level AJCC staging.

39953710.takeaway: Among people with diabetes in Saudi Arabia, the prevalence and predictors of improper sharps collection and disposal were surveyed.

39953711.takeaway: A scoping review assessed how much open dynamic glycemic data are available for diabetes research, identifying limits to data accessibility.

39953719.takeaway: Metabolic risk factors were compared between normal-weight and excess-weight Argentinian preschool children aged 1 to 5.9 years, using BMI, waist, arm circumference and body fat.

39953892.takeaway: A patient with hypergonadotropic hypogonadism was found to have DNA ligase IV deficiency, a rare DNA damage-response disorder.

39953894.takeaway: In 250 adolescents with obesity and 250 healthy adolescents, oxytocin receptor gene variants and serum oxytocin were examined for relation to psychiatric symptoms.

39953904.takeaway: Clinical and laboratory characteristics were described for 50 Turkish patients with propionic acidemia, a multisystem inborn error caused by propionyl-CoA carboxylase deficiency.

39957128.takeaway: Glycemic outcomes of a tubeless hybrid closed-loop system were evaluated in a racial and ethnic minority cohort of children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes.

39960227.takeaway: A systematic review of artificial intelligence applied to digital images for diabetic foot screening evaluates its potential as a noninvasive detection method.

39960254.takeaway: In a post hoc analysis of the ISCHIA trial, the percent coefficient of variation of sensor glucose was examined for association with severe and non-severe hypoglycemia in adults with type 1 diabetes.

39960858.takeaway: An international working group guideline gives updated recommendations for diagnosing, evaluating, managing and monitoring X-linked hypophosphatemia in children.

39963281.takeaway: In Chinese women, a history of gestational diabetes in a previous pregnancy was analyzed for association with large-for-gestational-age infants and macrosomia in a second pregnancy.

39965057.takeaway: In 9,269 children with type 1 diabetes from nine countries' pediatric registries, DKA at diagnosis was analyzed for association with glycemic outcomes, insulin needs, BMI SDS and technology uptake.

39967943.takeaway: The 2024 Polish recommendations give guidance on diagnosing and managing familial hypercholesterolemia in children and adolescents, to improve detection and treatment.

39968296.takeaway: A review summarizes the association between thyroid disorders and inflammatory bowel disease, which is present in adults and also in children and adolescents.

39968300.takeaway: A review links serum uric acid to musculoskeletal diseases such as sarcopenia, osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis, and describes underlying mechanisms.

39968727.takeaway: Glycemic and metabolic parameters were compared among adults with type 2 diabetes in India who had teleconsultations only, hybrid visits, or fully in-person visits at a tertiary centre.

39970010.takeaway: In Ontario database records of people using intensive insulin, HbA1c and healthcare use before and after FreeStyle Libre adoption were analyzed.

39970038.takeaway: A population-based study quantified thyroid cancer incidence trends in China and estimated the extent of overdiagnosis, which can lead to overtreatment.

39970166.takeaway: Evinacumab was added to lipid apheresis in a young boy with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia and Achilles xanthomas, and its effect on LDL cholesterol is described.

39970272.takeaway: In 275 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, baseline diabetes distress and depression scores were analyzed for prediction of future glycemic control.

39971752.takeaway: In a prospective observational study of women with GCK-MODY, two standardized insulin strategies during pregnancy were compared for pregnancy and neonatal outcomes.

39971754.takeaway: Islet autoantibody positivity was characterized in Thai individuals diagnosed with type 1 diabetes before age 30, in a large nationwide multicentre study addressing a gap in non-European data.

39974721.takeaway: A literature review of Noonan syndrome finds myeloproliferative diseases most common among cancers, followed by intracranial tumours, with no genotype-based way to predict cancer risk.

39974820.takeaway: In a retrospective analysis of 9,058 singleton pregnancies at a Guangdong hospital, gestational weight gain was analyzed for association with adverse maternal and infant outcomes.

39974824.takeaway: A radiomic model built from pituitary MRI features was developed as a pilot to help distinguish central precocious puberty from non-CPP in girls.

39975416.takeaway: A review covers the endocrine consequences of congenital disorders of glycosylation, a genetically and clinically heterogeneous group of metabolic disorders.

39976470.takeaway: Retrospective records of adolescents with heavy menstrual bleeding were reviewed to evaluate diagnostic and management options.

39976480.takeaway: Predicted adult height calculated from automated bone age reading was compared with clinician-read Greulich-Pyle assessments in girls with early puberty variants or precocious puberty.

39977216.takeaway: The effect of elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor on glucose tolerance was evaluated in adolescents with cystic fibrosis, a question that remains controversial.

39980261.takeaway: An algorithm was developed to detect and resolve duplicated or time-shifted CGM uploads in data warehouses, and validated on two weeks of data.

39980848.takeaway: Anxiety and its relation to metabolic syndrome and cardiometabolic risk factors were compared in adolescents with obesity, using propensity score matching.

39980852.takeaway: In a retrospective analysis of boys with obesity, the relationship between MAFLD and sex hormone and SHBG levels was investigated.

39982433.takeaway: In adolescents with obesity, gut microbiota composition was studied in relation to metabolic dysfunction, inflammation and related measures.

39987906.takeaway: A familial case of non-autoimmune hyperthyroidism caused by a TSH receptor extracellular domain variant, p.Leu267Phe, is described.

39988947.takeaway: Common and rare DUOX variants were compared between patients with congenital hypothyroidism and controls, with family-based analysis of inheritance mode.

39989334.takeaway: The feasibility of an expert-proposed glucose manipulation procedure for standardized CGM performance evaluation was assessed.

39992257.takeaway: Beta cell function modeling from OGTT data was used to characterize the metabolic phenotype of stage 1 and stage 2 type 1 diabetes and to detect subtle changes.

39993160.takeaway: Psychosocial burden was assessed in patients with SDHx-related paraganglioma syndrome in a head and neck paraganglioma registry at one centre, and was found to be low.

39995240.takeaway: Medical records of 1,237 children in a metabolic department were reviewed to identify red-flag clinical, laboratory and imaging features for inherited metabolic disorders with liver involvement.

39996274.takeaway: Consumer-grade smartwatch physiological signals were analyzed with machine learning to detect nocturnal hypoglycemia in people with insulin-treated diabetes, as a non-invasive alternative to CGM.

39996431.takeaway: Bone mineral density was assessed across the life span in patients with classic CAH receiving lifelong glucocorticoid therapy, from prepubertal to adult age.

39999035.takeaway: Exome sequencing with a tiered analysis was used to define the genetic architecture of early-onset primary ovarian insufficiency in a cohort of 149 young women.

39999830.takeaway: Supplementation with β-casein A2 cow milk was studied for effects on physical growth, inflammation, growth-related hormones and nutritional biomarkers in stunted children.

40001289.takeaway: ECG beat ensembles were used to predict hypoglycemia non-invasively in type 1 diabetes, as an alternative to invasive CGM sensors that are less accurate at low glucose.

40007803.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl with a duplicated pituitary and central precocious puberty responded to GnRH analogue therapy, with slowed puberty and improved predicted adult height over 2 years.

40007810.takeaway: A nomogram built from baseline predictors was developed to identify which of 165 children with primary hypertension would respond to amlodipine, with bootstrap internal validation.

40009407.takeaway: In 10 Turkish patients with glycogen storage disease Ib, empagliflozin caused glucosuria and rising neutrophil counts, but urogenital infections occurred in 60% and hypoglycemia in 20%.

40009551.takeaway: Among 4,164 youth with type 1 diabetes, starting CGM within 6 months of diagnosis was associated with lower HbA1c at 3 years than later or no CGM use.

40009774.takeaway: Among 1.6 million Israeli adolescents, isolated glucosuria was associated with an adjusted hazard ratio of 2.17 for diabetes in adulthood.

40013314.takeaway: A 9-month-old boy with hypoparathyroidism, hearing loss and renal dysplasia carried a novel heterozygous GATA3 missense variant, c.800G>T, found on genetic testing.

40015255.takeaway: Obesity and high-fat diet may induce hypothalamic inflammation that could activate GnRH neurons and contribute to central precocious puberty in girls, a hypothesis drawn from existing literature.

40015262.takeaway: In three girls with central precocious puberty, histrelin implant fragments left after breakage stayed bioactive for up to 5 years and were cleared by surgical removal.

40016443.takeaway: In TrialNet relatives, IA-2A positivity was consistently associated with faster progression to clinical type 1 diabetes within and across established stages, and the authors suggest it be considered in monitoring.

40018370.takeaway: In 2,003 U.S. adolescents, higher serum uric acid was associated with greater lean mass and grip strength and lower fat mass.

40018371.takeaway: Metabolomics of 19 CLCN7 osteopetrosis patients versus 19 healthy controls showed enrichment of glycerophospholipid, arachidonic and linoleic acid pathways and candidate biomarkers.

40018845.takeaway: Among 73 Japanese children with craniopharyngioma, preoperative hydrocephalus was the only factor linked to an abnormal postoperative growth pattern at 1 year.

40019499.takeaway: Targeted serum proteomics in newly diagnosed youth with type 1 diabetes validated apolipoprotein associations with C-peptide/glucose ratios in the first year after diagnosis.

40022592.takeaway: In a 16-year-old Indian girl with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, evinacumab lowered LDL-C by 76% to 82 mg/dL, sustained over four months.

40023771.takeaway: Newborn screening of 52,942 infants in North Macedonia over ten years identified 11 with MCADD (prevalence 1 in 4,813), most often carrying the c.985A>G ACADM variant.

40025791.takeaway: Hypothyroid children aged 6 to 14 had higher urinary bisphenol levels than 51 matched controls, and the authors suggest bisphenol level as a possible biomarker.

40025874.takeaway: A narrative review of ten studies found that physically active children maintain higher 25(OH)D levels and better muscle strength, with vitamin D linked to bone mineral content.

40026687.takeaway: Eighteen adults with phenylketonuria had lower hip and lumbar spine BMD T-scores than 19 matched controls despite adequate vitamin D and calcium status.

40026692.takeaway: A young Chinese patient with NEUROD1 MODY6 and a novel missense variant also had Charcot-Marie-Tooth 1A and was treated with insulin plus oral agents for islet dysfunction.

40031891.takeaway: In 132 children tested for suspected adrenal insufficiency, the 40-minute cortisol sample had the highest specificity (89.1%) for predicting low-dose synacthen test results by monoclonal immunoassay.

40034226.takeaway: Morning and evening growth hormone injections gave similar sleep-wake patterns and activity in 20 children with GH deficiency or idiopathic short stature, so injection timing can follow family convenience.

40034234.takeaway: In 1,399 Chinese children aged 7 to 14, higher muscle percentage in each body region was inversely associated with MASLD, most strongly in the extremities, while regional fat was positively associated.

40034235.takeaway: Integrated analysis of published single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data mapped stage-specific RNA-binding protein clusters across testis development and linked specific RBPs to non-obstructive azoospermia.

40036632.takeaway: Among over one million Swedish men, having a sister with PCOS was associated with higher adjusted risks of obesity, type 2 diabetes and hypertension than having unaffected sisters.

40036793.takeaway: Reference intervals for 24-hour urinary calcium were established in 1,239 Chinese participants, with sex differences in how urinary calcium relates to bone metabolism.

40036808.takeaway: In 419,581 UK Biobank participants, heterozygous loss-of-function variants in MC4R, POMC and PCSK1 were confirmed to affect adult BMI.

40036959.takeaway: A 3-week high-dose fiber intervention in people with Prader-Willi syndrome, compared with control in a crossover design, produced shifts in gut microbiota and microbial metabolites.

40036973.takeaway: Ethnicity-specific normative cutoffs for the modified Ferriman-Gallwey hirsutism score were derived from pooled community data, and most populations fit the guideline threshold of 4 to 6.

40037628.takeaway: In 39 pediatric thyroid FNA cases, combined oncogene sequencing and miRNA risk classification was a potentially useful adjunct to cytology for presurgical evaluation.

40041282.takeaway: A publicly accessible database presents next-generation sequencing variants from 5,926 Russian patients with 450 endocrine disorders tested between 2017 and 2024.

40041287.takeaway: Age- and sex-specific vitamin D binding protein reference ranges in 2,503 children aged 3 months to 17 years show that BMI, puberty, oral contraceptive use and inflammation affect DBP levels.

40041288.takeaway: Among 3,763 people referred for hyperinsulinism genetic testing, contiguous gene copy number variants were a meaningful cause and should be included in routine gene panels.

40042044.takeaway: Postprandial glucose responses to meals were predicted in 497 people with type 1 or type 2 diabetes using limited data, without personalized training or invasive microbiome data.

40042104.takeaway: Non-targeted serum metabolomics of 55 girls, including 30 with central precocious puberty, identified 14 metabolites forming a network proposed as a diagnostic marker.

40045579.takeaway: A 2-month-old Chinese child assigned female at birth had 5-alpha-reductase type 2 deficiency from a novel compound heterozygous SRD5A2 variant, a 175 kb deletion plus c.607G>A.

40046875.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease data show a significant recent rise in early-onset (ages 15 to 39) type 2 diabetes incidence in the Asia-Pacific region, exceeding pre-pandemic predictions.

40046879.takeaway: Ultrasound radiomics distinguished medullary from papillary thyroid carcinoma in 213 patients, and the combined clinical-radiomics model performed best.

40047305.takeaway: In children at adrenarche, prolactin levels correlated with adrenal androgens, with 11-ketotestosterone the dominant bioactive androgen, suggesting a possible role for prolactin in premature adrenarche.

40049149.takeaway: In an open-label extension, children with growth hormone deficiency given once-weekly lonapegsomatropin for up to 6 years kept height gains, with safety comparable to daily GH.

40049630.takeaway: Meta-analysis of randomized trials found real-time CGM lowered HbA1c and raised time in range in type 1 and type 2 diabetes versus blood glucose monitoring, with less hypoglycemia in type 1.

40049669.takeaway: A narrative review links adequate vitamin D to better sleep quality and fewer sleep problems in children and describes possible mechanisms.

40049670.takeaway: Once-weekly somatrogon is a potential alternative to daily GH in pediatric GH deficiency, reducing treatment burden, with supporting phase II and III trial data.

40049671.takeaway: Records of 583 Thai girls evaluated for early puberty from 2018 to 2022 showed rising evaluations, with obesity highlighted as affecting pubertal timing.

40049672.takeaway: In 47 pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes, the COVID-19 lockdown improved HbA1c, with the greatest benefit in those with poor glycemic control beforehand.

40049673.takeaway: In 200 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, GnRH agonist treatment improved final height outcomes, including in girls treated at 8 to 9 years.

40049674.takeaway: In 18 children with type 1 diabetes and mild COVID-19, CGM metrics worsened during infection and recovered within two weeks, with insulin pump therapy steadier than injections.

40053446.takeaway: In 1,130 mother-child pairs, maternal thyroid hormone levels within the normal range during pregnancy were associated with glycolipid metabolism in 4- to 6-year-old children.

40055929.takeaway: A 3.2-year-old girl with a large-scale mtDNA deletion presented with antibody-negative insulin-dependent diabetes, short stature, skin pigmentation changes and macrocytosis, later with corneal dystrophy and hearing loss.

40056050.takeaway: CGM in glycogen storage disease types Ia and III identified asymptomatic low glucose episodes, which can guide precise adjustment of dietary therapy.

40056055.takeaway: In 99 children with thyroid nodules, repeat FNA no longer than 6 months apart for benign nodules with suspicious ultrasound allows more timely surgery for malignancy.

40056454.takeaway: Among 3,902 adult childhood cancer survivors, untreated adult growth hormone deficiency was linked to adverse outcomes, while socioeconomic disadvantage limited access to GH therapy.

40056457.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes, a TGA-IgA level around 6.1 times the upper limit of normal may indicate biopsy for celiac confirmation, and adding IgG antibodies to deamidated gliadin may improve precision.

40058338.takeaway: A novel intronic GH1 variant in the splicing enhancer of intron 3 segregated with familial isolated growth hormone deficiency across three affected family members.

40059721.takeaway: In UK Biobank women, later menarche was linked to higher coronary artery disease risk only when driven by sources other than common genetic variation.

40060381.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease data show the burden of diabetic chronic kidney disease is rising, with further increases projected to 2050 without intervention, especially in low- and middle-income countries.

40060383.takeaway: Quantitative ultrasound percentiles for calcaneal bone health were developed in schoolchildren living at high altitude in Peru, supporting population-specific reference values.

40060384.takeaway: In 16,428 children followed from birth, early infections and antibiotic use showed few associations with type 1 diabetes, though frequent gastrointestinal infections need confirmation.

40063902.takeaway: Sequencing in 48 Sudanese children with primary adrenal insufficiency, excluding CAH and triple A, identified novel recurrent variants and explained several comorbidities.

40064154.takeaway: A review of childhood cancer survivors links post-treatment obesity to hypothalamic damage and other risk factors, and recommends annual BMI measurement and activity and diet counseling.

40064156.takeaway: An adult man with non-classic lipoid CAH due to STAR variants, including novel ones, had normal fertility, and reported adult males with normal gonadal function lacked documented paternity.

40067863.takeaway: In preclinical in vitro and rat studies, the GH receptor antagonist ALXN2420 added to octreotide produced an additive reduction in IGF1, supporting its study in acromegaly.

40067968.takeaway: Using national surveys from 2006 to 2022, the prevalence of obesity comorbidities in Mexico was stable over time but rose with age.

40067969.takeaway: National inpatient data show thyrotoxicosis hospitalizations fell from 2016 to 2020, while in-hospital mortality, costs, length of stay and major adverse cardiac events rose.

40068640.takeaway: In 37 youth with CAH and 100 controls, children with CAH showed more cognitive conflict when choosing between healthy and tasty foods, linked to two disease-severity indicators.

40068940.takeaway: In 10 boys with familial male-limited precocious puberty, early letrozole and spironolactone followed by GnRH agonist limited physical signs and improved adult height in six, without major side effects.

40068954.takeaway: A scoping review of six studies covering 58 boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy found pubertal induction successful in all, with no side effects reported, though evidence is limited.

40069730.takeaway: The international guideline for adolescents with PCOS sets diagnostic criteria that differ from adult criteria and clarifies screening and management, based on low-to-moderate certainty evidence.

40070585.takeaway: In 3,205 U.S. children and adolescents aged 8 to 19, the systemic inflammatory response index had a nonlinear association with bone mineral density, positive at specific thresholds.

40070587.takeaway: A 69-year-old woman with familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia type 1 from a novel CASR mutation also had Gitelman syndrome, whose hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia the authors say should be prioritized.

40071717.takeaway: In 26,427 real-world users of an automated insulin delivery system with type 2 diabetes, time in range exceeded 70% across insulin-dose phenotypes with low hypoglycemia.

40071788.takeaway: A review finds automated insulin delivery improves glycemia in pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, but pregnancy may need flexible glucose targets and algorithms that adapt to changing insulin needs.

40071796.takeaway: A multidisciplinary expert panel's framework guideline sets out assessment, puberty suppression and gender-affirming hormone protocols for adolescent transgender and non-binary people with gender dysphoria.

40071848.takeaway: An automated classifier identified continuous glucose monitoring Ambulatory Glucose Profile reports among 2,244 EHR documents with 95.0% sensitivity and 91.7% specificity; about half were AGP reports.

40073408.takeaway: At a diabetes summer camp, 21 children rated the Dexcom G7 more useful than the G6 and found it more accurate, and camp glucose management improved with healthcare-team efforts.

40073966.takeaway: The updated French consensus supports wider use of automated insulin delivery in type 1 diabetes, with benefits reported for children, pregnancy and other groups, and emerging evidence in type 2 diabetes.

40078582.takeaway: In a retrospective cohort of 33 children with McCune-Albright syndrome, uncommon features such as hepatic disorders occurred mainly in patients with involvement of multiple other tissues.

40078585.takeaway: Plasma extracellular vesicle microRNAs differed between participants with childhood trauma and controls, and some were linked to bone markers, though the small sample needs validation.

40079348.takeaway: In 56 prospectively evaluated carriers of an SDHAF2 variant, 33 developed paragangliomas, and Ga-68 DOTA-TOC PET detected more lesions than F-18 DOPA PET.

40080424.takeaway: In 114 children with Prader-Willi syndrome, starting growth hormone before age 2 was associated with a lower highest lifetime BMI-SDS than starting after age 7.

40086810.takeaway: In 3,812 Danish transgender persons, transmasculine people using gender-affirming hormones had higher autoimmune disease incidence than nonusers, and higher type 1 diabetes incidence versus controls was attenuated by care.

40090995.takeaway: Enterovirus VP1 positivity in tissues from 188 organ donors, including donors with type 1 diabetes, was linked to HLA class I hyperexpression in islet cells, suggesting infection may drive disease mechanisms.

40093751.takeaway: A provincial survey in Hainan found iodine nutrition generally adequate, with residents' iodine intake mainly from iodized salt, supporting continued salt iodization in island areas.

40094311.takeaway: In boys with constitutional delay of growth and puberty, the Roche-Wainer-Thissen method predicted final height better than Bayley-Pinneau or BoneXpert methods.

40094312.takeaway: Among 164 adolescents including 93 with obesity, problematic internet use, gaming disorder and cyberbullying were associated with lower self-esteem.

40094399.takeaway: An expert opinion outlines use of modified-release hydrocortisone in children and adolescents with classic CAH to mimic the diurnal cortisol rhythm, with dosing, surveillance and stress-dosing guidance.

40095061.takeaway: Enterovirus RNA was detected in pancreas and lymphoid tissues of organ donors with type 1 diabetes and of donors with islet autoantibodies, consistent with low-grade pancreatic infection.

40096834.takeaway: Parents of children with hypochondroplasia, ACAN, NPR2 or RASopathy-related short stature reported worse quality of life across multiple domains than reference groups with idiopathic short stature or GH deficiency.

40099251.takeaway: In NHANES 2013 to 2018 women of reproductive age, higher relative fat mass was positively associated with sterility, suggesting it may help identify women at risk.

40099385.takeaway: CGM use among German adults with diabetes roughly doubled between nationwide surveys in 2017 and 2021/2022, irrespective of sociodemographic factors.

40099422.takeaway: An educator's review of diluted U10 insulin in an automated system for very young children describes potential benefits such as less hypoglycemia, and stresses safety protocols and labeling.

40099468.takeaway: In a 12-week pilot randomized trial, CGM was feasible and acceptable for over half of youth with type 2 diabetes on infrequent self-monitoring, though device stigma and skin adhesion problems limited use.

40099975.takeaway: A 16-year-old girl with a homozygous FIBP variant had Thauvin-Robinet-Faivre syndrome with segmental overgrowth and thyroid carcinoma, expanding the known tumor spectrum.

40100859.takeaway: In 7 children after total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation, hydroxyurea did not appear to affect Libre CGM accuracy, unlike Dexcom, which differed more from point-of-care glucose.

40102949.takeaway: In 6.7 million Korean adults aged 20 to 39, a higher triglyceride-glucose index was associated with greater all-cause, cardiovascular and respiratory mortality, but not cancer mortality.

40103287.takeaway: Age-specific TSH and free T4 reference intervals were proposed for children with Down syndrome aged 6 months to 15 years, as both showed significant inverse associations with age.

40103355.takeaway: A case of Xp21 contiguous gene deletion syndrome with adrenal insufficiency and raised CK was confirmed by an Xp21.2 deletion and treated with hydrocortisone, fludrocortisone and salt.

40103414.takeaway: An international guideline recommends metabolic syndrome surveillance for childhood, adolescent and young adult cancer survivors, covering risk-factor screening, age at start and frequency.

40104566.takeaway: In 222 obese Chinese children aged 4 to 17, 16 clinical variables and 14 plasma metabolites were associated with NAFLD, and machine-learning models built on them discriminated well.

40104567.takeaway: In children with septo-optic dysplasia, measured resting energy expenditure was lower than predicted, and hyperphagia was higher with pituitary changes, suggesting hypothalamic dysfunction may drive BMI gain.

40104568.takeaway: In a subgroup of 200 children in the REAL4 trial, those with a GH peak of 3 µg/L or less on stimulation testing gained more height velocity and height SDS on weekly somapacitan.

40105362.takeaway: A review updates childhood obesity epidemiology, causes, complications and treatment, recommending a multifaceted biopsychosocial approach, with bariatric surgery an increasingly recognized option in adolescence.

40105403.takeaway: Whole-blood microarrays of 25 Prader-Willi patients and 25 age-matched controls found expression differences between obese and non-obese patients, with CLEC4D linked to macrophage infiltration.

40105472.takeaway: A 9.75-year-old boy with Weiss-Kruszka syndrome had growth retardation, developmental delay and craniofacial anomalies, adding to the limited reports supporting haploinsufficiency of the gene.

40105880.takeaway: An approach-to-the-patient review covers diagnosis, surgery, systemic therapy and follow-up for hereditary medullary thyroid carcinoma from RET variants, emphasizing multidisciplinary care.

40106712.takeaway: Among 204 South Indian children and adolescents, waist-to-height ratio predicted metabolic syndrome better than BMI or waist-to-hip ratio, and HOMA-IR and the triglyceride-glucose index flagged unhealthy obesity.

40106739.takeaway: Updated ASCO guidance recommends that people with cancer be counseled about reproductive risks at diagnosis, referred to fertility specialists, and offered fertility preservation before cancer therapy.

40108022.takeaway: In 212 healthy Hong Kong infants with low 25-hydroxyvitamin D, PTH was most suppressed at a lower 25OHD level than in Western studies, which may imply a lower deficiency cutoff.

40108964.takeaway: In 88 neonates with congenital hypothyroidism, TSH at diagnosis, TSH above 5 µIU/mL during treatment and levothyroxine dose patterns distinguished permanent from transient disease.

40109173.takeaway: A meta-analysis found incorrect injection-site rotation and needle reuse to be the strongest risk factors for lipohypertrophy in insulin-treated diabetes, both modifiable by education.

40109176.takeaway: A method encodes daily CGM profiles as compressed text, and the optimal glucose-range alphabet was selected by compression and information criteria across data from six studies.

40109245.takeaway: A 15-year-old with a 46,XY female phenotype, absent puberty and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism carried SRY, DHX37 and POR variants, suggesting combined gonadal and adrenal defects.

40110544.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease analysis shows rising global prevalence and mortality of chronic kidney disease from 1990 to 2021, with continued increases projected to 2032.

40110745.takeaway: Bioinformatic analysis of two public datasets identified 30 overlapping down-regulated genes in central precocious puberty, with candidate hub genes proposed for future validation.

40110970.takeaway: In 96 children with type 1 diabetes and 95 controls, late chronotype and poor sleep quality were linked to suboptimal glycemic control, supporting sleep-focused diabetes care.

40111179.takeaway: A survey of 43 international X-linked hypophosphatemia experts describes current monitoring practice for children and adults, with weak recommendations based on very low-quality evidence.

40111755.takeaway: In 84 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, those started on automated insulin delivery had lower HbA1c at 12 months than those on predictive low-glucose suspend or multiple daily injections.

40111862.takeaway: In Ugandan youth with type 1 diabetes, personalized A1c correlated better with mean glucose than laboratory A1c, but mean glucose was not clinically useful given extreme glucose variability.

40112797.takeaway: Australian children under 7 with type 1 diabetes did not meet recommended daily moderate-to-vigorous physical activity, and parents reported low concern about diabetes-related barriers.

40117472.takeaway: The 2024 Norbert Freinkel Award lecture describes how the ATLANTIC DIP network's work has shaped national policy and guidelines for pregnancies complicated by diabetes.

40119628.takeaway: A systematic review of nine studies found evidence on lipohypertrophy risk and consequences in insulin pump users insufficient for firm conclusions, calling for better-designed studies.

40119663.takeaway: A review of 24 observational publications covering 243 pregnancies on antenatal automated insulin delivery in type 1 diabetes reports glycemic and maternal-neonatal outcomes, with small subgroups to interpret cautiously.

40120082.takeaway: A review describes how testosterone and estradiol jointly maintain male bone health, with estradiol key for trabecular bone, and raises open questions about testosterone therapy for male osteoporosis.

40123165.takeaway: Two families with 46,XY DSD had a novel canonical splice-site CYB5A variant causing isolated 17,20-lyase deficiency, and steroid metabolomics helped separate it from 17α-hydroxylase deficiency.

40126979.takeaway: In 254 adolescents evaluated for menstrual irregularity, routine total testosterone, DHEA-S and free androgen index distinguished anovulation from increased PCOS risk after other causes were excluded.

40127627.takeaway: Across 22 pediatric diabetes centers, skin problems from diabetes devices were common in real-world use despite preventive strategies, so more skin-friendly devices are needed.

40128946.takeaway: De novo RET variants accounted for about 16% of MEN2 syndromes in 152 families with hereditary medullary thyroid carcinoma, and all were of paternal origin.

40129031.takeaway: Race-neutral pediatric BMD reference ranges were associated with prospective fracture risk, and the authors suggest adopting them, with thoughtful transition for children monitored with race-specific ranges.

40129139.takeaway: Fifteen individuals from six families with heterozygous ACAN deletions showed a homogeneous, age-dependent short stature phenotype with a high proportion of severe joint problems.

40130161.takeaway: Systematic exome and genome sequencing of 470 patients with suspected skeletal dysplasia in Slovenia's national system improved diagnostic yield and revealed substantial genetic heterogeneity.

40132045.takeaway: Prenatal PFAS concentrations were associated with maternal insulin resistance and beta-cell function 7 to 9 years later, with associations differing by specific PFAS.

40132568.takeaway: In 15 children with ACTH-independent Cushing syndrome, McCune-Albright syndrome, PPNAD and Carney complex were the main causes, and early diagnosis and management are essential.

40134702.takeaway: In 34 children with achondroplasia, 12 months of real-world vosoritide treatment improved growth and 6-minute walk distance.

40138490.takeaway: A review of surveys and qualitative studies finds automated insulin delivery in pregnancy improves well-being, flexibility and team collaboration for women with type 1 diabetes, though burdens are also reported.

40139165.takeaway: A review of endocrine-disrupting chemicals such as bisphenol A, phthalates and PFAS describes how these obesogens may promote childhood obesity through several metabolic pathways.

40139169.takeaway: An online global survey of 146 young people with diabetes and carers from 29 countries found transition services inadequate, with a preference for combined pediatric and adult clinics and psychologist support.

40144813.takeaway: A network meta-analysis found lonapegsomatropin the only long-acting growth hormone associated with better growth outcomes, with no significant difference in serious adverse events.

40150827.takeaway: A systematic review found pubertal disorders frequent in children with polyarticular and systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis, with some influencing factors potentially modifiable.

40152109.takeaway: In an 8-week pilot study, algorithm-driven initiation and adjustment of automated insulin delivery settings appeared safe and effective in children aged 2 to 6 with type 1 diabetes.

40152409.takeaway: The authors argue that publicly accessible APIs are needed for real-time diabetes device data, and examine how terms of service and copyright law affect access.

40159376.takeaway: A review describes individualized multimodal care for children with severe or genetic obesity, including mechanism-based drugs for genetic obesity and incretin-based drugs, delivered in specialized centers.

40159903.takeaway: Control-IQ pump users who switched from Dexcom G6 to G7 sensors saw glucose metrics change by less than 1%, with similar excellent control on either sensor.

40162319.takeaway: Among 13,958 French pregnancies, smoking may mask the large-for-gestational-age risk of hyperglycemia first diagnosed in pregnancy, while other maternal and fetal risks persist.

40163581.takeaway: An EHR-based computable phenotype identified diabetes and type 1 diabetes in youth and young adults accurately, though type 2 misclassification in youth needs refinement.

40165445.takeaway: In 286 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, the pandemic increased food consumption, telemedicine was well accepted, and older participants reported better quality of life.

40165449.takeaway: In 111 girls, bioelectrical impedance distinguished central precocious puberty from premature thelarche only modestly, with one cutoff reaching 50% sensitivity and 82% specificity.

40166675.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes at a Riyadh center, overweight or obesity present at diagnosis persisted during follow-up, underscoring the need to address obesity early.

40166677.takeaway: GBD 2021 data show global prevalence of type 1 diabetic nephropathy rising, with China's prevalence projected to stabilize over the next 20 years.

40170496.takeaway: Across type 1 diabetes trials, glucose management indicator underestimated the true change in A1C, and its direction depended on baseline A1C, so it may not reliably capture efficacy.

40170568.takeaway: In 156 children starting automated insulin delivery, glycemic outcomes were assessed at one year, and user-initiated boluses and CGM wear time had no impact on system performance.

40170658.takeaway: In 34 children with type 1 diabetes, pizza and a ham sandwich with matched macronutrients gave similar glycemic control, though responses differed between the 780G and Control-IQ systems.

40171722.takeaway: Ultra-rapid lispro with Control-IQ+ modestly reduced postprandial glucose compared with standard lispro in 176 people with type 1 diabetes, with the largest benefit after breakfast.

40171942.takeaway: Prepubertal boys with short stature had lower muscle strength and endurance than normally statured controls, and 12 months of GH treatment improved these measures.

40173211.takeaway: In autoantibody-positive relatives at risk for type 1 diabetes, disposition index measures showed an inverse relationship across glycemic ranges and predicted progression to T1D.

40175764.takeaway: In the Pune birth cohort followed for 24 years, parent-of-origin effects on cardiometabolic traits varied across life stages, with the authors suggesting implications for primordial prevention.

40176278.takeaway: In children and adolescents with type 2 diabetes at one Korean hospital, glycemic control and complications worsened during the 2020 COVID-19 outbreak, especially in those with obesity.

40176772.takeaway: A review of monogenic diabetes, including MODY and neonatal diabetes, describes identification, treatment and management of its forms and highlights unmet needs, as these forms remain underreported.

40177735.takeaway: Testosterone injections in 71 infants with 47,XXY did not improve neurodevelopment and suppressed the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, so routine treatment is not supported.

40179233.takeaway: In NHANES adults, thyroid hormone sensitivity indices were linked to metabolic phenotypes in younger adults but not older adults, supporting their use in obesity stratification.

40182627.takeaway: Among 384 visually impaired patients in northwest Ethiopia, excessive body weight was associated with determinants including urban residence and long-term visual impairment.

40182631.takeaway: In children on daily rhGH for isolated GH deficiency, discomfort toward peers was associated with therapy-related stress despite a high degree of adherence.

40183306.takeaway: In ten healthy boys from the Copenhagen Puberty Study, androgen bioactivity was undetectable before puberty and measurable in most boys afterward, partly reflecting assay sensitivity.

40183340.takeaway: A 15-day factory-calibrated Libre 2 Plus and Libre 3 Plus sensor was accurate in adults and children, with 97.1% of adult and 98.0% of pediatric results within ±15 mg/dL of the reference analyzer.

40184493.takeaway: In 554 children and young people with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, higher blood pressure was common and most pronounced at younger ages, but may not be explained by mineralocorticoid replacement.

40186497.takeaway: The authors propose a method that incorporates hypoglycemia treatments into CGM-based metrics, producing a behavior-sensitive measure of hypoglycemia exposure in type 1 diabetes.

40186499.takeaway: An inpatient CGM-based insulin titration protocol for type 2 diabetes outside ICUs was highly accepted by seven diabetes team members and was operable across 84 monitored inpatients.

40193575.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 71 children with self-limited delayed puberty identified candidate genes, including INHBB, suggesting both monogenic and polygenic mechanisms.

40193582.takeaway: In boys under one year with micropenis or cryptorchidism, inhibin B and/or AMH discriminated congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism from controls with good accuracy across four infancy periods.

40193585.takeaway: In midpubertal boys with short predicted adult height, aromatase inhibitor treatment alone or with GH increased adult height beyond initial predictions, compared with matched untreated boys.

40195751.takeaway: A meta-analysis of experimental studies found growth hormone therapy effective and safe for children with inflammatory bowel disease and impaired growth, though more randomized trials are needed.

40196912.takeaway: Cord blood metabolomics of 46 newborns of diabetic, obese or overweight mothers, compared with 20 controls, showed altered carbohydrate, protein and fat metabolism, with DGLA and kynurenines proposed as candidate markers.

40197421.takeaway: In 23 children with CAH, long-term conventional hydrocortisone, even within the recommended range, may adversely affect cardiac function compared with 21 healthy controls.

40200746.takeaway: A perspective proposes measuring the mechanical properties of insulin as a route to real-time, point-of-care insulin sensing, while noting feasibility challenges.

40202527.takeaway: Among adults with type 2 diabetes starting GLP-1 receptor agonists, higher out-of-pocket costs were associated with poorer adherence and more hospitalizations and emergency visits.

40205712.takeaway: In a post-hoc analysis of six cohorts, youth showed sexual dimorphism in bone mineral density, with body composition related to BMD differently in those with and without diabetes.

40205723.takeaway: In a Danish population-based cohort, one-year direct healthcare costs after fractures were higher in patients with type 1 diabetes at all sites except the hip.

40206601.takeaway: In NHANES women aged 18 to 49, recreational physical activity was associated with infertility, with HbA1c partly mediating this association.

40207786.takeaway: A narrative review argues that commercial insurer eligibility criteria block many people who would benefit from CGM and automated insulin delivery, and proposes changes to those criteria.

40208111.takeaway: In the I-DSD Registry, 46,XY partial gonadal dysgenesis showed a heterogeneous phenotype, and many with preserved gonads had the potential to develop puberty spontaneously.

40208229.takeaway: In Latinos with uncontrolled type 2 diabetes, culturally tailored education improved HbA1c, with real-time CGM conferring greater improvement in this randomized trial.

40208750.takeaway: The M120 risk score identified 26% more children at high risk of type 1 diabetes progression than oral glucose tolerance testing, and detected early teplizumab treatment effects by 6 months.

40208751.takeaway: Using 2016 to 2021 US birth certificate data, adverse pregnancy outcomes in gestational diabetes differed significantly across Asian subgroups, so disaggregated data are needed.

40208827.takeaway: In 101 youths aged 15 to 25 with type 1 diabetes, hybrid closed loop lowered HbA1c from 9.6% to 8.0% and raised time in range, with new or worsening retinopathy in nine.

40209099.takeaway: Among 129,466 Danish adults with a diagnosis of overweight or obesity, the risk of many gastrointestinal diseases was higher than in matched controls, most strongly among those aged 18 to 29.

40209722.takeaway: Across 202 observational studies covering 56.1 million pregnancies, maternal diabetes was associated with a higher risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in children, more strongly with pre-gestational than gestational diabetes.

40210729.takeaway: Genetic variants associated with low and high birthweight were analyzed in UK Biobank, underscoring genetic factors in the link between birthweight and later cardiometabolic disease.

40211541.takeaway: Re-evaluated surgical specimens from 20 children with atypia of undetermined significance suggest lobectomy is appropriate only when nuclear atypia is present, avoiding delay and unnecessary surgery.

40211555.takeaway: Clinical exome sequencing with copy number analysis in 11 patients with Peters-Plus syndrome was assessed for diagnostic utility, and the authors argue CNV detection should be part of routine workflows.

40211616.takeaway: In the Born in Bradford cohort, pregnant women with PCOS had distinct psychological, social and clinical profiles, and their female infants had higher birth weights than controls.

40213103.takeaway: In 225 adults recently diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and 450 controls, following a Nordic diet was associated with a significantly lower risk of type 2 diabetes.

40219621.takeaway: In 166 hospitalized patients with type 2 diabetes on basal-bolus insulin, time at high risk of hypoglycemia strongly predicted hypoglycemia, and keeping it below 50% aligns with the TBR target.

40219799.takeaway: Two consanguineous male siblings with vitamin D-dependent rickets type 2A from a novel VDR variant responded to high-dose oral calcium and calcitriol in a resource-limited setting.

40219802.takeaway: A miniaturized near-infrared fingernail device showed high specificity for identifying type 2 diabetes risk in pooled pilot studies, supporting feasibility for low-cost screening.

40219808.takeaway: Using four years of CGM data from 736 people with type 1 diabetes, a model predicted high glycemia risk index six to nine months ahead with an AUC of 0.87, but still needs validation.

40225327.takeaway: A review summarizes how microRNAs regulate growth plate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy through PTHrP, Indian hedgehog and BMP signaling, and their therapeutic potential.

40225328.takeaway: Among 18,548 Chinese women with gestational diabetes, study-derived gestational weight gain ranges and Chinese Nutrition Society recommendations suited local outcomes better than IOM guidance.

40225330.takeaway: A 3-year-old boy with epilepsy on phenobarbital had rickets and Fanconi-like phosphate wasting from vitamin D deficiency that reversed with replacement, despite an SLC34A1 variant.

40226520.takeaway: In a Swedish register of 230 patients aged up to 21, most pediatric adrenal tumors were malignant and carried high mortality, while benign tumors had mortality similar to controls.

40228835.takeaway: A Canadian GRADE-based clinical practice guideline gives evidence-based recommendations for managing pediatric obesity, supporting shared decision-making among children, families and clinicians.

40230485.takeaway: In 183 children with subclinical hypothyroidism and 313 controls, the SPINA model gave a wider view of thyroid gland function within the euthyroid range and informs whether subclinical hypothyroidism needs treatment.

40233002.takeaway: In 11 mothers with type 1 diabetes, maternal glucose correlated with breast milk glucose and fructose but not with milk volume ingested, and milk glucose and leptin were higher than in five women without diabetes.

40233006.takeaway: Among 234 youth with recurrent or chronic pancreatitis, islet autoantibody positivity (12%) was associated with beta-cell dysfunction, higher HbA1c, lower C-peptide and shorter time to diabetes.

40233162.takeaway: Longer tandem repeat units in the INS-VNTR class I haplotype from people with type 1 diabetes increased insulin expression in assays, and the authors suggest vitamin A might help prevent insulin autoimmunity.

40233175.takeaway: Youth with type 2 diabetes attending an adult transition clinic commonly reported mood symptoms and organizational cognitive difficulties, which were barriers to diabetes self-care.

40235218.takeaway: In a longitudinal Portuguese cohort, children with congenital hypothyroidism had persistent non-verbal cognitive deficits and lower quality of life despite early treatment, with severe intellectual disability rare.

40237140.takeaway: A commentary on the 26,427-user real-world study of automated insulin delivery in type 2 diabetes calls the system effective and scalable for insulin-requiring disease, while noting limits in baseline data.

40241991.takeaway: A review of iodine excess describes thyroid autoimmunity and systemic effects, including cardiovascular, nervous and renal risks, as iodine intake rises from diet, supplements and contrast media.

40242208.takeaway: A meta-analysis of critically ill children found vitamin D deficiency associated with higher mortality and greater need for inotropic support, supporting further study of supplementation.

40243526.takeaway: An international working group guideline for adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia suggests burosumab over conventional therapy in the absence of fractures, with conventional therapy if it is unavailable.

40243921.takeaway: A practical review guides counseling of pregnant people with type 1 diabetes on hybrid closed-loop therapy, selecting candidates, and managing available systems off-label through gestation.

40245859.takeaway: Over 40 years in Lodz Province, Poland, childhood type 1 diabetes incidence rose significantly but is slowing, with most new cases in children aged 10 and older.

40252005.takeaway: Among eight children with genetically confirmed congenital lipoid adrenal hyperplasia in North India, seven had the nonclassical form, suggesting it is more prevalent than recognized.

40255106.takeaway: A review of obesity management in adolescent females describes lifestyle, pharmacological and other options, and advises individualized approaches for optimal success.

40256802.takeaway: Among youth aged 11 to 17 with type 1 diabetes at a school camp, Control-IQ maintained satisfactory glucose control over three hours after both fried and boiled potatoes.

40256906.takeaway: In 53 prepubertal children with idiopathic short stature, lumbar spine bone density was lower than in 20 controls, and one year of GH in 11 improved body composition without significantly changing BMD.

40256953.takeaway: A meta-analysis found moderate to substantial agreement between self-reported Pubertal Development Scale and clinician Tanner staging, with high sensitivity and positive predictive value for puberty onset.

40257095.takeaway: In 65 patients with SDHx-related head-and-neck paragangliomas, most monitored tumors stayed stable, supporting initial observation before treatment, especially in asymptomatic patients.

40257233.takeaway: In a 12-week pilot cluster trial of 108 Indian schoolgirls aged 13 to 15, a 10-minute high-intensity dance program increased daily step counts by about 1,073 and improved several cardiometabolic measures.

40260280.takeaway: APEX is a real-world XLH global data unification program designed to close evidence gaps that randomized trials and regional registries cannot address.

40260284.takeaway: In 125 girls with breast development, basal LH, IGF-1, IGFBP-3, DHEAS and ultrasound features distinguished central precocious puberty from premature thelarche, and combining LH with DHEAS raised accuracy to an AUC of 0.973.

40260699.takeaway: In adults with type 1 diabetes, breath acetone gave a noninvasive estimate of blood beta-hydroxybutyrate, with correlation suboptimal in outpatient care but strong during supervised insulin withdrawal.

40265163.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease data attribute about 282,000 diabetes deaths and 12.9 million DALYs in 2021 to air pollution, with South Asia and Africa projected to see the largest rise in death rates.

40265636.takeaway: In 151 inpatients admitted for diabetes emergencies, 90.7% of intermittent-scan and real-time CGM readings fell within the modified 20/20 agreement criteria, supporting inpatient CGM use.

40266295.takeaway: In childhood-onset type 1 diabetes, DNA methylation at identified loci, including PKNOX1, was associated with 28-year incidence of diabetic neuropathy, suggesting epigenetic targets for prevention.

40269620.takeaway: Two children with novel IGF1R variants had growth restriction, and one treated with rhGH had a modest height response, with elevated IGF1 during therapy calling for careful dosing.

40270158.takeaway: A 3-year-old boy with developmental delay and ACTH-independent Cushing syndrome from adrenal hyperplasia had cortisol control and symptom improvement on off-label osilodrostat.

40270454.takeaway: Among 84 children with inborn errors of immunity, 15.6% of those with 22q11.2 deletion had permanent hypoparathyroidism, and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism appeared in several groups, so gonadal function needs monitoring.

40270468.takeaway: A survey of 51 clinicians managing bone health and puberty in Duchenne muscular dystrophy identified needs for guidance on testosterone monitoring after discontinuation and re-initiation thresholds.

40270714.takeaway: A 17-year-old boy with a monoallelic ENPP1 inactivating variant had femoral metaphyseal abnormalities and a slipped femoral epiphysis, and the review urges attention to calcium and phosphorus metabolism in pediatric bone disease.

40270717.takeaway: In 103 children under 20 undergoing DXA, height adjustment changed bone density Z-scores, so size adjustment may benefit all pediatric patients, not only those with short stature.

40270719.takeaway: Caregivers of 68 children with congenital hyperinsulinism in Brazil reported symptoms before six months in 60% of cases, and named delayed diagnosis and limited access to genetic testing and treatment as barriers.

40272271.takeaway: A review of DCCT and EDIC, which randomized 1,441 adolescents and adults with type 1 diabetes, traces how intensive glycemic therapy reduced microvascular complications and set the HbA1c target below 7%.

40272272.takeaway: A review summarizes TEDDY's findings on environmental triggers, drivers and modifiers of islet autoimmunity and gene-environment interactions leading to type 1 diabetes in children.

40272281.takeaway: A review of youth-onset type 2 diabetes describes its aggressive course, pediatric treatment response, and morbidity and mortality from landmark NIDDK studies, and notes differences from adult-onset disease.

40272924.takeaway: Patients with MODY carrying ABCC8 variants had loss-of-function KATP channel mutations, the reverse of the gain-of-function defect in KATP neonatal diabetes, with different clinical and therapeutic implications.

40273897.takeaway: In 306 children with type 1 diabetes across seven centers, numeracy measured by two tests was used to predict HbA1c, and the short Wordless Mathematical Test was a potentially practical tool.

40276675.takeaway: In 18 people with new-onset type 1 diabetes, lower 25(OH)D levels were associated with lower fasting C-peptide, which may reflect more aggressive autoimmunity, pending larger studies.

40285376.takeaway: A 10-year-old girl with a novel truncating BMP2 variant had short stature, facial dysmorphism and phalangeal osteolysis, a feature not previously recognized, supporting longitudinal skeletal monitoring.

40287849.takeaway: A review finds HNF4A and HNF1A loss-of-function variants can cause diazoxide-responsive hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, so MODY genes should be considered in persistent neonatal hypoglycemia requiring intensive care.

40290040.takeaway: In the Utah Population Database of 92,405 Hashimoto thyroiditis probands, first-degree relatives were at increased risk, and second- and third-degree relatives also were, suggesting an environmental component.

40290305.takeaway: Whole-exome sequencing of six patients with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis and familial controls identified variants, pointing to the GATA4 domain as a candidate for further study.

40290307.takeaway: In NHANES 2013 to 2016, ethylene oxide hemoglobin adducts were associated with sex hormones in most age groups, and the authors suggest it may act as an endocrine disruptor in adult males.

40290311.takeaway: A review of fertility preservation for gender-dysphoric youth notes that puberty blockers and cross-sex hormones complicate it, with little evidence on long-term reproductive harms.

40294339.takeaway: Seven children aged 3 to 60 months developed iatrogenic Cushing syndrome with adrenal insufficiency from topical clobetasol, with HPA axis recovery in a median of 6 months.

40294346.takeaway: A systematic review suggests that obesity at diagnosis of childhood leukemia is associated with worse outcomes in some studies, though the mechanisms linking adipose tissue to leukemia are unclear.

40294444.takeaway: In girls with Turner syndrome, an infant FSH above 37.4 mIU/mL predicted absence of later spontaneous thelarche with 97% accuracy and of menarche with 100% accuracy.

40294628.takeaway: In 1,595 ALSPAC adolescents followed for seven years, persistent hyperglycemia and worsening insulin resistance were associated with greater cardiac damage, largely explained by increased fat mass.

40296186.takeaway: A review describes sex differences in benign adrenocortical tumors, with cortisol-producing adenomas and mild autonomous cortisol secretion more common in women and mouse studies suggesting a protective role of androgens in males.

40296768.takeaway: Two siblings with harderoporphyria from biallelic CPOX variants had primary adrenal insufficiency suggestive of combined CYP11A1 and CYP11B1 deficiency, a mixed mitochondrial steroidogenic defect.

40297175.takeaway: Global thyroid cancer incidence among adolescents and young adults aged 15 to 39 rose 150% from 1990 to 2021, with females and lower-resource regions most affected.

40297176.takeaway: In the Bogalusa Heart Study, elevated childhood triglyceride-glucose index was associated with greater adult pre-hypertension risk in males and Caucasians, suggesting it may help identify higher-risk individuals.

40297179.takeaway: In 26 members of a four-generation Saudi family with X-linked hypophosphatemia, disease burden was high in those with delayed diagnosis and poor treatment adherence.

40300586.takeaway: An ESPE position statement reviews endocrine immune-related adverse events of checkpoint inhibitors in children, including adrenal insufficiency, diabetes, thyroid dysfunction and hypophysitis, and identifies knowledge gaps.

40302944.takeaway: Adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes had stiffer arteries and altered compliance and resistance than 45 matched healthy controls, suggesting premature vascular aging.

40302945.takeaway: In 127 Danish children with type 1 diabetes, elevated arterial stiffness was common and was associated with older age and lower time in range, independent of HbA1c.

40302946.takeaway: A systematic review and meta-analysis found little robust evidence that educational and psychoeducational self-management interventions improve HbA1c or quality of life in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes.

40302947.takeaway: Adolescents with type 1 diabetes who reported reviewing their retrospective glucose data had better HbA1c and time in range, and this review was not driven by fear of hypoglycemia.

40302948.takeaway: Among 631 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, elevated serum IgA was present in a subset with specific demographic and clinical features, suggesting a distinct pathogenesis in those individuals.

40302949.takeaway: Caregivers of children with new-onset type 1 diabetes and government insurance reported adverse social determinants that affected care, and preliminary data suggest community health workers can facilitate it.

40302950.takeaway: In 409 Australians diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in childhood, adolescent autonomic neuropathy and elevated albumin excretion predicted young-adult mortality, not glycemia, and mortality was over twice background in females.

40302951.takeaway: Patients with 6q24-related transient neonatal diabetes in remission should be able to check glucose and keep periodic diabetes follow-up, especially around puberty.

40302952.takeaway: Over 16 years in Sudan, neonatal diabetes was most often caused by EIF2AK3 mutations, a pattern similar to some Arab countries and different from Western and Asian populations.

40302953.takeaway: Scatter dose from X-ray or CT outside the field of view did not affect CGM accuracy during transmitter use, so children after total pancreatectomy could keep components in place during imaging.

40302954.takeaway: A review of insulin resistance in pediatric obesity covers mechanisms including lipid disorders, oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction, and treatment strategies aimed at improving insulin sensitivity.

40302955.takeaway: A review of autoimmune disorders in children with type 1 diabetes focuses on less common overlapping conditions, to help identify at-risk patients for treatment before complications.

40302956.takeaway: Forty-three interviews with young adults with type 1 diabetes and providers identified strengths, challenges and opportunities in transition care, and the potential role of digital technologies.

40302957.takeaway: A systematic review of parents of children with type 1 diabetes in the Middle East and North Africa finds psychosocial-spiritual distress and calls for culturally specific support and a new outcome measure.

40302958.takeaway: Capillary HbA1c percentiles from 4,615 Shanghai children aged 3 to 12 provide reference values for detecting abnormal HbA1c, and several factors were found to influence it.

40302959.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes at a Bordeaux hospital, both short-term individual deprivation and long-term area-level deprivation may partly explain poorer glycemic control over time.

40302960.takeaway: Among 7,143 children and adolescents in three urban Chinese cities, impaired fasting glucose was more prevalent than in earlier regional studies and was associated with obesity and higher triglycerides.

40302961.takeaway: A systematic review of transition interventions for adolescents with type 1 diabetes found mainly metabolic outcomes measured, limited psychological data, and no clearly effective theory-based model yet.

40302962.takeaway: A pilot multivariable risk model stratified children with type 1 diabetes into low, medium and high risk of acute healthcare use for severe hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia or DKA, with distinct times to admission.

40302963.takeaway: In 646 New Zealand children with type 1 diabetes, retinopathy was common, mostly low-grade, and rose in frequency until transfer to adult services, underscoring ongoing screening.

40302964.takeaway: In 2,195 European children aged 8 to 15, a late meal timing pattern was associated with higher insulin resistance, suggesting meal timing may influence insulin resistance from childhood.

40302965.takeaway: The ADAP agglutination-PCR assay detected islet autoantibodies in venous and capillary whole blood from 50 children with type 1 diabetes and 50 controls, with performance comparable to RIA and ELISA.

40302966.takeaway: A meta-analysis of randomized trials found SGLT2 inhibitors effective for glycemic control in children, adolescents and young adults with type 2 diabetes, without more adverse or serious events.

40302967.takeaway: Across 75 studies, type 1 diabetes incidence in European children under 15 varied substantially between countries and showed a worrying upward trend in most countries from 1994 to 2022.

40302968.takeaway: Youth aged 12 to 25 with high HbA1c who started advanced hybrid closed-loop therapy were satisfied with improved glucose, but persistent diabetes burden limited how well they used the system.

40302969.takeaway: In a post hoc analysis of high-risk relatives with low first-phase insulin release, oral insulin showed an early favorable effect on combined glucose and C-peptide endpoints after one year.

40302970.takeaway: A new Type 1 Diabetes Screening Acceptability Assessment scale showed sound psychometric properties in the general population, capturing key elements of acceptability for child screening.

40302971.takeaway: After a specialized children's hospital and expanded diabetes service were introduced, more frequent team contact was associated with improved glycemic control in children with type 1 diabetes.

40302972.takeaway: In 121 Chinese children with monogenic congenital hyperinsulinism, KATP variants were most common, and non-surgical treatment may suit most, with surgery considered for neonatal-onset cases with KATP variants.

40302973.takeaway: In a New South Wales inception cohort of childhood-onset type 1 diabetes, mortality exceeded that of the general population, with higher risk in females and in socioeconomically disadvantaged areas.

40302974.takeaway: An 8-week virtual food skills program was delivered to 43 children aged 6 to 14 with type 1 diabetes, and the authors suggest similar programs may support long-term food skills for self-management.

40302975.takeaway: Interviews with 38 parents found that the benefits of UK paediatric type 1 diabetes screening need clear communication to support uptake, with parents wanting peer support and counselling after testing.

40302976.takeaway: In SEARCH incident cohorts of youth under 20, cardiovascular risk factors improved more often in those with type 1 diabetes, while youth with type 2 diabetes showed worsening BMI z-score, CRP and kidney function.

40302977.takeaway: Among 357 young people admitted to a Northern Australian hospital, diabetes complications were more common with type 2 than type 1 diabetes, including microalbuminuria with an adjusted odds ratio of 4.8.

40303000.takeaway: In 31 youth with classical CAH and 36 matched controls, higher hydrocortisone doses and dexamethasone use were associated with higher Children's Depression Inventory scores.

40303234.takeaway: Three months on the tubeless Omnipod 5 system improved several psychosocial outcomes for 125 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes and their caregivers, independent of baseline and glycemic changes.

40303235.takeaway: In 307 children with type 1 diabetes monitored with routine creatinine, eGFR trajectories challenged the view that kidney function stays stable in childhood, supporting systematic monitoring.

40303236.takeaway: Across 12 PECARN centers, children presenting with DKA differed by demographics, and the authors call for early diagnosis and recurrence prevention in low-socioeconomic groups and closer monitoring of young children.

40303237.takeaway: In 286 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c predicted femoral intima-media thickness but not carotid or popliteal thickness, suggesting femoral thickness may be an early marker of hyperglycemia-related atherosclerosis.

40303238.takeaway: In youth with cystic fibrosis, a 1-hour OGTT glucose of at least 140 mg/dL was an early indicator of 5-year CFRD risk, while the 2-hour value better predicted lung function decline.

40303239.takeaway: In Finnish children with HLA-conferred risk, islet autoantibodies appearing by age 0.5 years became less common across birth cohorts from 1994 to 2019.

40303240.takeaway: A meta-analysis found that the COVID-19 pandemic raised new-onset type 1 diabetes incidence in children and the prevalence of ketoacidosis at diagnosis, markedly increasing the number of children with DKA.

40303241.takeaway: Canadian national surveillance found that childhood-onset type 2 diabetes incidence rose significantly between 2006 to 2008 and 2017 to 2019, with a doubling in Asian children.

40303242.takeaway: Among 255 children and young people with type 1 diabetes using flash monitoring, hypoglycemia awareness changed over two years for a significant proportion, and those trending toward impaired awareness were younger.

40303243.takeaway: In the CITY trial follow-up, adolescents and young adults using continuous glucose monitoring for up to 52 weeks reported improvements in self-reported diabetes and monitoring measures.

40303244.takeaway: COVID-19 in youth with type 1 diabetes was associated with a trend toward worse outcomes that was not statistically significant, and the authors recommend continued monitoring.

40303245.takeaway: An international survey of pediatric diabetes professionals found many lack confidence in exercise counseling for youth with type 1 diabetes, with physically active minutes often under-prescribed.

40303246.takeaway: In a prospective Israeli cohort of 51 children with new type 1 diabetes and 182 controls, SARS-CoV-2 antibodies were assessed, and the authors recommend follow-up because autoimmunity can emerge years after infection.

40303247.takeaway: In 46 youth after total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation, diabetes-related quality of life worsened over two years, mostly in symptom scores, and was similar to new-onset type 1 diabetes at two years.

40303248.takeaway: Among 188 youth with type 1 diabetes using high technology, race remained a significant predictor of glycemic outcomes after adjusting for age, diabetes duration, sex, insurance and insulin delivery type.

40303249.takeaway: A review of 18 metabolomics and lipidomics studies in childhood type 1 diabetes found significant metabolic changes in high-risk and diagnosed children compared with controls, pointing to candidate prognostic biomarkers.

40303250.takeaway: In Haitian youth with type 1 diabetes aged 8 to 25, activity did not affect HbA1c or quality of life, but shorter sleep was associated with higher HbA1c in those with HbA1c below 14%.

40303251.takeaway: In 262 children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, medication-induced diabetes during induction was linked to older age, higher BMI and prednisone, and high-risk regimens caused more complications.

40303252.takeaway: In a large SWEET registry cohort, a higher basal share of total insulin was associated with lower HbA1c and younger age, with no significant difference between CGM and pump technologies.

40303253.takeaway: The study links the availability of psychological care across 112 SWEET centers to patient HbA1c, supporting mental healthcare within multidisciplinary pediatric diabetes teams.

40303254.takeaway: Among parents of 882 children with type 1 diabetes, perceptions of responsibility sharing differed markedly, unemployment rose after diagnosis, and gender differences extended to parents' occupational life.

40303255.takeaway: Multiparametric MRI of 31 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, compared with 29 controls, tracked pancreatic function over the first year, supporting MRI for understanding T1D heterogeneity.

40303256.takeaway: Compared with 97 adolescents without diabetes, 100 adolescents with type 1 diabetes had higher blood pressure, abnormal lipids, endothelial dysfunction and, in boys, cardiac structural changes.

40303257.takeaway: In 1,461 youth with type 1 diabetes, neighborhood deprivation and other social determinants were associated with device use, HbA1c and DKA, suggesting care plans should address them to increase technology uptake.

40303258.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes starting Control-IQ, HbA1c fell within 12 months in both minority and nonminority youth, more reached the target below 7%, and racial disparities persisted.

40303259.takeaway: Six months of intermittently scanned CGM did not change objective or subjective sleep measures in adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes and high HbA1c.

40303260.takeaway: A systematic mapping review found the many quality-of-life instruments used in children with diabetes a substantial barrier to establishing comparable evidence.

40303261.takeaway: In 63 youths with type 1 diabetes transitioning to adult care, lower diabetes distress was associated with greater transition readiness, suggesting that targeting distress could improve readiness.

40303262.takeaway: Thirty kindergarten and school teachers described their knowledge, emotions and approaches to type 1 diabetes, and saw roles beyond medical tasks, such as tutoring peers about health awareness.

40303263.takeaway: In a Jordanian retrospective comparison, 112 newly diagnosed children in an early structured dietary education program had lower HbA1c at 6 and 12 months than those given conventional education, but not at 24 months.

40303264.takeaway: Depression-screen somatic items such as sleep and fatigue were compared between adolescents with type 1 diabetes and matched primary-care adolescents, supporting closer study of where these symptoms originate.

40303265.takeaway: In 460 Indian children with type 1 diabetes compared with 1,470 controls, growth was slower and puberty was delayed and extended, with greater HbA1c linked to more growth faltering, especially in girls.

40303266.takeaway: Youth with type 1 and type 2 diabetes on insulin who started CGM reported similar perceptions of CGM and similar quality-of-life measures, suggesting a similar management burden.

40303267.takeaway: In 59 youths starting Control-IQ in routine care, patient-reported measures improved and the impact of diabetes on daily life fell, while glycemic control also improved over 16 weeks.

40303268.takeaway: Among 55 families, more than half of children had stopped do-it-yourself real-time CGM at least three months after a trial, with 40% of those switching to commercial systems, and burdens contributing to discontinuation.

40303269.takeaway: The PAID-T diabetes distress scale was translated into Danish and, after cognitive interview feedback, found linguistically equivalent to the English original.

40303270.takeaway: Continued CGM over 12 months in the CITY extension, in 153 adolescents and young adults with suboptimal type 1 diabetes, supported earlier findings of better glycemic control and less hypoglycemia.

40303271.takeaway: Caregivers of 21 very young children with type 1 diabetes had no significant sleep differences between closed-loop and sensor-augmented pump therapy, though closed loop may be associated with better sleep quality in the primary caregiver.

40303272.takeaway: Austria's nationwide registry shows childhood type 1 diabetes incidence still rising, peaking in 2021, and a significant increase in pediatric type 2 diabetes for the first time.

40303273.takeaway: In 43 children on multiple daily injections, splitting an increased lunch insulin dose for mixed fat and protein meals improved late postprandial glucose, though extra insulin needs optimizing to limit hypoglycemia.

40303274.takeaway: In 136 parents of youth with type 1 diabetes, fear of nighttime hypoglycemia tracked with overnight glucose levels and variability, regardless of how often hypoglycemia occurred, suggesting screening for families with large variability.

40303275.takeaway: In 33 under-resourced adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes using rtCGM at least 70% of the time, diabetes-related emergency visits and costly events fell despite no short-term HbA1c reduction.
