40303276.takeaway: Compared with 23 healthy controls, 60 adolescents with type 1 diabetes had lower corneal nerve fiber density and reduced ability to taste sweet, suggesting cranial nerve involvement.

40303277.takeaway: In children and young people with type 1 diabetes taught short bursts of moderate activity to lower high glucose between meals, glucose control improved without increasing hypoglycemia.

40303278.takeaway: In 48 Australian children with type 1 diabetes, three-day food records showed excessive saturated fat intake, highlighting the need for dietary interventions to reduce cardiovascular risk.

40303279.takeaway: An after-hours nurse triage line for pediatric diabetes patients accurately triaged calls and reduced physician burden, with use equal across races and insurance types, though language was a barrier.

40303632.takeaway: In 37 people with Prader-Willi syndrome, pubarche occurred early and progressed slowly while gonadarche timing was normal, regardless of genetic subtype or MKRN3 status.

40303643.takeaway: In a Riyadh retrospective cohort, liraglutide combined with lifestyle intervention was effective in obese adolescents, especially in the first 6 to 9 months, and continued lifestyle work is key to sustainability.

40303645.takeaway: Two Brazilian patients with GCK-MODY carried novel frameshift variants, and one, a 14-year-old, had atypical manifestations that extend the known phenotype.

40303937.takeaway: Adolescents with type 1 diabetes in northern West Bank, Palestine, reported health-related quality of life shaped by income, and the authors call for national strategies that address income-related gaps.

40303938.takeaway: A standardized follow-up model for poorly regulated children with type 1 diabetes in Denmark increased the share of well-regulated children and lowered mean HbA1c by about 0.8 percentage points.

40303939.takeaway: Most adolescents with type 2 diabetes surveyed reported significant diabetes distress, impaired well-being or depressive symptoms, and considerable unmet support needs.

40303940.takeaway: At a specialized summer camp, improvements in mental and psychosocial wellbeing among children with type 1 diabetes correlated directly with better diabetes management.

40303941.takeaway: Interviews with 15 adolescents and caregivers in Ghana identified inadequate diabetes education and poorly coordinated transitions, calling for structured, developmentally appropriate transition processes.

40303942.takeaway: In 88 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, weaker executive functioning was associated with poorer diabetes management and higher diabetes distress, in secondary analysis of pre-intervention data.

40303943.takeaway: In a pilot of five teen and young-adult drivers with type 1 diabetes, CGM data supported the ADA recommendation to start driving with glucose above 90 mg/dL.

40303944.takeaway: In Shanghai children with suspected MODY, genetic testing aided precise diagnosis, with GCK-MODY the most common type and INS variants a relatively large share.

40303945.takeaway: In 46 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, perfectionism mediated the link between sociocultural appearance attitudes and eating attitudes, pointing to perfectionism as a target for prevention.

40304146.takeaway: A meta-analysis of five studies links circulating amino acids with higher BMI and other obesity indicators in children, though longitudinal and interventional studies are needed.

40304147.takeaway: In prepubertal children with short stature followed from age 8 to 12, those who reached normal height showed the largest rise in skeletal muscle mass index, suggesting body composition may help predict catch-up growth.

40309435.takeaway: In rainbow trout, chronic crowding stress altered skeletal muscle gene expression and DNA methylation, offering insight into stress effects on growth in aquaculture.

40309443.takeaway: In prepubertal female rats, lesions of the dorsal or ventral hippocampus delayed puberty, follicular growth and sex steroid secretion, suggesting a stimulatory hippocampal input to the gonads.

40313484.takeaway: Eight Saudi patients with pycnodysostosis from a shared CTSK variant had craniofacial and skeletal deformities, and 7 of 8 had fractures, with osteomyelitis suggesting a more progressive course in some.

40313487.takeaway: In 5,245 Korean children, parental metabolic syndrome was associated with offspring metabolic components more strongly in boys than in girls, with the number of affected parents having a proportional effect in boys.

40313490.takeaway: Among 108 Saudi adolescents and adults with 21-hydroxylase CAH, long-term outcomes were generally favorable, but hormonal control and complications varied, underscoring the need for individualized glucocorticoid therapy.

40317185.takeaway: In 1,255 mother-father-offspring triads in an Arizona Indigenous community, parental metabolic syndrome components were associated with offspring cardiometabolic risk, most strongly in adolescence and between mothers and offspring.

40319506.takeaway: A review of familial hypercholesterolemia calls for early screening, genetic testing and lipid-lowering therapy, with a structured transition from pediatric to adult services to sustain adherence.

40320660.takeaway: A literature review finds growth hormone therapy in children with GH deficiency changes lipid profiles, carbohydrate metabolism and body composition, with increased diabetes risk and no blood pressure change.

40321172.takeaway: In a 46-year population-based Olmsted County cohort of 234 children with pituitary adenomas or cysts, most lesions were small, nonfunctioning and stable on long-term follow-up.

40322222.takeaway: Annual dietitian visits were suboptimal among 1,982 children with type 1 diabetes at one center from 2018 to 2022, with the greatest improvement among Hispanic patients, and dietitian follow-up may aid glycemic outcomes.

40324364.takeaway: In a randomized phase 3 trial of 110 treatment-naive Chinese children with GH deficiency, weekly somapacitan gave height velocity and safety comparable to daily GH, with reduced treatment burden.

40326775.takeaway: In adolescent boys with idiopathic short stature and bone age of 13 or older, combining an aromatase inhibitor with rhGH significantly increased adult height, with anastrozole showing greater effect and fewer adverse reactions.

40326779.takeaway: A 1.5-year-old girl with biallelic ACOX1 variants and pseudo-neonatal adrenoleukodystrophy had primary adrenal insufficiency, as did a cousin with non-CAH adrenal insufficiency from 7 months.

40331898.takeaway: In a Swedish questionnaire of 667 adults with type 1 diabetes, skin rash from diabetes devices was common and underdiagnosed, with only 4.5% of those with rash investigated for contact allergy.

40333328.takeaway: In a Belgian multicenter cohort of children and adolescents, one year of Control-IQ improved glycemic management and diabetes-related quality of life and reduced school and work absences.

40335041.takeaway: A review of myokines, including irisin, describes how exercise-released muscle factors act on bone, fat and brain, and their potential as therapeutic targets.

40335042.takeaway: A narrative review compares telerehabilitation with conventional rehabilitation for type 2 diabetes, finding telerehabilitation offers convenience and greater adherence through wearables, while equitable access remains a concern.

40335043.takeaway: In 34 patients with 46,XX DSD followed a median of 8.8 years, phenotypes varied widely, and the authors recommend long-term monitoring of puberty, fertility, gender identity and gonadal complications.

40335044.takeaway: In 41 children with differentiated thyroid cancer, persistent disease in ATA low-risk patients resolved after radioactive iodine, and 98% had no evidence of disease at last follow-up.

40335092.takeaway: In 64 newly diagnosed children at a Vietnamese tertiary center in 2023, diagnostic delays and ketoacidosis were common, supporting a satellite hospital network for earlier detection.

40335093.takeaway: In a pilot randomized trial of 34 young adults with type 1 diabetes, a brief online self-compassion program improved HbA1c but did not reduce diabetes distress.

40335094.takeaway: Among 79 Vietnamese children with simple virilizing 21-hydroxylase CAH, diagnosis was often late, so early genetic analysis is recommended, especially for newborn-screened children.

40335737.takeaway: A perspective reviews standard medical therapies for transgender and nonbinary youth, such as GnRH analogues and sex hormones, and discusses individualized options with their benefits and risks.

40335774.takeaway: A Delphi survey of 43 endocrinologists found consensus on GH deficiency diagnosis lower in pediatric practice, mainly on stimulation tests, with a stimulated GH cutoff below 5 µg/L consistent with severe deficiency in children.

40337988.takeaway: A provider-focused review summarizes closed-loop evidence in pregnancy with type 1 diabetes, noting mixed glycemic benefits and that these systems can reduce the burden of care for some people.

40337990.takeaway: In 40 critically ill hospitalized patients on IV insulin, Dexcom G6 Pro and FreeStyle Libre Pro sensors tended to underestimate glucose, and the authors suggest per-patient calibration and validation for inpatient use.

40338032.takeaway: Two toddlers with autism and new-onset type 1 diabetes presented with hyperglycemic hyperosmolar state, with developmental delay likely contributing to hyperosmolality from an inability to report thirst.

40338033.takeaway: Among 44 genetically confirmed MODY cases, GCK-MODY was most common, and 25% were autoantibody-positive, challenging the view that MODY is always autoantibody-negative.

40339132.takeaway: Among 334 Belgian women 3 to 7 years postpartum, normal-glucose-tolerant women with a glucose challenge value of 8.3 mmol/L or more had glucose intolerance risk similar to women with GDM.

40339133.takeaway: Young people with youth-onset type 2 diabetes showed alterations in executive functioning, language and visual processing on brain MRI compared with peers with obesity alone or healthy weight.

40341870.takeaway: In adolescents born to mothers with untreated suboptimal gestational thyroid function, white matter microstructure was altered, an effect that may be reversible with levothyroxine given in pregnancy.

40342179.takeaway: A survey of 158 UK clinicians found antithyroid drugs remain the preferred first-line Graves' therapy, consistent with global practice but contrary to NICE guidance.

40346784.takeaway: In 26 adolescents and adults with cystic fibrosis-related diabetes, the Omnipod 5 system was assessed over six months against baseline CGM data, with hypoglycemia experience possibly limiting sustained use.

40347237.takeaway: Among 3,967 autoantibody-positive relatives, predictive models were compared for performance, cost and participant time, identifying cost-minimizing options for tailoring risk screening.

40350797.takeaway: In 75 patients aged 16 to 86 with Cushing's disease treated with pituitary radiotherapy, late-night salivary cortisol was clinically equivalent to 24-hour urinary free cortisol for assessing remission.

40350803.takeaway: In a large Brazilian cohort with 17α-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency, prolonged hypoestrogenism delayed bone age and produced an extended growth phase, greater final heights and frequent eunuchoid appearance.

40357199.takeaway: A review describes teplizumab, the first approved disease-modifying therapy for type 1 diabetes, designed to delay progression to stage 3 in people aged 8 years and older with stage 2 disease.

40357206.takeaway: GBD 2021 data show cardiovascular deaths and disability-adjusted life years attributable to high body mass index, with global burden projected to keep rising through 2045.

40357209.takeaway: A multicomponent patient support program improved caregiver knowledge, beliefs and behaviors that affect growth hormone adherence across several countries, which may improve adherence and outcomes.

40357642.takeaway: A practical guide for obstetric providers presents a systematic approach to CGM interpretation in pregnancy and off-label use of commercial automated insulin delivery, weighing individualized risks and benefits.

40357670.takeaway: A financial model using visit data from 234 participants of a virtual diabetes clinic suggests care could be viable, though profitability depends on privately insured patients and excludes fixed clinic costs.

40364581.takeaway: A Society for Endocrinology guideline sets out assessment, biochemical work-up, dynamic testing and imaging for women with severe androgen excess, beyond the common PCOS cause.

40365140.takeaway: Among 6,111 U.S. adolescents without diabetes or prediabetes, the prevalence of hyperinsulinemia or insulin resistance increased substantially from 1999-2000 to 2017-2020.

40365229.takeaway: A GBD 2021 analysis quantifies type 2 diabetes burden attributable to secondhand smoke across 204 countries, with disparities by gender, age and socioeconomic context.

40366702.takeaway: Among 173 infants born before 32 weeks, metabolic bone disease at four weeks occurred in 15%, with birth weight a risk factor, but antenatal steroids were not associated with the diagnosis.

40370777.takeaway: A GBD analysis reports the global prevalence and disability-adjusted life years of Turner syndrome in children aged 0 to 14 from 1990 to 2021, to inform diagnosis and care planning.

40370785.takeaway: A narrative review covers endocrine consequences of childhood obesity, including insulin resistance and hyperinsulinemia, thyroid dysfunction and other hormonal changes.

40372381.takeaway: In the U.S. Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Patient Registry from 2003 to 2018, CFRD risk factors included enteric feeds and both low and high BMI, supporting tailored screening algorithms.

40377230.takeaway: Modified-release hydrocortisone 20 mg matched immediate-release hydrocortisone for cortisol exposure in 24 healthy men, and a twice-daily switch with about two-thirds of the dose at night was an effective protocol for CAH patients.

40378277.takeaway: In a feasibility randomized trial, a low-intensity diet aimed at lowering triglycerides in gestational diabetes was feasible and acceptable, with improved maternal diet and desirable birth weight, warranting a larger trial.

40380800.takeaway: In a single-center retrospective series of 10 pregnancies on supported open-source automated insulin delivery, target glycemia was reached, while neonatal hypoglycemia occurred in 4 of 10.

40383119.takeaway: An 11-year-old boy with Noonan syndrome from a PTPN11 variant, receiving growth hormone, developed a DNET and Hodgkin lymphoma, a co-occurrence not previously reported, supporting individualized cancer surveillance.

40383122.takeaway: A girl with vitamin D-dependent rickets type 2A had long-standing tertiary hyperparathyroidism that did not prevent rickets healing or normalization of hypophosphatemia.

40384348.takeaway: In 14 infants with idiopathic infantile hypercalcemia, genetic testing in nine found only common, non-pathogenic variants, and the authors advise monitoring PTH during prolonged low-calcium feeds.

40385354.takeaway: A patient-led international Congenital Hyperinsulinism Collaborative Research Network developed a prioritized research agenda aimed at timelier diagnosis, less burdensome treatment and access to expert care.

40387306.takeaway: A Nordic consensus statement calls for coordinated national growth surveillance, using repeated child health measurements to uncover social inequalities and evaluate obesity prevention.

40388117.takeaway: In 3,444 children, a high type 2 diabetes genetic risk score and in utero maternal hyperglycemia were independently associated with impaired glucose tolerance or T2D, and combined exposure raised prevalence to 15.9%.

40390455.takeaway: Salivary testosterone, androstenedione and 11-oxygenated androgens varied by age and sex in healthy children, and the authors describe 11-ketotestosterone's profile for the first time, calling for reference ranges.

40391007.takeaway: Among 89 Chinese children undergoing ovarian tissue cryopreservation through single-incision laparoscopy, the authors describe surgical technique, such as removing the whole small ovary while limiting thermal damage.

40391009.takeaway: In Trieste, stimulation tests showed a temporary surge in central precocious puberty diagnoses during the pandemic that subsided afterward, with diagnostic delays resolving.

40391015.takeaway: In consanguineous families with primary congenital hypothyroidism, TSHR variants were studied with extrathyroidal features, suggesting oligogenic inheritance may explain variable expressivity.

40393423.takeaway: In 26 children with neuroendocrine tumors, including pheochromocytoma, GEP-NETs and medullary thyroid carcinoma, early diagnosis, genetic testing and long-term follow-up were key, since genetic testing identifies comorbidities and at-risk relatives.

40393426.takeaway: A targeted review of childhood obesity epidemiology, socioeconomic determinants and costs concludes that it imposes a significant public health and economic burden, calling for multi-sectoral policy responses.

40393445.takeaway: In 1,846 children with genetic data, type 1 diabetes polygenic scores helped classify diabetes, and the authors say they already have clinical utility for accurate diagnosis.

40394920.takeaway: A panel of circulating growth-plate microRNAs in prepubertal children with GH deficiency changed during six months of GH treatment but did not correlate with growth outcomes.

40400261.takeaway: Among 235 children with suprasellar low-grade glioma, IGF-1 was often elevated, especially in younger children, those with NF1 or underweight, and the elevation often resolved without affecting final height or tumor progression.

40400262.takeaway: Over three years in REAL4, weekly somapacitan sustained efficacy and tolerability in 200 children with GH deficiency, and children switched from daily GH kept benefits for two years.

40401233.takeaway: In 32 children with genetically confirmed Prader-Willi syndrome, serum lipoprotein(a) and hs-CRP correlated with body composition and genetic subtype, supporting genetic subtyping at diagnosis.

40401659.takeaway: Among 20 girls, 10 with Turner syndrome, three years of GH improved height and growth rate, with growth better in GHD girls in the first year but no significant difference between groups later.

40402094.takeaway: Home dried blood spot C-peptide was feasible as an alternative to mixed-meal testing in new-onset type 1 diabetes, and stimulated values showed early prognostic utility for beta-cell decline, pending validation.

40402101.takeaway: Pancreas volume was smaller in type 1 and insulin-treated monogenic diabetes, and those using insulin had smaller pancreases than non-insulin users, supporting insulin deficiency as a major factor.

40402843.takeaway: In a randomized crossover trial of 32 adults with type 1 diabetes on open-source automated insulin delivery, a non-carbohydrate-counting meal bolus strategy prevented glycemic excursions and kept mean time in range above 70%.

40404936.takeaway: A review of endocrine-disrupting chemicals and female reproduction links exposure to abnormal puberty, impaired fertility, premature menopause and PCOS, while noting difficulty proving causality.

40405612.takeaway: In Türkiye's first year of nationwide neonatal CAH screening, false positives for 21-hydroxylase deficiency were high, and refined cut-offs could cut referrals sixfold and remove second-tier testing for 95% of infants.

40405969.takeaway: A review of vegan and vegetarian diets warns of both iodine deficiency and excess, especially for women of childbearing age and children, and offers practical advice for adequate intake.

40405970.takeaway: In 1,514 U.S. adolescents, a higher cardiometabolic index was associated with lower bone mineral density, with a 0.052 g/cm2 reduction at the femoral neck per unit increase.

40406224.takeaway: In 7,603 children in the DPV registry, remission after diagnosis was affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, with the authors suggesting altered autoimmune progression or access to care as possible reasons.

40406225.takeaway: In a prospective study of 102 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, higher ALT and GGT were associated with early cardiac autonomic nerve dysfunction, suggesting hepatic inflammation may worsen endothelial dysfunction.

40411825.takeaway: In 47 pancreas sections from Japanese fetuses to adolescents, cyclin A2, assisted by cyclin D2, was suggested to play a central role in perinatal beta-cell proliferation.

40413599.takeaway: In a pilot trial in a cardiothoracic ICU, a novel intravenous glucose monitoring system was accurate and safe in patients with and without diabetes.

40413613.takeaway: A perspective argues that sex-specific factors across puberty, pregnancy, menopause, lifestyle and insulin pharmacology are underrepresented in diabetes research and care, and calls for closing these evidence gaps.

40414205.takeaway: In adolescents with obesity, MRI-based liver fat and stiffness were linked to androgen levels, insulin sensitivity and inflammation, with testosterone associations differing in girls with and without PCOS.

40417941.takeaway: Maternal exercise, acute and habitual, changed the breast milk metabolome, and some exercise-altered milk metabolites correlated with infant adiposity gains.

40418172.takeaway: A structured child psychiatry follow-up model for 129 patients with differences of sex development was associated with greater emphasis on psychiatric support, and residents' training was subjectively improved.

40418653.takeaway: A UK national survey of families of children with congenital hyperinsulinism found they felt safer and perceived benefits from CGM across aspects of living with CHI, despite concerns about accuracy and device range.

40418764.takeaway: In 411 healthy preschoolers followed for a year, serum triglycerides within the normal range were negatively correlated with the 12-month increase in calcaneal bone mineral density.

40418773.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggests specific PCBs lead to earlier age at menarche, DBP delays it, and BPA leads to earlier voice change in boys, with BMI possibly mediating these effects.

40418781.takeaway: Among Danish children referred for obesity treatment, prediabetes prevalence depended on the definition used, and no single test was superior because each captured different cardiometabolic risks.

40418898.takeaway: A female newborn with recurrent hypoglycemia and a heterozygous FOXA2 deletion had dual etiology, combining hyperinsulinism with pituitary hormone deficiency, showing that these can coexist.

40420740.takeaway: A review proposes an outpatient copeptin stimulation test early in evaluating hypotonic polyuria in children, citing safety and cost-effectiveness, with a stimulated copeptin cutoff of 9.3 pmol/L in 20 children.

40420837.takeaway: Eight females with heterozygous SLC16A2 variants had variable neurocognitive impairment, behavioral problems and abnormal thyroid function tests, so such females should be tested for SLC16A2.

40421239.takeaway: GBD 2021 data show PCOS cases among females aged 10 to 24 rose by 56% to 59% from 1990 to 2021, with disparities by region and sociodemographic index.

40421244.takeaway: GBD data from 1990 to 2021 show the diabetes burden in India rising, with marked state-level variation and projections to 2031, calling for prevention and screening in high-burden states.

40421429.takeaway: Serum phoenixin-14 was associated with central precocious puberty in 156 girls, with an AUC of 0.695 and a 195.85 pg/mL cutoff giving 75% sensitivity and 69% specificity, a possible adjunct biomarker.

40421430.takeaway: In 6,464 U.S. NHANES participants, new waist-to-height ratio fat-mass cut points predicted liver steatosis and fibrosis better than BMI-based overweight or obesity categories.

40421901.takeaway: In Southwestern U.S. children with type 1 diabetes, a model identified risk and protective factors for severe and recurrent DKA, with repeat severe events concentrated in a high-risk group.

40424079.takeaway: In the BANDIT baricitinib trial, beta-cell function derived from routine clinical measures tracked treatment response and predicted benefit, suggesting simpler primary outcomes for future trials.

40424555.takeaway: New reference equations for thyroid volume that account for age, body weight and height reduce the prevalence of thyroid enlargement and could decrease overdiagnosis in German adults.

40424589.takeaway: Among 27 Dutch children with heterozygous NPR2 variants, most had mild features suggestive of skeletal dysplasia and a significant growth response during the first two years of growth hormone treatment.

40425523.takeaway: An 8-year-old boy with two years of persistent hypertension, first attributed to encephalitis, was found to have retroperitoneal paraganglioma after elevated urinary normetanephrines, showing the value of early biochemical testing.

40425531.takeaway: In a prospective study of 68 children undergoing GH stimulation testing, metabolomics revealed a distinct lipidomic profile in those with GH deficiency, a proof of concept needing larger validation.

40432243.takeaway: In 23 people with obesity after craniopharyngioma surgery, semaglutide produced significant weight loss, offering a viable option for hypothalamic obesity.

40432266.takeaway: A 14-year-old boy with Wolcott-Rallison syndrome from a novel variant presented with late-onset diabetes and acute liver failure, far later than the typical infant onset of this disorder.

40433847.takeaway: In a single-center UK retrospective study, hybrid closed loop started preconception or in pregnancy reduced HbA1c at three months and improved time in range by 15% to 20% within a week.

40433939.takeaway: Among 121 children who had thyroid surgery after FNA of suspicious nodules, Bethesda categories predicted malignancy at rates above those reported in comparable pediatric studies, so the authors propose more intensive evaluation.

40435301.takeaway: In 86 people with acquired partial lipodystrophy, metabolic comorbidities and drusen were common, with earlier onset of complications in those with C3 hypocomplementemia.

40438403.takeaway: A systematic review of GnRH agonists for transgender and gender-diverse adolescents finds long-term evidence limited, with skeletal health, reproductive outcomes and cancer risk uncertain.

40438903.takeaway: A pediatric endocrinology clinic built billing codes and workflows for a diabetes-educator-led remote patient monitoring program, which the authors suggest may support broader adoption of educator-led care.

40439625.takeaway: A review examines anoikis resistance, a form of cell-death evasion, as a mechanism of thyroid cancer metastasis and a potential therapeutic target.

40439773.takeaway: In relatives of people with type 1 diabetes screened and monitored at one Italian center, autoantibody screening combined with regular monitoring prevented diabetes-associated ketoacidosis at onset.

40440417.takeaway: A review of hypertonic sodium lactate examines its emerging therapeutic uses in neurology and cardiology, noting that large trials are needed to establish efficacy, dosing and long-term safety.

40440421.takeaway: Among children screened after the Fukushima accident, stable iodine intake was not associated with thyroid ultrasound findings, and single-dose stable iodine appeared to have minimal adverse effects.

40440520.takeaway: In 69 children with Silver-Russell syndrome, the duration of growth hormone treatment was the most critical factor for success, and gastrointestinal problems and central precocious puberty were common.

40441173.takeaway: In a single-center Swiss randomized trial, real-time CGM was compared with self-monitoring in pregnant women with gestational diabetes, with participants preferring rtCGM and the authors suggesting it could simplify GDM management.

40443355.takeaway: In 464 EPOCH children, GLP-1R polymorphisms modified the association between maternal gestational diabetes and offspring BMI growth, suggesting genetic susceptibility shapes this link.

40444234.takeaway: Using Polish National Health Fund data from 2013 to 2023, pseudohypoparathyroidism prevalence was 0.62 to 0.64 per 100,000 nationally and 1.11 to 1.47 in the Lodz region, and the authors urge broader calcium-phosphate testing.

40444240.takeaway: A review discusses microRNAs as potential early predictive biomarkers and treatment targets in type 1 diabetes, a field that currently lacks early markers beyond autoantibodies.

40444241.takeaway: Serum exosome proteomics in juvenile gout differed from juvenile hyperuricemia and oligoarticular JIA, with DPP4 and SERPIND1 uniquely elevated in gout, suggesting possible diagnostic markers.

40444808.takeaway: A 17-year-old male with HIST1H1E syndrome had short stature and multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies from pituitary hypoplasia, contrasting with the overgrowth typical of this syndrome.

40445735.takeaway: The L-dopa stimulation test was evaluated for detecting cortisol deficiency in children assessed for GH deficiency, and the authors suggest it may be useful but needs larger prospective validation.

40445776.takeaway: In a two-center randomized crossover trial of 24 adolescents with above-target HbA1c, fully closed-loop insulin delivery improved glucose outcomes compared with pump therapy with CGM, with no severe hypoglycemia or ketoacidosis.

40448557.takeaway: A new strip-based point-of-care blood glucose system met accuracy criteria across venous, arterial, capillary and neonatal samples in critical and non-critical care settings.

40448560.takeaway: The Cobas Pulse strip-based system was not altered by common interfering substances, skin disinfectants, extreme ascorbic acid or out-of-range hematocrit, supporting its use in hospital point-of-care testing.

40450157.takeaway: In 41,790 people with type 2 diabetes in routine primary care and hospital data, SGLT2 inhibitors reduced HbA1c more than sulfonylureas or DPP-4 inhibitors when added to metformin across subgroups.

40451143.takeaway: A survey of 243 endocrinologists in 23 countries found growing use of aromatase inhibitors for short stature or short predicted adult height, while long-term outcomes remain uncertain and need trials.

40453582.takeaway: In 50 neonates admitted with respiratory distress, adrenal steroid clusters linked suppressed steroidogenesis to higher risk of bronchopulmonary dysplasia, small-for-gestational-age status and mortality, and excess cortisol to intraventricular hemorrhage.

40454939.takeaway: A deep learning model trained on adult ultrasound images diagnosed thyroid cancer in 128 pediatric nodules with high performance, suggesting it may be applicable to children.

40455440.takeaway: In matched White and Black youth with type 1 diabetes starting Omnipod 5, automated insulin delivery narrowed glycemic gaps but did not close them completely, pointing to social determinants.

40455652.takeaway: In 60 mothers with type 1 diabetes, higher time in range was associated with lower risk of neonatal hypoglycemia below 2.2 mmol/L, supporting glucose optimization early in pregnancy.

40455934.takeaway: In a longitudinal study of 143 children with type 1 diabetes and 71 controls followed for 6 to 8 years, white matter differences persisted, and fractional anisotropy was reciprocally related to hyperglycemia.

40458112.takeaway: Nailfold capillaroscopy found significantly more microvascular changes in children with type 1 diabetes than in matched healthy controls, mostly associated with poor glycemic control, even without overt complications.

40458319.takeaway: In 110 Haitian youth with type 1 diabetes diagnosed within two years, idiopathic type 1 diabetes was common, a significant share retained C-peptide, and predisposing and protective HLA patterns were identified.

40459186.takeaway: Thiol-disulfide measures showed more oxidative stress in 21 patients with branched-chain organic acidemias than in controls, most markedly in MMA and PA.

40459373.takeaway: In a Turkish cohort, a founder LMNA variant caused mandibuloacral dysplasia with variable phenotypes, some with additional endocrine disorders.

40460856.takeaway: Females and Hispanic children had greater height deficits at short stature referral; an educational and EHR-alert intervention improved referral rates.

40460857.takeaway: In 243 healthy Malaysian preadolescents, most had normal bone density; the study provides population reference values for bone mass, turnover markers and the muscle-bone unit.

40464109.takeaway: In 33,159 adults, albumin-adjusted calcium reference intervals were age-dependent, with slightly higher upper limits than total calcium, which may reduce overdiagnosis of hypercalcemia.

40465453.takeaway: In 103 youth with recent-onset type 1 diabetes, CGM metrics correlated moderately with stimulated C-peptide, but not strongly enough to replace C-peptide in trials.

40465469.takeaway: After a 2010 change in GDM screening criteria in British Columbia, lifestyle-treated GDM rose immediately, while birth-weight outcomes did not change.

40465847.takeaway: GH excess occurred in 8.7% of children with NF1 and optic pathway glioma, all prepubertal; long-acting somatostatin analogues normalized IGF-1 and growth velocity in 6 of 7 treated patients.

40468996.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes followed for 2 years, higher handgrip strength, one-repetition maximum and muscle power were associated with greater bone mineral content and areal BMD.

40469440.takeaway: In 16 patients with lipodystrophy and lymphoma, the authors suggest the link reflects underlying disease rather than metreleptin pharmacology, though a drug effect cannot be excluded.

40469835.takeaway: Oral glyburide suspension gave long-term glycemic control in 27 patients with neonatal diabetes, mostly KCNJ11 carriers, with HbA1c decreasing nonsignificantly over follow-up.

40470728.takeaway: In 82 probands, TSHR-activating mutation hyperthyroidism was overt in all infantile and childhood onset cases, while one-third of adult onset cases were subclinical.

40472820.takeaway: This review describes how AI-driven clinical decision support, using CGM, pump and app data, may support personalized self-management and clinical prioritization in type 1 diabetes.

40475996.takeaway: This review summarizes how growth hormone deficiency and rhGH therapy affect carbohydrate, lipid and protein metabolism in children.

40478457.takeaway: In 347 youth starting automated insulin delivery, greater day-to-day variability in carbohydrate entries was associated with lower time in range; overall TIR was 75%.

40481674.takeaway: Biallelic CPOX variants in three unrelated patients caused primary adrenal insufficiency with 46,XY DSD, with reduced CPOX protein in one patient.

40485249.takeaway: Among 692 youth with type 1 diabetes, technology uptake in the first year varied by race/ethnicity and household structure, with lower uptake in youth from non-intact households.

40487758.takeaway: In a 10-year series of children with 46,XX testicular or ovotesticular DSD, most were assigned male, gonadal tumor risk markers were modest, and testosterone often normalized in adolescence.

40487764.takeaway: Among children under 21 with risk factors for low bone mass, up to 10.5% had low bone mass for age and 4.8% had undiagnosed or unknown childhood osteoporosis.

40490584.takeaway: CD4+ T cells from individuals with type 1 diabetes recognized nucleus-associated islet autoantigens MLH1 and NUP50, suggesting a systemic autoimmune component.

40491594.takeaway: This review examines adipokines in the pathogenesis of PCOS in adolescent girls, noting that menstrual disorders are more common when obesity coexists with PCOS.

40491595.takeaway: In male mice, short-term ingestion of sublethal microcystin-LR increased peripheral and central HPA axis activity without changing inflammatory markers.

40491596.takeaway: In a child with McCune Albright syndrome, one year of burosumab normalized phosphate and reduced ALP without significant adverse effects, though fibrous dysplasia partly progressed.

40492130.takeaway: Two children with campomelic dysplasia had variants in the same high-mobility-group domain of the gene, and these variants were associated with different sex phenotypes.

40494332.takeaway: Variants in a 15q26.1 TTTG microsatellite were a common genetic cause of congenital hypothyroidism with a thyroid gland in situ, with phenotypes including transient CH.

40494335.takeaway: Sex-steroid priming before GH testing was well tolerated, increased spontaneous nocturnal GH secretion and reduced divergent spontaneous and stimulated results in short children.

40494338.takeaway: In Swedish children with T1D, those with celiac disease at diagnosis had lower BMI-SDS for up to 5 years, while celiac status and timing did not affect glycemic control.

40496553.takeaway: In 8 children and 10 adults with osteogenesis imperfecta, denosumab was associated with vertebral remodeling and height gain in children, but children had rebound hypercalcemia.

40496564.takeaway: In young men, adult Leydig-cell capacity as measured by INSL3 was largely established by age 17, with early-life parameters important for later levels.

40496567.takeaway: In a 5-year-old boy with a testicular adenomatoid tumor, the affected testis showed compensatory 2.1-fold hypertrophy, and INHB and AMH monitoring can track testicular function.

40496818.takeaway: Suicide risk was higher in youth with type 2 than type 1 diabetes, and PHQ-9 item 9 was less sensitive than the ASQ for identifying risk in adolescents and young adults.

40496819.takeaway: Systematic review found socioeconomic, ethnic and education inequalities in CGM use among children with T1D, especially with limited reimbursement, though CGM benefits were similar across groups.

40498627.takeaway: In preterm newborns with a delayed TSH rise, a normal first screening sample can be a false negative, so a second dried blood spot is justified.

40501122.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl had PTHrP-related hypercalcemia from a juvenile fibroadenoma, showing that benign breast tumors can cause hypercalcemia in adolescents.

40503246.takeaway: In adolescents with type 1 diabetes, longer diabetes duration was associated with changes in taste and smell perception, with more misidentified bitter tastes than controls.

40503671.takeaway: In 87 Chinese children with PHP, PPHP or POH, molecular GNAS testing was highly specific, and clinical features overlapped between iPPSD2 and iPPSD3 subtypes.

40506054.takeaway: The revised ESE guideline gives a practical algorithm for aggressive pituitary tumours and pituitary carcinomas, with standardized reporting and guidance for special situations such as pregnancy.

40509916.takeaway: In 314 Japanese people with type 1 diabetes, progression to β-cell depletion varied, and genetic and clinical factors, including the DR2 haplotype, predicted progression to insulin dependence.

40510014.takeaway: Screening 599 Chinese patients with congenital hypothyroidism expanded the DUOXA2 variant spectrum, and DUOXA2-mutated patients had milder disease with more often normal thyroid size.

40510464.takeaway: This review rebuts the 2024 Endocrine Society vitamin D guideline's one-size-fits-all advice for children and other groups, arguing for precision-medicine-guided screening and supplementation.

40510482.takeaway: In 52,027 euthyroid pregnancies, neonatal TSH was higher with advanced maternal age, preeclampsia, cesarean delivery and preterm birth.

40512774.takeaway: Older children and adolescents exposed in utero to gestational diabetes or a single abnormal glucose screen had higher obesity risk than those born to normoglycemic pregnancies, even after adjusting for maternal BMI.

40512811.takeaway: In Alström syndrome, boys had age-appropriate puberty onset, but almost all adult men had hypogonadism with primary gonadal failure.

40512822.takeaway: PHEX in the parathyroid gland may help set the serum phosphate threshold for PTH secretion, which could explain the high rate of hyperparathyroidism in X-linked hypophosphatemia.

40513101.takeaway: Biallelic POMC variants can cause combined pituitary hormone deficiency with severe early-onset obesity, so full POMC sequencing and evaluation of all pituitary axes are advised.

40513555.takeaway: In 160 mother-newborn pairs, free 25(OH)D may be more strongly associated with early-life growth parameters than total 25(OH)D.

40513556.takeaway: A 20-month-old boy with HMGCL deficiency presented with hypoketotic hypoglycemia and metabolic acidosis; he had no further crises after diagnosis, and early multidisciplinary care is advised.

40514045.takeaway: MMP13-related metaphyseal dysplasia can mimic rickets, with short stature, genu varum and metaphyseal changes despite normal biochemistry, so it belongs in the differential diagnosis.

40515610.takeaway: Machine learning on 24-hour urine steroid profiles predicted treatment control in children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, reaching an AUC of 0.90 when clinical variables were added.

40517764.takeaway: In a national cohort of childhood brain tumor survivors, endocrine disorders were highly prevalent, especially after suprasellar or posterior fossa tumors or radiotherapy, supporting ongoing monitoring.

40520848.takeaway: This Taiwanese consensus calls for risk assessment, early detection and tailored intervention for pediatric MASLD, which is driven by rising childhood obesity; no pharmacological treatment is approved for children.

40522816.takeaway: This review summarizes how psychological and physical stress affect hypothalamic-pituitary-thyroid function, and how childhood adversity and stress can raise the risk of thyroid disorders.

40522925.takeaway: In early adolescents, maternal thyroid function in early pregnancy was associated with gray matter morphology in certain regions, notably the frontal lobe.

40523371.takeaway: Evidence for MEN1-associated endocrine tumour treatments is very low quality; dopamine agonists appear to work for prolactinomas in MEN1 as well as in patients without MEN1.

40523372.takeaway: This international MEN1 guideline gives 55 clinical recommendations, built on systematic reviews and Delphi consensus, for assessing and managing MEN1 in adults and children.

40523943.takeaway: This review describes how youth-onset obesity and diabetes are rising globally, with heavier burdens in low- and middle-income countries, calling for early prevention and culturally tailored care.

40523944.takeaway: In 564 mother-child pairs, maternal overweight and gestational diabetes were each independently and jointly associated with steeper offspring adiposity gain from birth to early adolescence.

40527292.takeaway: This review describes how polygenic risk scores and lifestyle factors interact in childhood obesity, and argues that gene-environment understanding should guide equitable early intervention.

40529824.takeaway: A postpubertal patient with Turner syndrome had empty sella syndrome and pituitary dysfunction, showing that hypopituitarism can occur in Turner syndrome, with uncertain etiology.

40529832.takeaway: In a 13-year-old with early-stage 3 type 1 diabetes, 9 months of hybrid closed-loop use kept time in range above 80% with low insulin doses and no severe hypoglycemia or DKA.

40529833.takeaway: In adolescents with PCOS, triglyceride-to-HDL ratio and HDL profiles suggested a metabolic predisposition independent of obesity, supporting early metabolic monitoring; the findings are preliminary.

40531210.takeaway: In 8 adults with type 1 diabetes, exercise in cool water did not lower blood glucose more than thermoneutral water or land exercise, though glucose rose during on-land recovery.

40534206.takeaway: In two children with treatment-induced neuropathy of diabetes, caudal epidural steroid injection appeared to give durable pain relief, but larger studies are needed.

40534546.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with juvenile-onset diabetes and multisystem features had a novel homozygous DNAJC3 variant, expanding the phenotype of this monogenic syndromic diabetes.

40535332.takeaway: A scoping review of 45 studies compiled human genes linked to ovulatory dysfunction and infertility, providing a candidate list for genetic panels in assisted reproduction.

40535340.takeaway: Among Chinese women aged 18-45, the number of inactivated COVID-19 vaccine doses, the interval since vaccination and the manufacturer did not affect AMH levels.

40536030.takeaway: In pediatric common variable immunodeficiency, endocrinopathies were prevalent, particularly autoimmune thyroiditis, and about 41% had elevated parathormone suggestive of secondary hyperparathyroidism.

40538800.takeaway: In Chinese children and adolescents, higher IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 levels were negatively associated with metabolic abnormalities, a link that matters especially in adolescence.

40538808.takeaway: After pre-pump class, race and insurance were associated with starting an insulin pump rather than staying on injections, while automated insulin delivery outperformed non-AID pumps.

40539033.takeaway: Focus groups of 84 children and adolescents with T1D identified physical, material, care-organization and psychological concerns, offering a new tool to estimate treatment burden.

40544822.takeaway: In 75 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, a higher urinary uromodulin-to-NGAL ratio may be linked to reduced acute kidney injury risk, while uromodulin alone was not associated with AKI.

40544834.takeaway: In 19 hospitalized children with clinically diagnosed SIADH, copeptin above 8.0 pmol/L correlated with the diagnosis, though some SIADH cases had normal copeptin.

40544835.takeaway: The ADECA course trained a pool of competent paediatric diabetes nurse educators in sub-Saharan Africa and can be adapted for other low-income countries.

40544853.takeaway: In children aged 2-6 with type 1 diabetes, automated insulin delivery was non-inferior to manual mode for time in range, with better TIR and HbA1c in auto mode and acceptable safety.

40547523.takeaway: In gestational diabetes pregnancies, thyroid dysfunction was associated with higher risks of preterm birth, hypertensive disease and fetal overgrowth, supporting combined thyroid and glucose screening.

40548874.takeaway: In 120 youth with type 1 diabetes followed for 24 months, TIR below 45% or glucose CV of 41% or more roughly doubled the rate of severe hypoglycemia, while no CGM metric predicted DKA.

40549505.takeaway: Childhood glucose-trajectory subclasses stratified later risk of abnormal glucose tolerance in adolescence and young adulthood, and the subclasses were linked to maternal cardiometabolic disorders.

40550217.takeaway: In children under 6 with diabetes, automated insulin delivery with standard or diluted insulin kept time below 3.9 mmol/L under 4%, with no DKA or severe hypoglycaemia.

40550223.takeaway: Among 154 children with salt-wasting CAH, 9% needed very low glucocorticoid doses from early childhood and achieved good control, forming a distinct subgroup.

40554497.takeaway: Gliadin-reactive T cells were found in the gut mucosa of children with type 1 diabetes only when celiac disease was present, arguing against a pathogenic role of intestinal gluten immunity in T1D.

40554608.takeaway: In a racially and ethnically diverse pediatric MODY cohort, the guideline criteria based on an affected parent and lack of typical features may not apply well to US children with diabetes.

40554621.takeaway: Among 203 Portuguese patients with GH deficiency, gene panel and exome testing identified causes in some, but a significant proportion remained genetically undiagnosed.

40554803.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with Graves disease had transient worsening of thyrotoxic myopathy after starting methimazole and metoprolol, so drug side effects should be considered.

40555215.takeaway: This international guideline covers diagnosis and management of endocrine complications in children with alpha and beta thalassemia, with screening from age 10 for TD thalassemia and from age 11 for non-TD forms.

40555243.takeaway: In Chinese adults with overweight or obesity, once-weekly ecnoglutide produced superior and sustained weight reduction versus placebo, with a favourable safety profile.

40555795.takeaway: This Pituitary Society consensus gives recommendations on endocrine, neurosurgical, ophthalmic and imaging evaluation of incidental sellar lesions such as macroadenomas, microadenomas, cystic lesions and empty sella.

40556826.takeaway: In 1,424 patients with anaplastic thyroid carcinoma from SEER, a conditional-survival nomogram was developed and validated to predict survival probability for patients who have already survived some time.

40556970.takeaway: In 108 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, some purposes of social media use were positively associated with physical activity, healthy eating and interpersonal relationships; the authors advise monitoring use.

40557842.takeaway: New height-velocity reference centiles for German children were presented, and modified growth-referral criteria significantly increased specificity for evaluating short stature.

40560659.takeaway: Updated recommendations cover pediatric surveillance for multiple endocrine neoplasia syndromes, hyperparathyroidism-jaw tumor syndrome and Carney complex, reflecting genotype-phenotype knowledge since 2017.

40568560.takeaway: This narrative review examines the lack of a consensus definition for metabolic syndrome in children, along with its epidemiology, pathophysiology and management, and urges clearer guidelines.

40570829.takeaway: The IDEAL 12-week virtual program has trained 177 pediatric diabetes educators in low-resource settings and can serve as a model for similar programs.

40574354.takeaway: ESHRE's 44 good-practice recommendations address testicular tissue cryopreservation for prepubertal boys and adolescents receiving gonadotoxic therapy, covering eligibility, counselling and procedures.

40575257.takeaway: A new chemiluminescent immunoassay detected T3 and T4 autoantibodies in human serum; they were elevated in patients on immune checkpoint blockade and can interfere with thyroid hormone measurements.

40575266.takeaway: In 52 peri-menarcheal adolescents, psychological symptoms were associated with PCOS risk factors, suggesting high-risk adolescents may already have psychological vulnerability before diagnosis.

40575267.takeaway: Methylation and expression profiling of adamantinomatous craniopharyngioma identified gene sets, including a 212-gene and a 37-gene panel, linked to progression-free survival and possibly useful for tumor classification.

40576296.takeaway: In 91 adults with classic CAH on long-term modified-release hydrocortisone, doses fell and then stabilized with improved biochemical control, and adrenal crises were below prior reports.

40576382.takeaway: In healthy adults, the long-acting Fc-fused growth hormone GB08 was assessed for safety and pharmacokinetics, and modelling suggested 0.8 mg/kg as the optimal pediatric dose for phase 2.

40577229.takeaway: In 29 women with functional hypothalamic amenorrhea, 12 weeks of transdermal estradiol raised serum estradiol but did not improve vascular or psychological measures.

40577853.takeaway: In 110 children with adrenocortical tumors, a small subset had prolonged endocrine symptoms, possibly reflecting gradual tumor evolution, which supports early recognition.

40578837.takeaway: In 44 girls near menarche, daughters of women with PCOS showed ovulatory and neuroendocrine dysregulation, while girls with obesity had adiposity-related androgen excess.

40578839.takeaway: In paediatric differentiated thyroid cancer, autoimmune thyroiditis was present in 16% of patients and was associated with less distant metastasis, with a tendency to better event-free survival.

40579638.takeaway: In the UK Millennium Cohort, South Asian and Black African/Caribbean children had more body fat at age 7 than White children, linked to adverse early-life growth and lower socioeconomic position.

40583576.takeaway: Among adolescents with overweight or obesity in primary care, prediabetes was considerably more prevalent in Asian and Pacific Islander adolescents than in non-Hispanic White adolescents, independent of BMI.

40585060.takeaway: Parents of children with T1D in China reported more diabetes-specific distress than parents of adolescents, with fathers of lower education and higher anxiety and stress most affected.

40585887.takeaway: Empagliflozin reduced HbA1c versus placebo in drug-naive youth with type 2 diabetes, with a smaller effect in adolescents than in young adults, and no new safety signals.

40587656.takeaway: In children aged 10 to 14, cord blood methylation at the CDH13 locus was associated with adiponectin levels, supporting adiponectin as a marker of adverse metabolic health in youth.

40589506.takeaway: In 265 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, poor glycaemic control early in pregnancy was linked to lower birth weight, while poor third-trimester control was linked to higher birth weight.

40589510.takeaway: Adolescents with type 2 diabetes and their caregivers reported more stressors, functioning concerns and intensive care needs than adolescents with other chronic illnesses or none.

40589517.takeaway: The authors propose a molecular diagnostic algorithm for Chinese children with brachydactyly type E, based on genotype-phenotype correlations across isolated and syndromic presentations.

40589586.takeaway: Evidence on lower-limb neuropathy and vasculopathy in children with diabetes is limited by inconsistent assessment and reporting, though complications may appear before age 18.

40590663.takeaway: In newly diagnosed youth with T1D, time in range improved in the 24 hours after physical activity compared with sedentary days; each structured exercise education session was associated with a further 0.79% TIR increase.

40591205.takeaway: An Italian expert consensus recommends lifelong multidisciplinary care for X-linked hypophosphatemia, notes burosumab is effective and safe in children and adults, and calls for revised reimbursement criteria.

40592766.takeaway: In adolescent girls with elevated androgens, androgen elevation did not change the frequency of depression or anxiety, though the authors note conflicting prior evidence.

40598692.takeaway: Patients with KMT2A-related Wiedemann-Steiner syndrome may have favourable height responses to rhGH, and height gain did not differ between GH-deficient and non-deficient patients.

40599335.takeaway: This narrative mini-review identifies two foundational integrated care models for childhood obesity and calls for further study, adaptation and funding of such models with relevant outcome measures.

40599336.takeaway: In a Swiss population-based study of children born 2000 to 2019, sex chromosome DSD was underreported due to late diagnosis, while 46,XX CAH prevalence matched newborn screening data.

40599338.takeaway: In pediatric NTRK fusion-positive papillary thyroid cancer, larotrectinib showed a redifferentiation effect, and a drug holiday after stopping it did not cause significant progression.

40599339.takeaway: Among 58 transfeminine adolescents in a national cohort, the share choosing semen cryopreservation before hormone therapy was comparable to other publicly funded countries, and semen quality was impaired.

40599715.takeaway: In a qualitative study, adolescents with T1D valued peer support from in-person events, supporting codesigned, tailored education and transition services.

40600011.takeaway: This review describes how adipose tissue expansion and fat distribution signal energy status to the reproductive axis, linking childhood BMI gain and obesity to pubertal timing and later reproductive health.

40602377.takeaway: This review gives pragmatic guidance on long-term outpatient management of arginine vasopressin deficiency in neonates and infants, noting the best option varies by patient, family and over time.

40602383.takeaway: In a Turkish nationwide cohort of children with VDDR1A, four common mutations explained about 81% of cases, and no clear phenotype-genotype relationship was found.

40602781.takeaway: This clinical review uses two cases to show how molecular testing, patient autonomy and psychosocial support shape DSD care, with individualized shared decision-making suited to local resources.

40603555.takeaway: In a Hong Kong birth cohort, maternal glucose during pregnancy was associated with offspring metabolic health and adiposity at 18 years, in a graded way across the full glucose range.

40607214.takeaway: In a South Korean nationwide cohort of clinically suspected MEN1, patients had a substantial clinical burden, particularly with multiorgan involvement, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance.

40607219.takeaway: In a patient with perinatal hypophosphatasia, the standard asfotase alfa dose did not adequately treat skeletal disease, suggesting some perinatal patients need individualized higher doses.

40607221.takeaway: A 6-year-old boy with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism had a de novo retrotransposon insertion in FGFR1, a novel mechanism that calls for genomic analysis when short-read testing is negative.

40607224.takeaway: In children with T1D of at least one year, betatrophin correlated positively with C-peptide and negatively with BMI, suggesting betatrophin may be a biomarker of residual β-cell function.

40607228.takeaway: In 630 adults in Medina, Saudi Arabia, body composition differed by sex and age between people with and without type 2 diabetes, supporting tailored prevention and management.

40607229.takeaway: In critically ill children, stress hyperglycemia was linked to poor outcomes only when accompanied by hyperlactatemia, suggesting glucose targets should consider lactate.

40607230.takeaway: This protocol describes a planned study comparing cognitive training plus social interaction with standard intensive health behaviour treatment in children with overweight, estimating leptin sensitivity as an outcome.

40607634.takeaway: Postpartum CGM after gestational diabetes had high completion and acceptability, percent time in range predicted OGTT results, and 94% of participants preferred CGM to OGTT.

40607635.takeaway: In 42 adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, a self-adapting closed-loop algorithm that needs no meal announcement was feasible, with clinical benefit most apparent after full adaptation.

40609522.takeaway: A case of congenital hyperinsulinism due to HNF1A deficiency showed liver and kidney involvement, a possible link that needs confirmation in more cases.

40612706.takeaway: In new-onset pediatric T1D, severe hypertriglyceridemia varied in presentation and was linked to complications such as acute pancreatitis; early screening in protracted abdominal pain is suggested.

40620480.takeaway: In 192 pediatric differentiated thyroid cancer patients, distant metastases were common, and larger tumor size and extrathyroidal extension predicted them.

40620481.takeaway: In 646 Norwegian girls aged 6 to 16, weight-related measures were consistently associated with breast development and menarche but not pubarche, showing complex links between reproductive hormones and weight.

40620793.takeaway: An age-stratified AMH nomogram from 22,920 women gives age-specific reference values for ovarian reserve, with a sharp decline in AMH after age 36.

40621613.takeaway: In 129 children with idiopathic short stature and low IGF-1, rhGH treatment, selected by the IGF-1 generation test, produced a good response, better than predicted for ISS.

40622132.takeaway: For children with central precocious puberty, the Bayley-Pinneau method agreed most strongly with final height, and the simpler BAPCPHE method was also accurate.

40624806.takeaway: Obese and nonobese women with PCOS had similar hormonal profiles and insulin resistance, while both groups had more hepatic fat and insulin resistance than BMI-matched healthy controls.

40624912.takeaway: This narrative review describes how to reduce hallucinations and improve reliability when using large language models in medical research, emphasizing verification and human oversight.

40624913.takeaway: Lower gestational age and lower levothyroxine dose at 18 months predicted transient congenital hypothyroidism, suggesting some children could stop treatment before age 3.

40624914.takeaway: Female childhood acute leukemia survivors had low AMH versus age-adjusted reference ranges with normal FSH and LH; AMH may not be beneficial below a cumulative cyclophosphamide dose of 5,400 mg/m².

40624915.takeaway: In 114 children born small for gestational age, rhGH significantly improved height SDS in both preterm and full-term children, regardless of gestational age.

40624916.takeaway: In an adolescent with pancreatitis-related diabetes on parenteral nutrition, a fully closed-loop system kept glucose stable without hypoglycemia during transition to enteral feeding.

40626687.takeaway: In a real-world registry of children with severe primary IGF-1 deficiency, rhIGF-1 improved near-adult height, and treatment-naive patients gained more height.

40629940.takeaway: In a nationally representative survey of 12,100 Indian women aged 18 to 40, biochemical hyperandrogenism and subclinical hypothyroidism were among the most prevalent endocrine dysfunctions.

40629970.takeaway: In 60 girls aged 6 to 8 with GnRH-dependent precocious puberty, one height prediction method showed less bias with bone age advancement than Bayley-Pinneau, and residual growth may be overestimated at diagnosis.

40632462.takeaway: Two patients with SHOX duplications had short stature and extremity anomalies, showing SHOX duplications should be considered alongside other genetic causes of idiopathic short stature.

40632508.takeaway: Young Turkish adults gained 1.8 cm in final height over two decades, while 58% of young men were overweight or obese, supporting updated growth charts and obesity prevention.

40632818.takeaway: In TrialNet participants, genetic risk, mainly from HLA class II, influenced transitions through preclinical stages of T1D, supporting use of a T1D genetic risk score to predict progression.

40632944.takeaway: In 384 patients after total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation, pre-procedure HbA1c strongly predicted insulin independence, islet function and HbA1c below 7% at one year.

40635559.takeaway: Testicular adrenal rest tumors were an important complication in Indonesian boys with 21-hydroxylase deficiency presenting before or during puberty, linked to pubertal age and longstanding poor hormonal control.

40635581.takeaway: In an Italian multicenter cohort, organic central precocious puberty was marked by younger age, faster progression and higher gonadotropins, with LH peak above 9.1 mIU/mL and growth velocity above 1.75 SD as key markers.

40635651.takeaway: Youth with T1D in the 4T extension cohort sustained HbA1c improvements over 3 years, with 68% meeting the <7.5% target versus 37% of historical controls.

40642512.takeaway: In real-world use of advanced hybrid closed-loop systems in young children with T1D, glycaemic control improved significantly over one year without increasing hypoglycaemia risk.

40643384.takeaway: A preterm female neonate had secondary pseudohypoaldosteronism with hyponatremia, hyperkalemia and metabolic acidosis without urinary tract disease, illustrating the need for early recognition.

40651488.takeaway: Across 8 million parent-child triads in China, parental preconception BMI was studied for adverse birth outcomes, and the authors conclude a healthy weight for both parents before pregnancy is key.

40652449.takeaway: A systematic review of 17 studies underpinning the Endocrine Society guideline on preexisting diabetes in pregnancy found no significant perinatal complication difference with periconceptional GLP-1 receptor agonists.

40652450.takeaway: The joint Endocrine Society and ESE guideline for preexisting diabetes in pregnancy stresses preconception care, strict glycemic goals and emerging technology to reduce maternal and perinatal harm.

40652453.takeaway: The joint Endocrine Society and ESE guideline for preexisting diabetes in pregnancy stresses preconception care, strict glycemic goals and emerging technology to reduce maternal and perinatal harm.

40655315.takeaway: In 47 children with type 1 diabetes and celiac disease, insulin needs and growth parameters were lower at celiac diagnosis; villous atrophy was linked to worse glycemic control at one year.

40655394.takeaway: Among 50,539 newborns screened in Putian, a TSH cut-off of 9.5 μIU/mL balanced sensitivity of 100% and specificity of 98.1%, with seasonal variation and preterm infants needing tailored protocols.

40655400.takeaway: Thyroid cancer incidence among women of child-bearing age rose from 1990 to 2021 while mortality and DALYs declined slightly, with large variation by socio-demographic index.

40655401.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with Gabriele-de Vries syndrome from a YY1 variant had Hashimoto thyroiditis and nanophthalmos, a previously unreported association, and thyroid and eye assessments are advised.

40655407.takeaway: In children, Graves disease with type 1 diabetes presented with fewer thyrotoxic symptoms and lower free T4 and TRAb levels, though remission rates did not differ from those without T1D.

40658480.takeaway: The updated Endocrine Society guideline gives a practical approach to identifying and managing primary aldosteronism, aiming to raise diagnosis rates and reduce cardiovascular events through targeted therapy.

40658805.takeaway: In newborn dried blood spots, 21-deoxycortisone was elevated in 52 of 53 CAH cases and in no false-positive specimens, making it a sensitive and specific screening marker.

40658807.takeaway: Across 23 US centers, new-onset youth-onset type 2 diabetes rose significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic, while type 1 diabetes frequency did not rise significantly after controlling for yearly trends.

40660807.takeaway: In a Turkish cohort with L-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria, treated patients reported significant symptom improvement, and the disorder was more common where consanguineous marriage is prevalent.

40661739.takeaway: In children with cerebral palsy and other neuromotor impairments, long bones were smaller and thinner though cortical mineralization was not impaired, likely explaining their higher fracture risk.

40662594.takeaway: In youth with T1D, about 9.6 days of CGM data gave a reliable assessment of glycemia, and 7 days may suffice for youth with TIR of 70% or higher and CV below 36%.

40665778.takeaway: This commentary calls for a nationwide recycling process for used insulin pens in Germany, focusing on the pens themselves rather than packaging, in cooperation with manufacturers.

40666058.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease data show diabetes deaths and age-standardized mortality rose since 1990, and the rising type 2 burden calls for prevention targeting obesity and diet.

40668134.takeaway: In osteopetrorickets, a rare disorder of paradoxical rickets, early diagnosis and bone marrow transplantation are key, and high-dose calcitriol with cautious calcium may improve outcomes.

40668408.takeaway: This review explains how genomic advances have improved understanding of monogenic diabetes, highlights under-representation of non-European ancestries, and discusses newborn screening and emerging treatments.

40671911.takeaway: Among 389 children with transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia, low IGF-1 and hypogonadism were risk factors for low bone mass and higher BMI was protective, in the uncorrected model.

40671913.takeaway: In rats, sympathectomy increased osteoblast proliferation and bone formation in cranial fracture models, and [99mTc]Tc-MDP SPECT/CT could quantify this change.

40671914.takeaway: In females with Gaucher disease, a cytokine signature including CD40L, APRIL and MCP-4 suggested ongoing immune-aging inflammation may contribute to early-onset osteoporosis.

40674006.takeaway: Among 1,997 people followed 36 years from childhood, normal BMI in childhood that progressed to overweight in adulthood raised midlife cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic risk; resolved childhood overweight carried similar risk to persistently normal BMI.

40678313.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease data show 674 million people had chronic kidney disease in 2021, with burden shaped by regional inequalities and risk factors such as blood pressure and BMI.

40678318.takeaway: In 88 full-term neonates with mild hyperthyrotropinemia, most TSH elevations were transient, persistent cases occurred in 5.7%, and levothyroxine at 3-5 µg/kg/day was safe, with normal neurodevelopment at age 3.

40680105.takeaway: In 38 adults and adolescents with T1D, enabling the Omnipod 5 Activity feature before exercise reduced insulin delivery and attenuated glucose drops, but hypoglycemia rates did not differ.

40681324.takeaway: In 50 adolescents and young adults with T1D starting U200 concentrated insulin in automated insulin delivery, cartridge changes became less frequent and no severe hypoglycemia or DKA occurred over a median of 290 days.

40682375.takeaway: A girl with a JAGN1 mutation and immunodeficiency later developed atypical insulin-dependent diabetes, suggesting a possible link worth considering in combined immune and metabolic disorders.

40684755.takeaway: This review explains how childhood obesity alters growth and puberty and how it affects GH stimulation test results, noting that weight-adjusted cutoffs have not been validated.

40684769.takeaway: A height-gain prediction model from mid-puberty was validated for rhGH-treated boys with idiopathic isolated GHD but was not reliable for girls, so it may help decide on continuing rhGH in boys.

40685667.takeaway: This scoping review finds socially assistive robots for diabetes care are methodologically limited and mostly studied in younger people, calling for adult studies with adequate power.

40690536.takeaway: In a statewide Victorian cohort, maternal diabetes in pregnancy was not associated with developmental vulnerability or a clinically meaningful difference in school-age educational outcomes.

40692160.takeaway: In 41 adolescents with Graves disease, trabecular bone score was low at diagnosis and improved but stayed below zero at follow-up, with higher free T4 impairing the improvement.

40693816.takeaway: A child with a growth-hormone-secreting macroadenoma from a novel AIP variant responded to somatostatin analogue therapy after surgery, with IGF-1 normalizing within a year.

40694360.takeaway: This ACR-led practice parameter gives guidance on oral I-131 sodium iodide therapy for benign and malignant thyroid disease, covering procedures, precautions and special situations.

40694568.takeaway: Among 235,709 TrialNet relatives, autoantibody-positive adults had progression patterns distinct from children, and HbA1c and risk indices identified progressors better in adults, suggesting tailored monitoring.

40698417.takeaway: A systematic review found CGM offers advantages over self-monitoring of blood glucose in gestational diabetes by providing continuous real-time data that enables timely treatment adjustments.

40704143.takeaway: In 67 children with congenital hyperinsulinism, thrombosis was a potential complication of central venous catheter placement, supporting early screening and preventive strategies.

40704149.takeaway: A school-based campaign in 350 Italian schools combining sport, Olympic values and education was reported as well accepted and a scalable approach to preventing childhood obesity.

40705030.takeaway: In 145 human pancreata from 60 donors, insulin-positive single cells and small clusters were lost before large islets during type 1 diabetes development, suggesting smaller endocrine units are more susceptible.

40705853.takeaway: In 34 children and adolescents with Cushing disease who received conformal radiotherapy, remission rates were favourable with fewer new hypopituitarism cases, though relapse occurred in one-fourth.

40705962.takeaway: Two related patients with congenital hyperinsulinism from a new HADH mutation had increased pancreatic GLP-1 receptor uptake on imaging, a finding that warrants further research.

40706606.takeaway: Insulin-deficient diabetes in children and young adults in three sub-Saharan African countries appears to include non-autoimmune cases, so alternative causes must be considered in this group.

40709404.takeaway: In 181 children with neurofibromatosis type 1, puberty disorders and growth hormone deficiency were the most frequent endocrine manifestations, even in children without optic pathway glioma.

40711834.takeaway: In a 55-year-old man with type 1 diabetes on automated insulin delivery, continuous ketone monitoring gave early warning of impending DKA, allowing treatment without hospitalization.

40711947.takeaway: Over 24 months of Control-IQ use, daily carbohydrate announcements fell from 132 to 100 g/day while time in range slipped only from 61% to 58%, suggesting sustained effectiveness.

40711975.takeaway: A specialized diabetes team on medical units was linked to hypoglycemia falling from 17.6% to 8.8%, shorter length of stay and fewer readmissions for hyperglycemia.

40712097.takeaway: In children at high risk of T1D, DNA methylation smoke-exposure scores were inversely associated with islet autoimmunity and T1D, supporting an in utero smoke exposure link with lower risk.

40712645.takeaway: In overweight or obese adults with T1D, 12 months of adjunctive semaglutide was safe and well tolerated, produced significant weight loss and improved glycemic control, and reduced MASLD prevalence.

40717045.takeaway: Four members of a family with a novel NR0B1 (DAX1) variant had varying ages and symptoms of adrenal insufficiency, so male relatives with such a family history should be tested genetically.

40717801.takeaway: In Taiwan, children conceived by assisted reproduction had higher risks of some adverse health outcomes, but the choice of fresh or frozen and cleavage or blastocyst transfer had minimal impact.

40719244.takeaway: Children with metabolically healthy or unhealthy obesity both had higher myocardial performance index and carotid intima-media thickness than healthy controls, with no difference between the obesity groups.

40719607.takeaway: In adults with T1D on an AHCL system, faster-acting insulin aspart and higher-fat meals may improve postprandial glycaemia, with the highest time in range after high-fat, low-protein meals.

40720214.takeaway: In 100 adults with diabetes, most found the reusable DuraTouch pen injector very easy to use and easy to learn, regardless of prior pen experience, suggesting it is a viable alternative.

40720580.takeaway: Adult men aged 29 to 48 with a history of central precocious puberty, treated or untreated, had health outcomes similar to matched controls across reproductive, metabolic, emotional and oncological domains.

40726485.takeaway: In adolescents and young adults with Klinefelter syndrome, views on testosterone and infertility varied, and many reacted negatively, wanting to learn that there are many ways to have children.

40726969.takeaway: In NSW children, DKA at type 1 diabetes diagnosis was common and costly, with a rate that did not improve over 18 years, and DKA roughly doubled costs per person.

40727905.takeaway: In a child with isolated ACTH deficiency from a TBX19 variant diagnosed in the neonatal period, early hydrocortisone was essential for survival without sequelae.

40727953.takeaway: Among 819 publicly insured adults with T2D, telemedicine visits had significantly lower no-show rates and comparable glycemic control compared with in-person visits.

40729435.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with familial glucocorticoid deficiency type 1 had a homozygous MC2R promoter deletion caused by uniparental disomy, missed by initial exome sequencing, underscoring the value of copy-number and non-coding analysis.

40730104.takeaway: In a randomized trial of pregnant people with gestational diabetes, real-time CGM plus capillary testing gave significantly higher time in range than capillary monitoring alone.

40730138.takeaway: This protocol describes a multicenter prospective cohort seeking early biomarkers to identify children with premature adrenarche whose long-term metabolic and PCOS risks warrant intervention.

40730197.takeaway: This review argues that treating obesity can lead to remission of youth-onset type 2 diabetes, citing bariatric surgery with significant 3- and 10-year remission rates, and calls for more pediatric studies.

40735853.takeaway: In a 218-patient cohort with pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma, about 67% of malignant cases had favourable outcomes with multimodal treatment, and tumor size could not accurately predict metastases.

40737224.takeaway: In a multicenter pediatric differentiated thyroid carcinoma cohort, T4 tumor stage, lymph node uptake on whole-body scan and gross extrathyroidal extension independently predicted persistent disease.

40739992.takeaway: A meta-analysis found obesity and overweight were associated with increased risk of early puberty in boys, suggesting childhood obesity is an important determinant of earlier pubertal onset.

40741174.takeaway: This review examines endogenous determinants of glucocorticoid sensitivity in preterm newborns, such as gestational age and fetal sex, and their implications for disease risk and glucocorticoid therapy.

40741228.takeaway: In children with newly diagnosed T1D in Greater Poland, the prevalence of diabetic ketoacidosis at onset rose between 2006–2014 and 2015–2023, a concerning trend requiring early intervention.

40741667.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl developed severe lipoatrophy from repeated somatrogon injections at one site, which resolved after 10 weeks off treatment, suggesting a reversible side effect.

40741920.takeaway: In three pediatric cases of glycerol kinase deficiency, pseudohypertriglyceridemia mimicked primary hyperlipidemia; urinary glycerol analysis and absence of serum lipemia help avoid unnecessary treatment.

40742290.takeaway: In a crossover pilot RCT in people with T1D, the Hedia bolus calculator with an exercise feature appeared safe during moderate exercise, with fewer adverse events than usual insulin management.

40742303.takeaway: In a randomized trial of children aged 2 to 12 with new-onset T1D, six months of high-dose vitamin D raised partial remission rates to 59% versus 19% and may preserve residual β-cell function.

40745070.takeaway: In 83 youths with T1D followed for 2 years, less sedentary time and better sleep and physical activity patterns were associated with greater metabolic stability, measured by HbA1c and glucose.

40746173.takeaway: Children with diabetes and a non-autoimmune extra-pancreatic feature should be considered for monogenic testing, with islet-autoantibody and T1D genetic risk scores helping prioritize testing.
