40746184.takeaway: This review proposes a management algorithm for acquired hypothalamic dysfunction, emphasizing that consequences go beyond obesity to include hypopituitarism, adipsia, circadian and behavioural changes.

40746619.takeaway: This clinical guideline for women with prior gestational diabetes and their children emphasizes lifestyle changes, breastfeeding and periodic glucose-tolerance screening to prevent type 2 diabetes.

40751096.takeaway: In young adults with non-autoimmune diabetes in Assam, India, many were not overweight and were beta cell-deficient, a thin-fat phenotype the authors link to multigenerational undernutrition.

40754784.takeaway: This review explains the physiological changes across pregnancy and postpartum and discusses what they mean for using and designing automated insulin delivery systems.

40755394.takeaway: This review summarizes how climate change, through heat, air pollution and extreme events, affects reproductive processes and outcomes, and outlines mitigation strategies.

40756505.takeaway: A lightweight deep learning system for bone age assessment using the Chinese 05 standard is proposed to reduce subjectivity and improve efficiency in children.

40759089.takeaway: A 2.5-year-old girl with acquired generalized lipodystrophy had a prominent autoimmune phenotype and negative targeted gene sequencing, raising the possibility of a novel recessive variant.

40763708.takeaway: A scoping review of 18 studies found that pediatric-to-adult transition in congenital adrenal hyperplasia has gaps and high rates of care dropout, supporting structured transition programs.

40763714.takeaway: In two families with CUL3-related neurodevelopmental disorder, growth retardation occurred, and two children with short stature responded well to growth hormone treatment.

40766295.takeaway: Three Saudi patients with 46,XY DSD carried novel or known DHX37 variants, with phenotypes from complete testicular regression to partial gonadal dysgenesis, supporting whole-exome sequencing.

40768246.takeaway: In 289 children with congenital hypothyroidism in Istanbul, initial TSH values and the LT4 dose at 6 months distinguished transient from permanent disease; doses below 3.6 µg/kg/day suggested transient CH.

40768556.takeaway: In children with SRD5A2 deficiency, hCG stimulation testing appeared less sensitive than urinary steroid profiling, which suggested the deficiency in all patients tested.

40771274.takeaway: Donor sperm pregnancies had better outcomes for severe male infertility but higher risks of preeclampsia and pregnancy-induced hypertension than partner sperm pregnancies.

40771275.takeaway: This review explains how impaired N-glycosylation affects several endocrine axes in PMM2-CDG, the most common glycosylation disorder, with adrenal insufficiency probably underdiagnosed.

40772687.takeaway: In a pilot of transgender youth on GnRH analogues, psychological well-being stayed stable over 12 months, though youth and caregivers reported more challenges than the general population at baseline.

40772806.takeaway: In a retrospective Israeli cohort, children with stress hyperglycemia in the emergency department had markedly higher odds of later type 1 diabetes, supporting close follow-up and possibly advanced testing.

40776789.takeaway: In a child with insulinoma, endoscopic ultrasonography detected a small pancreatic tumor after hypoglycemia triggered by fasting or exercise, and the child remained free of recurrence over two years.

40777921.takeaway: In WFS1-associated disease, protein topology of variants may influence β-cell and urological defects, and three variants of uncertain significance were shown to be pathogenic.

40778272.takeaway: In 12,087 Chinese children aged 7 to 17, the triglyceride-glucose index and METS-IR showed strong linear relationships with three hypertension phenotypes, suggesting they may aid primary prevention.

40780817.takeaway: In adults with T1D, the investigational SteadiSet infusion set showed high 7-day survival for its primary endpoint with acceptable early removal, and average time in range was 70.6%.

40781566.takeaway: Parents of children with type 1 diabetes in Sweden had lasting income declines versus matched controls, and parental benefits eased only the short-term loss of mothers' income.

40785225.takeaway: FGF21 levels in glycogen storage disease with liver involvement were comparable to acute fatty liver disease, and GSD type IXc showed higher levels, suggesting FGF21 may flag more severe disease.

40785448.takeaway: In 51 diffuse sclerosing papillary thyroid cancers, RET fusions were linked to more aggressive behavior, and coexisting NTRK and TERT alterations may signal high-risk progression.

40785978.takeaway: A child with an activating AKT2 variant had hypoinsulinaemic hypoketotic hypoglycaemia with abnormal fat distribution, and continuous glucose monitoring helped diagnosis and follow-up.

40786596.takeaway: In 25 years of celiac screening in children with T1D, high celiac antibodies sometimes disappeared without disease, and the authors conclude screening is useful mainly in symptomatic children.

40791992.takeaway: In cord blood of very preterm infants, maternal type 2 diabetes was linked to higher insulin, IGF-1, HOMA-IR and AMH and lower adiponectin, suggesting an altered intrauterine environment.

40792561.takeaway: In healthy adults, CGM metrics correlated moderately with meal glycemic load, and a model using CGM data two hours after eating predicted glycemic load.

40793795.takeaway: In 90 Iranian girls with premature thelarche and 114 controls, higher urinary bisphenol A and some paraben levels were associated with greater odds of early breast development.

40794450.takeaway: This review argues adipose tissue is a prime target for research into insulin resistance and biomarkers of childhood-onset obesity, and calls for more pediatric adipose studies in mice and humans.

40794607.takeaway: This review summarizes evolving treatment of thyroid eye disease, including teprotumumab targeting the IGF-1 receptor, and calls for better risk stratification and multidisciplinary, patient-centered care.

40794653.takeaway: In South Korean girls with Turner syndrome, hypothyroidism risk was about 45 times that of the general population before age 10, supporting early thyroid function and antibody screening.

40794735.takeaway: In Japanese children aged 2 and 4 years, particulate matter exposure had only a very weak association with thyroid hormone levels, which the authors judge too small to matter clinically.

40795275.takeaway: A meta-analysis of diet trials in type 1 diabetes found heterogeneous evidence rarely stratified by participant characteristics, and calls for randomized trials of specific diets.

40795401.takeaway: In 101 young people with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, higher glucocorticoid doses were linked to lower leptin, and lower adiponectin tracked with higher androgens, suggesting it may mark metabolic risk.

40796279.takeaway: In 27 boys with delayed puberty over 6 months, testosterone produced greater bone mineral accrual than letrozole at metabolically active sites, while short letrozole treatment did not appear to harm bone.

40798828.takeaway: Girls under 10 with early menarche had no more psychological or behavioural problems than healthy controls, so GnRH analogue therapy should not be based on assumed psychosocial harm.

40799104.takeaway: In 165 patients with 46,XY DSD, FSH, stimulated testosterone/androstenedione ratio, ASI and LH were key discriminators for etiological diagnosis, while traditional cut-offs had limited utility.

40801028.takeaway: In a Lebanese tertiary hospital, adrenal incidentalomas were about as common as worldwide, but only 5.4% of patients were referred to endocrinologists for hormonal testing.

40801038.takeaway: A GBD analysis of childhood type 1 diabetes in China found girls had higher incidence, mortality and underdiagnosis rates than boys, prompting calls to reduce underdiagnosis and improve management.

40802196.takeaway: In a 24-week RCT of children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, mHealth-supported resistance training reduced insulin requirements and improved muscular strength without increasing adverse glycemic events.

40803363.takeaway: A Spanish model of 1,000 patients with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes on basal insulin estimated that FreeStyle Libre saves about €2 million a year versus self-monitoring, through fewer events and complications.

40803367.takeaway: In adult ICU patients, Dexcom G6 Pro sensors were less accurate than previously reported and tended to read high, though similar results appeared outside the ICU, pointing to a sensor effect.

40803607.takeaway: In newly diagnosed children and adolescents aged 10 to 16, insulin requirements more than doubled over 48 months on hybrid closed-loop therapy, with high day-to-day variability, supporting closed-loop use from diagnosis.

40810071.takeaway: In 1,072 adults with bipolar disorder, risk factors for fatty liver in lean patients included higher fasting glucose, triglycerides and GGT, female sex and diabetes, while higher HDL was protective.

40810200.takeaway: In 26 patients with bilateral macronodular adrenal disease, malignant neoplasms were prevalent among ARMC5-altered individuals, supporting genetic screening and continuous monitoring.

40810440.takeaway: In Black-ancestry adolescents and adults, a persistent-increase OGTT glucose shape was linked to higher inflammatory markers and lower adiponectin, with stronger associations in adults.

40820509.takeaway: In 201 transgender adolescents, body composition responses depended on pubertal stage: trans girls gained fat mainly during puberty suppression, while trans boys in puberty responded more to hormone therapy.

40820604.takeaway: In children with hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets with hypercalciuria, the diagnosis was missed when initial biochemistry was normal, so repeat testing is needed when clinical suspicion stays strong.

40820605.takeaway: An 11-year-old girl with Carney complex and prior pontine glioma developed Cushing syndrome from pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease, showing the atypical course that can delay diagnosis.

40822299.takeaway: A PBPK and pharmacodynamic model for henagliflozin supported pediatric dosing from 1 month to 18 years, with exposures comparable to adult patients receiving 5 to 10 mg.

40822943.takeaway: In 61 children with 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, obesity appeared to be influenced mainly by psychotropic medication rather than the syndrome itself, so metabolic screening and cautious prescribing are advised.

40822950.takeaway: In 223 patients with early-onset obesity in Belgium, a substantial share of genetic findings lay in genes for recessive conditions, and the authors urge expert genetic testing for obesity.

40822956.takeaway: In very low birth weight preterm infants, daily 800 IU vitamin D supplementation was associated with higher bone mineral density by DEXA at discharge, supporting its use for bone mineralization.

40824839.takeaway: In youths and adults with T1D using the MiniMed 780G with a disposable sensor, glycemic outcomes improved compared with run-in, with two severe hypoglycemia events and one non-device-related DKA.

40827087.takeaway: In 77 prepubertal children with Silver-Russell syndrome, two years of growth hormone raised height and nutritional status, with greater height gain when treatment began before age 4.

40827106.takeaway: In 115 patients with rare endocrine diseases, a joint pediatric-adult transition consultation at a French reference centre was associated with high satisfaction and good long-term follow-up.

40827356.takeaway: In a large cohort with 11β-hydroxylase deficiency, a recurrent deep intronic CYP11B1 splice variant was identified, showing that intronic screening with functional testing avoids diagnostic failure.

40828811.takeaway: In young children with persistent multiple islet autoimmunity, CGM metrics varied considerably within each child over time, so further research is needed before interpreting them in presymptomatic T1D.

40832941.takeaway: A 2-year-old girl with a hormone-active ovarian steroid cell tumor presented with virilization and precocious puberty, and after surgery she was followed without chemotherapy for 18 months.

40833006.takeaway: In 46 children with obesity, 12 weeks of supervised in-person or virtual combined training both improved cardiometabolic health, with virtual training giving a greater reduction in diastolic blood pressure.

40834241.takeaway: Nineteen cord blood DNA methylation markers linked to maternal hyperglycemia improved prediction of offspring β-cell dysfunction at ages 7, 11 and 18 beyond clinical factors alone.

40836563.takeaway: A 12-year-old boy with LEPR-related monogenic obesity developed dysplastic nevi during setmelanotide treatment, raising concern about MC1R-mediated melanocytic activity; therapy was temporarily stopped.

40836564.takeaway: Two children with both maple syrup urine disease and type 1 diabetes needed dietary plans balancing strict branched-chain amino acid restriction with carbohydrate counting, managed by a multidisciplinary team.

40838687.takeaway: In 138 children and adolescents tested for pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, plasma free and 24-hour urinary fractionated metanephrines were both reliable screening tests, with plasma useful for early noradrenergic tumour detection.

40842493.takeaway: International case discussions show how clinicians can promptly diagnose and manage children with lipodystrophy, and how challenges differ from adults during the transition to adult care.

40842494.takeaway: In Chinese patients with Turner syndrome, autoimmune thyroid disease risk was linked to karyotype, with isochromosome X raising risk and positive thyroid autoantibodies predicting thyroid dysfunction.

40842499.takeaway: A systematic review found CFTR modulators improved cystic fibrosis health and changed insulin secretion, but their role in preventing or reversing CF-related diabetes remains unclear.

40847542.takeaway: In a 24-year series of pediatric adrenocortical tumors, contrast-enhanced CT features, particularly percentage venous enhancement, may help distinguish adenomas from carcinomas.

40847549.takeaway: A 10-year-old girl with primary hyperparathyroidism from parathyroid carcinoma carried a CDC73 mutation, showing why early genetic testing matters for hyperparathyroidism-jaw tumor syndrome surveillance.

40852855.takeaway: In adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia, creatinine-based eGFR overestimated measured GFR, so annual cystatin C is recommended if chronic kidney disease is suspected.

40852975.takeaway: Pooled data from 12,629 individuals in 16 European cohorts produced the first leptin reference curves across age, weight and pubertal status, with an online tool for z-scores.

40853861.takeaway: In 11 patients with TRPM6-related hypomagnesemia, persistent severe secondary hypocalcemia was the prominent feature and could be life-threatening if not treated promptly.

40853921.takeaway: In 232 Japanese probands with suspected monogenic diabetes, actionable variants were identified, but neither classical criteria nor the MODY probability calculator detected all monogenic cases.

40854221.takeaway: Three normal-weight members of a consanguineous family with early-onset hepatic steatosis were homozygous for glucagon receptor variants causing near-complete loss of function, highlighting potential risks of GCGR antagonists.

40855734.takeaway: A systematic review found AI models show strong potential for predicting, screening and managing gestational diabetes, but broader validation, interpretability and prospective studies are needed.

40860013.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes, bladder and bowel dysfunction was a significant burden compared with healthy controls, supporting early identification and routine screening.

40860014.takeaway: In Ethiopian children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, autoantibodies for T1D, celiac disease and thyroid disease were notably common, resembling patterns seen in Caucasians.

40862089.takeaway: In 521 hand radiographs from children with growth or puberty disorders, two automated bone age programs agreed within human inter-rater variability, with BoneXpert more accurate in prepubertal children.

40862109.takeaway: In 701 at-risk newborns, glucose patterns and hypoglycemia risk differed by risk group, such as infants of diabetic mothers, supporting targeted screening protocols.

40862110.takeaway: This clinical review describes managing congenital hypothyroidism, which newborn screening has made largely mild, and suggests reassessing thyroid function from six months of age when L-thyroxine needs are low.

40862118.takeaway: In Graves hyperthyroidism, an iodine-rich herbal decoction improved free T3, free T4, TSH and TRAb levels compared with antithyroid drugs, with comparable efficacy duration and good safety in mild to moderate disease.

40862126.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease 2019 data show the incidence of type 2 diabetes-related chronic kidney disease rose from 1990 to 2019 in most regions and in China, with predicted increases through 2030.

40862130.takeaway: In 292 children with obesity followed for at least one year, a support vector machine performed best among eight machine learning models for predicting type 2 diabetes risk.

40865036.takeaway: Mendelian randomization and observational analyses linked several circulating metabolites causally to youth-onset type 2 diabetes, most notably phosphatidylcholine ae C42:3.

40873755.takeaway: Among 3,038 newly diagnosed children in Baden-Württemberg, a DKA awareness campaign showed a significant treatment effect, though DKA at onset rose in both participating and nonparticipating districts.

40873949.takeaway: Children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes performed worse on neurocognitive tests, particularly attention, than healthy peers, and poor metabolic control was linked to attention deficits.

40873952.takeaway: A meta-analysis of randomized trials found Tai Chi offers clinically meaningful benefits for managing type 2 diabetes, with future trials needed to examine age and sex differences.

40874738.takeaway: This review summarizes diabetic peripheral neuropathy in children with diabetes, where reported prevalence ranges from 3% to 62%, and stresses early identification of modifiable risk factors.

40874855.takeaway: In Turkish children with genetically confirmed heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, atorvastatin and pitavastatin were both safe and effective, but gaps remain in early diagnosis and follow-up.

40874867.takeaway: In Chinese hamster ovary cells, growth hormone increased expression from a 1036 bp SMN2 promoter construct, suggesting GH may be a candidate to enhance SMN expression in spinal muscular atrophy.

40875700.takeaway: In cord blood from 48 newborns, proteins associated with birth weight included a novel protein linked to left ventricular longitudinal strain, pointing to early programming of cardiovascular function.

40875711.takeaway: A survey of U.S. pediatric diabetes centers examined whether team-based T1D care is sustainable, and the authors propose telemedicine and remote models to support it.

40875734.takeaway: A prenatally diagnosed infant with autosomal dominant pseudohypoaldosteronism due to an NR3C2 mutation kept normal growth and sodium for 8 months after immediate oral salt therapy.

40876474.takeaway: In Swedish register data, people with type 1 diabetes had higher cardiovascular and mortality risk than those with type 2 diabetes, and managing all modifiable risk factors could help both groups.

40877213.takeaway: Using abatacept trial and TrialNet data, a binary one-year metabolic endpoint detected type 1 diabetes prevention treatment effects at least as well as standard endpoints with shorter follow-up.

40884153.takeaway: A meta-analysis found children with premature adrenarche are taller, heavier and have higher fasting insulin than healthy peers, though evidence is heterogeneous and based on small studies.

40884218.takeaway: A neonate with congenital hypopituitarism and midline abnormalities carried compound heterozygous ROBO1 variants, suggesting ROBO1 should be considered in genetic evaluation of such patients.

40888655.takeaway: An 8-year-old assigned female with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism later showed gender incongruence, raising challenges in pubertal induction after gonadectomy and calling for a non-coercive approach to decisions.

40888765.takeaway: In 233 children with Hashimoto thyroiditis followed at least three years, untreated patients showed no functional deterioration over five years, and autoantibodies fell by year five, supporting continuous monitoring.

40890050.takeaway: In 250 pediatric thyroid cancer patients, an interpretable machine learning model predicted early recurrence or nonremission, with younger age, high postoperative thyroglobulin and distant metastases as the strongest predictors.

40891584.takeaway: Four AI chatbots answered nine parent questions about short stature, with Bard giving the most useful guidance, Copilot the most accuracy and ChatGPT the most informative answers.

40891960.takeaway: In young adults with autoimmune Addison disease, sleep impairment was as common as in controls, but its association with poorer physical health was stronger in patients.

40895619.takeaway: Adolescent competitive swimmers had higher IGF-1, calcium and vitamin D than non-sport peers, and training load was negatively associated with aBMD, though inflammatory markers did not explain this.

40895628.takeaway: In 60 sporadic papillary thyroid carcinomas, the 20 in children and adolescents were more aggressive, with larger tumors and more nodal metastases, particularly with RET fusions or BRAF V600E plus other mutations.

40895631.takeaway: In 227 patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma treated by thermal ablation, digital pathology supported extending the ablation margin by 2.5 mm, regardless of tumor stage, to lower local recurrence risk.

40896819.takeaway: Proinflammatory cytokines increased nSMase2 and ceramide-enriched β-cell extracellular vesicles, and ceramide species were also enriched in plasma extracellular vesicles from people with type 1 diabetes.

40897432.takeaway: Across more than 97,000 participants, low CGM coverage days were linked to lower time in range, so low-coverage days may cause TIR to be systematically overestimated.

40897504.takeaway: In hereditary medullary thyroid carcinoma, the RET C634R mutation was linked to greater tumor aggressiveness and poorer disease-specific survival than other C634 mutations.

40899010.takeaway: In girls, circulating miR-30b-5p levels followed HPG axis activity from minipuberty through puberty, while miR-155-5p rose in late puberty, suggesting regulatory roles on the axis.

40899768.takeaway: The Automated Oral Minimal Model tool reproduced manually derived insulin sensitivity and beta-cell responsivity results with high precision, while greatly reducing analysis time for large datasets.

40899799.takeaway: This review finds limited evidence for CGM and automated insulin delivery in hospitalized patients, particularly those with kidney failure, in pregnancy or on glucocorticoids, where they may offer an alternative.

40900178.takeaway: Glucose360 is an open-source Python platform and web app that integrates CGM data with food logs and computes glycemic variability metrics for individuals and researchers.

40902109.takeaway: In Victoria, Australia, preexisting diabetes was linked to higher stillbirth risk, particularly with macrosomic fetuses above the 97th centile, while gestational diabetes was linked to lower stillbirth risk.

40903014.takeaway: In Bardet-Biedl syndrome, setmelanotide treatment was associated with improved fatty liver disease independent of BMI reduction, and with increased glomerular filtration rate.

40904852.takeaway: Mauriac syndrome still occurs in Sudanese children with type 1 diabetes; it can be diagnosed clinically and reversed with good metabolic control.

40908825.takeaway: This review summarizes sex-specific cardiovascular risk factors, presentation, diagnosis and treatment in women across the lifespan, including hormonal changes and pregnancy, and highlights research gaps.

40910890.takeaway: In pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, extrapolated time in range above 50% was associated with lower risks of preterm birth, neonatal respiratory distress and large-for-gestational-age infants.

40910928.takeaway: A 7.7-year-old boy with CHARGE syndrome and a novel heterozygous intronic CHD7 variant also had complete growth hormone deficiency treated from 19 months, showing the value of early diagnosis.

40910939.takeaway: In real-world CamAPS FX users aged 1 to 90, personal glucose targets had age-dependent effects; very young children and young adults reached time in range above 70% only with targets below the default.

40911547.takeaway: Height SDS and height velocity were the most reported outcomes in childhood growth hormone deficiency trials, and quality of life appeared in only 3% of outcomes, supporting a core outcome set.

40916127.takeaway: This review covers recent discoveries of GLP-1 mechanisms in the brain, including effects on obesity, and discusses potential uses of GLP-1 drugs in brain disorders.

40916128.takeaway: In prepubertal boys with premature adrenarche, higher BMI and DHEA-S z-scores were associated with bone age advancement, but adrenal androgens did not mediate the effect of obesity.

40916129.takeaway: In 69 overweight or obese girls with central precocious puberty, leuprolide acetate and triptorelin pamoate both suppressed LH effectively, with no significant difference in LH suppression or predicted adult height.

40916130.takeaway: Insulin resistance indices varied with age in children and adolescents, and age-specific percentiles for HOMA-IR and the TyG index reduced age-related variation in metabolic syndrome diagnosis.

40916794.takeaway: Some children with DUOX2-related congenital hypothyroidism had transient or hyperthyrotropinemic patterns after levothyroxine withdrawal, supporting long-term follow-up to prevent excessive thyroid hyperplasia.

40917343.takeaway: In Korean people with Prader-Willi syndrome, growth hormone therapy was not a direct predictor of mortality, but prolonged use was linked to more type 2 diabetes, supporting metabolic monitoring.

40917355.takeaway: An 8-year-old girl with McCune-Albright syndrome and multiple hyperfunctioning endocrinopathies showed that early multi-axis presentations need coordinated treatment that accounts for interactions between conditions.

40917359.takeaway: Among 165 people with congenital hyperinsulinism or caregivers, those on diazoxide with better glycemic control were less critical of its side effects, which affected daily life.

40917361.takeaway: In Sudanese children with triple A syndrome, phenotypes varied even within families, 95% of mutations were homozygous, and the condition is likely underdiagnosed.

40917366.takeaway: A six-variable nomogram predicted dyslipidemia risk in 913 children with Wilson disease, with good discrimination and calibration, enabling early risk stratification.

40920999.takeaway: A Victorian virtual emergency department for diabetes safely managed non-life-threatening diabetes emergencies, with no adverse events reported and hyperglycemia accounting for 46% of presentations.

40921717.takeaway: In males with classic CAH followed from childhood to adulthood, testicular adrenal rest tumors often formed in prepubertal boys and followed a characteristic ultrasound progression, supporting pediatric screening.

40921719.takeaway: In 240 patients with MEN1, pituitary adenoma risk was linked to prior primary hyperparathyroidism, non-missense MEN1 variants and female sex, which may help personalize imaging.

40922648.takeaway: In a prospective Tokyo newborn screening cohort, a refined LC-MS/MS algorithm using 21-deoxycortisol and 11-deoxycortisol/17-OHP ratio reduced low-birth-weight recalls by more than 99%.

40924646.takeaway: In a North Indian tertiary clinic over 20 years, neonatal diabetes showed genetic heterogeneity, with sulfonylurea trials successful in some children, while the authors stress early genetic testing.

40924658.takeaway: In a child with neonatal diabetes from an INS missense variant and pancreatic autoantibodies, the authors recommend cautious sulfonylurea use guided by clinical algorithms where genetic testing is limited.

40927291.takeaway: Among 83 Jordanian children with height percentile at or below 3%, short stature was linked to significant behavioural and emotional difficulties, especially in boys, and GH therapy was not associated with better scores.

40927297.takeaway: In a pilot of young female medical students in the UAE, 12.7% had elevated thyroid peroxidase antibodies, suggesting larger prospective studies are needed to assess clinical significance.

40932298.takeaway: In 39 twins discordant for type 1 diabetes, several gut microbiota-associated serum metabolites differed, suggesting gut microbiome-related environmental factors may contribute to T1D.

40932405.takeaway: This commentary argues that diabetes technology batteries should be designed for recycling, as regulations in the US and EU are shifting toward requiring recycling programs.

40933379.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease analysis shows thyroid cancer prevalence rose from 1990 to 2021 while mortality and DALY rates fell, with burden strongly tied to socio-demographic index.

40934131.takeaway: In 26 children with T1D during a 14-day summer camp, both automated insulin delivery systems were safe, met CGM targets and gave better time in range than sensor-augmented pump therapy.

40937411.takeaway: Bioinformatics and cell experiments suggested Epimedium components may act on undescended testis through PARP1-linked DNA damage repair in heat-stressed testicular cells, a preclinical finding.

40937421.takeaway: In 1,018 neonates, hypothermia was associated with more frequent hypoglycemic episodes and a greater need for treatment, so hypoglycemia should be ruled out when hypothermia is present.

40946023.takeaway: A Latin American pediatric consensus approved 22 of 26 statements on diagnosing, treating and following children with overweight and obesity, and found growth charts and cutoffs vary across the region.

40947755.takeaway: In a single-center cross-sectional study of obese adolescent girls with PCOS, hypertension was assessed, and the authors stress careful evaluation and early management to prevent serious complications.

40948018.takeaway: In 30,000 people with type 1 diabetes, rebound hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia metrics correlated more strongly with glycemic variability and time below range than those measures correlated with each other.

40948019.takeaway: In children with T1D switched to automated insulin delivery, HbA1c and hypoglycemia improved, but initial HbA1c benefits waned after the first year, with non-calibration systems performing better over time.

40948059.takeaway: In children with congenital hypothyroidism, a lower initial levothyroxine dose under 10 µg/kg gave favourable long-term linear growth and neurodevelopment, with no significant differences in IQ.

40951423.takeaway: GBD-based projections show age-standardized type 2 diabetes mortality rising in 72 countries by 2040 compared with 2021, with Africa remaining highest and age structure the main driver.

40951428.takeaway: In a US network cohort of women aged 16 to 45, prior gestational diabetes was linked to higher long-term risk of several thyroid diseases, especially in older and overweight women.

40951432.takeaway: The GBD 2021 analysis shows the diabetes burden in Africa from 1990 to 2021, with Mauritius having the highest incidence and prevalence, and the authors call for prevention and control measures.

40951437.takeaway: This review found prenatal bisphenol A exposure was linked to behavioural problems in offspring in 80% of reviewed articles, with male infants exposed in the third trimester at higher risk.

40951907.takeaway: Among 2,381 children newly diagnosed with T1D in Masovia, Poland, onset seasonality appeared linked to viral infection patterns, including COVID-19, suggesting viral infection control may influence onset.

40958410.takeaway: This paper outlines practical strategies for starting CGM at hospital discharge, addressing barriers such as impaired cognition during recovery and device compatibility with imaging studies.

40958508.takeaway: In a single-centre T1D cohort, structured transfer to adult care was associated with improved glycemic control and treatment adaptation, with single-session and gradual models performing similarly.

40958509.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes, neck and waist circumference were useful for identifying metabolic syndrome, with neck circumference z above 1.04 or waist circumference z above 1.41 as actionable thresholds.

40958510.takeaway: This review summarizes the genetic heterogeneity of idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism identified by next-generation sequencing, and recent insights into the GnRH pulse generator.

40959584.takeaway: Two brothers with an X-linked PLS3 deletion and low bone density had fewer fractures and better bone density after zoledronic acid, calcium and vitamin D treatment.

40959864.takeaway: In children with idiopathic GH deficiency, the TRH stimulation test helped separate hypothalamic dysfunction from primary hypothyroidism, and genetic testing for POU1F1 and PROP1 may be warranted when deficiencies are combined.

40960027.takeaway: A neonate with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia from an HNF4A mutation was managed with diazoxide, and CGM guided treatment decisions and detected hyperglycemia as an early adverse event.

40960072.takeaway: A 6.5-year-old girl with a novel THRβ variant had resistance to thyroid hormone beta with elevated thyroid hormones and non-suppressed TSH, a presentation that can be mistaken for TSHoma, so genetic testing is key.

40960128.takeaway: In 104 obese adolescents and 64 controls, an iNOS rs1060826 GG genotype was associated with lower diastolic blood pressure, and an eNOS TT genotype may relate to higher HOMA-IR in NAFLD.

40960216.takeaway: Among 350 muscle biopsies in Turkey, seven patients (2.1%) had McArdle disease, and the authors emphasize combining clinical assessment, biopsy and molecular analysis for diagnosis.

40960368.takeaway: In a three-generation family with hereditary central diabetes insipidus from an AVP mutation, parents knew the features, and early diagnosis enabled screening for previously unrecognized mild cases.

40960910.takeaway: Six patients from three families with combined malonic and methylmalonic aciduria had ACSF3 variants, and the authors note the condition may cause developmental delay, emphasizing early diagnosis.

40964160.takeaway: In primiparous pregnancies in Hubei, China, GDM rose from 2011 to 2019, and among singletons advanced maternal age interacted with GDM to increase preeclampsia, cesarean and preterm birth risk.

40965839.takeaway: A multi-stakeholder meeting highlighted unmet needs for suitable automated insulin delivery in children with T1D, with access and reimbursement varying by country and by proximity to specialist centres.

40965958.takeaway: Over 14 years at Kenyatta National Hospital, pediatric diabetes cases rose, type 1 diagnosis was often delayed, and nearly a third of type 1 cases were lost to follow-up.

40966131.takeaway: In 84 girls with premature adrenarche followed to mid-puberty, elevated mid-childhood DHEAS did not independently predict worse metabolic outcomes; baseline adiposity was the main driver of insulin resistance.

40966177.takeaway: This review argues that GH therapy for short stature should move toward individualized, mechanism-based prediction of response, while emerging therapies need validation of long-term efficacy and cost.

40966678.takeaway: In a German ecological study of children with new-onset T1D in 2022 and 2023, COVID-19 vaccination rates showed no significant association with T1D incidence over the following 12 months.

40966753.takeaway: In boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, testosterone enhanced long bone growth without reaching full catch-up, and both topical and intramuscular forms promoted secondary sexual characteristics.

40966772.takeaway: In 205 people with T1D in Jordan, DR3-DQ2 and DR4 haplotypes increased susceptibility, while DRB1*07, DRB1*15:02 and DQB1*03:01 were protective, supporting HLA genotyping in risk assessment.

40967201.takeaway: In youth with type 2 diabetes newly prescribed SGLT2 inhibitors at two centers, HbA1c and BMI z-score fell and basal and prandial insulin use decreased.

40967256.takeaway: In youth with T1D, early CGM adoption was linked to a greater probability of partial remission than late adoption, and the authors urge earlier technology use for all children, particularly minority children.

40968189.takeaway: In Sweden, type 1 diabetes incidence rose transiently during the pandemic, and SARS-CoV-2 infection was only partly associated with this increase, suggesting other environmental or lifestyle factors.

40968667.takeaway: In 423 adults with type 1 diabetes of over five years duration, age at diagnosis independently affected free-living glycemia, beyond the effect of insulin delivery modality.

40968676.takeaway: A health economic model for England estimated that a 10-percentage-point TIR increase lowers complication costs by 7.5% to 9.9%, with greater benefit for people starting from lower baseline TIR.

40969365.takeaway: In 22 Chinese children with Cushing disease over 20 years, transsphenoidal surgery achieved long-term remission in 81.8%, with recurrence mainly in microadenomas.

40969375.takeaway: This review summarizes circulating rejuvenating factors in young blood and their potential to counter cardiac remodeling and dysfunction in heart failure, as a basis for future therapeutic targets.

40971351.takeaway: This review applies an ethical framework to disparities in care for US youth with type 1 and type 2 diabetes, arguing that systemic racism and bias must be addressed through lived-experience-centred care.

40971503.takeaway: This clinical approach to Turner syndrome outlines multidisciplinary lifelong management, with growth hormone in childhood and sex hormone replacement as cornerstones, to reduce morbidity.

40973122.takeaway: In 155 patients diagnosed with thyroid cancer at age 20 or younger, long-term survival was excellent though progression can occur later, and younger age predicted distant metastases and poorer therapy response.

40974100.takeaway: In healthy infants followed through the first year, the serum steroid metabolome changed with age and sex, and the age-specific reference curves may help diagnose rare steroidogenesis disorders.

40974209.takeaway: In a 12-month pilot of publicly insured youth with T2D, the authors examined CGM feasibility and concluded that sustaining use may need different strategies than for adults or youth with T1D.

40976583.takeaway: Cytokine profiling across a multiracial PCOS biorepository suggested immune dysregulation and impaired angiogenic signaling rather than chronic inflammation, especially in nonobese patients.

40979706.takeaway: In 639 people with T1D and 653 controls, IL17RA and IL21R polymorphisms influenced T1D susceptibility and, for some variants, the presence of thyroid and TSH receptor autoantibodies.

40979708.takeaway: In 2,149 Taiwanese pregnancies with universal GDM screening, gestational diabetes was not linked to higher neonatal hypoglycemia or other immediate neonatal complications.

40979722.takeaway: In a longitudinal study, adolescents who did recreational gymnastics in childhood had better distal radius bone measures than active controls, with no differences at other skeletal sites.

40979725.takeaway: GBD data show the burden of infertility among reproductive-aged men and women rose globally from 1990 to 2021, particularly in middle SDI regions and among those aged 35 to 39.

40980543.takeaway: In male mice, liver-specific HIV-1 viral protein R combined with a high-fat diet caused hepatic steatosis and impaired glucose tolerance, suggesting a mechanism relevant to MASLD in people with HIV.

40980545.takeaway: In post hoc registry analyses, GH treatment over 5 to 10 years increased height in children with idiopathic short stature and GH deficiency, with similar adverse reaction rates across both groups.

40980822.takeaway: A national Irish cross-sectional study found a significant rise in type 2 diabetes among children under 16 in a short timeframe, with complication screening not in line with guidelines.

40980854.takeaway: In a 36-month-old boy with a novel MCT8 variant and Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome, a high free T3/T4 ratio identified the disorder, and the authors recommend early T3 measurement in male infants with unexplained developmental delay.

40982291.takeaway: Analysis of 2007 to 2022 US outpatient claims found the highest average Graves disease incidence among female and adolescent patients, and the authors call for monitoring trends.

40985112.takeaway: In people with T2D not on insulin, CGM improved time in range within both arms over 60 days, but a nutrition-focused approach did not improve time in range more than self-directed use.

40985127.takeaway: In a CRISTAL secondary analysis, pregnant women with type 1 diabetes benefited most from advanced hybrid closed-loop therapy when baseline HbA1c was below 7.0% or they had no prior AHCL use.

40986451.takeaway: In a single-arm proof-of-concept study of people with T1D on multiple daily injections, an AI decision support tool for insulin dosing was feasible and safe, with a trend toward less time above 250 mg/dL.

40986648.takeaway: A neonate with goitrous congenital hypothyroidism and airway compression responded to levothyroxine without surgery, and genetic testing revealed compound heterozygous SLC26A7 variants.

40986699.takeaway: In a randomized trial, midpregnancy universal GDM screening at 18 to 20 weeks did not improve most pregnancy outcomes compared with standard screening, except for less neonatal hypoglycemia.

40987949.takeaway: This consensus-based framework sets out age-specific endocrine screening for children with transfusion-dependent thalassemia in low-resource settings, to enable earlier detection and referral.

40988096.takeaway: UK best-practice recommendations set a pathway for children with pre-stage 3 type 1 diabetes identified through screening or clinical care, covering antibody confirmation, monitoring, insulin start and audit standards.

40988364.takeaway: In 65 children with delayed-diagnosis congenital hypothyroidism, skeletal maturation caught up in 72.3% and did so earlier than linear growth, and early thyroxine start was critical for growth.

40989118.takeaway: This narrative review summarizes cardiovascular risk factors in children with type 1 diabetes and emerging evidence that exosomal miRNAs may serve as early biomarkers of future vascular complications.

40989119.takeaway: A GBD analysis across 204 countries shows diabetes mortality in children and adolescents declined, while incidence rose sharply, making diabetes an emerging major threat to child health.

40990269.takeaway: A male infant with neonatal isolated ACTH deficiency from the TBX19 c.856C>T variant presented with hypoglycemic seizures and cholestasis, showing adrenal function should be assessed early in neonates with hypoglycemia.

40990290.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes, blunted post-meal CGM glucose trajectories, rather than hypoglycemia, were associated with undiagnosed celiac disease, suggesting CGM could help flag celiac disease earlier.

40990967.takeaway: A 2-month-old infant from a consanguineous marriage presented with severe diabetic ketoacidosis from a novel homozygous EIF2AK3 variant, supporting genetic sequencing in neonatal diabetes to diagnose Wolcott-Rallison syndrome.

40993374.takeaway: In KATP gain-of-function mice, a model of neonatal diabetes, intermittent fasting restored autophagic flux and beta cell identity, suggesting similar mechanisms may operate in other forms of diabetes.

40994736.takeaway: In 379 GADA-positive children from TEDDY, a dynamic prediction model estimated individual risk over time of progressing from single GADA to multiple autoantibodies and T1D, with 2-hour glucose a predictor.

40995592.takeaway: In high-risk young women with and without PCOS, apoB-lipoprotein dyslipidemia was linked to atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and cardiac remodeling, suggesting apoB may help screen for cardiovascular risk.

40995600.takeaway: This review examines how US payers decide coverage for medicines that reduce glucocorticoid exposure in CAH, and suggests coverage criteria should reflect what payers consider important to improve access.

40995656.takeaway: In a 12-week randomized trial of 127 adults with T1D in Saudi Arabia, a carbohydrate-counting and bolus calculator app improved time in range without hypoglycemia or weight gain.

40995783.takeaway: In children with newly diagnosed T1D, progranulin levels were higher than in controls at admission and stayed significantly raised during early insulin treatment, suggesting a possible biomarker role.

40995982.takeaway: A child with a 714.1 kb 5q35 duplication including NSD1 had a reverse Sotos phenotype with microcephaly and short stature, showing how NSD1 dosage changes can produce opposite phenotypes.

40996024.takeaway: Among adolescents with gender dysphoria, CAH or typically developing controls, hormonal and psychosocial factors predicted social cognition, and both gender dysphoria and CAH predicted poorer Unexpected Outcomes Test performance.

40996930.takeaway: In an Italian multicentre pediatric series, malignancy was found within the indeterminate cytology category, suggesting clinical follow-up for TIR3a nodules and total thyroidectomy for TIR3b, pending larger studies.

40997150.takeaway: Mendelian randomization suggested MMP9 may increase the risk of precocious puberty in girls, while arterial stiffness and other matrix metalloproteinases showed no significant causal role.

41001667.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes was treated with empagliflozin, which is approved for children aged 10 and older, and the authors review SGLT2 inhibitor data in youth.

41001668.takeaway: GBD data show chronic kidney disease mortality attributable to sugar-sweetened beverages has generally risen since 1990, and the authors call for SSB policies in high-burden regions.

41001670.takeaway: This review explains how bone turnover markers track bone metabolism in children and their use in growth and developmental disorders, while noting limited pediatric reference intervals and measurement traceability.

41001678.takeaway: In 2,810 mother-infant pairs, well-controlled gestational diabetes was not associated with neurodevelopmental delay at 6 or 12 months, suggesting optimized perinatal management may mitigate risk.

41001785.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 191 Korean children born SGA with short stature identified genetic variants in 34, with copy number variants contributing significantly and diagnosis more likely in familial cases or with intellectual disability.

41004687.takeaway: Six TPO variants found in Sudanese families with congenital hypothyroidism were characterized in silico and in vitro, showing that combined analyses can identify the causal variant among several in one family.

41005768.takeaway: In 137 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes in Spain, CamAPS FX and Control-IQ users had better glycaemic metrics and lower odds of large-for-gestational-age infants than MiniMed 780G users.

41005769.takeaway: In 179 adults admitted with diabetic ketoacidosis at five German hospitals, most episodes occurred in people with pre-existing type 1 diabetes, and sick-day rules for SGLT2 inhibitors were emphasized to prevent DKA.

41005794.takeaway: During surgery and the immediate postoperative period, continuing AHCL insulin delivery was feasible in adults with diabetes, keeping time in range high without hypoglycemia or serious device-related adverse events.

41006196.takeaway: Children with GATA6, GATA4 or PDX1 variants and pancreatic hypoplasia had poor weight gain, labile insulin-dependent diabetes and exocrine insufficiency, but low DKA rates, possibly because of glucagon deficiency.

41014105.takeaway: In 886 children aged 6 to 10 in China, brighter bedroom light at night predicted earlier pubertal onset in boys and girls over two years, with a stronger effect for light after bedtime.

41015786.takeaway: A 17-year-old boy with Noonan syndrome and biopsy-proven type 1 autoimmune hepatitis suggests children with Noonan syndrome should be monitored for liver autoimmunity with periodic transaminase checks.

41017303.takeaway: For CPT1A deficiency, dried blood spots were the preferred sample for diagnosis, as serum or plasma analysis can miss cases and produce false-negative confirmatory results.

41017336.takeaway: A rule-based natural language processing algorithm identified insulin pump and CGM users from clinical notes in electronic records, outperforming billing code methods and validating in a second health system.

41017432.takeaway: Normal variation in IGF-1 has small effects on height in childhood and final adult height, according to Mendelian randomization and cohort analyses in ALSPAC and UK Biobank.

41018050.takeaway: About 20% of children with new-onset diabetes had abnormal lipoprotein(a) levels, which fluctuated over time, suggesting Lp(a) should be measured serially in cardiovascular risk stratification.

41019322.takeaway: Switching children and young adults with T1D to the MiniMed 780G recommended settings, mainly by reducing active insulin time, improved glycemic control without increasing hypoglycemia.

41019329.takeaway: In 259 children and adolescents followed at least five years after solid organ transplantation, endocrine and metabolic complications were common, including obesity and dyslipidemia.

41019338.takeaway: Children with bioinactive GH form a biologically distinct, highly treatment-responsive subgroup of non-GH-deficient short stature, supporting IGF-1 generation testing for diagnosis.

41019339.takeaway: In a danazol-induced rat model of central precocious puberty, luteolin ameliorated the condition by acting on the Toll-like receptor pathway, with upregulated Tlr3, Cxcl10 and Cxcl11.

41022571.takeaway: In 10 patients after total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation, CGM metrics such as time in range, time above range, CV and GRI correlated with islet function, supporting CGM for post-transplant surveillance.

41023432.takeaway: This review describes an altered phenotype of insulin-dependent diabetes in chronically undernourished rural populations in low- and middle-income countries, and calls for clinician recognition and better nutrition.

41024512.takeaway: In youth with CAH, greater subcutaneous and total adiposity was associated with lower lumbar spine bone mineral density, independent of BMI and glucocorticoid dose.

41025548.takeaway: Weekly somatrogon for 12 months raised height SDS, IGF-1 and bone health index in 39 prepubertal children with GH deficiency; bone age did not change.

41025756.takeaway: A 17-year-old girl had ACTH-independent Cushing syndrome with androgen excess from a functional adrenal oncocytoma; cortisol and DHEAS co-secretion may mimic adenoma or carcinoma.

41027845.takeaway: CGM metrics tracked HbA1c closely in type 2 diabetes but weakly in prediabetes and normoglycemia, so they should not be read as HbA1c in those groups.

41030846.takeaway: Across nine studies, AMH was lower in Turner syndrome than in controls, and detectable AMH was associated with spontaneous puberty, particularly in mosaic karyotypes.

41030854.takeaway: Machine learning on Raman spectra of spent day-3 culture medium predicted extended-culture embryo outcomes with 94% accuracy in a preliminary study.

41030857.takeaway: In one 15-year-old with obesity, type 2 diabetes and hyperuricemia, 36 weeks of dose-escalated mazdutide improved weight, HbA1c and uric acid without reported adverse events.

41031465.takeaway: Urinary LH:FSH ratio rose with age in girls and boys aged 11 to 16 and tracked self-reported puberty in girls but not boys.

41032701.takeaway: In pregnancies with type 2 diabetes, excess gestational weight gain raised birth weight and macrosomia odds more when glycemic control was suboptimal.

41037099.takeaway: Type 2 diabetes prevalence in Indigenous youth under 25 ranged from 0 to 44 per 1000, rose with age, and was higher in females in most studies.

41039942.takeaway: Among Australians with type 1 diabetes, medication use and polypharmacy were more common in the most socioeconomically disadvantaged areas.

41040854.takeaway: In 274 young adults with type 1 diabetes, greater diabetes knowledge was linked to lower HbA1c; stress and illness acceptance were also measured with validated questionnaires.

41040856.takeaway: Adding whole-body vibration to a 3-week in-hospital weight-reduction program increased resting energy expenditure in adolescents with obesity, beyond the program alone.

41040857.takeaway: A nomogram using NLR, fasting glucose, creatinine, BMI and exercise habits predicted five-year diabetes onset with modest discrimination (AUC 0.67 to 0.71).

41040869.takeaway: Early rescue ICSI in non-severe male factor with poor oocyte yield gave live birth rates similar to conventional ICSI despite a higher multipronuclear rate.

41042998.takeaway: Genetic testing of 88 Japanese patients with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism found pathogenic variants in 34, including a novel ZNF462 variant, supporting oligogenic inheritance.

41045515.takeaway: In 161 patients with type 1 diabetes, each 10% rise in time in range was associated with a lower hazard of retinopathy progression (HR 0.88).

41048423.takeaway: Causal network modeling of GDM records identified relationships among risk factors and maternal and neonatal outcomes, offering hypotheses for intervention rather than proof.

41048426.takeaway: Over 6 to 12 months, real-world liraglutide with lifestyle change lowered BMI Z-score and improved metabolic markers in children and adolescents with severe obesity, with mild adverse events.

41048428.takeaway: Symptomatic Rathke cleft cysts most often cause hyperprolactinemia and hypogonadism; the review urges hormonal evaluation in every symptomatic case and notes the lack of guidelines.

41048433.takeaway: In 13,144 health-check participants, thyroid hormone sensitivity indices worsened as liver fat rose, most clearly in men and in those with BMI under 28.

41049863.takeaway: Weekly telehealth follow-up added to CGM care gave small but significant HbA1c and glycemic metric improvements in 105 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes.

41049864.takeaway: Immune profiles in pediatric type 1 diabetes differed by age: younger children showed more immune dysregulation, lower partial remission rates and poorer one-year glycemic control.

41051294.takeaway: In 457 people with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, genotype correlated with 17-OHP at diagnosis and phenotype, and genotype-phenotype overlap increased with age.

41052284.takeaway: In 229 patients with Cushing disease, osilodrostat rapidly and durably controlled urinary cortisol, and adverse events became less frequent over time without a clear dose relationship.

41052298.takeaway: Children with CAH followed growth patterns that differ from unaffected children at successive ages, supporting CAH-specific growth charts for clinical management.

41054004.takeaway: In boys with constitutional delay of puberty, puberty-promoting treatment caused no adverse psychosocial effects on temperament, and sociability was higher with one regimen.

41054822.takeaway: In Danish transgender adolescents, overweight, obesity and dyslipidemia were common before hormone therapy; BMI did not worsen, but dyslipidemia worsened slightly in trans boys.

41055383.takeaway: Adults with type 1 diabetes using a bihormonal closed-loop system reported glycemic benefits, but continued use depended on how well they managed technology hassles.

41057689.takeaway: In adolescents with type 1 diabetes, acute hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia altered brain perfusion and neural activity, and recovery from glycemic extremes was delayed.

41057893.takeaway: XLH and tumor-induced osteomalacia are both driven by excess FGF23; the review calls for greater awareness, better diagnostics, multidisciplinary care and standardized protocols.

41058069.takeaway: Urate and phosphate fractional excretion and NT-proBNP may help separate cerebral salt wasting from SIADH in neurologically ill children, but pediatric cut-offs are lacking.

41058080.takeaway: A machine learning model predicted methimazole doses in pediatric hyperthyroidism with a mean absolute error of 1.08 mg on external validation; prior dose, T3 and free T4 were key predictors.

41059222.takeaway: CD4+ T cell subsets differed in obese children from non-obese children and depended on obesity duration: naive-to-memory ratios were lower early, while CD4 counts were higher after five years.

41059232.takeaway: In preeclamptic pregnancies, concurrent gestational hypothyroidism was associated with lower birth weight, with maternal ALT partly mediating the association.

41061665.takeaway: Breast milk bile acid levels were higher with maternal obesity and correlated positively with pre-pregnancy BMI, leptin and insulin.

41062808.takeaway: In mice, placental mTOR deficiency caused fetal growth restriction and immature beta cells, and female offspring later showed diet-induced obesity and insulin resistance.

41064356.takeaway: In young adults in South Africa, total cholesterol, LDL and triglycerides correlated with HOMA-IR and HDL inversely, with pronounced dyslipidemia among those with diabetes.

41064468.takeaway: Sidestream dark-field imaging was feasible in children with compensated type 1 diabetes and detected sublingual microcirculatory changes before clinical microvascular complications.

41064848.takeaway: In a pediatric cohort with mucolipidosis II and III, six novel GNPTAB and GNPTG variants were found, and dried blood spot enzyme activity may offer a minimally invasive screen.

41066490.takeaway: In young children, a high BMI z-score from 9 months increased islet autoimmunity risk only in those with HLA-DR4 genotypes, not HLA-DR3.

41066624.takeaway: Adding 11-ketotestosterone and 21-deoxycortisone to newborn CAH screening helped discriminate true cases in two French screening centers, using a machine learning model.

41071584.takeaway: Antifracture drug use in osteogenesis imperfecta was low overall, rose with age, and bisphosphonates were the most prescribed class across all ages and severities.

41073368.takeaway: Lean mass differed between Kallmann and Klinefelter syndromes, and lean mass was inversely associated with FSH, suggesting FSH affects muscle independently of testosterone.

41076451.takeaway: In people with insulin resistance, higher daily-life stress was linked to higher glucose levels in real-world ambulatory monitoring.

41076452.takeaway: In pancreases from people with cystic fibrosis, beta-cell area was reduced at birth, and islet fibrosis increased with age, suggesting fibrosis contributes to CF-related diabetes.

41077417.takeaway: In 57 children with diabetes, two or more positive behavioral screening subscales showed a trend toward poor glycemic control at one year.

41077643.takeaway: A 2-year-old girl with galactosemia was also diagnosed with Coffin-Lowry syndrome by exome sequencing, illustrating co-occurring rare diseases.

41077646.takeaway: In 14 children with symptomatic Rathke cleft cysts, pituitary insufficiency was common and often persisted after surgery, so long-term follow-up is needed.

41078053.takeaway: Small-for-gestational-age birth was common in a tertiary cohort of newborns with differences of sex development, especially 46,XY DSD without a clear molecular diagnosis.

41078071.takeaway: In a long-term survivor of thanatophoric dysplasia type 1, vosoritide was well tolerated and improved growth velocity and lung function.

41079182.takeaway: Pediatric 3β-HSD2 deficiency showed wide phenotypic variability; the authors stress comprehensive genetic evaluation and multidisciplinary care to avoid diagnostic pitfalls.

41079188.takeaway: In 213 children and adolescents with obesity, the triglyceride-glucose index identified prediabetes better than triglycerides, fasting glucose or HOMA-IR, at a cutoff of 8.895.

41079194.takeaway: In an infant with hypothalamic hamartoma, very high estradiol with unsuppressed gonadotropins complicated the distinction between central and peripheral precocious puberty.

41079197.takeaway: In prepubertal mouse testicular organotypic culture, one system yielded more differentiated spermatocytes and another better preserved spermatogonia, offering a standardized platform.

41079198.takeaway: ACOXL gene polymorphisms were associated with type 1 diabetes susceptibility in Chinese individuals, and with age at onset and beta-cell function.

41079200.takeaway: A metabolomics signature in children with obesity was associated with metabolic abnormalities; longitudinal and experimental validation is still needed.

41079202.takeaway: In children with hyperinsulinism, food-based enteral formula may ease gut symptoms and reduce reliance on glucose polymers; larger, longer studies are needed.

41079204.takeaway: In critically ill children with cardiac disease, the triglyceride-glucose index had a nonlinear, U-shaped association with acute kidney injury, with inflection points near 8.6 and 8.8.

41080637.takeaway: In Wolfram syndrome type 1, diabetes insipidus appeared before optic atrophy, and symptom-based screening of type 1 diabetes patients led to earlier diagnosis.

41081623.takeaway: In Australian children with type 1 diabetes, automated insulin delivery was associated with fewer DKA or hypoglycemia admissions than multiple daily injections, saving about 40,000 Australian dollars per 100 patient-years.

41083160.takeaway: Bioactive IGF-I was above +2 SD in 13% of 126 GH-treated children versus 25% for total IGF-I, so monitoring it may help optimize dosing in some subgroups.

41085706.takeaway: In young people newly diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, higher baseline uric acid was associated with more macrovascular and microvascular complications later in life.

41087677.takeaway: Hypothyroidism causes weight gain that treatment reverses, while hyperthyroidism causes weight loss; iatrogenic hyperthyroidism is not an effective weight-loss strategy.

41089281.takeaway: In a single-institute series, intradural pituitary transposition during endoscopic endonasal resection of retroinfundibular lesions was associated with less bleeding and good preservation of pituitary function.

41090400.takeaway: In one Turkish center, teamwork, education, tighter goals and technology were combined, and automated insulin delivery users had the lowest mean HbA1c, about 7%.

41090401.takeaway: Isolated hypoglycemia was common in children with cystic fibrosis, and abnormal insulin and glucagon responses to an oral glucose load were the main contributors.

41090402.takeaway: In girls aged 4 to 8 with premature adrenarche, 11-oxo-androgens were proposed as a more sensitive marker than DHEA-S, and advanced bone age correlated with 11-ketotestosterone.

41091474.takeaway: A multidisciplinary consensus recommends lifelong, personalized Noonan syndrome care; GH insensitivity should not exclude rhGH therapy, and cardiomyopathy and neoplasm risks need attention.

41091641.takeaway: In a nationwide registry cohort, precocious puberty was linked to higher risk of psychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia, with the strongest associations in central precocious puberty.

41091947.takeaway: Swedish children with type 1 diabetes who lacked autoantibodies at diagnosis differed clinically from those with autoantibodies, suggesting heterogeneous pathogenesis.

41092054.takeaway: Israeli adolescents with autoimmune disease, especially autoimmune thyroid disease and celiac disease, had a higher risk of developing type 1 diabetes in young adulthood.

41092239.takeaway: In 290 patients with thyroid cancer, imaging after initial radioiodine predicted five-year prognosis; retreatment within two years and metastasis site were key factors.

41092452.takeaway: In healthy men, prednisolone disrupted the daily rhythm of clock gene expression in muscle and fat, along with interstitial glucose, blood pressure and sleep patterns.

41092479.takeaway: Morning serum cortisol predicted short synacthen test outcome in children and adults weaning off glucocorticoids; in adults above 290 nmol/L, weaning was safe.

41099075.takeaway: This narrative review summarizes how interfering substances affect the accuracy of marketed CGM devices and how device designs mitigate them.

41099230.takeaway: A child with PGM1 deficiency was first misdiagnosed with Laron syndrome, since the glycosylation disorder mimics GH insensitivity; rhIGF-1 produced a good response.

41099433.takeaway: Six Chinese children with HNF1β-MODY had early diabetes with kidney, pancreatic and genitourinary involvement; early genetic confirmation can guide insulin and electrolyte care.

41100425.takeaway: Thyroid hormone variation within the normal range was weakly and inconsistently associated with developmental test scores in a German pediatric cohort.

41101877.takeaway: This personal view proposes a pragmatic framework for managing adults with screen-detected islet autoantibody positivity, clarifying international guidance for a UK health system.

41103647.takeaway: Children and young adults with type 1 diabetes had shifts in oral microbiota and cytokines, with lower IFN-γ and higher IL-1β than healthy controls.

41103649.takeaway: After genetic confirmation of HNF4A-MODY, 43% of Russian children were successfully switched to sulfonylureas, though one switch from insulin failed.

41103651.takeaway: This review links PCOS with insulin resistance, obesity and metabolic syndrome, and urges early recognition in adolescents and young women to prevent long-term complications.

41103653.takeaway: Horner syndrome is a rare complication of thyroid surgery, usually from injury to the cervical sympathetic chain, and meticulous surgical technique helps prevent it.

41104464.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for growth disorders identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41104466.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for environmental endocrinology finds that endocrine-disrupting chemicals affect multiple endocrine systems, calling for coordinated research.

41104467.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for endocrine laboratory medicine calls for investment in quality assurance and innovative technologies to improve research reliability and patient care.

41104468.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for rare endocrine diseases calls for coordinated European research networks spanning centres, age groups and specialties.

41104469.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for pituitary and neuroendocrine tumors identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41104470.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for AI in endocrinology calls for integrating AI in ways that preserve clinical expertise and support fairness-aware system development.

41104471.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for calcium and bone endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41104472.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for diabetes, obesity and metabolism identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41104474.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for thyroid endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41104475.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for adrenal and cardiovascular endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41104476.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for endocrinology across the lifespan calls for coordinated research spanning paediatric and adult care, from conception to aging.

41104477.takeaway: An analysis of Horizon 2020 funding suggests endocrine science is underfunded relative to the prevalence of endocrine disorders, which the EndoCompass roadmap aims to address.

41104478.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for reproductive and developmental endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41105571.takeaway: Pubertal induction in girls with Turner syndrome varied in estrogen type and timing; the authors advise regimens that mimic physiology and meet patients' expectations to sustain long-term therapy.

41108035.takeaway: This narrative review covers in vivo CGM performance with interfering substances, their clinical implications, and the need for standardized interference testing.

41108712.takeaway: In SRY-negative 46,XX testicular and ovotesticular DSD, immunohistochemistry suggested a relatively low germ cell tumor risk, though the authors stress long-term follow-up.

41109685.takeaway: Non-benign CYP21A2 promoter variants were common in people with 21-hydroxylase deficiency and in unaffected carriers, and can explain genotype-phenotype discrepancies.

41109844.takeaway: A diabetes data platform integrated CGM and pump data into a pediatric network's health records, enabling risk-based monitoring and machine-learning-supported care.

41109845.takeaway: This review of unlabeled substances that affect CGM readings suggests some may fall within manufacturer acceptance criteria, and public disclosure would help.

41111054.takeaway: A consensus from three Spanish societies sets a common framework and recommendations for screening, staging and follow-up of type 1 diabetes in preclinical stages.

41111433.takeaway: A newborn with a positive CAH screen was diagnosed with 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 deficiency and stabilized on hydrocortisone and fludrocortisone.

41112506.takeaway: In young children with obesity, proteomic and lipidomic markers of insulin resistance were identified, and they diagnosed insulin resistance better than traditional lipid indicators.

41113700.takeaway: The emoTICare program showed positive effects in adolescents with type 1 diabetes, particularly in reducing perceived disease threat.

41115414.takeaway: In 22 nonobese men with low birth weight, four weeks of carbohydrate overfeeding revealed metabolic perturbations linked to limited subcutaneous adipose expandability.

41115851.takeaway: Feasibility studies suggest CGM is promising for older people with diabetes and cognitive impairment, especially in hospital, but more data are needed.

41117702.takeaway: Glycated albumin percentage correlated with HbA1c and may supplement HbA1c for glucose monitoring when erythrocyte half-life is altered, such as in kidney disease.

41118079.takeaway: Recommendations for transitioning adolescents with obesity to adult care stress a planned handover, trained adult clinicians, and a shared long-term follow-up plan.

41118323.takeaway: Ten children with ROHHAD-NET syndrome had rapid-onset obesity with respiratory and autonomic problems; three died, and early recognition enables timely respiratory support.

41118628.takeaway: Stage 3 progression in the TN-10 placebo arm resembled that in a European screening cohort, suggesting the trial's progression risk may generalize to Europeans.

41125247.takeaway: In infants, genetic influence on growth shifted from birth-size variants toward adult-size polygenic scores, with the IGF-I association significant by 6 and 12 months.

41125535.takeaway: A European expert position statement says parental communication about weight should be supportive and avoid stigma, equipping parents to promote healthy behaviours.

41127510.takeaway: Adding growth hormone to GnRH analogue therapy in girls with central precocious puberty improved short-term growth without accelerating bone age, but did not consistently improve adult height.

41127518.takeaway: Girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty showed brain structural changes in motor, emotional and cognitive regions, some correlated with peak LH, suggesting possible imaging biomarkers.

41129483.takeaway: In this systematic review, even 1600 IU/day of maternal vitamin D was associated with frequent infant vitamin D insufficiency, suggesting current recommendations may be inadequate.

41129620.takeaway: Probable familial hypercholesterolemia affected about 1 in 215 children with type 1 diabetes, and only about one-third of those at very high risk received lipid-lowering therapy.

41132004.takeaway: In 1,492 patients followed a median of 10 years or more, ultrasound-guided laser ablation of thyroid nodules was effective and safe, with only minor complications.

41134091.takeaway: In Indonesia, many 46,XX CAH individuals were initially assigned as males because of late diagnosis, driven by low awareness and limited resources; the authors call for standardized guidelines.

41137448.takeaway: Calcitriol monotherapy in children and adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia was safe and well tolerated, with modest benefits on mineral metabolism and rickets markers.

41139199.takeaway: MECP2 rare variants were found in boys with sporadic central precocious puberty, and both variants reduced MECP2 protein levels, suggesting a deleterious effect.

41140065.takeaway: Transcriptomic profiling grouped prolactinomas and somatotropinomas into subtypes, and treatment resistance was linked to specific subtypes, suggesting distinct mechanisms.

41141333.takeaway: During the COVID-19 era, new type 1 diabetes cases rose and the age distribution shifted, with fewer younger children in 2020 that later normalized.

41141339.takeaway: In UAE pregnancies, a new GDM threshold predicted adverse perinatal outcomes better than IADPSG criteria, improving composite outcome prediction by 5.0% versus 1.3%.

41141354.takeaway: In a pilot prospective study, CGM detected silent hypoglycemia in fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase deficiency, and ketonuria and hepatic steatosis tracked with attack frequency.

41146706.takeaway: In an 11-year-old with coexisting type 1 diabetes and GCK-MODY who had frequent hypoglycemia, insulin was gradually reduced and stopped after genetic testing.

41147385.takeaway: In children referred for elevated TSH, 6 to 59% had hypothyroidism needing treatment; TSH above 10 mIU/L, goiter and antithyroid antibodies were risk factors.

41152002.takeaway: In the European Lipodystrophy Registry, patients with generalized lipodystrophy died much earlier than those with partial forms, at a median age of 27 versus 72 years.

41157964.takeaway: In children with hypochondroplasia, IGF-1 was low and NTproCNP high at baseline, and changes in the two correlated during vosoritide treatment.

41158621.takeaway: This review finds worse sleep patterns in type 1 diabetes, especially with poor glucose control, and limited but similar data in monogenic diabetes, calling for interventional studies.

41162339.takeaway: A higher vitamin D metabolite ratio was protective against progression from islet autoimmunity to type 1 diabetes, possibly by reducing inflammatory pathway activation.

41163677.takeaway: This review covers the molecular pathogenesis, diagnosis and management of complete androgen insensitivity syndrome, including the risk of gonadal malignancy.

41163813.takeaway: In growth-impaired juvenile male mice, semaglutide worsened stunting by reducing energy metabolism, showing GLP-1 signaling affects growth during development.

41165086.takeaway: In pediatric complete androgen insensitivity syndrome, surveillance-based gonadal preservation appeared safe in childhood and allowed spontaneous pubertal feminization.

41165099.takeaway: An adolescent with autosomal dominant hypophosphatemic rickets from a de novo FGF23 variant presented with bilateral sacral insufficiency fractures, a rare manifestation.

41165100.takeaway: A child with compound heterozygous APOA5 variants had severe hypertriglyceridemia that stayed poorly controlled for a decade on conventional treatment.

41166547.takeaway: In Australian youth with type 1 diabetes, the physical activity questionnaire had moderate-to-high criterion validity and moderately distinguished those meeting activity guidelines.

41167265.takeaway: In children with obesity, plasma kynurenine pathway metabolites changed somewhat, and a higher 3HK/KYN ratio tracked with raised blood pressure, with no clear link to metabolic syndrome.

41169468.takeaway: Children with stimulation-test-unresponsive short stature responded to recombinant GH much like those with definite GH deficiency, while idiopathic short stature responded less favorably.

41169469.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl with diabetes was diagnosed with autoimmune polyglandular syndrome type 4, with autoimmune hepatitis, immune thrombocytopenia and celiac disease; the authors urge screening for other autoimmune diseases.

41169474.takeaway: In 3,907 pregnant women, 75-g and 100-g OGTTs using IADPSG criteria showed no significant difference in GDM diagnostic efficacy or adverse outcome risk.

41169481.takeaway: Pediatric endocrinologists in the Gulf Cooperation Council identified social background, injection context and patient satisfaction as key patient-generated data for growth hormone therapy decisions.

41171987.takeaway: In 62 children with thyroid nodules or cancer, BRAFV600E and RET, NTRK and ALK fusions were the most frequent pathogenic findings in differentiated thyroid cancer.

41172278.takeaway: Glucagon responses to an oral glucose load differed across stages of type 1 diabetes development, with a paradoxical rise at 15 minutes seen only in early stage 3.

41174211.takeaway: This review covers endocrine complications of cystic fibrosis, including CF-related diabetes, bone disease, growth and puberty, hypogonadism and adrenal insufficiency.

41175199.takeaway: In Ghana, about two-thirds of clinically diagnosed people with long-term type 1 diabetes kept C-peptide and lacked autoantibodies and HLA risk, highlighting atypical presentations.

41176785.takeaway: Genetic testing of 20 children with differentiated thyroid cancer identified alterations, and family screening may support early diagnosis and risk stratification.

41177980.takeaway: A bench sensor pairing enzyme-based electron transfer with an extended gate transistor measured glucose ex vivo in human plasma, with a 0.94 mM detection limit.

41177992.takeaway: An EHR-embedded perioperative glycemic protocol improved glucose monitoring and intraoperative control in people with diabetes without increasing hypoglycemia.
