41180175.takeaway: Ethiopian adults with type 1 diabetes had a higher risk of microvascular but a lower risk of macrovascular complications than non-Ethiopian adults.

41180189.takeaway: In 115 Chinese children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, phenotypes differed in virilization and steroid profiles, and newborn screening enabled earlier diagnosis in salt-wasting cases.

41181380.takeaway: In 207 children and adolescents with diabetes, depressive symptoms were linked to poorer glycemic control, partly mediated by self-care behaviors.

41183501.takeaway: In young adults with 46,XX testicular or ovotesticular DSD, biochemical primary gonadal insufficiency was common, and micropenis may persist despite normal testosterone in OT-DSD males.

41185648.takeaway: Interviews with 36 parents of children with type 1 diabetes in rural Iran revealed unmet emotional, social and systemic needs, calling for peer support and affordable care.

41186140.takeaway: In pregnant people with type 1 diabetes, late-pregnancy CGM metrics differed by hypertensive disorder and large-for-gestational-age status, and may help distinguish risk.

41186191.takeaway: This review of recent prospective studies examines mental health outcomes of puberty suppression and gender-affirming hormones in transgender youth, and the need for comprehensive care.

41186271.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes and celiac disease, worse glycemic control at celiac onset correlated with higher anti-transglutaminase IgA titers and more severe Marsh grade.

41189616.takeaway: In twin pregnancies after assisted reproduction, a higher number of abnormal OGTT results was associated with gestational hypertension and intrahepatic cholestasis.

41193695.takeaway: This review links sarcopenia with MASLD, which coexists with metabolic syndrome, and calls for standardized sarcopenia definitions and personalized treatment.

41194499.takeaway: A 3-year-old girl with 18p deletion syndrome had type 1 diabetes and Hashimoto thyroiditis, and the authors suggest deleted 18p genes may contribute to autoimmune endocrinopathies.

41195208.takeaway: The global burden of gout attributable to kidney dysfunction changed from 1990 to 2021 with marked regional differences, and the authors urge better surveillance in low-income regions.

41195209.takeaway: This narrative review finds no shared guidelines for low bone density in early infancy and surveys bone health technologies, though validated pediatric reference cut-offs are lacking.

41195213.takeaway: In Turner syndrome patients treated with GH in Taiwan over 25 years, karyotype including mosaicism was not a primary predictor of adult height; bone age, pre-treatment height and mid-parental height were stronger.

41195309.takeaway: In children, the HLA-C*0304 subtype was associated with a beneficial gut microbiota profile and later type 1 diabetes onset, suggesting a microbiota-linked mechanism.

41196293.takeaway: Teplizumab was safe and well tolerated in children under 8 with stage 2 type 1 diabetes, with no new safety risks identified.

41196654.takeaway: In neonatal NOD mice, transfer of Flt3L-derived antigen-presenting cells reduced the incidence of type 1 diabetes, acting through the neonatal tolerance window.

41198906.takeaway: This review examines how hypothyroidism, which affects about 5% of people, raises cardiovascular risk and how thyroid hormones shape cardiac structure, with risk-based management.

41198915.takeaway: Among mothers of children at risk for type 1 diabetes, detected autoantibodies did not raise ongoing perceived stress after 1 to 2 years, while mental health history did.

41199866.takeaway: Global Burden of Disease data show type 2 diabetes incidence, prevalence and disability burden in youth rose from 1990 to 2021, varying by region, sex and development level.

41199867.takeaway: A bibliometric analysis finds obesity a central node across five major diabetes complications, supporting weight management as a core part of diabetes treatment.

41201981.takeaway: In pediatric papillary thyroid cancer in Argentina, sequencing found molecular alterations, with fusions more frequent at younger age, and germline findings aided genetic counseling.

41203250.takeaway: In very young children with type 1 diabetes on hybrid closed-loop, time in range rose and time above range fell from the first month, with late morning a high-risk window for hypoglycemia.

41203252.takeaway: Real-world Dexcom G7 wear in youth with type 1 diabetes was under 10 days for most sensors, with a median of 8.6 days, so youth would need 43 or more sensors a year.

41203257.takeaway: In 24 adolescents with type 1 diabetes using automated insulin delivery, glucose stayed stable during graded exercise testing without hypoglycemic events during the test.

41203536.takeaway: A summary of EAU/ESPU guidelines on transition in urology emphasizes long-term follow-up for congenital conditions and use of a transition readiness tool; evidence strength is limited.

41204644.takeaway: In youth with new-onset type 2 diabetes, GLP-1 receptor agonists gave greater BMI reduction than metformin, with no significant difference in HbA1c change, in a retrospective study.

41204718.takeaway: Autoantibody detection by agglutination-PCR in whole blood was stable and consistent with serum assays, offering simplified, low-volume type 1 diabetes population screening.

41204978.takeaway: In Finnish children with genetic susceptibility, those with an affected first-degree relative more often had multiple autoantibodies and progressed to type 1 diabetes more often and faster.

41206002.takeaway: About 10% of males with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism reverse with sustained HPG recovery; clinical signs and genetic testing help identify who needs surveillance.

41206093.takeaway: In early childhood, oxidative stress was elevated in overweight and obese children and correlated with adiposity in boys only, suggesting sex-dimorphic associations.

41207288.takeaway: This review describes uses and limits of large language models such as ChatGPT in medical research, recommending they serve as complementary tools under ethical safeguards.

41207289.takeaway: Cerebral oedema is uncommon in pediatric DKA but causes 0.1% to 0.3% of deaths, and a quarter of survivors have permanent neurological injury; management options are reviewed.

41207290.takeaway: In euthyroid Korean adolescents, high-normal TSH was significantly associated with abdominal obesity, with a significant trend between TSH quartile and metabolic syndrome.

41207291.takeaway: In Korean children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, CGM use significantly improved HbA1c over 12 months compared with self-monitoring of blood glucose.

41208243.takeaway: Adolescents with pubertal gynecomastia had higher trunk fat mass and lower FSH and free T4 than healthy controls, suggesting an interplay of adiposity and endocrine change.

41208398.takeaway: In children treated with denosumab, fractures through sclerotic metaphyseal bands emerged as a distinct complication, which can co-occur with rebound hypercalcemia.

41210500.takeaway: In 210 Chinese patients with Prader-Willi syndrome, food responsiveness was a key factor in hyperphagia and body weight, and growth hormone did not improve it.

41210504.takeaway: After burosumab was stopped in a patient with X-linked hypophosphatemia, FGF23 rose and new insufficiency fractures appeared within 19 days, showing rapid relapse.

41211830.takeaway: A Bayesian network of GDM pregnancies found CGM-derived metrics associated with several neonatal outcomes, with ethnicity-related differences in glycemic control.

41211872.takeaway: In overweight children, CTRP6 was higher than in healthy controls, while FSTL-1 and FAM19A5 were lower, suggesting adipokine changes matter in obesity.

41213125.takeaway: In 50 adolescents with PCOS, BMI and HOMA-IR predicted disordered eating better than hyperandrogenism, and the authors recommend the EDE-Q for screening.

41213156.takeaway: In children with obesity, epicardial adipose tissue thickness was higher with fatty liver disease and may serve as a non-invasive marker of cardiovascular risk.

41213272.takeaway: In 27 patients with nonclassical CAH, final height was mainly determined by height at diagnosis and pubertal growth, rather than genotype or age at presentation.

41213273.takeaway: Unlike girls with central precocious puberty, boys with CPP did not show elevated or treatment-responsive serum α-Klotho, which correlated with testosterone.

41215667.takeaway: This narrative review classifies CGM devices and explains how substances, including over-the-counter and newly marketed drugs, can interfere with their readings.

41216603.takeaway: Qualitative interviews found Palestinian youth with type 1 diabetes cope through family support and faith, while facing cultural, social and political barriers in the West Bank.

41216978.takeaway: The Glycemia Risk Index is seen as a useful complement to traditional CGM reports, but standardization, guideline adoption and clinician training remain barriers.

41218652.takeaway: This review of pediatric primary adrenal insufficiency covers genetic and acquired causes, with CAH the most frequent, and the difficulty of replicating the cortisol rhythm.

41219438.takeaway: In 45 children with well-regulated type 1 diabetes, no manifest cardiac autonomic neuropathy was found, though children with overweight may be more susceptible.

41222075.takeaway: A meta-analysis finds GH combined with a GnRH analogue enhances growth in central precocious puberty over GnRHa alone, with greater benefit from longer treatment and higher GH doses.

41222213.takeaway: In obese adolescents, higher dietary diversity was associated with lower visceral adiposity and better triglyceride-glucose and lipid accumulation indices.

41223151.takeaway: In 230 children with diabetes, inhaled technosphere insulin did not meet HbA1c noninferiority but was safe over 26 weeks, with more treatment satisfaction and less weight gain than rapid-acting insulin.

41223156.takeaway: In two people with autoimmune polyendocrine syndrome type 1, teplizumab for stage 2 diabetes was followed by a transient rise in pancreatic volume, and the authors suggest it may preserve beta-cell function.

41225718.takeaway: Urinary GC-MS steroid profiling detected pediatric adrenocortical tumors from spot urine and distinguished carcinomas from adenomas, with Δ5-steroid dominance.

41229307.takeaway: Boys with hypospadias had reduced AMH, inhibin B and INSL3 during minipuberty, suggesting subtle testicular dysfunction, with severity linked to birth and placental weight.

41230026.takeaway: In a large cohort on a connected GH auto-injector, adherence was high, and children with high adherence gained more height SDS over two years (0.8 vs 0.5).

41231236.takeaway: The revised ESE guideline gives recommendations for diagnosing, managing and monitoring chronic hypoparathyroidism in adults, including a substantial role for parathyroid allotransplantation.

41233045.takeaway: This Personal View defines the major life-stage transitions in type 1 diabetes and identifies clinical gaps and research needs for lifelong care.

41234233.takeaway: An ensemble machine learning model predicted NAFLD risk in adolescents better than traditional metabolic markers and is offered as a web calculator for early screening.

41234236.takeaway: This review covers endoplasmic reticulum stress across pediatric diabetes forms and pharmacological and non-pharmacological ways to modulate it, including metformin.

41237017.takeaway: In 18 healthy elite footballers, CGM showed glucose rises during and after matches, suggesting mild hyperglycemia can occur with competition stress.

41237324.takeaway: Youth-onset type 2 diabetes formed reproducible clusters with different treatment responses and complication risks, but clusters added no prognostic value beyond simple clinical measures.

41239863.takeaway: In adolescents with transient idiopathic GH deficiency, stopping rhGH at mid-puberty did not change near adult height compared with continuing treatment.

41240372.takeaway: A meta-analysis shows sex differences in leptin in normal-weight children that are lost in obesity, so leptin alone is unlikely to explain earlier puberty in girls with obesity.

41243221.takeaway: Denosumab reduced serum phosphate and improved symptoms in three patients with FGF23-pathway hyperphosphatemia resistant to standard treatment, with hypocalcemia the only adverse effect noted.

41243835.takeaway: Two FKBP10 cases suggest a phenotypic continuum between Bruck syndrome type 1 and osteogenesis imperfecta type XI, with contractures and scoliosis that may evolve over time.

41244049.takeaway: In Chinese children, PNPLA3-Ile148Met and TM6SF2-Glu167Lys were independent risk factors for MASLD, while GCKR and LEPR variants may be protective.

41244054.takeaway: In an experimental model, hypothalamic FTO increased BDNF expression through m6A demethylation, promoting GnRH expression via PI3K/Akt signaling and precocious puberty.

41245156.takeaway: In early pubertal girls with excess weight, ovarian 17-OHP responded more strongly to hCG than in late pubertal girls, suggesting exaggerated ovarian responsiveness that may be transient.

41246972.takeaway: In children with persistent differentiated thyroid carcinoma, high-risk recurrence stratification, serum thyroglobulin of 32.9 ng/mL or more, and poor response to radioiodine identified patients needing closer care.

41247493.takeaway: In adolescents with type 1 diabetes, longer disease duration predicted slower spatial navigation, and nocturnal hypoglycemia predicted longer path length.

41248109.takeaway: Young adults with type 1 diabetes had gaps in alcohol-safety education, and excessive drinking was clearly more likely in some subgroups; the authors call for tailored education.

41248115.takeaway: Young people with primary ciliary dyskinesia had compromised skeletal health, with mostly normal densitometry but altered tibial microarchitecture compared with controls.

41248209.takeaway: Automated insulin delivery restored weight in underweight children with type 1 diabetes and kept overweight or obese children stable, with BMI change driven mainly by baseline BMI and glucose.

41249474.takeaway: This review asks whether thyroid dysfunction, especially hypothyroidism, is a reversible risk factor in chronic kidney disease, a question that remains unresolved.

41252199.takeaway: Placentas from GDM pregnancies showed hundreds of splicing differences enriched in metabolic pathways, and splicing factor SRSF10 was identified as a key regulator.

41255538.takeaway: In a 30-year cohort of type 1 diabetes, the authors advise checking TPO antibodies and TSH at diagnosis, then annual TSH in antibody-positive people.

41255955.takeaway: In the Norwegian childhood diabetes registry, youth with type 1 diabetes and ADHD had higher HbA1c than those with type 1 diabetes alone, and males with ADHD had higher DKA odds.

41258701.takeaway: The POR G88S mutation caused one of the most severe forms of P450 oxidoreductase deficiency, with protein instability and impaired drug-metabolizing enzymes, a pharmacogenomic risk marker.

41259303.takeaway: In adolescents, hair steroid profiles reflected hormone activity alongside serum levels and related to body composition, a less invasive measure that needs further validation.

41260209.takeaway: In 85 Korean children with type 1 diabetes, average CGM glucose from the four weeks before HbA1c testing predicted HbA1c closely (R² 0.83).

41261869.takeaway: Three children on weekly somatrogon developed injection-site lipoatrophy that fully resolved within three months after rotating sites, with growth remaining appropriate.

41261870.takeaway: Five pediatric patients with lipoid congenital adrenal hyperplasia from STAR variants presented with adrenal insufficiency and all survived without morbidity on replacement therapy.

41261973.takeaway: European EXPeRT guidance for pediatric adrenal and extra-adrenal paraganglioma recommends multidisciplinary management and lifelong surveillance tailored to genotype.

41262259.takeaway: Genetic testing in mild isolated hyperthyrotropinemia, with a systematic review, reclassified 122 unique variants across 173 patients, expanding the genetic spectrum of congenital hypothyroidism.

41262843.takeaway: Females with type 1 diabetes had steeper early BMI increases and persistently higher LDL-C than males, independent of age, glycemic control and DKA at diagnosis.

41264343.takeaway: This review argues that automated insulin delivery should be assessed beyond glycemic outcomes, including diabetes burden and the challenges of technology use.

41264350.takeaway: With the MiniMed 780G, a corrective bolus of 50% of the meal's carbohydrate an hour after a missed meal bolus improved TIR without raising hypoglycemia risk.

41264570.takeaway: Males with MKRN3 loss-of-function variants showed marked phenotypic variability, suggesting many male cases are underdiagnosed and penetrance may be incomplete.

41266045.takeaway: A consensus from three Spanish societies sets a common framework and recommendations for screening, staging and follow-up of type 1 diabetes in preclinical stages.

41267369.takeaway: This review summarizes the global burden of diabetic ketoacidosis, recent ketone-monitoring technologies, and a continuous dual glucose-ketone sensor under development.

41267374.takeaway: This review argues that dual glucose-ketone monitoring could help youth catch rising ketones before severe DKA requires hospitalization.

41267571.takeaway: A 17-hydroxyprogesterone-based algorithm applied to routine laboratory data identified existing 21-hydroxylase deficiency cases, reducing selection bias in outcome studies.

41269985.takeaway: An olfactory receptor gene deletion was far more common in prepubertal gynecomastia and juvenile macromastia than in controls, suggesting a possible genomic contributor that needs validation.

41271215.takeaway: This commentary argues Medicare should extend CGM coverage to people at high risk of hypoglycemia, not only to those with diabetes.

41271217.takeaway: CGM data from nondiabetic people support a normative glucose rate-of-change reference of ±2 mg/dL per minute over 15 minutes, analogous to the 70 to 140 mg/dL range.

41271221.takeaway: In adults with type 1 diabetes on injections, glucose responses to aerobic exercise depended on pre-exercise glucose and menstrual phase, with women steadier in the luteal phase.

41271225.takeaway: A pediatric endocrinology clinic integrated multivendor CGM data into the health record, finding the work needed significant resources and that workflow and data mapping remain challenging.

41274302.takeaway: Thyroid cancer incidence among adolescents and young adults rose across 185 countries; the authors say this indicates a large expansion of overdiagnosis.

41274303.takeaway: In 330,000 people with prediabetes in England, paths to type 2 diabetes and cancer depended on age at prediabetes diagnosis, so prevention should be tailored by age.

41275343.takeaway: A child with systemic pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1 had the first reported homozygous SCNN1G deletion, presenting with hyponatremic convulsion, which stresses copy-number testing.

41275383.takeaway: Cataract occurred in children with type 1 diabetes in North India, sometimes early, and the authors urge screening at diagnosis and within the first year.

41275391.takeaway: Monogenic diabetes in Sudanese children was predominantly syndromic, with genotype-specific features such as hepatomegaly and hypophosphatemic rickets.

41275517.takeaway: A nutrition knowledge assessment during comprehensive visits was feasible for newly diagnosed youth with type 2 diabetes and helped tailor education to each patient.

41282282.takeaway: Skin autofluorescence reference intervals were set for healthy never-smoking Western Europeans by sex, with higher values in smokers and in people with diabetes, cardiovascular disease or kidney impairment.

41282298.takeaway: In 72 short-statured children on rhGH, insulin resistance, hyperinsulinemia, free T3 and HDL were identified as determinants of first-year treatment efficacy.

41283064.takeaway: Among parents of children with type 1 diabetes, treatment satisfaction was tied to the child's health-related quality of life and perceived diabetes control.

41288361.takeaway: Adequately treated maternal hypothyroidism was not associated with autism in offspring, whereas persistent thyroid hormone imbalance across trimesters raised the risk.

41289028.takeaway: In adults on GH replacement, fibroblast activation protein-α activity rose alongside collagen turnover, suggesting FAPα may be a biomarker of GH activity.

41289222.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for endocrine laboratory medicine calls for investment in quality assurance and innovative technologies to improve research reliability and patient care.

41291202.takeaway: This review explores how genetic and nutritional signals, including lipid, steroid and oxygen signalling, regulate feto-placental development and pregnancy outcomes.

41293549.takeaway: In type 1 diabetes at onset, renal tubular damage was linked to metabolic acidosis, and the ketone-to-bicarbonate ratio predicted tubular damage well.

41296499.takeaway: In adolescents with obesity, semaglutide 2.4 mg improved insulin sensitivity, glycemic measures, ALT and other cardiometabolic risk factors versus placebo, most clearly with BMI reductions of 20% or more.

41296660.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for diabetes, obesity and metabolism identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41296665.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for calcium and bone endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41306434.takeaway: After surgery for pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, bone was a common site of metastasis, more often than liver or lungs, with SDHB mutation a risk factor.

41306439.takeaway: In pubertal girls, several bile acids were inversely associated with BMI and body fat, and two were nominally associated with free testosterone.

41306440.takeaway: A Saudi case series of 3M syndrome showed wide phenotypic variability and mainly autosomal recessive inheritance; GH helped some patients, though response was often poor.

41308050.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for AI in endocrinology calls for integrating AI in ways that preserve clinical expertise and support fairness-aware system development.

41308051.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for pituitary and neuroendocrine tumors identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41308056.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for adrenal and cardiovascular endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41308059.takeaway: An EndoCompass analysis of Horizon 2020 funding finds it unclear whether endocrine science is adequately funded, and calls for more given the high prevalence of endocrine disorders.

41308060.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for environmental endocrinology finds that endocrine-disrupting chemicals affect multiple endocrine systems, calling for coordinated research.

41308065.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for reproductive and developmental endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41308070.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for rare endocrine diseases calls for coordinated European research networks spanning centres, age groups and specialties.

41308071.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for endocrinology across the lifespan calls for coordinated research spanning conception to aging, linking paediatric and adult care.

41308662.takeaway: In women with gestational diabetes, real-time CGM reduced large-for-gestational-age births without differences in serious adverse events.

41310157.takeaway: This review analyses diagnosis and management of all hypophysitis subtypes, including hormonal and imaging criteria, biopsy when uncertain, and therapy for aggressive disease.

41311212.takeaway: Iscalimab, an anti-CD40 antibody, had acceptable safety and tolerability in adolescents and young adults with new-onset type 1 diabetes; the sample size limits efficacy interpretation.

41311234.takeaway: A 3-year-old Korean girl with compound heterozygous SECISBP2 variants had a thyroid hormone metabolism defect; biochemical improvement did not fix her poor neurodevelopmental outcome.

41312609.takeaway: Infants of mothers with hypothyroidism had congenital hypothyroidism in about 1 in 265 births, substantially more than the general population, with no link to maternal antibodies.

41313739.takeaway: In Slovakia, persistent nonsyndromic congenital hyperinsulinism had a nationwide incidence of about 1 in 39,804, with a genetic cause, mostly ABCC8, found in 32% of children.

41321009.takeaway: Among AI bone age tools using the TW3 method, YIZHUN and LIANYING agreed best with reference readings, while AIBAA underestimated bone age by about 0.7 years.

41323155.takeaway: Switching children with type 1 diabetes from first-generation basal insulin to glargine U300 or degludec U100 improved glycemic control without weight gain, with similar effects.

41325413.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for thyroid endocrinology identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41325415.takeaway: The EndoCompass roadmap for growth disorders identifies priority research areas in pathophysiology, prevention and treatment, aimed at reducing burden on individuals and society.

41326654.takeaway: This review examines how parental exercise shapes fetal metabolic and cardiac programming, with male offspring gaining more metabolic and female offspring more cardiac benefit.

41327588.takeaway: Monoallelic or biallelic CYP24A1 variants contribute to hypercalcemia and nephrocalcinosis, and early genetic diagnosis helps avoid inappropriate vitamin D supplementation.

41329339.takeaway: In a prospective cohort, adolescent binge eating was associated with higher odds of later PCOS, while infrequent laxative use showed lower odds.

41334443.takeaway: In children with congenital hypothyroidism in Yunnan, dyshormonogenesis genes were prominent, but genotype did not reliably predict phenotype or prognosis.

41334447.takeaway: In 527 women with natural conception, a steadily rising high estradiol trajectory in early pregnancy was associated with a lower risk of early miscarriage.

41335420.takeaway: Several IGHG2-FCGR ligand-receptor interactions accelerated progression to stage 3 type 1 diabetes, while some IGHG4-FCGR interactions delayed it.

41335548.takeaway: A 10.8-year-old boy with gonadotropin-independent precocious puberty and rising β-hCG had no tumor found for six years; a mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor was resected later.

41338999.takeaway: Japan's DSD guidelines give evidence-based recommendations on diagnosis, management, surgery, gonadal tumor risk, fertility preservation and transition, while noting limited high-quality evidence.

41340166.takeaway: This systematic review of pediatric virilizing ovarian tumors finds hyperandrogenism less common under age 8, and that raised 17-OHP or DHEAS does not exclude such a tumor.

41340520.takeaway: Adolescents with pubertal gynecomastia reported substantially elevated peer victimization and psychological impact, supporting routine bullying assessment in clinical care.

41340543.takeaway: Clinical and radiologic clues help separate mucopolysaccharidosis from skeletal dysplasia in difficult cases; early onset with systemic features points toward MPS.

41341137.takeaway: Six exosomal microRNAs were differentially expressed in children with obesity and MASLD and correlated with liver function and insulin resistance, suggesting non-invasive biomarkers.

41346657.takeaway: A meta-analysis finds microvascular complications affect at least one in 10 youths with diabetes before age 20, with similar prevalence in type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

41347128.takeaway: A 32-year bibliometric analysis maps idiopathic short stature research and shows growing attention to genetic mechanisms and precision medicine.

41347131.takeaway: Children with sleep disorders had a higher prevalence of growth disturbances and excess weight, supporting early recognition and treatment of sleep disorders.

41347132.takeaway: Over five years of GH treatment, children with GH deficiency or SGA showed improved metabolic parameters, with transaminases and total cholesterol falling.

41347136.takeaway: A 4-year-old boy with arginine vasopressin deficiency from IgG4-related hypophysitis was controlled with treatment; SARS-CoV-2 reinfection may have contributed, though this is only suggestive.

41347137.takeaway: In short children born SGA on GH, underlying conditions and associated treatments were the main factors linked to adverse events, while a higher GH dose at last visit was linked to fewer.

41349002.takeaway: In classical 21-hydroxylase deficiency, puberty started earlier, progressed more slowly and lasted longer, and final height was reduced despite early diagnosis; growth-promoting therapies were less effective in girls.

41353583.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes and obesity, GLP-1 receptor agonists reduced BMI and total daily insulin dose over about 16 months, with transient gastrointestinal side effects.

41354744.takeaway: After Thailand's 2023 CGM reimbursement, uptake was only 12% (17 of 142), though hybrid closed-loop users had higher time in range and better sensor adherence.

41355298.takeaway: CGM reference data from young adults without diabetes showed males with higher mean glucose and excursions, and age, BMI and activity linked to glucose variability.

41355750.takeaway: CGM users on rapid- or short-acting insulin had 19% higher odds of HbA1c below 9% and fewer emergency or inpatient days for hypoglycemia or DKA than nonusers.

41355764.takeaway: In real-world activity sessions of adults with type 1 diabetes, hypoglycemia risk rose with longer duration, lower starting glucose and higher insulin on board, and aerobic activity caused the largest drops.

41356008.takeaway: In juvenile male rats, a high-fat diet induced obesity and central precocious puberty, with SMIM20/phoenixin signalling implicated in earlier pubertal onset.

41356010.takeaway: In rats, prolonged high-fat diet caused IL-1β neuroinflammation and altered thyroid axis regulation, with juvenile rats more affected than adults.

41358890.takeaway: This section of the ADA Standards of Care 2026 sets out current clinical practice recommendations for children and adolescents with diabetes.

41358924.takeaway: Adolescents with PCOS and BMI below the 85th percentile had more insulin resistance and adipose tissue dysfunction than peers without PCOS, showing metabolic risk without excess adiposity.

41359174.takeaway: In TEDDY children with islet autoimmunity, a family history of type 2 diabetes was associated with delayed progression to type 1 diabetes.

41361403.takeaway: This Australasian guideline gives periprocedural guidance for children with diabetes, covering CGM and pump use, fasting protocols, perioperative fluids and insulin, and hypoglycemia management.

41364086.takeaway: In children with MASLD, a 30-unit rise in GGT over time was associated with a substantially higher risk of type 2 diabetes, with AST also significant.

41364459.takeaway: In the TN07 oral insulin prevention trial, genetic profiles distinguished responders from nonresponders, with lower proinsulin-related polygenic scores linked to greater benefit in one stratum.

41365839.takeaway: Patients with HRAS-mutant pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma had higher plasma metanephrines and a higher risk of intraoperative hemodynamic instability and ICU transfer.

41367096.takeaway: A German Diabetes Society statement discusses how diabetes conferences can become more sustainable, noting that some options conflict and need a structured approach.

41367630.takeaway: In pediatric MODY cases from one Turkish center, genetic testing clarified diagnoses and highlighted the value of population-specific genomic data and periodic reassessment of gene-disease links.

41369738.takeaway: In the Pune Maternal Nutrition Study, higher pregnancy glycemia reflected persistently higher glycemia since childhood, so gestational hyperglycemia is a window on lifelong hyperglycemia.

41370338.takeaway: The tracheal index correlated poorly with thyroid volume in preterm or low-birth-weight infants and had low sensitivity and specificity for thyroid hyperplasia.

41376381.takeaway: A meta-analysis finds aerobic, combined and high-intensity interval training improve cardiorespiratory fitness in children with overweight or obesity, while resistance training did not.

41377936.takeaway: Placental microvascular blood flow measured by MV-Flow imaging correlated moderately with birthweight and separated women with GDM at a threshold of 38.95%, with modest sensitivity.

41377944.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes, epidermal barrier measures such as transepidermal water loss and hydration corresponded with diabetes severity and may flag neuropathy or foot risk.

41379147.takeaway: In the ENDIA birth cohort, persistent single ZnT8 autoantibodies, detectable only by ELISA, did not appear to confer increased risk of progression to type 1 diabetes.

41379482.takeaway: Children exposed to GDM diagnosed before 24 weeks were more likely to develop obesity up to 11 years later, regardless of treatment type, glycemic targets or maternal BMI.

41379540.takeaway: In youth with few boluses on automated insulin delivery, Control-IQ users had about 8 percentage points higher time in range than Omnipod 5 users, mainly through more time in automated mode.

41379723.takeaway: A multidisciplinary lifestyle program covering diet, sleep and physical activity reduced obesity prevalence by 15% and severe obesity by 33.8% among Greek adolescents, with better cardiometabolic risk factors.

41379759.takeaway: In a 22-year study of childhood-onset type 1 diabetes, stable circumstances such as being a parent or working in an academic occupation were associated with better metabolic control.

41380163.takeaway: In 53 children with solid thyroid nodules, surgical decisions should combine ultrasound risk features with Bethesda cytology, and surgery may be considered even with benign or indeterminate cytology when several suspicious features are present.

41380172.takeaway: Over nine years of follow-up, thiazide diuretics alone restored electrolyte balance and supported normal growth in early-onset pseudohypoaldosteronism type 2, which can be diagnostically missed.

41381175.takeaway: An international expert panel issued practical recommendations on continuous ketone monitoring to reduce DKA risk in people on intensive insulin therapy, endorsed by ISPAD.

41381886.takeaway: In mice, declining FXR expression during weaning coordinates neonatal beta-cell mass development with maturing microbial bile acid metabolism, supporting later glucose homeostasis.

41383447.takeaway: Adolescents with type 1 diabetes in Barbados described how a specialty clinic and psychosocial support shaped their autonomy, and asked for age-appropriate communication.

41384014.takeaway: Mothers of children with 47,XXY or related sex chromosome variants had higher miscarriage rates than the general population, significantly so for 47,XXY and 49,XXXXY.

41384018.takeaway: Osteocalcin, a bone-derived protein, was detected in breast milk across lactation, with concentrations not linked to physical activity, BMI or maternal age.

41389002.takeaway: In adults, low nocturnal melatonin secretion, estimated from a single morning urine sample, was independently associated with a higher incidence of type 2 diabetes.

41392030.takeaway: Serum uric acid helped distinguish central precocious puberty from premature thelarche in girls, with a 4.1 mg/dL cutoff giving 90% sensitivity and 95% specificity.

41393281.takeaway: A meta-analysis finds overweight and obesity affect male puberty, especially earlier testicular enlargement and pubic hair development, with no significant difference in peak height velocity.

41393291.takeaway: Whole-exome sequencing in Russian adolescents with idiopathic premature ovarian insufficiency found diagnostic and novel variants, supporting its use alongside karyotyping and FMR1 testing.

41393299.takeaway: This review of fertility in 21-hydroxylase deficiency highlights reproductive and sexual quality-of-life challenges, and underscores neonatal screening and team-based management.

41394113.takeaway: In a retrospective series of young children with severe obesity, including hypothalamic obesity, topiramate reduced BMI in many, with no significant change in cardiometabolic markers or growth.

41394116.takeaway: After seven years of somapacitan, children with GH deficiency had consistent height SDS gains, reduced treatment burden after switching from daily GH, and no new safety concerns.

41395711.takeaway: In ENDIA, among 575 children with thyroid autoantibodies, female sex, family autoimmune disease and HLA haplogenotype were identified as risk factors for clinical autoimmune thyroid disease.

41396850.takeaway: Genetic analysis supported a causal effect of type 1 diabetes on juvenile idiopathic arthritis, with CD8+ NKT cells mediating the effect; diabetic mice developed synovitis.

41399023.takeaway: A patient with transaldolase deficiency presented with primary amenorrhea and elevated gonadotropins, so this metabolic disorder should be considered in premature ovarian insufficiency.

41401082.takeaway: A fully automated insulin delivery system without meal announcements improved average glycemic control and time in range, mainly overnight, while remaining noninferior for hypoglycemia.

41401108.takeaway: In a woman with childhood GCK-related hyperglycemia whose glucose worsened in her late 40s, a low-penetrance NEUROD1 variant was likely responsible for the altered trajectory.

41401417.takeaway: Progression likelihood scores stratified children with stage 1 and 2 type 1 diabetes by two-year risk, and a non-OGTT score identified low (1.7%) and moderate (24.6%) risk groups.

41402995.takeaway: A lifestyle intervention in women with obesity or overweight and PCOS did not raise 18-month live birth rates but significantly increased natural pregnancy rates versus usual care.

41409341.takeaway: COVID-19 was not associated with increased diabetes risk in children; incidence peaked early in the pandemic and mirrored pandemic-era healthcare use.

41409604.takeaway: Pregnancy outcomes were comparable and generally favorable in women with GCK-related hyperglycemia and HNF1A diabetes, with individualized insulin therapy and monitoring supporting safe care.

41409609.takeaway: In young male rats with colitis, neutrophil elastase was expressed in growth-plate chondrocytes and upregulated by inflammation, suggesting a direct route by which inflammation hinders skeletal growth.

41411205.takeaway: Adolescents with obesity showed lower aerobic glucose utilization on metabolomic profiling, which may contribute to insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular risk.

41413297.takeaway: In genetically at-risk Finnish children, higher vitamin C and vitamin E intake was associated with lower islet autoimmunity risk, while B vitamins showed no association.

41414753.takeaway: In children with salt-wasting adrenal insufficiency, plasma renin activity guided mineralocorticoid replacement better than renin concentration, which may standardize practice and improve control.

41420533.takeaway: In 49 children with GH deficiency, GH replacement improved physical fitness measures, including jump performance, six-minute walk distance, VO2max and quality of life.

41420850.takeaway: In US real-world data, fewer than half of GH-treated patients with Turner or Noonan syndrome started treatment early after diagnosis, highlighting the need for earlier diagnosis.

41422462.takeaway: Pancreatic mesenchymal stromal cells were denser around islets in later-onset type 1 diabetes, correlating with less immune infiltration, while younger-onset disease may impair their survival.

41424307.takeaway: Two siblings with a novel biallelic SERPINH1 variant had osteogenesis imperfecta type X with marked variability: the brother had early, severe disease and the sister a milder, later onset.

41424587.takeaway: Qualitative interviews found adolescents with type 1 diabetes rely on self-devised strategies and informal networks for physical activity, and called for youth-friendly, activity-specific guidance.

41424588.takeaway: In a case series of children with severe insulin resistance, dapagliflozin was tolerated for two to four years, and some children had fewer DKA episodes.

41427034.takeaway: A Spanish Delphi consensus gives national guidance on integrating long-acting growth hormone into pediatric GH deficiency care, including indication and monitoring.

41427042.takeaway: In Chinese multiparous women, a history of large-for-gestational-age birth was independently associated with subsequent gestational diabetes, more strongly than absolute macrosomia.

41427054.takeaway: For Slovene boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, the authors propose vamorolone transition for ambulatory patients with fractures, markedly low bone density, short stature or growth deceleration.

41428408.takeaway: Advanced carbohydrate-counting knowledge was higher with greater socioeconomic status, and longer diabetes duration was linked to lower knowledge and poorer glycemic control.

41432272.takeaway: Among 625 Chinese children with newly diagnosed central precocious puberty, sellar MRI abnormalities were relatively rare, so routine sellar MRI for all may not be needed.

41439332.takeaway: Differences between HbA1c- and CGM-based glycemia estimates were associated with complete blood count measures, which may help reconcile the two.

41442431.takeaway: Gonadotropin therapy and testosterone replacement were both effective and safe for pubertal induction in adolescent males with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism; TRT raised testosterone more steeply, while gonadotropins promoted testicular growth.

41442434.takeaway: In healthy adolescents, a larger pubertal growth spurt was linked to the age at reaching Tanner landmarks, but landmark timing had no association with adult height.

41446637.takeaway: This review finds functional hypothalamic amenorrhea in adolescent athletes impairs bone accrual and raises fracture risk, with underdiagnosis and deficits persisting after weight restoration.

41449600.takeaway: In adults with type 1 diabetes on multiple daily injections, time in tight range modestly outperformed time in range for predicting incident retinopathy, mainly when HbA1c was near target.

41456571.takeaway: In infants with severe atopic dermatitis, biochemical signs of secondary hyperaldosteronism resolved after skin and nutritional care, supporting extrarenal electrolyte loss.

41459635.takeaway: In children aged 3 to 12, variations in sex development were not strongly associated with gender-typed preferences during early and mid-childhood.

41459638.takeaway: A girl with osteogenesis imperfecta and pes equinovarus had a rare heterozygous COL1A1 variant, suggesting it should be considered when contractures and fragility coexist.

41460708.takeaway: In children with idiopathic short stature or partial GH deficiency, continuing GH through puberty did not add height beyond predicted adult height on average, and was costly.

41467600.takeaway: The peak-to-basal GH difference or ratio gave supportive diagnostic information for growth hormone deficiency in a large cohort of children with short stature.

41468096.takeaway: GAD65-specific CAR regulatory T cells homed to human islets, suppressed diabetogenic T cells ex vivo, and reversed type 1 diabetes in a spontaneous mouse model.

41468097.takeaway: During a 25-hour Yom Kippur fast, automated insulin delivery kept glucose stable in youth with type 1 diabetes without severe hypoglycemia, with ketones modestly higher than on a regular morning.

41468099.takeaway: In type 1 diabetes, GLP-1 RA or GIP analogue use was associated with lower health care use and reduced all-cause mortality in an observational analysis that needs confirmation.

41468104.takeaway: A Belgian cost-utility analysis found Control-IQ gave clinical benefits over injections and standard pump therapy with CGM for adults with type 1 diabetes, cost-effective at common thresholds.

41468105.takeaway: In youths with obesity, time in tight range measured in free-living conditions was associated with prediabetes, though CGM metrics discriminated only modestly.

41468168.takeaway: After hemithyroidectomy in children, hypothyroidism usually developed in the first postoperative year, and preoperative TSH with TPO antibodies helped identify low- and high-risk children.

41472381.takeaway: In a US cohort with maternally inherited diabetes and deafness, heteroplasmy varied widely within families, underscoring urine-based heteroplasmy testing and personalized management.

41472512.takeaway: In prepubertal Indian girls with Turner syndrome, low DXA bone mass disappeared after adjusting for short stature, and bone density did not differ from healthy girls.

41472892.takeaway: Greater linear growth in early infancy was associated with earlier pubertal onset in both sexes, with weight gain from late infancy more consistently linked, especially in girls.

41473979.takeaway: A patient with 5q35 duplication syndrome had a favorable height response to long-term growth hormone therapy, supporting its use in this ultra-rare disorder.

41474492.takeaway: The 2025 Female Athlete Triad consensus gives screening, diagnosis, treatment and return-to-play guidance for adolescents and adults, noting that adolescents need age-appropriate approaches.

41474655.takeaway: Adrenal pathology was exceedingly rare among children referred for premature pubarche, and routine laboratory testing without other signs of androgen exposure was not warranted.

41476919.takeaway: A machine learning model using non-invasive measures predicted MASLD in young adults with external-validation AUROCs of about 0.88 to 0.89, with BMI and body fat the strongest predictors.

41480193.takeaway: An integrated bone-and-puberty model predicted adult height with a mean error of 0.02 cm in prospective validation, outperforming bone-age methods and offering a two-bone protocol.

41480351.takeaway: This narrative review covers endocrine abnormalities in pediatric inborn errors of metabolism, organized by affected organ system, with monitoring recommendations where available.

41480354.takeaway: In 290 women in Hangzhou, iodine insufficiency in late pregnancy was linked to lower birth weight and length, and first-trimester insufficiency to lower long-term offspring weight and length.

41480357.takeaway: In postpartum Japanese mothers without diagnosed depression, salivary oxytocin responses to infant stimuli varied with EPDS scores, suggesting possible biological sensitivity to depression risk.

41482637.takeaway: In a randomized withdrawal study, continued diazoxide choline extended-release was superior to placebo for hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, with similar adverse event rates.

41486282.takeaway: This review discusses bidirectional communication between the autonomic nervous system and metabolic organs in humans, and how targeting autonomic function could improve metabolic health.

41486515.takeaway: In a regional cohort with congenital hyperinsulinism, genetic testing identified a novel ABCC8 variant, supporting genetic testing in standard diagnostic protocols.

41486943.takeaway: Three patients with Carney complex had varied presentations, including adrenal and extra-adrenal involvement, with no consistent genotype-phenotype correlation, supporting individualized care.

41488135.takeaway: In a 32-center randomized trial, automated insulin delivery improved HbA1c and time in hypoglycemia versus multiple daily injections in youth and adults with type 1 diabetes, with safety confirmed.

41488142.takeaway: Placental serotonergic dysregulation, independent of total serotonin levels, was associated with early impairments in infant neurodevelopment.

41488143.takeaway: A meta-analysis finds mobile health interventions in gestational diabetes reduce cesarean and composite neonatal complications and improve two-hour postprandial glucose.

41488144.takeaway: Five young boys with 48,XXYY showed infantile developmental dyspraxia by 18 months, with discrepancies between fine and gross motor skills and between expressive and receptive language.

41489212.takeaway: New European pediatric DXA reference charts for body composition were built from a diverse population; fat and lean mass index references ran lower than North American and Swiss cohorts.

41495276.takeaway: Adolescents with type 1 diabetes described middle-school PE, citing teachers' central role, a need to self-regulate effort by glucose level, and pump designs that are hard to use discreetly.

41498210.takeaway: In MEN1, radiological surveillance for nonfunctional pituitary adenomas offered little benefit beyond symptoms and pituitary function testing for most patients.

41498263.takeaway: In children and adolescents with DSD, muscle strength aligned with gender of rearing and testosterone, while chromosomal sex mainly influenced final height.

41498529.takeaway: In real-world MiniMed 780G users, glycemic control on days without user-initiated boluses was effective, with more users meeting targets when ROS were used.

41499094.takeaway: A double-dummy design was shown feasible for blinded comparison of two automated insulin delivery systems, one delivering insulin and the other a diluent, without operator bias.

41499313.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes and celiac disease, TTG IgA at least 3.6 times the upper limit or positive EMA supports confirmation, and follow-up was lower than in celiac-only children.

41505353.takeaway: In the global ACHieve natural history study of young children with achondroplasia, growth trajectories were similar across regions, supporting generalizability.

41507059.takeaway: Greater cumulative maternal glycemic exposure in pregnancy was associated with placental DNA methylation changes near inflammatory and cardiometabolic genes, suggesting an epigenetic link to offspring risk.

41507499.takeaway: This review frames diabetes and thyroid disease, which often coexist and share autoimmunity, obesity and insulin resistance, as non-communicable disease priorities needing earlier detection.

41508751.takeaway: This review explains how type 1 and type 2 diabetes impair bone during childhood, risking lower peak bone mass and lifelong fracture risk, and urges early intervention.

41508752.takeaway: In Iranian children from 2003 to 2016, the prevalence of metabolic syndrome and most metabolic obesity phenotypes did not change significantly, though metabolically healthy obesity rose slightly.

41508753.takeaway: In a pilot study of obese adolescents and young adults with type 2 diabetes, education using CGM and smartwatch data gave short-term gains in glycemic control, diet, activity and self-care.

41508754.takeaway: CPP incidence in Korea has risen, and early childhood obesity was a strong independent risk factor, most strongly in obese boys.

41508755.takeaway: In Korean children and adolescents, the DXA trunk-to-limb fat ratio was significantly associated with cardiometabolic risk factors and metabolic syndrome, beyond anthropometric measures.

41509147.takeaway: Japan's DSD guidelines give evidence-based recommendations on diagnosis, management, surgery, gonadal tumor risk, fertility preservation and transition, while noting limited high-quality evidence.

41511914.takeaway: A UK survey found significant variability in pediatric Turner syndrome services, with centres lacking dedicated clinics generally smaller, and called for better multidisciplinary care and transition planning.

41513899.takeaway: This review explains how fasting hormones cooperate rather than merely opposing insulin, driving the liver's production of glucose and ketone bodies during fasting.

41519847.takeaway: An Italian Delphi consensus offers a shared diagnostic approach to pediatric short stature, reaching strong agreement on 12 of 14 statements across clinical, biochemical, imaging and genetic domains.

41521526.takeaway: In transitional-age patients with childhood-onset GH deficiency, GH response to glucagon was driven mainly by pituitary damage, with BMI playing a minimal role once etiology was considered.

41521529.takeaway: A 13-month-old boy with SCOT deficiency from a novel OXCT1 duplication presented with severe acidemia from ketoacidosis, which the authors attribute to ketone accumulation before renal compensation.

41521682.takeaway: In 172 children, LRG1 was not a direct biomarker of hepatosteatosis in obesity but was negatively associated with insulin resistance and dyslipidemia.

41521707.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes on automated insulin delivery, HbA1c reflected recent glucose most, and GMI aligned more closely with CGM time-in-range measures.

41525084.takeaway: A novel bridging ELISA for insulin autoantibodies preferentially detected high-affinity antibodies linked to higher risk, with good sensitivity and specificity for type 1 diabetes screening.

41525152.takeaway: In 2,702 mother-infant pairs, maternal diabetes in pregnancy was linked to higher infection risk in the first six months, and lower IgG diversity in infants of mothers with prepregnancy overweight amplified that link.

41525336.takeaway: In children with early-stage type 1 diabetes, a varied, low-saturated-fat, low-added-sugar diet and moderate activity are likely beneficial, and low glycemic index diets may be protective.

41527361.takeaway: PCOS with MASLD in adolescence, but not PCOS alone, increased the likelihood of obesity, insulin resistance and an adverse cardiometabolic phenotype in adulthood.

41528724.takeaway: In a Brazilian cohort with congenital isolated GH deficiency from a GHRH receptor mutation, IGF-I bioavailability regulation was altered, with higher PAPP-A2 proteolytic activity and lower PAPP-A activity.

41529164.takeaway: Across six trials, baseline CGM time below range had limited value for predicting severe hypoglycemia in type 1 diabetes, and no threshold gave strong discrimination.

41529838.takeaway: This review describes how diabetes technology generates plastic, battery and electronic waste, and discusses eco-design and waste management as options for stakeholders.

41529840.takeaway: A system-wide inpatient glucose dashboard was associated with less hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia and mortality and shorter length of stay, though ED readmissions rose.

41530911.takeaway: This review argues Graves' disease treatment is moving from normalizing thyroid levels toward long-term remission and prevention of associated autoimmunity, guided by pathophysiology.

41531262.takeaway: Boys who had testicular tissue extraction before gonadotoxic therapy frequently developed persistent Sertoli cell dysfunction, with limited fertility potential in many.

41531283.takeaway: Across an international CAH registry, management in early infancy varied considerably, with hypertension and hyperkalemia frequently reported.

41532590.takeaway: This editorial argues that sharing research code in open, version-controlled repositories supports reproducibility, trust and alignment with NIH Gold Standard Science.

41533559.takeaway: In Greek children and adolescents with overweight or obesity, boys consumed more water, vegetables and meat than girls, and the dietary patterns can guide prevention and treatment.

41535597.takeaway: In a real-world study of teplizumab for stage 2 type 1 diabetes, glycemic responses were similar to trials, treatment was safe, and reduced preproinsulin-specific TCRs may be early immune biomarkers.

41537273.takeaway: This review of childhood craniopharyngioma covers hypothalamic syndrome and obesity, favoring therapies that preserve hypothalamic function, since irreversible bariatric surgery raises ethical issues in children.

41537284.takeaway: In males with advanced bone age and compromised predicted height, letrozole gave greater height gain than anastrozole, with earlier treatment, longer duration and concurrent GH also linked to greater gains.

41540796.takeaway: A deep-learning imaging method segmented and classified diabetic foot ulcers more accurately than existing tools, with 99.16% specificity and an F1 score of 95.53%.

41543833.takeaway: Endo-ERN expert opinion recommends deferring nonurgent irreversible genital surgery in DSD until the individual can consent where possible, with stronger family support and European quality indicators.

41543974.takeaway: A systematic review finds the diagnostic yield of genetic testing in short stature varies by method and phenotype, with higher rates for comprehensive genomic tests and syndromic presentations.

41543979.takeaway: An international guideline lists history, examination and investigation features that raise the likelihood of a genetic cause of short stature, and proposes a genetic workup algorithm.

41548894.takeaway: A pooled analysis found an AI-enabled low glucose prediction feature accurate and sensitive when validated against capillary glucose and CGM in people using multiple daily injections.

41549377.takeaway: A very young infant with infantile-onset Pompe disease kept receiving enzyme replacement therapy after allergic reactions, through a desensitization protocol with close monitoring.

41549445.takeaway: Among 520 patients who had first pituitary surgery for PitNETs in Northern Ireland, referrals came from 29 sources, most often general practice; median diagnostic delay was 2 years.

41549465.takeaway: Three siblings with Dyggve-Melchior-Clausen skeletal dysplasia shared a novel homozygous exon 16 deletion; one sibling also had Down syndrome.

41552835.takeaway: Reviews CFRD pathophysiology, risk factors and treatment in children and adolescents with cystic fibrosis, and advises proactive screening, with annual OGTT from age 10 as the gold standard.

41553367.takeaway: In 80 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes on automated insulin delivery, 71.5% completed a 25-hour Jewish fast without complications, and most changed their AID settings.

41553947.takeaway: In 1,727 children and adolescents, a personalized lifestyle program following e-health monitoring was associated with a decline in the proportion with obesity.

41553960.takeaway: Caregivers of Black and Hispanic/Latino youth with type 1 diabetes described mistrust of devices, fear of malfunctions and frustration with troubleshooting at each step of the technology journey.

41553972.takeaway: An ESPE position statement identifies unmet needs in pediatric endocrine care across Europe, including diagnostic uncertainty, fragmented care, transition barriers and drug development gaps, and proposes strategic directions.

41556335.takeaway: EHR-based logistic regression models predicted DKA-related hospitalization in 7,798 adults with type 1 diabetes, with AUC 0.87 at 90 days and 0.84 at 180 days.

41561047.takeaway: A Global Burden of Disease 2021 analysis found endometriosis prevalence and DALYs in women of childbearing age rose from 1990 to 2021 in absolute numbers, while age-standardized rates declined.

41561050.takeaway: Of 77 patients with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia who had pancreatic surgery, 4 of 5 histologically atypical cases had genetic variants, several of them low-grade somatic mosaic.

41561055.takeaway: Proposes a four-subtype framework for childhood obesity (dysmetabolic, inflammatory, neurobehavioral, biomechanical) that moves beyond BMI toward subtype-specific risk assessment and treatment.

41561060.takeaway: Three consanguineous siblings with isolated GH deficiency shared a rare homozygous GH1 promoter-region haplotype with no coding mutations; the authors propose it as the cause.

41563349.takeaway: In 220 children with stage 1 type 1 diabetes, 12 months of high-dose oral insulin did not change progression to dysglycemia or diabetes, or the immune response to insulin.

41564354.takeaway: In 47 adults with stage 3 type 1 diabetes, a plasmid expressing preproinsulin and immunomodulatory cytokines was safe and well tolerated, but showed no antigen-specific immune changes.

41566693.takeaway: In a matched real-world cohort of 647 inhaled-insulin users and 1,830 controls, lung cancer, COPD, emphysema and chronic bronchitis were not more frequent with technosphere insulin.

41566695.takeaway: In 27 adults with type 1 diabetes, 12 months on AndroidAPS raised time in range from 67.8% to 79.9% and lowered HbA1c from 6.6% to 6.0%, with no severe hypoglycemia or DKA.

41567807.takeaway: In 106 women with obese PCOS, 12 weeks of electroacupuncture lowered BMI more than sham treatment (difference -1.50 at week 12), with the effect sustained at 24 weeks.

41569948.takeaway: Three brothers with hypomasculinized genitalia shared a hemizygous maternally inherited MED12 variant, suggesting MED12 variants may cause 46,XY DSD with or without malformation syndromes.

41569973.takeaway: In 354 Korean youths with type 1 diabetes, mean HbA1c fell from 9.0% at age 15 to 8.2% at 22; CGM use was linked to better control, but a quarter stayed at 9% or higher.

41571285.takeaway: In 1,085 adult ICU patients after filtering, STAR model-based glucose control kept 71% of measurements in the target band, with severe hypoglycemia in 0.21% of patients.

41571286.takeaway: In youth with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes on hybrid closed-loop, carbohydrate-bolus insulin fell from 58% to 34% of daily insulin over 48 months, with basal delivery compensating.

41572650.takeaway: Describes a structured multidisciplinary diagnostic pathway for adolescents with suspected DSD, illustrated by a case, with individualized and gender-affirming care.

41572913.takeaway: In a randomized pilot of 15 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes at a holiday camp, disconnecting the hybrid closed-loop pump for exercise reduced time below 70 mg/dL without changing time in range.

41573056.takeaway: In a nationwide cohort of about 2 million newborns, children whose mothers had an autoimmune disease had higher odds of childhood-onset type 1 diabetes (adjusted OR 1.95).

41573195.takeaway: In 4,865 normoglycemic Riyadh adolescents aged 12–17, the triglyceride-glucose index, remnant cholesterol and vitamin D status were assessed against cardiometabolic risk factors.

41573196.takeaway: A previously healthy 9-year-old with new-onset type 1 diabetes and severe DKA developed cardiac arrest and stress cardiomyopathy in the first hours of treatment, without electrolyte or cardiac abnormality.

41573197.takeaway: In a Danish national registry cohort of over 6.5 million people, type 1 diabetes was not associated with overall tumor risk, and type 2 diabetes was associated with a slightly lower hazard after adjustment.

41573206.takeaway: In 1,077 premenarcheal girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, BMI was associated with basal LH: underweight girls had lower LH than overweight and obese girls.

41573211.takeaway: Reviews how chronic psychological stress may impair bone accrual in children through endocrine, immune, oxidative, dietary, activity and sleep pathways, noting that pediatric evidence remains limited.

41574487.takeaway: Reviewing 10 randomized trials and 15 nonrandomized studies, the authors report evidence supporting continuous glucose monitoring in adults with type 2 diabetes not using insulin.

41574498.takeaway: Among 11,758 US veterans on insulin pumps, COVID-19 telehealth expansion was linked to more specialty appointment delays and fewer HbA1c tests, without more poor control or emergency admissions.

41574541.takeaway: In 35 children under 6 with type 1 diabetes on a closed-loop system, switching to diluted insulin reduced nighttime time below range, glucose variability and pump alarms.

41574571.takeaway: Across 27 studies of automated insulin delivery in type 1 diabetes, pooled data were possible only for PSQI; among adult users, sleep quality showed no significant change in randomized trials.

41574582.takeaway: In a Swedish national registry, automated insulin delivery was consistently linked to significant HbA1c reductions in adults with type 1 diabetes, greatest with Tandem Control-IQ.

41574583.takeaway: The fifth-generation 16-day continuous glucose monitoring system gave accurate readings across the full wear period, regardless of sensor placement site or glucose concentration.

41574585.takeaway: Dexcom One+ CGM readings were compared with standard glucose testing in 48 cardiac ICU patients with diabetes or stress hyperglycemia, using 999 paired samples to assess accuracy, sensor detachment and skin safety.

41574589.takeaway: AI-informed retinal venous features on routine fundus images may offer a noninvasive way to detect diabetes and prediabetes in Asian Indians.

41574590.takeaway: In a real-world long-term study, CGM metrics gave more informative risk stratification than HbA1c alone for incident diabetic retinopathy.

41575463.takeaway: In propensity-matched adults with diabetes, inhaled insulin was not associated with lung cancer but was linked to a higher composite COPD risk (1.6% vs 0.5%; RR 3.45) than rapid-acting insulin.

41575892.takeaway: In 34 children with glucocorticoid-induced short stature treated with rhGH, growth was compared with 20 historical controls who had spontaneous catch-up growth after steroid cessation.

41575896.takeaway: In 716 GH-treated Belgian girls with Turner syndrome (BELGROW, 1985–2022), monosomy 45,X was the most common karyotype, though its share fell between the two study periods.

41578923.takeaway: In 37 girls with central precocious puberty, 6-monthly triptorelin kept LH and estradiol suppressed through 36 months, and the bone-age ratio fell by 24 months.

41580998.takeaway: After at least six months of CGM use, children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes had significantly lower fear of hypoglycemia, with no change in PedsQL quality-of-life scores.

41580999.takeaway: In three genetically confirmed 46,XY cases of 17β-HSD3 deficiency with female-appearing genitalia, rearing and gender decisions differed, highlighting the complexity of gender assignment and surgical timing.

41582533.takeaway: An 8-year-old girl with Graves' disease presented with symptomatic hypercalcemia, vomiting and impending thyroid storm, underscoring the need for prompt evaluation of mineral abnormalities.

41585414.takeaway: In 58 adolescents, apelin was lower in those with type 1 diabetes for over 7 years than in recent-onset cases and healthy controls, while the other myokines did not differ.

41585787.takeaway: A multidisciplinary Delphi consensus produced the NAVETA Obesity Consensus Tool, standardizing assessment of adults with obesity using validated patient-reported outcomes and clinical indicators within a value-based model.

41585793.takeaway: Reviews acquired pediatric hypothyroidism, most often Hashimoto thyroiditis in iodine-sufficient regions, using four cases to show typical and atypical presentations that can delay diagnosis and treatment.

41585809.takeaway: An 11-year-old boy with Graves disease and complete heart block had resolution of the block three months after vitamin D3 supplementation began, despite being euthyroid on methimazole.

41585812.takeaway: Among 994 children with type 1 diabetes, overweight or obesity (15.9% combined) was linked to a worse metabolic presentation at diagnosis, including lower pH and bicarbonate.

41585813.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with poorly controlled type 1 diabetes developed pulmonary mucormycosis from an unusual Rhizopus species; treatment combined glucose stabilization with management of coinfections.

41589729.takeaway: In 105 children with idiopathic short stature, PEG-rhGH and sequential therapy gave greater height velocity and height SDS gains than short-acting rhGH at one year, with PEG-rhGH showing the best adherence.

41591961.takeaway: In 50 children aged 2–18 with type 1 diabetes, six months of open-source Loop automated insulin delivery raised time in range from 68.3% to 72.7% and lowered HbA1c from 7.0% to 6.6%.

41601933.takeaway: A Saudi Delphi expert panel reached consensus on 27 statements guiding CGM use in non-intensively managed adults with type 2 diabetes, including recommended patient profiles for continuous and intermittent use.

41601935.takeaway: In 81 girls with Turner syndrome, phalangeal length ratios were lower than in a reference cohort of 4,082 bone-age radiographs, and 27.2% had a low 4:3 metacarpal ratio.

41603372.takeaway: In a secondary analysis of the DiGest trial of 425 pregnant women with GDM and BMI of 25 or more, the study compared pregnancy and neonatal outcomes between 50 women with PCOS and 375 without.

41606799.takeaway: In a single-center retrospective series, rhIGF-1 improved glycemic control, fasting tolerance and some growth in patients with Donohue or Rabson-Mendenhall syndrome, but two had poor response or intolerance and died in infancy.

41607087.takeaway: In 36 children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes, baseline muscle mass did not differ from 43 matched healthy controls, and muscle mass and strength were tracked for six months after insulin.

41607458.takeaway: A 14-year-old boy had bilateral intracranial mixed germ cell tumors together with bilateral retroperitoneal ganglioneuroblastoma, a first reported co-occurrence, alongside a 16p11.2 microdeletion and an ALK variant.

41607466.takeaway: In 1,286 third-grade students in Ningbo, China, screen time was analyzed for links to obesity-related metabolic indicators, with cardiorespiratory fitness tested as a mediator.

41608202.takeaway: Using four routine clinical features, an interpretable gradient-boosted Cox model was developed to predict survival in 97 children with adrenocortical tumors from a German registry.

41611635.takeaway: Across 47 reported 46,XY patients with NR0B1 duplication, complete gonadal dysgenesis was most common (66%), and maternal inheritance was reported in 63.3%.

41611636.takeaway: Of 72 people with Down syndrome, 48 (66.7%) had primary hypothyroidism, and 58.3% of those were anti-TPO negative.

41612845.takeaway: Two affected siblings with Meier-Gorlin syndrome from a recurrent homozygous DONSON variant had thumb aplasia, and one child's height improved over time without intervention.

41612862.takeaway: Three Indian children with Berardinelli-Seip congenital lipodystrophy type 2 (two siblings and one unrelated child) showed generalized fat loss, hepatosplenomegaly and metabolic disturbances.

41614605.takeaway: In 100 patients with Kallmann syndrome and 100 matched controls, increased cortical thickness was associated with cognitive impairment on MRI and neuropsychological testing.

41614610.takeaway: In 62 children born SGA with short stature, once-weekly somapacitan was followed to 208 weeks; 55 completed treatment, including 48 who switched from daily GH or lower doses.

41614681.takeaway: Over 37 years at a Chilean referral center, 87 patients with craniopharyngioma (75% childhood-onset) had pituitary dysfunction in 54% at diagnosis, rising to 71% after initial treatment.

41615464.takeaway: In 114 adults with type 1 diabetes on injections at a Baltimore center, the time from AID decision to initiation was analyzed against insurance and other care-pathway factors.

41615893.takeaway: The CrescNet registry added an achondroplasia module across 10 European countries and reports preliminary real-world outcomes of vosoritide treatment over 3 years.

41616799.takeaway: The phase 3 ORION-16 trial randomized adolescents with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia to inclisiran or placebo for one year, followed by an open-label year for all participants.

41618962.takeaway: Across nine studies with 465 hypoglycemic CGM–reference pairs in adults on non-critical care wards, CGM mean absolute relative differences in the hypoglycemia range ranged from 7.6% to 53.3%.

41622409.takeaway: Case reports illustrate practical use of Technosphere inhaled insulin in type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, pregnancy complicated by T2D, and exercise-related glycemic management.

41622410.takeaway: Reviews how Technosphere inhaled insulin can address barriers such as needle aversion, injection pain and variable absorption, with HbA1c reductions comparable to rapid-acting analogs and fewer hypoglycemic events.

41622411.takeaway: Argues that inhaled Technosphere insulin could help overcome therapeutic inertia, since only about 25% of people on prandial insulin reach an HbA1c below 7%, and fear of hypoglycemia and needle aversion limit adherence.

41622412.takeaway: Reviews the potential of Technosphere inhaled insulin's fast-on, fast-off profile to reduce the hypoglycemia that is common with current rapid-acting insulins.

41622413.takeaway: Reviews evidence for combining Technosphere inhaled insulin with automated insulin delivery to address postprandial hyperglycemia and the slow action of subcutaneous insulin, while noting challenges in matching its pharmacokinetics.

41622414.takeaway: Two case presentations describe possible uses of inhaled Technosphere insulin to prevent ketoacidosis and manage exercise, based on its faster systemic availability, though definitive studies have not been done.

41622415.takeaway: Reviews unmet needs in insulin-treated diabetes, arguing that glycemic control remains suboptimal for most people despite newer insulins and technologies, and that complication costs strain the U.S. health system.

41622416.takeaway: Reviews inhaled Technosphere insulin for gestational diabetes and pediatric type 1 diabetes, discussing potential gains in glycemic management, hypoglycemia reduction and adherence along with remaining challenges.

41622417.takeaway: Offers the authors' perspective on Afrezza dosing, titration, patient selection and education, aimed at the clinician confusion and skepticism that have limited its adoption.

41622419.takeaway: Reviews evidence that Technosphere inhaled insulin has no concerning adverse events beyond mild, transient cough, and presents pulmonary safety data in type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

41622420.takeaway: Briefly reviews the 30-year development of inhaled insulin formulations designed to mimic physiological insulin secretion in type 1 and insulin-requiring type 2 diabetes.

41623908.takeaway: In children with central precocious puberty given 6-monthly leuprolide depot, LH was suppressed in 93–100% of children through 144 weeks, and basal sex hormones stayed suppressed in all.

41623909.takeaway: In 56 children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, boys’ bone age was more delayed (1.2 vs 0.4 years in girls), and predicted height exceeded adult height in 4 males without prior orthopedic surgery.

41625243.takeaway: In 23,305 Chinese adults undergoing health examinations, metabolic indicators were analyzed as risk factors for thyroid nodules, and a simplified predictive model was built from the independent factors.

41625247.takeaway: Among 3,541 Beijing residents aged 18–79, the study identified risk factors for metabolic syndrome and developed a column-line graph prediction model, assessed in a separate validation set.

41626659.takeaway: In a thiamine-responsive megaloblastic anemia case series, early high-dose thiamine rapidly stabilized glucose and normalized blood counts, though one child's hearing loss progressed despite treatment.

41630573.takeaway: Among 1,321 infants, customized birth-weight percentiles that include maternal height and weight classified more newborns as SGA (11.9%) than conventional percentiles (9.8%).

41632726.takeaway: In an open-label, uncontrolled extension of 280 children with idiopathic short stature, once-weekly PEG-rhGH was evaluated over two years for change in height SDS, height velocity and safety.

41632727.takeaway: Of 19 neonatal diabetes cases in Ireland (2006–2024), 12 were permanent and 7 transient; KCNJ11 variants were the most common genetic cause in permanent cases, and genetic results changed a parent's management.

41634173.takeaway: Using experience-based co-design over 12 months, with community members and clinicians, this Western Australian project worked toward a clinical pathway for families of children with pre-symptomatic type 1 diabetes.

41634175.takeaway: In 5,065 multi-ethnic mother-infant pairs, maternal and fetal genetic risk for insulin deficiency and insulin resistance affected fetal growth through distinct pathways, tested with mediation analysis of maternal glucose and BMI.

41635543.takeaway: In 411 girls with central precocious puberty, diagnostic models for rapidly progressive disease that included serum osteocalcin consistently outperformed models without it.

41636640.takeaway: Among 11,863 five-year childhood cancer survivors in Germany, 31.3% had an endocrine or metabolic disease, versus 16.4% of matched comparators (prevalence ratio 1.9).

41637567.takeaway: In 53 girls with premature pubarche, the study measured adrenal androgens, including 11-oxygenated forms, to test whether they predict growth characteristics, compared with 36 age-matched girls without pubarche.

41637571.takeaway: Over 24 years at one children's hospital, the study reviewed the natural history of pituitary incidentalomas found on MRI to identify features that might predict later endocrinopathy or neurologic symptoms.

41639978.takeaway: In 20,399 pregnant women without known thyroid disease, 702 children (3.4%) had birth defects, and maternal TSH did not differ significantly between children with and without defects.

41640085.takeaway: In 999 Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes, higher time in tight range on CGM was linked to lower odds of microvascular complications; the top quartile had an adjusted OR of 0.30.

41640091.takeaway: In a 30-year-old woman with type 1 diabetes on empagliflozin, a low-carbohydrate diet and exercise, continuous ketone monitoring detected 14 hours of ketosis despite euglycemia on CGM.

41640105.takeaway: In 80 children aged 4–17 with diabetes on Technosphere insulin in the INHALE-1 extension, HbA1c rose by a mean of 0.38 percentage points between weeks 26 and 52.

41640110.takeaway: In five trials of 6,140 adults, oral orforglipron produced dose-dependent weight loss, over 6 kg at 36 mg with diabetes and approaching 12 kg without diabetes, with more GI adverse events at higher doses.

41640116.takeaway: Across nine RCTs of noninsulin drugs added to automated insulin delivery in type 1 diabetes, the pooled evidence on time in range was analyzed for SGLT-2 inhibitors, GLP-1 receptor agonists and DPP-4 inhibitors.
