41645514.takeaway: Interviews with families and clinicians in the UK UNBIASED study identified barriers to diabetes technology access for children from ethnic minority and low-income backgrounds, with recommendations to address them.

41645534.takeaway: In 90 patients with poorly controlled type 1 diabetes, the MiniMed 780G hybrid closed-loop system was reported to improve vascular and endothelial markers over 12 months, with changes linked to CGM metrics.

41645537.takeaway: In 379 adults with type 1 diabetes followed for about five years, automated insulin delivery users had less incident diabetic retinopathy than injection users (6.1% vs 18.9%; hazard ratio 0.33).

41645539.takeaway: In 43 children with type 1 diabetes who ate carbohydrates without a premeal bolus, the MiniMed 780G system had the lowest postprandial glucose AUC, ahead of Control-IQ and CamAPS.

41645547.takeaway: Reviewing CGM accuracy standards in Asia-Pacific, the authors highlight FDA iCGM criteria as the most stringent and explore adopting them with IFCC reporting recommendations, adapted to regional settings.

41647110.takeaway: Compares pediatric and adult gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms, finding pediatric tumors strongly enriched for hereditary predisposition, with pediatric care relying mainly on registry data and adult extrapolation.

41651803.takeaway: In a 16-week, two-site RCT of 30 adults with type 2 diabetes on insulin degludec, algorithmic CGM-based titration was tested for feasibility and noninferiority in time in range against self-monitoring titration.

41652263.takeaway: In 15,717 children in the ABIS birth cohort, red meat intake during pregnancy or at age 1 was not associated with type 1 diabetes risk.

41652324.takeaway: A 2022–2023 national survey of 2,929 pregnant women and 11,221 schoolchildren in Iran reassessed iodine status, testing whether iodine deficiency has recurred in pregnancy despite decades of salt iodization.

41652653.takeaway: A prospective quality-improvement intervention-control study at a New York City academic center evaluated whether a virtual glucose management service improved inpatient glycemic outcomes in adults.

41652832.takeaway: In two children after total pancreatectomy with islet auto-transplantation, automated insulin delivery achieved time in range of 71% and 81%, with time below range of 1–2%.

41655234.takeaway: In 85 children with Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome, the study examined whether genotype, including pUPD11 and KATP variants, determined hyperinsulinism severity as measured by glucose infusion rate, diazoxide response and surgical need.

41658513.takeaway: A 12-year-old boy with impaired fasting glucose had a novel heterozygous CEL variant without pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, illustrating phenotypic variability in CEL-MODY.

41658991.takeaway: In 55 boys with Klinefelter syndrome, height gain was greater than in a reference cohort during childhood and puberty, with earlier pubertal growth onset (11.3 vs 11.8 years).

41659330.takeaway: A systematic review of 87 studies (45 human, 32 animal) proposes that gut-brain axis disruption by low-dose endocrine-disrupting chemical mixtures contributes to precocious puberty, with consistent gut dysbiosis after perinatal exposure.

41659339.takeaway: In 788 autistic children compared with 301 non-autistic children, TSH was similar, while free T4 and free T3 were significantly lower in the autistic group.

41660725.takeaway: Reviews six modifiable factors of postprandial glycemic response, including hormones, gastric emptying, amylase, diet, exercise and sleep, as possible targets for personalized intervention.

41660790.takeaway: In 7,965 MiniMed 780G users across 19 MENAT countries, mean time in range was 71.7%, GMI 6.9%, and time in tight range 48.9%.

41662565.takeaway: Comparing children who developed islet autoimmunity with controls in two pediatric cohorts, the study found a distinct enterovirus antibody signature in cases, with an immunogenic hotspot in the viral polymerase.

41665666.takeaway: Residents of Cantalupo, Italy, aged 1–100 years were screened by fingerprick for type 1 diabetes and coeliac autoantibodies, with 50.1% of the eligible population participating.

41665939.takeaway: Among 1,252 children across five groups, treatment-naive children born SGA were more insulin-resistant than those with isolated GH deficiency, with levels approaching those seen in children with obesity.

41669242.takeaway: A mini-review hypothesizes that rapid-onset diabetes in preterm infants is driven by intermittent hypoxia from apnea of infancy, and outlines research gaps and possible interventions.

41669244.takeaway: Proposes a risk-stratified pathway for isolated premature thelarche that favors watchful waiting for many girls, using a tiered approach based on natural history and progression risk.

41669248.takeaway: Among 24,408 children with type 1 diabetes in Germany (2015–2023), DKA at diagnosis was not significantly lower overall in states with screening (RR 0.96), but was lower in the most likely screened subgroup (RR 0.88).

41669543.takeaway: In growing male rats, combined endurance and resistance training raised bone mineral density above controls, although exercised rats had lower body weight.

41673946.takeaway: In consented ICU patients with known hyperglycemia, Dexcom G7 readings were compared with laboratory or point-of-care glucose measurements to determine accuracy by MARD and Clarke Error Grid analysis.

41674363.takeaway: In 74 children on daily GH therapy, those with high adherence (85–110%) gained more height SDS over two years than those with low adherence (mean 0.87 vs 0.33).

41675570.takeaway: Integrates how epilepsy and metabolic disorders, including glucose abnormalities, vitamin B6 deficiency and ketogenic diets, influence each other in a bidirectional cycle.

41675571.takeaway: Measured ghrelin and cholecystokinin along the gut of juvenile Sparus aurata (gilthead seabream) during fasting and refeeding on three diets.

41675640.takeaway: In 521 patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma, BRAF V600E co-occurring with TERT, PIK3CA or TP53 was the strongest independent risk factor for central lymph node metastasis (OR 6.31).

41678360.takeaway: In 49 indeterminate thyroid nodules from patients under 21, the Afirma GSC identified all 14 malignancies as suspicious (sensitivity 100%), and all 30 classified benign were benign.

41678362.takeaway: In a nationwide cohort of 466,462 term infants, pregestational diabetes in mothers was linked to higher risk of delayed language, personal-social and gross motor milestones through 24 months.

41678364.takeaway: Long-term follow-up of all 71 known Norwegian patients with APS-1 (49 classical, 22 nonclassical), 1996–2025, characterized clinical progression and its links to autoantibody profiles and AIRE mutations.

41678418.takeaway: In 38 adolescents with type 1 diabetes starting insulin pump therapy, HbA1c did not change over 12 months, but those with disordered eating behaviors had consistently higher HbA1c.

41681122.takeaway: In a 12-week randomized trial of 73 adults with type 1 diabetes, automated insulin delivery without meal announcement was compared with hybrid closed-loop with meal announcement for time in range.

41684056.takeaway: In 64 community-dwelling adults with type 1 diabetes, 61% kept ketones below 0.6 mmol/L on continuous monitoring, and glucose was about 47 mg/dL higher during episodes of ketones of 1.0 mmol/L or more.

41684304.takeaway: A 55-year-old woman with Graves' disease who was hyperthyroid on methimazole became euthyroid within a week of starting batoclimab, an FcRn blocker, and remained off methimazole and euthyroid 23 months later.

41684453.takeaway: Among 66 children under 5 with congenital hypothyroidism, early-treated (under 3 months) and late-treated children were compared on growth and body proportionality against 64 healthy controls.

41685229.takeaway: In 40 children with GH deficiency on once-weekly somatrogon for at least six months, height SDS rose similarly in naive and switched patients at six months, while naive patients gained more by 18–24 months.

41685245.takeaway: Two case reports show diabetic sensory neuropathy in the mouth: a 14-year-old with type 1 diabetes had hyperaesthesia, and a 55-year-old with type 2 diabetes had reduced sensation, both relevant to dental care.

41685246.takeaway: Reviews long-acting growth hormone for pediatric GHD, covering molecular half-life strategies, pharmacokinetics, efficacy and safety of approved and candidate agents, and the need for real-world evidence.

41689273.takeaway: In 16 preterm infants under 30 weeks, urinary glucocorticoid precursors stayed high until term-equivalent age and then fell, while total glucocorticoid production did not change significantly over time.

41689466.takeaway: In 106 MEN2A gene carriers who had surgery, a preoperative basal calcitonin above 12.60 ng/L identified medullary thyroid carcinoma with 94.4% sensitivity and 74.3% specificity.

41689851.takeaway: Reviews how continuous glucose monitoring can detect early dysglycemia in cystic fibrosis, where postprandial hyperglycemia may precede CFRD by years, while noting limited guidance on managing these abnormalities.

41689852.takeaway: Across six diabetes summer camp weeks in Northern Greece, the MiniMed 780G automated insulin delivery system was compared with the MiniMed 640G sensor-augmented pump for glycemic control in people with type 1 diabetes.

41689855.takeaway: A narrative review of how heat and cold-chain lapses affect insulin stability in real-world use, calling for holistic evaluation of insulin's biological activity outside refrigeration.

41692841.takeaway: Among 21,774 people in Sweden diagnosed with type 1 diabetes before age 30, geospatial analysis of residential history found significant high- and low-risk clusters of incidence across life-stage exposure windows.

41693148.takeaway: In infants with severe hyperinsulinism and Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome who had pancreatectomy, islet insulin-secretion patterns were similar to those previously described in infants with KATP-channel hyperinsulinism.

41693150.takeaway: Preterm infants given antenatal glucocorticoids in phase or out of phase with maternal circadian cortisol were compared on glucocorticoid receptor sensitivity.

41693151.takeaway: In 388 children treated for primary brain tumors at one center (2000–2025), the study examined the prevalence, timing and risk factors of hypothalamic-pituitary disorders after treatment; gliomas were 66.2% of tumors.

41693157.takeaway: In 10 patients with P450 oxidoreductase deficiency (ages 8–27), hypertension was present in 80% of those evaluated, and microvascular and vasoactive-mediator findings were compared with 41 healthy controls.

41693442.takeaway: In 52 hospitalized patients with diabetes and chronic kidney disease, real-time Dexcom G6 CGM accuracy was assessed against point-of-care glucose by MARD, stratified by eGFR category.

41693672.takeaway: A Saudi multidisciplinary consensus, built on a 2016–2024 literature review and a Delphi process, calls for regulatory harmonization, robust CGM validation and transparent performance reporting.

41694565.takeaway: In Thai patients with atypical diabetes seen in a Bangkok clinic, targeted sequencing of 33 monogenic diabetes genes was used to identify MODY and assess the clinical value of genetic testing.

41695839.takeaway: Among 2,203 pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes, 101 (4.6%) also had celiac disease, and those with both conditions were younger at T1D diagnosis (median 9 vs 12 years).

41697894.takeaway: In 17 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, six versions of a virtual exercise game program with peer coaches were tested for feasibility, and participants rated the program, comfort and coaches highly.

41697902.takeaway: In 34 children aged 0.4–11 years with classical 21-hydroxylase-deficient CAH, gross motor, working memory and adaptive behavior scores were reported as lower than normative means.

41697906.takeaway: In 19 children with heterozygous IHH variants, daily rhGH raised median height SDS from −2.6 to −1.9 after one year, and 16 of 19 had height SDS of at least −2.0 at last follow-up.

41697933.takeaway: Of 39 children with Silver-Russell syndrome given combined GH and a GnRH analogue, 30 (76.9%) reached adult height, and treatment tolerability was assessed.

41698239.takeaway: Serum adrenomedullin was higher in 46 adolescents with Hashimoto thyroiditis than in 41 matched controls (p=0.016) and correlated with TSH.

41700350.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl with severe short stature and dysmorphism had a homozygous CEP57 variant (c.834_844dupCAATGTTCAGC), classified as likely pathogenic, in a report of mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 2.

41700684.takeaway: In a 12-week RCT of 35 women with overweight or obesity, adding intermittently scanned CGM to a structured lifestyle program was tested for weight loss and adherence against CGM only at baseline and end.

41701609.takeaway: Using Medical Expenditure Panel Survey data, the study traced per-capita spending on glucose-lowering medications among US adults with diabetes from 2000 to 2022, by drug class and subgroup.

41701914.takeaway: In the Hong Kong Childhood Diabetes Registry (2018–2023), mean HbA1c fell from 8.3% to 8.0%, though diabetes technology adoption remained suboptimal despite reimbursement.

41703423.takeaway: In a randomized study of healthy volunteers and adults with diabetes during standardized normobaric hypoxia, Dexcom G6 and FreeStyle Libre CGM accuracy was compared against venous plasma glucose by MARD.

41703432.takeaway: A Spanish cost-consequence model estimated the cost impact of CamAPS FX automated insulin delivery over standard care in type 1 diabetes pregnancy, based on a 0.3% HbA1c reduction.

41704483.takeaway: In 246 children admitted with severe hypocalcemia to a Vietnamese national children's hospital (2018–2024), seizures occurred in 79.2%, and vitamin D deficiency (67.1%) and hypoparathyroidism (28.0%) were the leading causes.

41705726.takeaway: A scoping review of 50 studies found eating behavior poorly assessed in craniopharyngioma, with only 10 using validated tools, although it may contribute to craniopharyngioma-associated obesity.

41707689.takeaway: ESPE and ESE joint guidance for transition from pediatric to adult endocrine care, built from 351 recommendations across 55 articles and refined by expert focus groups, sets out practical transition recommendations.

41709526.takeaway: In 25 children with CAH compared with 25 frequency-matched healthy peers, PedsQL quality-of-life scores were similar overall, with age-stratified differences examined.

41710163.takeaway: In 222 preterm infants born at 32 weeks or earlier, serial thyroid function trajectories from birth to discharge were tested as predictors of neurodevelopment at two years and of diffusion MRI correlates.

41710192.takeaway: In a New York City prospective birth cohort, early and mid-pregnancy urinary phthalate and bisphenol levels were analyzed for associations with gestational diabetes and glucose disturbance.

41710194.takeaway: In 39 healthy young men, those with low areal bone density had poorer bone microarchitecture and lower lean mass than men with normal density.

41711038.takeaway: A narrative review of transition to adult care in X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets emphasizes early readiness assessment, structured education, pediatric-adult collaboration and continued monitored therapy.

41711566.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with hereditary tyrosinemia type 1 had a porphyria-like crisis with SIADH-related hyponatremia and seizures, and fully recovered after hemin, fluid restriction and intensive care.

41712317.takeaway: Four children with APECED from one UK pediatric clinic had chronic candidiasis before endocrinopathy, with hypoparathyroidism the most common endocrine presentation (3 of 4).

41712405.takeaway: In 60 children with short stature grouped by growth hormone stimulation peak (≤7, 7–10 and ≥10 ng/mL), exome sequencing was used to assess its added diagnostic value and genotype–phenotype links.

41712477.takeaway: ESPE and ESE joint guidance for transition from pediatric to adult endocrine care, built from 351 recommendations across 55 articles and refined by expert focus groups, sets out practical transition recommendations.

41712606.takeaway: In 88 pre-pubertal children with idiopathic short stature, once-weekly somapacitan gave a 52-week mean height velocity of 10.2 cm/year, similar to 10.6 cm/year with daily GH.

41717547.takeaway: Among 35 children and 79 adults with differentiated thyroid cancer and distant metastases, pediatric metastases mostly involved a single organ, mainly the lungs (32 of 35), while adult metastases were often multi-organ (45 of 79).

41718722.takeaway: In a prospective birth cohort of 2,050 pregnant women, a 30-metabolite midpregnancy signature for GDM identified normoglycemic women with nearly twofold higher odds of preterm birth and large-for-gestational-age infants.

41724658.takeaway: In 12 healthy adults during a 7-day water-only fast, the share of CGM readings below 70 mg/dL rose from 3.0% at baseline to 66.0% by day 5.

41724659.takeaway: Examines whether cabin pressure changes during flight cause unwanted or incorrect insulin pump doses under real-life conditions, which pressure-chamber studies may not capture.

41725275.takeaway: An 18-year-old girl with NSUN3-related mitochondrial disease developed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy at age 15, which the authors propose as a new phenotypic feature of the disorder.

41726151.takeaway: In 341 Chinese school-age children with type 1 diabetes surveyed during COVID-19, structural equation modeling tested whether self-management mediated the link between diabetes distress and quality of life.

41727682.takeaway: Across 1,138 hand radiographs from children with syndromic, endocrine and lysosomal storage disorders, the open-source Deeplasia system was validated for bone age against multiple expert raters.

41727684.takeaway: In 96 children with 21-hydroxylase-deficient CAH, adrenal crises occurred in 20.8%, and monitoring strategies were examined to inform care where full biochemical panels are unavailable.

41727685.takeaway: Single-nuclei RNA sequencing of normal thyroid tissue from three pediatric or young adult patients identified seven major cell types, with thyrocytes the most heterogeneous, including subsets linked to hormone synthesis and transport.

41727686.takeaway: A systematic review of 18 homozygous RET C634Y cases found medullary thyroid carcinoma in 83.3%, versus 30.6% of heterozygous cases, with higher MTC penetrance and node-positive metastasis in homozygous carriers.

41729832.takeaway: Memory regulatory T cells were raised in 38 patients with new-onset type 1 diabetes and 24 siblings versus 18 healthy controls, with no patient–sibling difference, suggesting a candidate early marker.

41730813.takeaway: This review finds fear of hypoglycaemia, diabetes distress, depression, disordered eating and sleep disorders common in adults with diabetes; psychological interventions reduce symptoms in the short term, though long-term outcomes are uncertain.

41735586.takeaway: In 45 adults with type 2 diabetes at high cardiovascular risk, 26 weeks of canagliflozin 100 mg/day reduced CMR-quantified myocardial fibrosis compared with sitagliptin.

41735800.takeaway: Among 45 children surviving at least five years after high-risk neuroblastoma, 24 (53%) developed long-term thyroid toxicity, at a median of 7.5 years.

41737050.takeaway: A systematic review of observational studies in children with new-onset type 1 diabetes assessed biomarkers of partial remission across clinical, CGM, HLA, immune, hormonal, proteomic and microRNA domains.

41739851.takeaway: In 809 childhood cancer survivors exposed to hypothalamic-pituitary radiation, pituitary hormone deficiency was associated with rare TNS2 variants in the St. Jude Lifetime Cohort.

41739856.takeaway: Across 2,728 thyroid fine-needle aspirations in patients aged 0–25, age-specific malignancy risks were calculated, with malignancy prevalence among operated nodules falling with age.

41741810.takeaway: Using 16,430 exercise sessions from 834 people with type 1 diabetes aged 12–80, a simplified model using starting glucose, exercise duration and trend arrows predicted exercise hypoglycemia (ROC AUC 0.87).

41742372.takeaway: In 14 new patients with POLD1-related lipodystrophy (MDPL syndrome), nine different variants were identified, and phenotypes of p.Ser605del carriers were compared with those of missense-variant carriers.

41742375.takeaway: In 226 females in the Raine Study cohort, childhood-to-adolescent sleep behavior problems were examined for prospective association with a PCOS diagnosis at age 14.

41742816.takeaway: In 112 children with Turner syndrome referred to dermatology, skin and hair findings occurred in 86.6%, nail findings in 63.4%, and oral mucosal findings in 17.0%.

41742817.takeaway: Among 176 children aged 8–18 (84 with MASLD, 92 controls), the study examined gastrointestinal symptoms as a correlate of sleep disturbance in MASLD.

41746871.takeaway: A boy with 21-hydroxylase deficiency and a concurrent POR variant presented with absent hyperandrogenism and delayed puberty, pointing to impaired 17-OHP-to-androstenedione conversion.

41747741.takeaway: In 130 adults with type 2 diabetes not on prandial insulin, a breath volatile-organic-compound glucose algorithm was trained on 100 participants and validated on 30 during a standardized meal test.

41747751.takeaway: In a multicentre randomized trial of people aged 4–70 with type 1 diabetes and HbA1c 7.5–11%, tubeless automated insulin delivery was compared with multiple daily injections for glycaemic outcomes and safety.

41756009.takeaway: Reviews evidence linking the global rise in childhood obesity to rising early-onset cancer incidence, and argues for urgent obesity prevention while longitudinal evidence matures.

41757240.takeaway: In a retrospective real-world cohort, the study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of anti-Müllerian hormone for primary ovarian insufficiency.

41758754.takeaway: In 153 treated Chinese children with GHD, once-weekly lonapegsomatropin was compared with daily somatropin over 52 weeks, with annualized height velocity at week 52 as the primary endpoint.

41758964.takeaway: Sequencing IL2RA in 290 people diagnosed with diabetes before 6 months found five new biallelic cases, four of whom presented in the first month of life; of 22 known cases, 14 (64%) had early-onset diabetes.

41761663.takeaway: In 92 adolescents, overweight groups with normal or impaired glucose regulation had worse bone mineral content and tibial microarchitecture and strength, with sex-related differences examined.

41761702.takeaway: In 2,057 paired samples, an in-house LC-MS/MS IGF-1 assay with a Dutch Lifelines normative dataset was compared with a ligand-binding assay for agreement and clinical validity.

41762065.takeaway: Argues that breath volatile-organic-compound monitoring could offer noninvasive glucose monitoring for type 2 diabetes, which may improve adherence and quality of life and possibly reduce CGM costs.

41762432.takeaway: Part 2 of SIAMS–SIEDP guidelines gives GRADE-based recommendations for diagnosing and managing andrological disorders from childhood and adolescence into transition age.

41762714.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome from a sacrococcygeal teratoma containing a neuroendocrine tumor was identified by somatostatin-receptor PET, and cortisol and ACTH normalized after resection.

41763233.takeaway: Reviews how type 1 diabetes outcomes have moved from survival to residual cardiovascular risk and burden, arguing that HbA1c reduction alone will not close the gap and that physiological resilience is the next target.

41763234.takeaway: In a prospective cohort of US veterans with type 2 diabetes, the combined association of GLP-1 receptor agonist use and healthy lifestyle habits with major adverse cardiovascular events was examined.

41764031.takeaway: ChatGPT-4o estimated carbohydrate content from images of 60 fruits and vegetables and 60 composite meals, agreeing with manual counts in 93.3% of fruit and vegetable estimates, rising to 95% with a size reference.

41764080.takeaway: A narrative review of inpatient automated insulin delivery finds feasibility and safety, with better time in range and no clear rise in hypoglycemia, for both hospital-started and continued personal systems.

41764081.takeaway: In 143 people with type 2 diabetes, SGLT2 inhibitor users had a higher hemoglobin glycation index (0.3 vs 0.1) and a lower glycated albumin-to-HbA1c ratio than non-users, indicating greater HbA1c–GMI discordance.

41766136.takeaway: In a single-centre Indian cohort with Bardet-Biedl syndrome, the genotype spectrum and clinical features were described, with BBS10 and BBS2 among the most frequently involved genes.

41766631.takeaway: In 23,023 US NHANES participants (2007–2016), screen exposure and sleep indicators were analyzed for links to type 2 diabetes, with sleep duration and diagnosed sleep disorders as possible effect modifiers.

41766933.takeaway: Pooled data from 183 children with achondroplasia in two placebo-controlled trials compared vosoritide with placebo for one-year change in genu varum, using radiographic lower-limb measures.

41766939.takeaway: In piglets, atrazine exposure from gestation through lactation lowered body weight at postnatal day 10 and altered ovarian protein profiles in female offspring.

41767368.takeaway: Across 20 observational studies with 10,960 type 1 diabetes cases, early-life antibiotic exposure was analyzed by period: preconception, prenatal, neonatal and up to 24 months after birth.

41767372.takeaway: Reviews monitoring of 21-hydroxylase deficiency, noting that between-centre variation in androstenedione and 17-hydroxyprogesterone reflects differing monitoring practices, sampling timing and assay methods.

41767373.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl with primary hyperparathyroidism and coxa vara with genu valgus became severely hypercalcemic after osteotomy, and parathyroidectomy for a parathyroid adenoma achieved biochemical cure.

41767394.takeaway: In 136 Chinese patients with HNF1A-MODY, the single-centre series identified 22 distinct variants, 8 of them novel, and genotype–phenotype links with fasting C-peptide and lipids were analyzed.

41767402.takeaway: In 50 children with type 1 diabetes using MiniMed 780G, time in tight range peaked at 60.8% at six months and fell to 56.5% after three years, while CV and BMI z-scores were unchanged.

41770102.takeaway: In mice with type 2 diabetes and cultured rat cardiomyocytes, Yap was elevated under high glucose and palmitic acid, and its role in hypertrophy and fibrosis was tested through the miR-22-3p–Sirt1 axis.

41770120.takeaway: A Canadian cost-effectiveness model compared six type 1 diabetes autoantibody screening strategies, including general-population and family-history-based screening at ages 2 and 6, or once at age 4.

41770448.takeaway: An Italian expert board developed a shared approach to diagnosing and managing ENPP1 deficiency, covering GACI1 and ARHR2, which cause lifelong physical and emotional burden.

41773465.takeaway: In 225 physically active adults without diabetes but with mild dysglycemia, eight weeks of CGM wear showed significant changes over four wear periods in time in tight range and time below range.

41773692.takeaway: Across 16 studies, CGM-derived metrics were compared between people with prediabetes and those with normoglycemia, with mean amplitude of glycemic excursions as the primary outcome.

41774599.takeaway: Of 562 children with type 1 diabetes at a Dutch pediatric clinic, 66 were autoantibody-negative, and their clinical and biochemical features were compared with autoantibody-positive patients.

41774755.takeaway: In 77 GH-naive prepubertal children with Noonan syndrome, once-weekly somapacitan was compared with daily GH over 52 weeks in a randomized phase 3 substudy.

41775457.takeaway: In 691 Thai participants (244 normoglycemic, 447 with type 2 diabetes), HbA1c was significantly lower in those with red blood cell genetic disorders, while fasting glucose, fructosamine and ferritin did not differ.

41776008.takeaway: Reviews how the gut microbiome may shape ageing trajectories and age-related disease through gut-organ axes, noting that its causal role remains uncertain in clinical terms.

41777157.takeaway: Machine-learning models combining clinical data with 16S gut microbiome profiles were developed to predict insulin therapy need in 205 women with gestational diabetes.

41778061.takeaway: In 100 Saudi children aged 2–14 switched from injections to Control-IQ, median HbA1c fell from 9.2% to 6.9% at six months.

41778062.takeaway: Among 150 children with type 1 diabetes followed for at least a year, growth was examined by HbA1c level and CGM use over five years, and males' height SDS declined significantly over time.

41778163.takeaway: Of 50 women referred for fertility preservation after cancer diagnosed in or shortly after pregnancy, 30 chose to proceed by egg or embryo freezing, ovarian tissue cryopreservation or postpartum planning.

41778167.takeaway: A narrative review of surgical fertility-preservation options after cancer treatment, including ovarian transposition, ovarian tissue cryopreservation, and emerging uterine transposition and transplantation.

41779164.takeaway: In 77 children with MEN1, MEN2A or MEN2B and 26 siblings, PedsQL quality-of-life scores were compared with siblings and healthy Dutch norms, with clinical associations explored.

41779453.takeaway: Among 14,870 women with gestational diabetes in a Northern California cohort, four glycemic-management trajectories were identified and related to offspring BMI and obesity risk through age 10.

41780161.takeaway: A child treated with 177Lu-DOTATATE for refractory neuroblastoma developed growth hormone deficiency and central hypothyroidism, the first reported pituitary dysfunction after this therapy in children.

41782416.takeaway: In 142 prepubertal, treatment-naive children born SGA, once-weekly somapacitan gave a 52-week height velocity of 11.0 cm/year, compared with 9.4 and 11.1 cm/year on the two daily GH doses.

41783507.takeaway: In 184 girls aged 5–9 with suspected central or early puberty and 47 prepubertal controls, DXA showed higher lumbar spine BMD in the precocious puberty group than in controls.

41783509.takeaway: A US online discrete-choice survey of patients and caregivers using short-acting GH examined which once-weekly injection-device features matter most when choosing a long-acting GH treatment.

41783511.takeaway: In 75 children aged 0 to under 5 with achondroplasia, one year of vosoritide was associated with measurable improvements in interpedicular distance and spinal canal width from L1 to L5 compared with placebo.

41783997.takeaway: In 221 patients evaluated for hereditary pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma, 143 (64.7%) carried pathogenic variants, and age under 41 with a positive family history had a 100% positive predictive value for carrying one.

41784095.takeaway: In 74 young people aged 7–25 with type 1 diabetes and HbA1c of at least 8.5%, mean HbA1c in the AID-first group fell from 10.5% at baseline to 8.3% at 52 weeks.

41785910.takeaway: In an international retrospective cohort from eight tertiary centres, the association of USP8 status and tumour size with recurrence after first pituitary surgery for Cushing's disease was assessed.

41787707.takeaway: Reviews PEX6 variants in peroxisome biogenesis disorders in children, noting that some patients have normal very-long-chain fatty acid levels and that dysregulated pexophagy may contribute to disease.

41787708.takeaway: Of 46 children born SGA on rhGH for an average of five years, hypertension frequency did not differ from 26 healthy controls, though multiple regression revealed a small increase in a blood pressure measure.

41787709.takeaway: Of 126 children with type 1 diabetes in Hong Kong, 17.5% were overweight or obese, and those with overweight or obesity had higher rates of hypertension (28.6% vs 2.9%) and dyslipidemia (90.5% vs 71.9%).

41787710.takeaway: In 92 boys with central precocious puberty treated with a GnRH agonist, final adult height (173.6 cm) exceeded target height by 1.2 cm, and predicted adult height rose by 1.3 cm after treatment.

41787711.takeaway: Among 105 infants with congenital hypothyroidism, LT4 dose per kg at 6 months was significantly lower in the 70 with transient disease than in the 35 with permanent disease.

41787712.takeaway: In 84 Korean patients with youth-onset type 2 diabetes followed into young adulthood, 33.7% had complications by about age 25, and 83% needed insulin or second-line agents.

41787713.takeaway: In adolescents aged 13–14 with excess body fat, fat mass and fat percentage were key negative predictors of whole-body bone percentage in both sexes, with PTH and CTX also associated with bone measures.

41787714.takeaway: Among 1,035 Korean adolescents aged 13–17, Endocrine Society blood pressure criteria identified more diastolic abnormalities than AAP criteria, for example 15.2% vs 8.1% of 16-year-old males.

41787735.takeaway: Across 585 children with GH deficiency in trials of long-acting GH, BMI SDS was higher at 12 months than with daily GH (mean difference 0.66 SDS, 95% CI 0.04–1.29).

41788765.takeaway: In five children with fibrous dysplasia/McCune-Albright syndrome treated with denosumab for 12 months, bone pain, bone turnover markers and lesions improved, and alkaline phosphatase fell.

41788780.takeaway: In 100 mother-child pairs, first-trimester maternal isolated hypothyroxinemia was associated with a lower offspring developmental quotient (adjusted β −3.28), most strongly in the language domain.

41788782.takeaway: In 18,971 patients with type 1 diabetes and 18,971 matched type 2 diabetes comparators in Shanghai, sex-stratified multimorbidity networks were built to compare comorbidity patterns.

41791885.takeaway: In a Finnish congenital hypothyroidism cohort of 139 exome-sequenced patients, a Finnish-enriched SLC26A7 variant was studied for clinical spectrum, thyroid histology and thyroid gene expression.

41793064.takeaway: In a UK multicentre retrospective cohort, 164 of 247 children with central precocious puberty were eligible to compare 24-weekly with 12-weekly triptorelin for HPG-axis suppression.

41793701.takeaway: An expert consensus report sets out how to use the glycemia risk index, a 0–100 CGM composite, in clinical practice and research, including for people with diabetes and cancer on glucose-altering drugs.

41793758.takeaway: In 16 children with type 1 diabetes (8 on injections, 8 on pump therapy from diagnosis) and 8 controls, multimodal MRI compared brain structure and function and related imaging features to HbA1c and working memory.

41795035.takeaway: A trans-ancestry type 1 diabetes polygenic risk score, combining GWAS data from 29,469 people across four ancestries with an HLA component, was developed and validated for performance across ancestries.

41795815.takeaway: Among 90 youths with premature adrenarche who had follow-up HbA1c, 38% of males and females developed prediabetes, and 8% of males and 6% of females developed type 2 diabetes.

41795819.takeaway: In three patients with diazoxide-unresponsive hyperinsulinism, PET imaging identified focal lesions that were resected, and diffuse disease was also present in the pancreas outside them.

41796107.takeaway: In 147 children with 46,XY DSD at an Indian tertiary hospital (median age 3.8 years), 5α-reductase type 2 deficiency or androgen insensitivity was the most common provisional diagnosis (56.5%).

41797552.takeaway: An infant with classical congenital adrenal hyperplasia had four normal newborn screens, and hyponatremia and hyperkalemia developed by day 26, with the diagnosis later made by 17-OHP testing.

41797564.takeaway: In a retrospective study of 411 people with type 1 diabetes using CGM, high glycators were identified by the HbA1c-to-updated-GMI ratio, and time to retinopathy diagnosis was compared across glycation groups.

41797577.takeaway: A 3-year-old girl with pseudo-neonatal adrenoleukodystrophy from a homozygous pathogenic variant was found to have primary adrenal insufficiency during hospitalization for a urinary tract infection.

41798193.takeaway: An umbrella review of GLP-1 receptor agonists in children and adolescents with obesity or type 2 diabetes assessed effects on body weight, HbA1c, BMI z-score and systolic blood pressure, along with adverse events.

41798194.takeaway: Among 7,799 children aged 7–12 in Chaozhou, China, a height survey estimated short-stature prevalence and identified risk factors used to build a nomogram-based prediction model.

41798197.takeaway: A boy with microcephaly and severe growth restriction was found to carry two novel RAD50 variants after five years of GH treatment, during which his height SDS improved from −3.35 to −1.28.

41798896.takeaway: In 70 girls born at 32.0–36.9 weeks, serum androstenedione and estrone fell steadily during infancy, while testosterone and DHT surged around 1–2 months of age.

41799227.takeaway: Reviews how electroacupuncture may act on premature ovarian insufficiency, comparing animal models and clinical studies, as a possible option given the thrombosis and breast cancer risks of long-term hormone replacement.

41800356.takeaway: In 2,369 Lithuanian children with type 1 diabetes (2001–2024), incidence rose from 10.8 to 36.4 per 100,000, with peaks in 2021–2022 and most new cases diagnosed from September to March.

41800491.takeaway: In 25 children from 19 families with high FT4 and non-suppressed TSH, THRB testing identified RTHβ in 33.3% tested, and ALB hotspot testing found FDH in 46.2%, supporting ALB hotspot analysis as a first-line test.

41802911.takeaway: In 151 women at risk of gestational diabetes (65 with PCOS, 86 without), early-pregnancy inflammatory and adipokine biomarkers were compared by PCOS status and tested for interaction with maternal and neonatal outcomes.

41803509.takeaway: A narrative review argues that chronically elevated basal insulin, rather than postprandial excursions, may promote adiposity and cardiometabolic disease, and highlights gaps in causal evidence.

41804540.takeaway: In a retrospective study of 61 adults with type 1 diabetes and overweight or obesity on tirzepatide, CGM metrics over 12 months were compared with 54 computer-matched controls.

41804758.takeaway: In a survey of 230 adults with type 1 diabetes using adjunctive tirzepatide or semaglutide at one center, patient-reported adverse events were recorded alongside glycemic control and medication details.

41807128.takeaway: Of 767 hospital-based studies screened, 44 were included to show how the glucometric terminology and models proposed in 2006 were actually used in inpatient diabetes research.

41807129.takeaway: Three large language models (ChatGPT-4o, Doubao 1.5 and DeepSeek R1) generated education materials from 10 de-identified discharge records of patients with diabetes, which nursing experts then rated for quality.

41809577.takeaway: Of 11 children with HNF1B variants at one center's atypical diabetes registry, 7 (64%) presented with diabetes, often MODY5, while the others were identified through family history or renal genetic evaluation.

41810512.takeaway: Sequencing 281 people with genetics-negative hyperinsulinism found 16 noncoding HK1 intron 2 variants in 18 (6.4%), half of them de novo, with onset from day 1 to 21 months.

41810517.takeaway: Across five observational studies of 11,475 people, individuals with type 1 diabetes were about half as likely to have an affected mother as an affected father (OR 0.55), indicating a relative maternal protective effect.

41811754.takeaway: Among 708,437 newborns screened for CAH, serum confirmatory tests by LC-MS/MS and radioimmunoassay were evaluated for their ability to reduce false-positive recalls.

41811759.takeaway: In 130 patients across 27 rare genetic neurodevelopmental conditions (43% children), total, acylated and unacylated ghrelin levels and hyperphagia scores were measured against PWS, obese and lean comparison groups.

41812234.takeaway: In 132,452 full-term singletons from Kaiser Permanente Northern California, mediation analysis tested how BMI in infancy and each childhood period relates to clinician-rated pubertal maturity ratings.

41817687.takeaway: Pooling 799 participants from nine phase II stage 3 type 1 diabetes trials, baseline beta-cell glucose sensitivity, with age, HbA1c and insulin dose, predicted the HbA1c effect of intervention.

41819111.takeaway: Using aggregated administrative mortality data from high-income jurisdictions (2000–2023), cause-specific death trends were compared between people with and without diabetes to test whether cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause.

41820251.takeaway: Reviews clinical challenges in transition from pediatric to adult care for young people with childhood-onset endocrine disorders, with management strategies for both pediatric and adult clinicians.

41821267.takeaway: An international consensus sets out a roadmap for European implementation of screening and monitoring for early-stage type 1 diabetes, where monitoring can greatly reduce DKA once symptomatic disease develops.

41821305.takeaway: In a Japanese cohort with ROHHAD syndrome, obesity was present in 72.7% and central hypoventilation in 36.2% at presentation, and serum prolactin was elevated at first consultation in all cases.

41821744.takeaway: In 52 children with isolated GH deficiency, pretreatment pituitary height and volume on MRI were examined as predictors of the growth response to rhGH therapy.

41821745.takeaway: In a multicentre randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of women aged 18–40 with primary dysmenorrhea in Shanghai, the Dysmenorrhea Patch was compared with placebo over three cycles, using total effective rate as the primary endpoint.

41821747.takeaway: In 490 working-age adults with type 2 diabetes at one medical center, a nomogram combining HbA1c, eGFR and systolic blood pressure was developed to identify diabetic macular edema, with a validation cohort of 147.

41823987.takeaway: In 573 children with 21-hydroxylase-deficient CAH from the I-CAH Registry, growth and BMI trajectories, including the timing of adiposity rebound, were modelled against glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid doses.

41830209.takeaway: In 217 youth aged 4–17 with type 1 diabetes, inhaled Technosphere insulin gave glucose excursions similar to adults on the same insulin, and smaller excursions and higher time in range than adults on rapid-acting analog.

41830217.takeaway: In a randomized trial of 59 participants after gastric bypass, a CGM-guided forecasting algorithm did not significantly reduce postbariatric hypoglycemia (31% vs 44%, p=0.30).

41831023.takeaway: In a randomized crossover trial of 12 adults with type 1 diabetes, the glycaemic response to morning fasted resistance exercise was more consistent than to afternoon fed exercise.

41832665.takeaway: Four 46,XY DSD cases with GATA4 variants, including congenital heart disease and hypospadias, showed variable genital, cardiac and gonadal phenotypes, and one twin with the same variants had no DSD.

41837125.takeaway: Proposes a three-panel workflow for medullary thyroid carcinoma that mandates germline RET testing for all patients and combines calcitonin, CEA, genotype and staging to guide surgery and surveillance.

41837139.takeaway: In 56 adults with type 1 diabetes, phase angle from body composition correlated negatively with HbA1c in both sexes, even after adjusting for age and weight.

41837323.takeaway: A 16-year-old with Graves' disease had late-onset, recurrent methimazole-induced agranulocytosis that required repeated G-CSF after the drug was stopped.

41837438.takeaway: In DCCT participants with virtual CGM profiles, those who had severe hypoglycemia had higher CGM-derived hypoglycemia and variability measures and lower HbA1c.

41837704.takeaway: In 58 children with GH deficiency in a real-world cohort (20 naive to somatrogon, 18 switched, 20 on somatropin), outcomes and quality of life were followed for six and twelve months.

41837708.takeaway: Among 665 youth with prediabetes, adding the Area Deprivation Index to an HbA1c model raised the AUC for predicting type 2 diabetes within a year from 0.68 to 0.73.

41837715.takeaway: In 210 children aged 12–60 months with and without obesity, prenatal, feeding, lifestyle, household and parental factors were compared to identify determinants of early childhood obesity.

41839742.takeaway: In 65 adolescents with Prader-Willi syndrome seen over 35 years, hypogonadism was diagnosed in 77% of females and 88% of males, and pubertal hormone replacement started in 80% of females and 60% of males.

41840147.takeaway: Reviews how overnutrition impairs lymphatic function in adipose tissue, leading to lymphoedema, adipogenesis and insulin resistance, and how lymphatic dysfunction can in turn promote adiposity.

41841385.takeaway: Of 26 children with central precocious puberty and short stature treated with triptorelin, 24 were treated to improve height, and indications, protocols and predicted adult height changes were summarized.

41842727.takeaway: Among 55,028 children with type 1 diabetes in a German registry, 9.7% had LDL above 3.4 mmol/L, and HbA1c, female sex and high BMI were the strongest correlates of LDL level.

41842822.takeaway: The Chilean Society of Pediatrics' nutrition branch recommends multidisciplinary pediatric obesity treatment, centred on nutritional interventions, family education, physical activity and early psychology referral.

41842913.takeaway: A 7-year-old boy with severe short stature and dysmorphic features was diagnosed with Kenny-Caffey syndrome type 2 after late-onset hypocalcemia, and GH treatment was started.

41842915.takeaway: In 16 patients under 20 treated with radioactive iodine for lung metastases of differentiated thyroid cancer (1973–2018), long-term disease-free survival and radiation pneumonitis rates were reviewed.

41842929.takeaway: In 15 patients with ovotesticular DSD followed for a median of 8.25 years in western India, 14 had gonadectomy and 14 were raised male, and none reported gender incongruence.

41842936.takeaway: Among 149 antibody-negative and 298 antibody-positive children with type 1 diabetes, celiac disease prevalence was 3.4% vs 5.0% and autoimmune thyroid disease 2.7% vs 4.4%.

41842968.takeaway: In 37,544 individuals with gestational diabetes followed for 12 years postpartum, machine learning identified four data-driven GDM clusters, each analysed for perinatal complications and postpartum diabetes.

41843702.takeaway: Among 154 Pediatric Endocrinology Society respondents, 70.1% had seen an adrenal crisis from adrenal suppression, and the survey was designed to support national pediatric guidelines on screening and management.

41843720.takeaway: In a prospective multicenter study of adolescents aged 12–19 with type 1 diabetes, the metabolic effects of high-intensity interval training were assessed, including time in range, glycemic variability, HbA1c, lipids and body composition.

41843914.takeaway: In 84 non-obese children with premature adrenarche (85.7% female), bone age advancement and predicted adult height were examined alongside growth acceleration.

41843922.takeaway: In 547 Vietnamese children aged 6–11, the C/C genotype of rs17782313 was associated with higher odds of metabolic syndrome (OR 2.28) under a recessive model.

41843941.takeaway: Five children with LRP5-related osteoporosis, referred for recurrent fractures, were followed after zoledronate therapy, with fracture and densitometric outcomes reported.

41844520.takeaway: In 50 children with pituitary stalk interruption syndrome followed a median of 5.9 years, 15 of 32 with isolated deficiencies developed more deficits, raising combined pituitary hormone deficiency from 32% to 62%.

41846236.takeaway: In 182 girls aged 6–9 (91 with central precocious puberty, 91 age-matched controls), volumetric MRI showed greater pituitary height in the CPP group, while global brain volumes did not differ.

41846242.takeaway: Of 524 articles reviewed, 16 met criteria on family and culture in type 1 diabetes transition readiness interventions; 37.5% included family components alone, 25% cultural alone, and 37.5% both.

41846525.takeaway: Two Chinese siblings with Oliver-McFarlane syndrome had growth hormone deficiency and a positive growth response to rhGH, and the elder brother also had secondary adrenocortical insufficiency, not previously documented in this syndrome.

41846542.takeaway: In 678 pregnant women with Graves' disease across 44 Dutch centres, trimester-specific TRAb titers predicted fetal or neonatal thyroid dysfunction with high accuracy.

41847449.takeaway: Four severely virilized 46,XX CAH individuals reared male kept a stable male gender identity, and a review of published cases found 43 of 50 with outcome data satisfied with male identity.

41847450.takeaway: In European sea bass, two gonadal soma-derived factor paralogues arose from lineage-specific duplications, with expression varying by sex and developmental stage.

41847829.takeaway: Two 46,XY siblings with pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 7 had hypoplastic male genitalia, absent uterus and cryptorchid testes, and a review of 26 further cases found elevated FSH in 7 of 7 with data.

41848173.takeaway: An adolescent girl with genetically confirmed POMC deficiency developed short stature with biochemically confirmed growth hormone deficiency, an association not usually expected in this obesity syndrome.

41852454.takeaway: In 85,347 healthy Australian schoolchildren aged 9–17, sex differences in exercise performance were analysed, and the largest differences were found to arise with puberty.

41852455.takeaway: In 27 females with Turner syndrome aged 13–19, visceral adiposity and fat mass were higher than in comparison groups, and 38% had dyslipidemia.

41852457.takeaway: In a prospective pregnancy and birth cohort of 218 children, serum PFOA from delivery to age 12 was associated with lower distal radius bone mineral density in early adolescence.

41852472.takeaway: Using narrative medicine interviews with 53 pediatric patients on daily rhGH and their caregivers, the study examined emotional experience, quality of life and factors shaping the burden of daily injections.

41852478.takeaway: In 56 adolescents (30 overweight, 26 normal weight), ultrafast pulse wave velocity quantified carotid arterial elasticity to detect early arterial changes in overweight.

41857721.takeaway: In 31 children and adolescents using automated insulin delivery for 28 days, time in range rose for two days after ultrasound-guided infusion set change and then fell by 4.7 percentage points per day.

41858856.takeaway: In 1,439 pregnant women randomized at 24–28 weeks to a two-step or one-step OGTT strategy, the study compared diagnostic yield and outcomes and tested OGTT time points as predictors of complications.

41858875.takeaway: In 15 children with GH deficiency compared with 15 age- and sex-matched children with idiopathic short stature, thalamic nuclei morphology and lateralization were examined on MRI.

41860303.takeaway: In 113 Chinese patients with complete 17α-hydroxylase deficiency, all presented as phenotypic females, with hypertension in 93.6% and hypokalemia in 74.3%, and 50 pathogenic CYP17A1 variants were identified, 6 of them novel.

41861056.takeaway: A 9-year-old boy with pituitary duplication and a ventricular septal defect had central precocious puberty, the first such report in a boy, and GnRH agonist treatment normalized growth and slowed bone maturation.

41861067.takeaway: A re-analysis of a published miRNA dataset in prepubertal children with GH deficiency found sex-specific changes after three months of GH therapy, with 3 miRNAs changed in females and 9 in males.

41863835.takeaway: Among 270 insulin-pump-naive youth with type 1 diabetes at Johns Hopkins, median time to automated insulin delivery start was 43.5 days, longest between prescription and pre-AID training.

41866961.takeaway: In 29 youths with obesity and prediabetes, 14 days of baseline CGM were used to predict HbA1c progression over six months.

41866965.takeaway: Analysing about 60 days of CGM data, the study compared three binning strategies and argued that splitting data at midnight artificially inflates glycemic variability estimates.

41869033.takeaway: Among 11,782 mother-infant pairs in Guangdong (1,734 with GDM), cardiac ultrasound parameters were compared between infants of mothers with and without GDM, stratified by infant age and sex.

41871528.takeaway: In 501 people with type 2 diabetes using a diabetes app with connected meters, time in range rose by 6.9 points in year 1, and the gain was still evident at year 5 (+7.5 points).

41871534.takeaway: A logistic regression calculator was built from electronic records of young-onset diabetes in Asian Indians, using age at diagnosis, BMI, parental history and HbA1c to estimate the probability of HNF1A- or HNF4A-MODY.

41871591.takeaway: Among 4,215 adults with type 1 diabetes in the FinnDiane cohort, 449 first-ever myocardial infarctions were verified, and incidence and risk profiles were compared between STEMI and NSTEMI.

41875073.takeaway: Among 16,415 Hispanic/Latino adults in HCHS/SOL, latent class analysis of nine social determinants of health was used to relate social adversity profiles to diabetes status and its change over about 12 years.

41875292.takeaway: Among 1,541 youth newly diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in 2018–2022, 84% started CGM within a year and 50% started a pump, and time to CGM start rose across higher social deprivation quintiles.

41877382.takeaway: Across 30 studies of 1,155 children under 7 with type 1 diabetes, automated insulin delivery raised time in range by a pooled 9.9 percentage points, about 2.4 hours a day.

41879358.takeaway: A Markov model of 5-year-old children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes compared self-monitoring, CGM and CGM with remote monitoring, projecting costs and QALYs over 20 years to lifetime.

41882966.takeaway: In 212 people with poor glycemic control (120 with type 1 and 92 with type 2 diabetes), the Q-Score detected in-hospital therapy changes more sensitively than time in range and other CGM metrics.

41884206.takeaway: Using Türkiye's national electronic health record system from 2018 to 2024, treated central precocious puberty incidence and prevalence were estimated, with changes across the COVID-19 period and geographic variation examined.

41884214.takeaway: In 282 children aged 8–16 performing walking, running, jumping and hopping on a force plate, peak vertical force and loading rates were quantified by sex and maturity status to inform bone health.

41884215.takeaway: A girl with hypercalcemia and non-autoimmune hypothyroidism at age 1 was diagnosed with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1b at 3.5 years, before symptomatic hypoparathyroidism, highlighting the value of checking calcium and phosphate in unexplained hypothyroidism.

41885138.takeaway: A novel homozygous TRPV6 deletion was linked to transient hyperparathyroidism and severe intrauterine osteopenia, consistent with impaired maternal-fetal calcium transport.

41885617.takeaway: In 563 mother-infant pairs in the Illinois I-KIDS study, maternal phthalate and phenol exposures in pregnancy were examined for associations with infant anogenital distance at birth, at mini-puberty and across infancy.

41890172.takeaway: In 417 children aged 5–18 across BMI categories, blood-count inflammatory indices (SII, SIRI, AISI and MHR) were compared with insulin resistance to test whether they reflect adiposity or metabolic impairment.

41890175.takeaway: Among 362 respondents with classical CAH (151 adults, 211 caregivers of children), quality of life was scored on a 0–100 scale across general health, adrenal insufficiency, glucocorticoid excess and other domains.

41890181.takeaway: In 1,863 Chinese patients with type 2 diabetes (22.9% with hyperuricemia), BMI correlated positively with hyperuricemia (r = 0.32) among the metabolic syndrome components examined.

41890183.takeaway: digiBONE, a deep learning tool, was developed to assess Greulich-Pyle bone age segment by segment in Indian children and adolescents, modelling different maturation rates across hand regions.

41890189.takeaway: In 13 children with congenital hyperinsulinism undergoing focal lesionectomy or subtotal pancreatectomy, Dexcom G6 CGM was evaluated for accuracy against capillary glucose and for its usefulness to clinicians.

41890190.takeaway: Probands with the KLF11 p.R29Q variant (MODY7) had insulin dependence, severe hyperlipidemia, diabetic retinopathy and cataract, and functional assays tested insulin promoter binding and secretion.

41890194.takeaway: In 76 children aged 3–11 with short stature (37 with GH deficiency, 39 with idiopathic short stature), bone turnover markers including osteocalcin were compared, with ROC analysis of their value for distinguishing the two.

41895315.takeaway: Reviews how AI could improve primary diabetes care in low- and middle-income countries for screening, risk prediction and monitoring, while noting barriers including infrastructure, data fragmentation, equity and regulatory oversight.

41905764.takeaway: In 19,029 people with diabetes who had routine fundus photography, a deep learning model trained on bilateral images with Cox-style outcomes stratified test-cohort mortality risk into quartiles with escalating hazard ratios.

41905765.takeaway: A wavelet-transform AI algorithm was developed to detect postprandial glucose responses from CGM alone in people without diabetes, tested on 25 normoglycemic adults and three validation cohorts totalling 65 participants.

41907541.takeaway: A scoping review of pediatric MASLD (2010–2025) compares global epidemiology and screening with the distinct genetic, environmental and diagnostic challenges in sub-Saharan Africa.

41907543.takeaway: Among 18 children after craniopharyngioma resection and 18 with idiopathic short stature on rhGH, the craniopharyngioma group reached comparable height gains with half the rhGH dose.

41907557.takeaway: Among 1,832 propensity-matched full-term SGA infants in a Korean national screening cohort, exclusive breastfeeding and exclusive formula feeding were compared for their association with catch-up growth by 42–48 months.

41907688.takeaway: In 55 children, antenatal exposure to a mixture of two PCBs and four PFAS measured in cord blood was associated with attention and executive function at age 6, with a sex-specific effect.

41907689.takeaway: In an 18-year-old woman with cutaneous skeletal hypophosphatemia syndrome, three years of burosumab every four weeks was well tolerated and corrected hypophosphatemia.

41911084.takeaway: In 808 children with newly diagnosed hyperglycaemia, the T1D genetic risk score discriminated type 1 diabetes well (AUC 0.919) and was tested as a way to prioritise children for monogenic diabetes testing.

41911157.takeaway: Among 736 children with central precocious puberty in the Portuguese registry, idiopathic cases in boys rose by 19.1% a year, and pathogenic MKRN3 variants were found in 2 of 15 boys tested by exome sequencing.

41911242.takeaway: In 185 people with cystic fibrosis aged 10 and over, a nonfasting 1-hour 50 g glucose challenge test was evaluated as first-line screening for CFRD and pre-CFRD against OGTT.

41911946.takeaway: In a real-world study of 641 children aged 2–17 with X-linked hypophosphatemia (498 on burosumab, 143 on oral phosphate and active vitamin D or no treatment), growth was modelled separately for children and adolescents.

41913979.takeaway: In 80 children with autoimmune hyperthyroidism, 24 of 48 (50%) who stopped antithyroid drugs relapsed, and an FT3/FT4 ratio of 0.42 or higher at diagnosis predicted relapse.

41914440.takeaway: Among 111 children with mild subclinical hypothyroidism followed for at least six months, 45 (40.5%) became euthyroid during follow-up.

41915459.takeaway: Reviews TEDDY, TrialNet and other cohort data linking BMI and adiposity to islet autoimmunity and progression through preclinical type 1 diabetes, with stronger associations in younger children and Hispanic populations.

41918296.takeaway: In 69 hospitalized children with type 1 diabetes, Dexcom G6 and G7 readings paired with capillary glucose had an overall MARD of 10.6%, improving over sensor days.

41918972.takeaway: Across 17 studies of 5,215 youth with type 2 diabetes, the pooled prevalence of comorbid depression was 23.1% (95% CI 18.0–29.1%), with substantial heterogeneity.

41921546.takeaway: In 729 participants of the Chilean Growth and Obesity Cohort followed to age 18, early puberty was examined against metabolic syndrome and insulin resistance, with metabolic syndrome in 9.8% of boys versus 4.1% of comparators.

41921573.takeaway: In 38 adolescent girls with menstrual diaries and daily urine hormone measures, 24 PFAS were measured in serum and related to cycle length and reproductive hormone levels using mixed models.

41922880.takeaway: Among 3,079 people with type 1 diabetes followed for 14 years, 272 (8.8%) reached a 50% eGFR decline to below 30, and blood pressure variability was examined as a risk factor.

41922972.takeaway: In 71 people with prediabetes or diabetes, smartphone-measured vibration perception thresholds correlated moderately with tuning-fork scores for detecting large-fibre sensory deficits.

41924297.takeaway: Rescreening 27 probands with unexplained congenital hyperinsulinism across 18 known genes was informative in 22% and gave definitive diagnoses in 4 participants.

41924298.takeaway: In a nationally representative NHANES sample of 287 US girls aged 12–19, higher free testosterone predicted greater metabolic syndrome severity.

41924524.takeaway: In 9,110 people aged 18–60, the CHG index was significantly associated with carotid atherosclerosis (OR 2.47), which was present in 33.9% of participants.

41925716.takeaway: Comparing 414 adults and 2,000 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, adults presented with DKA less often (32.6% vs 56.0%) and with slightly lower HbA1c.

41926547.takeaway: A multidisciplinary guideline sets out lifespan monitoring for MCT8 (Allan-Herndon-Dudley) deficiency, a rare X-linked thyroid hormone transporter disorder, and highlights heterogeneity in symptoms and outcomes.

41928639.takeaway: At baseline of a 24-week weight-loss trial, CGM profiles were characterized in adolescents with obesity without diabetes and examined by sex, age, excess BMI, physical activity and fasting biochemistry.

41928888.takeaway: In 47 trans men and 6 trans women who had 5–10 years of gender-affirming hormone therapy from adolescence, echocardiography showed normal systolic function in all, and only one trans man had grade 2 diastolic dysfunction.

41930239.takeaway: Reviews newly approved drug classes, including GLP-1 receptor agonists and SGLT-2 inhibitors, for youth-onset type 2 diabetes, noting limited large-scale long-term evidence and difficulty recruiting young people to trials.

41933482.takeaway: Reviews 37 studies using infrared thermography and artificial intelligence to detect diabetic foot complications and predict ulcer risk, concluding that these tools can support clinical decisions.

41933485.takeaway: In a post hoc analysis of 17 adults with type 1 diabetes on injections, a bolus calculator app with 50% prandial reduction was compared with usual care for glucose change around cycling.

41933491.takeaway: Introduces the dt-Report, a real-world survey of healthcare professionals and people with diabetes in European countries on diabetes technology use, covering AID dropouts, technology in type 2 diabetes and ageing.

41934628.takeaway: In 211 patients with ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome (173 Cushing's disease, 38 ectopic ACTH), ectopic ACTH was linked to more severe immune suppression, with lower CD4+ and CD3+ T-cell counts.

41934635.takeaway: Among 139 burosumab-naive people with XLH in a prospective monitoring program, burosumab produced significant, sustained improvements in serum phosphate z-scores at years 1 and 3, including in age groups excluded from trials.

41938119.takeaway: In a retrospective pediatric chart review of children with nonclassic CAH, peak cortisol after high-dose ACTH stimulation was compared between mild/mild and mild/severe genotype groups.

41947337.takeaway: In 9,856 youth with type 1 diabetes across 27 US centers (2020–2022), earlier AID start was linked to lower HbA1c at 24 months (7.1% if started within 6 months vs 9.8% in non-users).

41948559.takeaway: Of 27 Chinese children with diffuse congenital hyperinsulinism, 12 had surgery; the study describes indications, pancreatectomy choice and outcomes, with a median follow-up of 2.9 years.

41950158.takeaway: A community-based participatory and human-centred design process had adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes and their caregivers co-design peer support prototypes, beginning with digital stories of lived experience.

41950159.takeaway: Commonly used in silico tools distinguished deleterious MKRN3 missense variants poorly, and the study proposed additional classification criteria based on conservation and population constraint.

41952051.takeaway: Three girls with genetic hypoparathyroidism from CASR, GNA11 and GATA3 variants had chronic hypocalcemia and low PTH without neck surgery, and diagnosis was delayed by non-classical features.

41953514.takeaway: In 106 young people with type 1 diabetes followed for a median of 8.3 years in New Zealand, BMI SDS trajectories were examined, with age at diagnosis modifying the trend in girls.

41955216.takeaway: In 327 girls followed for six years in the LEGACY cohort, steroid metabolite profiles were tested for association with earlier breast development, with BMI and parent-reported child stress as modifiers.

41955566.takeaway: A systematic review of denosumab in adults with rare bone diseases found pain relief, lesion reduction and bone formation; 120 mg monthly or every three months for about a year worked for most.

41956113.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with Alström syndrome and growth hormone deficiency had severe dyslipidemia, and GH replacement improved her height to −1.9 SD while lipid levels stayed within the normal range long-term.
